listings.remarks: This stunning Mid-Century Modern home was built in 1950 for Roy Doty, the celebrated cartoonist. A rare opportunity to own an iconic home designed by Henry N. Wright, managing editor of Architectural Forum. Wright and George Nelson, published Tomorrow's Home (1945) a seminal work on the use of space and passive solar.  The Doty house is an "open space" weaving nature in through skylights and walls of glass. The flagstone entry leads into the open concept great room, highlighted by a wood paneled vaulted ceiling and floor to ceiling glass that integrates the indoor to outdoor living experience-a core tenet of the Mid-Century esthetic.  The great room includes the living-dining area and a den complete with a Fisher wood burning stove. The kitchen and adjoining sunroom transition to an oversized stone patio, all thoughtfully designed for casual living and entertaining. A raised loft office/studio that was Roy Doty's original workspace, and a "sunken" office space are perfectly placed off the entry hall. An attic storage space is accessed by iron rungs set in natural rock walls in the office. The primary bedroom has a private floating deck, and an ensuite bath. 3 additional family bedrooms complete the floor plan. A free standing two car garage is steps from the front door. One hour to NYC by car or Metro North. Parking is limited. There is street parking on side streets across from the house.

The character and improvements in place, are clearly setting the stage for a livable attic space, an additional 1/2 bath/laundry on the main floor. Included are hardwood floors to be installed, a custom marble bathroom, newer exterior siding, all replacement windows and traditional front covered porch adding welcoming charm. DO NOT MISS OUT ON THIS POTENTIAL UPGRADE IN LIVING AND ENJOYMENT!

Gracious colonial in Hubbard Heights. Inviting front porch. Spacious living room with built in shelves and a non working fireplace hardwood floors that need your touch. Formal dining room that is great for family gatherings. The bright eat in kitchen with newer dishwasher and refrigerator. There is a full bath off the kitchen with a shower done by bath fitters plus a mud room. The second level has the master bedroom with 3 additional bedrooms and a full bath. The finished walk up attic makes a great office space or play room. Partially finished lower level with a bath. Lovely private fenced in yard with a shed and new drive. Wonderful location in Hubbard Heights and close to the golf course. 5 minutes to bustling downtown Stamford, Metro North train station and I 95.

Rare combination of cul de sac living in the coveted Upper Newfield neighborhood, plus the serenity of a private location with a stunning in-ground heated pool and spa, within minutes of King School, Sterling Farms golf, tennis and theater, Davenport Ridge School, The Italian Center, shopping and the Merritt Parkway. This gracious 5 BR colonial with circular driveway offers an inviting floor plan perfect for today's lifestyle and entertaining. Front and back staircases, formal living and dining rooms, large family room with bar, sun porch, den, eat in kitchen with access to extensive two tiered deck overlooking grounds and pool, and powder room complete the main level. Upstairs the master suite includes a walk in closet and full bath. There are 4 additional bedrooms, 2 full baths and laundry. The lower level features a large walk out rec/playroom, lots of storage and 2 car garage. The home boasts significant improvements to the infrastructure and exterior including a generator. Lovingly maintained by its current owner this is an opportunity not to be missed!

Welcome Home to Harbor House! - The luxury waterfront community nestled along the Long Island Sound in Stamford. As you enter, the open floor plan draws you to the stunning water-views. This beautiful retreat includes an open floor plan, updated wood-burning fireplace with granite trim plus a sliding glass door to your private patio, the perfect place for alfresco dining. The kitchen includes all new stainless-steel appliances, sub-zero refrigerator and a wine refrigerator. As you enter the primary suite, you are once again awed by the amazing water views. The updated primary bath includes double sinks, stall shower, jacuzzi tub and beautiful marble flooring. Renovated half bath, washer/dryer and assigned underground parking are all included. All this, plus, Heat and Hot Water are included in the common charges. Move right in and enjoy Waterfront Living at its finest!

listings.remarks: Updated Ranch in Desirable Foxwood Lake Association Nestled on 1.49 scenic acres in sought-after North Stamford, this sun-filled ranch offers 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and the perfect blend of comfort and style. The eat-in kitchen features granite countertops and a spacious center island, opening to a formal dining room and a spacious living room with vaulted ceilings, fireplace, and an invisible LRX-83 | Stealth Acoustic speaker system-seamlessly built in for high-quality sound without disrupting the aesthetic. New hardwood floors run throughout the main level, and the updated bathrooms include discreet, wheelchair-friendly features designed for ease and comfort. Step onto the oversized screened-in deck and take in the private, tree-lined backyard-perfect for year-round enjoyment. A two-car garage adds convenience, while the finished lower level with a second fireplace offers flexible space for a home gym, playroom, media room, or guest suite.  Residents of the Foxwood Lake Association enjoy private lake access for fishing, canoeing, and tranquil sunset views-all just minutes from shopping, dining, trains, and highways.

Welcome to maintenance-free living in Strawberry Woods-one of Stamford's most sought-after private communities. Ideally located in mid-city, this spacious end-unit townhome is just a short walk to the train, shops, restaurants, fitness centers, schools, and houses of worship, yet privately set within 19 acres of beautifully manicured grounds.  The main level features an open-concept living and dining area with hardwood floors, double sliders, and a wood-burning fireplace, leading to a private patio.  Upstairs, the primary suite includes two double closets and an ensuite bath. The second bedroom has access to a private balcony. A third-floor loft provides additional space-perfect for a home office, den, or studio. Walk-in attic offers generous storage and future potential.  Additional features: gas heat, central air, in-unit washer/dryer on main level, attached garage, and ample guest parking. Community amenities include a heated inground pool and clubhouse.  Don't miss this rare opportunity to own an end-unit in one of Stamford's premier locations!

listings.remarks: This updated two-bedroom townhouse offers the best of both worlds - low-maintenance living with the feel of a private home. Set in a garden-style community with its own private entrance, this unit is bright, well-designed, and move-in ready.  The layout includes two bedrooms, one full bath, and a half bath, plus a private outdoor deck for grilling, working from home, or just catching some sun. The kitchen features updated finishes in neutral tones, offering a clean, modern look that blends easily with any style. Located just off Newfield Avenue, you're around the corner from the Newfield Green Shopping Center, and minutes from downtown, the train, and commuter routes. It's an ideal spot for anyone who wants to be close to everything but still have a quiet place to recharge.

Welcome to Anderson Ridge, Unit 22. A bright and spacious three-level townhome located in Stamford's desirable Glenbrook neighborhood. Offering approximately 1,384 square feet of living space, this well-maintained home combines comfort, functionality, and community amenities in a prime location walkable to the water! Just minutes from I-95, Metro-North, shopping, dining, and downtown Stamford, you'll have quick access to both local amenities, beaches and an easy commute to New York City.  Whether you're a first-time buyer, a growing family, or seeking an investment property, Unit 22 is a rare opportunity to own a spacious home in a sought-after Stamford community.

listings.remarks: OFFER DEADLINE: HIGHEST AND BEST Tuesday May 6 at 5PM. Welcome to this wonderful 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial located in the highly convenient Upper Springdale neighborhood. This beautifully renovated home truly checks all the boxes, offering a perfect blend of modern updates and classic charm. Renovation includes kitchen, powder room & 2nd level full bath, main roof, windows, & furnace. Hot water htr (2023)  The heart of the home is the stunning kitchen, featuring white cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and an island that overlooks the dining area - ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the spacious family room, highlighted by vaulted ceilings, a cozy fireplace, stylish shiplap accent walls, and custom built-ins and powder room. A sliding glass door leads out to the deck, perfect for relaxing or hosting gatherings. Attached one car garage conveniently located with just a few steps up to the kitchen.  Upstairs, you'll find four bedrooms and a newly renovated full bathroom with double sinks. There are hardwood floors throughout. The finished lower level provides additional living space with a recreation room and a full bath. Set on a lovely, level lot, the outdoor space offers plenty of room for play, gardening, or simply unwinding. Location is a commuter's dream - less than one mile to the Metro-North Springdale Train Station - and close to the library, schools, shopping, and dining.

Rare opportunity to own one of a few condominiums in the desirable Harbor Point neighborhood! Light and spacious home within a 5-minute walk to the lively waterfront area shops, dining, and nightlife. Just a 10-minute walk from Stamford Station with Metro North & Acela trains to Manhattan/NYC (45 mins). The inviting 1,135 square-foot interior has a wonderful flow for entertaining friends and family. A foyer opens to the large living room (18' x 17') for catching up and relaxing at the end of the day. The formal dining room adjoins an eat-in kitchen with stainless steel appliances, along with a newly renovated guest bath and lovely deck overlooking the backyard. Upstairs you'll find two generous bedrooms and a full bathroom, making a perfect primary suite and a second guest bedroom/office capturing views of Harbor Point. Rounding out the second floor is a convenient laundry closet. Be the first to see this beautifully maintained and decorated condo unit featuring hardwood floors, raised-panel wainscoting, built-ins, custom staircase with iron balustrade and ample windows filled with abundant natural light and views from every room. Highest and best due by Monday the 2nd at Noon.

Set on a lovely acre in North Stamford is this beautifully maintained, move-in-ready 4 bed, 2.5 bath Colonial. Step through the double door entry into a gracious foyer with two coat closets and an open staircase. The open-concept living and dining rooms boasts a fireplace and stunning wall of French doors that flood the space with natural light and lead to a partially covered patio-perfect for seamless indoor-outdoor living and entertaining. The spacious kitchen is a chef's delight with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances including a double oven, and a breakfast bar. It opens to a large family room with a second fireplace, vaulted ceilings with skylights, plus a built-in speaker system. The family room is large enough to provide the option of space for informal dining space or a playroom. A side entrance with a covered porch creates a cozy spot to enjoy morning coffee while watching the kids play. The main level also features a private home office, powder room, and a well-equipped laundry/mudroom. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a private bath, while three additional bedrooms share a hall bath with double sinks. There are also two hallway closets for ample storage. The unfinished basement provides excellent storage and potential for future expansion. Additional highlights include gleaming hardwood floors, recessed lighting, central air conditioning, and a two-car garage. Neighborhood favorite, LaRocca's market, is also within walking distance

Tucked away on a meticulously kept cul-de-sac, this spacious and refined Colonial offers the perfect combination of comfort, elegance, and convenience. Situated in one of Stamford's most sought-after, commuter-friendly neighborhoods, the home showcases an airy, open-concept layout designed for modern living and a new roof! At the heart of the home, a sun-drenched kitchen features gleaming quartz countertops and a sleek tile backsplash, effortlessly flowing into a warm and inviting family room complete with a cozy fireplace and sliding doors that open to a private deck-perfect for seamless indoor-outdoor entertaining. A vaulted ceiling enhances the generous living room, which connects beautifully to a large dining area ideal for hosting. Upstairs, the tranquil primary suite impresses with tray ceilings, a luxurious en-suite bath, and a walk-in closet with custom built-ins. Two additional spacious bedrooms and a conveniently located laundry room complete the upper floor. The fully finished lower level expands your living space with a flexible den, a third full bath, and an additional room ideal for guests or a private home office.

Discover this private 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home in Stamford, CT, offering the perfect mix of space, style, and serenity. The main level features a bright living room, formal dining room, updated kitchen, dedicated office, spacious family room, and a full bath-ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, you'll find a luxurious primary suite complete with a full bathroom and walk-in closet, plus two additional bedrooms and another full bath. The finished basement adds even more flexibility for a media room, gym, or guest space. Step outside to your own backyard oasis with a pool, lush garden, fire pit, and pergola-perfect for relaxing or hosting all year round. This move-in ready Stamford home offers privacy, functionality, and the outdoor lifestyle today's buyers are searching for.

Rarely offered but frequently sought after, is this vintage Mediterranean style home with its stucco exterior and timeless Terra Cotta roof. A charming awning covered terrace with decorative ironwork, leads to a petite mud room and the heart of the home kitchen. Arched doorways, a vestibule main entrance and tall windows topped with pediments, classic stone fireplace, open and delightful spaces all enhance the main level, including a banquet sized dining room with a vaulted, beamed ceiling and windowed walls overlooking the rushing Rippowam river. Three second floor bedrooms all with their own unique personality share a full bath. The lower level rec space and laundry room adjoin a private suite of rooms perfect for an au pair, in law or extended stay guests. A walk to everything in town location.

Nestled in a picturesque and serene setting, this charming colonial offers the perfect blend of classic architecture and modern comfort. Set on over an acre of beautifully landscaped, park-like grounds with stone walls and mature plantings, this light-filled home features 3,198 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space and a gross partly finished basement adding an extra 1,152 square feet. The main level welcomes you with an open-concept kitchen and living area, complete with hardwood floors, a cozy fireplace, and oversized windows that bathe the space in natural light. A home office or library with floor-to-ceiling built-ins provides the ideal work-from-home environment. The formal dining room is perfect for entertaining, and the stunning vaulted-ceiling family room offers a warm and inviting space for gatherings. The home features two full baths and one-half bath. Upstairs, you'll find four generously sized bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with a marble-clad bathroom and a walk-in ample closet space, offering comfort and convenience for family and guests. Step outside to enjoy the peaceful, private backyard, which includes a trex deck and a stone patio-ideal for outdoor dining or quiet relaxation.

Don't miss this immaculate and well maintained 3 bedroom 2 full bath ranch style home located on cul-de-sac in convenient Newfield area. You will love this spacious eat-in kitchen with dining area and island, and sun-filled living room with gas fireplace. The family room with vaulted ceiling is just off of the kitchen. In addition, the lower level is partially finished with office, sitting room, walk-in closet, cedar closet, storage room, laundry room, full bath and workshop area. Gas heat, central air, heated 2 car detached garage, and brick patio for entertaining. Great location!

Welcome to this warm and inviting home in the desirable mid-ridges. Nestled in between High Ridge and Long Ridge Rd. this home is spacious and inviting with lots of natural light and is great for hosting or just relaxing. Walk into the open floor plan family room and kitchen. Down the hall you will find three bedrooms and a newly updated bathroom. Continue through the kitchen to a wonderful dining room that flows into a large and open living room with a laundry room and full bathroom. On the other side of the dining room you will find a large den which can be used as a fourth bedroom with an additional private office space with a generous walk in closet. The landscaped lawns and gardens give you a place to rest and relax on sunny days. A large deck will provide ample space for BBQ and outdoor dining and hosting. You don't want to miss this opportunity to have a slice of this desirable neighborhood.

Welcome to 5 Amherst place, conveniently located in the mid-ridges neighborhood of Stamford minutes to the Merritt Parkway and downtown. This expanded and renovated raised ranch has been meticulously maintained and is sited on a branch of the Rippowam River. The main level features an open layout, hardwood floors and expanded kitchen family room with vaulted ceiling and slider access to an oversized deck. The primary ensuite bedroom was also expanded with double vanity bath sink and oversized walk in closet. Two additional bedrooms and a guest bath complete the first floor.  Not to be overlooked is the walk out lower level featuring the fourth bedroom and full bath, plus a second family room that walks out to a covered patio and views of the river.  An extra storage room behind the two car garage is additional versatile space.

PRICE REDUCTION ($385/SQFT) Stunning 2022 Custom New Construction home w/sparkling waterfront views. Set back far from the road, sited on 2.20 level acres in a serene new subdivision w/a pond, this fabulous modern farmhouse features 6 bedrooms, 6.5 baths, 3 car garage & custom elevator accessing 3 levels of finished living space. Boasting 6,219 sq ft (2,239sf unfinished space in the lower-level w/walkout+plumbed for a bath), propane gas heat, city water, a full house generator & fenced in yard, this home is incomparable. A designer showcase gem, this home has an expansive open concept floor plan with unique glass panel walls, barn doors, white-oak hardwood flooring throughout, high ceilings, surround sound speakers, motorized shades, two-story double entry foyer with floating staircase looking up to a glass walled 2nd fl media room with a 20' ceiling to the Finished 3rd floor above. The gourmet kitchen, w/Viking appliances/quartz counters w/9' x 5' center island & 10ft long beverage counter, w/custom cabinetry, 2 wine fridges & bar sink adjoins the breakfast area, a large family room w/fireplace, walls of windows & 8-glass door panels allowing abundant sunshine indoors & views to the fenced yard & pond. Step outside to the flagstone patio w/built-in grill & stone walls, the perfect venue for outdoor entertaining. There's a proper dining room area, spacious living room & 1st floor bedroom/office w/fireplace, full bath & glass doors to flagstone patio.

Thoughtfully designed with a great layout and abundant natural light, this home features skylights in the kitchen, new stainless steel appliances, a spacious island, fireplace and multiple inviting living areas for relaxation, work or entertaining. The main-level master suite is a true retreat featuring high ceilings adorned with stunning exposed beams, complete with a private sitting or office area, walk-in closet, and ensuite bathroom featuring a stand-up shower and jetted bathtub. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, a versatile office space and a full bathroom with another relaxing jetted tub. The finished basement expands your living options with an additional bedroom, full bathroom, kitchenette, and spacious living area, ideal for in-laws, guests or potential for further customization. The basement also offers ample storage and a laundry area. Outside, enjoy the fenced-in yard and patio, 1-car attached garage with a paved driveway for additional parking. Located just minutes from downtown, schools, parks, dining, shopping plazas & the train station, this home combines convenience with comfort. *Agent related to seller.

Welcome to 477 Woodbine Road located in North Stamford, CT and minutes to downtown New Canaan.  Surrounded by lush specimen plantings, stone walls, plus a free form in-ground pool, this country cottage exudes charm. Renovated and expanded this cape style home features handsome hard wood floors throughout, built-ins, Anderson windows & doors, and two fireplaces.  The impressive living room incudes a cathedral ceiling with exposed beams, large wood burning fireplace and double sliding doors to a stone patio overlooking the pool. Adjacent to the kitchen is a cozy dining area that leads to a sunken family room. A cozy gas fireplace, casual dining area and double sliders to a new Trex deck complement the family room.  A first floor primary bedroom suite with full bath, ample closet space, sliders to the deck, plus another full bath complete the first floor. Upstairs, there are two en-suite bedrooms with generous closets, hardwood floors and plenty of storage space. Set on over 2 bucolic acres yet easy access to downtown New Canaan and Pound Ridge.

This solidly built and well-maintained ranch-style home, built in 1940, is great for those who love to entertain with ease. It has many updates, and an open, easy floor plan with abundant natural light throughout. There's a spacious living room with built-ins, dining area, and expansive family room with fireplace off the kitchen. Step out onto the deck from here and appreciate a flat, fenced in yard for many backyard activities. The kitchen has newer appliances and breakfast bar. Much of the hard work has been done: gas stove (2025), newly paved driveway (2025), windows (2024), siding (2024), hot water heater (2021), roof and solar panels for the utmost in energy efficiency (2021) and washer/dryer (2020). Other features include an attached garage, hardwood floors, central air, and natural gas. Just add your personal cosmetic touches and you've got a gem. The Glenbrook neighborhood is known for its charm and convenience to schools, shopping, restaurants, Metro North, the beach, dog park, and downtown Stamford. Make your dream of home ownership a reality!

Rare opportunity to own a classic ranch in The Cove, one of Stamford's more sought-after neighborhoods. Outside, enjoy an acre of beautifully landscaped backyard perfect for gatherings, gardening, or a potential pool, with a welcoming porch and double doors that create seamless indoor-outdoor living. With three fireplaces, central air, and updated windows, this home delivers warmth, style, and functionality in an unbeatable location.

Welcome to your new home...this updated 4 BR split-level home is set on 1/3 acre in desirable mid-Ridges. Enjoy sitting in your living room, by the lovely stone fireplace. Your beautiful newer granite kitchen has imported tile backsplash and brand new stainless steel appliances. Enjoy your relaxing, sunny family room--or entertain on your oversized deck in your elevated, private back yard. This home has two bedrooms on the main level and a half bath. In the upper level, you will find two additional bedrooms with plenty of closet space and a beautiful full bath with wainscoting. New roof, leaf gutter system and sump pump. Come to see this great home in wonderful neighborhood - you won't be disappointed!

If you have not found what you're looking for, bring your imagination and come finish this 3-5-bedroom, 2 full bath raised ranch. This home is situated on a corner, level lot. Much of the work has been done. All required permits were pulled. The kitchen has been completely gutted, along with the main level bathroom. Choose your own colors and finishes. Hardwood floors throughout the main level. The lower level of this home features a large family room with sliders that take you to your outdoor patio. You'll have plenty of room for a swimming pool in your spacious yard. The 4th and possibly 5th bedroom/home office is located on this level as well. In addition, there is a full bath with shower stall along with a designated laundry area/closet. There is a newly installed hot water heater. Economical natural gas heat warms this home, and central air will keep you cool this summer!  This home is conveniently located to all major highways, shopping, and Metro transportation. Make this your dream home today!! Cash, Conventional Rehab, 203K or Rehab loan.

Historic Charm Meets Modern Luxury - Once the carriage house for the famed 1760s estate "The Owl's Nest," this exquisitely renovated home blends timeless charm with today's comforts. Original doors and vintage details have been preserved, while high-end updates elevate every space. Inside, enjoy 9-ft ceilings, gleaming hardwood floors, and two stunning fireplaces (one stone, one brick). The spacious living room opens to an expansive two-tiered stone patio featuring a hot tub-perfect for entertaining. The gourmet kitchen offers granite counters, stainless appliances, and flows into a welcoming family room with a brick fireplace. A warm formal dining room and elegant half bath complete the first floor. Upstairs, you'll find four large bedrooms and two updated baths. The sunlit primary suite with a bath featuring radiant heated floors, custom cabinetry, and refined tilework. Two bedrooms are double-sized with walk-in closets, and the fourth is perfectly sized for guests, a nursery, or a stylish home office-bright and versatile. Hall bath has a radiant heated floor. All bedrooms have hardwood floors, and the upper hallway offers exceptional storage. Surrounded by professionally landscaped and lush plantings, this home is a private oasis. A detached studio with electricity offers endless possibilities: gym, office, artist studio, or just a quiet retreat. Located in sought after and convenient Westover, this home is a rare find-a must-see.

Wonderful 2-Bedroom First-Floor Condo - Great Location for Commuters!  Plenty of living space in this well-maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath first-floor unit. Newer Kitchen, Bathroom and floors, perfect for owner-occupants or investors alike! Conveniently located near Post Road with easy access to I-95, this home offers unmatched convenience for commuters. Walking distance to the bus line, restaurants, parks, and everyday amenities.  Enjoy a spacious living room and two good sized bedrooms located on opposite ends of the hallway, providing added privacy. Coin-operated laundry facilities are located in the lower level for your convenience. Includes one assigned parking space and plenty of guest parking.  Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to own in a desirable and accessible location!

WE HAVE MULTIPLE OFFERS, BEST AND FINAL DUE SUNDAY MAY 18, BY 4PM! NO EXCEPTIONS! Great investment opportunity in a desirable building near downtown. This unit offers living room/dining area combo with full bath off the living room, galley kitchen and a separate bedroom. One indoor garage space, monthly common charges include all utilities, heat, hot water and YES even electricity is included. Building features 24/7 concierge, gym, sauna and laundry room. Unit is in need of complete updating, HVAC/AC unit does not work and needs replacement, condition of the unit is reflected in the listing price. No rental restriction, 1 bedroom units in this complex were recently renting between $1,700-$1,825 depending on the condition. Unit is sold strictly "AS IS" NO INSPECTION CONTINGENCIES WILL BE ACCPETABLE!! CASH OFFERS ONLY due to high investor ratio of ownership in the complex. AGENTS PLEASE READ AGENT REMARKS REGARDING OFFER SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS.

listings.remarks: Experience comfort, sustainability, and style at 996 Stillwater Rd, a meticulously updated 4-bdrm, 2.5-bth contemporary home located in the sought-after Westover neighborhood. Situated on a serene 0.73-acre, this spacious residence offers over 3,000 sqft of total living space, including a partlly finished lower level ideal for a homeoffice, gym, playroom, or guest retreat.The main level features vaulted ceilings, hardwood floors, and oversized windows that bathe the interior in natural light. A formal dining room with Palladian windows and a cozy living room with sliders seamlessly connect to the heart of the home-a well-appointed kitchen.The sun-filled family room includes a wood-burning fireplace and opens to a large private deck, perfect for outdoor dining or entertaining. Upstairs, the prmary ste boasts a full bth, hardwood flrs, and private balcony. Energy efficiency is a standout feature, with a 6.81 kW SunPower solar power system (2016) generating approx. 5,000 kWh/year, reducing electric costs by over $1,500 annually. Recent major upgrades include a new roof (2018), high-efficiency HVAC system (2019) with smart Ecobee thermostats, a Navien tankless hot water heater, and a comprehensive water treatment system (2024). The WiFi-enabled irrigation system (2022) adds even more convenience.Perfectly blending form, function, and sustainability, Westover gem offers an exceptional opportunity for modern suburban living minutes from downtown Stamford, shopping, commuter routes.

Set on two professionally landscaped acres in North Stamford, this beautifully updated 5/6 bedroom home was fully renovated in 2023 and 2024. Spacious rooms feature timeless millwork and a flowing layout ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The custom gourmet kitchen offers Woodmode cabinetry, marble countertops, Sub-Zero and Viking appliances, a large island, eat-in area, and walkout access to the backyard oasis. Outside, enjoy a gunite pool surrounded by a patio, mature trees, and manicured gardens, plus a custom-built firepit, perfect for summer days or evening gatherings. The living and family rooms each feature a wood-burning fireplace, while front and back staircases enhance the home's seamless flow. The primary suite is a serene retreat with a walk-in closet and spa-like bath with marble finishes, soaking tub, glass-enclosed shower, and double vanity. A generous mudroom with side entry, 3-car garage with oversized driveway, and a walkout lower level with gym/playroom, workshop, wine cellar, and storage complete the home. With city water, 6-bedroom septic, and proximity to the Merritt, shopping, and dining, this property offers comfort, style, and convenience.

Welcome to the heart of the desirable Pepper Ridge neighborhood, where timeless New England charm meets modern comfort. This classic Cape Cod home is nestled on a beautifully landscaped lot, offering exceptional curb appeal and a warm, inviting atmosphere. Step inside to discover a gracious Formal Living Room adorned with hardwood floors, a cozy fireplace, and custom built-in bookcases-perfect for relaxing or entertaining guests. The Formal Dining Room features elegant French doors that open to a private Study, ideal for a home office or reading retreat. At the heart of the home is an expansive kitchen, thoughtfully designed with abundant cabinet and counter space, a full suite of appliances-including a dishwasher, refrigerator, and electric range-and a delightful breakfast nook framed by a charming bay window. The rear Sun Room is a true showstopper, bathed in natural light from skylights and large windows overlooking the deck and backyard. Complete with wall-to-wall carpeting and a wood-burning stove, it's the ultimate space for gatherings year-round. A convenient powder room completes the main level layout. Upstairs, you'll find three spacious bedrooms and two full bathrooms, all with hardwood flooring and generous closet space. The lower level offers a one-car garage and a versatile unfinished area, with a workshop, storage, laundry, and housing the home's mechanical systems. Don't miss this opportunity to own a piece of quintessential New England living in Stamford.

Welcome to this well-maintained 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath raised ranch located on a quiet street with a cul-de-sac in Stamford's desirable Mid-Ridges neighborhood. Perfectly positioned just minutes from the Merritt Parkway and downtown Stamford, this home offers both convenience and tranquility.   Step inside to an open main level featuring hardwood floors and a light-filled living and dining area. A sliding glass door off the dining room opens to a deck overlooking a serene branch of the Rippowam River-ideal for morning coffee or evening entertaining. The kitchen has stainless appliances, pantry, and a tile floor. Three bedrooms and a full bath complete the main level.   The lower level offers versatile living space with a family room that walks out to a covered patio and back yard. You'll also find a second full bath, laundry room, and an additional room-perfect for a home office, gym, playroom, or potential fourth bedroom. An oversized garage with direct access from the basement provides ample storage and convenience.   A perennial garden frames the front of the home, adding to its charm. This property blends comfort, space, and nature in a sought-after Stamford location-don't miss your chance to make it yours!  NO FLOOD INSURANCE REQUIRED

*H&B due by Tuesday, June 24 at Noon*  Welcome to a true unicorn of an investment opportunity - 10 Elmwood Street. This rare 3-family property features three side-by-side townhouse-style units, each offering 3 bedrooms, 1.5 baths, private entrances, and over 1,115 sq ft of living space. Each unit includes finished or finishable basement space with laundry. Long-term tenants are in place, all on leases through October 2025, and consistently pay on time. While current rents are well below market value, each unit has the potential to generate over $3,000/month with updates - plus, there's an additional garage on the property that offers extra potential rental income. Investors, this is your chance to own a multi-family property with tons of upside and imagination. New gutters installed in 2024 as well as new kitchen floors in each unit. The property needs some TLC, but the bones are strong and the income potential is huge. Properties like this simply don't hit the market often - especially at this price point. Whether you're looking to hold, renovate, or maximize profits, 10 Elmwood Street checks every box. See it quickly-this one won't last!

The perfect blend of classic charm and modern elegance in this completely remodeled and reimagined 1950 farmhouse colonial, nestled on a lush acre in the sought-after Revonah Woods area. This stunning home boasts five well-appointed bedrooms, including a versatile main-level bedroom that can serve as a home office or guest room with a full bath. An open flow concept seamlessly connects the living spaces, creating an inviting atmosphere that's ideal for entertaining and comfortable living. The thoughtful design honors the home's original character while incorporating contemporary finishes and amenities that cater to today's lifestyle. The dramatic kitchen with vaulted ceiling, 2 sinks & 2 dishwashers & dining area. Large windows bathe the interior in natural light. Upstairs are 4 generous sized bedrooms. The primary suite is a luxurious retreat, featuring walk in closet and spa-like ensuite bathroom. Outside, the property's acreage offers a private in ground heated pool with plenty of room for outdoor activities and relaxation. Enjoy summer breezes in the screened porch off of the living room. There is also a finished lower level. The home's idyllic setting in Revonah Woods offers a serene environment while still being conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, and houses of worship.

330 Emery Drive East - First time on the market in 42 years in the coveted Highcliff community. This classic stone-front Cape Cod is ideally located in Lower Westover near the Greenwich border. Set on private lot, the home offers four bedrooms and four full baths, with timeless charm and warm, livable spaces. A spacious living room with wood-burning fireplace and formal dining room open to a serene screened-in porch-creating an effortless indoor-outdoor flow perfect for entertaining or relaxing. The home has been lovingly maintained and tastefully updated, offering the perfect blend of traditional character and modern comfort. The flexible layout and expansion potential in the upper levels allow for future customization. Enjoy the exceptional lifestyle that comes with living in Highcliff, including a full calendar of neighborhood events, private pool, tennis courts, playground, and basketball and volleyball areas. Just minutes to downtown Stamford restaurants, shops, golf, medical facilities, highways, and Metro-North, this is a rare opportunity to own a legacy home in one of Stamford's most sought-after communities.

listings.remarks: Nestled in the highly sought after waterfront community of Shippan Point,142 Downs will make you truly feel like you are living the coastal lifestyle. This beautifully maintained home features 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, an open floor plan filled with natural light and stunning water views from every front window. The living and family rooms are connected by an elegant double-sided gas fireplace, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere. A large 4th Bedroom Suite (currently a gym) with the option for a private entrance is a space with limitless potential to suit your needs. The generous deck overlooking a fenced backyard is an ideal setting for entertaining or relaxing amid lush rose bushes, hydrangeas, and gently swaying seagrass.  A spacious and recently upgraded primary suite with a luxurious marble bathroom is your private retreat offering breathtaking water views and even Manhattan skyline in the distance. Private deeded beach access is steps from your door (no HOA). The perfect spot to launch your paddleboard or kayak, relax, and enjoy stunning sunsets.  Shippan Point offers miles of quiet roads ideal for enjoying spectacular vistas of Long Island Sound. Just minutes from vibrant downtown Stamford, residents enjoy a wealth of shopping, dining, entertainment, city parks, marinas and beaches. A 5 minute drive to Stamford train station makes New York City reachable in under an hour.  This exquisite home seamlessly combines beachside tranquility with elegant coastal living.

An updated and spacious classic Cape with extra spaces for flexible living. Renovations include professionally finished basement with new full bath, new roof & windows, dual stage boiler, radiators. An endearing home with arched doorways, plaster walls, oak floors. Main level: updated kitchen, large living room w fireplace, dining room, bedroom + full bath, 3-season porch. The upper level holds two bedrooms, renovated full bath, and fantastic attic storage room. Amazing fully finished lower level playroom + office space w new full bath + laundry room. Fully fenced backyard, driveway gate, oversized garage. This home offers yesteryear character, great space, and close proximity to everything!

Welcome to Davenport Farm - the premier enclave in North Stamford, where timeless New England charm meets modern living. Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac within one of Stamford's most desirable private associations, this stylish 4-bedroom home offers the perfect blend of privacy, space, and comfort. This classic Colonial features a front to back formal living room and an elegant dining room with timeless wainscoting. The updated eat-in kitchen boasts quartz countertops and a large island with seating, seamlessly flowing into a spacious family room with vaulted ceilings and abundant natural light. With easy outdoor access to a spacious deck to overlook the beautifully landscaped, private yard-this home is perfect for entertaining inside and out.  The spacious primary suite with vaulted ceiling includes a large bath and walk-in closet, while three additional bedrooms share a generously sized renovated hall bath. The huge finished lower level with full bath provides flexible space for a home office, gym, guest bedroom and playroom. Outside, the private yard is beautifully landscaped with perennials-offering the perfect setting for both playtime and pup. 2 car attached garage. Just a few minutes to quaint New Canaan downtown and bustling Stamford. Beach rights.

Nestled on a peaceful cul-de-sac in a desirable Stamford neighborhood, this well-maintained 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home offers comfort, space, and convenience. Step inside to find a bright and inviting living room with bay window, a separate dining area, terrific for gatherings and sliding doors out to the back deck and patio, perfect for outdoor entertaining! The kitchen offers a dining area, as well as granite counters and ample storage. All three bedrooms are nicely-sized, bright, offering good closet space. The full bathroom is centrally located on the upper level as well. On the lower level, there is a paneled family room with built-ins and a half bathroom, offering direct access to the one car attached garage and basement. Enjoy the tranquility of suburban living with close proximity to schools, parks, and shopping, as well as a short drive to the Merritt Parkway and minutes to vibrant downtown Stamford! With its versatile layout, new roof in October 2023 and prime location, this home is a must-see!

Charming solid Cape off High Ridge Road just south of Rippowam Middle School. Enter the inviting living room with glistening hardwood floor just refinished, large front windows flanked by bookshelves, and a fireplace. Cozy sunroom/enclosed porch off the living room with access to the patio and pool area. Patio with in ground pool access, and a large fenced and sloping back yard. Separate dining room also with gleaming refinished hardwood floor. Kitchen back door leads to patio, pool, and back yard.  Down a several steps from living room to garage level, with washer and dryer and the oil burning furnace. Garage access from this level, and also a door to the side yard. Quiet neighborhood with no through traffic. Bedrooms are up a few stairs above the garage area, and a full hall bath. The private primary bedroom and its own half bath is up a few more stairs above the main floor living room, dining room, and kitchen. Property sold 'As Is'. Access to attic via pull-down stairs.

This spacious 1-bedroom, 1.5-bath condo offers 1,057 square feet of comfortable, well-designed living space. The expansive 30-foot living room flows seamlessly to a screened-in balcony-perfect for relaxing-and a dining area that easily accommodates eight guests. You'll love the beautiful parquet floors throughout, along with generous storage, including a 12-foot-wide closet and a walk-in closet in the bedroom. The kitchen and both bathrooms have been tastefully updated, making this home move-in ready. Regency Towers is ideally located across from the Tully Health Center and just a short walk to Stamford's vibrant downtown, filled with shops, restaurants, and entertainment. Plus, you'll enjoy easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, Metro-North, local beaches, and more. The HOA includes 24/7 door staff, an on-site superintendent, updated security systems, garage parking, and utilities-heat, hot water, and cooking gas. Laundry facilities are conveniently located on every floor. This is a wonderful opportunity to live in one of Stamford's most sought-after buildings-don't miss it!

listings.remarks: Welcome to 270 W. Main St., Stamford, a unique property located in the CB (Community Business) Zone-a versatile area designated for light community business such as hair dresser etc. and residential use. Although currently taxed as a single-family residence, the property presents a flexible layout with the top floor consisting of a 1-bedroom apartment and the lower floor currently vacant. The vacant space offers possible community business use, in line with zoning allowances, or the opportunity to convert the property back into a larger 4-bedroom single-family residence. **Please note, agent and owners make no representation regarding the current or future use of this property. Buyer to perform their own due diligence to verify permitted uses and development potential under current zoning regulations.  Property being sold as is with contents. Please note: Showings include access to the main floor and lower level only. Viewing of the upper level is available by separate appointment upon request, if there is continued interest.

Grand, unspoiled and oversized two family, owned and occupied by the same family for over 70 years. Located on a quiet, sidewalk and tree lined street within walking distance of Stamford Hospital and central downtown. Both units have an eat in kitchen with walk in pantry plus banquet sized dining room and living room, 8 1/2' ceilings and hardwood floors. The unfinished, walk up attic is approximately 1,300 square feet with windows front, back and both sides. The unfinished basement encompasses 2 partially finished rooms including laundry and ample storage areas. Two car detached garage. Replacement windows and vinyl siding. Two gas meters, hot water heaters and electrical panels. One boiler, two thermostats.

Welcome to this bright and airy 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse nestled in the highly desirable Glenbrook neighborhood. Thoughtfully designed for comfort and convenience, the main level offers easy day-to-day living with an open flow perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. The sunlit primary bedroom features a full bath and plenty of natural light, while the spacious second bedroom boasts a charming loft-ideal for extra storage, a cozy reading nook, or a creative hideaway. The lower-level rec room is perfect for workouts or movie nights, and an additional finished room offers flexible space for a guest bedroom or home office. Located just moments from I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, and within walking distance to shopping, dining, entertainment, Glenbrook Train Station, and local sports fields-this home combines location, lifestyle, and livability in one perfect package.****SELLER RECEIVED MULTIPLE OFFERS AND DECISIONS WILL BE MADE MONDAY 7/14 @ NOON****

Here is an opportunity to purchase a sophisticated and updated modern farmhouse set off the road on top of a knoll offering a private country atmosphere. It is an oasis-like property with exterior features that are rarely found at this price point. An outdoor patio, a heated in-ground pool, a covered pergola with a dining area and ornamental gardens with splendidly landscaped seating areas. As you enter the front door you will appreciate the period details and quality finishes. The large living room with a fireplace and dining room have French doors leading to the outdoors. A newer bright chef's kitchen with excellent appliances and amenities, such as lighted cabinetry, Carrera marble breakfast bar & countertops, a dining area and heated floors. On the upper level you will find the primary suite with a fireplace, an exquisite marble bath also with heated floors and substantial custom closet space. In addition, there are two other bedrooms, a renovated hall bath and an office space overlooking the picturesque back yard. Recent upgrades include an in-ground heated pool, HVAC, septic, well pump, many windows, full house generator and an attic with spray foam insulation for energy efficiency. It is truly a home for the discriminating person searching for a classically unique property. All highest and best offers expected by 12noon on July 14th

Opportunity is knocking on this move in condition, two bedroom, 1 bath townhouse with a finished lower level located in the desirable Sylvan Knoll complex. The unit has been updated with an eat in kitchen with granite counters, an updated bathroom central air conditioning and common charges include water and property taxes. The property is conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, Chelsea Piers, downtown, I-95, train stations and beaches. This is an estate sale and is sold in As Is condition and is subject to probate court approval. Unit must be owner occupied, buyer must apply and be approved by the co-op, debt to income ratio cannot exceed 30%.

Welcome to this meticulously maintained 3BR, 2.5baths ranch-style home nestled on a serene and level 1.36-acre lot in desirable North Stamford. Perfectly blending modern upgrades with timeless charm, this home offers comfort, style, and convenience just minutes from local amenities. Step inside to discover a thoughtfully renovated interior featuring 10-11" raised ceilings, custom woodwork, and European iron hot water radiators that add character and warmth. The spacious living areas are complemented by all-new plumbing and wiring, ensuring peace of mind for years to come. The heart of the home boasts a seamless flow from the spacious kitchen to the inviting living and family spaces, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Each bedroom is generously sized with new custom closets. Many but not all improvements include a new roof, new hot water heater, walls insulation, and foundation waterproofing. Enjoy outdoor living on the new granite patio, perfect for relaxing or hosting guests in your private backyard oasis with a playground and zip-lines. A whole-house generator adds an extra layer of security and comfort. This move-in-ready gem combines the tranquility of a spacious lot with proximity to shopping, schools, and commuter routes. Don't miss the opportunity to own a truly turnkey home in one of Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods. DEADLINE TO SUBMIT THE BEST AND HIGHEST OFFER IS TUESDAY, JULY 22D AT 10AM. NO ESCALATION CLAUSE.

Welcome to Fairway Commons! This rarely available first-floor 1 bed, 1 bath unit combines comfort, convenience, and scenic charm. Step out onto your oversized private deck and enjoy peaceful water views-perfect for morning coffee or winding down at the end of the day. The spacious living area flows seamlessly into the kitchen and dining space, creating a warm, open layout ideal for everyday living. Enjoy the perks of in-unit laundry, generous closet space, and additional storage in the shared basement. The complex is professionally managed with flood insurance included in the common charges. One assigned parking spot with plenty of visitor parking. Just minutes to Ridgeway Shopping Center and walking distance to Scalzi Park, shops, and dining. Fairway Commons is a hidden gem where homes are rarely available-don't miss this opportunity!

Welcome to this exquisite top-floor penthouse-a rare corner residence bathed in natural light, offering breathtaking views & unparalleled Stamford living. With windows on three sides, each day starts with stunning sunrises in the living area and ends with magnificent sunsets from both bedrooms. Featuring spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath accommodations, soaring 9ft+ ceilings, hardwood floors, & a smart open layout ideal for everyday comfort & entertaining. The expansive living & dining spaces, enhanced by custom automatic blinds, open seamlessly onto a private balcony with panoramic vistas. A stylish, windowed kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, elegant cherry cabinetry, & a large-capacity built-in wine fridge-perfect for the wine aficionado. Relax in the serene primary suite offering ample closet space & a private en-suite bath. The second bedroom & bathroom are thoughtfully situated for optimal privacy, perfect for guests or a home office. Residents enjoy luxury amenities in this sought-after full-service building: doorman, on-site superintendent, state-of-the-art fitness center, community lounge, patio with grills, storage locker, covered garage parking, and guest spaces. With heating & cooling conveniently included in the HOA, comfort is effortless year-round. Ideally located steps from downtown Stamford's vibrant restaurants, shopping, nightlife, and Metro North train to NYC, this penthouse delivers sophisticated living at its best-unmatched location, lifestyle, & views.

Open and airy living and dining spaces are fresh and appealing and enjoy a screened balcony overlooking the sights and sounds of a bustling city. Primary bedroom with newer full bath, large walk in closet, additional double closet and screened balcony. Secure storage in the lower level of the building. Comfortable in town living with a CT Transit stop at the front door.

listings.remarks: Welcome to 44 Woodway Road! A meticulously maintained split-level home located in the desirable Springdale neighborhood.. This spacious 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom residence offers 3,414 square feet of living space on a 0.32-acre level lot, providing ample room for comfortable living and entertaining. The home features a sun-filled primary bedroom with a newly renovated luxury bath on the first floor. Additional highlights include a renovated eat-in kitchen with quartz counters, a Jack & Jill bathroom with a hydro tub, and a basement with walk-out access. The private, fenced backyard boasts a new patio and a deck, ideal for outdoor gatherings. Conveniently situated near the Merritt Parkway, shopping centers, train stations, and recreational facilities, this home offers both comfort and accessibility in a vibrant community.

Charming Condo in Prime Location! Tucked away in a small, well-maintained complex, this bright and inviting home offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Ideally situated near I-95 and within walking distance of Holly Pond in Darien, enjoy easy access to the beach, scenic waterfront views, and all that coastal living has to offer. Step inside to beautiful hardwood floors that flow throughout the space, complemented by an updated kitchen and bathroom designed for modern living. The generously sized bedroom provides a tranquil retreat, filled with natural light. Additional perks include coin-operated laundry and storage in the basement, reserved parking, and ample visitor spaces. Surrounded by stunning landscaping, this hidden gem is a rare find for those seeking charm, location, and accessibility. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity!

Vintage Charm Meets Modern Living! This sunny Glenbrook Colonial blends classic character with today's updates - and it's ready to impress! The main floor is bright and welcoming, featuring beautiful hardwood floors, custom moldings, a cozy living room that opens to a formal dining room with a sunny bay window, and a modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances and a pass thru window into the dining room. Convenient mudroom w/built in cubbies, a stylish half bath, & a heated front porch that's perfect for year-round lounging or bonus/office space. Upstairs, you'll find two spacious bedrooms, an updated full bath, & an oversized walk-in hall closet. Need more space? The large unfinished basement offers a workshop space, laundry area and is just waiting for your personal touch - think gym, office, playroom, you name it! Outside, enjoy the low-maintenance composite deck & a lush, private backyard with mature plantings, a privacy hedge, and space to grow your own garden. Exterior freshly painted, 200 AMP electric service, efficient gas heating, a detached one-car garage sits on a quiet dead-end street, all on a prime corner lot located in the heart of the desirable Glenbrook neighborhood. This commuter's dream is just a short walk to the Glenbrook train station, shops & restaurants on Hope St, Stark elementary school, downtown Stamford, and more. Whether you're starting out, sizing down, or anything in between-this move-in-ready home offers the perfect blend of charm & updates.

Your opportunity to personalize this charming and manageable Cape Cod-style home on a spacious lot, ideally located near the Merritt Parkway with easy access to top restaurants and a convenient Greenwich, New Canaan, Darien, Rye Brook, Bedford, Norwalk & NYC commute. Enjoy the comfort of a first-floor primary bedroom and the added versatility of a finished basement.

Best of all worlds! New construction in a suburban, yet central Stamford neighborhood. This beautifully crafted residence offers over 4,300 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space spanning 2 floors plus a finished lower level. Abundant windows fill the home with natural light, enhancing the open-concept main floor. The family room with a fireplace flows into the chef's kitchen, featuring high-end Thermador appliances, two sinks, two dishwashers, a walk-in pantry, and a dining area. A formal dining room and a versatile living room/library-ideal for working from home-add to the functionality. A mudroom off the extra-wide two-car garage provides everyday convenience. Upstairs, five bedrooms and three full baths offer ample space. The primary suite includes a spa-like bath, while two bedrooms share a Jack and Jill bath, and two others have en-suite baths and walk-in closets. A generous walk-in laundry room completes the level. Step inside through your own entrance and find a flexible den - your new home office, workout spot, or creative studio. Head upstairs to the heart of the home: a gorgeous farmhouse-inspired kitchen with a subway tile backsplash, butcher-block countertops, trendy open shelving, and bold accent walls. The bright, open living and dining area offers plenty of space to gather with friends, relax with a book, or host game night. Open the door to your balcony, spacious enough for two cozy seating areas and a coffee table - perfect for lazy Sunday mornings or summer evening get-togethers. Upstairs, you'll find two comfortable bedrooms, including a primary suite with a walk-in closet and oversized windows that welcome the daylight. Extra storage? You've got it - with pull-down attic space and room in the garage. Plus, enjoy the ease of a first-floor washer/dryer, central air, heat, and parking for a second car. listings.remarks: Contemporary retreat on 2.80+ private acres in North Stamford showcasing modern elegance and comfort throughout. This immaculate home features an open floor plan with soaring vaulted ceilings and walls of glass that frame panoramic views of the natural surroundings. Designed to feel like a year-round escape, the dramatic family room invites relaxation and connection to nature, while the updated kitchen includes quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and seamless flow to the living, dining, and sitting areas-ideal for entertaining or everyday living. Beautiful wood floors run throughout, enhancing the modern aesthetic. Three bedrooms on the main level provide flexibility for guests, offices, or hobbies, while the upstairs primary suite includes a private deck overlooking the backyard along with two additional bedrooms. The finished lower level spans over 1,000 square feet, creating endless possibilities for a media room, gym, playroom, or home office, and with so many versatile spaces the home easily lives like a six-bedroom residence. Outside, the heated pool with connected spa, expansive patio, and landscaped grounds create a resort-like setting perfect for gatherings. Additional highlights include a horseshoe driveway, advanced solar panel system with Tesla backup batteries for minimal electric bills and reliable power during outages, and a location just minutes from shopping, dining, schools, and the Merritt Parkway.

Step inside a storybook antique, where time slows and history whispers through every timber. Circa 1740, this North Stamford gem feels less like a house and more like a chapter from New England's past. Wide-plank 18th-century floors polished by generations of footsteps, chestnut beams glowing in the one-of-a-kind kitchen's vaulted ceiling, handcrafted built-ins that balance charm and practicality, and a fieldstone wood-burning fireplace that has warmed countless winters - these are just a few of the enchanting details that make this home unique & special. Three en-suite bedrooms, including one on the main floor, along with thoughtful updates that honor the home's timeless spirit. Outside, take in the poetic landscape: ancient trees, sculptural boulders, and a weathered three-story red barn (~750 SF) perched on a hill. For the next thoughtful steward of this property, endless possibilities unfold. Perfectly positioned between the convenience of Downtown Stamford and the charm of Bedford and Pound Ridge, with a beloved country market just down the road, this is a home not just to be lived in, but to be cherished.

listings.remarks: Welcome to this light-filled, beautifully updated condo in the heart of downtown Stamford. Freshly painted throughout, this residence features a crisp white kitchen with quartz countertops and updated stainless steel appliances, offering a modern and functional space for everyday living. The oversized bedroom is complemented by a full bath and a generous custom walk-in closet. Enjoy sweeping city views and stunning sunset vistas from this high-floor unit. The building offers exceptional amenities including 24-hour concierge service, a state-of-the-art fitness center, community room, expansive outdoor courtyard, dog park, and a convenient shuttle to Metro-North-making it ideal for commuters. Indoor garage parking is available for $106/month, along with a private storage unit located on the third floor. Pet-friendly and perfectly situated just steps from downtown dining, shopping, and entertainment.

listings.remarks: "OPEN HOUSE CANCELED 1/18/26" Welcome to this stunning Westover ranch, set on a sweeping driveway and filled with beautiful natural light. The open floor plan features a vaulted Great Room with fireplace, dining area, and granite kitchen with center island and six-burner dual-fuel range - all under soaring ceilings with skylights and cove lighting, and a wall of sliders overlooking the stone patio and gorgeous landscaped yard. The private primary suite offers a bedroom with fireplace, vaulted ceiling & 2 skyligths; updated full bath and walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms are tucked off the main-level family room, along with a beautifully updated full bath. An office, powder room, workroom/shed, and direct access to the two-car garage complete the main level. The partially finished lower level provides flexible space with a playroom, office, and den, plus a large storage and mechanical room with washer and dryer. Outside, enjoy a lovely two-level fenced yard with bluestone patio, stone walls adorned with pollinator-friendly perennials and plenty of room for entertaining, play, or quiet relaxation. Located on a quiet cul-de-sac in desirable Westover with hardwood floors on the main level, city water and sewer, just minutes to the Merritt Parkway, schools, houses of worship, and a short drive to vibrant downtown Stamford and Harbor Point. A truly special home.

Renovated from top to bottom, this stunning one bedroom condo is ideally located in the heart of Downtown Stamford, offering effortless access to everything the city has to offer. Set within a beautifully updated prewar building, the residence blends classic architectural character with modern luxury. Rich hardwood floors and refined trim work enhance the home's timeless appeal throughout. The European inspired kitchen features oversized quartz countertops, a breakfast bar, high end finishes, refrigerator and dishwasher with multiple drawers, and a wine chiller, perfect for entertaining before stepping out to nearby restaurants, theaters, or waterfront events. The sleek bathroom offers a walk-in shower wrapped in porcelain tile. A sun filled living room boasts oversized windows, custom built-in cabinetry for the TV, in unit washing machine, and a thoughtfully designed workspace with a built-in standing desk, ideal for today's flexible lifestyle. The spacious bedroom includes a custom built in media center, automated window shades and a walk-in closet. Enjoy a truly walkable lifestyle just moments from award winning dining, farmers market, street fairs, theaters, parks, and MetroNorth for an easy NYC commute. Additional features include dedicated storage, with heat and hot water included in the monthly fees. An added bonus for investment-savvy buyers: no rental restrictions, making this an exceptional opportunity in one of Downtown Stamford's most desirable locations.

listings.remarks: Rare Craftsman Colonial in coveted Davenport Farm offers a unique opportunity to own a home rich in character & timeless craftsmanship in this quintessential Stamford neighborhood. Spanning over 5,000 sq ft across three expansive levels, this residence features 3 bedrooms (+1 other) & 4 fireplaces on a private, park-like property. A welcoming foyer opens to a sun-filled living room with a striking fireplace & serene views, ideal for everyday living & entertaining. The gracious dining room with oversized windows flows into an eat-in kitchen with breakfast bar & a charming brick fireplace. The dramatic open-beam sitting room is light-filled with Atrium-style windows, shiplap walls, a built-in bar, & a statement fireplace. A cozy family room, laundry, powder room, & attached two-car garage complete the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a sitting area, a fourth fireplace, & a spa bath, while two en-suite bedrooms provide comfort & privacy. The finished 1,700+ sq ft walk-out lower level overlooks a nature preserve & offers a playroom, family room, large bedroom or other, full bath, & ample storage-ideal for guests, in-law, ADU or au pair living. Enjoy Stamford Arboretum with gardens & hiking trails, & Stamford Nature Center, plus a diverse selection of nearby restaurants. Conveniently located in lower North Stamford near downtown, beaches, parks, schools, shopping, dining, Metro-North, & major commuting routes. A must see! More pictures & video coming soon!

Lovely Cape Cod style home with many fantastic updates and a level backyard with a pool! Step inside to an open and inviting floor plan ideal for entertaining, featuring a spacious living room, formal dining room, and gleaming hardwood floors throughout. Elegant moldings add a touch of sophistication. The updated kitchen is a chef's delight, complete with stainless-steel appliances, gas cooking, and direct access to the backyard-perfect for effortless indoor-outdoor entertaining. Enjoy summer gatherings on the outdoor dining patio with built-in grill. There is a cozy main-level den and a stylish, updated full bath with shower that completes the first floor. Upstairs, you'll find two comfortable bedrooms, including a nice-sized primary suite. The true standout is the luxurious spa-like bathroom with an oversized tub-in-shower combination, trendy double vanity, and sleek finishes. Outside, your private oasis awaits. Unwind by the above-ground pool with a sunning deck, dine al fresco on the patio, or tend to your garden surrounded by mature landscaping. Store pool and patio items in the large storage shed. Additional features include a one-car garage, lower-level with amenities and laundry, central air and more. Located just minutes from Cove Island Park, I-95, and vibrant downtown Stamford, this home offers convenience, comfort, and lifestyle. Don't miss your chance to see it!

Springdale home owned and cared for by the same family since 1941 offers easy living and convenience to new owners who are ready to simply refresh or tap the tremendous potential to make it their own. Originally configured as a 3-bedroom home, a wall can be added back to the large primary bedroom to restore the space. Finishing the enclosed front and back porches as well as the walk-out basement can potentially add ~850 sqft of living space. The basement has potential as a family room or even in-law suite and the large front porch could hold an office, sunroom or mudroom. City water & sewer and gas service are in place. Walk to Metro North Springdale station is 6 mins and ride into Manhattan 69 mins. Rare 2 car garage. Original hardwood floors on 1st and 2nd levels. Updated electrical wiring throughout plus new 200 amp electric service. Eat-in-kitchen is outfitted with gas range, dishwasher, refrigerator, ample storage and adjacent dining room. Well-sized main floor powder room with storage and updated upstairs bathroom with tub, classic subway tile and shelving. Basement holds spacious laundry, new 50-gal gas-powered water tank, and ducted heating system. Beautiful views of landscaped yard and mature trees. Tranquil outside space. Close to all that Stamford has to offer. Sold As Is.

Welcome to this beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bath, 2-level luxury condo nestled in a meticulously maintained complex in Stamford, CT. This move-in-ready home offers modern elegance, high-end finishes, and exceptional functionality. Step inside to soaring 20-foot vaulted ceilings adorned with a dramatic 9-foot chandelier, and enjoy the warmth of engineered European white oak hardwood floors throughout the main living areas. The brand-new chef's kitchen is a showstopper, featuring white shaker cabinets, quartz countertops, a stylish quartz backsplash, a stunning quartz waterfall island, and all-new stainless steel appliances. The open-concept living and dining area flows seamlessly to a private balcony overlooking a beautifully landscaped courtyard, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Each spacious bedroom offers 10-foot ceilings, hypoallergenic carpeting, and large walk-in closets. The upper-level loft/family room, complete with a 75" mounted TV on acoustic wood paneling, provides an ideal space for relaxation or movie nights. There's also a versatile bonus room perfect for a home office or third bedroom. Additional highlights include: fully renovated bathroom, central air conditioning, energy-efficient gas furnace with forced hot air, updated plumbing and electrical, recessed lighting and fresh paint throughout. FHA Approved complex! This exceptional condo combines luxury, comfort, and convenience in one of Stamford's most desirable locations!

listings.remarks: Stamford Multi Family with two units, one upstairs and one down. Great opportunity for an investor, or live in one apartment and rent out the other, as this owner has for many years. Nicely set on a level 0.16 acre lot with ample private parking as well as a two car garage. First floor apartment features: Living room with fireplace, dining room, kitchen, sun room, 2 bedrooms and one full bath with Tub/shower. Second floor apartment features: Living room, kitchen with large dining area, sun room, 2 bedrooms and one full bath with Tub/shower. The basement is partially finished but is in need of repair. . Utilities: City water, city sewer. Two electric meters, one for each of the units. Baseboard heat, no AC. Shared Oil boiler for heat and hot water, each unit has its own thermostat. Shared Laundry in the Basement. Very convenient location: Stamford Train Station 1.3 miles. Easy walk to the Bus stop on West Broad St 0.1 mile or to Stamford Hospital 0.2 mile. Downtown and Bedford Street restaurants 1.0 mile. For sports and recreation enthusiasts, it does not get much more convenient, property is adjacent to Lione Park, a 9.2-acre park with tennis courts, basketball court, soccer field, baseball/cricket field & more. Also the property is less than a mile to Scalzi Park, and less than half a mile to E. Gaynor Brennan Municipal Golf Course.

This updated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial in Upper Springdale, bordering New Canaan, offers comfort and functionality. Set on a 1-acre lot with gardens, mature trees, and a large stone patio, the property features a fully fenced-in backyard, ideal for pets or play. The first floor living room features a brick wood-burning fireplace and an adjacent spacious screened porch and open deck. The dining room includes custom built-ins, and the open-concept kitchen offers white cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, a gas cooktop, and a wine cooler, all enhanced by recessed lighting. Upstairs, the primary bedroom features an ensuite bath with designer tile, heated floors, and a heated towel bar. Three additional bedrooms, all with hardwood floors and custom closets, share a modern second bathroom with stylish tile and dual sinks. The walk-out lower level provides space for an office, recreation area, or gym, with built-in cabinetry and a beverage fridge. Upgrades include new windows, smart thermostats, and more-see the MLS for a full list. Conveniently located near the train station, highways, schools, and shopping, this home blends accessibility with a peaceful setting. Multiple offers, highest and best by 9/8, 8PM

listings.remarks: Beautifully renovated in 2025, this raised ranch is set on a quiet cul-de-sac in Stamford's desirable Mid Ridges neighborhood. The main level includes an open and bright living room and dining room, with hardwood floors throughout. Sliders in the dining room allow for easy access to a spacious deck perfect for outdoor living and grilling. The kitchen features sleek stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops with a breakfast bar. The primary bedroom, with dual closets, two bedrooms, and a full bath complete the main level. The lower level features a family room with fireplace as well as an additional bedroom and full bath. Laundry room on lower level. Walk-out to the two car garage and patio. The level yard offers ample room for gardening and recreation. Minutes from the Merritt Parkway and downtown Stamford.

Ideal, sought-after North Stamford home with 5 bedrooms, 7(5/2) baths and 3-car garage, is move-in ready for you! A serene and private 1+acre with majestic stone outcroppings offers generous outdoor entertaining decks, patio and yard. Two primary bedroom suites, multiple/versatile work spaces, well-designed kitchen with high-end appliances and recently refinished hardwood floors & fresh paint throughout. Excellent schools and grocery/dining options are all within an 8-15 minute drive. Home was expanded and redesigned by a builder/owner in 2004/5 creating comfortable, functional, contemporary living throughout. Must-see quality!

Two-family property built in 2010 on a corner lot in Stamford's South End. This building is much newer than the typical multi-family homes in the area, many of which are more than 100 years old. The first-floor unit offers two bedrooms and one full bathroom. The second-floor duplex spans two levels with five total bedrooms and two full bathrooms, an uncommon layout that provides flexible living arrangements and strong rental appeal. The property features vinyl siding, quality Weil-McLain boilers, wide staircases, good ceiling height, and an expansive unfinished basement with excellent storage and future potential. The property also includes a cleared side lot used for off-street parking, providing ample space for multiple vehicles. Built to modern codes, this property offers more efficient systems and reduced maintenance compared to older multifamily homes. Located minutes from Harbor Point, the Metro North train station, and downtown Stamford, the property offers both accessibility and convenience. The combination of newer construction, rare unit configuration, corner lot location, and dedicated parking area makes this a strong long-term rental investment. Subject to court approval.

Welcome home to your 2 bed, 2.5 bath townhouse in the sought-after Greenbriar community! This light-filled, move-in-ready home offers an open floor plan with hardwood floors, a cozy wood-burning fireplace, and access to a sunroom/office overlooking the peaceful courtyard-ideal for working from home. The spacious living and dining areas flow into an eat-in kitchen featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, ample storage, a breakfast bar, and sliders to a private deck. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bath and an abundance of closet space. The primary suite boasts a newly renovated, luxurious bathroom, while the second bedroom offers a large walk-in closet. New Renewal by Anderson window and Ecobee thermostats make for an energy efficient home. Enjoy the convenience of one covered parking space, an additional assigned spot, and plenty of guest parking. Located in a well-managed, quiet complex just steps from shopping, dining, parks, public transportation, and all that vibrant Downtown Stamford has to offer. The perfect balance of comfort, style, and unbeatable location!

Welcome to your perfect new home! This beautifully maintained, move-in ready cooperative offers effortless living just a short stroll from vibrant Downtown Stamford. Nestled among lush, professionally landscaped gardens, this light-filled unit offers the perfect blend of convenience, comfort, and charm. Ideal for first-time homebuyers or those looking to downsize, this first-floor residence features spacious, sun-drenched living areas, in-unit laundry, and ample storage-including a dedicated storage unit. Enjoy the ease of assigned parking, with the option for a second space for just $25/month. Step outside and enjoy the serene grounds, or take advantage of the unbeatable location close to shops, dining, entertainment, and public transportation.
