listings.remarks: Live your best life at 60 Redmont Road, situated on the North side of Stamford, offering over an acre of land with complete privacy. This six-bedroom home features five full baths and an additional half bath. The inground heated pool, located just outside the kitchen area, creates an ideal spot for barbecues and an outdoor kitchen, offering endless summer fun and serving as a perfect retreat.  Upon entering, you are greeted by a well-appointed main level, with a home office and a living room warmed by a charming fireplace, perfect for staying cozy during the winter months. The grand great room impresses with its soaring ceilings and a wood-burning stove. The kitchen, designed to inspire culinary creativity, provides stunning views of the pool, while an adjoining in-law suite with two rooms and a full bath ensures there is room for all! Further enhancing the main level are an art studio or sun room, laundry room and a home gym located above the garage.  Ascend to the upper level, where four additional bedrooms and three full baths await. The updated primary suite is a true delight, with a luxurious soaking tub and a large walk-in California closet. The location of this home is ideal, just minutes away from the Merritt Parkway, less than a mile from the elementary school and close to Stamford's vibrant downtown.

Adorable 2-Bedroom Cape in Desirable Springdale! This well-maintained home features hardwood floors and numerous updates, including a new roof, driveway, and recent interior and exterior paint. Enjoy your own private backyard-ideal for relaxing, entertaining, or pets. Conveniently located just minutes from Springdale train station, shopping, dining, schools, downtown, and a public golf course. Move right in or take advantage of the expansion potential with an unfinished attic and basement offering endless possibilities.

Nestled in the rolling hills of North Stamford, this celebrity French Country Colonial is a masterpiece of artistry and history. Offering 4 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, and a serene cul-de-sac location, this exceptional home pairs panoramic views from all windows with a level of craftsmanship rarely found today. Step inside and be transported to the French countryside with interiors curated by Howard Kaplan, the renowned founder of French Country design. Every detail tells a story: hand-stenciled walls and ceilings, 19th-century doors and tiles sourced from England and France, and six etched glass doors from a Parisian salon. Even the front door hails from an English manor house in the Lake District. The striking cedar Mansard roof completes the authentic European aesthetic. The grounds are equally enchanting. Spread across 1.5 acres of lush, landscaped privacy, the property features extensive stonework, multiple outdoor seating areas of the neighboring pond, waterfall and landscaping designed for all-year interest. There is an in-ground pool, and a separate storybook guest house. Once a music studio, the guest space boasts an open-concept layout with a stone fireplace, full kitchen, and bath - perfect for creative retreats or hosting guests.

This is the home that will offer you the lifestyle you have been looking for - immaculate/turn key condition, move in ready, great village (Springdale) location, and all the while tucked away on a private cul de sac within the coveted Riverwood Association. This 3 bedroom home has a spacious open concept floorplan. The living room with gas fireplace and dining room with door leads out to a private patio and lawn area. There's a fabulous BRAND NEW kitchen and appliances with pantry and laundry room. A powder room on the main floor as well. Upstairs there are 3 generous bedrooms. The primary has a full bath, walk in closet and an additional closet. The other two bedrooms are filled with sunlight and ample closet too. A hallway full bathroom is here also. An attached one car garage, a private driveway plus visitor parking, gorgeous engineered floors throughout, freshly painted, natural gas heat, central A/C, smart thermostat, private association with low common fees begs the question ....What are you waiting for?

Your own private oasis on a desirable Pepper Ridge cul-de-sac! This lovingly maintained 3 Bedroom, 3 Bath Ranch offers easy, comfortable living with hardwood floors throughout the main level. A spacious Living Room with a picture window and charming fireplace flows into the formal Dining Room, while the updated granite/stainless Eat-in Kitchen makes cooking a delight. A Mudroom with side entry, Laundry, and access to the 1-Car Garage add everyday convenience. The Bedroom wing features a lovely Primary Suite with an updated marble Bath, along with two additional Bedrooms and a refreshed Full Hall Bath with jetted tub. The Lower Level offers a separate entry to a large Family Room, Office, Full Bath, Kitchenette, and Storage-a possible in-law or guest setup. Step outside and enjoy your private yard featuring a beautiful patio with brick fireplace, perfect for entertaining or relaxing. The inviting in-ground pool with new vinyl liner and adjacent gazebo provide the ultimate backyard retreat. The professionally landscaped, level yard will offer hours of fun and entertainment. All this in a fantastic location-close to shopping, schools, houses of worship, commuting, and just minutes to vibrant Downtown Stamford & Harbor Point entertainment districts!

One of the largest one bedroom corner units in the complex at 934 square feet in up to the minute, move in ready condition! Imagine an English style courtyard entrance with ivy covered brick exterior and port-cochere in this pre war building where charm and character abound. A wonderful east/west exposure floods the unit with natural light all day long and the evening hours give you sparkling city views. A defined entry foyer, 9' ceilings and a long list of recent improvements including all new windows, bathroom renovation, kitchen updates, refinished hardwood floors and more. An easy walk to downtown and CT Transit has a stop practically at your front door. A wonderful city gem.

Absolutely spectacular primary bedroom with walk-in custom closet and spa inspired bathroom with floating vanity sink, stall shower, and frameless glass door. Enjoy the large mudroom with custom built-ins, heated floors, and 2nd laundry location. Additional features included new hot water heater, electrical, new windows, bathrooms, hardwood floors, railings, simply too many items to list. Walking distance to Restaurants, shops, parks, and places of worship.

This charming 4 bedroom Cape Cod home is full of potential and ready for your personal touch. This classic property features an inviting layout, hardwood floors, fireplace and abundant natural light. Walking distance to local elementary school, Chelsea Piers and 2 of Stamford's finest parks, Cove Island and Cummings Park which feature beaches, tennis, pickleball, basketball, baseball, a fishing pier, marina and a skating rink. This property offers a fantastic opportunity to build equity and create the home of your dreams. Perfect for investors, DIY enthusiasts, or anyone looking to customize a home in a desirable neighborhood. Bring your vision and make this Cape Cod gem shine again. Close to train, and vibrant downtown Stamford. 47 minutes to NYC by train. The home is being sold "as is."

Welcome to Chesterfield, one of Stamford's most sought-after gated communities! This freshly painted 1-bedroom, 1-bath unit offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and style! The open-concept living and dining area with hardwood floors, is bright and inviting, featuring sliding glass doors that lead to a private deck, ideal for outdoor dining or morning coffee! The newer kitchen is well-appointed with ample cabinetry, granite counters and a center island, making meal prep a breeze! The spacious bedroom has hardwood floors and offers generous closet storage. This unit also has a laundry room with additional storage, as well as access to a crawl space. Residents of Chesterfield enjoy access to outstanding community amenities, including a 24-hour gated entrance, two swimming pools, and beautifully landscaped grounds. The location is terrific, just minutes from vibrant downtown Stamford, shopping, dining, Metro-North, and major highways. A wonderful place to call home! Some photos are virtually staged.

Welcome to this stately center hall colonial with a gracious 2 story entry hall nestled on a private 2-acre lot. Offering timeless charm and generous sized rooms, this home features large, light filled rooms perfect for both everyday living and elegant entertaining. Recent upgrades include a brand new roof, all new HVAC system, and a new on-demand hot water heater, so you can move in worry-free and enjoy this beautiful home. At the heart of the home, the custom-designed kitchen is a chef's dream. Outfitted with top-of-the-line appliances, Thermador and Viking, and custom cabinetry offers ample storage along with granite counters and a wine-chiller. The second floor has 4 generous sized bedrooms with large closets and the hall bath has been completely renovated. The finished lower level offers a possible private in-law suite with it's own entrance perfect for multi-generational, or au pair living. Designed with ease this home features 2 laundry rooms and a 3 car garage which provides ample space for vehicles, storage, or a workshop. Close to the Merritt Parkway and shopping.

Lovely two bedroom ranch style condo with many appealing features: hardwood floors, fireplace, central air, breakfast room off of the kitchen, balcony, lower level family room, a private storage room and a carport a few steps from your door. Conveniently located between I-95 and the Merritt, this home could not have a better location. Walk to Ridgeway Shopping, Whole Foods and numerous restaurants. There are only a few one-level units in this attractive 23 unit complex.

This beautiful ranch-style home is nestled in the highly desirable North Stamford neighborhood, on a quiet 1.05-acre lot at the end of a cul-de-sac. With 5 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, it offers plenty of room for family, guests, or multigenerational living. Highlights include a generously sized living room with a fireplace, a large eating kitchen that opens via sliders to a patio perfect for alfresco dining and entertaining. The master suite is a retreat with a Jacuzzi tub. The lower level is fully finished and includes a full bath and a walk-in cedar closet. The separate in-law/au pair suite features its own entrance, bedroom, bath, and laundry room. Built in 1953 and recently painted, the home also reflects solid updates: the lot is level and lightly wooded, providing privacy, and the location is just minutes to the Merritt Parkway and High Ridge Plaza for convenient shopping and commuting. This is a rare opportunity to own a true North Stamford ranch with generous acreage, space to spread out, and flexibility thanks to the in-law suite. The property is ready to go, don't miss out!

***CALL FOR OFFERS: TUES (11/18) @ 9P*** If you've been searching for that perfect North Stamford home on a cul-de-sac, you may have just found it. With easy access to the Merritt Pkwy and quick drive to the Nature Center & Bartlett Arboretum, this location is ideal for commuters and nature lovers alike. 49 Alexandra is a classic Colonial with a modern addition and thoughtful updates that bring the best of both worlds. Set back on a quiet street, the semi-circular driveway and one-acre flat lot make an immediate impression. Inside, the layout offers the perfect main-level flow for everyday living and entertaining: a welcoming living room with fireplace, a dining room with character, an open kitchen with island seating, and a stunning double-height family room with vaulted ceilings that is something you simply don't see every day, framed by walls of windows overlooking the backyard. A large mudroom connects the living spaces with everyday function, keeping life organized and guests moving easily between indoors and out. Upstairs, the primary suite features multiple built-in closets and a large ensuite with dual vanities and an oversized dual-head shower with a built-in bench. Two additional bedrooms share a well-appointed hall bath. The backyard offers a wide, level lawn, a large deck, and multiple walkouts from the home for seamless indoor-outdoor living. A 2-car garage, hardwood floors (most of home), updated mechanicals, city water(!!), generator and Lutron lights.

listings.remarks: Beautiful Colonial on a quiet cul-de-sac on one of the most desirable streets in North Stamford. This home features an effortless open flow with crown molding, limestone and hardwood floors, and two marble fireplaces that add warmth and character throughout. There are formal living and dining areas, perfect for hosting guests, and the gourmet eat-in kitchen opens to a vaulted family room with a fireplace and a deck overlooking the private yard, ideal for everyday living or entertaining. A special first-floor office with custom built-ins provides an ideal work-from-home setup. Upstairs, the private master suite features a tray ceiling, his and her closets, and a luxurious bathroom with a vaulted ceiling and Jacuzzi tub. listings.remarks: Chateau Rochamore - a French Normandy stone manor of timeless grace - sits on over three park-like acres in North Stamford. Designed at the turn of the century by renowned New York City architect Gustave Steinbeck as a summer residence for himself and his family, this historic landmark offers nearly 6,000 square feet of elegant living space steeped in old-world craftsmanship and charm. From the moment you pass through the stone-pillared gates, the home's architectural details captivate: ornamental hand-carved gargoyles preside above the three-car garage, stately stone chimneys rise above the slate roof, and every element reflects the artistry of a bygone era. Step into the great hall, where a soaring three story beamed ceiling, dramatic stone fireplace, Juliet balcony, and French doors to a wraparound stone terrace set the tone for grand yet inviting living. The formal dining room, with its own beamed ceiling and stone fireplace, opens to the terrace - connecting the great hall - and leading to lush lawns and a Koi pond. Random width wide-plank oak floors flow throughout much of the home, while an indoor garden room with fountain - the perfect place for your morning coffee or yoga - brings the outdoors in. The main-floor primary suite provides comfort and privacy, and every corner of the home reveals distinctive architectural character. Less than an hour from Manhattan, Chateau Rochamore is an enchanting country retreat-a one-of-a-kind residence ready for its next chapter.

French doors lead to a large, completely renovated private deck and that overlooks the spacious fenced yard, perfect for hanging out, entertaining, or letting your dog roam. Two bedrooms and a spa-inspired bath featuring a deep soaking tub complete the main level, where hardwood floors and clean lines keep things fresh and timeless. The lower level adds flexibility - great for guests, a home office, or a creative studio - with its own living space. Previous owner used lower level as a mother/daughter. Extras include 2 year old central air, a storage shed, and off-street parking. All this just minutes to Metro-North, downtown Stamford, and an easy shot to NYC - the best of suburban ease with an urban vibe.

Step inside to discover a home that seamlessly blends classic allure with modern comforts. The inviting living room is highlighted by a beautiful gas fireplace, ideal for cozy evenings. Adjacent is a spacious dining area, perfect for entertaining or enjoying intimate family meals. The kitchen, a dream for any culinary enthusiast, features ample cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a gas stovetop and the convenience of an outdoor deck for easy dining or morning coffee. This home offers three generously-sized bedrooms, with a versatile family room on the first floor that easily transforms into a fourth bedroom, accommodating the evolving needs of any household. Two well-appointed bathrooms ensure convenience and privacy for residents and guests alike. Enjoy the tranquility of your private outdoor space, perfect for summer gatherings or quiet reflection. The 1-bedroom guest cottage has an open floor plan, cathedral-ceiling and is ideal for guests, in-laws or extended family. The screened porch creates a perfect extension of the living space for morning coffee and summer dinners. Two bedrooms and a full bath complete the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a true retreat with an updated ensuite bath featuring dual sinks, heated floors, and a striking copper tub. An additional bedroom, renovated hall bath, and laundry complete the upper level. Natural light fills the home, enhanced by soaring vaulted ceilings and skylights that create an elevated yet inviting atmosphere with seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The property is set against a tranquil natural backdrop, complete with a gentle brook. A custom chef's kitchen by Deane anchors the home, featuring a large walnut center island, marble countertops, and a custom walk-in pantry, while living spaces extend to a large composite deck with multiple access points-ideal for entertaining or enjoying the peaceful surroundings. The Home offers two luxurious primary suites with spa-like baths, including a main-level suite with dressing area and walk-in closet. Upstairs, a second primary suite features dual walk-in closets, along with two additional bedrooms, an updated hall bath, large closets and custom built-ins. A spacious main-level office/den adds flexibility. Located in Stamford's Cove neighborhood, this exceptional waterfront residence combines striking architecture, high-end construction, and sweeping water views from nearly every room. Set on a professionally landscaped half-acre, the home is designed to maximize its unique setting with walls of Andersen windows and sliders that seamlessly connect the interior living spaces to multiple decks and outdoor entertaining areas overlooking the water. The open concept kitchen and family room are centered around a marble-topped island and appointed with premium appliances including a Wolf gas range, Wolf convection oven, Sub-Zero refrigerator, Bosch dishwasher, wine chiller, and custom cabinetry. Exceptional craftsmanship and attention to detail are evident throughout with gleaming hardwood floors, designer baths with radiant heated floors, retractable custom window treatments, and thoughtfully designed living spaces filled with natural light. The luxurious primary suite offers stunning water views, a waterfront balcony, and a spa-like bath featuring a soaking tub, steam shower, marble topped vanity, and radiant heated floors. Exterior features include Hardie Plank siding, stone facade, Trex decking, Azek trim, solar panels, outdoor shower and changing area, full house generator, deer fencing, and a three-car garage with electric vehicle charging outlets. Fully FEMA compliant and ideally positioned to capture the beauty of the waterfront from sunrise to sunset.

***HIGHEST & BEST 5/12 @ 12P***174 East Ln is one of those homes where you immediately understand why people want to live in the hidden gem that is Revonah Woods. Set on 1.12 acres, it offers a private, nature filled setting that feels like North Stamford, but with all the amenities and convenience of being just minutes to everything Stamford has to offer. When you pull up, you will see why the neighborhood talks about the lawn that looks like it belongs on a PGA course. This classic New England Colonial has been fully restored, expanded, and modernized over the past 5 years. A curved stone walkway, mature trees, and seasonal plantings create standout curb appeal. Inside, hardwood floors, crisp millwork, shiplap detail, and sun filled spaces balance classic character with a clean, updated feel. The main level offers six rooms that are open where you want them to be, kitchen, family, and dining, but still defined enough to keep real character, including a formal living room with wood burning fireplace, den, and office. The kitchen anchors the home with a Wolf gas range, pot filler, wine chiller, oversized island with second sink, and great sightlines throughout. Multiple French doors open to a spacious composite deck, creating seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Upstairs offers three bedrooms, including a well-designed primary suite with a soaking tub and curbless walk-in shower. The lower level adds storage, gym space, and a one-car garage. Turnkey in a location people rarely leave

Antique Post & Beam. Incredible transformation of a 1787 Vermont Barn. Converted to a residence in 1920 artfully integrating hand-hewn beams, random-width floors and incredible stone fireplace. Striking interior with vaulted ceilings and walls of windows to capture natural light and views. Entry with walls of exposed brick and barnwood, vaulted ceiling and sliding barn door. Incredible Great Room with vaulted ceiling beams, fireplace, seating and dining areas. Chef's Kitchen with granite counters and stainless appliances. Primary Bedroom with vaulted ceiling, wood burning stove and doors to porch. Two additional Bedrooms, both with vaulted ceilings and exposed beams. Two Full Baths. Beautiful, terraced gardens, fieldstone walls and stone terraces for dining and entertaining. Absolutely gorgeous grounds overlooking the East Branch Mianus River. Fabulous stone terrace with firepit at river's edge. Convenient location and just a moment's drive to the commercial area of High Ridge Road with its shops and restaurants. Close to the Merritt Parkway, the bus line, the Metro North train and I-95. A remarkable offering!

Charming and full of character, this impeccably maintained 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home offers the perfect blend of classic appeal and modern convenience. Beautiful wood floors run throughout, adding warmth and elegance, with perfect flow between the living room, kitchen, and dining room. The kitchen is very inviting and features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a new refrigerator, a breakfast bar, and a free-standing hutch, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Situated in Stamford's desirable Glenbrook neighborhood, this home enjoys a location known for its tree-lined streets, strong sense of community, and easy access to downtown Stamford, Metro-North, parks, shopping, and dining-making it a favorite for commuters and those seeking a neighborhood feel with city convenience. Set on the corner lot, the property offers exceptional privacy along with generous outdoor space. The yard is professionally landscaped, providing a lush and welcoming setting for relaxation or gatherings. A two-car garage plus a driveway that accommodates two additional vehicles ensures ample parking. Adding to the home's value and efficiency, fully paid-off solar panels keep electric costs exceptionally low which is an outstanding benefit for anyone who is energy-conscious. Be part of the community and own a truly special home in one of Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods.

Welcoming you home, is this beautiful front porch where you can sit and enjoy some quiet time or visit with a neighbor. Once inside, you can cozy up to a roaring fire in the living room while you watch your favorite football team or stream your favorite show. This low traffic street holds its own privacy. Your private, fully fenced in back yard is perfect for enjoying quiet mornings and serene ambiance with the water fountain. Entertaining is a wonderful experience by the fire pit. Ever thought of growing your own veggies? Well, you have plenty of room for that as well! The outdoor building allows for plenty of storage space for bicycles, lawn mower or perhaps even a man cave/she shed. The possibilities are limitless! There is also a wonderful room in the lower level with lots of natural sunlight. It's great for a TV room, exercise room or game room just to name a few. You are minutes away from the downtown area and shopping with easy access to Metro North and I-95. What are you waiting for?

Located on scenic Long Ridge Road in Stamford, this property offers a unique blend of space, flexibility, and natural beauty. The home features a well-designed main residence along with a private in-law apartment-ideal for multi-generational living, guests, or added income potential.  Enjoy peaceful lake views that create a serene, retreat-like setting, while still being conveniently close to shopping, dining, and major commuter routes. A great opportunity for both end-users and investors seeking versatility and value in a desirable location. Being sold As Is.

Attention Contractors, Investors or Homebuyers who see the potential in this 2-family house. Sold as-is. First floor unit has a living room, dining room, 2 bedrooms and bathroom, second floor has a living room, 2 bedrooms and bathroom. The property has an unfinished basement and needs a lot of work. No representation of heating or plumbing to be in working order. Private driveway with detached garage. Nice-sized backyard perfect for summer barbecues and outdoor entertaining.  Ideal for investors or owner-occupants seeking rental potential in a prime Stamford location, close to I-95, Stamford Hospital, just minutes from downtown Stamford, train stations, parks, shopping and restaurants. Please execute the Hold Harmless Form prior to scheduling an appointment.

Welcome to Fountain Terrace #91-1133, ideally situated on the top floor (penthouse) of a well-maintained, full-service building in the heart of Stamford. This bright and airy unit offers outstanding sunrises, abundant natural light, and a spacious layout designed for comfortable living.  The open living and dining area provides a versatile space for both relaxing and entertaining, with a balcony to enjoy the views and sunsets. The updated kitchen with stainless appliances offers ample storage and functionality, with space enough for a small table. Generously sized bedrooms and updated bath complete the interior. Residents enjoy access to a range of amenities including a pool, fitness center, gated entry with security guard, and an assigned parking space. Heat and hot water are included. Conveniently located just minutes to downtown Stamford, Metro-North, shopping, restaurants and major highways, this location is perfect for commuters and those seeking easy access to everything Stamford has to offer.  A fantastic opportunity to enjoy low-maintenance living in a prime location!

listings.remarks: Nestled on a tranquil cul-de-sac in the heart of Stamford's highly sought-after Mid-Ridges neighborhood, this charming 3-bedroom, 2 bathroom raised ranch at 37 Elaine Drive presents a rare opportunity to create your dream home in an unbeatable location. Step inside and be greeted by the warm potential of this well maintained residence. The spacious 1,586 sq. ft. layout is a perfect blank canvas awaiting your personal touch. A significant head start has been made for you: the beautiful hardwood floors throughout the main level have been professionally sanded and are ready for you to select the custom stain color of your choice, instantly tailoring the home to your unique style. The home is equipped with the "big three" of city conveniences: natural gas, city water, and city sewer, offering you peace of mind and hassle-free living. Set on a generous quarter-acre lot, the property provides ample space for outdoor relaxation, gardening, and entertaining combined with the tranqulity of the river in your backyard. Location is everything, and this home delivers. Situated in one of Stamford's best neighborhoods, you are just moments away from everything you need. Enjoy unparalleled convenience with easy access to the Merritt Parkway and I-95, premier shopping destinations, a variety of restaurants, schools, and local houses of worship. 37 Elaine Drive is more than just a house; it's a chance to establish roots in a vibrant community with a location that simply can't be beat.

This is an rare opportunity to own a unique property right in the middle of town. This is one unit that lives like two separate units. A two bedroom one bath unit with Kitchen, dining room and living room. It has an attached one bedroom, one bath unit below that has a kitchen and Living room and separate entrance of its own. 4 Parking spaces and tons of Storage. Complex has lots of Green space for pet friendly activities. Walk to shopping, gym, parks and recreation, restaurants and entertainment as well as tr. Minutes to train and all major commuting roadways. Across the Street from ridgeway center and Scalzi park perfect for active buyers or people who need lots of space and rooms.

Completely reimagined in 2020, this turn key residence at 26 Three Lakes Drive offers the perfect blend of modern design, comfort, and flexibility in one of Stamford's most peaceful residential settings. A sun-filled open-concept layout is anchored by a show-stopping chef's kitchen featuring custom white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and an island ideal for entertaining. The seamless flow into the living and dining areas, complemented by gleaming hardwood floors and recessed lighting, creates an elevated everyday living experience. The primary suite is a private retreat featuring a well designed ensuite bath and generous his-and-hers closets. while two additional bedrooms and a beautifully updated full bath complete the main level. The fully finished walk-out lower level offers exceptional versatility with two additional bedrooms, a third full bath, and multiple living spaces ideal for a media room, home gym, guest suite, or multi-generational living. Sliding doors provide direct access to a private, level backyard oasis featuring a brand new deck, patio, fresh landscaping, and a multi-zone irrigation system for effortless outdoor enjoyment. Additional highlights include a full 2020 gut renovation with updated mechanicals, roof, siding, and interiors, a newly paved driveway with ample parking, and professional masonry and fencing enhancing curb appeal. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, and Metro-North, this move-in-ready home delivers.

Fully remodeled condo in downtown Stamford. Located on the 5th floor, this unit offers vaulted ceilings, abundant natural light, and a bright open concept layout. The brand new kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a large island with seating, opening directly into the main living space. Both bathrooms have been fully remodeled with clean, modern finishes. This 2 bedroom, 2 bath layout includes hardwood floors throughout main areas and new carpet in the bedrooms. Private balcony overlooking a professionally landscaped courtyard. Garage parking included. Full service building with concierge and fitness center. Just minutes to Metro North, restaurants, shopping, and everything downtown Stamford has to offer. Ideal for primary residence or investment with strong rental appeal. Completely move in ready, fully remodeled units with this level of finish are rarely available in this building.

Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this newly renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment located in the sought-after Harbor Point neighborhood of Stamford. This spacious and modern unit offers a luxurious living experience with high-end finishes throughout, including sleek hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, large windows that flood the space with natural light, and the convenience of in-unit laundry. The area also offers excellent transportation options, with easy access to major highways and public transit, making it ideal for commuting to nearby cities or into New York City. This is an ideal choice for those seeking a modern and hassle-free living experience.

Welcome to 179 Berrian Road, a well-maintained ranch-style home set on a quiet dead-end street in Stamford's desirable Pepper Ridge neighborhood. Offering the ease of one-level living on a flat half-acre lot, this 4-bedroom, 2-bath residence combines space, functionality, and a private outdoor setting that's increasingly hard to find. With approximately 2,270 square feet, the home features a practical layout designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The single-level design provides seamless flow between living spaces. The four bedrooms offer flexibility for a variety of needs, whether for guests, a home office, or additional living space. Two full bathrooms add convenience, and the overall footprint makes the home feel comfortable and well-balanced. Recent upgrades contribute to both efficiency and peace of mind, including a newer HVAC system (2023), generator (2021), and fencing (2021). These improvements enhance the home's functionality while reducing the need for immediate updates. The outdoor space is a standout feature. Set on a flat, half-acre lot, the fully fenced backyard offers privacy and versatility-ideal for relaxing, entertaining, or simply enjoying the space. A patio provides a great setting for outdoor dining or gatherings, while additional features such as a shed and chicken coop add unique utility and character to the property.

Completely renovated and upgraded-Private Balcony with City Views-Full-Service Building-Prime Stamford Location! Welcome to this bright and inviting condo at Fountain Terrace, ideally located in downtown Stamford. This well-maintained and COMPLETELY updated unit features a flexible open-concept living and dining area, highlighted by engineered wood floors, crown moldings throughout, custom doors, radiator covers & ample windows that fill the space with natural light. Step outside to your private balcony & enjoy sweeping skyline views-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The updated kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, stone counters, & ample cabinetry-designed for everyday convenience. Two generously sized bedrooms offer comfortable space complemented by ample custom closet storage throughout, flanked by a renovated full bath! Residents enjoy a full suite of amenities, including elevator access, a swimming pool, fitness center, playground, 24-hour security, and on-site laundry facilities. The unit also includes a dedicated storage space in the basement+ 1 assigned parking spot & additional parking available. Ideally situated just minutes from Downtown Stamford, with easy access to restaurants, shopping, parks, medical facilities, and more. Approximately 1.5 miles to Metro-North and Amtrak for a seamless commute. HOA includes: heat, hot water, water, security, assigned parking, and access to all community amenities. Pet-friendly community

listings.remarks: Welcome to Casa Nossa at 91 Clovelly Road, a beautifully reimagined residence nestled in Stamford's highly sought after Glenbrook neighborhood, where timeless elegance meets modern comfort. This stunning home offers an exceptional layout where the spacious living room sets the tone with warmth and sophistication, while the oversized dining room provides the perfect backdrop for memorable gatherings. And just beyond, the area flows seamlessly into a newly updated sunroom or private office. Thoughtfully updated throughout, the home features modernized bathrooms and freshly painted interiors, delivering a clean contemporary aesthetic with a refined touch. The lower level presents a flexible bonus space ideal for a home gym, office or custom expansion. Step outside to a generous backyard retreat with newly installed stone patio and enjoy dining al fresco or quiet relaxation while savoring the outdoors. The property is further enhanced by two private driveways and a detached garage with electricity that is currently utilized as an artist's studio - a unique and inspiring bonus space perfect for creatives, a workshop or yoga studio. At Casa Nossa, every detail has been curated to create a warm yet elevated living experience, all within a prime location close to downtown Stamford.

Centrally located on a quiet triple cul de sac, this inviting home offers an open floor plan, abundant natural light, and thoughtful updates throughout. It features 3 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, with hardwood floors running throughout the home. The living room with fireplace flows into the dining room, where sliders open to a spacious deck with an awning. The updated kitchen features a skylight, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances. The primary suite is a true retreat, complete with an oversized walk in closet outfitted with California Closets cabinetry and shelving, plus a private spa like bath with double sinks, radiant heated floors, a shower stall, jacuzzi tub, and sauna. The lower level family room offers flexible space and could serve as a 4th bedroom, with a full bath and an alcove ideal for a home office. The home underwent a major renovation and addition in 2005, including updated electrical, plumbing, windows, and roof, along with an 80 gallon water heater replaced in 2021, a furnace updated in 2013, and the roof was replaced in 2020.

Waterfront living at her best! Beautifully updated 3 bed, 3 and a half bath end unit townhouse in desirable Marina Bay complex. Private waterside community just minutes from Stamford, CT RR (with fast trains into Manhattan), downtown Stamford for pickle ball & restaurants, and i95 for those needing to commute (north or south - exit 7). Incredible sunset views from living room (park-like vista) and primary suite balconies. Stunning eat-in kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances and plenty of storage. Large open plan dining (room for table as well as bar stools) and light-filled living room with elegant gas fireplace. Modern half bath completes the main level!  Upstairs there's a spacious primary suite with sliders to a balcony. Two further bedrooms well apportioned bedrooms plus full bath complete the upper level.  The lower level makes for a perfect den/family room, gym, au pair suite and offers a full bath (with oversized shower), side by side laundry in dedicated room, and sliders out to a stone patio! Attached one car garage with bonus storage, and further under stair storage room on lower level. One further parking in driveway. Take advantage of the gunite waterfront pool during summer months, and enjoy moments with neighbors/friends in private clubhouse with fitted kitchen. Views of Westcott Cove, Marina and Long Island Sound for those looking to live by the sea: Life doesn't get much sweeter than this! Sold "AS-IS".

Welcome to 49 Buena Vista Street, a beautifully maintained 1927 Colonial blending timeless charm with modern updates. This 3-bedroom, 2-bath home features a new roof (2024), central air and air exchange systems (2025), and a long list of additional improvements.  The main level offers a sun-filled living room with marble gas fireplace and built-ins, a formal dining room with french doors to the deck, a bright sunroom/office with full bath, and a fully equipped kitchen with gas stove, granite counters, newer appliances, and mudroom access.  Upstairs includes three bedrooms, two with walk-in closets, including a lofted bedroom with skylights offering flexible living space.  A finished basement provides bonus room for recreation and storage. Outdoors, enjoy a private oasis, landscaped yard with deck and patio to relax and enjoy stunning sunsets. Detached garage with new door, updated flooring, and attic storage.  Conveniently located near the Springdale Train Station, restaurants, library & school offering easy access and everyday convenience. Seller asking for best and final offers by 5 PM Monday 4/20

Charming 3-bedroom, 2-bath Cape in a highly desirable location. Featuring an eat-in kitchen, formal dining room, family room, and inviting living room with a picture window, wood-burning fireplace, and hardwood floors, this lovingly maintained home offers comfortable living spaces, timeless character, and an exceptional opportunity in a sought-after neighborhood. Recent improvements include roof and driveway completed in 2023, adding value and peace of mind.

Turnkey and fully updated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial Split on a quiet cul-de-sac in a highly convenient Stamford location. Offering approximately 2,877 sq ft, the home features a comfortable layout with a fireplace and French doors opening to a large deck and private backyard. The updated kitchen includes new countertops, refreshed cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a gas range, with great natural light throughout. Refinished hardwood floors and recessed lighting add a clean, updated feel. The flexible lower level works well as a family room, gym, or game room. Flat, fenced yard with updated landscaping. Enjoy easy access to the Merritt Parkway, Trader Joe's, shopping, dining, and everyday essentials.

***HIGHEST & BEST DUE APR 21st @ 12PM*** If you're looking for that perfect mix of convenience and neighborhood feel, this is it in Pepper Ridge. Close to both the Stamford and Glenbrook Metro-North trains for an easy NYC commute, and just minutes to I-95 and the Merritt Pkwy, while still being able to walk to Newfield Shopping Center, Barrett Park, and houses of worship. Set on a quiet street, this classic New England Colonial has the charm you want with a layout that actually works. The main level starts with a bright, inviting living room with fireplace and great natural light, flowing into a proper dining room with built-ins. The eat-in kitchen offers solid cabinet space and connects easily to the back of the house, where a sunroom brings in tons of light and opens out to the patio for easy indoor-outdoor living. A full bath completes the first floor. Upstairs are three bedrooms, including a primary with a newly added ensuite bath, plus an additional renovated full bath for the other bedrooms. The walk-up attic is a major bonus, offering excellent storage and flexible space. The lower level provides additional storage, usable space, and a half bath. Outside, enjoy a level, fenced-in backyard with a great rectangular layout, a walk-out patio, and a one-car garage. A move-in ready Colonial in one of Stamford's most convenient neighborhoods.

First floor, easy living in this meticulously maintained STUDIO apartment convenient to just about everything Stamford has to offer. An open concept layout with natural light pouring in makes this the perfect place to call home. Large private storage unit and laundry in basement. Assigned parking right in front with easy access to unit plus visitor parking. Minutes to shopping, restaurants, entertainment, houses of worship, schools and more. A quick drive to downtown, walking distance to the Glenbrook train station and shopping center. Close to both Merritt Parkway and I-95. Don't miss out!

listings.remarks: Sophisticated Style and Unbeatable Location - Newfield/Pepper Ridge.   Some homes just have *it* - that rare blend of style, space, and location that makes you stop and pick up the phone. This is that home.  Nestled in one of Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods, this beautifully maintained 3-4 bedroom, 1.5 bath residence has been thoughtfully updated for the way people live today. From the striking new front door to the showpiece custom eat-in kitchen - featuring stainless appliances, custom cabinetry, and direct access to a brand-new private deck - every detail has been considered.  The sun-drenched living room impresses with vaulted ceilings and a cozy fireplace, while gleaming hardwood floors flow throughout. Need flexibility? The lower level delivers - a spacious family room plus a fourth bedroom or home office, perfect for guests or remote work. Upstairs offers three spacious bedrooms and a newer bath. Best of all? **Everything has already been done.** New roof, new deck, new front door, repointed chimney, and newer driveway mean zero headaches from day one. Gas heat, central air, city water, and sewer complete the package.  And the location? Walk to everything that makes Stamford living so desirable - shops, parks, and top-rated schools, all steps away.  Move-in ready. Meticulously updated. Perfectly positioned.  *This is the one you've been waiting for.*

*OFFER DEADLINE 4/20, 5PM* Set on over 1.5 private acres in a sought-after Stamford location near the Greenwich line & surrounded by multimillion-dollar homes, this mid-century modern ranch offers architectural character, generous scale, and a natural flow between indoor and outdoor living. Hardwood and slate floors, recessed lighting, rich woodwork, beams, built-ins, and expansive glass sliders reflect the home's distinctive design and appeal. The living room is the centerpiece, featuring a dramatic cathedral ceiling, floor-to-ceiling fireplace, and expansive glass sliders that open to the enclosed porch, where walls of windows frame the serene backyard and set the tone for morning coffee, quiet moments, or easy entertaining. A spacious formal dining room flows naturally into the eat-in kitchen, creating an inviting layout for both everyday living and larger gatherings. Offering 5 beds, with one perfectly suited for use as a home office, 3 full baths, plus a mudroom/laundry off the kitchen, the layout provides flexibility, while the lower level adds tremendous potential for additional living. Outside, the sprawling private backyard is framed by mature trees and offers the space, privacy, and setting for a true outdoor oasis. All of this is ideally located with easy access to downtown Stamford, Metro-North, major commuting routes, and the shopping, dining, and conveniences of Greenwich, offering a lifestyle that blends privacy, space, & convenience in an exceptional location.

FOR RENT - 637 Cove Road, Stamford, CT 06902 | Unit A15  Welcome to The Beachcomber, located in the beautiful Cove neighborhood of Stamford - one of the area's most sought-after waterfront communities.  This bright and freshly updated 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment offers a clean, modern living space just moments from the shoreline. The unit features a fully updated kitchen with brand new appliances, refinished hardwood floors, and a tastefully updated bathroom. Freshly painted throughout, the apartment has a light and airy feel with great natural sunlight.  Apartment Features: 1 Bedroom / 1 Bathroom Fully updated kitchen with brand new appliances Refinished hardwood floors Updated bathroom Freshly painted interior Bright, sun-filled living space Laundry in building Location Highlights:  Set in Stamford's desirable Cove neighborhood, this location offers the perfect mix of coastal charm and everyday convenience. Enjoy easy access to Cove Beach, where you can take advantage of sandy beaches, walking paths, and beautiful waterfront views.  Additional benefits include:  Close proximity to Downtown Stamford, restaurants, and nightlife Easy access to I-95 and major commuting routes Nearby parks, shopping, and local amenities  A great opportunity to live in a move-in ready apartment in a prime beachside location.

The home offers 4 generously sized bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, with a flexible third-floor layout that spans the entire level-perfect as a private primary suite or home office. Enjoy brand-new hardwood flooring on the second and third floors, complemented by durable new vinyl flooring on the first level. Every room is enhanced with upgraded LED lighting, creating a bright, energy-efficient living environment. Additional features include washer/dryer on the first floor and a well-designed multi-level layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Located in a mixed-use building, the residential space maintains a quiet, single-family feel, with neighboring businesses operating only during standard daytime hours-ensuring peace and privacy in the evenings and weekends. Enjoy seasonal views of Laurel Reservoir from this well maintained and thoughtfully updated home. The remodeled kitchen showcases recent stainless-steel appliances, a greenhouse window and an adjacent powder room. The kitchen is open to a generous breakfast and seating area, complete with sliders leading to a deck overlooking private surroundings. A large formal dining room and inviting living room, both with beamed ceilings and built-ins, provide comfortable living spaces with a striking two-sided stone fireplace with gas inserts. The upper floor has three bedrooms plus a sunny office. The spacious primary bedroom has an ensuite bath and walk-in closet. The third/largest bedroom could also be suitable as a family room. Hardwood floors run throughout the home, enhancing its warmth and appeal. A favorite unique feature is the screened-in porch with a stone floor, connected to the home and perched above the two-car garage-a special multi season retreat for entertaining or relaxing. Additional highlights include perennial gardens, stone patio, four-zone heating, whole house generator and paved off-street parking. This very special property combines privacy, convenience, and classic New England style in an unbeatable location.

Tucked away this lovingly maintained colonial home feels warm and charming. Inside this 3 bedroom, 2 bath home you'll find a home that's been cared for with 1890 square feet of comfortable living space on a beautifully kept lot offering a peaceful retreat that's perfect for anyone looking to settle into a cozy, private setting. The cute neighborhood adds to the charm all while being a short drive to everything you need.

A wonderful 4-bedroom Cape Cod Style home in the Newfield section of Stamford. The open floor plan has a living room with fireplace, that leads to the adjacent dining area and a cozy eat-in-kitchen. The primary bedroom, a full bathroom and second bedroom complete the first floor. Off the dining area there is a walk-out to a sun-filled Trex deck. Upstairs there are two bedrooms and a full bath. Newly refinished hardwood floors and fresh paint on the first and second floors. The lower level has a large finished family room and a laundry/utility room. New furnace and garage door opener. A lovely level back yard. Located on a welcoming tree-lined street in the heart of Stamford, within minutes of parks, golf & tennis, schools, dining and shopping. Enjoy the vibrant downtown Stamford and three amazing public beaches on Long Island Sound. Welcome Home!

Spectacular estate in highly coveted Westover delivering luxury, scale, and versatility at every turn. Boasting 6 bedrooms and 5.5 baths, this exceptional home is designed to meet a wide range of needs-from comfortable everyday living to hosting grand, unforgettable events. Freshly painted throughout, it showcases a crisp, modern feel while maintaining timeless elegance. Built for entertaining, the expansive layout offers seamless flow between gracious living spaces, creating the perfect setting for everything from intimate dinners to large celebrations. Step outside to breathtaking, resort-style grounds highlighted by a stunning pool-your own private oasis where every day feels like a getaway. This is not just a backyard, it's a destination. Stunning direct waterfront rental perched on a bluff overlooking Holly Pond on the Darien/Stamford line. Completely renovated in 2018, this home offers a seamless open floor plan designed to maximize both comfort and breathtaking water views.  The spacious living room features French doors that open to a covered porch, creating a perfect indoor-outdoor flow-all with sweeping waterfront vistas. The beautifully updated kitchen boasts a center island, quartz countertops, modern backsplash, and top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances. It opens to a generous dining area, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining, along with a convenient powder room.  Upstairs, the primary suite occupies a private level and includes a renovated bath. Three additional bedrooms offer ample closet space, a Murphy bed, and a shared hall bath with tub/shower. Outside, the covered porch leads down to an expansive flagstone patio with masonry walls and a firepit-perfect for year-round enjoyment of the serene waterfront setting. The expansive family room, with cathedral ceilings, a fireplace, and wet bar, creates a striking yet inviting central gathering space. A new TimberTech deck (2025) extends the living area outdoors, overlooking a private, landscaped yard with mature trees and a serene wooded backdrop. The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with its own fireplace, full bath, and walk-in closet. The finished walk-out lower level adds versatile space for recreation, guests, or a home office. Step inside to an open and inviting floor plan bathed in beautiful natural light. The spacious living room and dining area flow seamlessly, creating an ideal setup for daily living and hosting guests. The bright eat-in kitchen features direct access to a private brick-paver patio, which effortlessly connects to a larger back patio, making indoor-outdoor entertaining a breeze. Down the hall, the primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat complete with double closets and its own en-suite bath. Two additional generously sized bedrooms and a second full hallway bath complete the main level. The living space extends to the finished lower level, featuring two distinct rooms: a second living room and a versatile space ideal for a home office or gym. This level also includes dedicated laundry, a spacious storage room, and direct access inside to your 1-car garage. Outside, enjoy your own sanctuary on an oversized, private .75-acre lot framed by lush greenery and beautiful landscaping, offering endless room to relax or play. *Square footage listed does not include finished lower level.

The inviting living room features a wood-burning fireplace and sliding doors leading to a spacious 380 sq. ft. deck overlooking the private backyard. A generous formal dining room flows into the updated custom kitchen with granite countertops, breakfast nook, and additional deck access-ideal for indoor and outdoor entertaining. The first floor also offers a large recreation/playroom with French doors and a convenient laundry room. Upstairs, the primary suite features an en-suite bath, walk-in closet, and two additional dressing/linen closets. Three additional bedrooms with hardwood floors share a full hallway bath. Conveniently located just 3 minutes to the Merritt Parkway, 5 minutes to Downtown Stamford, and 8 minutes to I-95 and the Stamford Train Station, providing an easy commute to New York City.

With a western-facing orientation, the property enjoys beautiful sunsets and sweeping water views across the harbor and out toward the New York City skyline. Approached by a cobblestone driveway and surrounded by mature landscaping, the home has an understated and refined presence. The rear of the property opens to a broad terrace and manicured lawn that lead directly to the beach, creating a seamless connection to the water. This 5-bedroom, 3.5-bath home offers light-filled living spaces, many oriented toward the water. A spacious kitchen with oversized island and adjacent breakfast area opens to the outdoors, while a formal dining room and multiple living areas provide flexibility. A full-length enclosed porch offers panoramic water views and is one of the home's standout features. The property also includes a separate cottage on its own parcel, offering flexibility for guests, extended family, or future use. Located just a short walk from the Stamford Yacht Club and only minutes to Metro North with frequent express service to Manhattan, the setting offers a unique combination of privacy, accessibility, and direct connection to the water that is difficult to replicate.

Welcome to this sun-filled ranch offering breathtaking, year-round views from nearly every window in the house. Set on 1.5 beautifully maintained acres - a mix of open, cleared grounds and natural woods - this 5-bedroom, 3-bath home is a rare find for anyone seeking space, light, and privacy in one package. Inside, 3,800 square feet of living space unfolds across thoughtfully designed rooms with high ceilings throughout. The kitchen is a true centerpiece - a cook and entertainer's dream, outfitted with high-end appliances, stunning quartzite countertops featuring a porcelain farmhouse sink and large center island. A convenient laundry room sits just off the kitchen, and closet space throughout the home is exceptional. The family room is a showstopper: vaulted ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows on two full walls, and a wood-burning stove create a warm, light-filled gathering space for every season. The primary suite offers a private ensuite bath, while two additional full baths serve the rest of the home with ease. Downstairs, the finished walkout basement adds remarkable flexibility to entertain family and guests of all ages, a home office setup, or a true in-law suite. Step outside to an 800-square-foot bluestone patio, framed by elegant mahogany railings, the perfect spot to take in the property's year-round scenery.

Rich in authentic architectural detail, the residence is defined by soaring ceilings, five original fireplaces, wide-board pumpkin pine floors, handcrafted millwork, and warm brick passageways that create an atmosphere both elegant and inviting. listings.remarks: Light and bright remodeled First Floor Apartment in the heart of South End! Two minutes walk to Stamford RR for a quick train ride into Manhattan.  Spacious first-floor unit (#1) with high ceilings and plenty of natural light.  Generous living room with bay windows.  Galley style kitchen with gas range and new dishwasher.  Full bath with a shower and window for ventilation!  Oversized primary bedroom with abundance of windows and new blinds.  Bonus: Private access to a front porch where you can put a table and chairs and while away those balmy evenings watching the world go by.  Extras: Coin-operated washer and dryer in the shared lower level, along with additional storage space.  One dedicated parking spot in the driveway behind the house.  Tenants to pay total of $200 a month to cover utilities - heat, hot water, cooking gas, and electricity (light and a/c units). Landlord is looking for creditscore of 680+ and a stable work history (2.5 times monthly rent in income). Maximum two inhabitants, no pets!   Schedule your tour today!

Owner occupied for the past 50+ years. Front and rear entry for both units. Large eat in kitchens and large living rooms in both units. Kitchens each have access to covered decks with steps to the rear yard. First floor unit is owner occupied and has 2 bedrooms and one bath. Second floor unit has been occupied by the same tenant for 30+ years and has two bedrooms and one bath. Full basement with hatchway door. Baseboard and radiators fueled by oil, one boiler with two zones, one HWH, two electrical meters. Gas line to house for gas stove in first floor unit only. Long driveway and carport for good off street parking in rear of house. Level rear yard.

Super cool & fun living in the pulse of downtown Stamford is yours to have! Enjoy fab cityscape views from the super large entertainer's balcony (20 feet long!) in this immaculate & updated 7th floor condo in the heart of sophisticated downtown. Enjoy reserved parking, a bright new kitchen, drift-wood style laminate floors, separate sleeping alcove and living room with fabulous south-facing balcony overlooking downtown. HEAT AND HOT WATER INCLUDED IN RENT. There is a small, separate storage unit. Enjoy living the urban dream in vibrant downtown Stamford, steps to the renowned Avon Theater, popular restaurants, shops, bars, the Ferguson library and public transportation. 1-cat allowed.

listings.remarks: Move-in ready is an overused phrase, but this one earns it. The unit has been freshly painted throughout and comes with stainless steel appliances, a new in-unit washer and dryer, a newer water heater, and an updated electrical panel. Those last few are the unglamorous, expensive items most buyers end up handling themselves, and here they're already taken care of.    A private balcony extends the living space for morning coffee. One off-street parking spot comes with the unit, as does a private storage unit and pets are welcome, including a built-in nook under the stairs that's already set up as a dedicated dog and cat space.    The location adds a lot. Lione Park is a short walk away, E. Gaynor Brennan Golf Course sits around the corner, and downtown Stamford is under a mile on foot, which puts restaurants, coffee, and everyday errands within easy reach. Metro-North is a quick drive when the city calls, with a direct ride into Grand Central.    Finished, comfortable, and priced below the Stamford condo median. This is a genuine opportunity to own in a market where that's getting harder to find.

Rare opportunity in Stamford's coveted Springdale neighborhood! Set on a private .26-acre corner lot with driveway access from a quiet, dead-end side street, this 1,173 sq. ft. two-bedroom home offers exceptional bones and an unbeatable location. Built in 1862 and renovated in 2005, the home is ready for its next chapter - hardwood floors lie beneath the wall-to-wall carpet on the main floor. The multi-level yard features a hidden private patio and a three-season porch, outdoor living at its best. Updated and fully renovated two-bedroom homes in the immediate area have recently sold between $560,000 and $828,000. Sold strictly as-is as part of an estate sale. Sale is subject to Probate Court approval. Bring your vision and your contractor!  *Highest and best offers due Sunday, 10/4 by 6:00 PM.

listings.remarks: Living is easy in this impressively restored 4 Bedroom 3 Bath split level in prime commuter location just a short walk to Metro North to NYC! A living room & spacious walk-in for storage, a generously sized bedroom & full bath round out this floor. Up top you can find your primary bedroom with en-suite bathroom. Two additional bedrooms, one with a large walk-in closet & separated by a Jack-and-Jill full bath. All second floor bedrooms are flanked by a common area perfect for family room or dining area. Full size washer/dryer included. An oversized 2 Car Garage can fit 2 large vehicles with extra space for all your storage needs. All situated on a private dead-end street with easy access to shops, transportation, downtown Stamford, short walk to Glenbrook train station to NYC, & all major highways!

This beautiful two-bedroom, one-bath residence offers a spacious, light-filled layout with a private balcony and open views toward downtown. Enjoy the convenience of one reserved parking space, in-building laundry, and well-maintained amenities including an in-ground pool, fitness center, and playground. Ideally located just steps from downtown dining, shopping, nightlife, and public transportation-perfect for easy everyday living or commuting. A move-in ready opportunity combining comfort, convenience, and lifestyle.

listings.remarks: Discover the potential of this spacious 2,600+ sq. ft. ranch, nestled on 2 private, picturesque acres. Featuring 4 bedrooms, 3 full baths, and two charming stone fireplaces, this home offers a versatile layout ideal for those seeking room to grow or even space for a potential in-law suite. The expansive grounds complete with mature trees and an in-ground pool provide an incredible canvas for outdoor living, gardening, or recreation. Offered as-is, this estate is a rare find in a prime location, presenting an exceptional opportunity for investors, builders, or imaginative homeowners ready to customize this property into their dream vision.

Beautifully rebuilt in 2006, this custom turn-key retreat offers 4 spacious Bedrooms with the flexibility for a 5th, 3 full & 2 half baths, all set on 2.33 acres of private, picturesque grounds; just 1 hour away from NYC. Arrive to curated landscaping surrounded by mature trees and seasonal blooms, including hydrangeas, geraniums, and climbing mandevilla, complemented by bespoke stonework and hand-crafted stepping stone paths. As you step inside, soaring ceilings and gleaming hardwood floors set the tone for the home's expansive, open-concept, anchored by a striking spiral staircase that makes an unforgettable first impression. Natural light pours through French doors, seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living.  The living room, perfectly positioned off the grand foyer and family room, is filled with natural light and features a second fireplace crafted from premium natural limestone.  The Family room is a true centerpiece, featuring vaulted ceilings & a grand wood-burning fireplace. Both warm and inviting, it's the perfect setting for cozy game nights or relaxing with hot chocolate by the fire while watching the snowfall outside. The Chef's Kitchen is both grand and functional, featuring high-end Viking appliances and designed for effortless entertaining, with seamless flow to the Dining and Living rooms and direct access to the outdoor patio, perfect for al fresco dining on a summer night.

Primely located at the end of a quiet Westover cul-de-sac, a long, sweeping drive leads to 35 Drum Hill Lane, gracefully set on one private acre. Taken down to the studs and completely rebuilt, the residence pairs a striking exterior with light-filled interiors and a refined, contemporary sensibility. Floor-to-ceiling windows, white oak floors and trimless recessed lighting bring warmth to beautifully proportioned rooms that flow effortlessly from one to the next. The kitchen features Thermador appliances, custom cabinetry, quartz countertops and an oversized island designed for casual gatherings and effortless entertaining. The dining and living spaces flow naturally together, with expansive glass doors opening to a bluestone patio for seamless indoor-outdoor living. A wood-burning fireplace with a reeded surround anchors the open-concept family room and create an inviting setting for both everyday living and entertaining.  Upstairs, four bedrooms, an office, a laundry room and a spacious great room provide ample space to gather, work and unwind. The primary suite boasts vaulted ceilings, floor to ceiling windows, California Closets, while the bath offers a serene retreat with dual sinks, radiant-heated floors, heated towel racks, a deep soaking tub and a generous walk-in shower. One of Stamford's most desirable locations, this home offers convenient access to downtown Stamford, Greenwich and commuter routes.

Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac in Stamford's desirable Newfield neighborhood, this well-maintained raised ranch offers space, comfort, and privacy. Featuring 4 bedrooms and 3 full baths, the home boasts hardwood floors throughout much of the main level and two fireplaces that add warmth and character. The spacious layout includes a renovated primary bathroom and generously sized rooms filled with natural light. Step outside to an oversized deck perfect for entertaining, outdoor dining, or simply relaxing in a peaceful setting. A private side yard provides additional outdoor space for recreation and enjoyment. The lower level offers excellent flexibility with a family room and large storage room adjacent to the garage that presents an exciting opportunity for future expansion, home office space, gym, or recreation room. Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, parks, and commuter routes, this move-in-ready home combines a sought-after neighborhood setting with exceptional potential.

Welcome to this completely renovated home in the heart of downtown Stamford. Be the first to live here after such extensive upgrades were completed. The upgrades are numerous, featuring a kitchen with new appliances, cabinetry, backsplash, counters, and more! The bathroom has been beautifully designed to the last detail. Professionally refinished hardwood floors shine throughout the home. A custom walk-in closet was added to the 2nd bedroom. All new blinds complete the list of final touches. You'll notice the abundance of light in the living room which then flows throughout the bedrooms as the day continues. On-site laundry for your convenience. Heat & hot water are included in the rent.   Step outside and enjoy everything- restaurants, cafes, night life, shoppping, public library, and so much more. The Avon and Palace theaters are just steps away. The Metro North is within a walk, making for an easy commute. The Bedford Street Garage is close to the building and offers monthly parking passes. Prime downtown location.

Spacious Colonial set on a serene and private 1.5-acre property with breathtaking sunset views. Offering incredible flexibility and endless potential, this expansive home features 5 bedrooms, 3 full baths, and a separate second kitchen ideal for extended family or possible in-law accommodations. A massive walk-out basement provides abundant storage and the opportunity to create additional finished living space. The main level showcases a generously sized eat-in kitchen with center island and stainless steel appliances, a sun-filled living room with hardwood floors and a wood-burning fireplace, plus a charming screened porch perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Also on the first floor are a spacious bedroom with adjoining full bath that can serve as a primary suite, two additional bedrooms with hardwood flooring, and a second full bath. The second level offers its own oversized kitchen, a large primary bedroom, fifth bedroom, and a full bath - creating excellent potential for multi-generational living. Additional highlights include a detached 2-car garage, newer roof, and a flat, usable backyard with plenty of room for a pool. This home is being sold as-is and presents a fantastic opportunity to customize and make it your own.

Welcome to 21 Culloden Road, a spacious and meticulously maintained 2-family residence situated in the highly desirable Glenbrook neighborhood. This turnkey property features two large, light-filled units, making it an incredible opportunity for investors or owner-occupants/ multi generational family living. Unit 1 (First Floor) features 3 bedrooms, 1 full bath, separate living and dining rooms, central air, and an expansive eat-in kitchen. Unit 2 (Second Floor) features 4 bedrooms, 1.5 baths, in-unit laundry, central a/c and an equally spacious eat-in kitchen. Major capital improvements offer peace of mind, including a fully replaced roof and new water heater (both 2021). Both units will be delivered vacant at closing. Step outside to a flat, usable backyard-a private outdoor oasis perfect for grilling, gardening, or relaxing. The oversized driveway provides ample off-street parking for multiple vehicles and features a new gardening shed for extra storage. Just minutes from the Glenbrook and Stamford Transportation Centers (Metro-North/Amtrak express to NYC), I-95, and Chelsea Piers. Enjoy easy access to Cove Island Park's beaches and the vibrant dining, shopping, and nightlife of Downtown Stamford. Whether you are looking to expand your rental portfolio or live in one unit while renting the other, 21 Culloden Road is the perfect place to call home.

Set on one of North Stamford's most sought-after lanes, this beautifully refreshed New England Colonial blends timeless elegance with modern functionality, offering an ideal layout for today's lifestyle. A sun-filled, open floor plan welcomes you with a spacious living room that flows seamlessly into the formal dining room-perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The eat-in kitchen features all new SS appliances, including a washer and dryer, and opens to a warm and inviting family room complete with custom built-ins and a fireplace. A separate sunroom, framed by French doors, leads to a rear deck and private flagstone patio-creating a perfect indoor-outdoor connection. Flexible spaces throughout the home offer endless possibilities for a home office, sitting room, or playroom. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite provides a true retreat, featuring an en-suite bath, a large exercise or sitting room, multiple closets, vaulted ceilings, and oversized windows that flood the space with natural light. The finished lower level offers additional living space, ideal for a playroom, media room, or private retreat. Ideally located in lower North Stamford, within a mile of The Stamford Museum & Nature Center, Chestnut Hill Park, Tennis Courts, Dog Park plus just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, shopping, top-rated schools, downtown Stamford, and the train station, this move-in-ready home is the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and style. Offers generator as well.

Looking for a charming and renovated place to live in the Cove neighborhood of Stamford? Look no further. This just renovated 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath home features quartz kitchen countertops, stainless steel appliances, new floors, and in-unit laundry. The main level of this features a spacious living room, eat-in-kitchen, half bathroom, and laundry area. On the upper level, you'll find two bedrooms and a full bathroom. Two off-street parking spaces are included within a shared driveway. Landlord covers all exterior maintenance & trash. Good credit (650 or better with no red flags), income verification, background check, and rental application are required. Private garage space available for $100 /mo. Schedule a tour before it's gone. 2 months security. Tenant pays electric utilities. Trash and water included.

Privately situated overlooking a picturesque pond, this meticulously maintained 4-bedroom, 3-bath home combines space, comfort and tranquility in desirable North Stamford. Set back in its own private, serene setting, the property offers a peaceful, retreat-like feel that makes every day feel like a getaway. A skylit foyer with double staircase welcomes you into the bright interior. The sun-filled living room with fireplace and formal dining room showcase beautiful pond views. The spacious kitchen features a center island, 6-burner Dacor cooktop, double ovens, Sub-Zero refrigerator, wet bar with wine cooler, abundant cabinetry, built-in pantry organizers and pull-out storage. The light-filled primary suite includes a walk-in cedar closet and skylit bath with heated floors, whirlpool tub and separate shower. Both main-level bedrooms feature distinctive varied-width plank hardwood floors. The walk-out lower level includes two additional bedrooms, an office, full bath and family/entertainment room with wood-burning stove and wet bar. French doors open to the patio and yard. Additional highlights include a whole-house generator, UV purification system and newer water heater. Just a quick car ride to shopping, dining, parks and everyday conveniences.

Impeccably maintained ranch in desirable Springdale, offering effortless one-level living and exceptional convenience. The inviting living room with built-ins flows into the eat-in kitchen and dining area with fireplace. Four bedrooms and two full baths complete the main level, including a spacious primary with a walk-in closet. Upstairs, a laundry room and a bonus space offer an ideal home office, or studio. Beautifully landscaped grounds feature a front deck, back patio, and fenced side yard for easy outdoor living and entertaining. Attached garage, abundant lower-level storage, hardwood floors, central air, and natural gas. Unbeatable location just moments from Sleepy Hollow Park, train, buses, Twin Rinks, shopping, dining, and more. A true Springdale gem that has been in the same family for almost 45 years, and is ready for its next owner.

Privately nestled on 1.14 picturesque acres at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in one of North Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods, this gracious 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath Colonial offers 4,594 square feet of exceptional living space. A dramatic two-story foyer welcomes you into a home distinguished by generous room sizes, multiple fireplaces, and a timeless floor plan designed for both elegant entertaining and comfortable everyday living. Lovingly maintained by the same family for many years, this exceptional property is ready to inspire its next owner. Rich in character and classic architectural appeal, it presents a rare opportunity to create a truly personalized residence tailored to your own taste, style, and vision. Whether preserving its enduring charm or introducing a fresh, modern aesthetic, the home's impressive scale, thoughtful layout, and exceptional setting provide the ideal canvas to craft a home that is uniquely yours. Set amidst mature trees and lush surroundings, the expansive property offers remarkable privacy, tranquility, and abundant space for outdoor living, recreation, and entertaining. Ideally located just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, shopping, dining, parks, and downtown Stamford, this distinguished North Stamford property combines the peace and privacy of cul-de-sac living with exceptional convenience. This is a rare opportunity to own a remarkable home and transform it into the home you've always envisioned. Offered As Is. All information is be

Three-level, 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhouse at Schooner Cove in Stamford, Connecticut - with a deeded garage, and partial water views from two private balconies.This townhouse at Schooner Cove delivers a rare marina lifestyle with low-maintenance living in one of Stamford's most sought-after waterfront communities. The open-concept main level combines kitchen, dining, and living areas around a wood-burning fireplace, with a private balcony off the living room offering water views. A second balcony off the primary bedroom extends outdoor living to the upper level, where vaulted ceilings enhance two of the three bedrooms.The layout includes 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and smart vertical flow across three floors. Two parking passes plus one visitor pass - three parking options total - supplement the deeded attached garage. HOA membership includes access to the community pool and clubhouse. Schooner Cove in Stamford's Shippan neighborhood sits minutes from West Beach, with convenient access to I-95, the Metro-North Stamford train station, and downtown Stamford.

Located on the Stamford waterfront, Allure offers direct access to public parks, marinas, and a scenic boardwalk, along with vibrant dining options and over 200 events year-round-from yoga on the boardwalk and 5K races to farmers markets and seasonal pop-ups.  Welcome to a new standard of luxury. Welcome to Allure.
