Short walk to Metro North and Steps to weekend farmers market, Library, medical facilitates, UCONN and some of the finest restaurants in Fairfield County. Pet friendly and underground parking is available. Heat, Hot water and cooking gas included

Set in one of only two buildings at Rivers Edge that do not face other buildings front and back, this 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse offers a rare, semi-private patio overlooking the community's landscaped grounds. A private elevator serving all three levels further distinguishes this home on the Stamford/Darien border.  The entry level features a flexible family room with direct access to the garden patio, an upgraded laundry area with new washer/dryer, utility sink, and hose spigot, along with a newer water heater and direct garage entry.  The main level showcases hardwood floors throughout a spacious living room and eat-in kitchen appointed with stainless steel appliances, gas range, and center island. Sliding doors open to a sunny, newly built deck, and a half bath completes the floor.  The top level includes a generous primary suite with walk-in closet, jetted tub, separate shower, and double vanity. The second bedroom also offers a walk-in closet, complemented by a full hall bath and additional storage. A stand-up attic provides substantial storage space.  Thoughtful updates include a full HVAC replacement in August 2024 featuring dual zones, WiFi thermostats, and a 10-year parts warranty. Carpeting was replaced in 2020 and has been professionally cleaned annually. The home is pre-wired for a security system and includes accessibility features throughout.  Residents enjoy a community pool, clubhouse, fitness center, and professionally maintained grounds.

listings.remarks: Welcome to Midtown Estates! Just steps from vibrant downtown, this stylish townhome offers the perfect blend of sophistication, space & convenience. Custom details throughout include hardwood floors, recessed lighting & detailed millwork. The entry foyer with built-ins leads to a sun-filled main level with an open floor plan featuring a living room, dining area with sliders to a private balcony and the designer kitchen showcasing quartz countertops, breakfast bar, custom shelving & stainless steel appliances. A powder room completes the main level. Upstairs, you'll find two generous bedrooms & a hall bath, while the entire third level is dedicated to the primary bedroom with walk-in closet featuring built-ins & full bath. The crown jewel is the private rooftop deck with fabulous city views-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Attached 2-car garage. Freshly painted interior. Move-in ready & not to be missed!

Nestled on a coveted cul-de-sac in Stamford's highly sought-after Mid-Ridges neighborhood, this beautifully updated raised ranch offers a rare opportunity to enjoy the serenity of waterfront living without sacrificing convenience. Ideally located between the Merritt Parkway, I-95, and Metro-North, you're just minutes from Stamford's finest restaurants, shopping, and entertainment. At the heart of the home is a stunning kitchen with Quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances that flows effortlessly into the dining room and spacious living room, creating the perfect space for entertaining or everyday living. Step outside to the expansive deck and let the peaceful Rippowam River steal the show. Sip your morning coffee, host unforgettable gatherings, or unwind in Adirondack chairs along the riverbank as the water gently flows by and the seasons transform the landscape. Large storage room. This gated community is impeccably maintained with an on-site superintendent, offering a move-in-ready opportunity in one of Greenwich's most coveted addresses.

Coveted Glenville location offers a gracious four-bedroom Cape with new covered deck and level backyard near schools, shops, Byram Park with town pool, beach and Greenwich as well as Port Chester trains. This home is conveniently located near parks, schools, shopping, and public transportation, making it a perfect location for anyone looking for a convenient lifestyle. Excellent opportunity to buy in Greenwich.

Designed with classic sophistication, this home provides an exquisite backdrop for the Greenwich lifestyle. The grand, balconied foyer, framed by French doors and large windows, welcomes natural light and leads you into beautifully appointed public spaces and a peaceful study. Ideal for both lavish entertaining and intimate gatherings, this 8500+square-foot center hall colonial with open floor plan offers ample room to live and entertain in style.  At the day's end, relax in one of the generous ensuite bedrooms, complemented by spacious game room with bath for added leisure or possible in-law suite. This stately manor sits gracefully on 4.23 acres, providing privacy and beauty in equal measure. The expansive walk-out, high-ceilinged lower level, includes space for a bedroom and full bath, along with a doble-sided fireplace offering tremendous potential for customization to suit your needs. There is a 7 Bedroom Septic, Possible Pool & Tennis Court Sites. Note: Total Square Footage INCLUDES Unfinished Walk Out Lower Level of 2731SF

Exquisite Milbrook Association home close to Greenwich Ave. This lovely 4 bedroom, 4 bath home has hardwood floors throughout and renovations to the highest standard. Formal living room with bay window and fireplace adjoins dining room with French doors to deck. Eat in kitchen with top-of-the line appliances and custom cabinetry. Family room/library with built ins. First-floor bedroom with lots of light and door opening to the porch could be home office. The second floor has a lovely primary suite which has a large spa bath with glass countertops and shower. There is a large walk-in closet as well as 2 other closets. The upstairs guest bedroom includes private bath. Lower level bedroom and bath suite walks out to rear yard. Association maintains security 7 days per week.

Large scale entertaining rooms all professionally decorated by high profile design firm with stunning renovation throughout. Stunning entry hall opens to lacquered office with terrace, dining room, living room and family room with adjacent kitchen. Eat-in gourmet kitchen with island + breakfast area + two dishwashers, Wolf ovens and stove. 2 wine fridges. Primary suite with two walk-in closets, 2 en-suite guest suites, 3rd and 4th bedrooms with Jack and Jill bathroom. Windowed lower level is walkout with playroom, game room, exercise room and kitchenette w bar and bathroom. Complete smart house - Hydrawise sprinklers, iaqualink smart pool heater, Lutron smart system, 12 security cameras, Doorbird, Resideo thermostats, Sonos, MyQ remote garage doors. Surrounded by horse farms and Conyers Farm polo field, Stanwich Golf Club and only 10 mins to downtown Greenwich or Bedford. North Street shopping mall around the corner with gourmet grocery, pharmacy, wine store, animal hospital, and dry cleaners. Turnkey. Possible tennis court or sports court site.

HIGHEST & BEST DUE MONDAY 1/13 BY 5PM. Nestled in the highly desirable neighborhood of Cos Cob, this meticulously maintained home features a perfect blend of timeless charm and modern comfort. Gleaming hardwood floors flow throughout, enhancing its warm and inviting atmosphere. The chef's kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a spacious center island, and ample room for gathering. Upstairs, the primary suite is a tranquil retreat with a luxurious bathroom and a spacious walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms and another full bathroom complete the second level. The partially finished basement adds versatility with a additional room, full bathroom, and laundry/exercise area. Outdoors, enjoy a backyard oasis, fully renovated in 2021 with a lush lawn, sprinkler system, vinyl fencing, and Trex decking on both porches. Entertain on the Italian porcelain tile patio or around the custom firepit. The detached two-car garage features a screened in garage door and provides ample storage and flexibility, ideal for vehicles, hobbies, or a workshop.

Privacy and close to downtown Greenwich. This HOBI Award winning home was built in 2020 by Red Canoe Partners and Designed by Clarity Home Interiors with thoughtful details throughout. It boasts sunset oriented perspective from large patio and 20x40 gunite pool with built-in auto-cover. The exceptional features of this 8646 sqr. ft. home include 5 bed, 7 bath, 3-car oversize garage, elevator, Wolfe and Sub-Zero appliances, Marvin windows and doors, plus Control 4 Smart Home technology throughout. the Great-Room features full surround sound capability and 13ft bi-folding door to open directly to the rear patio. Stunning Primary Suite with fireplace and view. Luxury primary bath with heated floors, heated towel bar and soaking tub. Huge basement with gym, 2nd laundry, lots of storage.

Welcome to 334 Palmer Hill, a charming farmhouse-style home in the NM school district with a versatile layout. The main residence offers 2 bedrooms, an office, 1.5 baths, a sunny kitchen, a dining room, and convenient laundry facilities. An unfinished attic provides potential for further expansion. The first-floor accessory apartment features an eat-in kitchen, living room, office, 2 bedrooms, and a bath. The lower level includes additional storage and laundry space. A detached 2-car garage with attic storage completes this delightful property. Perfect for multi-generational living or lucrative rental opportunities!

Walking distance to the train, Greenwich Avenue and Bruce Park, this 4 bedroom home is a must see! Nestled among several newly built homes on the street, this property is ideal for entertaining. Sunshine pours into the living room from three exposures and fills this happy home all the way to the spacious outdoor deck overlooking the wonderfully private backyard. With extra height ceilings in the upstairs bedrooms, hardwood floors throughout, and multiple rooms for office space, nursery, exercise or closets, this home offers maximum optionality. Don't miss the finished lower level with an additional 437 square feet with exterior access complete with a full bath, additional washer/dryer, kitchen sink and a covered porch. Come see this downtown gem before it's gone!

listings.remarks: Nestled amidst stately homes in a tranquil setting, this charming 1930s Colonial offers a rare opportunity for renovation and customization. With its timeless appeal, this home is ready to be upgraded to today's standards, providing endless potential to create your dream residence. Property is sold "as is."

Close to town in a very desirable private association,this exquisite manor-style home boasts five bedrooms and five-and-a-half baths. Situated on approximately two acres in coveted Edgar Manor Association.. Perched high above the street, this residence presents a tremendous opportunity to own a stunning property. Inside, you'll find a spectacular great room, soaring ceilings, and a glass-enclosed garden room, designed by renowned architect designer John Saladino - ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The home also features an elevator connecting all four floors - lower level to the attic, as well as a gorgeous wine cellar. There is a pool site. Meticulously maintained, it's hitting the market for the first time in decades-a rare find indeed!

Spacious townhouse which boast 3 bedroom and 2.5 baths. Kitchen with updated appliances. Living room and dining room combination. Hardwood floors. Living room with gas fireplace. Exterior deck. Attached garage and one off street parking. Great value.

Quintessential Old Greenwich South of the Village Living - 5 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom Colonial on A+ quiet neighborhood street with spectacular fenced backyard. Generous sized rooms on all 3 floors. Primary bedroom with walk in closet + large bathroom, 3 family bedrooms with a hall bath + laundry on 2nd floor. 3rd floor with vaulted + beamed ceiling has great playroom, exercise space, 5th bedroom and full bathroom. The front porch, stone terrace and fully fenced large backyard provide wonderful outdoor spaces. Close to Tod's Point, downtown shops and restaurants, train + the amazing village of Old Greenwich! Not in a flood zone.

Picture yourself in a boat on a pond, with tangerine trees and marmalade skies. 7 Byfield Lane, set on nearly three acres in beautiful Mid-Country Greenwich, with five bedrooms, four and a half bathrooms, a pool, and a hot tub offers you a day in the life every day. In 1973, Yoko Ono and John Lennon rowed their own yellow submarine peacefully along a sea of green when they came to visit this home for about an hour and sailed around the pond in the dingy that sits there to this day. Across the universe, this property stands out like a diamond in the sky. Imagine a cozy living room where you can come together with loved ones. Be a day tripper to the city with the Merritt (and the "Ave") minutes away yet still quiet enough to whisper words of wisdom. In the end, you'll realize, all you need is love, and this house is your golden slumbers. Dream away. While it needs TLC and updating, with a little help from your friends, you can make this house a part of your long and winding road to happiness. If you desired, you could start from scratch and have a glorious 6000+ sqft home or you could move in immediately as it currently stands and just, "let it be."

Tucked away, this .34 acre, meticulously maintained property is perfectly located on a private cul de sac in Byram. Set back from the road, the interiors offer a versatile layout, with 3 bedrooms (4th bedroom option), 4 full baths, a wood burning fireplace, and hardwood floors throughout. Sliders lead to a level backyard with an oversized patio, large shed, and beautiful stone wall. Conveniently located by the Mill Street shops and restaurants, making it easy to indulge in local dining and retail experiences in both Greenwich and in Port Chester. Very close to the Byram Beach, Pool, Park, Shubert Library, and New Lebanon Elementary School. Commuting is a breeze with easy access to both the Greenwich and Port Chester Train Station. Taxes under $7,000, with FAR remaining.

Behind the gates in highly prized Conyers Farm sits this incredible brick Georgian on 13+ acres, meticulously re-built with commercial-grade mechanicals, stunning high-end finishes used in all new kitchen and bathrooms. All new plaster moldings, seamless new wood floors, exceptional cabinetry...all done with the finest craftsmanship and thoughtful design. Geo-thermal system installed for efficient cooling/heating w/ separate zones for each room. State-of-the-art water purification system, spray foam insulation, Crestron, heated driveway, and commercial sized generator. This house has back-up systems galore, with every contingency well thought out and engineered. Luxury meets technology. LL framed/prepped for wine & media rooms. Landscape plan to be completed by the buyer but the backdrop is set w/ beautiful terraces, layout of gardens, etc.

Nestled near Greenwich Avenue, this bright 1-bedroom gem exudes a charming Parisian ambiance. Located on the 4th floor of a well-maintained building with an elevator and reserved parking, this inviting unit blends classic charm with modern upgrades. Features include an updated kitchen, high ceilings and a sleek renovated bathroom. The spacious eat-in kitchen and versatile home office creates an ideal work-from-home setup, while wraparound windows fill the space with natural light. Enjoy the rooftop terrace with breathtaking views of the town and Long Island Sound. This building features a live in super and additional storage in the basement. Just blocks from necessities, this apartment perfectly balances comfort and convenience, offering a taste of Greenwich living with European flair.

Unwind in the private gym or explore the well-stocked wine cellar, both conveniently located in the basement.  Embrace an idyllic lifestyle on Byram Shore Road, a prestigious location with effortless access to New York City.

Remarks: Indian Harbor House. Direct waterfront on Greenwich Harbor. Western Exposure with wonderful sunsets. The perfect Pied-a-Terre. Walking distance to the Indian Harbor Yacht Club, Bruce Museum, Bruce Park, Delmar Hotel, Island Beach Ferry, train station and Greenwich Avenue's wonderful stores and restaurants. All rooms excluding baths have stunning water views with large windows and abundant sunlight. Primary bedroom connects via outdoor private waterfront terrace to a 24'x14' living room. Also included is a rare separate studio apartment with full bath on lower level. Great for an office, art studio, guest or live-in help. There are 2 elevators, full time superintendent and a secure indoor parking garage with reserved space. No pets allowed as per bi-laws. A/C included in common charge.

Upon entering this exquisite home, you are greeted by a grand double-height entryway that bathes the space in natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The sunken living room boasts tall windows and a dual-sided fireplace shared with the formal dining room, perfect for seamless entertaining. The family room is equally impressive, offering a cozy retreat around a third fireplace and adjacent to the spacious eat-in kitchen with sleek lacquered cabinets, high-end stainless steel appliances, and ample counter space. The kitchen effortlessly flows out to the new deck, ideal for outdoor dining. This home features two luxurious primary suites. The main floor suite showcases double-height ceilings, a spacious walk-in closet, and a spa-like bathroom. The second-floor suite provides similar qualities, providing privacy and comfort. The walk-out lower level provides a flexible floor plan with options for a fitness room, extra bedroom, large family or screening room, in-law suite, and a full bath. Ample parking is provided by a three-car garage and circular driveway, making it easy to welcome guests. Whether you require dedicated office space, playrooms, or guest rooms, this home's flexible layout can accommodate your lifestyle needs. This contemporary masterpiece seamlessly combines elegance, functionality, and natural beauty, overlooking four lush acres of meadow-like surroundings, creating an exceptional retreat for discerning homeowners.

This elegant Shore Colonial, tucked away on a private lane just south of Old Greenwich village, offers a perfect blend of style and comfort. The open living spaces are adorned with a cozy fireplace and striking beamed ceilings. A flexible first-floor layout features a sun-drenched office or bedroom, a gracious dining room, and a family room that opens onto a spacious patio and yard. Upstairs, you'll find a versatile sitting/play area, three bedrooms, and a full bath. Highlights include skylights, wainscoting, and inviting window seats. The serene, park-like yard enhances the property's appeal, along with a two- car garage and loft, plus expansion potential up to 4,802 sq. ft. Whether seeking a weekend retreat, an investment, or a primary residence, this home is a rare opportunity.

This exceptional 2-bedroom, 2-bath first-floor unit with 3 exposures to charming serene courtyards was renovated extensively in 2022 including new flooring throughout and new plumbing and electric wiring in the kitchen and bathrooms. Nestled among lawns and gardens, yet conveniently located just off the main drive, this inviting home features an open floor plan that welcomes both sunrise and sunset. The spacious dining room flows to the shady terrace, perfect for enjoying the outdoors. The kitchen is equipped with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. Additional features include hardwood floors, recessed lighting, onsite parking and an optional garage rental. Set on 12 beautifully landscaped acres, Putnam Park is a tranquil, pet-friendly community adorned with flowering trees, ideally situated in the heart of Greenwich. Enjoy close proximity to Whole Foods, Greenwich Avenue, fine dining, schools, and the train station.

listings.remarks: Stunning Old Greenwich gem combines ultimate style with unique flexibility. Built on .48 acres with possible pool site, generator, first floor primary, 3 family bedrooms with optional 4th, plus luxurious kitchen and formal dining room, this rare find provides a retreat fit for today's discerning customer. Additional space on the second floor and finished walk out lower level with full bath allows for multiple uses tailored to individual needs. Beautiful outdoor space leads to the charming cottage with living room, kitchenette, full bedroom and bath perfect for guests, relaxation and parties. Featured in both Cottage and Gardens and at Home Magazines, this is truly a one of a kind opportunity south of the village of Old Greenwich. Square footage includes 726 in the cottage.

Experience the best of Old Greenwich living in this fully renovated 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath unit within the gated Gables community. The open-concept kitchen, dining area, and living room, featuring a cozy fireplace, lead to a private balcony. The main level includes a luxurious primary suite, an additional bedroom or office, and a powder room. Upstairs, enjoy a spacious bedroom with an en-suite bathroom, perfect for guests. This unit also has a washer/dryer, an indoor storage locker (#133), and a private assigned parking space (#78). Enjoy luxury amenities like a heated pool, squash court, gym, sauna, and club lounge. Conveniently located near the train, village, and beach, this is a must-see property!

This stunningly remodeled home built in 1900 seamlessly blends old New England charm with modern amenities. This spacious residence features 4 bedrooms, 3 full baths, and 2 half baths, nestled on a level lot adjacent to open play fields, perfect for outdoor activities. Upon entering from the beautiful enclosed porch, you'll find a formal dining room and a bright living room, complete with a cozy gas fireplace. The gourmet chef's kitchen is a true highlight, featuring gas cooking, custom cabinetry, a farmer's sink, and a large center island, complemented by a charming breakfast nook. Hardwood floors flow throughout, enhancing the home's elegant feel. The second floor offers a serene primary bedroom with an en-suite bath, along with two generously sized bedrooms, a den, and an additional full bath. Ascend to the third floor to discover the fourth bedroom, accompanied by another full bath, ideal for guests or privacy. The finished lower level is perfect for entertaining and everyday living, featuring a family room with a built-in entertainment center, an office space, a laundry room, and a convenient half bath. The spacious back deck overlooks the beautiful landscaping and provides an inviting atmosphere for outdoor gatherings and relaxation. Additional features include a carport for convenience. One of the most sought after streets in Greenwich. 3 blocks to Greenwich avenue, 1/2 block to Brunswick school one block to Greenwich academy. Make this charming home your own!

This Stunning Picturesque Colonial that seamlessly blends timeless architecture with every modern amenity and luxurious detail. From the gated entrance and circular driveway to the dramatic two-story foyer, the completely renovated home exudes elegance and grandeur right from the moment of arrival.  Embodied in stylish serenity, custom detailing and intricate millwork throughout the expansive 3 levels featuring 6 bedrooms, 6.2 baths and over 7,500+ sqft of sophisticated elegance. The heart of the home, the gourmet kitchen, sounds like a chef's dream, perfectly connected to the commodious family room, where the combination of vaulted ceilings, oversized windows, and wood-paneled fireplaces adds warmth and sophistication. The formal living spaces and private office with custom built-ins and fireplaces continue the theme of opulence, ideal for both intimate and large gatherings. The upstairs, where the primary suite occupies an entire wing, offers an exceptional retreat with its sitting room, luxurious bath, and double walk-in closets. Hardwood floors throughout, paired with practical features like the laundry room and the spacious 3 car garage with a Tesla charger. The opportunity to expand the home's living space with the 3,000 sq. ft. unfinished lower level, with its high ceilings, makes this property even more desirable for creating a custom media room, wine cellar, and gym. This home beautifully combines traditional charm with state-of-the-art living

Nice 3 bedroom, 3 bath colonial style home with walkout finished basement and 2 car detached garage. Property is located in Cos Cob within close distance to Cos Cob center, train station and shopping. Property does need sone work and being sold strictly as is.

The exterior is designed with maintenance-free decking and siding. As landscaping nears completion, this exquisite home is ready to welcome its new owners just in time for the holidays!

Chic, sophisticated and contemporary luxury best describes this spectacular backcountry retreat. Fully renovated 2022-2024 classic shingle style residence w/pool, pool house, gardens, level lawns and tennis court has it all. Iron gates, long driveway and large courtyard present the perfect approach to 5 bed/6.3 bath masterpiece wi/high ceilings, beautiful floors, exquisite wall coverings, dramatic staircase, amazing kitchen, perfect bathrooms, private office/ library, and full gym. Soaring stone fireplace in Great Room, stunning glass wine wall in adjacent game room & solarium w/ flr to ceiling windows set the tone for both elegant entertaining and family gatherings. 2nd Level: primary suite w/sitting room & luxury bath w/infrared sauna, 4 en-suite bedrooms w/custom walk-in closets and a separate wing with separate entrance and half bath.. 3rd Level: Gym with half bath. Amenities include pool, pool house, tennis court /pickleball court, Koi pond, proper fenced in vegetable garden, 5 car garage and private walking trail. This estate is the epitome of modern luxury, offering an unmatched lifestyle amid Greenwich's country estates.

listings.remarks: This exceptional 1900s Colonial on Old Church Road in Central Greenwich effortlessly blends timeless elegance with modern luxury. The living room, featuring intricate moldings, period woodwork, and a cozy fireplace, flows into a spacious dining room perfect for entertaining. Distinctive rounded walls and a wide staircase add architectural grace, while the first floor boasts a sun-filled, updated eat-in kitchen, family room, office, two powder rooms and expansive great room with 14' vaulted ceilings with custom beams and beautiful wood-burning fireplace. Upstairs, seven bedrooms and four baths provide ample space and comfort. A heated salt-water pool, outdoor patios and thoughtful updates throughout make this home a rare fusion of classic sophistication and contemporary convenience.

Carefree, convenient living defines this recently updated Condo with secluded patio/small yard & flexible upper level floor plan in Hawthorne complex very close to Glenville shopping & dining. Stylish 2020-2024 upgrades include freshly painted interior, new Quartz counters in kitchen, full baths; radiant heat kitchen floor and new living/dining room floors. Main level boasts eat-in kitchen with stainless appliances, open plan dining/living room with wood-burning fireplace, patio & half bath. The upper floors, with loft, provide options for multiple bedrooms including spacious primary suite and possible office. With attached garage & guest parking. Amenities include grounds care, snow & trash removal. Great location near Greenwich Ave., highways, airport, & Westchester

Private corner unit with park like views of the Courtyard has space and flexibility. This inviting three bedroom co-op features one floor living with the convenience of being in town. The generous, light-filled living room flows seamlessly into the adjacent dining area. The updated eat-in kitchen opens to a private patio, perfect for entertaining and relaxing. The primary suite features multiple closets, complemented by two additional bedrooms, and full bath. Hardwood floors add warmth and elegance throughout, off street parking with rental garage parking available. Located in central Greenwich, this unit is close to shopping, dining and the train, offering the perfect blend of comfort and convenience.

The office offers a quiet spot for productivity, and the guest suite provides flexible space for company or downtime. Outdoors, find relaxation at your own private oasis with a heated in-ground pool surrounded by generous flat yard, perfect for coastal Connecticut summers. This is the moment to design and build an extraordinary dream home. This 4.35-acre site is tree lined, private and picturesque. The positioning of a home on this lot with a pool site would be like no other. With a quiet setting and easy access to the Merritt Parkway and short drive to town the convenience and possibilities are endless. The pastoral Back Country is defined by the meandering streams, the pronounced rock outcroppings, winding roads and open meadows. Detached 2 car garage with heating and cooling system.

Redesigned in 2019 by renowned architect Doug Vanderhorn, this 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom home blends exceptional craftsmanship with natural light throughout. The main level features formal living and dining rooms, a private office, and an open-concept kitchen and family room, all opening to a patio and level grounds with a playground. Upstairs, the second level features 5 en-suite bedrooms, including a luxurious primary suite with a marble-clad bathroom and a custom dressing room. The fully finished lower level offers a 6th bedroom and full bath. Pool site approved. Just minutes to Greenwich Avenue, schools, trains and available for you to move before the school year starts!

Be the first to enjoy this thoughtfully renovated 4-bedroom home in the heart of historic Glenville which has been completely remodeled and expanded in 2025 with a low maintenance lifestyle in mind. The home is flooded with natural light and features an open floor plan with the option of a first-floor primary bedroom. The kitchen and dining area includes a large island, stainless steel appliances and clean, modern finishes. The second floor offers three spacious bedrooms and a large full bath with a separate sink/shower room. The finished lower level has two versatile rooms-ideal for a home office, gym, or playroom plus a third full bath. A classic front porch provides the perfect spot to sit and take in the neighborhood, while the backyard features stone walls and a generous patio made entertaining. The large two car garage offers plenty of storage and comes ready to charge your EV!

Move right in to this bright + airy updated Riverside Colonial w sidewalks to schools, trains + town of Old Greenwich. Approx 3500SF of updated living space on .33 of an acre w stunning gardens + room for expansion. 2025 custom renovations incl spectacular gourmet kitchen, new and lightened floors, updated mudroom + entrance from garage, updated bathrooms, new roof, tree work - the list goes on. Options for 1st floor or 2nd floor primary suites. 1st floor has an open floor plan w eat-in kitchen, family room, living / dining room + wonderful 4 season sun room or playroom. Lower level has a family room w stone masonry FP, laundry and an oversized storage room with access to outside. 3 bedrooms with 2 updated bathrooms upstairs. All rooms get lovely sunlight. Available for August move in.

Welcome to this beautiful 5 bedroom, 4.5 bath home in the heart of Old Greenwich and the coveted Dundee International school district. Incredibly convenient to Binney Park, Perrot Library, Metro-North train, and all that OG village has to offer, this transformative, to the studs renovation and expansion was designed by award winning Greenwich architect, Krist Dodaro. The open-concept main floor features a stunning new kitchen flowing seamlessly into the dining and family room, with beautiful limestone-clad fireplace and  French doors leading to the stone patio and expansive, fully fenced in back yard. A light-filled office, living room & half-bath complete this level. A gorgeous primary suite, 3 additional bedrooms and laundry room make up the 2nd floor while the versatile 3rd floor includes a play room, 5th bedroom and full bath. A rare opportunity to own a turn-key home in one of Greenwich's most beloved neighborhoods.

Great opportunity to make this cute Colonial in the highly desirable Riverside section of Greenwich your own. Featuring 4 bedrooms and 1.5 baths, including a convenient first-floor bedroom, this home offers a flexible layout with plenty of space to update and customize to your style. The dining room flows into the kitchen, and a one-car garage provides added convenience. Set on public water and sewer, the property also includes a private backyard, ideal for outdoor living. With its prime location near schools, shopping, parks, and transportation, this home is the perfect canvas to renovate and create your dream residence in one of Greenwich's most sought-after neighborhoods.

Experience unparalleled luxury in this extraordinary custom-built Riverside waterfront residence. Nestled on 1.13 acres with 9,418 square feet of living space, this exceptional home, designed by acclaimed architect Cormac Byrne, boasts a seamless open-concept layout that promotes effortless flow throughout. Soaring ceilings and expansive windows flood the interiors with natural light, highlighting the breathtaking water views that can be enjoyed from nearly every room. Outside, indulge in the serene beauty of a sparkling pool and a private dock, perfect for those who love the water, while westward-facing vistas offer stunning sunsets. A walk-out lower level elevates the home's functionality, making it a rare fine in Riverside!

Classic Cape Cod Charmer in Riverside - This beautifully updated four-bedroom, two-bath Cape Cod offers a rare combination of classic charm, modern upgrades, and exceptional value. The home features a remodeled kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a gas range with renovated bathrooms. Central air conditioning and a gas HVAC system ensure year-round efficiency and easy living. A large stone patio provides the perfect setting for entertaining or relaxing outdoors. The attached garage adds convenience and extra storage. The lower level includes finished bonus living space and an additional space dedicated to laundry & storage. Ideally located, this home is just moments to Schools, Metro North, and the Mianus River & Park.

A chic pied-a-terre designed for luxury, this 2 bed, 2 bath end unit offers four exposures, & exceptional privacy. Renovated in 2023, the home features an open living and dining layout with refinished hardwood floors, custom built-ins, and brand-new windows. The chef's kitchen is elegantly composed with bespoke cabinetry, marble surfaces, Ann Sacks tile, Thermador appliances, and a Miele built-in refrigerator/freezer. Additional features include your private balcony, full-size washer and dryer, new Mitsubishi HVAC mini split system, custom window treatments, on-site parking, and private basement storage. Walking distance to Greenwich Avenue boutiques, cafes, fine dining, parks, train, and waterfront. This true turnkey delivers effortless living in a prime in-town location and is poised to be claimed quickly.

listings.remarks: This wonderful chalet-style home is nestled in the woods and is deeply connected to its natural surroundings, making it a unique retreat. Exposed timber beams, multiple wood balconies and other charming features enhance the handcrafted Alpine feel of this home. Large windows in main rooms offer views reflecting trees and sky. The beautiful stone fireplace is the centerpiece of this home, anchoring the open, but cozy main living space. Much of the property is surrounded by Greenwich Land Trust and is across from Mianus River Park.

Town and Country. Enjoy the best of both worlds in a sun-drenched custom built single family home one block from Greenwich Avenue and all of its shops, restaurants and amenities. Thoughtfully designed with generously scaled rooms throughout, this 4 bed, 5.1 bath 4,000+ sf home features an open floor plan on the main living level, exposures in every direction, a variety of spaces to gather, and elevator to all floors. The kitchen includes top of the line appliances, a butler's pantry, and eat-in breakfast area. Upstairs, the peaceful primary suite features a separate sitting area, large bathroom, walk-in closet, and french doors to a Juliet balcony. Additional outdoor spaces include a rear yard with stone terrace and fireplace, covered front porch, and third floor rooftop deck with outdoor kitchen and fireplace. Attached 2-car garage. Low maintenance, easy, and convenient to literally everything. In-town living and utmost comfort.

IMMACULATE 2,990 sq. ft. END unit in complex of 25 townhouses located off a quiet cul-de-sac in Glenville. Walk to town and experience house-like living without any of the maintenance. Light-filled first floor with large Living Room, fireplace and sliders to private wood deck, office/den with fireplace, formal dining room and sleek updated modern kitchen with Sub-zero fridge/freezer and drawers, and gas cooktop. Second floor with Primary BR and huge dressing room/walk-in closet and updated bath, plus additional BR and full bath. Walk-out lower level with heated floors that is perfect for in-laws or extended guests: Family room with gas fireplace and private patio, 3rd BR and full bath and rec room. Exquisitely quiet and convenient, charming and spacious, this home is a gem. Don't wait to see it!

listings.remarks: Welcome to Riverside and to this beautifully updated and expanded 4 bedroom Cape Cod. The main level has a large stylish Chef's kitchen with custom cabinetry, Thermador appliances and leathered finished Granite countertops. The kitchen opens up to a fieldstone patio with a stone grill, great for entertaining. There is a large living/dining room with fireplace, family room, new mudroom and a full bathroom. The second floor has a large new primary suite with a modern bathroom, 'his & her' walk in closets and space for seating and/or work. Three additional bedrooms and another updated bathroom. Finished lower level. Stroll or bike to the beach, Binney park, Old Greenwich shops and restaurants. Close to elementary and middle schools as well as two train stations. A must see!!

Nestled on a quiet street in the award-winning North Mianus School district, this 3-bedroom home offers a stunning backyard that is showcased right as you walk in the front door. Sunshine pours into the spacious, front to back, beamed living room with sliding doors that extend the living space out to the expansive deck and patio. Three bedrooms and a full bath on the second floor and another full bath on the lower level with versatile space ideal for an office, exercise room or playroom. Substantial opportunity to expand as well. Don't miss this unusual opportunity to own in Riverside!

From a welcoming front porch to its cheerful canary-yellow door, 2 Lakeview Dr invites you in with warmth & personality. Nearly rebuilt in 2013 & offering approx. 3,000sf across 3 finished levels with existing expansion to 4-5 bedrooms, this 3-bed, 2.5-bath home is turnkey. The main level is filled with natural light & features an open-concept layout that connects a spacious dining room, elegant living area, stylish powder room, & a bright breakfast area. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with high-end features, like Wolf/Sub Zero, & flanked by a professionally organized pantry & radiant-heated mudroom. Upstairs, 2 large guest bedrooms share a full bath, & the primary suite boasts 2 walk-in closets & an en-suite bathroom with 2 sinks, a separate jet tub and marble-clad steam shower. A convenient laundry room completes the second floor. The fully finished lower level offers flexible space perfect for a playroom or entertainment space, home gym, media room, or private office.   Just off the kitchen, French doors lead to a screened porch that opens to a patio and an expansive, level backyard (with irrigation) - ideal for outdoor entertaining. Cornered on a quiet street, 2 Lakeview Drive is ideally located close to schools, local shops and restaurants, and public transportation.

Welcome to this tastefully renovated and meticulously maintained condo in the highly sought-after Greenwich Hills community-where comfort, convenience, and a touch of luxury come together. Recently remodeled, this home features a chef-friendly kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances, custom cabinets, and sleek Caesarstone countertops. The main level offers a bright, open floor plan with a sun-filled living room, newly redone powder room, dining area, and dine-in kitchen-all with peaceful views of the surrounding preserve land. Step outside through the sliding glass doors to your own private yard, complete with a bluestone patio and mature shrubs-an ideal spot to relax or dine alfresco. Upstairs, you'll find three spacious bedrooms, including a bright primary suite with lots of closet space and two additional bedrooms on the backside of the home with an updated full bath. additional full bath. The finished lower level adds even more flexible space with a family room featuring custom built-ins, an extra bedroom or home office, and a full bath-perfect for guests or working from home. Enjoy the park-like grounds with amenities including a heated pool. Show-off your competitive side or let loose on the tennis/pickle ball courts with friends. Experience resort-style living in one of Greenwich's most desirable communities-just minutes from shops, schools, and transportation. 1-car garage and additional unmarked parking is available.

Located in the heart of Riverside, this five-bedroom home has just been beautifully and significantly renovated by the sellers. The stunning European kitchen has appliances and appointments for the most discerning chef. There are multiple ovens and a fireplace. The adjacent family room has been redone to seamlessly flow to the backyard with all new landscape. New wood floors and exquisite lighting are some of the home's many features.Sunny formal living and dining rooms invite gatherings. The primary ensuite is set off from the family bedrooms and has ample closets and opens to a private deck. Stressless living is now afforded by all the recent improvements and upgrades. The home is near the Riverside Yacht Club, train, schools and shopping. Just move in and enjoy!

A hidden gem close to town, updated and at the end of a cul-de-sac on a great quiet street, this beautiful 4,525-square-ft home on 1 acre offers a perfect blend of tranquility and convenience, located just minutes from town, the property boasts offices, 5 bedrooms, 5.5 baths, creating flexible layout, a perfect lifestyle for today's owner. Perfect for working from home or pursuing your passions. With family rooms and 2 cozy fireplaces, this home provides ample room for relaxation, entertaining, and making cherished memories. Great area for walks. Experience the perfect balance of peaceful living and easy access to all the amenities Greenwich has to offer.

Nestled in the heart of the Riverside section of Greenwich, this charming 3-bedroom, 2-bath Cape Cod on .37 acres is on a quiet cul-de-sac. Accented with perennial gardens, open lawn & a sparkling pool, it's your private retreat. The main level features a welcoming entry, living room with fireplace, a spacious dining room, and an open kitchen-family room with French doors to the private backyard.The primary bedroom has two walk-in closets.There are two additional bedrooms & both baths are updated. The lower level with a mudroom area provides flexible space for a playroom, gym or office w/ access to an oversized garage.Located on a quiet cul-de-sac, sidewalks lead to Binney Park, Perrot Library, Old Greenwich Village, schools, and Metro-North. Fantastic opportunity to move right in, renovate or create your own dream home

Located near the heart of Old Greenwich, this classic Cape-style home is filled with warmth, character, and endless potential. The layout includes two bedrooms, one full bath, a dedicated office, formal living and dining rooms, and a sunny eat-in kitchen-offering both comfort and flexibility. Hardwood floors run throughout the main living areas, bedrooms, and office. Additional features include central air conditioning and a washer/dryer conveniently located on the main level. Head outside to a private back deck, ideal for relaxing or entertaining guests. Enjoy close proximity to Tod's Point, Binney Park, Perrot Library, and all the shops, dining, and conveniences of Old Greenwich Village-with schools and the train just minutes away.

Welcome to this beautiful Pre-War Colonial, ideally situated on a picturesque tree-lined street in the heart of vibrant downtown Byram. Combining timeless charm with modern convenience, this home offers high ceilings, elegant moulding, bay windows, and hardwood floors throughout. Enjoy the warmth and character of the spacious front and back porches, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Inside, you'll find 3-4 bedrooms, including a walk-up third floor with exciting expansion potential. The fully finished lower level provides flexible space for a home office, guest suite, or playroom. Just moments from the Metro-North train, town pool, tennis courts, beach, marina, parks, award-winning restaurants, shopping, library and new state of the art elementary school. This home offers the perfect blend of suburban tranquility and urban accessibility. Don't miss the opportunity to own a truly special home in one of the most convenient and sought-after Greenwich locations. A must-see!

Located on 4.2 private acres on a quiet mid-country cul-de-sac, this contemporary retreat blends sleek design with resort-style living. A dramatic double-height foyer welcomes you into sunlit spaces with panoramic property views. The open layout features a chef's kitchen with waterfall island and 8-burner range, flowing seamlessly into living, dining, and family rooms-all with access to the outdoor oasis. Highlights include a Connecticut stone gas fireplace, walk-in wine cellar, and elegant bar. The home offers a luxe primary suite, office/gym, two additional bedrooms, and a flexible bonus room. Outside, enjoy a pool, spa, pergola, fire-pit, outdoor kitchen, and built-in speaker system. Exceptional amenities include a golf simulator, car lift, EV charging station, and possible expansion potential (FAR).  Stylish, private, and amenity-rich this is elevated living at its finest.

listings.remarks: Welcome to 88 Indian Field Road, where convenience meets comfort in this updated 3 bed, 3 bath cape. Seconds from the Cos Cob Train station, Greenwich schools, parks, and dozens of dining & shopping options, this home offers unparalleled accessibility.  Highlights of the surprisingly spacious layout include the living room's w/b fireplace, renovated kitchen and inviting family room perfect for gathering with loved ones. The floor plan is flexible with baths on each of the home's 3 levels supporting a variety of uses including WFH, in-law or au pair suites.  Outside, a relaxing backyard oasis awaits with a deck off the family room with stairs down to the patio and pool areas. Super low taxes, R-12 zoning, & 1,000+ additional buildable square feet only add to 88 Indian Field Road's appeal!

This stunning 3 bedroom home is ready for it's new owner! Located on a cul-de-sac with supreme privacy, gardens and mature landscaping. Beautifully updated with the perfect layout for today's lifestyle. Amazing eat-in kitchen with walk-out to backyard and bluestone patio. Spacious and open living and dining room. Second floor with primary bedroom/bath w/radiant floors and 2 additional bedrooms with hallway bath. Don't miss the finished lower level complete with laundry room & 1 car garage/storage. Brand new windows, garage door, upgraded electrical panel & light fixtures. Fully encapsulated crawlspace with GE humidifier. This one will not last! Convenient location: close to schools, shops, and all major transportation. Expansion opportunity and gas on street.

listings.remarks: A meticulous renovation and expansion has transformed this quintessential New England Colonial into a refined retreat on 1 beautifully landscaped acre with pool, set along one of Mid-Country's most premier streets. Thoughtful design and attention to detail create over 6,000 sq. ft. of light-filled living space with sweeping views of the lush grounds. Elegant formal rooms are complemented by a sun-drenched family room, custom kitchen, breakfast room, and 2 offices. French doors from nearly every room allow for a seamless connection to the outdoor entertaining spaces. The luxurious primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, a fireplace, private balcony, dual walk-in closets, and a marble-clad spa like bath. Four additional bedrooms and three full baths complete the second level. The finished lower level features a media room, gym, cedar closet, and generous storage. Outside, a bluestone terrace with built-in grill and outdoor fireplace overlooks the 20x40 pool, spa, and park-like setting. An exceptional opportunity just minutes from downtown Greenwich.

Welcome to this stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath Colonial nestled on a desirable Riverside cul-de-sac. The main level boasts a spacious living room with a cozy fireplace, a formal dining room, a convenient powder room, a large family room with a second fireplace. The expansive eat-in kitchen features a center island and opens to a generous deck-perfect for entertaining and outdoor dining. Upstairs, you'll find a luxurious primary suite with a spa like bath and a gas fireplace Three additional well-sized bedrooms share a large hall bath, and a second-floor laundry room adds everyday convenience. The finished lower level offers a full bath and versatile living space ideal for a playroom, media room, or home office. A large two-car attached garage includes plenty of storage. Enjoy privacy and outdoor living in the fully fenced, oversized backyard perfect for gatherings, gardening, or simply relaxing. Pool site plans available. Enjoy all that living in Greenwich has to offer, easy NYC commute via metro north train, beautiful beaches, award winning parks, exceptional schools, world class shopping, and fabulous restaurants.

Perched on the top floor of historic Greenwich Lodge, this spacious one-bedroom blends classic character with crisp updates. Soaring 18-foot vaulted ceilings complement hardwood floors and western-facing windows that flood the home with light and frame unobstructed sunset and NYC skyline views. An eat-in kitchen offers generous room for dining and meal prep, and the smart layout supports both relaxed living and effortless entertaining. Building perks include a brand-new fitness center and a rooftop seating area with panoramic vistas. Additional conveniences: common laundry, a locked storage bin, bicycle storage, assigned parking, and pet-friendly policies. Just moments from Greenwich Avenue, enjoy immediate access to shops, restaurants, the public library, and the Metro-North station for an easy commute.

listings.remarks: Stunning sun-filled 2-bedroom, 1-bath end unit fully renovated in 2021 with designer finishes throughout. Bright and airy with hardwood floors and incredible natural light flowing through every room from three exposures. The chef-inspired kitchen features custom cabinetry and newer stainless steel appliances, paired with a full-size, newer full size washer and dryer for true convenience. Both bedrooms offer excellent light and comfort, and the beautifully updated bathroom provides a sleek, spa-like feel. Enjoy indoor-outdoor living with a private balcony perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Additional storage includes a pull down attic plus shared basement space. Minutes to downtown Greenwich's upscale boutiques, shoppes, dining, and Metro-North train station.

Welcome to 512 North Street, a meticulous colonial nestled on 2.97 manicured and private acres, south of the Merritt Parkway. As you step into this distinguished home, you are greeted by an inviting formal living room adorned with a fireplace and french doors leading to a screened-in porch that offers tranquil views of the pool. Separating the living room and kitchen is a charming den with wet bar. The heart of this home features a recently remodeled kitchen. Adjacent to the kitchen is the dining room and also the family room, which features cathedral ceilings, built in's and a 2nd fireplace. Head upstairs and find 4 bedrooms with a primary suite that sports an ensuite bathroom, and walk-in closet. Lastly this home features a finished walkout basement and a 2 garage attached garage. Close to the Merritt Parkway, schools, Whole Foods, Greenwich Ave, and Westchester County Airport, with a short train ride to NYC.

This recently renovated, sun-filled condo features an open-plan first level with a spacious living room with fireplace, dining area and kitchen with stainless steel appliances. A first floor powder room is perfect for visitors. The second level has a large primary bedroom with two closets (one walk-in) and bathroom with shower and bathtub. Second bedroom has an ensuite bathroom with tub/shower combo. Enjoy your morning coffee on the back patio or charming wrap-around porch with a private, fenced backyard.

Modern One-Bedroom Condo with Garage Parking and Prime Commuter Access Welcome to effortless living in this light-filled one-bedroom, one-bath residence built in 2005. Thoughtfully designed with a galley kitchen featuring a breakfast bar, this home offers a seamless blend of functionality and style. Enjoy oversized windows that flood the space with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. This pet-friendly building includes a well-equipped exercise room, secure garage parking, and is ideally located just minutes from major highways, public transportation, and Metro-North-making it a commuter's dream. This home offers comfort, convenience, and a low-maintenance lifestyle in a well-maintained community.

Enjoy the best of West Lyon Farm living in this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 3-bath home offering the ideal blend of comfort, space, and privacy. A rare three-season enclosed porch opens to a lush, landscaped yard-your own peaceful retreat off of the spacious dining room. Inside, cathedral ceilings and hardwood floors throughout the living space create an airy, elegant flow, while a whole-house generator offers practical peace of mind. A den with wet bar on the first level could also be used as a fourth bedroom. Plenty of storage and workbench area in lower level. Well-positioned in a quiet section of the community, this home delivers a low-maintenance lifestyle -without sacrificing charm, space, or outdoor living space. West Lyon Farm amenities include pool, tennis and more.

listings.remarks: Tucked discreetly at the end of a long, private drive in coveted mid-country Greenwich, this masterfully renovated Colonial offers a harmonious blend of heritage architecture and sophisticated modernity. Designed to accommodate both grand-scale entertaining and intimate daily living, the residence unfolds across three levels and over 7,000 square feet of meticulously curated interiors. The home's arrival sequence sets a gracious tone-guests are welcomed by a soaring two-story foyer with front-to-back sightlines that open to a sun-washed terrace and lush landscaped grounds. Abundant natural light spills in through expansive windows, illuminating custom millwork, bespoke cabinetry, and elegant detailing throughout. At the heart of the home, a newly designed gourmet kitchen, crafted for the discerning chef, features state-of-the-art appliances and a seamless connection to a generous family room. The adjacent great room, with its dramatic double-height ceilings and wood-burning fireplace, serves as a striking centerpiece for gatherings both casual and formal. A richly appointed home office, complete with custom built-ins and its own wet bar, offers a distinguished workspace, while a flexible main-level suite provides optional first-floor bedroom accommodations. Defined by grand ceiling heights across all levels and the luxury of all town utilities.  Upstairs, the serene primary suite offers a true sanctuary: a private fireplace lounge, two custom-fitted closets

facts.laundryLoc: Second level and in lower level

listings.remarks: Direct waterfront on beautiful Mianus Pond in Riverside. 4 bedroom/4bathroom spacious home with fenced-in yard, off street parking, large shed and licensed dock. New roof 2023, newer mechanicals 2016 and open permit for minor kitchen expansion and renovation. Recent survey available. Bring your kayak and fishing pole and enjoy!

Great opportunity to develop this level .334-acre (14,375 sq ft) lot located in central Greenwich. Property is zoned R-6 with 126 feet of road frontage. The existing building was damaged by a fire in January 2025 and was last used as mixed commercial/residential. Property being sold "as is".

Welcome to 52 Pemberwick Rd, a 2-family property perfect for investors, multi-generational households, or those seeking to offset expenses with rental income, this home offers flexibility and long-term value. Unit 1 features 3-bedrooms, 1-bath, hardwood floors, an eat-in kitchen, family room, and in-unit w/d. Currently rented month to month @ $3,300. Tenant will be given 60 days to vacate from closing date at current rent but would prefer to stay if possible. Unit 2 has 2-bedrooms, 1-bath, kitchen/dining area, family room, and w/d. Four parking spaces, a shared backyard, and a location just steps from Pemberwick Park, residents enjoy both convenience and community. Greenwich is known for its excellent schools, vibrant town center, easy access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, and express Metro-North trains to Manhattan. Parks, beaches, and a strong rental market make Greenwich especially appealing to both tenants and long-term investors.

Corner-unit townhome in desirable Byram Shore blends coastal living with commuter convenience. Just seconds to the water and minutes to Metro-North, this location connects you to both vibrant Port Chester and emerging downtown Byram. Inside, hardwood floors, bay window, fireplace, and sliding doors to a private deck offer a great foundation. The open kitchen/dining flows to the living room, with a powder room on the main level. Upstairs: two bedrooms, large bath; top floor: vaulted loft with skylights, perfect as 3rd bedroom, office, or family room. Lower level includes garage, laundry, and storage. With a prime layout and location, just add your finishing touches.

Unique opportunity in a price range with little inventory Handsome, colonial style home on a quiet, private cul-de-sac just a few minutes from Old Greenwich, in North Street/Central school district. The home was updated in 2012 to include a first floor ''open plan'' layout offering multiple French Doors to a large, sunny patio and capacious back yard. On the second floor, enjoy an updated primary suite, three double bedrooms, and, additionally, a guest/au-pair suite with private entrance, an additional bedroom, flexible use sitting room, full, eat-in kitchen, bathroom, and separate laundry.

After a 2+ year museum level renovation, this amazing residence is ready for its next owner. Tucked behind private gates on one of Greenwich's most secluded roads, this exquisitely reimagined mid-century estate offers a rare fusion of timeless architecture and modern sensibility. Spanning over 7,900 square feet, the residence is a masterclass in indoor-outdoor harmony. Floor-to-ceiling glass walls dissolve boundaries between refined interiors and nature's embrace, revealing sweeping lawns, a resort-style pool, and tranquil lake views. Inside, the design speaks to modern sensibilities: white oak floors, soaring ceilings, and skylights infuse every space with warmth and light. The spa-inspired primary suite is a retreat unto itself, while open-plan living areas invite effortless entertaining and quiet reflection. Every detail from the curated finishes to the serene palette echoes a lifestyle of understated elegance. This is not just a home - it's a sanctuary for those who seek balance, beauty, and the quiet sophistication of Greenwich living at its finest.

Spectacular home in the heart of sought after Old Greenwich! Beautifully finished four bedroom 3.5 bath Colonial with open floor plan. First floor includes an eat in chef's kitchen with top of the line stainless steel appliances highlighted by a unique serving window, which flows seamlessly into the living room and dining area, French doors leading out to the expansive deck which overlooks a beautifully landscaped back yard. Primary suite with a luxurious ensuite bath, two additional bedrooms and another full bath complete the second floor. Finished lower level with a fourth bedroom, full bath and gym/playroom or guest area with walk out to yard. White oak hardwood floors throughout. Exterior showcases with white James Hardie siding, sleek black windows and clean architectural lines that create striking curb appeal! Minutes to schools, train, beaches, parks, library, shops, restaurants and I-95 for an easy commute/trip into NYC! Enjoy everything that Greenwich has to offer, including the lowest property taxes in the entire area! As per builder original foundation, and first floor joists and decking under the hardwood is original. Additional sq footage in finished lower level is approx. 682. Great investment opportunity!

Great opportunity to own a two family residence situated in great Cos Cob neighborhood across from a park. Walk to schools, restaurants, library, restaurants, shops, public transportation and more.  Two units- ready to move in immediately.  A must see !

Welcome to this beautifully appointed condo located in the heart of Greenwich. Unit 3B offers a bright and modern living space with an open layout, high ceilings, and large windows providing excellent natural light throughout. The unit features a well-designed kitchen with quality finishes, spacious living and dining areas, and comfortable bedroom(s) ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Additional highlights include assigned parking, private storage, ample closet space, and convenient laundry facilities located within the building. The well-maintained building offers premium amenities including a fitness center and secure common areas. Ideally situated just steps from downtown Greenwich, Metro-North, shopping, dining, and parks, this home delivers luxury, convenience, and low-maintenance living.

listings.remarks: A tranquil, private road leads to 2.42 acres of beautifully landscaped land. With Health Department approval for a five-bedroom septic system, this property offers the perfect opportunity to build your ideal home. No wetlands on the property. Enjoy the peace and privacy of your own oasis, all while being conveniently close to town, private schools, and the Merritt Parkway for easy access to NYC. Presently 2 income producing cottages- 22 Peepers Hollow and 33 Peepers Hollow.

Modern Luxury Meets Tranquil Living in North Greenwich. Discover the perfect blend of sophistication and comfort in this stunning 5-bedroom, 4 1/2- bath modern residence, set on 4 private acres in desirable North Greenwich-just 11 minutes to downtown. Built in 2019, this thoughtfully designed home offers a bright and open floor plan ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The dramatic Great room features soaring cathedral ceilings, a sleek gas fireplace, and seamless access to the patio and pool area with outdoor shower-your personal outdoor retreat. The chef's kitchen is a dream with a generous island, dual ovens, and two dishwashers-perfect for hosting and holiday gatherings. The adjacent dining room with dry bar adds a stylish touch for dinner parties and casual entertaining. With two spacious primary bedroom suites, both with radiant heated bathroom floors, including one on the main level, multigenerational living or guest accommodations are easy and elegant. listings.remarks: Fantastic Townhouse with a Movie Theater you would only find in a multi-Million Dollar Home! Fabulous 3 bedrooms/3.5 baths, open plan home. 1st floor has a powder room, spacious kitchen with new SS appliances, inviting dining room, living room with a stone fireplace and home office that opens to a carport in winter, patio for entertaining in warmer months. The carport has exterior storage, recessed lighting, and an EV charger. This home has all wood floors, crown moldings, plantation shutters, and built-ins through out. Upper level has the primary bedroom suite with luxury bath and walk-in closet, 2nd bedroom and bath, washer &dryer in a separate area and a built in desk. Bring your popcorn and watch your favorite movie in the custom state of the art home theater in the LL. An additional bedroom and full bath complete the LL. A wonderful home with Greenwich amenities. Not to be missed !

Discover refined living in this elegant center hall colonial, ideally set on a private cul-de-sac just minutes from downtown Greenwich. Meticulous attention to detail is evident throughout, from sophisticated coffered ceilings to exceptional craftsmanship. The open-concept gourmet kitchen is the heart of the home, with generous counter space and a seamless flow into the spacious family room. Five ensuite bedrooms offer comfort and privacy, highlighted by a luxurious primary suite with its own sitting room for a serene retreat. Versatile living areas provide endless options for a home office, study, playroom, or home theatre. Additional features include a three-car garage, finished basement, and fenced yard.

Set high above western Greenwich, this adorable 2 bedroom pre war colonial, with wood floors throughout, has a vibe that must be seen to be appreciated. The enclosed sunporch is the perfect place to work from home or create your next artistic masterpiece. The backyard is low maintenance and pollinator friendly, filled with meadowscaping, beautiful tall flowers and a fruit producing apple tree with plenty of room for additional plantings and gardens. The roof, clapboard siding, and furnace were all replaced in approximately 2013 and the water heater was replaced in 2021. Zoned for Greenwich Schools and Greenwich Beach access.

Experience luxury living in this beautifully updated home. Featuring a brand-new high-end kitchen with premium appliances, custom cabinetry, and elegant finishes, this residence blends timeless style with modern convenience. Throughout the home, new flooring, upgraded door hinges, and designer door handles add a refined touch. The newly renovated bathroom offers a spa-like retreat, while the freshly installed roof ensures lasting peace of mind. Outdoor living is elevated with a stylish new awning, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated to deliver comfort, sophistication, and lasting value.

This exceptional 5-bedroom, 4-bath center hall colonial underwent a complete renovation in 2007 and was thoughtfully updated again in 2023. Privately set back on over 2.5 acres abutting Mianus River Park, this home offers a rare combination of tranquility and convenience, located just minutes from downtown Greenwich and under an hour to NYC. Enter through a gracious double-height foyer from the charming covered front porch. The main level features a generous living room and a gourmet kitchen that opens to a stunning, three-exposure family room with direct access to the outdoors. The incredible primary suite boasts soaring cathedral ceilings, a luxurious spa-like bathroom, and a fabulous walk-in closet. Four additional well-proportioned bedrooms provide space and comfort for family and guests. With a Greenwich address and access to Stamford schools, this rare gem in a most sought-after location is truly a must-see!

Location, location, location! Welcome to this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom townhome located on one of the most desirable streets in Greenwich. This home is conveniently located to Greenwich Avenue, the train station, Bruce Park, and the Bruce Museum. The main level includes a foyer with large closet, spacious living area with built-in bookshelves (ideal for home office use), a bedroom with full bath, and laundry room. The second level offers a living room with fireplace, dining area with sliding doors to the deck, and an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and an under-sink reverse osmosis water filter. The third floor features two large bedrooms with vaulted ceilings, generous closet space, and two full bathrooms, including one en suite. Recent updates include new central air conditioning, furnace, boiler, and dishwasher (all within the last four years).

Attractive six-bedroom 4536 square feet (includes finished LL) Colonial in North Street School district. Well laid out with newer additions. Spacious & bright home on a quiet road in mid-country Greenwich. Two primary suites, one on each floor. First floor has a living room w/fireplace, well designed kitchen w/space for a large dining table and island seating, family room, formal dining room, library/office, add. bedroom w/laundry & bath. Welcoming deck off kitchen for grilling/entertaining/relaxing, bordered by lush landscaping & overlooks play yard. Upstairs is another spacious primary suite w/walk-in closet & bath, 3 additional bedrooms & bath. Garden level w/gym area, playroom & plenty of storage, 3 car garage w/workshop area. Minutes to downtown, train & schools. Generator!

Elegant Center Hall Colonial nestled on a serene mid-country cul-de-sac. Encompassing 4,300 square ft, this gracious home features an expansive kitchen/family room, flexible entertaining spaces, a first-floor bedroom, and an office. A newly built deck and patio overlook two tranquil acres, perfect for outdoor gatherings. Sunlight pours through skylights on the second floor, enhancing the home's warmth and charm. Ideally located and zoned for North Street School, this exceptional property offers space, setting, and endless potential.

Great opportunity to own this well maintained 3 bedroom 1 1/2 bath colonial located at the end of a cul-de-sac in Old Greenwich. Home has an eat-in kitchen, formal dining room, living room with fireplace, spacious three season sunroom off the kitchen, deck, covered front porch, a 1 car garage, and a large .38 of an acre parcel of land.

Welcome to 68 Orchard Drive, a distinguished residence nestled within the coveted, gated Milbrook Association. Built in 1928 and reimagined with thoughtful updates, this home seamlessly marries the enduring character of its architectural heritage with the comforts and style of modern living.The home offers five spacious bedrooms and four full baths. The primary suite is a serene retreat featuring radiant heated floors and an instant hot water system in the spa-inspired bath. Hardwood floors throughout, a wood-burning fireplace, and thoughtfully placed French doors create an inviting atmosphere that flows effortlessly from intimate gathering moments to grand entertaining. The gourmet kitchen, complete with center island, and high-end appliances, opens to warm gathering spaces, while abundant natural light highlights the home's craftsmanship and attention to detail. Beyond the home itself, ownership in Milbrook affords a lifestyle without compromise. Just moments from Greenwich Avenue, schools, and the train, 68 Orchard Drive balances privacy, sophistication, and convenience in an extraordinary way. This is a rare opportunity to own a piece of Greenwich history in one of its most sought-after neighborhoods, a residence that embodies timeless elegance and modern luxury.

This peaceful 5-bedroom home is situated in a quiet cul-de-sac, offering easy access to schools, public transit, and highways. It features two luxurious primary suites, with the first-floor suite boasting a spacious walk-in closet and en-suite bathroom. Upstairs, the second suite impresses with vaulted ceilings and elegant finishes. The bright family room flows into a modern kitchen with updated appliances and a cozy breakfast nook. Step outside to a newly renovated deck that overlooks the beautifully landscaped backyard. The lower level offers a large entertainment area with 10-foot ceilings, a walk-out to a patio, a kitchenette, and a bathroom. Additionally, a well-planned office space on this level provides a quiet and efficient environment for working from home.

This storybook Pemberwick Colonial is an ideal condo alternative and oodles of character from the covered front porch awaiting your rocking chairs and seasonal mums and ferns. A .14 acre in the R-6 Zone has potential expansion with off street parking. The main floor has an open living-dining room with hardwood floors and Pella replacement windows, and sun-lit eat-in kitchen with new GE appliances. First floor bedroom with a full bath. Upstairs is a king size bedroom with adjoining room ideal for nursery/office/or expanded closet that share a bath and entry. A walk-up attic and basement provide plenty of storage. Conveniently located to I-95 and NY border.

Freshly updated 5BR + 2.5BA Single Family Home is offered. on an oversized lot .22 in an R6 Zone in the upper Pemberwick section of Greenwich. Recent updates include new siding (Hardee Board), new fencing, ,new plumbing, toilets, stove, fan, kitchen flooring, painting, shower doors, garage door and much more. Huge potential awaits in this diamond in the rough. A two family conversion in this R-6 zone is very attainable. The garage is extended and has a tool bench. The second garage in rear of property is ideal for tools, landscaping, storage ect. There is also one additional shed which is ideal for firewood ect. Nice rock garden, patio off of kitchen and nice sized yard. The location is super convenient and is only about one mile to the Metro North (NYC) train station. Agent to Agent Rmrks: Agent is related to the owner.

Tucked away on a peaceful road surrounded by cul-de-sacs in the award-winning North Mianus School district, this 4-bedroom Riverside gem is a perfect blend of convenience and a tranquil, private retreat. Step into a dramatic entryway with soaring vaulted ceilings and rich natural slate tile, leading to a grand living room anchored by a stately fireplace, which flows effortlessly into a sun-drenched dining room with vaulted ceilings -perfect for everyday living and elegant entertaining. A peaceful family room features full-length windows framing serene views of the expansive, tree-lined backyard. Don't miss the lower-level bonus rooms, ideal for a playroom and home office. Schedule your showing today-this Riverside treasure won't last.

Welcome to 10 Carissa Lane, a privately situated home on a cul-de-sac street not far from the center of town. With 4,000sf of living space, the home has a perfect flow for entertaining. A high-end kitchen that opens to the family room and dining room is the heart of the home. The living room, outfitted with a second fireplace, offers additional space to retreat. The primary bedroom, with its own bath overlooking the peaceful yard, is joined by 3 additional bedrooms and a full bath on the 2nd floor. A bonus room and full bath on the same floor allow for a lot of flexibility. A walk-out lower level provides ample space to play, work, exercise - outfitted with another full bath and kitchenette. The home sits on over 1-acre of property that offers entertainment during all seasons. In warmer weather you can gather on a recently renovated, expansive deck off the family room/kitchen that has an outdoor TV & sound system, or practice your swing on a putting green. In the winter, a quiet pond off in the distance allows for ice skating. Don't miss the opportunity to see this home - with an abundance of updates - on one of Greenwich's most special streets.
