Welcome to 20 Old Wagon Road, nestled in the highly sought-after Havemeyer Park section of Old Greenwich. This charming two-bedroom, one-bath ranch offers the rare combination of move-in-ready comfort and exceptional long-term potential. Set on a level and dry .31-acre lot in R-12 zoning, this property is surrounded by many newly constructed homes-offering a prime opportunity for expansion or new construction. The home features an open-concept layout with a bright living and dining area, bay window, and wood-burning fireplace. The kitchen flows easily into the main living space, and gleaming hardwood floors run throughout. A new roof was installed 2024, adding peace of mind for the next owner. The full-height, unfinished basement includes laundry and existing plumbing for a potential second bathroom-presenting an easy path to increase finished square footage. Whether you're looking for a place to call home now with room to grow, or seeking a site for your next build, this property delivers unmatched flexibility in a prime Old Greenwich location. Convenient to train, beach, shops, and parks, and zoned for Mianus Elementary and Eastern Middle School.

Extraordinary, custom-built 5 bedroom stone + shingle Colonial is tucked away on 10 beautifully landscaped gated acres in serene backcountry. Sunlit 8685SF interior boasts generously scaled rooms w high ceils + stunning details incl four WB FPs + wide plank floors. The house is designed to take full advantage of picturesque setting bringing the outside in from all rooms. 1st floor has an open flow for entertaining incl a year-round solarium + wood-paneled lib. Gourmet kit / fam room opens to expansive stone terrace.4 suites on second floor incl an impressive primary suite w library & balcony. Walk-out LL w game room, full bath + exercise or 5th bed. Extremely peaceful setting abutting a 50-acre private art foundation. Specimen trees + mature plantings, gated courtyard + 3 car garage.

Charming 1929 home in one of Cos Cob's most desirable neighborhoods, close to town and schools. Sun-filled open floor plan with hardwood floors, classic detailing and beautiful landscaping. Living and dining rooms feature two walls of windows and a wood burning fireplace. Eat in kitchen with new appliances, breakfast nook, and family room with built-ins open to a stone terrace and tiered, fenced backyard-ideal for entertaining. Upstairs features 3 bedrooms, 1 full bath, and finished attic playroom. A 4th bedroom and second bath above the 2-car garage make a perfect guest suite or office. Play area and level yard complete this special property. Expansion potential with available FAR. Move-in ready with timeless character, modern updates, and space to grow in a truly welcoming community.

Stunning Colonial in Havemeyer Park, Old Greenwich, on a 0.38-acre cul-de-sac lot, offers resort-style living with a pool, deck, and built-in barbecue. Inside, find hardwood floors and sunlit rooms. The main floor includes a living room, family room with fireplace, breakfast room, gourmet kitchen with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, dining room, powder room, and mudroom. The second floor boasts a primary suite with tray ceiling, walk-in closets, spa bath, plus three bedrooms, hall bath, and laundry. A private guest suite is above the garage with a separate entrance.The lower level features a full bath, playroom, and utility room. Minutes from Old Greenwich Village, Metro North, and Tod's Point beach.

Currently configured as a 2-family home, this property offers the unique opportunity to convert and expand into a spacious single-family residence with ease. First floor features 2 bedrooms, full bath, generous eat-in kitchen with pantry, living room, and home office - perfect for today's flexible lifestyle. Upstairs, you'll find an additional bedroom, full bath, living room, and large eat-in kitchen with pantry and tons of storage. Hardwood floors throughout. Extra large, one-car attached garage leads directly to a spacious basement complete with half bath, offering even more room for storage, recreation, or future expansion. Enjoy relaxing on the inviting front porch or entertain in the beautiful, level backyard. Located in a desirable neighborhood on a quiet, dead end cul-de-sac, close to top-rated schools, and just minutes from Byram Park, pool, and marina. With a current living space of 1,485 sq ft and a total FAR of approximately 3,000 sq ft, there's plenty of opportunity to expand and truly make this your dream home. Don't miss this chance to bring your vision to life in Greenwich! Being Sold As Is.

Welcome to 75 Cos Cob Avenue, where style meets comfort! This newly renovated condominium boasts 2 cozy bedrooms and 1.1 pristine bathrooms, all wrapped up in a generous 1,222 square feet of living space. The open floor plan flows effortlessly, highlighting chic, modern finishes that make entertaining a breeze. Enjoy the convenience of being close to local amenities while still savoring a peaceful retreat at home. Whether you're lounging by the pool or hosting friends in your renovated new space, this home checks all the boxes for casual, contemporary living. Don't miss the opportunity to experience the charm of Cos Cob!

This timeless Colonial, completely rebuilt in 2002 with only the original foundation remaining, was thoughtfully designed for today's lifestyle. Sunlight fills the home through large windows, highlighting hardwood floors throughout and offering water views from several rooms.  The main level features a spacious living room with a fireplace, a formal dining room, a comfortable family room, and a generous kitchen with an island, stainless steel appliances, abundant quality wood cabinetry, and ample counter space. A mudroom provides access to the large deck, complete with a pergola draped in wisteria-perfect for al fresco dining. Also on the first floor, a versatile office/bedroom with an adjacent half bath offers flexibility for guests or work-from-home needs.  Upstairs, the primary suite serves as a private retreat with a sitting area, spacious walk-in closet, and nicely appointed full bath. Two additional bedrooms share a well designed full bath with double sinks and private shower area, and a convenient hallway laundry closet adds everyday ease. The partially finished lower level offers lots of flexible space ideal for a playroom or gym.  Additional highlights include two garage bays, a private backyard, and the coveted perk of deeded water access just steps away at the end of the cul-de-sac. Launch your kayak or paddleboard, or simply enjoy the serene views. Ideally located close to the Riverside train station and all the exceptional amenities Greenwich has to offer

In Old Greenwich, ideally located in one of the area's most desirable neighborhoods, this charming Colonial sits on a .68-acre lot at the end of a peaceful cul-de-sac. It offers a perfect blend of timeless character and exciting potential. A gracious layout is enhanced by oversized windows and open spaces that flood the home with natural light. The main level features generous formal living and dining rooms, each with its own fireplace. A modern kitchen with center island connects seamlessly to the adjoining family room, which opens onto a spacious deck. Upstairs are four bedrooms, including a primary suite with an en-suite bath. The finished lower level includes a recreation area, full bath, and laundry. The expansive backyard adds even more appeal. Convenient to the village, schools, shops, and train.

This elegant residence showcases three sun-filled levels designed for modern luxury living. The open-plan layout features soaring ceilings, 11'', and a kitchen with custom millwork, granite counters, and premium stainless steel appliances, a gas fireplace, connected to a sophisticated living room perect for entertaining. The primary suite offers a luxurious steam shower, while hardwood floors, plantation shutters, and fine details add elegance throughout. The finished lower level offers an exercise room and a versatile suite with full bath, ideal for guests or a home office. Outdoors, a stone patio, landscaped grounds and full sprinkler system create a serene setting. Conveniently close to shops, schools, train,the beach, and like-new construction, move-in ready!

The condo you've been waiting for at The Gables! This bright and spacious end unit offers one-level living with 3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths, and the convenience of an elevator from the garage that brings you just steps from your front door. The flexible open floor plan features two private balconies, a fully renovated chef's kitchen, new hardwood floors, and beautifully updated bathrooms. Additional highlights include a large walk-in pantry and a cedar closet for extra storage. Take in peaceful views of the meticulously maintained grounds, or stroll to the library, train, Binney Park, and the shops and restaurants in the heart of Old Greenwich village. Just minutes away, Greenwich Point offers beaches, trails, and water sports, while right at home you can unwind at the heated pool

Welcome to your cozy haven at 12 Glenville Street, Unit 108 in Greenwich, CT! This spacious 1-bedroom, 2.1-bath retreat boasts 1,860 square feet of endless possibilities. Nestled in the River Run Association, enjoy breathtaking views of the waterfall and stream from your balcony off the first floor. The home features an updated kitchen with new appliances and a detached garage for your convenience. Your full finished lower level includes a walkout sitting area. Embrace the tranquility and charm of this special home, perfect for creating cherished memories!  Sale is subject to probate approval. Tax Card is One Bedroom

This home is brimming with potential. Charming raised ranch on a desirable, quiet Glenville street. A large living room and dining area are adjacent to an eat-in kitchen. Three bedrooms and updated two full baths complete the main level. The lower level features a time capsule-like wet bar and family room/den area. This room opens to a patio and lovely backyard shaded by mature trees and plantings. Renovate, expand, or build new!Roof approx 7 years old

Lovingly maintained house in the heart of the Chickahominy section of Greenwich! Bright and sunny open floor plan with spacious living room, formal dining room and eat-in kitchen. two bedrooms plus office, 2 full baths, 1 with charming original clawfoot tub, spacious unfinished lower level for storage... great yard with deck... parking in driveway. Close to train, beaches., top rated restaurants, shops, and I95 for an easy ride/commute into NYC! Great expansion possibilities.

Highest and Best Bid deadline is 12 noon on Monday, 1/12.  Rare find! Updated 4 bedroom, 2 full bath Ranch with 2,041 square feet of versatile living spaces. Nestled on a 0.28 acre lot at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this home meets the brief of modern life, blending a highly-functional layout with the advantages of living in Greenwich. A flexible floor plan adapts to meet one's lifestyle needs with an expansive family room, an elongated dining room with skylights, a sunny living room, cheerful kitchen, four bedrooms, plus a private, lower-level home office. Hardwood floors in most rooms add warmth and character. The inviting kitchen has a high ceiling, a wall of windows, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and quality cabinetry. The partially-finished, newly-carpeted lower level offers extra spaces for work, gym or playroom, as well as a mudroom/laundry area and wood workshop.Outdoor spaces include a flat front yard with a fire pit and backyard with a wrap-around stone patio with sliders from both the dining and living rooms-perfect for alfresco meals or parties. Dense three-season foliage provides privacy screening during the warmer months of outdoor living. Extensive stone masonry further enhances the property's curb appeal.Maintenance-free vinyl siding, attached oversized one-car garage, attic with pull-down stairs. Conveniently located near Metro-North train stations, I-95, top-rated schools, shopping, and parks, this Greenwich gem delivers!

Luxury Townhouse in Prime Greenwich Location ~Just 1.5 blocks from the Greenwich Train Sta. & world-class shopping & dining of Greenwich Ave. This stunning & sophisticated 3-BR, 4-bath townhouse condo is quietly nestled behind a charming, tree-lined sidewalk in one of Greenwich's most sought-after locations. Designed by renowned architect Rich Granoff & masterfully built by Thomas Torelli, this residence showcases 10' ceilings, exquisite millwork, intricate moldings & exceptional high-end craftsmanship throughout. The spectacular chef's kitchen, redesigned in 2018 by Putnam Designs, is a true showpiece, featuring Neolith countertops, full-access custom cabinetry w soft-close drawers & hinges, a Rohl fireclay sink, top-of-the-line Viking & Miele appliances, executed w remarkable attention to detail. Offering 3 levels of light-filled living space, the home features a gracious open-concept main floor highlighted by a beautiful gas fireplace & French doors that open to a serene bluestone patio, ideal for entertaining/quiet relaxation. A flexible floor plan provides multiple options for a home office, media room, gym, playroom, or bonus space. Other highlights include Restoration Hardware lighting & custom window treatments throughout, a luxurious primary suite w soaring ceilings, chandelier, spa-like bath w jacuzzi tub, separate walk-in shower, and his/her closets w custom built-ins. A convenient motorized dumbwaiter connects lower level to kitchen. Attached garage +guest pkng.
Brick and frame two-family with large detached two-car garage. Centrally located, off street parking, large level lot, flagstone terrace, stone barbecue.

Built in 1936, this stately residence features 5 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, and over 3,700 square feet of living space, all set on a sprawling flat parcel rarely found in the area. The home boasts timeless charm with hardwood floors throughout, two fireplaces, and elegant architectural details. A sunlit great room showcases cathedral ceilings, a grand fireplace, and French doors that open onto a rear patio-perfect for entertaining or simply enjoying views of the private grounds. Perfect for investors or owner occupancy! Spacious 2,620 sq. ft. multi-family Home boasts three apartments with easy access to shopping, dining and trains. Fully updated ground level apartment showcases hardwood floors in an open plan living room and granite clad kitchen with stainless appliances, full bath and bedroom. Main level one-bedroom apartment, also completely updated and featuring hardwood floors, reveals living room, kitchen with granite-topped counters, stainless appliances, full bath. Updated lighting and a statement chandelier illuminate the space, while a custom upholstered built-in bench adds charm and functionality. The inviting living room features a cozy wood-burning fireplace-perfect for relaxing evenings or entertaining guests. The primary suite offers a serene retreat with a luxurious en-suite bath featuring fog-free heated and LED lighted mirrors. Incredible property to renovate or start new! Across the street from North Mianus School, almost a third of an acre. (AS IS)

Modern Luxury New Construction residence sits on .78 acres combines privacy with elegant design. Moments from Greenwich Ave. built by an award winning builder. This home features soaring 10ft ceilings, light filled rooms, wide white-oak wood-floors throughout, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. A few highlights of many, are a Rooftop deck with Long Island Sound views that crowns the residence, a 3-car garage (+900 sq. Ft.) with 14-ft ceilings, and a serious top-of-the-line chef's kitchen. A private balcony extends the retreat, while the spa-inspired bathroom features a steam shower and radiant heated floors. 4 additional light filled en-suite bedrooms, share the same level, alongside a full laundry suite equipped with custom built-ins including steam/Iron drawer, a dry rack drawer, and stacked double washers and dryers. A 4-stop hydraulic elevator serves every level-from the versatile finished attic to a finished expansive lower level, you'll find a dedicated room for a gym, guest/au pair en-suite, and pre-wired theater/Golf simulator, ample space for a wine cellar, storage, and protected living space.

Step into timeless charm with this spacious 1920s Colonial, ideally located in the heart of Byram, just moments from shops, schools, and public transit. A bright and welcoming front sun porch sets the stage, perfect for enjoying your morning coffee or a relaxing afternoon. Inside, the home showcases beautiful period woodwork, generous-sized bedrooms, and a dedicated home office on the second floor, along with a walk-up attic that offers endless potential. The kitchen balances vintage character with modern convenience, featuring updated appliances while leaving room for your own finishing touches. Recently added mini-split A/C units provide comfort year-round, and the full basement with high ceilings offers abundant options for a gym, playroom, or creative space. Outside, the level, fully fenced backyard is ideal for entertaining, gardening, or play. A detached two-car garage with access from Spruce Street adds both practicality and privacy. With energy-efficient upgrades that help lower utility costs, plentiful parking, and a commuter-friendly location, this home perfectly blends classic character with everyday comfort and convenience.

Sophisticated and timeless, this beautifully crafted colonial offers refined living in a private Greenwich setting. Designed with both elegance and functionality in mind, the home features 5 bedrooms, 4.1 baths, sun-filled interiors, and graciously scaled rooms ideal for entertaining and everyday living. The heart of the home is the chef's kitchen, seamlessly flowing into the main living spaces. Rich hardwood floors, two fireplaces, and thoughtful architectural details create a warm yet elevated atmosphere throughout. A fully finished lower level provides flexible space for a media room, gym, or playroom. Outdoor living is equally inviting with a screened porch, stone patio and a fenced backyard, offering privacy and tranquility. A rare opportunity to enjoy polished, move-in-ready living just minutes from downtown Greenwich.

Space and convenience await you at this incredible townhouse with views of the Mianus River and a location close to Old Greenwich, Riverside and Cos Cob. This 3 bedroom, 3.5 bath home has high ceilings throughout, generously sized rooms and picture-perfect outdoor space. With 3 dedicated underground parking spaces and an elevator to take you to your living floor, this is as easy as it gets. The unit (one of only 3 in the building) offers high end finishes: coiffured ceilings, Viking appliances and his/her primary bathrooms & closets. With 3 sets of French doors giving access to outdoor spaces, you are never far from the calming water views of the river below. Gourmet kitchen and family room, as well as dining room, mud room and den flow seamlessly on the main level, along with the luxurious primary suite. The second floor offers 2 more en suite bedrooms. Access to the unit is gained from the main vestibule or from your own front door. And the outdoor fireplace on the patio overlooking the river a great place to end the day. 523 E Putnam B is not to be missed for those looking for easy living close to everything.

facts.laundryLoc: Laundry on each level of townhouse

listings.remarks: First floor one level living in this pristine beautifully updated unit located in the heart of downtown Greenwich. Featuring open floor plan, great closet space, gleaming hardwood floors throughout, updated kitchen with Cherry cabinets and granite countertops, marble bath, newer A/C wall units freshly painted and hardwood floors were just refinshed- all you need to do is unpack! Large dining room is ideal for entertaining guests or easily converted to a home office. Washer/dryer in unit and a separate storage unit is included. Ample free off street parking and garage parking is available for rent $85/month through HOA. This is a pet-friendly complex with amazing privacy. Enjoy the beauty of the 13 park-like acres and the convenience of an in-town location close distance to the Metro North train, Greenwich Ave, Whole Foods, award winning restaurants, and world-class shopping.

listings.remarks: Rare opportunity to get into this beautiful quiet neighborhood. Tons of potential to renovate or start afresh. Home being sold "as is" with all remaining contents to be conveyed. No disclosures. Owner is elderly and makes no representations as to condition of property.

Welcome to this meticulously maintained 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom home ideally situated just steps from the Library and beautiful Binney Park. The main floor features an open layout with sun-filled living areas that flow seamlessly, featuring hardwood floors and coffered ceilings.  The heart of the home is the generous kitchen, dining and family room, opening to a private backyard-ideal for hosting gatherings, kicking a soccer ball or enjoying quiet afternoons outdoors.   The expansive primary suite is a true retreat, complete with a large walk-in closet, and a spa-like en-suite bathroom. 4 additional bedrooms accommodate family, guests or a WFH office. Lower Level boasts laundry & gym/flex space.   A short stroll to Old Greenwich shops, dining, beach and Metro-North.

Ideally sited on more than two acres just minutes from town, this timeless and light-filled colonial offers the perfect blend of classic elegance and modern luxury. Graciously scaled rooms begin with an expansive foyer that provides a stunning front-to-back view, setting the tone for the rest of the home. The main residence features a private gym, home theater, custom 1,000-bottle wine cellar, six en suite bedrooms, luxurious primary suite with two full baths and sitting room. The first-floor office, complete with full bath, offers flexibility as a guest suite. Thoughtful amenities include laundry rooms on both the first and second floors, an enviable pantry, and a spacious mudroom. Outside, a gunite pool is perfectly positioned just beyond the expansive terrace, surrounded by  mature, professionally designed perennial gardens. Completing the estate is a charming guest house with two bedrooms one ideal as a home office, offering the ultimate in convenience and privacy. There are 2 additional bedrooms, a full bath, living room, dining area and kitchen in the Guest House.

Welcome to 11 Pond Place-a delightful 4 bedroom, 2 bathroom home located in the heart of Cos Cob. Offering 2,329 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, this residence combines comfort, charm, and modern style. The spacious living room features a cozy fireplace, creating the perfect setting for relaxing or entertaining. A beautifully updated kitchen is ready for your culinary creations, while French doors open to a large deck-ideal for gatherings, barbecues, or simply soaking up the sun. The private backyard offers a serene escape for both play and quiet moments. Enjoy the convenience of being just minutes from the village, parks, top-rated schools, and the train.

Tucked away down a private driveway off Riverside Avenue, this stylishly updated, cedar-clad home offers the perfect blend of classic charm and modern farmhouse appeal. Set on over a half an acre of level lawn, this peaceful retreat is just minutes from the train, town and coastline. The sun-filled living room, framed by twin picture windows, sets a warm and welcoming tone.  At the center of the home, a beautifully renovated chef's kitchen features an oversized marble island, eat-in area, and French doors opening to a bluestone patio ideal for dining and relaxing outdoors. A butler's pantry/bar connect to the vaulted dining room, creating effortless flow for entertaining.  A cozy den with a fireplace provides a quiet escape. The stone-floor mudroom leads to a rare 3-car garage with oversized barn doors for easy access. Upstairs, a spacious great room offers flexibility for a playroom, gym, family room or multiple offices. Five bedrooms and three full baths complete the second floor.  With additional FAR available for future expansion, this home offers the perfect blend of immediate comfort and long-term potential in one of Riverside's premier neighborhoods.

This bright and sunny 3 bedroom unit with knockout newly gut renovated kitchen and primary bedroom with brand new en suite bathroom and closets is a dream! The front to back entry invites you into the open concept living & dining which are bathed in natural light . The gorgeous custom kitchen with all new St. Martin cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless appliances and custom lighting is a show stopper. Upgrades such as installing & refinishing hardwood floors, all new recessed lighting, new hardware throughout, & new Nest thermostat system - to name but a few - contribute to the ease of living in this fabulous townhouse. The huge family room with fireplace & an office alcove, which walks out to a serene & sunny deck overlooking conservation land, can't be beat. Come see for yourself!

Welcome to this spacious 4-bedroom, 3-full bathroom home tucked away on a private drive with peaceful winter water views of the Mianus River. Located in the sought after North Mianus and Easter school districts. This home is in great condition, offering a bright and open layout perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. Enjoy a large living room with plenty of natural light, and an eat-in-kitchen, generous bedrooms, and a finished lower level with extra living space. If you are looking for space, privacy, and charm in Greenwich, this home is a perfect fit.

Perfect as an Investment or as a Multi-Generational Opportunity Discover the potential of this well-maintained two-family home, set on 0.20 acres and perched high on Moshier Street. Each unit features two generously sized bedrooms, one bathroom, and a family room. The lower level includes a private entrance, an additional bathroom, and a kitchen area-ideal for extended family or as potential rental income. Enjoy ample parking with a detached two-car garage and additional off-street spaces. The rear of the property borders Pemberwick Park and a scenic nature preserve, offering both sports courts, playgrounds, and walking trails. Close to transit including Metro North stations, the Merritt Parkway, and Westchester County Airport. Two minutes to the Mill and downtown Glenville. Districted for Glenville Elementary School, taxes are under $6,200 a year, and there is plenty of FAR remaining.

Renovate, Expand, or build new on one of Cos Cob's coveted streets. Two bedroom, with tons of potential for expansion. Highlights include fireplace in living room, hardwood floors, central air, and a 300 sq. foot heated sun room located off the kitchen overlooking private back yard. The unfinished basement offers additional sq. footage ready to be finished with plumbing for bath already in place. FAR allows for 2822 sq. ft subject to town regs.

The home offers endless potential for investors, builders, or DIY enthusiasts. With a newer roof, newer plumbing, newer siding, and an on-demand boiler, the major updates have already been done, but the home still needs TLC to make it shine. Sited on a generous .133-acre lot in an R-6 Zone. Just a short walk to the Metro North train station and with easy access to I-95, this location is perfect for commuters. Enjoy the vibrant downtown Byram area with its shopping, fabulous restaurants, and attractions like the beautiful Byram Park, offering a playground, marina, beach, and town pool. Whether you're looking to restore the existing structure or tear down and build something new, this is a fantastic opportunity to invest in a prime location in a growing community.

Beautifully maintained 4BR/3BA home on a flat, parklike 1acre property in a private association. Lush lawns, a handbuilt stonewall, and plenty of room for a pool or sports court. Features include hardwood floors, living room with fireplace, formal dining room, large eatin kitchen, firstfloor bedroom, full bath, and laundry. Second level offers a spacious primary with cedar walkin closet, additional bedroom, full bath, and an approved inlaw suite with kitchen, full bath, and separate entrance. Oversized 1car garage, treelined street, and opportunity to expand or move right in.

Perched in the heart of downtown Glenville, this turn-key beauty sits on a .28 acre, meticulously manicured and fenced lot. Discover this spacious and sun-filled 5 bedroom, 3.1 bath home with a 3-story staircase, and 4 fully finished floors. Showcasing modern finishes throughout, the great room is both elegant and warm with its vaulted ceiling, gas fireplace, and lofted area with beautiful built-in desks and bookshelves - a versatile space ideal as a reading nook, WFH, or homework station. Entertain with ease in the open-concept dining area that flows into a chef-inspired kitchen featuring an island, breakfast bar, premium appliances, and both butler and walk-in pantries. Adjacent to the kitchen is a spacious family room with a second gas fireplace and French doors that lead out to a backyard oasis. Enjoy the stone terrace with a built-in BBQ, and charming pergola. Upstairs, the generously sized primary suite offers ultimate comfort with its own gas fireplace, granite-adorned bathroom, and 3 walk-in closets. Four additional bedrooms and two stylishly updated full baths are thoughtfully positioned across the second and third floors, making room for family, guests, and hobbies. The lower level has another 1,000+ sq. ft. of space, which is ideal space for a gym, media room, and extra storage. Just steps from schools, parks, The Mill, Glenville Pizza, Pop-Up Bagels, The Country Table, and new shops like Green & Tonic, Luca's, and Bluebird Taqueria.

facts.availability: seller prefers the end of July

listings.remarks: Completely renovated in 2018, this turn-key colonial with an open floor plan and modern amenities is in a quiet, private Cos Cob neighborhood near town, abutting Pomerance Park & Montgomery Pinetum. Gourmet kitchen with island, stainless appliances and quartz countertops. Separate room on 1st floor can be used as office, den or family room. Two full baths, hardwood floors, mechanicals, washer/ dryer, windows & doors, all renovated/ replaced in 2018. Conveniently located to train, bus, schools, shopping, Bible Street Park & playground. Finished lower level playroom with storage closets and laundry room. Extra square footage in lower level beyond finished area that could be finished if desired. Good as new! Move right in!

Beautifully Renovated Condo in a Prime Downtown Greenwich Location. Nestled in the heart of Greenwich, atop the renowned Greenwich Avenue, this stunning south-facing, sunlit 1-bedroom condo offers an open layout that has been meticulously maintained. The extensive list of improvements includes major upgrades such as refinished original oak floors, a brand-new eat-in kitchen with LG appliances and Carrera Quartz countertops, and a luxurious spa-like bathroom with Kohler fixtures. Attention to detail is evident with refinished original hinges, new window weatherstripping, and updated outlets and light switches. The Greenwich Lodge Association offers amenities like a rooftop deck with city and water views, an on-site full-time superintendent, and a convenient central location. Parking and storage are included.

Totally updated and renovated, this charming 1920's Shore Colonial mixes timeless turn of the century charm with today's contemporary design and technology. A great neighborhood near schools, playground and shopping has easy access to I95 and Metro North. The welcoming front porch introduces a spacious main level with living room with new gas fireplace/ shiplap and hearth and opens into the newly designed chefs kitchen with marble countertops, breakfast bar seating, custom cabinetry, high end appliances and service bar. This open plan living space seamlessly expands into the great room leading to the terrace and yard, allowing for great indoor/outdoor living. Second floor is a beautiful new primary suite with luxurious bathroom with heated floors and walk-in closet. Two bedrooms, office and 1 full bath complete the second level. An added third floor has two sunny bedrooms with vaulted ceilings and a shared bath. An open staircase leads to a lower level family room and separate large unfinished basement. Many updates including New white oak hardwood floors throughout, driveway and Belgian blocks, new HVAC, lighting etc.

facts.laundryLoc: second floor laundry room in hallway

listings.remarks: Sandwich Road Colonial with In-Law Apartment - A Rare Find!  Welcome to Sandwich Road, one of Greenwich's most sought-after locations-where timeless charm meets modern convenience. This two-story Colonial offers 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, perfectly designed for comfortable living and effortless entertaining.  Features: A private 1-bedroom in-law/au pair suite with its own entrance, cozy fireplace, and full bath-ideal for extended family or guests.  Inside the main home, you'll find:  A sun-drenched living room with a wood-burning fireplace  A functional flow from the kitchen to the dining and living areas  A spacious two-car garage  A level, 1+ acre yard-perfect for outdoor gatherings  Located on quiet, tree-lined Sandwich Road, you're just minutes to schools, parks, shopping, dining, and Metro-North for an easy NYC commute.  This is the kind of opportunity that doesn't come often-and won't last long.

Enter through the gated driveway to this ranch-style residence, quietly set on nearly four acres in Greenwich. The property offers a tranquil atmosphere with mature landscaping, a slate terrace, and an in-ground pool. While the home has good bones, it presents a prime opportunity for renovation and customization. Inside, the front foyer opens to a combination of hardwood and carpeted flooring. The primary bedroom features wood floors and a private bath, while two additional bedrooms-also with hardwood floors share a full hallway bathroom. The living room includes wall paneling, a large picture window, carpeting, and a classic stone fireplace. Just off the living room, the dining area transitions between carpet and wood floors. The kitchen with access to the rear patio and pool, includes vinyl flooring, laminate counters, and dated appliances such as an electric stove, microwave, and dishwasher, a newer refrigerator. Adjacent to the kitchen is a laundry area with a utility sink. A bright sunroom with sliding glass doors opens to the backyard and also provides entry to the attached garage. Off the dining room are stairs to a private office w/hardwood floors and a full bath offers potential as a home office, studio, or guest suite/fourth bedroom. A walk-out basement adds valuable storage or finishing possibilities. With a functional layout and substantial lot, this home is well-suited for a buyer eager to restore and personalize a property in Greenwich. "Sold As Is"

Welcome to Palmer Point! Experience serene waterfront living in this sought-after condominium community, located just half a mile from the Cos Cob train station. This inviting one-bedroom plus loft/den residence features an open-concept design with abundant natural light throughout. The spacious living room boasts a cozy gas fireplace and sliding glass doors that open to a private balcony, offering a peaceful outdoor retreat. Highlights include: Light-filled loft-style den for added versatility, In-unit washer and dryer, Central air conditioning, Covered assigned parking in a secure gated garage, Private storage room plus ample guest parking. The community provides exceptional convenience with common charges that cover water, exterior maintenance, and trash removal. Whether enjoying the spacious living area or unwinding on your balcony, this Palmer Point home combines comfort, practicality, and a coveted waterfront lifestyle.

Welcome to 3 Green Lane, an inviting, move in ready Cape on a peaceful cul-de-sac in Greenwich's Glenville area. Sun filled living and dining spaces set the tone for everyday comfort, with hardwood floors throughout and a refreshed kitchen that keeps things bright and functional.  The home offers 4 bedrooms and 2 full baths, plus a finished lower level with 900+/- sq ft of additional flexible space beyond the listed square footage, ideal for a media room, playroom, hobby space, or work-from-home setup. Two fireplaces add warmth and character.  Outside, enjoy multiple places to relax, a private patio and an elevated deck, along with a classic stone-walled entry that gives the home standout curb appeal. There's also a fenced side yard area great for contained outdoor space. Central air, natural-gas heat/hot water, and a 1-car garage add everyday convenience. Also, Located in an R-6 zone, the property may offer two-family potential (will need to verify with the town). Close to Glenville School, local shops, parks, and commuter routes/train connections.

Perfectly positioned between conservation land and one of Greenwich's most prestigious roads, this five-bedroom home combines exceptional convenience with refined privacy. A tree-lined sidewalk provides direct access to downtown, while the property offers a serene, retreat-like setting. French doors open to a spacious terrace with outdoor lighting and a fully fenced yard, adjacent to an oversized two-car garage with bonus space above. The elegant family room showcases a grand stone fireplace and views of the manicured lawn, and don't miss the lower level complete with a playroom, laundry, and wine cellar.

Fully reimagined luxury 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse elegantly positioned at the end of a private cul-de-sac in highly sought-after Glenville, offering a sophisticated blend of refined design, exceptional craftsmanship, and turnkey living. The main level showcases an expansive open-concept living and dining area centered around a stylish wood buring fireplace with custom built-ins and sliding glass doors leading to a private deck with serene woodland views. The designer kitchen features top-of-the-line appliances, sleek cabinetry, quartz countertops that extend seamlessly to the backsplash, and elegant under-cabinet lighting. The tastefully updated powder room is conveniently located just off the kitchen. Upstairs, the stunning primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, a custom walk-in closet, and a beautifully appointed en-suite bath. A spacious second bedroom and a fully renovated hall bath featuring designer textured wallpaper and a beautifully tiled tub/shower combination complete the upper level. The finished lower level provides exceptional versatility with a spacious family room ideal for a media room, home office, or additional living space, along with a dedicated laundry area and abundant storage. Additional highlights include a detached garage, assigned parking space, and a peaceful setting surrounded by nature. This exceptional residence offers luxury, privacy, and convenience in one of the most desirable locations in Greenwich.

This nicely updated Putnam Park turnkey co-op is just steps from parking area making easy access to the unit. Updated with high end appliances. Contains more square footage than a standard 2-bedroom unit!! Spacious and sunlit unit with welcoming foyer, spacious living room, comfortable dining area, galley kitchen and alcove perfect for computer/workspace, generous bedroom and bath. A stone terrace invites you to enjoy the outdoors. Putnam Park is located in the heart of Greenwich minutes from shops, train, library, hospital, parks and schools. Beautifully landscaped property with flowering shrubs makes leisurely walks a delight. Garage when available is at additional cost. Must see to fully appreciate!

listings.remarks: This turnkey townhouse offers a modern open concept layout, featuring two bedrooms and two and a half baths, along with a finished lower level ideal for a home office, gym, or playroom. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and a marble backsplash, complemented by a separate laundry room with a newer washer and dryer. The spacious living area showcases beautiful hardwood floors, a cozy gas fireplace, and an inviting dining space, while French doors open to a private terrace. The oversized primary bedroom suite includes a fully renovated bathroom and a custom walk-in closet, with a second bedroom and full bath completing the upper level. Additionally, the property boasts an attached oversized one-car garage with keyless entry and ample storage space. Conveniently situated near Greenwich's exceptional amenities, including downtown shops, restaurants, the Metro North train, beaches, parks, marina, ferry, and the town pool, this lovely townhouse is ready for you to move in and enjoy.

Tucked away on a private in-town lane, this beautifully landscaped and fully renovated home blends timeless charm with today's modern amenities. A welcoming courtyard leads to a beautiful covered porch and sunlit interiors with hardwood floors throughout. The gourmet kitchen features marble countertops and new Thermador/Bosch appliances, flowing into a bright family room with French doors to a bluestone terrace and large, private and level backyard. Upstairs offers a new primary suite with a luxurious bath and walk-in closet, plus three additional bedrooms, two full baths, and laundry. Just minutes to Greenwich Ave, shops, dining, and train.

Welcome to 39 Cambridge Drive, a stunningly renovated 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence located in the heart of Greenwich's highly desirable Glenville neighborhood. From the moment you arrive, you'll notice the brand-new siding and windows that give this home incredible curb appeal. Inside, the main level boasts a fully renovated kitchen with sleek finishes and modern appliances, complemented by newly refinished hardwood floors and sunlit living spaces. The primary suite offers a private oasis with a beautifully updated ensuite bath, while the additional bedrooms provide comfort and flexibility, including one on the lower level ideal for guests or a home office. The fully finished walkout basement offers in-law potential or bonus living space, perfect for multi-generational living or entertaining. With updated electrical, central air, and efficient natural gas, every detail has been carefully considered. Step outside to a private backyard sanctuary - quiet, level, and ready for summer nights or weekend lounging. All of this in an unbeatable location just minutes to parks, shops, Glenville School, and with easy access to the Merritt Parkway, I-95, and Metro-North, making your NYC commute a breeze. This is Greenwich living at its finest - turnkey, stylish, and perfectly situated.

Welcome to your own slice of California right here in Greenwich with great potential investment property or room to expand. This picture-perfect home, inspired by the charm of a California Bungalow. Step inside and enjoy the warmth of an open-concept layout with hardwood floors and a stone-clad wood-burning fireplace that anchors the main living space. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, generous cabinetry, and a breakfast bar. Tucked away for privacy is the primary bedroom with the two additional bedrooms and a full bath in the rear of the home. The lower level includes laundry area, clean storage, and direct access to the garage. Outside, the level backyard brick patio, just off the kitchen, is perfect for entertaining. Updates include central air and updated kitchen and bath. Just blocks from Byram Shore Park & Beach, and minutes to shops, schools, and major commuting routes. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity to own a move-in-ready gem!

Nestled privately, and surrounded by matured trees, on 1.82 bucolic mid-country acres, sits this seven bedroom, seven full and three half bath, gorgeous estate! Extraordinary stone & shingle construction, built by Aberdeen Properties, and gardens magnificently designed by Rutherford & Associates. Dramatic front to back, double height entry, exquisite millwork throughout, 10' ceilings, and a comfortable open flow. Ideal for both everyday living and grand scale entertaining! Fabulous primary suite, with sitting area, plus five other spacious ensuite bedrooms, and a separate guest suite with f/p. Gourmet kitchen with sun-filled breakfast area and large pantry, formal dining room, family room, living room and magnificent office/library that is privately located at the end of the first floor. Finished lower level with gym/extra ensuite bedroom, another family/hang out room, home theater & spectacular wine room. Outside is a private, resort like oasis, with a large flagstone patio, fire pit, pizza oven, jacuzzi and a magnificent pool, overlooking the gorgeous manicured lawn! Minutes to shops, five-star restaurants, beaches, parks, train and major highways for an easy commute to NYC. Luxury, comfort, privacy and convenience...this one has it all!

Welcome to Mead Farm - exquisitely renovated and transformed midcountry Greenwich estate that blends historic character with modern luxury. Set on nearly 6 acres in a 2 acre zone, this 9,189 SF residence offers 6 bedrooms, 6 full and 2 half baths. A recent multi-year renovation by renowned designer Thom Filicia, paired with award-winning landscaping by James Doyle, elevates the property to a rare level of refinement, harmonizing timeless design with modern comfort. Originally built in 1846, the home features wide-plank floors, copper gutters, 7 fireplaces, and a wraparound porch. The rebuilt water tower adds a gym, wine room, full bath, and dramatic double-height office. Outdoors, enjoy gardens, terraces, pool with autocover, pond and a barn with loft and garages - just minutes from town.

listings.remarks: An exceptional opportunity on a rare, expansive property in coveted Greenwich, presenting a unique choice to renovate or custom-build. The home offers timeless character, light-filled interiors & is ready for a transformation to suit your vision. The main level boasts a living room, formal dining room, and a spacious kitchen adjoining the family room. Upstairs, four generously sized bedrooms provide comfort & versatility, while the expansive unfinished lower level offers endless possibilities. Outside, tranquil grounds create a private retreat with lush landscaping and space to relax or entertain. Whether you choose to renovate or build, this property presents unmatched potential in one of Connecticut's most desirable communities. Don't miss this opportunity!

Prime Greenwich Location.  This 4bed,3.5 bath on over a quarter acre blends classic charm with modern ease. Just moments from Greenwich Ave the residence features an open-concept living space with a gas fireplace, deluxe kitchen and a private primary suite with spacious walk-in closet. Three additional well-appointed bedrooms provide space for family or guests. Enjoy sunrise coffee on the covered front porch or step outback to a west facing backyard designed for relaxation and entertaining, large level yard, lush private landscaping, an outdoor fireplace, flagstone patio, and deck ,perfect for enjoying sunsets. Additional 600 sqft of storage in basement.

Impeccable home in a fantastic Riverside location close to Binney Park, Perrot Library, and the Old Greenwich Metro North station with adjacent village shopping and dining. Sidewalks lead directly to Riverside School and Eastern Middle School. The main level flows between family room, dining room, and kitchen and includes a windowed den for play-space, office, or sitting room. Upstairs has four bedrooms and two full baths, while the finished third floor provides ample space for office, workout, and storage. Lower level includes updated garage and laundry, plus a state-of-the-art media room that doubles as playroom or office. Spacious deck for outdoor entertaining and lounging overlooks a private backyard with custom gates and meticulously maintained English-style gardens surrounding the home. Additional features include exterior EV charger, full home water filtration system and partial generator.

Experience exceptional craftsmanship in this new construction 6-bedroom, 6.2-bath home on a desirable Riverside cul-de-sac. Spanning over 6,500 sq. ft. across four levels, this thoughtfully designed residence blends luxury, comfort, and convenience. The main level features 10-foot ceilings, white oak floors, and a dramatic double-height family room with a gas fireplace. The show-stopping eat-in kitchen anchors the home, complemented by a formal dining room with wet bar, living room with fireplace, and private office. Upstairs, the primary suite impresses with vaulted ceilings, dual walk-in closets, a fireplace and a spa-like bath. Four additional bedrooms each with a walk-in closet-and three bathrooms complete the upper floors. The finished lower level offers a family room with fireplace, wet bar, gym, and en suite bedroom. Outside, enjoy a private oasis with a fire pit, motorized pergola, and room for a pool. Only minutes from schools, train, parks, and Old Greenwich village.

Welcome home to 30 High Street where timeless charm meets modern comfort. This three-bedroom home is perfectly situated on a quiet, tree-lined street in Byram, offering both privacy and convenience. Step inside to sun-filled living spaces designed for both relaxation and entertaining. The finished lower level provides a flexible layout-ideal for a home office, guest suite, or fourth bedroom. Enjoy crisp Fall mornings on the welcoming front porch or host memorable gatherings on the expansive deck overlooking the backyard. The property blends indoor comfort with outdoor enjoyment, making it a true retreat. Perfectly located near parks, shops, restaurants and the waterfront, this home offers the Greenwich lifestyle at its best. Close to train & I95 for an easy commute/trip into NYC!

House sits on 1.29 acres back lot off private road boarding with wooded and wetlands, tongue and groove cedar siding with stone veneer, asphalt roof, central a/c, heat and central vacuum, vaulted ceilings, stone veneer fireplaces, second floor deck wrapping around side and back overlooking wooded and wetland areas, five-minute drive to I95 or Merritt Parkway, five-minute walk to elementary school. NOTE: HOUSE FOR SALE AS IS!!!

Open floor plan Duplex condo with private yard and patio. Located in the central Greenwich, only a few blocks away to Greenwich Avenue. Granite counter tops with stainless steel appliances. 9-foot ceiling on the first floor. Very spacious primary bedroom with primary bathroom and walk-in-closet. Crown moldings and hardwood floors throughout. New HVAC and hot water system installed 2 years ago.

Near Downtown Greenwich- This spacious end-unit has high ceilings, lots of storage and a flexible floor plan. Seller has made various updates; and the home is well maintained. The primary suite has a sitting area w/ fireplace and a large walk-in closet. There is a second floor w/d. The kitchen opens to an informal eat-in area; and family room with another fire place. The dining area has coffered ceilings and opens to the living room. Sound system/speakers are throughout. A private, outside terrace is accessed from the kitchen through french doors - easy for outside grilling! The 3/4 lower level offers storage and other options. There's an attached garage plus additional parking. Close to restaurants, train, shopping and a recently rebuilt magnet, elementary school.

One of the largest residences at Putnam Hill, this impeccably renovated 3-bedroom, 2-bath apartment is set on a tranquil 10-acre, park-like campus in the heart of downtown Greenwich. Bathed in natural light from three exposures, the home showcases an open floor plan and a gourmet eat-in kitchen designed for both everyday living and easy entertaining. The serene primary suite features an expanded spa-like bath with built-in storage and a walk-in closet. There are two additional bedrooms adjacent to a renovated second bath. Additional highlights include in-unit washer/dryer, private balcony with distant views, basement storage, garage parking as available ($85/month), and an on-site Superintendent. Six spacious ensuite bedrooms include a luxurious primary retreat with sitting room, 2 private offices, fireplace, spa-like marble bath with steam shower and soaking tub, and expansive walk-in closets. A private in-law or nanny suite provides flexible living options. The finished lower level features a 2,000-bottle temperature-controlled wine cellar with tasting bar, recreation space with putting green, sauna, fitness area and ample storage. Outdoors, enjoy a 55-foot pool, spa, 3,000 sq ft sun deck, BBQ island, and sweeping lawns. Additional enhancements include a redesigned laundry room, upgraded lighting throughout, refinished floors, freshly painted interiors, smart home and automation upgrades, state-of-the art security system, new HVAC systems and a modernized garage. An iconic residence where grandeur meets exceptional craftsmanship and refined living.

Welcome to 31 Thornhill Rd in Greenwich's Riverside neighborhood, a renovated home that feels like new and is backed by a new construction warranty. Rebuilt from the ground up, the property features a reinforced foundation, all new framing and walls, plus a new roof and siding for long-term peace of mind. Inside, enjoy wide white oak floors, a custom kitchen, and a Viking appliance package designed for both everyday living and entertaining. Efficiency and comfort are enhanced with spray foam and soundproof insulation, natural gas heat, a new heating and cooling system, and Davinci aluminum-clad windows with energy-efficient glass. The home is smart-home pre-wired with Control4 automation and built-in speakers. Outdoor living includes a private patio and deck, automated sprinkler system, and garage parking, completing this thoughtfully rebuilt and move-in ready residence.

Welcome to 255 Byram Road - a charming and move-in ready Colonial that offers a thoughtful layout and updates throughout. The main level is anchored by a welcoming foyer, a living room with fireplace, and a dining room with newly refinished hardwood floors. The kitchen and powder room complete the first floor. Upstairs are three bedrooms, a full bath, and an additional room perfect for a home office or playroom. A screened porch overlooks the flat yard, and a one-car garage completes the property. The home is ideally located near downtown Greenwich, restaurants, shops, parks, and the waterfront. Proximity to the train and I-95 offers easy commuting.

Situated on over two private acres in the highly desirable Mid-Country Greenwich area, this sophisticated 5-bedroom, 3.5-bath brick Colonial is a move-in-ready home designed for comfortable living and effortless entertaining. A welcoming foyer introduces the home's spacious layout, leading to both the living and family rooms. The generous family room, featuring a fireplace, flows seamlessly into the formal dining room. The updated, oversized eat-in kitchen opens to a large deck, creating an ideal setting for indoor-outdoor gatherings. A flexible bonus room-perfect as a sunroom, den, or home office-offers sliding doors that open to the expansive, private backyard. The home includes two primary bedroom suites - one on the main level and another upstairs -offering versatility for guests, multi-generational living, or an au pair. Bright, sun-filled interiors, hardwood floors throughout, and a fully finished basement add to the home's comfort and appeal. Additional features include a three-car garage, beautifully updated bathrooms, a whole-house generator, and a fully fenced backyard. Just minutes from the amenities of Greenwich, this exceptional property offers a rare blend of privacy and convenience.

Exquisite, turnkey 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom residence located on the first floor of an elegant, full-service doorman building in the heart of downtown Greenwich. This beautifully renovated 1,250 sq ft home offers a seamless blend of sophistication and comfort. The thoughtfully designed interior features a chef's kitchen outfitted with premium Bosch appliances, opening into a gracious dining area and an additional sitting space ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. A sunken living room with a fireplace creates a warm, inviting atmosphere and leads to a private, covered terrace perfect for outdoor dining. Additional highlights include hardwood floors throughout, high ceilings, and generously proportioned rooms. Located just moments from Greenwich Avenue, 25 W Elm offers exceptional amenities, including a full-time doorman, assigned parking, and private storage unit. Move-in ready and ideally situated this is downtown Greenwich living at its finest.

listings.remarks: A rare offering in the heart of downtown Greenwich, this 2,500 sq. ft. luxury condominium delivers an exceptional blend of sophistication, privacy and effortless living. Set within a serene, tree-line enclave, the residence offers a refined retreat just moments from Greenwich Avenue. A private elevator from the garage introduces a thoughtfully designed interior where elevated finishes and timeless details define the space. The main level showcases a gracious living room with a gas fireplace and custom built-ins, flowing seamlessly into an expansive dining room designed for elegant entertaining. The chef's kitchen is appointed with high-end appliances, a bespoke breakfast nook, and opens to a private covered terrace overlooking the lush grounds. A powder rooms completes this level. The second floor reveals 2 generously proportioned bedrooms, a full bath and a stunning primary suite featuring a spa-inspired dressing room. A dedicated laundry area enhances everyday convenience. Additional amenities include private garage parking with an electric charging station and abundant storage. Offering the rare combination of tranquility, scale and premier in-town location, this residence of luxury living with the charm of a secluded "treehouse" retreat.

A rare and magnificent architectural offering designed by award-winning architect Paul Haigh, where sophisticated simplicity meets the quiet poetry of Bauhaus influence. Set along the serene Mianus River, this home is a masterful composition of nature, light, and form-where every space is intentionally designed to engage with its surroundings. From the moment you enter the oversized foyer crowned by a striking cupola, there is an immediate sense of volume, light, and quiet drama. This architectural introduction unfolds into a home that is both expansive and deeply connected to nature. Walls of glass frame ever-changing river views, while the great room-with its soaring vaulted ceiling, white brick fireplace, and curated built-ins-offers a balance of openness and intimacy. Light moves effortlessly throughout the day, casting warmth across rich hardwood floors and transforming each window into a living work of art. The kitchen is refined and purposeful, with clean lines, natural materials, and a generous central island-all surrounded by soft, ambient light. It is a space equally suited for quiet mornings or gathering with ease. Just beyond, a screened-in porch floats above the river, offering a serene vantage point for coffee at sunrise or long, lingering evenings immersed in the sounds of nature. There are four bedrooms and baths, each thoughtfully composed with a palette of stone, glass, and warm earth tones. The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with tranquil

First Time on the Market! Set on a quiet, sought-after street, this spacious five-bedroom, three-bath split-level home spans 2,911 square feet of bright, comfortable space. The main level features an eat-in kitchen and a large open dining and family room with an electric fireplace, ideal for gathering and everyday living. Sliders off the dining and family area lead to a generous deck overlooking a level yard, well suited for indoor-outdoor entertaining. A sun-filled living room with a bay window adds welcoming charm.  The upper level includes a large great room, providing valuable flexible space for recreation, work, or relaxing. A walk-out lower level adds even more versatility, well suited to a playroom, home office, gym, or multi-generational living needs. Central air, a one-car garage, and abundant space throughout complete this desirable opportunity in Riverside.

Beautifully renovated rental in the heart of Cos Cob offering the perfect blend of modern style and comfortable living. This home features an open floor plan with soaring ceilings and abundant natural light throughout. The spacious kitchen is a true centerpiece, complete with a large island and seamless flow into the dining area, which opens directly to a patio with a gas grill, ideal for indoor-outdoor entertaining. The inviting family room showcases vaulted ceilings, creating a bright and airy gathering space. The luxurious primary suite offers a private retreat with a beautifully appointed bathroom. Upstairs, you'll find an office, two additional bedrooms and a full bath, providing plenty of space for family or guests. The versatile lower level includes an additional bedroom or office, along with a large bedroom or recreation room featuring a brand-new full bathroom and walk-out access. Set on a professionally landscaped property, the home includes an attached oversized garage and a fenced-in backyard that backs directly onto Pomerance Park, offering privacy and scenic green space. A rare rental opportunity combining space, style, and an exceptional location.

listings.remarks: Fully Renovated Coastal View Townhouse.  Welcome to 5 Glen St #204, a beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse offering style, comfort and an unbeatable location on a private dead-end street. This light-filled home features hardwood floors throughout and an open living/dining area enhanced with custom shiplap, a redesigned fireplace with new tile and mantel, and seamless flow for entertaining. The updated kitchen includes a modern yet timeless subway tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances and refreshed finishes.  Upstairs, the spacious bedrooms offer comfort and convenience, including a renovated primary bath with a large custom shower and a hallway bath featuring a relaxing jacuzzi tub. A standout upper-level loft provides incredible flexibility-perfect as a 3rd bedroom, office, or retreat-while showcasing stunning views of the Long Island Sound and NYC skyline.  Enjoy morning coffee or evening relaxation on the private deck, all while taking in the exceptional natural light. Recent upgrades include central air (2022), hot water heater, washer/dryer, updated fixtures and more.  Residents love the close-knit community feel, where neighbors gather, families play and privacy abounds. Ideally located just minutes to Byram Shore, Metro-North, Greenwich Avenue, and local dining. A truly special home offering lifestyle, views and community.

listings.remarks: A rare and distinguished offering in mid-country Greenwich, an estate of architectural significance, ready to be reimagined for modern luxury living. The Helen C. Douglas house was designed by the renowned Twachtman Brothers, this timeless brick English country home blends classic elegance with warmth, sophistication and scale. Set on 3.8 acres of beautifully landscaped, private grounds, the property features a pool, pool house, clay tennis court, and a striking allee of chestnut trees. The estate was also featured in the 2014 film ''And So It Goes'' starring Michael Douglas and Diane Keaton. A gracious front-to-back foyer invites you into the home's classic interiors. Formal living and dining rooms are complemented by a wood-paneled library, chef's kitchen, spacious family room and additional entertaining space.

This beautifully updated condominium, set within a restored Victorian home, blends timeless architectural character with modern luxury in a premier downtown location. The residence offers 4 bedrooms and 3.1 baths, plus a gourmet kitchen with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances. A spacious wraparound porch extends the living space outdoors, complemented by a rare front and side yard. Parking includes a two-car garage and two additional spaces. The lower level features a 2,000-bottle wine cellar and abundant storage. Located in an intimate seven-residence boutique community, it offers exceptional privacy and refined downtown living.

listings.remarks: Rare 3BR ranch-style, one-level corner co-op in sought-after Putnam Hill-just minutes to downtown Greenwich. Sun-filled end unit with an open layout, expansive living space, and walls of windows. Updated kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining area, perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Spacious primary suite with walk-in closet and full bath, plus two additional bedrooms and second full bath.  Enjoy effortless lock-and-leave living with in-unit W/D, private balcony, hardwood floors, high ceilings, and generous storage. Elevator building with garage and on-site parking, set on 10 beautifully maintained acres. Maintenance includes property taxes, heat, hot water, and grounds.  Moments to Greenwich Ave, Metro-North, shops, dining, and parks-an unbeatable in-town lifestyle.

listings.remarks: Tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in coveted Hillcrest Park, this superbly renovated 5-bedroom, 3.1-bath Colonial offers 5,213 square feet of refined living on 1.11 manicured acres in the heart of Old Greenwich, CT. Close to top-rated North Mianus Elementary School and just minutes from the Old Greenwich train station, downtown shops, and the beach, this is the rare Greenwich estate that delivers space, privacy, and walkability in equal measure. A double-height entry with gleaming hardwood floors sets the tone, opening to a sun-filled living room with fireplace and French doors, formal dining room, and a stunning chef's kitchen featuring a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Dacor double ovens, wine refrigerator, large center island, and a built-in eating area. The main level also includes a library/den, family room with fireplace and French doors to the terrace, and a powder room. Upstairs, the primary suite is a private retreat with a walk-in dressing area and bath. Four additional bedrooms, two full baths, a dedicated laundry room, and a flexible office/sitting area complete the second floor. The finished lower level adds a media room, playroom, and studio ideal for entertaining, working from home, or growing families. Additional features include central air, a 2-car attached garage, security system, expansive deck and terrace, and beautifully landscaped grounds. Renovated in 2016 and meticulously maintained.

Unit 818 at Hawthorne is a beautifully-renovated one bedroom, one bathroom unit that's ideal for downsizers, professionals, or anyone looking for a peaceful community that's just minutes from town. The kitchen, with generous storage for all your cooking needs, features GE appliances and a breakfast bar. A light and bright living room opens to a quiet backyard overlooking the woods. The generously-sized bedroom has two closets and a full bathroom with a large vanity and beautiful shower. Stacked laundry beside kitchen. Situated in the heart of Glenville, this home puts you within walking distance of local shops, restaurants, and the soon-to-open DeCicco's market, adding even more convenience to your everyday routine. A dedicated indoor garage spot is included, ensuring hassle-free living.

A rare offering in the coveted Willowmere Association, 44 Willowmere Avenue presents an exceptional opportunity in a truly special setting. This 4-bedroom residence captures beautiful water views and is nestled within exquisitely mature, curated landscaping that creates a private, garden-like sanctuary. Established plantings and seasonal blooms frame the property, evoking a sense of retreat just moments from everyday conveniences. A true mid-century modern residence, originally designed by architect William Rutherford as his personal home. Known for his celebrated landscape work at Storm King Art Center and the New York World's Fair, Rutherford brought a rare sensitivity to the relationship between architecture and the natural environment. This home reflects that vision--seamlessly integrating clean modern lines with its surrounding landscape. The existing footprint provides flexibility, while the setting elevates the potential to something truly extraordinary. Enjoy the heated pool and the ease of a walkable, highly desirable location. An exceptional opportunity for the discerning buyer to craft a one-of-a-kind residence in an idyllic coastal enclave.

Privately sited on beautifully landscaped grounds, this extensively renovated 5-bedroom residence blends modern design with exceptional comfort and energy efficiency. Thoughtfully updated throughout, the home features an open-concept layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining, with a designer kitchen, high-end stainless steel appliances, and beautifully renovated baths with premium finishes in 2020. New windows and doors enhance the light-filled interiors, while the lower level offers flexible recreation space with the second powder room and direct access to the property. A separate guest or in-law suite with its own entrance and kitchenette provides excellent flexibility for extended family, guests, or au pair living. The home is equipped with advanced energy-efficient systems, including Tesla solar panels and Powerwalls, spray foam insulation, and upgraded water and air filtration systems. Expansive lawn areas offer endless possibilities for outdoor living, including room for a pool or tennis court, all surrounded by mature trees, natural privacy, and picturesque stone walls woven throughout the property.

If your wishlist sounds something like: ''Greenwich, updated, bright, great for entertaining, and close to everything'' than 34 1/2 Orchard St. in beloved Cos Cob is what you've been waiting for. Nestled on a 1/4 acre just a short stroll to the best restaurants, shops, and school, this stone and sustainable shingle colonial feels welcoming from the moment you come down the driveway. Whether enjoying a quiet day at home or hosting a party overflowing with friends, you'll find this residence spacious, fun, & easy to live in. Updated in 2022, the oversized Dining Room opens to the fresh Kitchen w/white quartz counters & door to the bluestone patio. The large, light-filled Living Room flows into a cozy Family Room w/a stone fireplace & sliders to the yard. Upstairs are the 4 family bedrooms - you'll love the primary bedroom with walk-in closet and full bath. The lower level, complete w/fireplace offers ''potential'' should you ever need extra room.

6 Oak Drive is on a cul-de-sac off Indian Head Road. The plot is .617 of an acre -26,872 square feet- which allows the construction of a new house of 6,046 square feet, plus the finished area in the basement and third floor. The back to the house where the family room and kitchen would be situated is south facing with amazing sun all day. Survey with a pool site, drainage plans, planting plans, soil tests and grade plane calculations have been approved with the town, the Wetlands Agency and DPW.

Experience the charm of arriving at Putnam Hill-10 acres of meticulously landscaped grounds in the heart of Greenwich. This unique community features five beautiful brick buildings, ample parking, and a welcoming residential feel, all just steps from the center of town. Leave the car at home and enjoy easy access to dining, shopping, transportation, worship, and countless local activities. This spacious residence offers two bedrooms and two bathrooms, a generous living and dining area, a walk-in closet, and a large private balcony-perfect for relaxing or entertaining outdoors. Co-mingled with the Putnam Park Cooperative Townhomes, Putnam Hill combines classic history with the ease and convenience of apartment-style cooperative living, all within a vibrant and inviting community.

listings.remarks: Situated in the heart of Pemberwick, this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom home blends classic charm with modern updates. The sun-filled, renovated kitchen opens to a formal dining room and an inviting living room with a fireplace, plus a flexible space perfect for a home office or den. Glass sliders lead out to a fully fenced, professionally landscaped backyard-ideal for gatherings, play, or peaceful relaxation. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers a walk-in closet and a luxurious bath with a Jacuzzi tub. Two additional generously sized bedrooms share a full hall bathroom. Set in a welcoming, family-friendly neighborhood just steps from Pemberwick Park and moments from Byram Park's beach, pool, and marina. Enjoy easy access to both I-95 and the Merritt Parkway.

Set in the desirable Edgewater neighborhood, 7 Heusted Drive offers a flexible layout, multiple living options, and exceptional convenience in the heart of Old Greenwich. The home is designed to adapt to a variety of needs, with open, well-proportioned living spaces, high ceilings, and thoughtful detailing throughout. A central kitchen with a large island connects seamlessly to the main living areas and opens to a private rear patio, creating an easy flow for both everyday living and entertaining. The second level features a primary suite with private balcony and a luxurious bath with steam shower, heated floors and soaking tub, along with additional bedrooms and a conveniently located laundry area. A finished third floor adds valuable flexible space, offering options for work, recreation, or extended living. A separate two-story cottage provides a unique and highly functional extension of the home, complete with a spacious bedroom and full bath. Ideal for guests, private workspace, or creative use, this space adds meaningful versatility. Additional highlights include flexible room configurations, ample storage, and professionally landscaped grounds designed for low-maintenance living. Located just moments from the village, train, shoreline, restaurants, schools, and shopping, the property offers a rare combination of adaptability, comfort, and convenience in one of Old Greenwich's most sought-after neighborhoods.

listings.remarks: Fabulous opportunity to personalize this home & make it your own! Located on a coveted, tree lined street, with a charming, classic neighborhood feel! Close to beaches, parks, restaurants and shops! Minutes to train and I 95 for an easy commute/trip into NYC! This one has it all!

Nestled within the Putnam Park community in the heart Greenwich, this sun-drenched 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom co-op offers effortless, single-level living in a serene, park-like setting. Spanning over 1,200 square feet, the residence features three exposures, filling the home with natural light throughout the day. The open floor plan creates a seamless flow between living and dining spaces, complemented by an updated kitchen outfitted with stainless steel appliances--ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Thoughtfully renovated bathrooms add a modern touch, while an oversized in-unit washer and dryer provide everyday convenience. Step outside to a private bluestone terrace--perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation.

Located in the Cos Cob neighborhood of Greenwich, this two-bedroom apartment offers convenient access to I-95, the train station, shopping, restaurants, parks, and all that Greenwich and Stamford have to offer.  The unit features stainless steel appliances, a living room, full bath, in-unit washer and dryer, a primary bedroom, and a smaller second bedroom that can also work well as a home office or guest room. The eat-in kitchen opens to a rear deck/patio area with space for outdoor dining or grilling.  Off-street and on-street parking available. Convenient commuter location just about 35 miles from New York City.

listings.remarks: Welcome to Greenwich Hills - this sunny and spacious 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath unit offers comfortable living with great community amenities. The fully equipped kitchen opens to a dining area with sliders leading to a peaceful private patio, perfect for enjoying the outdoors. A spacious living room completes the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite features a private full bath, along with two additional bedrooms and a marble hall bath with whirlpool tub. The finished lower level offers a large family room plus a spacious laundry area, providing flexible living space. Offered furnished - with furniture shown in the listing included - or unfurnished. Two unassigned parking spaces are included, along with access to the community pool and tennis courts. The unit was freshly painted for its next tenant. No smoking and no pets permitted. Tenant must have excellent credit and comply with Greenwich Hills association rules and regulations.
