Coveted, close to the water location boasts a recently updated four-bedroom Colonial on a peaceful cul-de-sac in close proximity to the park with beach, new pool, tennis and dock. This move-in ready home features newly refinished wood floors, freshly painted interior/exterior as well as updated kitchen and baths. Sundrenched entry, enhanced by multiple skylights, leads into the living room with fireplace, dining room with bay windows, chef's granite-clad, eat-in kitchen with island and deck access, den/playroom, main level bedroom and full bath. Second floor provides primary suite with vaulted beamed ceiling, walk-in closets, spa bath, adjacent sitting room/office with bookcases as well as two bedrooms, full bath, half bath and laundry. With FAR available up to add on or build new.

Classic Colonial set on a quiet cul-de-sac in sought after Riverside, offering space, ideal layout, and exceptional potential. This 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home features a gracious floor plan with generously sized rooms, hardwood floors throughout, ideal for today's living. Highlights include a large primary suite with en-suite bath and walk-in closet, additional well-proportioned bedrooms, and a welcoming front porch perfect for relaxing with coffee overlooking the garden and its beautiful native blooms. The home is spacious throughout and provides an excellent opportunity to renovate and customize to your taste. Located in a prime Riverside neighborhood in the coveted North Mianus/Eastern school district. Sold as-is. Ideal for buyers looking to create their dream home in one of Greenwich's most desirable locations.

Don't miss this charming, completely renovated home quietly tucked away, yet exceptionally located in the heart of Cos Cob. A beautiful covered front porch leads to the inviting foyer with interior windows, open plan living room, dining area, and gorgeous kitchen featuring a huge island and French door access to deck and backyard. Main level bedroom with barn door and en-suite bath is also the perfect spot for an office. Serene primary suite offers built-ins, spa bath with radiant floors, towel warmer, and soaking tub. Two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and a great laundry room complete the second floor. The lower level was completed in 2025 and you can customize it to fit your needs; using the large space as a playroom, gym, or family room.  Also has outdoor access to the fenced-in backyard. Home was fully gutted in 2018 with new roof, siding, electrical, windows and sprinkler system; driveway and Trex deck were redone in the last few years as well. Close to Cos Cob Village, Cos Cob and Loughlin Parks, and enjoy being just minutes away from Cos Cob school, restaurants, and the train. Total sq. footage including finished basement is about 2,260. ALL OFFERS SHOULD BE SUMBITTED BY MONDAY, 1/26 3PM.

Experience life at elegant Greenwich Towers. Imagine owning a spacious, bright, 2-bedroom / 2.5 bath apartment in a premier in-town Greenwich location! Welcome to this splendid duplex with a wealth of newly added special features that includes rare ownership of TWO Deeded Garage Parking Spaces. It boasts a gracious, sun-filled, open floor plan with abundant windows that fill the space with sunlight and views of LI Sound & Manhattan's skyline. Owners have thoughtfully renovated and upgraded the home over the last 3-years by refinishing vintage floors, refurbishing and painting walls and deep windowsills, adding custom window treatments throughout, adding custom staircase rug / carpet up the stairs to the dramatic upper hallway, and by creating an unrivaled designer EIK! The 2025 custom EIK features natural quartzite counters & backsplash, beautiful Miralis cabinetry, abundant storage & workspace, SubZero, Wolf gas range w/oven + Wolf wall oven & microwave, wine chiller & integrated laundry center. Upstairs, the stunning Primary BR w/fireplace and sitting area plus 2nd BR w/lovely en suite both have closets with outfitted interiors. New heating units, new air conditioning and a 2Easy high tech system on each level add to the splendor - while feature sheet tells all! Residents enjoy a roof-top deck & basement storage unit that add to ease of condominium living. Walk to Metro North & enjoy Greenwich beaches, town shopping, dining and parks. Your ideal life awaits!

A wonderful opportunity to own in the Glenville School district for under $1M! Set on a quiet dead-end street along the Byram River and a stone's throw from Pemberwick Park, this 3-bedroom Mediterranean-style bungalow offers charm and easy living. The inviting, vaulted living room with wood-burning fireplace flows easily into the dining area and kitchen. Hardwood floors throughout. The walk-out lower level offers new flooring, extensive storage and a second washer/dryer. 11 Rex presents an exceptional entry point into Greenwich with immediate livability and future potential. The residence has been formally removed from the Special Flood Hazard Area by FEMA; flood insurance is not required.

Extraordinary new construction crafted by a highly regarded local builder. Every detail of this 5-bedroom, 5.1-bathroom home timeless design exudes excellence offering the best that in-town living can be! Tucked away on a quiet street, it offers the perfect balance of privacy and convenience to everything downtown Greenwich has to offer. An open floor plan, meticulously crafted with exceptional finishes and a private elevator, designed for both everyday comfort and effortless entertaining. The chef's kitchen features Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, two dishwashers, a walk-in pantry, oversized windows, and a large center island-flow to a bright family room with a fireplace and access to a large private deck ideal for outdoor enjoyment. Additional highlights include a formal dining room with custom built-ins, a butler's pantry, a versatile living room/home office, and a large mudroom off the 2-car garage. The second-floor boats a luxurious primary suite with a fireplace, opulent spa bath, two walk-in closets, two en-suite bedrooms and a laundry room. listings.remarks: Welcome to Lansing Meadows. This bright and beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 2-bath condominium offers an inviting, light-filled living space with a cozy fireplace and private deck. The kitchen features a generous breakfast nook and flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas; ideal for everyday living and entertaining. A dedicated office provides flexibility for today's lifestyle. Enjoy abundant storage and the convenience of a garage. Tucked away in a quiet, private setting with pool access, yet just moments to town, train, shops, and restaurants, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience.

So the 3,826-square-foot, architect-designed contemporary? Effectively free. Both claims are easy to check. The land: every comparable Greenwich lot - same town, same schools, two-plus acres - is offered for more than the asking price here, with no house on it at all. The sales: run these filters on Zillow - single-family houses, 3,500+ sq ft, 2+ acres, built 1985 or later, sold in the last 12 months. Fifty-five homes. Not one sold below $3.6 million, and the median was roughly $7.5 million. (Zillow flags one apparent exception, 43 Hunting Ridge Rd, but it has only 3,262 sq ft above grade - the rest is finished basement - and sits on regulated wetlands.) This home sits at least a cool $1 million below that floor, and roughly a third of the median.  And this is no teardown. Updated kitchen has stainless steel appliances, breakfast room with built-ins that opens to family room with floor to ceiling windows, skylights and French door access to a deck & large stone patio. Second floor offers a spacious primary suite with multi-closets and luxe bath, two family bedrooms & bath. Third floor has gym, bedroom or office & bath. Square footage includes the 300+sqft in lower level playroom. Separate lovely remodeled apartment in its own wing. Close to train, I95, ferry boats, park, shops and restaurants. Elegant & convenient.

listings.remarks: Beautifully renovated and thoughtfully reimagined, this light-filled 3-bedroom, 2.1-bath residence offers effortless one-floor living on a private and serene 0.72-acre property in central Greenwich. Blending modern updates with timeless appeal, the home is perfectly positioned just moments from top schools, town, and transportation. Sun-drenched interiors feature an open and inviting layout, highlighted by a spacious family room with tranquil garden views and seamless access to an expansive stone patio ideal for indoor-outdoor living and entertaining. The elegant living room, anchored by a fireplace, creates a warm and sophisticated atmosphere, while the formal dining room and updated eat-in kitchen provide the perfect setting for both intimate gatherings and larger-scale entertaining. The gracious primary suite is a true retreat, with windows on three exposures that flood the space with natural light, complemented by a beautifully appointed full bath. Two additional bedrooms offer flexibility for guests, a home office, or creative space, including one with custom built-ins. Privately set yet exceptionally convenient, this property offers close proximity to all amenities. With generous FAR allowing for future expansion, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy move-in-ready living with long-term potential in a coveted location.

Welcome to this beautifully updated residence offering the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and modern living in the heart of Greenwich. This bright and inviting home features thoughtfully updated bathrooms with clean, contemporary finishes throughout. The living spaces are filled with natural light, offering an open and airy layout that feels both welcoming and functional for everyday living and entertaining. The home is equipped with an EV car charger, adding a level of convenience and efficiency. From the seamless flow of the interior spaces to the abundance of light, this home offers an effortless living experience in a prime location close to town, transportation, and all that Greenwich has to offer. A truly turnkey opportunity with modern upgrades and timeless appeal.

Renovated old world charm in the heart of Downtown Greenwich! 1/2 block to Metro North train. On the Ave with shops and restaurants. Blocks to ferry for Island Beach... just in time for Summer! Hardwood floors throughout. Heat & hot water included! Sorry no pets. Municipal parking lots and laundry pick up/delivery services nearby.

Beautiful 4-bedroom, 3-full bath Colonial home built in 2000, situated at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac. This residence offers water views of Caroline Pond along the Byram River directly from the front porch. The home features 9-foot ceilings and hardwood floors throughout.  Key highlights include: Main Floor: A light-filled open flow featuring an eat-in kitchen, a living room with a fireplace, a dining room with a bay window, a private office, and a mudroom entry. Second Floor: A primary suite with a full bath and walk-in closets, plus three additional spacious bedrooms and a hall bath. Outdoor Space: An entertaining patio equipped with a wood-burning pizza oven and a fire pit. The property provides easy access to Pemberwick Park's hiking trails, tennis courts, and playground, and is located just minutes away from the train station and Greenwich Avenue.

ALL UTILITIES INCLUDED (Gas, Electric, Water) WiFi not included. This 700sf second floor one bedroom, one bath home was fully renovated in 2016. The spacious open living room enjoys south western exposures/views and is adjacent to the new eat-in kitchen with stainless steel appliances and quartz counter tops. The fully renovated bathroom features marble and quartz tile. The bedroom offers generous closet space including a large walk-in as well as room for your home office. A larger outdoor terrace, in-unit washer and dryer and ample off street parking complete this offering.

Renovated down to the studs in 2023, no expense was spared in redesigning this two-story residence in a beautiful art deco luxury building in the heart of central Greenwich. The eat-in kitchen with marble countertops, custom cabinets and Thermador appliances is open to the dining area and living room with electric fireplace. Beside the kitchen is a built-in home office and door to your private terrace. On the second floor is the primary bedroom with dual closets and an ensuite bathroom featuring dual sinks, a soaking tub, large shower, and marble throughout. The second bedroom, bathroom, and in-unit laundry complete this floor. Amenities include a common rooftop with L.I. Sound and NYC views, a storage unit, and 2 dedicated parking spaces in secure garage.  Highest and Best - Monday April 27 - 5 pm.

listings.remarks: Welcome home to a quintessential Greenwich estate with incredible views, privacy, and all the bells and whistles one could want. Spend the summer lounging by the pool and dining on the expansive terrace, watching the sunsets. The five-bedroom main house is professionally decorated, combining modern elegance with antique chic. It includes a fabulous sunroom overlooking the property, a chef's kitchen, and many social spaces, including a billiards room, private offices, and a gym with a steam room. Overflow guests will be ecstatic to enjoy the two-bedroom guest cottage on the property. Close to both downtown Greenwich and Bedford, this property is surrounded by horse farms and is in an excellent estate location with easy access to NYC. Note the property address is Greenwich, however the property falls within Stamford Public School district. Property available for month of June and July 20 -Aug 31.

Lovingly cared for by the same family for more than 50 years, this well-maintained, 3-bed, 1-bath ranch is located in the highly desirable Glenville School District. The main level features an open and inviting living room and dining area, an eat-in kitchen, 3 bedrooms, and a full bath. The walkout lower level offers additional living space with a large family room, featuring a fireplace, a laundry room, and direct access to a terrace and private backyard-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. A two-car attached garage provides added convenience. With nearly 1,200 sq ft of remaining FAR, this property offers an exceptional opportunity to expand and customize. A rare chance to make this cherished home your own.  Situated in a wonderful neighborhood, this home enjoys a prime Greenwich location close to shopping, parks, transportation, and just minutes from Westchester County.

Live Elevated at The Loren @ King Street... "No Steps Living"  A limited collection of 17 Residences designed for those who expect more -  Residence Highlights One- and Two-bedroom starting $7,500/mo *Unique floor plans with private patios *Select units boast soaring 20-ft ceilings and    lush courtyard views *High-gloss European cabinetry, chef-caliber kitchens, marble baths with bespoke vanities   Five-Star Amenities *White-glove concierge & 24-hour security *Valet parking & car detailing *State-of-the-art fitness center *Lounge with full kitchen, fireplace & large screen TV *Putting green & botanical courtyard *Housekeeping, personal chefs & grocery delivery *Mani-pedi & airport transportation

Bright 2BR/2BA Greenwich condo in a well-maintained complex, freshly painted with brand-new carpet -- ready for move-in. The standout feature: two assigned parking spaces, one just steps from the rear entrance. Most units require hauling groceries up a flight of stairs -- not this one. Pull in, walk a few feet, you're home. Step outside to your own private patio for morning coffee or evening downtime. About a mile to the Port Chester Metro-North station for an easy NYC commute, walking distance to Byram Park (beach, playgrounds, kayaking, summer concerts), and minutes to the shops and restaurants of Byram village. Quick access to I-95 and the Merritt. Greenwich address, quiet complex, and the kind of everyday convenience you'll appreciate from day one. (SHOWING AVAILABILITY: M-F 5pm-7pm, Sat/Sun 1pm-4pm)

Newly renovated and centrally located Greenwich Gem! This intelligently updated 3-bedroom, 2.5 bath multi-level apartment offers built-in USB interfaces (Type A & Type C) for smart devices, all stainless steel smart appliances, new central heat/AC, high efficiency complete home air filtration for allergy free indoor living, an expansive remodeled "Chef's Kitchen" with multi-function, extra-large capacity appliances and double wall oven (Convection, Air-fry, Bake, Broil, Roast). Well-appointed bathrooms and convenient in-unit laundry makes tasks a breeze. Large sun-drenched living space opens up to a private back deck for additional extended outdoor living and off-street parking for 3 SUV sized vehicles all yours. Convenient and flexible use basement storage space of over 300 sq ft., and two separate entrances. This great location offers a quick 6-minute access to both I95 and The Merritt Parkway. Easy access to NYC via Metro North station only 5 minutes away. Historic Byram Park Beach and Marina is a 6-minute drive and beautiful Pemberwick Park w/ tennis, basketball and Baseball field is a 5-minute walk. Wholefoods, Citarella, Stop n Shop, Costco, AMC Theatres, Hydro Gym, Greenwich YMCA, Equinox, Carvel, CVS, and the Greenwich Avenue corridor all within either walking distance or a quick 2-6 minute drive. Schedule your showing today, to experience all that Greenwich has to offer!

Charming Cotswold-style home in a convenient Western Greenwich neighborhood, custom built by its builder/owner with exceptional attention to detail and timeless aesthetic. This beautifully designed residence offers 4 bd and 3.5 ba. including a relaxing private sauna. The gourmet kitchen opens to a formal dining room featuring custom built-ins, perfect for entertaining. A spacious, light-filled living room with fireplace and built-ins creates a warm and inviting atmosphere. Upstairs includes a lovely primary bedroom with walk-in closet and French doors and two charming double bedrooms with a hall bath. The large walkout lower level includes a bdrm/rec room, mudroom, sauna, and access to the garage with an additional storage room. A rare blend of character, comfort, and convenience in a sought location.

4 Bedrooms w/ huge bonus room in basement within homeowners' association! Located in the highly desirable private Dogwood Park Association in Riverside, this beautifully updated single-family home includes all association costs AND monthly landscaping in the rent for easy, low-maintenance living. Enjoy access to a peaceful pond and grassy area in a tightly knit community known for quiet streets, friendly neighbors, and very limited through-traffic. The home is freshly painted throughout and features refinished hardwood floors, updated kitchen improvements, new lighting fixtures, and new door hardware across the main level. The primary suite offers a walk-in closet and full private bathroom, while the main level includes both an additional full bathroom and half bath for guests and everyday convenience. The lower level includes a large bonus room with a clothes closet, ideal for additional living space, a home office, gym, or guest area, plus a second refrigerator located in the nearby mechanical room. Outside, enjoy two separate stone patios perfect for entertaining or relaxing, along with a fenced backyard ideal for pets and outdoor enjoyment. Conveniently located near top-rated public schools, Riverside Commons shopping, I-95, Metro-North commuter trains, Stamford, and everyday conveniences, this is a rare Riverside rental opportunity.

listings.remarks: Built in 1928 on a quiet corner lot in one of Cos Cob's most desirable neighborhoods, this move-in ready Colonial has the character of its era with the updates today's buyers are looking for. The kitchen flows into the family room, where extra-height ceilings and a skylight pour in natural light. A fireplace anchors the living room, and a full bath on the main level adds everyday convenience. Upstairs, the sun-filled primary suite includes a steam shower, with two additional bedrooms and a full hall bath. The finished lower level complete with a half bath, which works as a home office, playroom or guest suite. Outside, a private deck and an oversized lot offer real potential. Proximity to town, to commuting options, to the water: it's all there.

Feels like home! Immaculately maintained, renovated old world charm! Sun pours into this two bedroom with hardwood floors, eat in kitchen, front and back porch, and great shared yard for bbq'ing. Off street parking for one car and plenty of street parking for others. Coin operated washer and dryer in sep laundry room. All utils included except electric. Landlord pays for heat. Quiet dead end street on the Byram river! Close to train, shops, restaurants, parks, beaches and I95 for an easy commute! Sorry no pets.

Cos Cob Perfection! Location, location, location! This turnkey 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath rental features an open floor plan, a spacious yard and is a stone's throw from the local Cos Cob Elementary school, shops, the famous Rinaldi's deli, restaurants, and offers easy transportation access! Pull into the two-car garage and enter the home through a large mudroom perfect for storage. This leads to the first floor's open floor plan, which includes a living room with a wood-burning fireplace, a large dining room adjacent to an open gourmet kitchen, and a big family room in the rear overlooking the flat yard. Hardwood floors throughout. French door sliders lead to the patio for easy grilling and outdoor entertainment. There are a few steps up to the second floor, which has three bedrooms sharing a full hallway bath. Half bath attached to master bathroom with heated floors for convenience and comfort. Don't miss the large bonus room downstairs, which is equipped with a beautifully renovated full bath and an additional laundry room. Efficient home with natural gas and tankless hot water. Welcome to Cos Cob!

This home has been thoughtfully updated with vinyl flooring (Hardwood floor under it on first floor), upgraded deck, attic HVAC replacement (2024), water heater replacement (2026), and a fully renovated basement (Dec 2023) featuring full perimeter water protection, and dehumidifier system. Beautifully maintained townhouse offering comfort and style, in a meticulously cared-for complex. The spacious eat-in kitchen features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances., and a pantry. Nestled on a private cul-de-sac in one of Greenwich's most coveted mid-country locations, this beautifully updated five-bedroom residence is set on 1.1 professionally landscaped acres, offering a rare combination of privacy, functionality, and convenience. Thoughtfully designed for modern living, the home blends formal and informal spaces, features abundant natural light, and offers seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The living room with fireplace opens to a sun-filled three-exposure office or conservatory, while a second dedicated office provides exceptional work-from-home flexibility. At the heart of the home, the eat-in kitchen flows effortlessly into the inviting family room with incredible vaulted ceilings, beam work and custom light fixture, which features a second fireplace, vaulted ceilings and direct access to an expansive deck overlooking sweeping lawns and mature gardens. A versatile first-floor bedroom suite offers endless possibilities as a guest-suite, playroom, fitness studio, or additional living space. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features a walk-in closet and an oversized bath, complemented by three additional bedrooms and a hall bathroom. The finished lower level provides valuable bonus space for recreation, media, fitness, or play, while a dedicated laundry room and an attached two-car garage enhance everyday convenience.

Sun-drenched and privately set on 1.45 level acres, this spacious 4-bedroom, 3 full bath mid-country home offers tranquility just minutes from town and steps from Mianus River Park. Sliding doors connect the indoor living spaces to the outdoor deck, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living ideal for entertaining. A finished lower level provides flexible space for a playroom or home office. Recent improvements include a newer roof, boiler, and well pump, offering a solid foundation for future updates and personal touches. Surrounded by peaceful grounds and nature, this special property presents a wonderful opportunity to create lasting memories.

Bright and Spacious 4 BA/3 BA in the Dundee/Eastern school district. Completely renovated in 2018 so all you have to do is unpack. Great kitchen with open layout makes entertaining a breeze and great flow through the French Doors to the easy maintenance expansive deck. Third floor is finished and great for relaxing or playing and could be turned into a 5th bedroom and there is plumbing for a 4th bathroom. The level .27 acre yard is perfect for playing or relaxing. Centrally located in Riverside means you're minutes to trains, shops and schools on foot, bike or car.

Old Greenwich Gables end-unit on the 1st floor on the upper courtyard near the association pool. Open floor plan with a terrace off the Living Room. Enjoy the easy access to Old Greenwich, Binney Park and the library.

Elegant formal living and dining rooms are complemented by a Christopher Peacock kitchen with adjoining breakfast room, a comfortable family room, and a library or private office. Expansive terraces extend the living spaces outdoors, overlooking the sweeping grounds and putting green, while a circular drive creates an impressive approach. A rare combination of scale, privacy, and setting, just minutes from central Greenwich.

Extraordinary privacy for an in town property. Classic farm house on .84 of acre and only .3 miles to shops and even closer to deli and fine restaurants. Rocking chair front porch. Rear terrace. Huge yard. Hardwood Floors. Owner will cut the grass, clear the snow and supply water.

listings.remarks: Tucked at the end of a private road in Cos Cob, this newly built (2025) Louis Contadino-designed home offers a layout rarely available in central Greenwich at this price point: sophisticated single-level main-floor living over a fully finished walk-out lower level, all on a private 0.34-acre setting. The main floor delivers four bedrooms - three with private en-suite full baths, including a primary suite with soaking tub, double vanity, and heated floors. The chef's kitchen features Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, custom cabinetry, marble counters and backsplash, a white oak island, and a walk-in pantry, all opening to a light-filled great room and formal dining. Wide-plank white oak flooring runs throughout. Below, a generous family room with full bath and direct yard access expands the home for guests, entertaining, or future flexibility. Approximately 3,500 square feet of finished living space in total, with available FAR for roughly 1,000 square feet of additional expansion if desired. Outside, extensive stonework frames the entry, terrace, and grounds, with four-zone HVAC and EV charging completing a thoughtful modern build. Set high above a quiet private road yet minutes from the village, train, and I-95, the property offers the privacy of an estate in a location that keeps you fully connected to Greenwich. Vision, design, and execution complete - a finished home, ready to move into.

Welcome to this bright and sun-filled 3-bedroom, 4-bath townhome offering 1,465 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. Featuring hardwood floors, elegant crown molding, central air, and quality finishes throughout, this home offers the perfect combination of comfort and style. The updated kitchen is equipped with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and direct access to a private terrace-ideal for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing. A flexible office/sunroom provides the perfect space to work from home or unwind, while the finished lower level adds valuable living space that can be customized to fit your needs. The spacious primary suite features a private en-suite bath and its own balcony, creating a comfortable retreat at the end of the day. Outside, enjoy a private outdoor area along with parking for up to three vehicles. Please note: The photos shown are of the adjacent mirror-image unit. Finishes and layout are substantially similar

Located in one of Greenwich's most desirable neighborhoods, this meticulously maintained home offers the perfect blend of timeless elegance and modern comfort. Thoughtfully designed living spaces are filled with natural light and feature gracious proportions ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The inviting open floor plan showcases spacious formal and casual gathering areas with extra height ceilings. A well-appointed kitchen with high end appliances & solid hand crafted cherry wood cabinets. Seamless indoor-outdoor flow to the private grounds with 2 patios. Generous bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations, including a serene primary suite designed for relaxation. Set on beautifully landscaped property and conveniently close to town, schools, parks, transportation, and all that Greenwich has to offer!

Experience the perfect blend of privacy and unparalleled convenience at the end of a quiet Riverside cul-de-sac in this beautifully maintained, manageable Cape Cod-style home. Ideal starter home, or for downsizers alike, this turnkey property offers the ultimate setup for accessible one-floor living, featuring the kitchen, living room, dining area, family room, home office, primary bedroom and a full bath all on the first floor. French doors from the office open directly to a flat, low-maintenance backyard bordered by a peaceful, protected forest buffer. The designated public schools - International School at Dundee and Eastern Middle School are both among Greenwich's highest performing public schools, consistently scoring well above state averages across core academic measures. The second-floor features two bright, spacious bedrooms with their own private bath, providing the perfect dedicated space upstairs. Adding to the home's exceptional versatility, the flexible basement can serve as a wonderful playroom, gym, yoga studio, or function as an additional bedroom with a full bath for a nanny or visiting guests. Complete with the highly coveted trifecta of municipal utilities-town water, town gas, and town sewer-this low-maintenance gem sits just 3 minutes from the Metro-North train station and 10 minutes from both Central Greenwich and the beach.

A rare opportunity in one of Greenwich's most coveted in-town settings, 21 Calhoun Drive combines the timeless presence and character of a classic Greenwich estate with exceptional privacy, generous scale and remarkable potential. Set amid mature landscaping on approximately 1.8 acres in a one-acre zone, the property offers nearly twice the typical lot size while remaining just moments from the heart of Greenwich. Inside, gracious entertaining rooms, comfortable everyday living spaces and distinctive architectural details create a home with warmth, character and a sense of permanence rarely replicated today. A newly renovated kitchen brings a fresh, modern sensibility to the residence and serves as a beautiful centerpiece for daily living and entertaining. A private wellness retreat, complete with an indoor pool and dedicated fitness space, brings resort-style amenities into the comfort and privacy of home. Beyond the main residence, the expansive grounds offer an exceptional opportunity to further enhance the estate. Fully permitted plans provide the option to add a Cottage, along with the potential for a pickleball or tennis court an increasingly rare offering this close to town. With its substantial acreage, established landscaping, private wellness amenities and extraordinary flexibility for the future, this is a unique opportunity to enjoy a private estate setting without sacrificing the convenience of in-town Greenwich living.

Nestled within a beautifully maintained and privately secluded community, this exceptional corner-unit home offers the perfect blend of comfort, natural beauty and convenience. From nearly every window, you'll enjoy views of mature trees and lush landscaping creating a serene, park-like setting that feels worlds away from the everyday. The oversized windows frame the beautiful scenery surrounding the premises, creating a seamless connection with nature, meanwhile the sun-drenched living room features large south-facing windows filling the space with natural light throughout the day and the bedrooms offer breathtaking views of winter sunsets. Thoughtfully upgraded for everyday comfort, the home features a premium three-zone heating system with separate controls for two of the bedrooms and one for the rest of the living area providing customized climate control throughout. The updated kitchen is equipped with a reverse osmosis water filtration system, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances and a breakfast bar. Step outside to the private balcony, enhanced with a brand-new composite floor, creating a perfect spot to relax, enjoy the tranquil surroundings and those morning sunrise hours. A tremendous opportunity to make this bright and turn key unit, tucked in a peaceful vacation like setting, your home.

listings.remarks: Completely reimagined and expanded to nearly twice its original footprint, this exceptional Riverside residence is the result of a meticulous gut renovation by Abode Interiors NYC, where sophisticated design meets effortless modern living. Graceful arches, soaring 9- and 10-foot cathedral ceilings, wide-plank Brazilian oak floors and a marble fireplace establish a refined architectural language, while all-new windows bathe the interiors in natural light. At the heart of the home, an Architectural Digest-worthy custom kitchen pairs Calacatta Gold marble, quartz countertops, Bosch appliances and bespoke millwork with an expansive eat-in peninsula. The adjoining dining area opens through dramatic 12-foot sliding doors to an oversized deck, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor entertaining. A light-filled, lofted family room offers a striking second living space, while the privately positioned primary suite is a serene retreat with a custom-designed dressing room and spa-inspired bath featuring a freestanding soaking tub, oversized shower and double vanity. Five bedrooms thoughtfully arranged across separate levels provide exceptional privacy and flexibility.

Welcome to 17 Thornhill, a beautifully appointed home offering exceptional space, versatility and effortless indoor-outdoor living. Sun-filled interiors feature hardwood floors and an inviting flow from the spacious living room to a warm family room anchored by a striking floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace. The eat-in kitchen offers granite countertops, stainless steel appliances and direct access to the deck, creating an ideal setting for everyday living and entertaining. A first-floor bedroom/office with adjacent full bath and conveniently tucked-away laundry provides wonderful flexibility. Upstairs, the serene primary suite features a vaulted ceiling, custom walk-in closet and spa-like bath with double vanity, soaking tub and glass-enclosed shower. Two additional bedrooms and a beautifully updated hall bath complete the level. A spectacular bonus room above the garage impresses with soaring vaulted ceilings, exposed beams, skylight, hardwood floors and private balcony, perfect for a media room, playroom, gym or office. Outdoors, enjoy an expansive, level and fully fenced backyard with mature landscaping, stone walls, spacious deck, stone patio/fire pit area and garden beds. A rare combination of generous living space, character and exceptional outdoor amenities designed for today's lifestyle.

A rare opportunity to create your own private retreat, this beautifully reimagined 6-bedroom, 4 full and 1 half bath home offers nearly 3,000 square feet of versatile living on a peaceful, private 0.33-acre lot in desirable Greenwich. A standout feature is the exceptionally large, fully renovated attic, offering expansive bonus space ideal for a home office, studio, gym, playroom, media room, or additional living area. Outside, the generous yard space alongside the driveway offers exciting potential for a swimming pool, outdoor kitchen, or expanded entertaining area. Thoughtfully expanded and extensively updated, the home blends modern comfort with timeless appeal. The main level features 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, a welcoming living room, and a spacious family room with vaulted ceilings and exposed beams. The luxurious primary bath includes a jetted soaking tub, heated floors, and solar-powered skylight. The walkout lower level adds exceptional flexibility with 2 additional bedrooms, 2 full baths, a large recreation room, and mudroom-ideal for an in-law suite, au pair, guest quarters, home office, or multi-generational living. With abundant space, a remarkable renovated attic, private grounds, and exciting outdoor potential, this move-in-ready home offers flexibility and the opportunity to make it truly your own.

Nestled in the coveted Portal Rock community, this beautifully updated two-bedroom, one-bath rental offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience. This sun-filled, one level unit features features a brand-new kitchen with stainless steel appliances, refinished hardwood floors, crown molding, and recessed lighting throughout. The spacious open-concept living and dining area is ideal for both relaxing and entertaining, with ample space for a dedicated home office. Both generously sized bedrooms are filled with natural light and offer serene views of the beautifully landscaped grounds, creating a peaceful and private atmosphere. Step outside to enjoy your own patio and lush green space, complete with colorful blooms and peach tree all perfect for outdoor dining, gardening, or simply unwinding in nature. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, central air, gas heat, one assigned parking space and visitor parking. Located just a 12-minute walk from the Cos Cob train station, commuting is effortless. Shops, restaurants, parks, Cos Cob Park, the Mianus River trails, and all that Greenwich has to offer are just moments away. Easy living at its best!

listings.remarks: A splendid long-term rental offered fully furnished, this masterfully reimagined English manor was taken down to the studs and completely rebuilt in 2014. Privately set at the end of a cul-de-sac and perched atop 2.50 acres of manicured lawns, it captures distant views of Cos Cob Harbor and Long Island Sound. A state-of-the-art Crestron system provides effortless, whole-house control of lighting, shades, climate, audio/visual, and security. Refined formal rooms, a bespoke gourmet kitchen, and dual terraces open seamlessly to the level grounds. The home also features a finished lower level with playroom and fitness room, a third-floor bonus room, and a fourth-floor tower room with spectacular water views. Private water access completes this exceptional offering.

Beautiful and quiet two bedroom, three bath condo in downtown Greenwich, CT with new 2024 hardwood floors installed. Incredible location with a 5 minute walk to the parks, ferry, train, playgrounds, shops and restaurants. This Condo has its own attached two-car garage plus an additional outdoor parking space, for a total of three parking spots. Features include central air conditioning, new hardwood floors, living room with fireplace, dining room with French doors leading to a private outdoor patio for relaxing and barbecuing, and yard. Updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, quartzite countertops and hardwood floors. The 2nd floor has 2 en-suite bedrooms including the primary with walk-in closet. This unit has a washer/dryer and lots of storage. Conveniently located! A pleasure to show!

Pristine, meticulously maintained townhouse in a small, private, sought-after Riverside community with an inground pool. Backing to serene trees, this very bright home features hardwood floors throughout. The updated kitchen offers granite counters and a cozy banquette breakfast nook, complemented by a formal dining room. The first-floor deck overlooks the trees - perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Three light, spacious bedrooms include a primary with tranquil tree views. A bonus dormered and finished third floor with closets makes an ideal fourth bedroom, home office, or playroom. The finished, heated walk-out lower level is carpeted with a full bath and opens to a private back patio. One garage parking space plus one outdoor space included. Conveniently close to the Riverside train station, schools, shopping, and all that Riverside has to offer. Available immediately in one of Riverside's most desirable locations. Cats are allowed. HOA does not allow dogs or other animals. Tenant pays heat and electric. Garage #2 belongs to unit & has auto remote. Pool is close to unit.

Thoughtfully updated across two levels, this 5-bedroom, 3-full bath home offers approximately 2,300 square feet with bright gathering spaces, renovated finishes, and multiple areas to work, host, or just relax. The main level features hardwood floors, a newly updated kitchen that easily flows into a spacious dining and living room overlooking the foyer with generous natural light. Three bedrooms and two newly renovated full bathrooms complete this level. The finished lower level adds meaningful versatility with a spacious bedroom, renovated full bathroom, fireside recreation room, and an additional flex room that can function as a bedroom, office, gym, or playroom.  61 CENTER DRIVE IS ACTIVE AND AVAILABLE. Completely renovated and move-in ready, this beautifully updated split-level sits on a generous 0.33-acre level lot in Greenwich's desirable Glenville neighborhood. With 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and 1,713 square feet, this home blends thoughtful updates with everyday comfort.  Step inside to find new hardwood flooring throughout, an open and bright layout, and two fireplaces for cozy ambiance. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances including a gas cooktop and range, and the updated bathroom offers a fresh, modern vanity. The lower level offers a spacious family room with a convenient laundry area, adding valuable flexible living space. Behind the scenes, this home has been fully upgraded with all new plumbing, heating, and electrical systems, plus a new propane heating system and central air - true peace of mind for the next owner.  Outside, enjoy a new patio, driveway, gutters, and siding, an attached one-car garage, and parking for up to 5 vehicles.  Located just minutes from the highway with an easy commute into New York City, this home offers the best of both worlds: a peaceful, established neighborhood with the convenience of nearby shopping and major routes. Zoned for Glenville Elementary, Western Middle, and Greenwich High School - and set in one of Connecticut's most sought-after towns - this is a rare opportunity to own a fully renovated home in Greenwich.

Some homes are built. This one is crafted - and it can be yours. AR Luxury Homes presents a Bespoke Colonial set on 5.35 level, serene acres in Greenwich, with interiors by Tara Benet Design. Walls of glass flood the home with natural light while soaring ceilings and an elevator define the scale and flow of open living spaces thoughtfully designed for the way you actually live. An expansive primary suite, dedicated wellness center, golf simulator and media room speak to a standard of living rarely offered at this level. Beyond the walls, a heated pool and spa, tennis court, outdoor kitchen, heated terrace with Ghost Screens and fireplace, and a private one-bedroom guest house complete a compound where every finish, every detail, and every square foot is still yours to shape. This is not just a home. It is a legacy - being built for you.

Custom-designed kitchen which boasts a Bertazoni range and custom cabinetry, creating a culinary haven for food enthusiasts. Elegant bathroom showcases Carrera marble and top-of-the-line Kohler fixtures. Unique and functional split-Level layout: on the first floor, you'll find the kitchen and dining area, while the upper level has the bedroom, bathroom, and a 2nd bedroom or office and a laundry room. Abundant Natural Light, creating an inviting and airy atmosphere. Unit B is a 2 floor unit with 1200 SF-The main floor-Living room, dining room, eat-in-kitchen, bedroom and full bath. Prime location: conveniently situated within walking distance to the Metro-North train station and the upscale shopping of Greenwich Avenue, this unit offers seamless accessibility. Don't miss out on this exceptional opportunity! Make this exquisite space your new home and rent out the other side as an income producer.

Tucked away in a private setting, this spacious tri-level townhouse offers 2,354 sq ft of living space in a well-maintained complex. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living with direct access to a private patio and lawn. Ideally located near North Mianus School, parks, shopping, Metro-North, and all that Riverside and Greenwich have to offer.

Renovated with a timeless coastal feel, featuring wide-plank white oak floors, abundant natural light, town utilities, natural gas, bluestone patios, EV-ready charge & a level backyard with possible pool site. The chef's kitchen, designed by an award-winning designer, offers Thermador appliances, custom cabinetry, center island, designer finishes & a custom banquette eat-in area, opening to the family room with fireplace and sliders to the blue-stone patio. The primary suite features two walk-in closets and a spa-like bath with radiant heated floors. Finished lower level offers flexible space. Finished walk-up attic with full bath provides ideal guest or office space. Minutes to Greenwich Ave, train & nature preserve, close to shopping, dining, parks, and nearby schools.

Welcome to this sophisticated townhouse style condo, one of only eight residences in an association designed by Rich Granoff. Soaring 9+ foot ceilings, rich hardwood floors throughout, and elegant crown molding showcase true craftsmanship at every turn.The main level offers a generous, open flow from the kitchen to the dining area and into the inviting living room with fireplace and direct access to a private covered terrace. Upstairs, the primary suite features a fireplace, private terrace, dual walk in closets, and a spa inspired bathroom. A second bedroom offers custom built ins, a walk in closet, and a full en suite bath. The lower level adds a generous family room, private one car garage with ample storage, and mudroom. A true neighborhood feel, yet close to Greenwich's shopping, dining, and recreation.

Large 3 Bedroom 2 Bath available immediately! This beautifully updated Second-Floor apartment in the desirable Byram neighborhood of Greenwich offers Three spacious Bedrooms and Two Full Bathrooms with Hardwood Floors throughout, and Modern Finishes throughout a Bright, Move-in-ready Layout. The Gourmet Kitchen boasts natural oak cabinets w/ tons of storage space, sleek dark granite countertops, and premium stainless steel appliances, and a large dining room while the Living area is spacious & open flowing beautifully from the main entrance & Kitchen/Dining. The Primary Suite includes a generous Master bedroom with Private en-suite bathroom and his and hers closets, and the second Bathroom offers a bathtub w/ shower head. Enjoy the convenience of In-unit Washer and Dryer, and two dedicated Driveway parking spots. Located in Close Proximity to Local parks, Waterfront areas, Shops, and Restaurants with Excellent Public Transportation options including nearby CT Transit bus routes and Metro-North Railroad for easy commutes to NYC, Stamford, and beyond, plus quick access to I-95 & The Merritt Parkway, this is a rare opportunity for comfortable low-maintenance living in a Prime Greenwich location. Schedule a viewing Today!

Set on a peaceful cul-de-sac in the coveted Riverside neighborhood, 1 Crawford Terrace offers refined suburban living with exceptional convenience. This sun-filled home features an inviting open layout, expansive living spaces, hardwood floors throughout, and effortless indoor-outdoor flow to a private deck and beautifully landscaped yard. Thoughtfully renovated in 2022, this space was designed by a renowned NYC architect for both comfortable daily living and easy entertaining, the home combines warmth, functionality, and timeless appeal. Ideally located moments from top-rated schools, parks, beaches, Metro North, and the shops and dining of Greenwich, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy turnkey living in one of Riverside's most desirable enclaves.

Welcome to this Manhattan style 3 bedroom 2 bathroom apartment in Downtown Greenwich. Sophistication extends to the baths, featuring Phylrich plumbing fixtures. A double-sided linear water vapor fireplace and custom glass and steel frame doors connect spaces. The primary bath showcases carrara marble and a custom vanity for added luxury. Visual comfort decorative light fixtures grace the interior, providing both illumination and style to every corner of this remarkable apartment.

Beautifully renovated and modernized, this classic Tudor on one of Greenwich's premier in-town streets is located just moments from schools, the train, shops, and the hospital. Inside, discover a new kitchen, restored hardwood floors, updated lighting, and graceful arches that create a seamless flow throughout. The primary suite offers a newly renovated bath and spacious dressing room, while 4 additional bedrooms and 2 updated baths complete the 2nd and 3rd floors. The pristine lower level includes exterior access, laundry, generous storage, a 1-car attached garage, and a separate 2-car detached garage. Outside, a stone terrace overlooks lush, level lawns and beautifully landscaped gardens, creating a vibrant display of blooms throughout the seasons offering exceptional privacy.

Set on four beautifully landscaped and exceptionally private acres, this distinctive European-inspired estate offers nearly 9,500 sq. ft. of gracious living and entertaining space. Dramatic beamed rooms, stone fireplaces and light-filled interiors give the home wonderful character, while French doors open to expansive terraces, formal gardens and a 40' x 20' pool and spa. Five bedrooms, a spacious game room and extensive office space provide exceptional flexibility. A rare Backcountry setting where privacy, scale and serenity come together, just five minutes from the Merritt Parkway with convenient access to all that Greenwich has to offer.

Welcome to Hamilton Way, Unit 8, a 2,500 SF, 2-BD, 2.5-BA end-unit townhome offering exceptional space, thoughtful updates & low-maintenance living. The gracious dining room with coffered ceiling adjoins the vaulted living room. The '23-renovated gourmet kitchen features custom cabinetry, Bosch appliances, a walk-in pantry & opens into the family room with fireplace. Upstairs, the private primary suite features a sitting area & fireplace; 2nd-floor laundry adds convenience. The expansive lower level offers exceptional storage & flexible space for a gym, hobbies or future needs. Outdoors, a private bluestone patio is surrounded by mature, multi-season landscaping. New roof, gutters & complete HVAC. Exceptionally clean & move-in ready. Near restaurants, shopping, downtown Greenwich & train.

Private Cos Cob oasis designed for effortless single-level living, with the added flexibility of a spacious second-floor great room ideal as second home office, fitness studio, media or playroom. A stunning, light-filled foyer with generous closet space welcomes you into the spacious living room, anchored by a cozy wood-burning fireplace. The adjoining floor-to-ceiling glass sunroom offers tranquil views & creates the feeling of being immersed in nature throughout every season. The dining room features soaring ceilings & flows seamlessly into the well-appointed eat-in kitchen, complete with a charming greenhouse-style space-the perfect place to enjoy your morning coffee. Hidden laundry in kitchen. Just off the kitchen, you'll find a home office, a convenient secondary entrance, a powder room, direct access to the attached two-car garage & backyard. A dedicated wet bar makes entertaining effortless. The thoughtfully designed bedroom wing provides abundant storage & includes two generously sized bedrooms, a whimsical hallway full bath, & a spacious primary suite featuring a large walk-in closet & an en-suite bath with dual vanities & a double shower. A fourth bedroom offers direct access to a sparkling pool & fully-fenced deck with various entertaining options. 10 Steep Hollow Ln offers exceptional quiet indoor-outdoor living, & yet is located close to all of Cos Cob's offerings. This remarkable home delivers the comfort, versatility & lifestyle you've been waiting for!

Welcome to Downtown Greenwich Living. Experience refined elegance and effortless comfort in this stunning 4-bedroom, 4.1-bathroom townhome, ideally situated within a private, gated association in the heart of downtown Greenwich. Every inch has been thoughtfully designed to blend upscale luxury with everyday ease. listings.remarks: Charming townhouse in the heart of Norwalk! This two-level home is a perfect blend of comfort and convenience, featuring a light and bright open concept living space with high ceilings. Large kitchen with plenty of storage leads out to a private outdoor space, perfect for morning coffee or gathering for a summer barbecue. Enjoy the vibrant lifestyle minutes to downtown SONO, where you can explore a variety of restaurants, shops and entertainment options. Close to the train station, easy access to I-95. Ideal for those seeking urban living in a peaceful cozy setting!

Come home to this well maintained Colonial on a coveted cul-de-sac in West Norwalk. Enter the home thru double front doors. Featuring private property with in-ground pool and expansive entertaining deck. Living room w/fireplace opening up to formal dining room. Kitchen with breakfast nook. Large family room with fireplace and glass sliders to deck. A study with built-ins and closet are directly off the family room. Ascend to the upper level where you will find the primary suite with fireplace. Walk-in closet and new bathroom. 3 other bedrooms with new bathroom complete this floor. This home has been lovingly maintained by the current owners and has the additional feature of a sprinkler system. Within minutes of Oak Hills Public Golf course with restaurant. Close to shopping and minutes from the towns of Darien and New Canaan.

Welcome to Nor-West, a beautiful property featuring flat, large landscapes, mature trees, and peaceful benches--it's perfect for long walks. This bright and spacious one-bedroom apartment is a fantastic opportunity at an unbeatable price. Located at the front of a complex that offers a pool, clubhouse, large courtyards, and ample guest parking, the location is ideal. HOA fees cover heat and hot water, making your expenses mostly fixed. With one-level living on the second floor, enjoy extended daylight through large, newer windows. Upon entering, you'll find a small hallway with a closet, leading to a bright kitchen and a spacious living room with enough space for a dining area. A large sliding glass door opens onto a generous back balcony, perfect for relaxing or morning coffees. The primary bedroom is sizable, featuring a walk-in closet and cozy wall-to-wall carpeting. This unit is perfectly situated in a highly desirable complex, just moments from everything. The new Norwalk High School will be right across the street, with additional schools nearby, as well as fantastic restaurants, Stew Leonard's, the Westport train station, and more. Don't miss out on this prime opportunity-it won't last long!

listings.remarks: Tucked away on one of Rowayton's most coveted streets, 17 Bryan Road exudes charm and warmth while offering modern amenities. As you walk up to the home, you are greeted by a wraparound porch, the perfect spot to enjoy your morning coffee or evening cocktail. The flow of this home is unmatched. Upon entering the living room, you are led past a wood-burning fireplace into a dining room large enough for entertaining family and friends, yet still an intimate space. A beautiful powder room is located off the dining room, and a sunroom with stone flooring leads to the perfect work-from-home office. Saving the best for last on the first floor is the state-of-the-art kitchen with stainless steel appliances, including a Wolf range and Sub-Zero fridge. The kitchen includes a generous family room with an additional fireplace and wood beams. The kitchen overlooks the exquisitely manicured backyard and patio; however, before stepping out, you'll find a conveniently located mudroom. Beyond the backyard is a driveway and a two-car detached garage accessed off of Crest Road. Upstairs, you'll find three secondary bedrooms, a hall bath, and a swoon-worthy primary suite. With soaring ceilings, a fireplace, and wood beams, this bedroom has it all, including an ensuite bathroom with a standing shower and soaking tub. The home is within walking distance of town, beaches, a community center, paddle courts, tennis, and more.

Charming gem in Silvermine neighborhood, 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom ranch with fully finished basement making the home 1,800 SqFt finished/livable space plus a 1 car garage and bonus shed. Basement boasts a beautiful wood bar, built in hutch and full bathroom. Relaxing Trex deck off of the kitchen provides the perfect spot to sit and enjoy the sunny days. Walk up attic for storage or renovation, make it into your dream office or additional bedroom. Long driveway provides space for ample tandem parking. Freshly painted, hardwood floors just refinished, and new carpeting installed. So convenient to shopping, parks and transit. Nothing to do here but move in and make it home!

Welcome to Shore Haven Estates, an exceptional waterfront enclave is nestled on a 12-acre peninsula, offering unrivaled luxury and privacy. As you pass through the gated entrance, you are welcomed into over 200 acres of resort-style living with breathtaking panoramic views of a golf course surrounded by a wildlife sanctuary and nature preserve. Inside, the masterfully redesigned 7,700+sq.ft. estate captivates with 7 spacious ensuite bedrooms and exquisite finishes throughout. Reimagined by Architect Tanner White, the open-concept plan effortlessly unites public & private spaces across 4 meticulously crafted levels, with an elevator providing seamless access to each floor. The gourmet kitchen, a culinary delight, opens to banquette for casual meals & formal dining for fine entertaining. The sleek primary suite with spa-bath & forever views, provide the perfect respite for the soul. The 3rd-floor library with FP & balcony with lofty views, playroom-guest wing is perfect for fun-&-games and can easily serve as double offices. The property not only has a unique connections to golf & tennis, but residents enjoy easy access to nearby beaches an charming seaside village, known for its quaint eateries and coastal charm. The pool and spa are seamlessly integrated into a three-tiered terrace with direct waterfront access. Come enjoy kayaking, paddle boarding, or take a tender out to Sprite Island, making every moment feel like a luxurious retreat at Shore Haven Estates

listings.remarks: Discover this stunning unit in the heart of SONO. This prime location epitomizes "Location, Location, Location," with easy access to Zagat-rated restaurants, vibrant nightlife, the Norwalk Waterfront, Maritime Aquarium, museums, the SONO Mall and the SONO Train Station, all just a short walk away. Plus, it's only minutes from grocery shopping. The condo complex boasts gated private parking-a rare find in SONO. Inside, the fully updated unit is move-in ready, featuring a spacious living room. The modern eat-in kitchen is equipped with ample cabinet space, and a large pantry, with room for barstool seating. The private bedroom includes an updated full bath and a spacious closet. Additional building amenities include an elevator, storage unit on the same floor, and laundry facilities. Lastly be sure to check out the rooftop deck with water views that's great for entertaining. Don't miss your chance to see this unique gem!

Welcome to this charming colonial house featuring 4 bedrooms, 3 full baths, and an attached 2-car garage, all set on a large, private lot with an expansive backyard and spacious deck, ideal for outdoor relaxation. The master suite boasts a generous walk-in closet, while abundant natural light fills every corner of the home, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Enjoy the convenience of easy access from the garage to the house through a breezeway. A working fireplace adds cozy charm, making this home perfect for those looking to add their own personal touches and style. Located close to major highways for easy commuting, yet set in a peaceful and quiet neighborhood, this home offers the perfect blend of serenity and accessibility.

This remarkable Rowayton -Nantucket style colonial is waiting for you! This bright, charming and spacious home has so much - including a full kitchen renovation in 2023 with all new cabinets, countertops and appliances. There's even a sunny eat-in area with bay window seating and access to a lovely patio for grilling and entertaining. There's a formal dining area that leads to a generous sized living room with fireplace. Beyond the dining room is a home office/5th bedroom and full bath. Through the living room you'll be wowed by the sunny and spacious family room which leads to the back patio and fenced in yard. Upstairs the primary bedroom with vaulted ceiling includes a dressing area, walk in closets and full bath. Three additional bedrooms which share a large full bath complete the upper level. The perfect blend of sunshine and privacy creates an ideal backyard space for entertaining and relaxing. Ride your bike to Bayley Beach for Sunday Summer concerts, walk to downtown village shops and restaurants and train. 2 Memory Lane is the Rowayton home you've been waiting for.

Lovely, sunny, and conveniently located Highview 1 BR Condominium in the Norwalk Hospital neighborhood of Spring Hill. Completely renovated bathroom and private patio for outdoor relaxation and entertaining. Washer Dryer in unit with central air, reserved parking and easy no-stairs access to the unit from the parking lot. Open floor plan with dining area and ample windows. Beautiful common grounds with pool, terrace and gardens. This condo offers reserved parking, professional management and low maintenance expenses. Enjoy SONO shopping, the Post Rd, I-95 and the Merritt Parkway access nearby.

Nestled in the private beachfront gated community of Wilson Point, this quiet, sundrenched home is a magical blending of modern day living and old world charm. Offering serene outdoor living, this 3-4 bedroom 4 bath home and separate barn overlook the peaceful saltwater marshes to enjoy an abundance of egrets, blue herons and wildlife. Through a picket fence, the main home features a large LR w fireplace, FR w fireplace, Bermuda room, formal dining room & eat in kitchen with a bedroom/office and full bath on the first floor.  The primary suite has a sitting area with loft & private terrace to enjoy morning coffee & listen to the halyards in the wind. 2 additional bedrooms on the second floor share a full bath. The separate barn behind provides 3 garage spaces, kitchenette, bath and living loft. Let your imagination run wild with renovation ideas for the barn.  Drive your golf cart to your private beach club with a clubhouse, tennis courts, beach w swim dock and kayak rack on the Long Island Sound. Endless walks and privacy. Walk to Norwalk Yacht Club. Minutes to train and town.

Experience SONO loft living in this stylish one-bedroom bi-level condo complete with reserved parking. This contemporary residence features exposed brick walls, beams and towering windows that flood the space with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The open-concept layout seamlessly connects the living area to the modern kitchen, making it an ideal space for entertaining guests or enjoying a quiet night in. Plus, you'll find a convenient half bath and a laundry area on the main level adding to the home's functionality. Upstairs, you'll find a generously sized bedroom and a full bath, providing a serene sanctuary ideal for relaxation after a long day. Nestled just steps from the heart and energy of SONO, you're within walking distance to an eclectic mix of shops, restaurants and entertainment venues. Whether you're craving a gourmet dining experience, a night out at a chic bar or a day on the water, everything you desire is right at your fingertips. Local attractions, including the Maritime Aquarium, offer endless possibilities for exploration and enjoyment. Perfect location for commuters, the train station is just a short stroll away, while easy access to the Merritt Parkway, I-95, and Metro North keeps you connected to the surrounding areas. Don't miss your chance to embrace the ultimate loft living experience in SONO - where style, convenience, and urban vibrancy come together.

H&B DUE 9AM TUESDAY 9/24.Discover modern living at its finest in this stunning quad-level home, where contemporary design and an open-concept floor plan provide the ultimate in comfort and style. The William's neighborhood borders East Norwalk and Westport - an ideal commuter-friendly location. Moments to the East Norwalk train/Calf Pasture beach and coveted East Norwalk amenities. Step inside and be greeted by sunlit spaces, gleaming floors, and a beautifully updated kitchen w/sprawling island that overlooks the expansive great room. Perfect for family gatherings and entertaining! The formal and informal areas flow together, creating an inviting environment ideal for day-to-day living, special occasions. Large sliders lead to the outdoor living space, tiered decks and fully fenced in backyard with current open space beyond, inviting the party to continue outdoors! Generously sized bedrooms offer ample space for rest and relaxation, while an additional suite provides the perfect solution for an in-law setup, home office, playroom or guest accommodations. Thoughtfully designed for both convenience and elegance. Whether you're hosting loved ones or simply enjoying a quiet evening at home, this residence is a true gathering place, delivering the open flow and updated touches you've been dreaming of. Extensive drainage installed for a dry basement. Added 420 square feet of living space w/large storage area beyond, 3 season room converted to 4 season room.

Here's your chance to own a lovely studio apartment right in the heart of SONO! One of only 4 units in complex, this pristine studio has hardwood floors, central air, 12 ft ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows with custom blinds surround this end-unit's living space, and the unit has two very spacious closets. This studio is freshly painted and cleaned, kitchen has dishwasher, and the studio also includes a washer/dryer. The heating/cooling system was newly installed three years ago, and the full bathroom was renovated earlier this year. The building's front door is always locked, and the unit has an intercom for additional security. Low common charges! Walk everywhere! Steps to SONO train station, Veteran's Park, Norwalk Harbor, boutiques and fine restaurants. Close to I-95. Pets are allowed! Investment opportunity, as well!

listings.remarks: 189 Rowayton Ave, a private sanctuary on .56AC next to the beloved Pinkney Park, steps from town & w/ water access to 5 Mile River. Lush, mature landscaping creates a serene barrier from the outside world, allowing one to enjoy modern amenities in peace & privacy. From your 1st step in the entry w/ terracotta floors & bespoke lights, you know you're in for a treat. The thoughtful design exudes warmth & character w/ wide plank oak floors, 4 fireplaces, cathedral ceilings, & French doors out to an unparalleled backyard. The 1st floor flows w/ ease as you walk from the entry to the right, into the living room, followed by the dining area & kitchen. The state-of-the-art kitchen features a new Viking range, a chef's dream come true. Walking from the entry to the left is a grandiose primary suite w/ a large walk-in closet, expansive ensuite bath, & doors to the yard. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms share a full bath & include a stacked washer/dryer. Adjacent to the kitchen is a powder rm, laundry rm, mudroom, & staircases leading up & down. Upstairs, discover a bonus room, bedroom, & full bath. The finished basement offers ample space for a home media room, as well a gym, & full bath. The meticulously landscaped yard boasts a pool, fireplace, & outdoor dining area situated under a pergola adorned w/ wisteria & an elegant chandelier. Summer living, just got a lot more glam! A separate structure makes for a great WFH office or gym space and let's not forget the 3 car garage.

Welcome to the largest Dalton unit in the sought-after Foxboro complex! This bright and spacious 1,650+sq.ft corner townhouse has a peaceful setting with convenient access to ample parking, a sparkling pool, and a pool house. The updated white kitchen opens to a living room with sliders leading to your private deck, overlooking a serene and secluded hillside. The formal dining room and versatile family room on the main level provide plenty of space for entertaining, with the family room easily adaptable as a first-floor bedroom or home office.  Upstairs, you'll find a generously sized primary suite featuring vaulted ceilings, two walk-in closets, and an expansive en-suite bath. A second bedroom also boasts its own private bath, perfect for guests. The finished basement has a convenient laundry area, abundant space for storage, and room for an exercise setup or home gym. The complex is meticulously maintained and is perfectly located just off Route 7 on the Wilton line. With easy access to the Merritt Parkway and I-95, commuting is a breeze while you enjoy the tranquility of this hidden gem.

Wonderful ranch with level lot and inground, swimming pool. Swimming pool is as-is.  Some appliances are brand new!

This property is located in a quiet yet convenient neighborhood with proximity to Westport Ave. Full Unfinished basement with laundry, fully fenced in back yard, new hot water heater, newer luxury vinyl flooring, French drain and foundation sealant, 3 yr roof.

As you enter 101 Murray Street you will be WOWED.  Sun drenched rooms will welcome you to this gracious home with a beautiful deck to relax and entertain your guests. Gas range, microwave and dishwasher are all new out of the box high end BERTAZZONI and are the belle's of the gourmet kitchen complete with Ann Sack's designer custom tile backsplash. More NEW: Primary Bedroom ensuite bathroom and renovation of existing 2 additional baths, all with HIGH END KOHLER. Central Air has been added; laundry re located to main level off kitchen(New LG W/D); new hot water heater and updated electrical. The house has a spacious living room with a separate formal dining area. Additionally, the family room is conveniently located off the stunnning eat in kitchen. Sliders lead to a lovely landscaped yard on a corner lot to be enjoyed by all including your furry friends. Did we mention the electric pet fence is NEW too?? Please look at the comprehensive list of improvements attached. And such a convenient location on the Westport/Norwalk border in beautiful leafy CT. 101 Murray Street is not to be missed! Come take a look!

This terrific East Norwalk Victorian has it all!!! A short walk will bring you to Metro North RR, Calf Pasture Beach, Veterans Park, nearby Restaurants or your choice of ice cream destinations. With a total of 9 separate rooms/living spaces this home offers versatility few others do. The 1st level is comprised of a living room, dining room, well appointed renovated cook's kitchen, bedroom & a full bathroom. As this home was once configured as a 2 family home, the 2nd level offers an en-suite primary bedroom w/luxurious bathroom, a 2nd full bathroom and a large family room (could be easily enclosed to create a 3rd bedroom) The 3rd floor is configured as 3 small rooms and could suit the needs of home office or hobby space. The basement is large & offers great storage or potential for future use. Outside you will love the period 1890s front porch, patio w/covered area for sunny days & al fresco dining. Many recent updates/upgrades including brazillian cherry hardwood floors, new natural gas furnace, C/A, appliances throughout, jacuzzi soaking tub, renovated kitchen, 2 asphalt driveways, beautiful fencing & much more!!! Do not miss video virtual tour, floor plans and Public Open Houses this Saturday & Sunday!!

Nestled in the sought-after East Norwalk community, this property combines convenience with tranquility. Featuring a private pool and easy access to the area's best amenities. Step inside to an inviting foyer that leads to a sun-drenched living room, complete with an open hearth fireplace-ideal for cozy gatherings. The modern kitchen boasts a spacious island and a sunroom that overlooks your expansive, fenced yard & serene in-ground pool. The flexible first-floor layout includes a versatile space that can serve as a guest room, in-law suite, or home office. You'll also find a full bathroom and a 2-car garage on this level. Ascend to the 2nd floor to find a large primary bedroom, full bathroom, and two additional bedrooms. Making this home ideal for family living. The Lower-Level apartment has 3 Bedrooms, a Living Room with Fireplace, Dining Room, eat-in kitchen, large pantry/laundry room with a washer machine and 1 full bath, also includes an enclosed front porch. The Upper-Level apartment has 3-Bedrooms, Living Room with fireplace, Dining Room, eat-in kitchen, large pantry/laundry room and full bath. HIGHEST AND BEST MUST BE SUBMITTED BY MONDAY OCTOBER 21ST BY 5PM.

Meticulously designed with attention to detail, this charming home is move-in ready-your perfect retreat awaits!

Opportunities like this are exceedingly rare. Betts Island is one of just 10 private islands off the coast of Norwalk, offering a uniquely private coastal setting and a canvas for imagination. Located approximately one mile offshore, the island is distinguished by its natural land bridge, which connects its two halves and creates a protected cove long favored by boaters. A small bungalow currently sits on the island, and future development options may be explored. Shaped by retreating glaciers more than 17,000 years ago, the Norwalk Islands form a remarkable archipelago scattered across Long Island Sound. For generations, they have attracted boaters, kayakers, and those drawn to a quieter, more adventurous relationship with the coast. Rich in maritime history and surrounded by protected waters, portions of the island chain are preserved within the Stewart B. McKinney National Wildlife Refuge, helping maintain the natural beauty, wildlife, and sense of escape that define this rare environment. A setting for those who appreciate that true privacy often lies just beyond easy reach. Also for sale is Calf Pasture Island which is MLS #24147619.

Opportunities like this are rare. Calf Pasture Island is one of just 10 private islands off the coast of Norwalk, offering a uniquely private coastal setting and a blank canvas for imagination. Properties like this remain in the same hands for many decades and do not come up for sale often. Located approximately a half mile offshore, it is among the closest islands to the mainland and takes its name from the cattle once kept there. The island is easily accessible from Norwalk Harbor and the Saugatuck River, making it a convenient yet distinctly separate retreat. A small A-frame structure currently sits on the island, and future development options may be explored.  Shaped by retreating glaciers more than 17,000 years ago, the Norwalk Islands form a rare archipelago scattered across Long Island Sound. For generations, they have attracted boaters, kayakers, and those drawn to life just beyond the shoreline. Rich in maritime history and surrounded by protected waters, portions of the island chain fall within the Stewart B. McKinney National Wildlife Refuge, helping preserve the natural beauty, wildlife, and sense of escape that define this remarkable setting. A place for those who appreciate that true privacy often lies just beyond easy reach. Also for sale is Betts Island which is MLS #24148140.
