listings.remarks: Welcome to Cranbury! This three bedroom bath and a half raised ranch sits on a half an acre in the heart of Cranbury. Featuring beautiful hardwood floors on the main level and a spacious sunroom overlooking the private backyard. Lower level includes large family room with sliders to back yard and laundry room/ half bath. New boiler, hot water heater, and new oil tank. Oil tank was removed September 2, 2025 by Enviroshield and letter dated 9/8/2025 regarding in ground oil tank removal plus Complete Environmental Testing, Inc regarding clean soil sample can be given upon request. Subject to probate court approval. This is a multiple offer situation all offers must be submitted by 3:00 October 29.

Spacious and bright Bungalow style home on a corner lot in Norwalk. The living room features hardwood floors and a fireplace, opening to the dining room with matching hardwood floors and a charming built-in corner cabinet. The kitchen and bathrooms have been thoughtfully updated, and the interior has been freshly painted throughout. Offering 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, this home combines warmth, character, and convenience in a desirable location.

A very special home and location! This fabulous newly renovated 4 bedroom - 2 1/2 bath colonial split level has been completely updated and designed for indoor/outdoor entertaining, extended family, or working from home. With a blend of classic design, timeless appeal, modern amenities, and open concept this home is an ideal haven for creating lasting memories and enjoying family. The Main floor includes the living room and formal dining room with a central fireplace creating a welcoming atmosphere. From the living room is an updated country kitchen with light oak custom cabinetry and travertine tile backsplash. A few steps away is the entertaining area with family room, office/guest bedroom, full bath, mudroom, and sliders to the private backyard complete with stonewall and patio. The upper floor is custom designed for privacy with 3 bedrooms including a spacious private primary bedroom suite that offers an oversized walk in closet and full bath with custom cabinetry, separate shower, vintage tub, and washer and dryer. The additional two bedrooms have access to updated bath with double vanity and all bedrooms offer large windows, abundant closet space, and hardwood floors. Additional features include palladium windows, custom stonework and cabinetry, hardwood floors throughout, full basement, and attached garage. Minutes to E. Norwalk Train, I-95, Merritt Parkway, shopping/dining and walk to parks/playgrounds and schools.

Welcome to 31 High Street #4-2B - a beautifully updated one-bedroom, one-bath condo perfectly situated in the heart of Norwalk! This bright and inviting unit offers a stylish, well-maintained interior with modern finishes throughout. The kitchen features sleek white cabinetry, stainless-steel appliances, and granite countertops. The spacious bedroom enjoys direct balcony access- ideal for morning coffee or unwinding at day's end. Enjoy the comfort of central air, designated parking, and additional designated storage space, all within a professionally managed complex. Located just moments from vibrant SoNo, The Maritime Aquarium, Calf Pasture Beach, and a variety of restaurants, cafes, and shopping destinations, you'll love the convenience of being close to everything Norwalk has to offer. Easy access to I-95 and the train station makes commuting a breeze, whether heading to Stamford or New York City. Move-in ready and low-maintenance, this condo offers the perfect blend of modern living and prime location - a great opportunity for both owner-occupants and investors alike.

Welcome Home! Conveniently located and lovingly cared for, this charming residence offers comfort, flexibility, and room to grow. A wide driveway and attached garage provide plenty of parking, while the beautiful level backyard features mature plantings, a shed, and a lovely patio-perfect for outdoor entertaining or quiet relaxation.  Inside, you'll find an extra-long living room and a dining room that offer a warm, inviting flow for everyday living and gatherings. The light and bright kitchen makes meal prep a pleasure, and the main level also includes a bedroom and full bath for added convenience.  Upstairs, the spacious primary bedroom can easily be converted into two separate bedrooms if desired (see floor plans), accompanied by another full bath. The partially finished basement with walk-out access to a covered patio adds versatile space for recreation, work, or guests. Central air ensures year-round comfort.  A wonderful opportunity to own a well-maintained home in a convenient location-ready for you to move right in and make it your own!

Discover this inviting single-family colonial home located at 6 W Couch St, in a peaceful Norwalk neighborhood. The property features 3 bedroom, 1.5 bath with a total living area of approximately 1,519 square feet. The home sits on a 5,227 square foot lot.  The interior boasts a traditional layout with a basement that has a separate access through a side door.  Situated on a quiet street, this home offers a sense of tranquility while been conveniently located close to 1-95 and downtown Norwalk.

Exceptional East Norwalk Opportunity! Perfectly situated across from the East Norwalk train station in the desirable CD-3 Zone, this legal 2-family property offers exceptional potential for those with vision and creativity. The home is ready for renovation or re-imagination and offers multiple pathways for value and income, whether you're looking to:  -Convert to a spacious single-family residence and create your dream home,  -Maximize returns as a 2-family investment property, or  -Develop or expand with the option to build up to 3.5 stories for mixed-use or commercial possibilities.    This property places you at the heart of a vibrant and connected community. Just steps to marinas, parks, restaurants, and waterfront attractions, and just minutes to SONO, Calf Pasture Beach, I-95, and under an hour to NYC. A rare investment or redevelopment gem in one of Norwalk's most promising neighborhoods.

Rarely available end-unit townhouse in prime Norwalk location, complete with a 2-car garage and a brand-new 2024 HVAC system with a 10-year warranty. Additional recent upgrades include a newer washer, dryer, dishwasher, refrigerator, and hot water heater-all replaced within the last three years for true move-in peace of mind. Just minutes to the train, major highways, beaches, and all the shopping and waterfront dining SoNo has to offer, this impeccably maintained 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath home delivers effortless living with low $275/month common charges. Enjoy the bright open-concept living/dining area, central air, and the convenience of 2nd-floor laundry. Don't miss this turn-key opportunity! Norwalk is in year three of a 5 year tax phase in.

listings.remarks: Make this your new home! Located in the heart of Cranbury this three bedroom, bath and a half split level is waiting for its new owner. Walking distance to bank, restaurants and shopping as well as the elementary school and Cranbury Park with 227 acres featuring walking trails, dog park and 18 hole Disc Golf Course! Roof, full bath, furnace and oil tank all replaced in 2020! With some additional improvements this home will sparkle!! House is being sold "AS IS".

Excellent Location. Private corner lot on a quiet cul-de-sac on the Westport border. 10 minute walk to the Metro North train station. 5 minute walk to Elementary, middle and high school's. Close to beaches, top-notch dining and shopping. 95 and Merritt parkway minutes away.  Well laid out open floor plan and some recent updates. Beautiful rear deck, well maintained gardens and property is surrounded by mature trees.

Prime Building For Sale + "Bonus - Kitchen Business Included" - OWNER FINANCE! - NO BANK - NO HASSEL - 18 months - 15% down - 4% rate --- 6 Month Leaseback Option --- Rare opportunity! - 2,765 sq ft Building and property are in immaculate condition. Building has beautiful stone front. Featuring: 1,400 sq ft kitchen showroom including office and bathroom. Two, very nice 1 bedroom 700 sq ft rental apartments. Including contemporary kitchen with range, refrigerator, dishwasher and microwave. Hardwood floors. In unit washer/dryer. $1,900/month rent for each. 9 paved parking spaces, garage, private outdoor space w/patio. High ceiling, 1,400 sq ft dry basement in excellent condition. All mechanicals in great shape. Located in Broad River, busy central Norwalk location with high traffic. Merritt Parkway 1.3 miles away, Rt 7 Connector .5 mile. On Route 123 leading to New Canaan just 10 min away. Kitchen remodeling business is well established with name brands and high gross sales.

Fabulous 5-Bedroom Cape on a Picturesque Pond  Welcome to this charming 5-bedroom Cape nestled beside a serene pond-perfect for those who love peaceful views and outdoor entertaining. Relax or host guests on the spacious patio overlooking the water, creating the ideal setting for memorable gatherings.  Inside, the home offers incredible potential with a flexible layout. A separate entrance leads to two versatile rooms and a full bath-ideal for an in-law suite, guest space, or home office setup.  The main living room features a large bay window that fills the space with natural light. Enjoy pond views from both the kitchen and formal dining room. The inviting family room boasts cathedral ceilings and a cozy fireplace, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere.  This unique home offers both comfort and opportunity-don't miss your chance to make it yours!

Step into this charming Colonial home and experience the perfect blend of historic character and modern convenience. The sun-filled living areas feature hardwood floors and freshly painted walls, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere. A renovated eat-in kitchen boasts a stylish new backsplash, offering a contemporary touch and a great space for casual dining.   Downstairs, a finished basement offers versatile space for a family room, home office, or guest suite - complete with its own full bathroom for added convenience. Each of the three full bathrooms is well-appointed, ensuring comfort and privacy for everyone in the household.   This home's exterior is as impressive as its interior. The vinyl siding, updated in a sophisticated dark grey-blue tone just three years ago, enhances curb appeal while providing low-maintenance durability for years to come. Enjoy summer barbecues or morning coffee on the private wood deck overlooking a landscaped yard - an ideal space for outdoor dining, play, or relaxation. With driveway parking, you'll have convenient off-street space for your vehicles - a valuable feature in this neighborhood.   Situated in a prime Norwalk location, 59 Spring Hill Avenue is close to shopping, restaurants, and everyday amenities. Commuters will appreciate the quick access to I-95 and the South Norwalk (SoNo) train station, making travel to New York City or other parts of Connecticut a breeze. Here you truly get the best of both worlds.

Endless potential awaits. This spacious 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath split-level home with an in-ground pool is full of possibilities and ready for your personal touch. Conveniently located just minutes to shopping, beaches, I-95, and Metro North, this home offers a desirable layout and solid foundation to reimagine as your own. The main level features a welcoming foyer, formal living and dining rooms, and an eat-in kitchen that opens to a sunken family room with wood burning fireplace. A half bath and laundry room completes this level. Upstairs, hardwood floors run throughout, with a primary suite offering a walk-in shower and sliders to a balcony overlooking the backyard and pool. Three additional bedrooms and a full hall bath complete the second level. Potential for laundry on upper level, hooks up in place. The finished walkout lower level provides added flexibility, with space for recreation and a soundproof music room. Outside, the vinyl-lined pool and freshly painted decks create the perfect setting for summer and fall entertaining. Additional highlights include transferable solar panels for energy efficiency, natural gas heat, public water and sewer, and a fire/alarm system. Audio/video cameras on premise. Sold AS IS. This is an Estate sale and subject to probate court approval.

Welcome to this exceptional three-family property, perfectly situated in the vibrant SONO district of Norwalk, CT. Hitting the market for the first time in over 20 years! Each apartment is thoughtfully designed with modern conveniences, including its own washer/dryer, stainless steel appliances, central heating, and air conditioning. The first and second floors feature three-bedroom units with an open-concept living room and kitchen, creating a warm and inviting ambiance. The third-floor apartment boasts two bedrooms, with the same open-concept design, ensuring a cohesive and stylish living experience. Newly installed hardwood flooring, windows, electrical, plumbing and more ensure a fresh and contemporary feel throughout. Roof was installed in 2023, providing added peace of mind and durability. The property boasts an electric gate for private parking, with each tenant having their own remote for access. Additional street parking is available for guests.

Nestled on one of Rowayton's most desirable streets, 20 Indian Spring Rd stands on 0.8 acres, exuding charm and sophistication. This impeccably maintained home, built in 1940, blends old-world elegance with modern amenities. Inside, discover a stunningly renovated kitchen by nuKitchen, all-new bathrooms and updated mudroom, offering a turnkey experience in the heart of Rowayton. The main level features an inviting entry with a powder room, a spacious living room with 1 of the home's 3 fireplaces, a cozy den, and an impressive dining room that flows from the updated kitchen. A screened sun-porch offers views of the flagstone patio and lush backyard. Upstairs, the spacious primary bedroom includes a fireplace, complemented by two additional bedrooms. The lower level boasts a 4th en-suite bedroom, expansive family space, and a mudroom leading to a two-car garage. The vast backyard is ideal for outdoor entertaining. Just minutes from Rowayton's vibrant amenities, this home marries elegance with modern living. Additional square footage on the lower level.

Introducing an exquisite legal neoclassical Victorian 4-family house with 4 units located in a sought-after CD-3 zone. Property boasts 3,317 square feet. All units have separate utilities, showcasing elegant high ceilings and original interior and exterior accents. Noteworthy updates include renovated bathrooms in 3 of the units. Ample parking amplifies the convenience, while its prime location offers easy access to I-95, Merritt Parkway, SoNo Collection, Whole Foods, vibrant dining spots, trendy SoNo district, and beautiful beaches. Explore potential development opportunities, subject to individual due diligence with the town. 2 of the 4 units are currently rented and the tenants are month to month. House is sold, 'As Is.' Potential for townhouses, congregate housing, etc. and is zoned for up to 12 units.

Stunning Contemporary Ranch in Coveted Wilson Point. Welcome to 4 Shagbark Road, a dramatic, light-filled Contemporary Ranch set on 1.46 acres of serene waterfront property in the gated Wilson Point Association. Designed for modern living and effortless entertaining, this spacious home features an open layout with soaring ceilings, a huge chef's kitchen, and expansive living and dining areas-each with a cozy fireplace. Walls of glass and a wraparound deck showcase beautiful water views and bring the outdoors in. The main level offers ideal one-floor living with three bedrooms, an office, and a Primary Suite wing, while the fully finished lower level includes a large family room, fourth bedroom, and direct access to the sprawling backyard-perfect for relaxing, working out, or play. Enjoy the lifestyle Wilson Point offers with amenities including tennis courts, a beach, a recreation lodge for community events. For boaters there is a private dock, and a mooring available too! This move-in-ready home is the perfect blend of privacy, luxury, and convenience.

listings.remarks: Remodeled raised ranch-style home ideally located in the sought-after West Norwalk market area. The main-level features an awesome layout! Bright and spacious living room, dining room w/ sliders to deck, three generous sized bedrooms, and a remodeled full bath and kitchen. The kitchen has been upgraded with new shaker cabinets, granite countertops, tiled floor/backsplash, and stainless steel appliances. Beautifully refinished hardwood floors and fresh paint complete the main-level. Additionally, there's over 800 sqft in the finished lower-level. Features in lower level include-spacious family room with brand new vinyl flooring, remodeled 1/2 bath, laundry/utility room, and garage access. Outside, enjoy the expansive backyard and deck, perfect for entertaining, gardening or just relaxing. Recent exterior upgrades include, newer roof, freshly painted deck and wood shingles. Perfectly situated in a peaceful yet accessible location, with close proximity to all major highways, train stations, and ferry service. Enjoy all the town of Norwalk has to offer! Top-Rated schools, beaches, parks, Maritime Aquarium, Stepping Stones Museum, shops, restaurants, and art galleries at SONO. Schedule your showing today!

A 3-bedroom ranch style home set on .31 acres with formal living room with fireplace, formal dining room, 2 full baths and hardwood flooring. Located close to restaurants, shopping, beaches, boating, and parks. Easy access to major highway Route 95 North/South and Route 1, makes this the perfect spot for commuters to NYC. Offers a great opportunity for renovation!

A coastal Connecticut entertainer's dream, this newly updated home is located on a quiet cul-de-sac in the highly desirable Gregory Point neighborhood. With deeded beach access just steps away, you can enjoy stunning sunsets from the sand, your kayak, or stand-up paddleboard. The flexible and open floor plan is designed for both everyday living and seamless entertaining, featuring a two-story fireplace crafted with masterful detail and a custom kitchen designed by award-winning Karen Berkmeyer, as seen in New England Home Magazine. Coastal-curated landscaping and a meticulously maintained exterior enhance the home's charm, while the expansive third-floor bonus space, with water views and a private balcony, offers the perfect spot to relax or host. A first-floor primary suite is also a possibility thanks to the versatile layout. From thoughtful design to exceptional craftsmanship, this Gold Coast gem will wow you at every turn.

Tucked away at the end of a private road in Norwalk's Brookside neighborhood, 7 Topping Lane offers rare privacy and space on 2.39 acres. This 5-bedroom 4.5-bath Tudor-style home combines timeless charm with modern updates. The open-concept main level features dramatic 17-foot cathedral ceilings, a striking wood-burning stone fireplace, and exposed beams. The updated kitchen boasts quartz countertops, shaker cabinets, stainless steel appliances, oak flooring, and a spacious dining area. Three additional bedrooms and a full bath complete the main level. Upstairs the private primary suite features an 11-foot vaulted ceiling, walk-in closet, and generous bath with soaking tub and separate shower. The finished walkout lower level adds flexible living with a large family room, bedroom and full bath ideal for guests or in-laws, plus a rec room laundry and half bath. Outside enjoy multiple patios and decks a fire pit an in-ground pool with newer liner and a detached garage. Converted to propane and conveniently located near I-95 and Rowayton this unique home offers peace privacy and exceptional indoor-outdoor living

listings.remarks: Enjoy the serenity of your 0.66-acre lot at 77 1/2 Ohio Ave Ext--offering privacy, space, and character in the heart of Norwalk's desirable West Rocks neighborhood. Offering 2,500 square feet of living space, this 4-bedroom Colonial includes a dedicated office, 2.5 bathrooms, and a versatile finished lower level that adds 600 square feet of additional living space--perfect for a home gym, playroom, media lounge, or all three. At the center of the home is a showstopping Great Room with soaring ceilings, exposed beams, and a dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone wood burning stove. French doors open to a brand-new composite deck overlooking the peaceful backyard, complete with a firepit area for cozy evenings. A sun-filled eat-in kitchen, formal dining room, half bath, and laundry room complete the main level. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite includes a walk-in closet, hydrotub, separate shower, double sinks, and water closet. An oversized 2 car garage with EV-ready wiring, solar panels, and abundant storage add everyday ease, while the location offers the best of both worlds-quiet neighborhood living within a short distance to restaurants, grocery and drug stores, and many other shops. Not to mention easy access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. Whether you're hosting in the Great Room, relaxing outdoors, or exploring the area, this home delivers comfort and convenience in equal measure.

Welcome to 125 N Taylor Ave, a charming single-family home with modern updates throughout. Featuring a fully renovated kitchen and bathrooms (2022) with new countertops, appliances (refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, microwave, washer/dryer, grinder - all 2022), and fresh paint inside & out. Enjoy gleaming hard wood floors (2022), a new bay window, updated electrical outlets, and a stylish new front door. Major systems include a new roof, boiler, water heater, and toilet (2022) plus central AC/heat (Lennox) installed in 2023 for year-round comfort. Exterior enhancements include tree trimming (2022), adding curb appeal to this move-in ready home.  Located in desirable West Norwalk connected with the golf park area, close to schools, shopping, dining, parks, and commuting options, this home offers both comfort and convenience. (Seller Offering seller concession for closing costs,!!!)

Bright and charming 2bedroom, 1-bath condo in a well-maintained complex. Features include hardwood floors, a modern kitchen, and spacious living room/dining area. Enjoy spacious bedrooms, great closet space, assigned parking, and on-site laundry. Located just minutes from I-95, Merritt Parkway, SONO, and local shopping/dining. Ideal for first-time buyers, investors, or anyone looking for easy, low-maintenance living. Heat & hot water included in HOA Fees.

Like new and pristine 445 Flax Hill Road, Norwalk, CT-a stunning modern colonial built in 2018. Spanning 3700 sq. ft., this exquisite home offers four spacious bedrooms and four luxurious bathrooms, including a master suite with a spa-style bath and custom walk-in closets. Enter through a dramatic foyer to find a formal living room adorned with detailed moldings and a gas fireplace with granite accents. Entertain in style in the elegant dining room adjacent to a gourmet kitchen, featuring high-end cabinetry, a butler's pantry, and Carrara marble countertops. The Family Room also boasts soaring ceilings and seamless indoor-outdoor living with French doors leading to a sweeping wrap-around deck, perfect for al fresco dining. A tiled mudroom offers ample storage and connects to the two-car garage. The main level also includes a private den/home office.  Upstairs, find three additional bedrooms with custom closets, a second-floor laundry room, and an oversized all purpose room which could easily be converted to a fifth bedroom or media room. Situated on a .34-acre lot, the home boasts 9-foot ceilings, enhancing its spacious feel, a full basement plumbed to be finished with electricity and duct work completed. The walk-up attic provides amazing potential for further customization, while forced air heating and central cooling ensure year-round comfort. Ideal for discerning buyers seeking luxury and convenience in vibrant West Norwalk close to all amenities.

Welcome to this charming 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath raised ranch in Norwalk, set on over a 3/4 acre of level land with stunning views of Keeler's Brook right in your backyard. Located near Rowayton, SoNo, and I-95, this home provides both convenience and tranquility. Enjoy outdoor living with a spacious deck and a large backyard. Spanning across 2,128 square feet, this home features a unique curved staircase, hardwood floors throughout the main level, and a cozy fireplace on the lower level. With a newer roof, attached 2 car garage, and fully finished basement, this property is perfect for both entertaining and everyday living. Don't miss the opportunity to make this your home!

listings.remarks: Welcome to Briarpatch, an enchanting 1781 Colonial/Saltbox home that has been lovingly restored and moved to its current location on desirable Maywood Rd. This antique gem which exudes 18th-century Connecticut country charm, offers modern comfort while preserving its rich historical architectural details. With 2.32 acres of pure privacy, yet conveniently close to beaches, restaurants, transportation hubs, and shopping, this home offers the best of both worlds. Step inside to discover wide-planked chestnut floors that seamlessly blend with the home's historical allure. The residence features five bedrooms, a first floor primary bedroom suite, options for an in-law suite, and four full bathrooms, making it ideal for accommodating guests or family. The inviting living spaces boasts three working fireplaces, perfect for cozy gatherings. Basement steel beams help support this sturdy historic home. Relax on the spacious backyard deck/patio overlooking the lush perennial gardens. Recent noteworthy improvements include a new 5 bedroom septic system, CT Basement System installation and 11 Kw solar panel system. See documents section for the complete list. Briarpatch is not only a historical treasure but a great opportunity for those seeking a unique and charming home, *see agent remarks re: tax card and latest info regarding offers.

Welcome to SoNo Gardens, a gated condominium community in the heart of South Norwalk. This spacious three-bedroom, one-bathroom home features a bright open-concept layout, where the living room, dining area, and kitchen flow seamlessly together-perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The property also includes a large basement offering endless possibilities. Whether you'd like to create a home office, playroom or fitness area - the space can be configured to suit your needs. Situated in a secure, gated community with assigned parking, this home is ideally located just minutes from the South Norwalk train station, highways, shopping, dining, and the waterfront.  *Income, rental, and pet restrictions apply

listings.remarks: This fully redone ranch offers three generously sized bedrooms on the main level plus an additional 1,232 square feet in the finished lower-level with full bath, giving you extra space for media room, gym or even a 4th bedroom. Everything is BRAND NEW - siding, roof, windows, upgraded HVAC, including a gorgeous kitchen with quartz countertops and backsplash. Large deck, perfect for relaxing or entertaining.  The detached two-car garage provides plenty of storage. All of the move-in ready updates mean less stress and more time enjoying your new home! Great neighborhood...close to everything and yet nestled in a quiet cul-de-sac.

This architect-designed home offers approximately 4,250 square feet of living space with five bedrooms and three bathrooms. It is situated on over a half acre of flat property including a refreshing in-ground pool, an expansive patio, mature plantings and cedar fence. The first floor features a private bedroom suite with separate outdoor access, a state-of-the-art kitchen, living room with fireplace and built-ins, great room with dining area, and home office. There is ample storage throughout including generous closet space, a pull-down attic, mudroom and finished lower level.  On the second floor, the Primary Bedroom suite showcases a cathedral ceiling, His & Hers oversized walk-in closets and a spa bath with large soaking tub. The four additional bedrooms provide flexible space for use as guest rooms, home gyms, or additional workspace, depending on the homeowner's needs. A convenient 2nd floor laundry and large hall bath complete this level. The bright and spacious kitchen is equipped with Thermador appliances and satin brass fixtures. It is anchored by a large island topped with quartz with plenty space for dining and meal prep. The open-concept living and dining areas are great for entertaining! This home presents a versatile, comfortable and well-appointed living experience in the heart of the desirable beach and boating community of Rowayton, CT.JUST AN HOUR AWAY FROM NYC. A perfect place to come home to.

listings.remarks: Gorgeous unit one bedroom loft in the historic Clocktower Close. The townhome offers a 16-foot wooden rafter ceiling, a very bright unit with 10-foot windows that fills this unit with natural sunlight with exposed brick walls and beams. This building is very charm and has lot of character and so much to offer to residents. It includes a fitness center with rooms/saunas, same floor laundry room, dog walk area, covered outdoor garage library area, community room and pool table. There is 2 parking available with this unit and. parking garage available for a monthly fee ( subject to availability). This unit is in pristine condition., move in ready. It is located in a very convenient location close to train station, shopping, restaurants. A must see. Unit is actually rented for 2,500.

Multiple offers. reviewing offers with Trustee on Monday 3:00pm 10/20. Charming 1940s bungalow with endless potential! This solidly built cottage feels larger than its square footage and is filled with character. The entry foyer opens to a spacious living room featuring a wood-burning fireplace and built-ins. The kitchen flows into the dining room, and the vintage black-and-white bath adds timeless appeal. Hardwood floors are present in the living room, foyer, and both bedrooms. There seems to be hardwood in the dining room based on the removeal of a small peice of tile, however, we are can't say for certain. A full walk-up attic offers great expansion possibilities. All rooms have been freshly painted; radiators will be painted by list date. The basement includes a finished room of approximately 216 sq. ft., a large storage area with workbench, and a laundry room with sink and hook-ups. Additional highlights include a 3-season porch, attached 1-car garage, newer furnace, and a level yard. This estate property is being sold as-is with no disclosures-an excellent opportunity to make this sturdy, well-built home your own! More photography coming. Active date is October 15 As-Is. Estate No disclosures. Probate is all set.

Welcome to 341 Strawberry Hill Ave, where everyday living feels easy, comfortable, and full of possibility. From the moment you step inside, natural light fills the home, and the inviting layout makes you feel instantly at ease. Enjoy cooking in your updated kitchen, hosting family and friends, or relaxing in a cozy living space filled with warmth and character. This home offers peace of mind with a new roof and updated mechanicals, providing long-term comfort and efficiency. Step outside to a fenced-in yard with ample room to play, garden, and unwind - and enjoy the private patio perfect for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or quiet evenings under the stars. With plenty of parking space, everyday convenience is built right in. Perfectly located in the heart of Norwalk, close to schools, parks, beaches, Metro-North, shops, and restaurants. This home blends accessibility with the peaceful neighborhood charm everyone hopes to find. Whether you're beginning a new chapter, expanding your space, or searching for a place that feels "just right" the moment you walk in, this home is ready to welcome you. ***Highest and Best Offers by Tuesday Nov 11th 5pm***

Tall and stately, this beautiful home stands proudly at the end of a peaceful cul-de-sac. Filled with warmth, charm, and character, this residence welcomes you with a sun-filled living room featuring a cozy fireplace - perfect for relaxing or entertaining. A versatile den or home office adds both style and function to the main level. The beautifully remodeled kitchen is a chef's dream, boasting stainless steel appliances, a spacious pantry, and modern finishes. Step outside to an oversized deck overlooking the fully fenced backyard - an ideal retreat for gatherings, gardening, or playtime with your furry friends. Centrally located and a commuter's delight, this home offers easy access to the train station, shopping, and is just a short drive to scenic Calf Pasture Beach. A rare combination of comfort, convenience, and timeless appeal - ready to welcome you home.

Welcome to this fully renovated West Norwalk retreat. This 3 bedroom 3 bath has it all. Large en suite primary with 2 additional bedrooms and beautiful full bathroom on upper level.Main level has large family room with fireplace leading into fully redone kitchen.The lower finished level has many flexible options with its own full bath. This property sits on 1.15 acres of flat land.Featuring brand new Solar panels, updated electrical, brand new pool, cabana, patio, all new hardwood floors, epoxy garage floors with built in storage. This house is not to be missed.

Welcome to 6 Tulip Tree Circle in Brookfield, Connecticut, a bright and spacious single-level condominium in the desirable Stony Hill Village community. Surrounded by mature trees and open green space, this home offers a peaceful, park-like setting just minutes from Route 7, I-84, shopping, and dining.  The open layout features a comfortable living room and dining area that flow to a private deck overlooking the landscaped grounds, creating an easy space to relax or entertain. The kitchen is functional and ready for your personal touches. Two well-sized bedrooms and a full bath complete the floor plan, along with in-unit laundry, ample storage, and a one-car garage. listings.remarks: This beautifully renovated farmhouse, set on just under a half-acre, seamlessly blends timeless charm with modern updates and exceptional indoor-outdoor living.  Inside, a spacious living room showcases white oak flooring that flows effortlessly throughout. The dining area opens into an updated kitchen, complete with a large island, stainless steel appliances, and quartz countertops-perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The stunning family room is a true centerpiece, featuring vaulted ceilings and dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows that frame breathtaking sunset views. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bathroom designed for ultimate relaxation. Two additional generously sized bedrooms share a beautifully appointed hall bath. The finished lower level adds versatility, complete with a newly renovated full bathroom-ideal for a home gym, playroom, or guest/in-law suite. Outside, the fully fenced backyard provides exceptional privacy, bordered by a charming stone wall, cedar fencing, and the scenic Devils Garden Open Space. Designed with entertaining in mind, the outdoor space features a covered deck, a stone patio with a fire pit, and an irrigation system. All of this is just a short walk to the Rowayton train station, Pinkney Park, and the charming shops and dining that make Rowayton such a special place to live.

Step into effortless style and modern comfort in this stunning 2-bedroom, 1-bath ground-level condo. Designed to impress, the sleek quartz countertops with a dramatic waterfall edge set the tone for a space that feels both elevated and inviting. The modern inspired bathroom features a chic walk-in shower, offering a daily escape right at home. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living with your own private patio-perfect for morning coffee or evening unwinding. This well-maintained complex has been thoughtfully updated with new decks, roofs, and siding, and a paved parking lot delivering fresh curb appeal and lasting value. Convenience meets lifestyle with a dedicated storage unit, one reserved parking space, and plenty of visitor parking. Just minutes from premier shopping, dining, beaches, boating, and cultural attractions, this location offers the best of coastal living. With easy access to nearby train stations, your commute is as effortless as your surroundings.

Approximately 1,400 SF of modern office space on the second floor of a recently renovated building. The suite offers a bright, open layout with four glass-walled private offices, a dedicated conference room, an open work area, and a full kitchen and lounge with island seating and stainless appliances. High-end, energy-efficient windows on all exterior walls and floor-to-ceiling glass partitions throughout the suite provide abundant natural light and clear sightlines across the entire space. Additional features include polished concrete floors, high exposed ceilings with modern LED lighting, private bathroom in the adjacent hallway, and both front and rear stairwell access. Four assigned parking spaces are included at the rear of the building.  Offered at $2,700 per month on a modified gross lease. Tenant is responsible for their own utilities. Located on Main Avenue, the property offers high visibility and excellent accessibility, with close proximity to the Merritt Parkway, Route 7, restaurants, retail, and major corporate campuses. Ideal for a variety of professional office uses.

A primary bedroom features dual custom closets with built-in storage systems, an arched window and vaulted ceiling. An updated full bathroom with gray subway tile and modern vanity completes the main floor. The second bedroom with hardwood floors is privately located on the second floor. Quick access to I95 and the Merritt makes commuting effortless-NYC is just 50 miles away. The secured building includes elevators, a storage room, and a reserved carport space. A rare opportunity to enjoy the best of Fairfield County's coastal lifestyle. This is an exceptional opportunity to enjoy multi-million dollar views and amenities at a popular price point.

This unit also has a large finished basement for extra flex space in addition to overflow storage. The spacious and functional layout offers an ideal flow for everyday living and entertaining. Ideally located close to shopping, dining, and commuter routes, this is effortless living at its best!

Stunning newer-construction townhouse in desirable Silver Ledge! - Fantastic open floor plan on the main level with large kitchen, featuring granite counters, subway tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances! - Main level flows into dining area and large living room with gas fireplace! - Lots of natural light as this unit is an end unit + doesn't have a neighbor to the right side as most units do - Primary bedroom features a tray ceiling, walk-in closet, and en-suite private bath - 2 additional bedrooms and a full bathroom on 2nd level - Hardwood floors throughout the 1st and 2nd floor - BONUS finished lower level offers another family room / office / flex space + additional full bathroom! - One-car attached garage for parking & storage + additional off-street parking - Private patio through sliding door in living room! - Pull down attic stairs for storage - NEW gas furnace in Nov. 2024 + New fridge in 2025 - Located in central Norwalk with easy access to SoNo, East Norwalk, shopping, dining, and more!

Welcome to 4 Glenwood Avenue, Unit B7-where location truly does all the talking. Perfectly positioned in the heart of Norwalk, this well-situated residence offers unmatched convenience for today's on-the-go lifestyle. Commuters will appreciate the quick access to I-95, Route 7, and the South Norwalk train station, making travel to Stamford, Westchester, and New York City seamless. Enjoy being just minutes from vibrant downtown South Norwalk (SoNo), known for its top-rated restaurants, waterfront dining, nightlife, and attractions like the Maritime Aquarium. Daily errands are effortless with nearby shopping centers, grocery stores, and local boutiques all within close reach. Outdoor enthusiasts will love the proximity to Calf Pasture Beach, Veteran's Park, and scenic coastal areas-perfect for relaxing weekends or evening strolls. Whether you're heading to work, grabbing dinner, or enjoying Norwalk's waterfront lifestyle, this location delivers exceptional accessibility and convenience. If you're looking for a rental that keeps you connected to everything Norwalk has to offer, Unit B7 at 4 Glenwood Avenue is the perfect place to call home. Schedule your appointment today!

104 Comstock Hill Ave is tucked away in the Silvermine area of Norwalk. If you're looking for peace & quiet this is certainly the place for you. Right next to what used to be a strawberry farm. One of the very few homes/cabins on this estate. ALL UTILITIES ARE INCLUDED IN PRICE! Updated cabin/cottage vibe including 1 spacious bedroom, 1 full bathroom, 1 half bath, living room, dining area/office & kitchen. Interior access to basement for storage & laundry. Large private yard perfect for grilling & entertaining. Plenty of parking in the driveway/lot for visitors. High Ceilings, hardwood floors, plenty of windows & cabinets/closets for comfort. Minutes from New Canaan & South Wilton. Tenants must have good credit, proof of income & references.

Welcome to sought after Sheffield Ridge condominiums. Move right into this updated spacious two bedroom corner unit with recent update. Freshly painted, new wall to wall carpeting, kitchen with updated appliances, granite counter tops and breakfast counter.Totally move in condition. Secure parking lot with one parking space. Additional street parking. Coin operated laundry in basement. Credit report, references required. Two months security.

Well-maintained 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse offering a comfortable and functional layout. This home features a spacious living room perfect for relaxing or entertaining, along with a dedicated dining area that flows seamlessly into the kitchen. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry and the comfort of wall-unit air conditioning. The property also includes private yard space, ideal for outdoor enjoyment. Located near a variety of local amenities, including shopping centers, restaurants, parks, and public transportation, this townhouse provides both convenience and a great place to call home.

listings.remarks: Your Private Oasis Awaits: Space & Versatility at 32 Styles Lane! Discover the perfect blend of classic charm and modern scale in this expansive 3/4-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence. Tucked away in a quiet Broad River enclave, this home is designed for those who refuse to compromise on space or style. The Heart of the Home The main level invites you in with hardwood floors and a seamless flow. Gather by the wood-burning fireplace in the living room or host dinners in the sun-drenched dining area. The showstopper is the massive family room addition, boasting soaring vaulted ceilings, a cozy wood-burning stove, and a wall of windows that overlooks your private retreat. Step out onto the oversized deck and flat, level backyard-a rare find perfect to add a pool, play, or grand-scale entertaining. Flexibility for Modern Living Whether you need a quiet home office, a gym, or an in-law setup, the layout delivers. The lower levels feature a guest suite/den, laundry, and a full bath, plus an additional finished level for recreation or storage. The rare 3-car garage offers incredible ADU or professional studio potential with its own private entry. The Primary Retreat The upper level features three bright bedrooms and a full bath, leading to the stunning primary suite addition. This sanctuary offers two walk-in closets and a spa-like bath with heated marble floors. New and newer roof 2019/2025

Completely renovated in 2025, this stunning home offers a seamless blend of modern design, quality craftsmanship, and thoughtful details throughout. Situated on approximately 1.5 acres, the property provides exceptional space, privacy, and outdoor enjoyment.  Inside, the home showcases high ceilings and 6" white oak hardwood floors that create a warm and sophisticated atmosphere.  The beautifully designed kitchen is equipped with brand-new high-end appliances, including a Wolf range, Sub-Zero wine cooler, Miele coffee system, delivering both style and functionality.  The first floor includes a bedroom with its own en-suite bathroom, offering flexibility for guests, multi-generational living, or convenient main-level living.  The second floor offers a thoughtfully designed layout, highlighted by a spacious primary suite with a spa-like en-suite bathroom, walk-in closet, and private deck overlooking the heated pool, a perfect retreat to relax and unwind.  An additional bedroom features its own en-suite bathroom, while two more bedrooms share a beautifully designed full bathroom. A conveniently located laundry area completes the upper level.  Bathrooms have been meticulously designed and feature radiant heated floors, offering comfort and luxury. Additional upgrades include a durable slate roof for long-term peace of mind.

Recently updated 2-bedroom, 2-bath first floor rental just two blocks from the water, offering easy coastal living in a prime East Norwalk location. The layout includes primary bedroom en suite. You will also find a bright eat-in kitchen with plenty of room to gather, along with the convenience of in-unit washer and dryer, off-street parking and the Landlord takes care of the yard. There is plenty of extra storage in the lower level. This is a dream spot for anyone who loves the outdoors-paddleboarding, kayaking, and peaceful waterfront walks are all just steps away. You're also within walking distance to local favorites like Harbor Harvest, plus a variety of nearby restaurants and shops that give the neighborhood its relaxed, coastal vibe. Commuters will love the convenience of being just an 8-minute walk to the East Norwalk Metro-North Station, making trips into Manhattan simple and stress-free. When you're ready to unwind, you're only minutes from Calf Pasture Beach and the lively dining and nightlife scene in South Norwalk.

This very affordable quiet spacious 1 bdr unit is in the heart of historic Norwalk and close to the beach, Westport border, shops, SONO, the Merritt, I-95 and a Train Station. Wake up by the bells from the two churches built in 16th and 17th century. Relax in the park and gazebo across the building or stroll to Stew Leonard's for a cone of frozen yogurt. The condo has just been painted in crispy white, it has a brand new carpet and it's in an immaculate condition. Plenty of free parking. Make an appointment before this rare unit is gone.

Updated Home in Prime Norwalk Location! This beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath residence offers an excellent alternative to condo living, featuring thoughtfully designed living space throughout. The main level boasts an eat-in kitchen with gas range and direct access to an expansive deck-ideal for relaxing or entertaining with added privacy. A bright and sun-filled living room with hardwood floors, two generously sized bedrooms, and a full bath complete this level. The upper level includes a spacious 792 sq ft unfinished attic, perfect for storage or potential future expansion. The lower level offers a laundry area, mechanicals, and a one-car garage. Recent upgrades include central air conditioning and a gas furnace, making this home truly move-in ready. Ideally situated near shopping, dining, major highways, and train stations, this property provides convenient access to all that Norwalk has to offer. A fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers or those seeking low-maintenance living in a highly desirable location. Please schedule your private viewing before it's gone!

Welcome to 20 Linden Heights, a beautifully maintained detached single-family home in Norwalk's sought-after Linden Heights community. Set in a picturesque and beautifully landscaped setting, this inviting residence offers the perfect blend of comfort, privacy, and easy living. Inside, you'll find a spacious and airy layout with vaulted ceilings, sun-filled living spaces, and a warm, welcoming flow ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The eat-in kitchen opens to a large private deck, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor connection and a perfect place to relax, host guests, or take in the home's wonderful sunset views. The great room with a fireplace adds warmth and charm, while the finished walk-out lower level offers versatile space for a playroom, media room, home office, gym, or guest area. The spacious primary suite provides a peaceful retreat, and the home's thoughtful layout offers flexibility for today's lifestyle. Complete with a two-car attached garage, manicured landscaping, and the benefits of community maintenance, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy a detached home in one of Norwalk's most desirable residential enclaves. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, parks, and major transportation routes, 20 Linden Heights offers an exceptional combination of serenity, convenience, and neighborhood appeal.

Amazing Location | Turnkey Updates | Sun-Drenched Living! Welcome to this beautifully updated, light-filled ranch set on over half an acre in Norwalk's desirable Cranbury section, bordering Westport. Freshly painted inside and out, this move-in-ready home blends classic charm with thoughtful modern upgrades.   The spacious, flexible layout features 3 bedrooms plus a versatile additional room-perfect for a home office, gym, nursery, or guest space-and 2 full baths, including a newly renovated primary bath. The brand-new kitchen shines with modern finishes (Samsung Bespoke appliances & hand-made porcelain tiles from Spain as backsplash) and functionality, while newly refinished hardwood floors add warmth and continuity throughout. At the heart of the home, a bright living room with exposed beams and a wood-burning fireplace creates an inviting atmosphere. Additional living spaces include a dining room, family room, and an eat-in kitchen with a walk-in pantry-ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.    The primary suite offers a private retreat with an en suite bath with walk in shower and an adjacent room with its own entrance-perfect for today's flexible lifestyle needs. Two additional bedrooms and a full bath are thoughtfully situated for added privacy.  Brand new washer/dryer.

listings.remarks: Tucked away in a quiet Norwalk setting, this bright and inviting apartment blends comfort with thoughtful updates and an easy, livable layout. Step into a sun filled living room where vaulted ceilings and warm hardwood floors create an open, airy feel that instantly feels like home. The flow continues into a spacious eat in kitchen, complete with tile flooring, ample cabinetry, gas range, dishwasher, and all the essentials for everyday living and entertaining. Just beyond, a dedicated dining area offers the perfect spot for casual meals or hosting guests. Both bedrooms are nicely sized with hardwood flooring and great natural light, while the full bath features clean finishes and a whirlpool tub with shower. Central air keeps things comfortable year round, and the convenience of in unit washer and dryer adds to the ease of living. Off street parking is included, along with a peaceful back patio and yard, and tucked away setting that still keeps you close to shopping, dining, and major routes. Available for immediate occupancy, this well maintained rental offers a balanced mix of space, function, and location. Agent/Owner

INCREDIBLE waterfront 2-family in the heart of East Norwalk! Soak in breathtaking water views from your sizable backyard, two outdoor decks, covered patio, and from all three floors inside the home! - The first floor features a welcoming living room, two spacious bedrooms, and an updated bathroom. The large eat-in kitchen leads directly to a gorgeous sun room with a propane wood stove for year-round usage, and sliders out to the deck overlooking Mill Pond - The finished basement is completely updated, with its own stainless steel refrigerator, tile floors, a separate heating zone, recessed lighting, and a remodeled bathroom - The second floor unit is the sunniest of all, with two skylights, updated vinyl floors, two additional bedrooms, and outdoor access via the eat-in kitchen - The property's two asphalt driveways provide plenty of parking, and the garage offers additional storage. You simply cannot beat the location: walkable to the East Norwalk train station, Vet's Park, and several amazing local restaurants, plus just a few minutes by car to Calf Pasture beach and I-95! A prime location combined with excellent cash flow! Schedule your showing before this unique gem is snatched up! Possible 3-family with the basement as a separate unit - buyer to do their due diligence!

Welcome to 46 Ponus Avenue, a charming home in the heart of Norwalk offering great potential and flexibility. This property features bright living spaces, a functional layout, and comfortable bedrooms suited for everyday living. While the home may benefit from some updates, it is ready for occupancy and presents an excellent opportunity to make it your own or invest.  The lower level includes an extra room, perfect for a home office, guest space, or additional living area. Outside, enjoy a nice-sized backyard ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, and major highways, this property offers both value and location.  A great opportunity for homeowners or investors alike-don't miss it! Property is being sold As-Is.

MULTIPLE OFFERS: HIGHEST AND BEST TUESDAY 5/5 AT 5PM Welcome to 103 Ponus Ave, a move-in ready hi-ranch nestled in the highly desirable West Norwalk neighborhood. Offering 2,702 square feet of living space on nearly half an acre, this home combines comfort, flexibility, and a beautifully private, fully fenced backyard.  The main level features a sun-filled layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. A spacious family room with soaring ceilings creates an inviting place to relax and flows seamlessly into the dining area. The adjoining sunroom bathes the space in natural light and offers versatile use, complete with a new washer and dryer and direct access to the back deck overlooking the serene yard.  Down the hall, you'll find three generously sized bedrooms and two updated bathrooms, including a sought-after primary en-suite.  The lower level adds exceptional flexibility, currently configured as a spacious accessory-style living area with its own full bath, washer/dryer, kitchenette, and expansive living space-perfect for guests, extended family, or movie nights with the built-in projector setup.

Updated 3 bedroom townhouse in Nor-West!! - Stunning kitchen with white shaker-style cabinets, quartz counters, subway tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances!! - Kitchen also features custom filtered-water & instant-hot water faucet! - Light and bright unit with hardwood floors throughout! - Very unique and rarely available townhouse layout offers direct / private entry into the unit (no shared hallways) - Spacious living room features recessed lighting and sliding door out to private patio space! - Updated first floor bathroom with distressed shiplap feature wall - 2nd floor features primary bedroom with updated en-suite bathroom & walk-in closet! - 2 additional bedrooms, and another updated bathroom featuring subway tile walls - Private washer / dryer in unit - Pull down attic stairs for great storage + additional storage locker in the complex - *HOA fee includes heat & hot water!* - Short walk to the beautiful association pool + clubhouse! - Park-like setting with large, central grass courtyard - All located on the Westport border, and convenient to shopping, dining, and all that Norwalk and Westport have to offer! - Reserved parking spaces just outside the unit (234 & 235), 3rd parking space can be rented for $20 / month

listings.remarks: HIGHEST & BEST DEADLINE WEDNESDAY APRIL 29 AT 10 AM.  This original 1930 residence lives like a private SF home while offering the ease of a condominium association. It stands apart with a rare combination of history, character, and exceptional privacy. Thoughtfully integrated into the landscape, surrounded by mature perennial gardens, the home reveals itself through winding stone staircases and curated approach points. Inside, a soaring vaulted living room is anchored by a striking stone fireplace, showcasing the quality craftsmanship and artistry of an earlier era. The space is both dramatic and inviting, offering warmth, texture, and architectural presence. A defining feature of the home is its unique interior layout, designed with a clear separation between living and private spaces. A light-filled hallway with oversized windows leads to the bedroom wing-down to secondary bedrooms or upward to a private primary suite. The primary suite is set apart for privacy and features a vaulted ceiling and a full bathroom: an elevated retreat within the home. The additional 3 bedrooms offer separation/flexibility for guests, home office space, or extended living needs. The interior has been renovated to meet highest of expectations, including updated kitchen, bathrooms, finished walk-out lower level, and HVAC systems.

listings.remarks: Welcome to 100 Winfield Street, a charming Cape Cod-style home in the highly coveted East Norwalk area, ideally located near the Westport line and close to top local amenities.  This home offers a rare layout for a Cape, featuring three bedrooms on the upper level-a setup that lives more like a Colonial and is ideal for those who prefer all bedrooms together. With two full bathrooms, one upstairs and one on the main level, the home offers comfort and convenience. Fueled by natural gas, the property provides efficient heating for New England winters. The location is a standout. Enjoy a 10-minute walk to the East Norwalk train station for an easy NYC commute. You are just 7 minutes to Calf Pasture Beach and 6 minutes to Taylor Farm Dog Park. Washington Street in SoNo, known for dining and nightlife, is also 6 minutes away. Everything you need is within a 10 minutes. Located in C zoning, the property may offer potential for conversion to a legal two-family, subject to approvals. A compelling opportunity in one of Norwalk's most convenient neighborhoods.

Beautifully maintained raised ranch featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths. Enjoy a remodeled kitchen and updated bathrooms, along with a newer roof and siding offering peace of mind. The home boasts a finished basement with a classic old-fashioned bar-perfect for entertaining or relaxing evenings. Step out to the enclosed porch or the expansive deck overlooking a fenced, level yard, great for gatherings, pets, or play. Add a shed for additional storage. Situated on a level lot in a prime location with easy access to major highways, railroad stations, shopping, and restaurants. Move-in ready and full of charm! Waiting for your personal finishing touches!

Located in the heart of Norwalk, CT, The Curb combines community, nature, and forward momentum in an urban environment. Our pet-friendly luxury apartments boast impeccable modern layouts with new stainless-steel appliances, including a walk-in shower, in-unit full-size washer and dryer, wood-finish plank flooring, and oversized windows, and high ceilings. The Curb offers numerous amenities that act as an extension of your home and help you add variety and quality to your day-to-day life. Take in a breath of fresh air with any of the numerous courtyards and outdoor spaces available, which include fire pits, grilling stations, a pool, and resort-style outdoor lounges. Enjoy games and entertainment in The Club Room, which includes a kitchen, perfect for entertaining. Recharge at the state-of-the-art Fitness Center or give man's best friend the attention they deserve at our onsite dog park. In addition to offering loads of amenities, there are year-round events perfect for socializing and getting to know your neighbors. The Curb has easy access to major transit, fine dining, entertainment, and retail.

listings.remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST by 12 noon Tuesday! Perfectly situated on the Darien and New Canaan borders, this home is nestled within a highly sought-after neighborhood known for its mature trees, established landscaping, and strong property values-offering both charm and exceptional value. Set on a picturesque, level half-acre on a quiet dead end street, the property is ideal for outdoor living, entertaining, or simply enjoying the peaceful setting.  Inside, the home features a light-filled interior with hardwood floors throughout, complemented by updated kitchen and baths -including one in the primary suite - and a clean, modern aesthetic. A sun-drenched sunroom overlooks the private, beautifully landscaped backyard-creating a perfect space to relax and enjoy year-round.  Designed with flexibility in mind, the home offers a spacious family room and a full lower level (including the sunroom, it is an additional approx. 1000 SQ ft of usable space), providing ample room for living, working, or recreation. Major system updates add peace of mind, including a whole-house Generac generator, Weil-McLain furnace, Andersen windows, and Connecticut Basement waterproofing system.  Conveniently located just minutes to train stations, major highways, shopping, dining, and recreation-this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and timeless appeal.

facts.laundryLoc: off of bonus room lower level

listings.remarks: Beautifully renovated and move-in ready, this charming 3 bedroom, 2.5-bath home is tucked away at the end of a quiet street in the heart of vibrant South Norwalk, offering added privacy and minimal through traffic.  Updated in 2024, the home combines modern comfort with timeless charm and features hardwood floors, central air, an updated kitchen with newer appliances, and a bright, welcoming layout throughout. The main level offers a spacious primary bedroom with a full en-suite bath, along with a convenient half bath for guests.  Upstairs, you'll find two additional bedrooms and a full bath. The finished lower level adds valuable space perfect for a home office, gym, playroom, media room, or cozy recreation area, plus laundry hookups and additional storage. While the lower level features lower ceiling height, it offers great versatility and functionality for everyday use and includes a separate walk-out entrance providing direct access to the backyard. Enjoy being just minutes from South Norwalk's restaurants, shopping, waterfront, Metro-North train station, and I-95, making commuting and daily living easy and convenient. Additional highlights include an in-ground sprinkler system and invisible electric pet fence. The corner lot may offer potential for a future garage with access from either Avenue A or Couch Street, subject to verification and municipal approvals.

listings.remarks: Great 1 bedroom with new quartz counters! - Updated kitchen & bathroom with newer vanity & tile shower - Light & bright laundry room - Off/street parking for 1 car (additional parking available on side street) - No pets!

This well-loved 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath Cape Cod offers a fantastic blend of cozy living and flexible space. The main level features two comfortable bedrooms, along with a generously sized living room anchored by a fireplace, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. An eat-in kitchen provides a functional layout for everyday living, while the sunporch adds a bright, relaxing space to enjoy year-round.  Upstairs, you'll find two additional finished rooms that offer great potential for extra bedrooms, a home office, or creative space-tailor them to fit your needs. Hardwood floors lie beneath the carpeting on the main level, just waiting to be revealed and restored.  The partially finished basement expands your living options even further, complete with a second fireplace-perfect for a recreation room, media space, or home gym. A dedicated laundry room in the basement adds convenience and practicality.  Step outside to a private, fenced-in backyard with plenty of room for entertaining, gardening, or simply enjoying the outdoors in peace.  Ideally situated for commuters, this home provides quick access to the Merritt Parkway, I-95, and nearby train service, making daily travel a breeze.  A great opportunity to personalize a home with solid bones in a highly convenient location-come see the possibilities!

Bright 1 Br Unit on 2nd floor, freshly painted, new carpets, recently renovated bathroom/kitchen. Quiet and still close to everything. Good size rooms, walk to train, easy on easy off 95. Minutes to waterfront restaurants, beach, all major shopping.

Welcome to the "Eastview" - a sophisticated, stylish, and completely move-in ready condo in the much sought-after Eastview Condominium complex. This unit offers modern living with exceptional convenience. Enter through your private entrance or directly from your attached garage into a bright, beautifully updated space that lives far larger than its footprint. The refreshed kitchen features sleek quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a clean contemporary design perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The spa-inspired full bath has been thoughtfully renovated with a stunning walk-in shower, modern finishes, and elevated fixtures. Central air conditioning and heat provide year-round comfort, while in-unit laundry adds effortless functionality. Sliders open to a private outdoor deck, creating the perfect extension of living space. Eastview is a well-managed, intimate complex known for its low common charges and prime location-just minutes to SONO, Norwalk Hospital, and all major commuting routes. Turnkey, modern, and ideally located-this is Norwalk condo living at its best.

A very special home and location! This warm and charming expanded 3 bedroom - 2 bath split level on .57 acre has been updated and designed for large families, indoor/outdoor entertaining, and/or working from home. Incredible flexibility including a possible In-law apartment conversion located on the main floor. With a blend of classic design and open floor plan this home is an ideal haven for creating lasting memories and enjoying family. The Main floor includes the oversized dining room, living room, full bath, and family room with a central fireplace creating a welcoming atmosphere. From the dining room is an expanded/updated country kitchen with light oak custom cabinetry and travertine tile backsplash. A few steps away is the enclosed porch and large deck overlooking a beautiful, private backyard for family gatherings. Just off the kitchen is the lower family room and office with laundry and attached garage. The upper floor creates privacy with full bath and 3 bedrooms including the primary bedroom all with hardwood floors. Additional features attached garage. Minutes to East Norwalk Train/Metro North, I-95, Merritt Parkway, shopping/dining and seconds from track/field at All Saints School and West Rocks Middle School.

listings.remarks: "This Old House", built in 1900, has been transformed to a very inviting almost new home which has been painted throughout, the floors beautifully refinished, a new gas furnace and central air, stainless steel kitchen counters, new stove, dishwasher and great microwave. There are two skylights on the first and second floors; with the abundance of windows, this is a very happy sunny home. The landscaped yard is lovely, and the new crushed stone driveway will be the perfect place to park your cars. It is located only steps to the kitchen entrance! The first and second floors each have a full bath with tubs and showers.The basement is not heated, but could be an exercise room, playroom part of the year, workshop or for storage. It can not be used as a bedroom. GARAGE NOT INCLUDED

listings.remarks: Wonderful one bedroom unit in Sutton Place complex in sought after Wolfpit area. Walking friendly to shopping, restaurants and transportation. Great opportunity both for investors or first time homeowners. Features sunny living room, dining area, and one bedroom. Remodeled kitchen and bathroom is in the remodeling process with newly painted cabinets, new countertops, new flooring and tile backsplash. Remodeling should be finished approximately in 10 days. Heat, hot water and cooking gas is included in the common charges. wall to wall carpeting in Living room and bedroom. Complex has on site coin operated laundry. Wall unit air-conditioning.

listings.remarks: Coveted East Norwalk location on Dead End street, 4 houses from the water with some waterviews. Completely renovated, brand new kitchen, brand new bathroom. High end finishes. Hardwood floors sanded and refinished. Spacious 3 Bedroom with hardwood floors throughout. Full unfinished basement provides for plenty of storage and additional space. Good sized back deck off the kitchen for indoor/outdoor entertainment. Waterviews from the back deck. Enjoy walking to the beach, to ludlow park, to the local waterfront restaurants and ice cream places. Benefit from quiet, walkable, luxurious, convenient East Norwalk Living.

PLEASE NOTE: HIGHEST AND BEST BY MONDAY. MAY 4th BY 3:00 pm.  Beautiful refreshed and move in ready. This 2 bedroom, 2 full bathroom condo offers a bright, welcoming and spacious interior for easy living. Every wall has been freshly painted and brand new carpet has been installed throughout the entire second level and loft area. The living room and dining area have warm hardwood floors, a cozy fireplace and a sliding door leading out to a private deck overlooking a peaceful river setting. The perfect place to unwind in the evening. Upstairs, you will find two generously sized bedrooms, both featuring vaulted ceilings. The primary suite has two closets and a private full bath, along with access to it's own private balcony. The second bedroom has a walk in closet. A spiral staircase leads to a versatile loft space, perfect for a home office, creative studio or just a fun space to hang out. The attached garage has a new garage door and additional storage space. This is all minutes away from both 95 and the Merritt Parkway making it convenient for your commute.

Welcome to 30 Marlborough Road, a 4-bedroom, 3-bath Colonial set on a cul-de-sac in Wolfpit, offering 1,974 square feet on over half an acre. Enter through the central foyer, which flows into the heart of the home: a living room with vaulted ceilings, a fireplace, and large windows. The family room and dining room sit adjacent to the spacious eat-in-kitchen, creating a relaxed, everyday living space, while a convenient laundry room keeps chores tucked away. The first floor also features a private bedroom with an attached, fully updated full bath, ideal for guests or multi-generational living and a large den with a slider to the back patio. Upstairs, the primary suite spans the home and includes two closets and a private bath with a whirlpool tub and separate shower. Two additional bedrooms share a full bath with a tub/shower combination. The basement provides ample utility and storage space. Outside, the generous 0.52-acre lot offers room to roam, and the attached two-car garage adds convenience. Built in 1963, this home combines classic Colonial charm with functional living spaces. Located in a desirable neighborhood, all the amenities of Westport Avenue are within reach, including Stew's, the movie theater, and more. I-95 and the Merritt Parkway are equidistant, and downtown Westport is just minutes away. Everything you need comes together in this exceptional offering in a sought-after location.

This one checks all the boxes! This 1 bed 1 bath Town house style home features updated kitchen and bathroom, hard wood floors throughout, built in air conditioners, ample closet space, and a full private basement with in unit laundry, and TONS of storage. Use lower level as work out room, office, storage, let your imagination go wild! Close to Merritt Parkway, Route 7, and train stations.

Spacious First-Floor 2-Bedroom Apartment for Rent. Welcome to this updated first-floor apartment offering comfort, convenience, and ample space. This well-maintained unit features 2 generously sized bedrooms and 1 full bathroom. The apartment has been recently updated and includes brand-new appliances. Enjoy the ease of first-floor access along with an abundance of storage space throughout the unit. Conveniently located with easy access to local amenities, shopping, and transportation.

Rooftop Rear Deck (off Kitchen) with waterview of Mill Pond in East Norwalk! Enjoy the Summer breezes as you dine and relax outside. Walk to East Norwalk train station, Vets Park and SoNo in just a few minutes, get to Calf Pasture Beach, Shady Beach picnic area, Taylor Farm Park, Norwalk Cove Marina, Shorehaven Golf Club (and much more) in a 5-10 minute drive. Great new look; just freshly painted. Unit is in good condition - has good amount of natural light - full-size washer and dryer in unit - good storage space - Gas heat and cooking - 2 off-street parking spaces. No pets/no smoking......While you're viewing #3, also take a look at unit #1 - directly below. Unit #1 is on 1st floor and has no steps if you enter from the front, street-side door.

listings.remarks: Welcome to Wolfpit II condo's, unit number 1B! This three story condo offers a functional layout perfect for today's living. The main level features a kitchen upgraded with manufactured stone countertops, lots of cabinetry, matching stove, refrigerator and dishwasher, large living room, dining area and half bath. There is a combination of hardwood and carpeted floors. Upstairs are two good sized bedrooms with lots of closet space. There second floor also has a shared full bath. The basement has a large finished area that gives you extra room. The laundry is also in the full basement for your convenience. There is additional storage space next to the rec room. There are two parking spaces #5 and #11. Mechanical updates include a water heater that is 6 months old and central air that is about 5 years old. Close to shopping, transportation and highways. Come check it out today!

Rare opportunity to rent a beautiful 1-bedroom apartment in the highly desirable Silvermine area. Located above the garage with a private entrance, this unit offers great privacy and abundant natural light. Open-concept layout with hardwood flooring, spacious living area, and a well-appointed kitchen featuring granite countertops, nice cabinetry, and recessed lighting. Private parking and in-unit laundry included. A bright, comfortable space in a prime location.

Set in the coveted Harbor Shores community, 33 Naromake Avenue offers a rare blend of refined design and true, direct waterfront living. Fully updated with a clean, open floor plan, this home has been thoughtfully reimagined with high-end finishes throughout, creating a space that feels both elevated and effortless.  The main level is designed for how you actually live-light-filled, connected, and centered around the water. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the living and dining areas, all oriented to capture sweeping views across the water toward Harborview Island. Just beyond, step outside and you're instantly immersed in the setting-launch kayaks or paddleboards right from your backyard and take full advantage of this unique, accessible shoreline.  A first-floor primary suite offers comfort and convenience, complete with a beautifully updated en-suite bath. Upstairs, a second bedroom with its own renovated bath provides an ideal space for guests, family, or a private retreat.  For those who enjoy boating, private dock rights are available, while multiple nearby marinas offer additional flexibility-making it easy to pick up and drop off guests directly from your own backyard. A detached two-car garage provides ample room for storage, gear, and all the extras that come with an active coastal lifestyle. Zoned for award winning Rowayton Elementary School.This is more than a home-it's a lifestyle defined by water, light, and effortless living.
