listings.remarks: Location, lifestyle, and a touch of timeless charm - welcome to one of East Norwalk's most coveted addresses.  Perfectly positioned just over the Norwalk River drawbridge, this gem offers the best of convenient maritime living with a full sense of tranquility. Tucked away on a quiet street without the hustle, bustle, or parking headaches, you'll find this impeccably restored Queen Anne Victorian oozing with character and coastal charm. Stroll to vibrant restaurants, Veterans Memorial Park, Norwalk Marina, SONO, and the East Norwalk Metro North Station - all within minutes.  This sun-filled, freshly renovated one-bedroom apartment features a sleek modern kitchen with quartz counters and stainless appliances, a stylishly updated bath, soaring 9-foot ceilings, huge windows, and chic finishes.  Relax on the gracious wraparound porch overlooking Norwalk Harbor, surrounded by lush seasonal plantings and rocking chairs - the perfect setting for morning coffee or evening cocktails and wine.  East Norwalk's vibrant boating community, walkability, and waterfront lifestyle await - and opportunities like this rarely come along.

Nestled near the coveted New Canaan/Darien border in West Norwalk, "Sanctuary West" delivers the perfect blend of space, functionality and serene natural surroundings. Thoughtfully renovated and impeccably maintained, this home features over 2,500 square feet of finished living space designed for both everyday comfort and effortless entertaining. The heart of the home is the stunning white kitchen, renovated with timeless style and equipped with stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, and an inviting layout that seamlessly connects to the main living areas. Hardwood floors run throughout the home, while oversized windows fill the space with natural light. A highly versatile floor plan includes a main level bedroom with private full bath; ideal for guests, in-laws or au pair accommodations. Upstairs, you'll find three additional bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite complete with dual walk-in closets and a large bathroom. The finished lower level offers exceptional bonus space perfect for a media room, playroom, gym or home office. Step outside to experience your own private retreat. An elevated deck overlooks beautifully landscaped grounds accented by mature gardens, a charming footbridge, and a peaceful babbling brook that winds through the wooded backyard - creating a setting that feels worlds away while remaining close to everything. A newly installed stone patio with firepit gives you another outdoor entertaining dimension.

Welcome to 10 Elliott Street, where classic 1924 Colonial charm meets the ease of coastal living in Norwalk's coveted Marvin Beach neighborhood. Just moments from the water, this home invites a lifestyle defined by morning walks along the shoreline and relaxed afternoons at home. Thoughtfully and meticulously maintained by the same owner for over 53 years, it offers a rare sense of care and continuity. The inviting exterior, warm interior spaces, and overall condition reflect true pride of ownership. Move right in and enjoy, or personalize over time-either way, this is an opportunity to become part of a close-knit waterfront community known for its charm and convenience.

Beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath condominium located in the heart of Norwalk. This move-in ready unit features a brand-new kitchen with updated cabinetry, appliances, modern finishes, and spacious living/dining areas filled with natural light. Additional upgrades include new laminate flooring throughout, renovated bathrooms, and fresh contemporary touches that make this home feel like new. Conveniently located close to shopping, restaurants, major highways, Metro-North train stations, and all that Norwalk has to offer. Ideal opportunity for owner-occupants or investors seeking a turnkey property in a desirable location. HOA includes grounds maintenance and common area upkeep. A must-see unit offering comfort, convenience, and value.

Best & Final Offers due by 12 noon, Monday June 1st.Tucked away in the heart of sought-after Silvermine, this beautifully updated ranch w/NEW ROOF offers the ease of one-level living w/ the feel of a private retreat. Surrounded by mature trees, lush lawns, curated planting beds, & a sparkling inground pool, the property invites you to slow down, unwind, & enjoy every season at home. Inside, sun-filled spaces and an effortless open layout create a warm, welcoming atmosphere designed for both everyday comfort & entertaining. The eat-in kitchen features NEW Stainless Appliances & a generous dining space w/sliders leading to the deck for easy indoor-outdoor living. Stylish formal living & dining areas pay homage to the home's mid-century roots w/distinctive 1960s-inspired details, including a striking stone veneer fireplace wall & architectural metal railing room dividers. The private bedroom wing offers a serene primary suite with a beautifully renovated bath, along w/2 additional spacious bedrooms & an equally stylish updated hall bath. Downstairs, more than 600SF of finished space provides endless flexibility plus 2000SF unfinished of space. An oversized 2 car garage adds exceptional convenience, while a third full bath off the side entrance is perfectly positioned for poolside guests. Benefit from lower utility costs w/energy-saving solar panels. Host summer gatherings, enjoy quiet mornings by the pool, or simply embracing the beauty of Silvermine living.

listings.remarks: Modern living meets historic charm in this NYC Style Loft Rental unit with 20-foot ceilings, expansive 2 story windows, rustic wood beams and exposed brick. This updated unit features gleaming hardwood flooring throughout, an open-concept kitchen with white marble counters & stainless-steel appliances (2025 dishwasher & microwave). The half-bath is conveniently located on the main level, while the private bedroom suite upstairs offers a newly renovated bathroom (2025) and walk in closet. Residents enjoy access to reserved parking, a fitness center, sauna, a community room, game lounge, conference room, and an inviting outdoor landscaped courtyard. A laundry room is conveniently located on each floor. Minutes from downtown South Norwalk, the Sono Mall, trending restaurants, Norwalk beaches, and easy access to the train station, I-95, and the Merritt Parkway.

In Norwalk's Spring Hill neighborhood, A truly unique and well maintained legal two-family property offering space, flexibility, and incredible potential. Property features include a 2022 roof and hardwood floors throughout, including under the carpeting in two rooms. The main living area offers a primary en suite and 1,638 sq. ft. on the first floor. The finished lower level adds 840 sq. ft. with a half bath and kitchenette area, offering additional usable space and flexibility. The upper level features a legal 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment with its own private entrance. Solid, spacious property, and full of possibilities! Being sold in as-is condition.

LIGHT & BRIGHT 2 BEDROOM / 1.5 BATH TOWNHOUSE W/ HARDWOOD FLOORS! - UPDATED KITCHEN WITH STAINLESS STEEL APPLIANCES - NEWER BATHROOM WITH SUBWAY TILE SHOWER - GOOD CLOSET SPACE - FULL BASEMENT FOR STORAGE - WASHER/DRYER IN UNIT - EASY ACCESS TO BOTH I-95 & MERRITT PKWY - OFF STREET PARKING - NO PETS!!

Charming and move-in ready, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial offers 1,560 sq. ft. of comfortable living in a highly convenient Norwalk location. Classic curb appeal welcomes you with a covered front porch, manicured landscaping, mature shrubs, and a flagstone walkway leading to the entry. Step inside to find hardwood floors throughout and a bright, sun-filled front sunroom that adds wonderful extra living space and natural light. The main level features a spacious living room, formal dining room, and a cozy family room anchored by a working fireplace, along with a convenient half bath. Upstairs, the primary bedroom offers vaulted ceilings, a ceiling fan, and a private full bath, while two additional well-sized bedrooms share a second full bath. The full basement includes a utility sink and walkout access to the backyard, providing excellent storage and flexible use. Additional highlights include leafless gutters, a private driveway, a detached garage, and a picket-fenced side yard. Major recent updates bring peace of mind, including a new roof (2024) and new water heater (2024). Ideally situated near Norwalk Hospital with quick access to Metro-North, I-95, and the Merritt Parkway, making commuting throughout Fairfield County and into NYC simple. Shopping, dining, and everyday conveniences are just steps away, with The SoNo Collection only minutes from your door. A wonderful opportunity to own a well-maintained Colonial in one of Norwalk's most accessible pockets.

Welcome to the desirable Birches condo complex! This light-filled and spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath corner unit features a primary bedroom suite with its own private bath, plus an additional full hall bath. This move-in-ready, first-floor condo offers an open layout with hardwood floors throughout, a gourmet kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, and a large island perfect for entertaining. Sliders lead to an expansive private patio and garden area, offering great indoor-outdoor living. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, central air, a security system, elevator access, private storage space, and an underground garage with 2 parking spaces. Pet friendly (2 pets per unit allowed, 50lbs or under). Conveniently located just minutes to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, shopping, restaurants, parks, and public transportation-ideal for commuters!

1 bedroom/1 bathroom unit with a kitchenette (no full kitchen). Open living area with kitchenette, leading to a private bedroom with an en-suite bathroom. Gas heating in the unit. Includes 1 off-street parking space during non-business hours. No laundry facilities on-site, but a laundromat is located nearby. Renter responsible for all utilities: gas, electric, internet, etc. Easy commuting with entrance to I-95, Route 7, and Merritt Parkway just minutes away.

Move-in-ready, fully renovated 4-bedroom rental featuring a bright, open floor plan and a brand-new granite kitchen with a center island. The home offers living space, including a finished lower level with a private entrance, 2-bedrooms, full bath, and family room. Highlights include central air, gas cooking, a detached garage, and a deep, level fenced-in yard. Perfectly located near Route 7, I-95, and local shopping. Available for immediate occupancy. Easy to show.

The spacious living room offers a cozy fireplace and oversized windows, while the generously sized bedrooms and updated bathrooms provide comfort and flexibility for everyday living. Additional space offers the perfect setup for a home office, playroom, or guest accommodations. Outside, enjoy a large level backyard and patio ideal for entertaining, outdoor dining, or relaxing summer evenings, all surrounded by mature landscaping and excellent curb appeal. Conveniently located just minutes from Metro North, beaches, parks, restaurants, shopping, and major highways, this East Norwalk home combines neighborhood charm with exceptional commuter convenience. Sale is contingent upon sellers finding suitable housing

Beautifully appointed, newer townhouse in convenient East Norwalk location. Minutes to train, shops, restaurants, Calf Pasture Beach, Norwalk Aquarium and parks. This 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home features an open-concept floor plan with high ceilings, hardwood floors, crown molding, recessed lighting, and premium finishes throughout. The sun-filled kitchen showcases Carrara marble countertops, stainless steel appliances, a large center island with seating area, and seamlessly flows into the dining and living areas. The living room features a beautiful gas fireplace and sliders out to a bluestone patio and fenced yard, ideal for al fresco dining and entertaining.  Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features a tray ceiling, walk-in closet, and luxurious bath with double vanity and oversized shower. Two additional bedrooms, full bath, and laundry complete the second floor.   The finished lower level provides flexible space ideal for a family room/playroom, home office, gym, or media room, plus a large enclosed storage area.  Boutique 4-unit association. Attached garage plus additional private parking. Move-in ready coastal living at its best.

Tucked away on a picturesque cul-de-sac in trending East Norwalk, this charming 1939 Colonial offers the kind of warmth, character, and neighborhood feel that instantly feels like home. Surrounded by equally quaint residences and tree-lined streets, the setting is peaceful, welcoming, and wonderfully connected to everything East Norwalk has to offer. Inside and out, the home is filled with timeless charm and everyday comfort, creating an easy, inviting lifestyle that's becoming harder and harder to find. Centrally located yet tucked into a quiet neighborhood setting, this is the perfect blend of convenience, community, and classic New England appeal. Minutes to shops, restaurants, beaches, healthcare facilities, train and cultural attractions.

listings.remarks: Nestled in one of West Norwalk's most desirable neighborhoods, this spacious split-level home offers the perfect blend of comfort, flexibility, and privacy. Featuring 5 bedrooms and 4 full baths, including a separate 2-bedroom in-law apartment with its own private entrance, this home is ideal for extended family or multi-generational living. Filled with natural sunlight, the home offers hardwood floors throughout, crown molding, and a welcoming living room with fireplace. The updated kitchen features quartz countertops, center island, and stainless steel appliances. Enjoy the enclosed porch, covered deck, and an oasis-like backyard with plenty of space for entertaining and relaxing in privacy. The main home includes central air, while the in-law apartment features its own split-system heating/cooling. A rare opportunity in sought-after West Norwalk with space, versatility, and charm.

listings.remarks: Withdrawn until July 1, upon vacancy of the current tenant. Welcome to this charming halfduplex townhouse in a prime Norwalk location. Lovingly maintained, this home offers 3 bedrooms, 1.5 baths, a finished basement, and numerous updates including a new roof (2026) and a newer deck. The first floor features a bright living room with hardwood floors, a dining room with parquet hardwood, a convenient half bath, and a kitchen that opens to a spacious deck-perfect for entertaining. All three bedrooms are located on the second floor, each with beautiful hardwood flooring. The finished basement includes a large closet, laundry area, and walkout access to a quiet patio area. Located close to shopping, dining, schools, and major highways, this home offers both comfort and convenience. The property is part of an HOA with no monthly fee; bylaws are in place, and exterior expenses along with the master insurance policy are shared. A wonderful opportunity-don't miss it.

Welcome to 8 Roland Avenue in Marvin Beach. This Impeccably maintained home welcomes you as soon you step on the inviting front porch. 1927 colonial offers a foyer, living room with fireplace, office, a large eat-in-kitchen for entertaining and a full bath complete the first floor. Three bedrooms, Primary with vaulted ceiling and a full bath on the second level. Full basement for extra living space and storage. Fenced in yard with party barn and bluestone patio for outside gatherings lush with perennials. Costal living with association offering holiday parties and neighborhood get togethers. Three beaches to watch sunsets or kayak from also boat slips available. No flood insurance needed.

Welcome home to this charming Cape nestled in one of Norwalk's most convenient locations, where classic Connecticut character meets modern updates and everyday comfort. This beautifully maintained 4-bedroom,3 full bath home offers flexible living space, stylish finishes, & the warm, inviting feel New England buyers are sure to love. Step inside to discover hardwood floors flowing throughout most of the main level, where 2 spacious bedrooms and an updated full bath provide easy one-level living. The remodeled eat in kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring modern cabinetry, elegant quartz countertops, & stainless-steel appliances - perfectly designed for both everyday living & entertaining alike. This custom designed kitchen opens to both a dining area & spacious living room offering room for everyone and a versatile bonus room complete with its own full bath and large closet, ideal as a private home office, guest suite, or 4th bedroom. Upstairs, retreat to the serene primary suite showcasing a beautifully updated full bath with porcelain finishes and a sleek stand-alone shower, creating the perfect private escape at the end of the day. The finished lower level adds even more functional living space with a cozy family room, additional office or flex space, plus ample storage and laundry area. You are sure to appreciate the efficient and cost saving natural gas heat along with city water and sewer!

This storybook cape with front porch is set on nearly one third of an acre and is conveniently located to everything! Shopping, schools, restaurants, gyms, train, highway, library and hospital. Main floor offers a large living room with wood burning fireplace, dining room, kitchen and updated full bath. Hardwood floors and newer windows throughout. The expanded second floor provides three bedrooms with wide plank wood flooring and a remodeled full bath. There is a walk up attic for easy access to an abundance of storage. The finished basement offers a tremendous amount of additional living space. In addtion to great curb appeal the exterior has a large yard with dog fence, a back porch, shed, garage and a 7 year old roof. The 200 amp electrical service can support any future home upgrades.

This move-in-ready home combines style, comfort, and exceptional indoor-outdoor living in one of Norwalk's most convenient locations. From its inviting curb appeal to its thoughtfully designed updates, the property is ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Inside, the updated kitchen, hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, and wood-burning fireplace create a warm and polished atmosphere throughout the main level. Featuring 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 full baths, the home offers a functional layout with flexibility and comfort for a variety of lifestyles. The dining area flows seamlessly onto an elevated deck, providing the perfect setting for relaxing or hosting guests. Beneath the deck, a finished storage area with barn-door access offers practical space for tools, equipment, and easy backyard maintenance. An attached garage leads directly into the finished lower level, complete with sliding doors that open to a spacious patio and fully fenced backyard. Ideally situated near Westport Avenue shopping, vibrant SoNo dining and nightlife, and Calf Pasture Beach. This home also offers easy commuter access I95 and the East Norwalk train station. A rare opportunity to enjoy value, convenience, and lifestyle in a sought-after neighborhood.

17 Seabreeze Pl "Windswept" is a rare waterfront offering. A thoughtfully designed coastal retreat where architecture and setting come together to create this prized home. The steel-framed construction offers just over 2,000 sq ft across three finished levels. Designed to maximize natural light and panoramic water views, the home features a dramatic 16-foot wall of glass visible from the living room, office, and primary suite. A custom pivot entry door creates a striking first impression, leading into an open living and subtle nautical-inspired elements, defined by coastal aesthetic metal railings throughout.The flexible floor plan includes a main-level bedroom with access to a full bath. The second floor offers a primary suite with en-suite bath, private balcony, and a custom sliding wall system allowing for privacy or expanded sightlines. The third floor, accessed via a floating staircase, features a vaulted ceiling making the room airy and spacious with a full bath, and private deck with expansive water views, ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Exterior upgrades include new composite siding, awning, and professionally designed landscaping with drip irrigation. Owned solar panels help offset rising electricity costs. Enjoy nearby Baxter Park, a city-maintained, dog-friendly waterfront park with seating, small kyak launch, a cherished amenity of the Harbor Shores community

Nestled in the heart of Silvermine, this unique storybook-style riverfront retreat blends timeless antique charm with serene natural surroundings. Spanning three levels, the home features 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths, highlighted by wide plank floors, bay windows, and a cozy fireplace that adds warmth and character throughout. Step outside to multiple newly built decks overlooking the river, perfect for relaxing or entertaining, while the outdoor fire pit creates an inviting setting surrounded by nature. Additional amenities include a dedicated laundry room and seamless indoor/outdoor living spaces. A rare opportunity to enjoy the beauty, charm, and tranquility of this one-of-a-kind Silvermine gem. Please schedule your private viewing before it's gone!

Welcome to this beautiful Silvermine home where timeless charm meets spacious everyday living. Filled with an abundance of natural light, this 3-bedroom home features soaring vaulted ceilings, stunning hardwood floors throughout the house, a beautiful fireplace, and multiple living spaces including both a formal living room and a spacious family room perfect for entertaining or relaxing. The kitchen is equipped with granite countertops and offers both functionality and style for everyday living. The oversized primary bedroom suite features dual wardrobe closets along with a walk-in closet, creating exceptional storage and comfort. The second and third bedrooms are also generously sized, with abundant closet space and storage found throughout the entire home, including additional storage in the basement. Step outside and enjoy the warmer months on the expansive back deck and patio complete with a fire pit, creating the perfect setting for outdoor gatherings and peaceful evenings at home. This home is perfectly situated in a highly convenient location, just minutes from shopping, dining, and major highways, making everyday living and commuting exceptionally easy. This exceptional Silvermine property combines warmth, space, and character in a highly desirable setting you will not want to miss.

Crafted as the builder's own residence, every decision was made to create a home of EXTRAORDINARY QUALITY, design and lasting value. The Kitchen features 2" marble countertop on the 8' island, quartz countertops, 48" range, wine refrigerator, abundant natural light, butler's pantry/wet bar, plus a 2nd pantry. Open to the Family room with fireplace connecting to a fabulous covered porch with fireplace. And then...there are THE VIEWS! Rolling lawns on the 1.6 acre property lead to the pond waterfront for the most peaceful setting in all seasons. A mudroom with shiplap, 2nd powder room, and ample closet space keeps mess contained. Two private offices-one on the main level and one on the third floor-offer dual workspaces. The second floor includes a primary suite with two WIC's, three additional bedrooms with ensuite or jack-and-jill bath and a huge bonus/playroom. The newly finished third floor serves as a private retreat with a large sun-filled gym, 5th bedroom, full bath, and large private office for concentration above the fray. The huge 3-car garage is enhanced by a 2nd-level EV charger. Whole-house generator. This one is different--so solid and elegant, in a beautiful quiet neighborhood, and set on land that one just cannot find anymore. Don't wait!

Set on an oversized, flat lot, this beautifully updated 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath home spans over 3,400 square feet above grade plus finished lower-level space. Originally built in 1954 and fully renovated in 2015, the home features an open kitchen, stunning primary suite with custom walk-in dressing room and en suite bath, beautiful laundry room, wood flooring throughout, and thoughtful updates inside and out. Recent improvements include a professionally designed patio with fire pit, extensive landscaping, exterior lighting, automated irrigation, and flourishing raspberry and blueberry bushes. A welcoming foyer opens to the heart of the home, where the kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining room, living room with wood-burning fireplace, and family room with access to the patio. Four bedrooms are located upstairs, including the primary suite and an additional en suite bedroom. The fifth bedroom and full bath are on the main level, ideal for guests. The finished lower level provides flexible living, recreation, or gym space. The expansive backyard offers ample room for entertaining, relaxation, and future pool possibilities. The train, schools, village center, beaches, and waterfront are all just a short walk away. A rare opportunity to enjoy the best of Rowayton living.

The first floor also offers a versatile office/guest room/bonus room to fit your needs. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite features a beautiful spa-like bath and walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms are serviced by another stylish modern full bath. The finished lower level adds approximately 740sf of additional living space and includes a stunning full bath with a large walk-in shower, perfect for extra room for the family or as a potential in-law set up. Situated on a beautiful lot in a highly desirable and convenient location close to shopping, restaurants, beach, schools, train, and major highways. Everything is new, nothing to do but move in.

Offering three levels of living space, the main level has a foyer/parlor with carved staircase, living room, and dining room connected by classically detailed openings. There are two staircases, front and rear for convenience. The classic kitchen includes marble countertops, stainless steel appliances, chef's range, island w/ second sink, a pantry, and an eating area. Adjacent are a mudroom and a powder room. The main level's gracious rooms feel settled, substantial, and timeless. The second floor includes the primary suite with two closets and a sophisticated ensuite bath. Two additional bedrooms share a double-sink hall bath with tub/shower. The third floor offers two additional bedrooms, including one with an en-suite bath (tub only), plus a double-sink hall bath. Additional features include a full unfinished basement with washer and dryer; detached two-car garage; and level yard. Set on an in-town street of classic homes, think sidewalks and strolls to amenities, while also having this convenient location minutes from train, beaches, shopping, schools, and major transportation routes. Each unit has its own heating, hot water, and electric meter. There's even a small backyard for warm-weather play and barbecues. This rare property offers the opportunity to restore its historic elegance while enjoying captivating water views from nearly every room. Rich in timeless architectural character, the home showcases an imposing turret, intricate woodwork, parquet floors, stained glass windows, sleeping porches and an array of architectural details throughout. Built in the 1890's with exceptional craftsmanship, the residence was thoughtfully positioned to capture the sweeping unobstructed waterfront vistas and beauty of coastal living. Whether you choose to return this historic gem to its original glory or create a custom waterfront masterpiece in an unbeatable setting, the possibilities are truly exceptional. The property is offered "as is" and the price reflects the renovations needed. Ideally located with easy access to the restaurants, shops and attractions of both East Norwalk and South Norwalk, as well as Calf Pasture Beach.

The community feels peaceful and tucked away, yet is conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, Metro North, I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and Norwalk's beautiful beaches. Best of all, end your day enjoying a gorgeous sunset overlooking the pool and pond. If you're looking for easy, comfortable living in a terrific Norwalk location, this is one you won't want to miss!

listings.remarks: This meticulously maintained center hall colonial on a desirable private street boasts 2.25 acres of gorgeous land and features an inviting pool, making it an ideal oasis for relaxation and entertainment. Great flow between rooms, with sunny and well sized spaces throughout, the home features living room and family room with fireplaces, white kitchen with high end appliances, spacious dining room, screened porch for enjoying the serene surroundings, and an office with built ins. Six bedrooms and four full baths upstairs offers wonderful room for all. With its spacious and well-appointed interior, along with the allure of the outdoor pool and expansive grounds, this property is sure to captivate those seeking a comfortable lifestyle in a serene setting.

Welcome to 16 Park Lane where old world charm meets modern day living. This gracious colonial set in a storybook setting on a private street is close to everything-covenient to schools, trains, downtown, shopping and so much more. Filled with character and light, this home has the space, layout and features for how we live today. Enjoy your morning coffee on the lovely porch with swing or capture the serene evenings on your private patio with oversized .73 acre lot. Enter into a gracious foyer that leads to an oversized living room. Entertain and host holiday parties in your grand dining room and kitchen with granite counters. A full bath completes the first floor. Upstairs boasts 3 bedrooms and a full bath. Enjoy your primary bedroom suite on the 3rd level with walk-in closet and private full bath with granite topped vanity. Need to work from home or recreation space? The finished lower level can accomodate your needs. Enjoy views of Noroton River from your backyard. Interior and exterior of house freshly painted. Make your home ownership dreams a reality. House and detached garaged being sold "As-Is".

Completely renovated and expanded, this turn-key home combines classic charm with modern convenience. As you approach the property, you are greeted by a beautifully landscaped front yard and a welcoming exterior that exudes warmth and character. Step through the front door and into a bright, open-concept living area. The spacious living room features a cozy fireplace and large windows that flood the space with natural light, highlighting the elegant hardwood floors and tasteful finishes while the adjacent dining area is ideal for entertaining guests. The well-appointed eat-in kitchen boasts high-quality appliances, clean-line cabinetry, and generous countertop space, perfect for culinary enthusiasts. The home offers five bedrooms and five full bathrooms each thoughtfully designed to provide a relaxing retreat. The primary bedroom is a true sanctuary, complete with an en-suite bathroom and a walk-in closet. Additional features include two home offices, and a large bonus room with a wet bar providing tons of optionality. Outside, the stone terrace is an entertainer's dream with outdoor dining space, a pergola with additional seating, hot tub, as well as a built-in barbeque with bartop seating. Full house generator. Located in a serene & friendly neighborhood, this home offers the perfect balance of tranquility and convenience. With top-rated schools, local parks, and vibrant community amenities close by, this home is ideally situated for enjoying all that Darien has to offer.

Charming 1925 colonial conveniently located walking distance to town and train. Gleaming hardwood floors and large windows welcome you to this 4 bedroom/2 bath, well-loved home. The first floor includes the kitchen, on open flow, sun-drenched dining room and living room with custom inlaid floors, as well as the primary bedroom and bath. Upstairs is an additional bath plus 3 bedrooms, one of which would make a great nursery or home office. The lower level consists of a recreation room with wall to wall carpeting and a walkout basement which provides excellent storage space and includes a washer, dyer and freezer. Interior and exterior recently painted. A large deck in back offers opportunities to grill, relax or entertain while enjoying the spacious, level backyard.

Hidden away in a most convenient location, sits this beautiful home on a professionally landscaped 1.22 acres. Sun shines into this beautiful 1950's home throughout the day. As you enter the welcoming foyer, the formal LR and DR flow seamlessly into the eat-in kitchen, den with fireplace and 3 season sunroom, all which open to the expansive deck and private, peaceful back yard. 4 generously sized BRs, a second-floor family room and 3 full baths complete this wonderful home. The 1950's workmanship, encompassing fine period detail and moldings, makes this home especially unique and eye catching!
NA

Please submit highest & best offers by 5pm Monday, 10/28. Rebuilt in 2000 and completely renovated between 2022-2024, 147 Hoyt St is the one you've been waiting for! The elegant and sprawling first floor features a stunning custom kitchen with walnut cabinetry, Calacatta Monet countertops, Thermador appliances, unlacquered brass hardware, and minimalist Prado outlets. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the great room with soaring vaulted ceilings and stone fireplace. Perfect for entertaining, the floor plan is open and cohesive while still maintaining distinct spaces, including the living room and formal dining. The stunning primary suite was completely reimagined with a custom walk-in closet, bathroom with soaking tub, and bedroom with vaulted ceilings. An additional bedroom completes the first level. Upstairs you'll find two additional bedrooms with a jack and jill bathroom and sitting area, which overlooks the great room. Don't miss the lower level, featuring a top-of-the-line gym and media room. Completely smart enabled with Ring alarm system, new thermostats, Kasa light switches and bulbs, and more. Numerous other updates include new AC system, extensive exterior landscaping and a full house water filtration system. You can truly turn the key and move right in to this Darien gem! This home is also part of the Boulder Ridge Assoc. and has access to the tennis court and playground!

Don't miss this stunning 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse in Darien's desirable Villager Pond Complex! This well-maintained end unit is tucked away at the rear of the complex, offering added privacy. The first floor boasts an open floor plan, featuring a spacious living room with a fireplace and sliders leading to the deck, a dining room, a kitchen, and a convenient half bath. Upstairs, you'll find a generous primary suite with vaulted ceilings, a luxurious, updated bath, and 2 additional bedrooms accompanied by an updated full bath with a walk-in shower. The lower level provides ample storage space and versatile possibilities to suit your needs. The association amenities include a beautiful pool and a charming pool house.

listings.remarks: Welcome to 16 Prospect Ave, a distinguished residence on one of Darien's most coveted streets. This renovated (originally built in 1870) 4,030 sqft, home, combines timeless elegance with modern comforts, featuring 10-plus-foot ceilings, 5 generously sized bedrooms, and floor-to-ceiling windows in every room on the 1st floor. Stepping through the entrance, you are greeted by a spacious foyer with beautiful hardwood floors, setting the tone for the rest of the home, and exuding sophisticated architectural details. The living spaces are perfect for gatherings of any size, flowing effortlessly between rooms and with views and access to the landscaped grounds. Multiple fireplaces add warmth and character, ideal for cozy evenings. The kitchen, equipped with double ovens and updated appliances, is functional and stylish, featuring a beautiful dining area, flowing into the family room with a fireplace and French doors leading to the patio. The primary suite is a true retreat, featuring vaulted shiplap ceilings, a spa-like ensuite bathroom, and a walk-in closet. A standout feature is a large additional room above the garage, with a dry bar and beverage refrigerator, perfect for a home office, guest suite, potential ADU (Accessory Dwelling Unit), or entertainment area. 16 Prospect Avenue is an opportunity to own a piece of Darien's history while enjoying modern amenities in a prime location near downtown, restaurants, shops, and trains.

Charming, updated colonial-style house that is both elegant and practical. The open floor plan, handcrafted built-ins, and tall windows enhance the spacious and airy feel, making it perfect for hosting gatherings or enjoying everyday life. The attention to detail with modern updates like stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and recessed lighting in the basement playroom adds a contemporary touch. The outdoor space seems equally inviting, with a relaxing deck and landscaped grounds and privacy, complemented by original stone walls and beautiful lilacs and climbing roses. The detached two-car garage with overhead storage. The home's location convenient just 3 blocks to shops, restaurants and a commuters dream to the train

Welcome to one of Darien's most welcoming streets, where neighbors have shared their lives for over 90 years! You'll love the top-rated schools: Ox Ridge Elementary, Middlesex Middle School, and Darien High!  Embrace the charm of nearby Springdale, Stamford, where you can easily stroll to the post office, New Wave Seafood (delicious!), CV's, cozy coffee shops, hair salons, and a variety of tasty restaurants. Plus, the Springdale train station is just a short walk away, offering convenient access to NYC-perfect for commuters!  This adorable Cape Cod home is nestled on a lovely lot and is ready for your personal touch. Imagine expanding it into a spacious four-bedroom, two-bath haven, complete with a fully finished basement-so many possibilities await!  With friendly neighbors and all of Springdale's amenities at your fingertips, life here is truly delightful. Schedule your tour today! Subject to probate. Sold "AS IS."

Nestled on a stunning 1.3-acre park-like property in the heart of Darien, 215 Leroy is a must-see! Just a short stroll to town and Darien High School, this expansive 5-bedroom home features a beautiful in-ground heated pool, along with over 5,000 square feet of luxurious living space.   Upon entering, you'll find a formal living room, dining room, and foyer leading to the impressive great room. This central space flows seamlessly into the newly updated kitchen and dining area, complete with a stylish new wet bar. The main floor also boasts a spacious playroom, a versatile office, and an additional bedroom with an ensuite bath.   Upstairs, the bright primary bedroom includes a newly renovated ensuite bath and walk-in closet, along with three additional bedrooms. Don't forget to explore the studio above the 2-car garage-perfect for an at home gym or additional office! Enjoy Darien's pristine beaches and parks, and bustling town with incredible restaurants and shopping, all one hour from the city.

100 Hanson Rd is an iconic Darien home combining historic charm with spacious modern living. This home boasts 10 ft ceilings, a huge kitchen with Wolf appliances, extensive island, and opens to the family room with built-ins and French doors leading to the covered back patio. Walk through the butler's pantry to the generous dining room, inviting living room with private terrace, and paneled office. Upstairs features 4 bedrooms with oversized closets, three full baths, plus a beautiful primary suite with balcony overlooking the manicured lawn. The 1.73-acre property is impeccably landscaped with thoughtfully designed gardens for year round color. Follow the gravel path to the restored post and beam barn to watch a movie, play pool or entertain in a space that will captivate. This is the perfect house, perfect property, perfect location!

listings.remarks: Waterfront Living at its best on beautiful Long Neck Point. Panoramic open water views of Greens Ledge Lighthouse and Long Island. Five minute walk to both Pear Tree Point Beach and Great Island, Darien's new 60 acre coastal preserve. This is your vacation home and your primary residence!  Totally renovated in 2010 by Fox Hill Builders this house is elegantly redone and ready for someone who wants to enjoy Coastal Living. Windows and doors are hurricane proof and the house sits high above mean high water. Rare opportunity to buy on the water, with a dock, open water views and no flood risk!

listings.remarks: Discover a touch of New England history in this lovingly maintained 1911 brick Colonial, seamlessly blending timeless charm with modern amenities. Nestled on nearly half an acre, this classic home offers a harmonious balance of period details with contemporary updates. The formal living room, featuring a stone fireplace, the formal dining room, and the adjoining sun room provide an easy flow and inviting space ideal for entertaining. Outside, the private, landscaped, fenced yard offers a picturesque setting with seasonal blooms, mature ornamental trees, and a lovely large patio area for outdoor gatherings. Conveniently located near the quaint Rowayton neighborhood and just a short walk to the Rowayton train station, this property also holds potential for expansion, providing a valuable investment in the Tokeneke school district. PLEASE SUBMIT HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS BY 3PM ON MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 9TH.

Situated on a peaceful 0.64 acre lot on a desirable cul-de-sac in the heart of Darien, this beautifully renovated 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath home offers an exceptional blend of modern style and classic elegance. The thoughtfully designed open floor plan features a newly updated eat-in kitchen with high-end appliances, perfect for culinary enthusiasts and family gatherings. The formal living room provides a welcoming space for guests, while the sun-filled family room with French doors open to a professionally landscaped backyard.  The first-floor guest suite offers privacy and convenience, ideal for visitors. A generous mudroom includes ample cabinets and storage for everyone. Upstairs, the primary bedroom suite serves as a private retreat with a newly updated spa-like bathroom, featuring luxurious finishes with his and hers closets. An additional two bedrooms with an updated bathroom complete the upper level. The lower level features a cozy bonus room with fireplace, gym and renovated full bath. An additional highlight is the office space which opens directly onto a beautiful stone patio, offering a serene space for work. This home is conveniently located just minutes from town, train station, schools, parks and amenities. Whether you're looking for privacy, elegance, or convenience, this home delivers it all in a perfect setting.

Welcome to 173 Middlesex Road, where old-world charm seamlessly blends with modern luxury. This expansive residence offers 5,352 sf of exquisite living space, set on a generous 1.27AC lot, promising both tranquility and grandeur. Upon entering, you'll be captivated by a beautiful living room with a cozy fireplace, leading to a picturesque sunroom. To the right, a light-filled dining room awaits your gatherings. The heart of this home is the striking, state-of-the-art kitchen, featuring high-end appliances and a unique live-edge center island, perfect for social gatherings. The open layout flows into a versatile room with an additional fireplace ideal for entertainment and relaxation. The first floor also includes a half bath, a small office, a spacious mudroom, and a bonus room that offers endless possibilities. Ascend to the second floor, where the primary bedroom serves as a luxurious retreat with an expansive ensuite bathroom and two walk-in closets. Four additional ensuite bedrooms and a convenient laundry room complete this level. The fully finished basement provides flexibility for a media room, playroom, or home gym potential, alongside an additional bedroom and full bathroom. A 3-car garage and private outdoor space enhance the property's appeal, offering ample room for relaxation and plenty of space to add a pool. Discover the perfect fusion of classic character and contemporary amenities conveniently located walking distance to schools and close to the train.

Welcome to this beautifully updated classic colonial home, perfectly situated on a spacious 1/3 acre lot. With 4 bedrooms and 3.5 baths, this residence blends timeless charm with modern convenience. Step inside to discover a recently renovated kitchen, featuring elegant quartzite countertops, cabinets with new soft-close doors and drawers, and Bosch and Viking appliances. The kitchen opens seamlessly to an expansive rear deck, ideal for outdoor entertaining and enjoying warm evenings with family and friends. The fully renovated family room boasts a stunning vaulted shiplap ceiling, creating a bright and inviting space that flows effortlessly into the kitchen. Cozy up in the living room with its updated gas-burning fireplace, while the dining room impresses with custom wall paneling, perfect for hosting special gatherings. Enjoy peace of mind with a fully fenced-in backyard, ideal for pets and play. Additional highlights include a detached 2-car garage and a full basement offering playroom and ample storage space. Don't miss the opportunity to make this charming home your own in a delightful, walkable community, close to both train station and schools.

listings.remarks: Nestled within the sought-after Delafield Island Association, this stunning five-bedroom home exudes warmth and charm on a private one-acre lot. The cozy den, complete with a fireplace, offers a perfect retreat for relaxation. Enjoy the convenience of nearby town amenities, Pear Tree Point Beach, and Great Island while savoring the tranquility of your surroundings. The inviting living room features a wood-burning fireplace and French doors that open onto a covered deck, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor living. The gourmet kitchen, equipped with a spacious island, flows effortlessly into the dining area and family room, making it ideal for entertaining. An expansive stone terrace adds to the allure, creating an idyllic outdoor space for gatherings or quiet moments.

Delightful 3-story farmhouse, perfectly situated on a low traffic road in a highly sought-after school district. Note the endless possibilities for expansion (dormer 3rd floor for additional full bath)! As you enter, you'll be welcomed by a foyer that leads to a cozy living room, featuring a character-filled wood-burning fireplace & an updated powder room. The dining area seamlessly flows into a spacious light-filled kitchen with a charming breakfast nook & picture window. Relax in the four-season sunroom, complete with a vaulted ceiling & underfloor radiant heated ceramic tiles-perfect for unwinding after a long day! The laundry room boasts a new storage system for added convenience. On the 2nd level, you'll find 3 inviting bedrooms & a newer full bath with a Waterworks stall shower! Ascend to the renovated 3rd level, where a decorative fireplace, 2 skylights, & generous space create an ideal office/games room or den. The property has an attached 1 car garage with a new door, new motor & renovated floor. Ample parking in the driveway!  This home features fresh paint throughout, new siding, 50+ new windows, new gutters & a brand-new roof! The spacious fully fenced-in backyard (plus patio) provides a safe space for outdoor activities, & front yard that has also been fully enclosed since purchase. Award winning Darien schools & beautiful beaches, New Canaan nature/parks, Springdale stores/life & super friendly neighbors: This is truly a wonderful place to call home!
Sunny and spacious unit with an open floor plan, updated kitchen and bathrooms, private enclosed patio. Conveniently located walk to town and train.

listings.remarks: 8 Prospect Avenue is Darien's most desirable in town location! Rarely available, this home with gorgeous custom moldings, hand crafted cabinetry and highest quality built-ins are just the beginning. This sunlit 5 bedroom, 3 full bath home is only minutes to the exciting new Darien town center and easy access to the train. Entering the foyer you turn left into the living room with fireplace which opens onto the private screened in porch, and side patio. A large formal dining room seats many guests and connects to the charming all glass breakfast room. The 1997 addition includes a cooks kitchen and new 2024 refrigerator. Step into the large family room with views of the level landscaped back garden and yard with two-car garage, waterfall an organic garden. Enter mud room from back patio into family room. Full bath, laundry with new W/D add convenience to comfortable living. The second floor is home to the primary bedroom and three other bedrooms and a bath. Off the top of stairs is a generous sleeping porch for two happy beings. The third floor has a large bedroom suite with bath and office. The unfinished basement is set up to show great possibilities with workshop, wine room and exercise room. Enjoy Darien's two public beaches and newly acquired 60 acre ocean front Great Island, all within an hour from NYC.

Wonderful 1940's colonial in one of the most sought-after neighborhoods on a cul-de-sac. An oversized level lot, with an small charming garden, and plenty of room for all. Formal living room with FP, formal dining room, magnificent oversized kitchen with vaulted ceilings. Kitchen has new counters, cooktop, and Sink as well as plenty of space to sit at the island or a separate informal dining table. Patio right outside slider to entertain or just BBQ. Spacious family room with FP, vaulted ceiling and character windows. First floor also has an office or 4th bedroom, full bath, and a generous sized laundry room. The second floor boasts a large primary bedroom, plenty of closet space, and en-suite bathroom. Two additional bedrooms share a lovely hall bath. Additionally, there is an extra room - great for sitting room, or even an additional bedroom with closet. Storage in walk up attic or large unfinished basement. Full house generator and Central Air. Interior rooms freshly painted. Hardwood floors throughout, many just redone, kitchen has tile floor. Full house generator. Beach rights. Agent related to Owner.

Welcome to your beautifully renovated classic colonial, nestled on one of Darien's most sought-after streets. Step inside and feel right at home in this bright, inviting space where you can immediately enjoy your recently updated kitchen, complete with top-of-the-line appliances and custom cabinetry. The first floor has a seamless flow, featuring a family room that opens onto a stunning deck, perfect for additional living space during the warmer months. When the temperatures drop, cozy up by the fire in the living room. There's a spacious bedroom on the first floor that can also serve as a home office. Upstairs, you'll find two more generously sized bedrooms, along with a primary suite that boasts a luxurious bathroom with radiant heat and a steam shower, plus a full-size walk-in closet. Additional storage is available in the two-car attached garage and the pull-down attic. The lower level features a sunlit, partially finished basement, ideal for a playroom, extra office, or gym. This home has been thoughtfully updated, with new windows installed in 2018, a new heating system in 2021, and a new roof in 2024, just to name a few improvements. And if that's not enough, the location is unbeatable. Enjoy the convenience of walking to the elementary, middle, and high schools, as well as Darien Commons and the Noroton Heights train station

You will be swept away by the light and ease of this move-in ready home, perched at the top of the hill in a coveted Darien neighborhood. Boasting 1.29 acres and 4 bedrooms, you will have all the space you need both inside and out! Featuring a fenced in back yard, deck overlooking the mature evergreens and a flagstone terrace to enjoy daily. Welcome your guests in the open concept main floor, where the updated kitchen is situated between the family and living rooms with direct access to your deck. The surprise of this home is the abundance of flexible space throughout, including a sun porch/office and additional family room with fireplace. Make this your forever home and enjoy all the possibilities this residence has to offer!

Welcome to this charming Cape Cod home designed for both comfort and style. The bright, sunny rooms create a welcoming atmosphere throughout the house, enhancing the excellent flow from one space to another. The lovely living room with fireplace, dining room and renovated kitchen and baths with screened porch on the first floor has wonderful ample spaces! All three bedrooms are conveniently situated on the upper level, providing a private and peaceful retreat.  The eat-in kitchen has been thoughtfully renovated, boasting white cabinetry and sleek stainless steel appliances, making it a delightful space for both cooking and casual dining. Step out onto the pretty screened porch, perfect for enjoying your morning coffee or relaxing in the evening, while overlooking the professionally landscaped property that adds a touch of nature's beauty to your everyday life.  Both bathrooms have been tastefully updated, offering modern amenities and a fresh, clean look. Additionally, the finished basement provides great additional space, ideal for an office or a playroom, catering to your varied needs. This home combines classic charm with modern updates, making it a perfect place to be home!  Easy walk to Darien Commons and Noroton Heights train station. Don't miss this gem!

Secluded, modern hilltop retreat overlooking Holly Pond and the salt marsh. Nearly 3 acres on a private road adjacent to Darien Land Trust property and Weed Beach Park. Designed by David Austin for his personal residence in 2003. This 5-bedroom 3.5 bath home has been totally renovated by the current owners. A pool, dock, stone patio with gas fire pit, an additional wood burning fire pit, and perennial gardens complete the stunning outdoor spaces set dramatically into the natural contours of the property. With its kitchen and bar set up for entertaining the downstairs spaces take full advantage of the views of Holly Pond. Abundant wildlife and magnificent sunsets make this such a special offering. Easy access to school, shopping and commuting.

listings.remarks: Experience the finest in coastal living at 123 Long Neck Point Road. This impeccably renovated 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom residence spans a generous 6,214 square feet and is situated on 1.22 acres with 118 feet of direct waterfront. Upon entering, you are greeted by an interior that showcases meticulous craftsmanship and high-end finishes. The open-concept design enhances natural light and stunning views of Ziegler's Cove and Long Island Sound. The custom-designed kitchen, seamlessly opens onto a deck, perfect for al fresco dining. This space overlooks the landscaped grounds, brought to life by elegant landscape lighting. The home office provides an oasis for productivity and tranquility while the great room presents endless possibilities for entertainment and gatherings.  The primary suite is a sanctuary of luxury, featuring a sumptuous soaking tub, two walk-in closets, and a private deck with serene water views. A plethora of outdoor amenities designed for leisure and enjoyment including the pool and hot tub beckon you to unwind, while the outdoor kitchen, bluestone patio, and dockside fire pit provide the ideal setting for recreation and relaxation. A private boat dock further enhances the waterfront experience, making this home a true haven for water enthusiasts.

Welcome to this beautifully updated sun-filled Cape Cod-style home, exuding a warm and inviting urban cottage vibe, nestled in one of Darien's most desirable neighborhoods. Perfectly positioned for convenience and lifestyle, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence was thoughtfully renovated in 2023, adding a bright and airy great room just off the kitchen, as well as a modern full bath and laundry area. Every detail has been upgraded, from the high-end porcelain flooring to significant electrical, plumbing, and HVAC improvements. A new roof installed in 2016 completes this home's exceptional maintenance. The chic, efficient kitchen boasts brand-new appliances while preserving its charming original built-in cabinetry, blending the best of modern convenience with classic appeal. French doors open to a serene outdoor oasis, featuring a spacious backyard perfect for entertaining and relaxation. Located on a quiet one-way street, this home offers the best of town and country living. Just steps from the Noroton Heights train station, a commuter's dream, with express trains to New York City. Enjoy nearby gourmet markets, restaurants, shops, Equinox gym, and all the conveniences of the new Darien Commons and Heights Crossing. A short distance to Weed Beach, Pear Tree Beach, Noroton Yacht Club, and Darien Boat Club, this property enjoys abundant southern light and mature landscaping-a coastal Connecticut dream. Homes on Patton Drive rarely come on the market - come see all this home offers!

Nestled in the desirable community of Darien, CT, this beautifully remodeled 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home is a perfect blend of modern amenities and classic charm. With 2,388 square feet of living space, the property boasts an open and airy layout designed for both comfort and entertainment. The spacious living room, complete with a wood-burning fireplace, provides a cozy retreat, while the large dining room is perfect for hosting gatherings, and a TV room to watch your favorite games.  The home features an attached two-car garage, ensuring convenience, and the front and back gardens have serene outdoor settings. Enjoy the screened porch for morning coffee or relax on the patio with friends. The property also includes a solar energy system, adding eco-friendly efficiency to your lifestyle. Public water and sewage provide ease of maintenance. Designed with both indoor and outdoor social spaces, this home is ideal for entertaining year-round. It's a must-see opportunity in one of Darien's most sought-after neighborhoods. Don't miss out on this gem-schedule your viewing today!

Welcome home to 18 Catalpa Terrace. This Cape style charmer has enjoyed many new updates including new furnace, siding, windows, driveway, updated kitchen and bath. Situated on a quiet/private road that leads to the water. Enjoy the cozy fireplace, eat-in kitchen, seasonal water views from the primary bedroom and access to Holly Pond for kayaking or paddle-boarding. Conveniently located to Weed Beach, Pear Tree Beach, Noroton Heights train station, and the Darien YMCA. Darien Commons, only a short distance away, features many shops and restaurants. Fun fact...the last remaining Catalpa tree is in the front yard of #18.  Highest & best Tuesday October 15th at 3pm to: Attorney Jeremy Kaye  *List Agent for details

Welcome to 60 Hanson Road, a property that offers the best blend of old-world charm and modern amenities. Thoughtfully updated by its current owner, this 4 bedroom, 4 full, and one half bath home on 2 acres is private and convenient, centrally located, and within walking distance to the high school. Immediately upon arriving at the home, you are greeted by a gracious front porch and views of the Weeburn Country Club's 18th hole. The scenic view and sunlight are carried into the foyer with an updated glass entry. This is just the beginning of the many surprises in this home, featuring approximately 4,446 square feet of living space and primary suites on both the first and second floors. The home's character-filled formal living room showcases antique beams and a wood-burning fireplace. The newly renovated and pristine eat-in kitchen overlooks a spacious family room with a gas-fireplace, antique wood accents, and two sets of French doors. A formal dining room, a butler's pantry, a private office, a sunroom, and a chic mudroom are all move-in ready. Upstairs you will find more thoughtful improvements with newly renovated bathrooms and laundry room, and a vaulted-ceiling bonus room with a large picture window. The home's energy-efficient amenities feature a new roof, new heating and cooling, added spray foam insulation, and new windows. This unique Darien home is not to be missed.

REMODELED and READY! Open floor plan ranch home boasts a sleek and stylish, all new kitchen featuring breakfast bar, stainless steel appliances, including a double oven and gorgeous granite countertops. Sparkling new bathroom provides combination tub with shower. New floors run throughout the easy, no steps interior! The remodeling goes beyond looks alone and includes new systems, mechanicals and appliances: Central Air Conditioning, Heating, Electrical, Recessed Lighting, Additional Insulation, Washer & Dryer and more. The unfinished lower level has plenty of storage space. Relax on the gated rear deck overlooking a delightful rear yard - ideal for gardening, pets and backyard fun. The exterior is freshly painted and includes a newly sealed driveway with ample parking. Set on private cul de sac convenient to Noroton train station and the brand new Darien Commons where you can shop and dine. Walk to Baker Park, Jake's Place and other amenities... A fabulous alternative to restrictive condos. Enjoy the Darien lifestyle.

Welcome Home to Darien: A Bright Beginning Awaits  This freshly updated 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath Cape-style home is ideal for buyers seeking charm, comfort, and convenience. Freshly painted interiors and refinished hardwood floors create a bright, welcoming space. The atrium-style family room fills the home with natural light and opens to a spacious deck overlooking a deep backyard. The updated kitchen, cozy living room with a wood-burning fireplace, and open layout bring a fun and inviting vibe.  Upstairs, you'll find four bedrooms: a serene primary suite, a secondary ensuite, and two additional bedrooms with a shared bath. Practical features include a mudroom, first-floor laundry, a second-floor laundry chute, and a full basement perfect for a workout area, playroom, or extra storage.  Just one block from Holmes Elementary, this home offers unmatched convenience and access to Darien's beaches, and vibrant downtown. With a quick 50-minute commute to NYC, this home has great light, great bones and endless possibilities!

Storybook four-bedroom home exudes charm and character on a manicured .72 level acre with inviting stone courtyard offering exquisite original details. This enchanting home features a grand living room with vaulted, beamed ceiling, a wall of windows and a wood burning fireplace. The versatile floor plan provides the choice of a master suite either on the first level or upstairs which includes two additional bedrooms. Additional amenities include 3 zone ductless split air conditioning and a fireplace in the cozy office. Enjoy heated floors in all bathrooms, the laundry room, and the mudroom. The expansive backyard deck, finished with contemporary cable railings, provides a perfect outdoor relaxation and entertainment setting. Shade Store window coverings throughout home. The sunroom, off the main level, is a tranquil space to relax, while the finished lower level offers versatility for a playroom, home office, or additional living space. Two additional generously-sized bedrooms and a well-appointed bathroom complete the second floor. The property's prime location places you just moments away from the Noroton Heights train station, Darien's top-rated schools, and the dining and shopping options at the lively Darien Commons! Finished playroom in lower level with 260 SQ FT not included in total square footage.

Welcome to this move-in ready Colonial home located at 107 Leroy Avenue in the heart of Darien, CT. This warm and inviting residence offers the perfect blend of classic elegance and modern comfort, nestled on an expansive .71 acre lot.  Step inside to discover a spacious 2,166 square foot interior thoughtfully designed for both relaxation and entertaining. The heart of the home is the beautifully updated kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances and a seamless flow that makes cooking and gathering a delight. Just off the kitchen, the family room beckons with its cozy fireplace, creating a perfect backdrop for cherished moments with loved ones. The house has a large unfinished walk out basement with plenty of space to use your imagination. Situated in a desirable location, this home is just a short walk to the train and town, making it perfect for commuters and those who love to explore the local community. Embrace the warmth and character of this lovely home and make it yours today.

Fantastic opportunity to own this sun-filled, turn-key 4 bedroom, 2 1/2 bath home in a lovely Darien neighborhood, walkable to the Noroton Heights train station and adjacent to Woodland Park Nature Preserve! As you step into this quintessential 1926 colonial, you are greeted by open space and an extra large living room that flows into a sweet separate alcove and a gracious formal dining room. The updated kitchen features quartz countertops, newer appliances, and plenty of cabinetry plus a pantry for all your storage needs. The Family room off the kitchen boasts a vaulted ceiling, tons of natural light, and a mudroom area that exits to the large backyard with bluestone patio, oversized detached garage, plus fenced-in yard all backing up to 64.7 acres of woodland trails!    Upstairs you will find all 4 generously-sized bedrooms. The primary bedroom has an updated en-suite bathroom plus 2 large closets, making it a comfortable retreat. There is also a large walk-up attic accessible through one of the bedrooms that is ideal for storage and/or possible opportunity to finish for additional living space. The full basement is partially finished with a sizeable playroom/gym area plus ample storage. Updates to this gem include Hardie Plank siding, all-new windows, new paved driveway, newly finished hardwood floors, and more!

Showings start Saturday, 3/8!! The fully landscaped yard with picturesque willow tree and expansive deck create the perfect backyard oasis.

Own a piece of history with the Quintard-Frost House, a stunning antique Dutch Colonial home built in 1715 that seamlessly blends historic charm with modern comfort. This 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom residence showcases timeless craftsmanship, including original wide-plank floors, exposed beams, and period details throughout. At the heart of the home is a true antique bar with fireplace, a rare and inviting space perfect for entertaining. The grand dining room sets the stage for unforgettable family gatherings, while the sunroom and eat-in kitchen offer warm and inviting spaces for everyday living. Step outside to enjoy the beautiful patio, an ideal spot for relaxing or hosting under the open sky. A 2-car garage provides convenience, completing this exceptional offering. Situated within walking distance to the train as well as the Corbin District, this home offers easy access to restaurants, coffee shops, and shopping, blending historic charm with the best of modern-day convenience. Steeped in history yet designed for modern living, the Quintard-Frost House is a rare opportunity to own a historic treasure in a prime location. Don't miss your chance to make this timeless property home!

An exceptional and unique opportunity awaits - rarely, if ever, does land of this quality and location come to market! Dream, create and escape to your sanctuary with this breathtaking and flat 7.62-acre property nestled in coveted Darien, CT. Boasting 2.74 buildable acres, this one-of-a-kind parcel offers an unparalleled canvas to create your custom masterpiece. Imagine waking up to serene and panoramic vistas, entertaining like no one else can, and multiple generations playing in the natural and private landscape. Whether you envision a family compound, a minimalist retreat or a timeless country estate, this property offers endless possibilities to bring your architectural dreams to life. listings.remarks: Beautifully renovated in 2022, this 5-bedroom Colonial has been expertly updated from top to bottom, both inside and out. Nestled on a sought-after cul-de-sac street, the home sits on 3 stunning acres, meticulously landscaped with lush, green lawns and enhanced by newly installed landscape lighting. The interiors have been thoughtfully updated, offering a sophisticated and functional floor plan perfect for daily living and entertaining. The formal living room with a fireplace leads into a sunroom with expansive glass walls that open to a newly added bluestone patio. The dining room seamlessly flows into the updated eat-in kitchen with breakfast nook and family room featuring a wet bar. The luxurious primary suite boasts two spacious closets and a beautifully renovated bathroom. The second floor is completed with four additional bedrooms and new bathrooms. The finished lower level offers a fantastic bonus space, ideal for a playroom, along with ample storage. Outside, enjoy al fresco dining on the bluestone patio, while taking in the breathtaking, meticulously maintained grounds.

32 Old Oak Road is a stunning 6,000 square foot, turn-key home featuring 5 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms located on a quiet cul-de-sac within the coveted Boulder Ridge Association. From the moment you step inside, the high ceilings, custom finishes, and abundant natural light reflect the comforts and elegance of modern living. The main level includes: formal living and dining rooms, family room with stone fireplace, library, office, and a well-appointed wet bar-perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The renovated gourmet eat-in kitchen is a chef's dream, with top-of-the-line appliances and a large center island with additional seating, all opening seamlessly to the backyard. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a spacious bedroom with vaulted ceilings, walk-in closet, and luxurious bathroom. The second floor bonus room offers flexibility for an additional office or playroom. Not to be missed is the additional 1,500-square-foot finished walkout basement, ideal for entertaining or fitting in a workout in the home gym. The three-car garage offers ample storage. Step outside to enjoy the private backyard, complete with a deck and stone terrace-perfect for summer entertaining or quiet relaxation. Residents of Boulder Ridge have access to Boulder Ridge Park which includes a playground and tennis court. Located in a private setting, just minutes from Darien's top-rated schools, shopping, and dining, this property offers the best of both worlds. Don't miss it!

Nestled on a quiet street in one of Darien's most desirable neighborhoods, 25 Libby Lane offers the perfect blend of timeless charm and modern elegance. This beautifully maintained home boasts 5 bedrooms, 5.2 bathrooms, and over 5545 SF of sun-drenched living space. Step inside to discover a thoughtfully designed floor plan with gracious entertaining spaces, 9 foot ceilings, hardwood floors throughout, extensive custom mill work and a gourmet kitchen featuring high-end appliances, marble countertops, and a large island and dining area. The inviting family room with a cozy fireplace opens to a large deck, and a private level wooded backyard-ideal for play, gardening, or summer barbecues.  Upstairs, the spacious primary suite includes his and hers walk-in closets and a luxurious en-suite bathroom. Additional bedrooms are generously sized and perfect for family and guests. The finished lower level offers flexible space for a rec room, gym, or media area with a fireplace and a wine cellar. Located just minutes from top-rated Darien schools, train stations, town beaches, and the vibrant new Darien Commons, this home is a true gem for anyone seeking comfort, convenience, and community. Come experience the lifestyle that 25 Libby Lane has to offer-schedule your private showing today.

Bursting with charm, this home has a rare blend of classic old-world character and modern updates and amenities. The thoughtfully designed chef's kitchen features a vaulted ceiling, custom moldings, and a center island, serving as the heart of the home. An open layout connects the kitchen, living spaces, and outdoor areas, making it ideal for both daily living and entertaining. French doors across the back of the house lead to stone terraces with views of a private, rolling lawn and the scenic Darien Land Trust Preserve and river. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a beautifully updated bathroom, along with three additional bedrooms and a hall bath. Quality finishes and original details throughout. Conveniently located within one mile of downtown Darien's shops, restaurants, and train station. A must-see home.

Welcome to the epitome of sophisticated elegance at 48 Dorchester Road. As you ascend the graceful driveway, the declaration "I've arrived" is truly realized in this grand estate where the grandeur of Versailles meets the charm of Darien. This unique residence is replete with architectural surprises, including a hidden main staircase which gracefully leads to an enchanting interior balcony reminiscent of Rapunzel's tower, overlooking the remarkable oval foyer. Elegant glass doors in the foyer open to a picturesque courtyard and a reflecting pool, creating a stunning first impression. The gourmet chef's kitchen is designed for culinary excellence, boasting an oversized marble island, pantry, glass cabinetry, double ovens and a cozy family room w/a casual eating area. Entertain elegantly in the formal living & dining rooms, each adorned with a welcoming fireplace. The wet bar has a refrigerated wine closet which stores up to over 130 bottles. The 1st floor primary suite exudes luxury with its soaring ceilings, his and her walk-in closets, a lavish bathroom featuring a shower with an enclosed bathtub* and a separate sitting room. The bedroom's floor-to-ceiling French doors lead to the courtyard, complemented by a cozy gas fireplace. An adjacent bedroom and a 3rd bedroom/office share this wing of the home. Upstairs are 2 additional ensuite bedrooms connected by a refined wrought-iron bannister. The lower level offers an in-law apartment
