listings.remarks: Built in 2016 this turnkey home combines classic charm with modern convenience all just steps from downtown Darien, Cherry Lawn Park, train and shops. The beautifully landscaped yard and welcoming exterior radiate warmth and character. Step onto the front porch and through the front door into a bright and gracious entryway leading to the formal living and dining rooms and private office. As you pass through the center hall you enter the heart of the home with a spacious gourmet kitchen and family room with fireplace which flows effortlessly onto the terrace and backyard. The well-appointed eat-in kitchen boasts high-quality appliances, two ovens, clean-line cabinetry, and generous countertop space, perfect for culinary enthusiasts, while the butlers pantry is equipped with an additional mini refrigerator and second dishwasher. Upstairs are five bedrooms and four bathrooms each thoughtfully designed to provide a relaxing retreat. The primary bedroom is a true sanctuary, with an en-suite bathroom, walk-in closet and gas fireplace. Additional features include a bonus room with gas fireplace on the 2nd floor and a vast finished open space and storage space on the third floor. Outside, is an entertainer's dream to relax and unwind by the outdoor stone fireplace or enjoy the open flat backyard. Three-car attached garage. With top-rated schools, local parks, and vibrant community amenities close by, this home is ideally situated for enjoying all that Darien has to offer.

Charming 3-bedroom Darien colonial on quiet cul-de-sac offers 2,064 sf of beautifully appointed living space on a lush 0.52-acre parcel with large rear private patio with a low maintenance setting with tasteful landscaping. Inside the home flows effortlessly, with a spacious living room featuring hardwood floors and a cozy fireplace. The heart of the home - an open kitchen with center island that seamlessly connects to the dining area and sliders that provides easy access to outdoor entertaining. A flexible upstairs Family room is ideal for a home office, playroom or media lounge.  Retreat upstairs to the three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a primary suite graced with hardwood floors and ample natural light, and two adult sized secondary bedrooms. Two full baths and a half bath ensure comfort and convenience for family and guests.  Practical features include central laundry (off the kitchen), garage with automatic opener, and efficient zoned heating powered by propane and Central AC. The home sits on a quaint street with a level lot yet conveniently close to Goodwives Shopping Center, Trader Joe's, Downtown Darien, and the train - Perfect for daily life or commuting.  Located in the sought-after Darien school district (Tokeneke Elementary, Middlesex Middle, and Darien High), this picture-perfect home embodies the ideal blend of elegance, comfort, and convenience. A rare opportunity to move right into a gorgeous home in a wonderful neighborhood!!

In-town oasis with ample privacy, yet still a convenient walk to Old King's Market, town, train, and Tilley Pond Park. Well-maintained home with enclosed courtyard and garden area, perfect for outdoor entertaining. Eat-in kitchen, living/dining room with fireplace, 2 bedrooms with cathedral ceilings, 2.5 baths. Laundry on 2nd floor. Plenty of storage with two attics, pull-down stairs on 2nd floor and in garage. Central AC.

An opportunity rarely found in Darien's coveted Ridge Acres Association. This storybook Cape-style home offers 4/5 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms with tremendous potential to renovate, expand, or just move in!! The home features a flexible floor plan with generously sized rooms, hardwood floors and wonderful natural light throughout. Set on a one acre lot, the backyard is absolutely gorgeous - lush, green, and thoughtfully landscaped, creating a serene and private setting. Don't miss the chance live in one of Darien's most sought-after neighborhoods.

A Commuter's Delight! Beginning from the lower level & up, this terrific new listing is as close to brand new as you can get! The unique floor plan offers great flexibility w/open entertaining space on the main level in addition to a bonus den/office/potential 5th BR & full bathroom. The 2nd floor delivers a stylish Primary bedroom suite w/plentiful closet space & a luxurious en-suite bathroom. Also featured on the 2nd floor is a sun-drenched rear facing guest bedroom, hall bathroom & front facing guest bedroom w/surprise bonus office/gameroom/nursery.  The 3rd floor offers a spacious 4th bedroom, possible alternate master bedroom, w/en-suite full bath & abundant storage. In the lower level you'll find a terrific recreation space, a laundry center & plenty of storage. Benefit from efficient living w/energy saving closed cell foam insulation, insulated Andersen windows, natural gas sourced heat, LED lighting, brand new appliances & more. Modern conveniences include integrated Wi-Fi, cable, security systems and generator ready hookup if needed. The yard is easy to care for and shows as it features a bluestone patio, large driveway & circular parking area. Located on a private dead-end street while being only steps to Noroton Heights train station & new shopping/dining district! This home is move-in ready and will provide years of ease & comfort! Agent/Owner

Welcome to this inviting four-bedroom home perfectly situated on one of Darien's most coveted in-town streets, renowned for its strong sense of community and vibrant neighborhood gatherings. Just steps from Royle Elementary School and a short walk to town, train, and schools, this property offers the ultimate in convenience and lifestyle. At the heart of the home is a spacious eat-in gourmet kitchen designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. The kitchen flows seamlessly into both the indoor living and family rooms, creating a warm, connected space, and extends naturally out to the home's exceptional exterior areas. Freshly painted interiors enhance the light and bright atmosphere throughout. Enjoy year-round outdoor living with a charming wrap-around porch featuring a cozy corner seating area, a large patio perfect for dining and relaxing, and an expansive backyard offering space for play or quiet retreat. This is a rare opportunity to own a home that blends classic charm with modern ease, all in one of Darien's most desirable locations. Extensive list of homeowner's improvements available!

Experience over $800,000 in exquisite luxury upgrades designed to captivate even the most discerning buyers. The first floor's open floor plan seamlessly flows from formal to casual to intimate spaces, including a formal dining room with a gas fireplace, luxury kitchen with 7-foot island with granite countertop, and a formal living room with a wood-burning masonry fireplace and a welcoming family room with chic French doors. The primary suite has South-facing water views of the gunite pool, sliders for an evening dip, and a spa-like primary bathroom with luxury tiles highlighted by a seamless glass shower for an authentic retreat experience. Second BR en-suite in the same wing. The third bedroom en-suite of the kitchen and laundry room has a renovated bath and a spacious closet perfect for siblings or an in-law suite. Whole house renovations include new Hardie Board siding, architectural shingle roof, expanded Anderson windows, sliders, and French doors to the expanded terrace around the pool. The fully finished lower level has a rec room, a new full bath, a bonus utility room/dog spa, an office, and a bonus room. The exterior is equally impressive with a beautifully landscaped front entrance with Belgian block edging, mature specimen plantings, a white fence around the front and backyard, a 3-car attached garage, and new stone steps to the backyard. Designed for luxurious, modern living, this home truly has comfort, style, and timeless elegance.

This stunning colonial in Darien, CT offers 3,472 sq ft of elegant living space with four bedrooms, including a luxurious primary suite with a full bath, a private ensuite bedroom, and two additional bedrooms share a Jack and Jill bath. Features include beautiful, oak hardwood floors, a finished lower level, a spacious deck, and a lush landscape maintained by a smart irrigation system. The home also boasts recent upgrades including: modern kitchen appliances, finished lower level and an attached one-car garage. Located near top schools, dining, shopping, highways, and just minutes from NYC train stations, this is a rare opportunity to own in one of the best towns in CT! Schedule your private tour today!

**Watch video link below!** Charming New England Farmhouse with golf course views. Perfect for sunset enjoyments from the covered front porch. Inside, a welcoming Center Hall Colonial features a formal living room, elegant dining area with a butler's pantry and wet bar-great for entertaining. The eat-in kitchen offers granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and an open view to the family room with a wood-burning fireplace. Slider doors lead to a spacious wood deck for seamless indoor-outdoor living. A mudroom, half bath, and laundry are conveniently located between the kitchen and two-car garage. Upstairs, the primary suite boasts an ensuite bath and golf course views. Three large bedrooms and a hall bath provide ample space; a flexible fourth bedroom can serve as an au pair or second primary retreat, with potential for a bathroom and walk-in closet. A full attic adds extra storage. The home features hardwood floors and custom blinds throughout. The finished lower level adds 780 sq. ft. of living space, including a media room, office, utility room, and storage. Durable Hardie plank siding enhances exterior appeal. This architect-owned, well-maintained home is ready for new owners with expansion possibilities. Located across from Woodway Country Club and set back from Hoyt Street, it's not in a flood zone. Close to train, Merritt Parkway, Waveny Park's trails, and just 5 minutes to schools-an ideal commuter's dream!

With its unbeatable location and tons of potential, this is a one-of-a-kind chance to build your dream home in a truly special spot.

listings.remarks: Tucked away on a private 0.58-acre lot at the end of a tranquil cul-de-sac, this exceptional Colonial blends timeless elegance with modern comfort. Offering approximately 5,473 square feet of beautifully finished living space-plus an additional 1,314 square feet in the walk-out lower level-the home features six bedrooms and five and a half baths designed for today's lifestyle. At the heart of the home, a gourmet eat-in kitchen with a large Quartz center island and premium finishes opens seamlessly to the family room with vaulted ceilings and a striking stone fireplace. French doors lead to one of three expansive terraces, creating an effortless flow for indoor-outdoor living and entertaining. Formal living and dining rooms provide elegant spaces for hosting, while the main-level lounge with a wet bar offers a refined retreat. Upstairs, the primary suite serves as a private sanctuary with a spa-inspired bath and custom walk-in closet. Five additional bedrooms surround a bright, skylit office or study nook, offering both comfort and flexibility. The walk-out lower level includes a home gym, recreation area, and private bedroom suite with its own living space. Outdoors, professionally landscaped grounds, multiple patios, and a level yard provide the perfect setting for dining, play, and relaxation in one of Darien's most coveted neighborhoods.

This exceptional property is set at the end of a quiet, coveted tree-lined lane, offering a rare sense of privacy and tranquility. Spanning two flat, park-like acres framed by mature trees, the approach unfolds through a storybook stone wall, creating an immediate sense of arrival. The classic Colonial residence is gracefully set back from the road, blending timeless architecture with a serene natural setting. This is a property defined elegance, and the enduring appeal of one of Darien's most desirable private roads. Inside the home it is bright and sunny with large windows. The floor plan offers excellent space for family gathering and entertaining with scenic views of the property.

Discover the epitome of modern living at 365 West Avenue. This one-of-a-kind residence boasts a contemporary and stylish aesthetic, highlighted by unique materials and finishes with a distinct Danish flair. This home is thoughtfully designed to blend comfort with sophistication. Step inside to find a fully renovated kitchen featuring a Viking gas range & hood, and a breakfast bar with room for 3 stools. A chic dining room with fireplace and cozy living room provide just the right ambiance. The enclosed front porch reveals two finished flex rooms, ideal for a pair of home offices, a study, sun room or playroom, catering to versatile lifestyle needs. Upstairs find 3 distinctive bedrooms, each equipped with a ceiling fan, and sharing an elegantly updated full bath. Downstairs, a polished finished basement with a full bath offers a haven for both kids and adults alike. Adding to its allure, the finished detached garage has a vaulted ceiling, creating an exceptional space for an office, studio or for movie nights. Entertain with style on the backyard deck, complete with an extra-long breakfast bar and a separate outdoor kitchen patio equipped with a built-in sink, grill, and fire pit. The home is entirely enveloped by lush green giants, ensuring privacy. The expansive lot with a large side yard invites endless play opportunities. Many beautiful furniture pieces available for purchase. Close to Noroton Heights, train, Woodland Park and beaches. A modern yet timeless living space.

An Exceptional Offering in the Heart of Darien. A unique opportunity not to be missed, this gracious four-bedroom Dutch Colonial masterfully blends timeless 1930s charm with modern sophistication. Nestled on one of Darien's most sought-after in-town streets-known for its deep-rooted traditions and close-knit community-this exceptional home is set on a lush, level, one-acre lot in a coveted half-acre zone, offering rare potential to create a true family estate. Step inside to discover beautifully refreshed interiors, including a newly minted kitchen and baths, complemented by fresh paint and classic period details that reflect the home's heritage. From elegant millwork to the warmth of original hardwood floors, character radiates throughout every room. Outside, enjoy a private oasis with mature plantings and pool, perfect for entertaining or quiet relaxation. Whether you're envisioning future expansion, a guest cottage, or simply reveling in the gracious space, this property offers a rare blend of location, lifestyle, and long-term value. Stay tuned-this one-of-a-kind offering is coming soon, and it won't last long.

Modern Luxury & Exceptional Craftsmanship- Custom built in 2021 by Oliver Wilson. Introducing a stunning home offering the perfect blend of modern design and timeless elegance. Thoughtfully crafted with premium materials and high-end finishes, this custom-built residence delivers superior quality and comfort throughout.  Situated on a beautifully landscaped .88 lot, this spacious home features 5 bedrooms and 6.2 bathrooms across over 5000 sqft of open-concept living space. The main level boasts soaring ceilings, oversized windows, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow-perfect for both everyday living and entertaining.  The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, complete with custom cabinetry, Silestone Quartz by Cosentino countertops with a 15 ft center island that seats 8, and top-of-the-line appliances. The 14-ft coffee station/ bar, seamlessly situated between the dining room and kitchen, creates the perfect accent for entertaining. The dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows create an unforgettable first impression.  A spacious living room with a gas/wood fireplace, sitting room, a formal dining room area and office beaming with sun filled windows complete the first floor. The luxurious primary suite offers a spa-inspired bathroom with a freestanding soaking tub, dual vanities, and a walk-in closet. Additional bedrooms are generously sized with ample closet space and designer finishes. Additional features include

Welcome Home to this Storybook Cape Cod style set beneath a Picturesque Magnolia Tree. This 3 bedroom two full bath house offers the perfect blend of character, comfort and convenience. Inside you'll find beachy floors and freshly painted walls that give the home a light, breezy feel. The thoughtfully designed layout is ideal for a family including an expansive finished basement with fireplace offering plenty of space for a family room, office and built-in workshop. Step outside to your own private retreat. A beautiful, oversized, professionally landscaped backyard with a spacious stone patio perfect for entertaining and a garden with a shed. Endless opportunities to expand. Enjoy the peaceful neighborhood setting while being just a short walk to train, Darien Commons for dining and the Goddard School for daycare. Plenty of opportunities to expand as well. Don't miss this special opportunity to own and live in Darien with the Top Rated schools in CT.

Introducing one of Tokeneke's most iconic waterfront estates-available for the first time in 50 years. This rare and storied compound is set on 2.4 acres of exquisitely landscaped grounds with 180 feet of private shoreline along Long Island Sound. It offers an unrivaled blend of historic charm, timeless elegance, and breathtaking coastal beauty. A sweeping two-story paneled foyer leads to a gracious formal living and dining rooms with soaring ceilings, fireplaces, and uninterrupted views of the water. Sunlight pours into the sophisticated sunroom-an ideal setting for quiet mornings or refined entertaining. The expansive kitchen and breakfast area open seamlessly to a family room with a granite fireplace, while a discreet back stairway leads to a stunning double-height billiards room with vaulted, beamed ceilings. The second floor is anchored by a grand primary suite with an oversized waterfront balcony, offering a private vantage point for sunsets over the Sound. Two additional bedrooms complete this level, with three more on the top floor to accommodate family or guests in style. A separate three-car garage includes a fully finished upper level with a full bath-ideal for a guest suite, gym, or private office. This exceptional estate embodies the quiet prestige of a bygone era, offering privacy, beauty, and unparalleled access to the water-all in the heart of Darien's most coveted private enclave. A once-in-a-generation opportunity to own a true coastal masterpiece.

Your private backyard oasis awaits featuring an oversized patio, in-ground pool, and lush, professionally landscaped gardens, all framed by mature specimen trees. Three additional bedrooms and a full bath complete the second floor, while a finished lower level and expansive walk-up attic add versatile living space. An extraordinary bonus: the detached three-car garage with a fully outfitted 550+ SF legal ADU/guest house above - complete with kitchen, living room, bedroom, and full bath - perfect for guests, an au pair, or working from home. In-town Darien living has never looked so good.

Step inside to discover a remodeled island kitchen, featuring French doors that open to a newly built deck-perfect for outdoor dining or simply enjoying the serene views of your lush gardens filled with over 50 perennials including tulips, roses, lavender and 18 gorgeous hydrangeas. The main level is home to two cozy bedrooms that share a well-appointed full bath, alongside a spacious living room w/ a fireplace and a formal dining area. Upstairs you'll find the impressive primary bedroom suite, a true retreat with high ceilings, built-ins, and a private balcony that overlooks the picturesque backyard gardens. This suite also offers a sitting area, dressing room, and a luxurious full bath. A dedicated office and a laundry room complete the upper level. Enjoy the ease of electric heating and cooling, with an impressively low average monthly electric bill of just $438 over the past year. Situated on a quiet street with minimal traffic, this home is just moments away from the vibrant Noroton Heights developments, bustling with new shops, restaurants, and close to train and town beaches. Embrace this ideal blend of tranquility and convenience.

Step inside to discover a tastefully renovated interior featuring high ceilings, tons of light and spacious living areas. The home boasts a welcoming dining room with picturesque views of the flat yard, large living room with fireplace, an office, guest room suite, multiple spaces off the bright white kitchen with marble counters and high end appliances. Don't miss the cozy eat in area complete with a fireplace - a space ideal for intimate gatherings. Five bedrooms and three and a half updated baths, provides ample space for family and friends.  The finished basement offers a versatile playroom and extra living space plus an attached two-car garage provides convenience and storage. Enjoy the peace and tranquility of the fabulous private outdoor space, perfect for entertaining on the large blue stone patio or simply relaxing with a book. Enjoy waterfront moments through Tokeneke and enjoy the serene setting while being a short walk from downtown Darien and the train. This home is not just a place to live, but a lifestyle that promises comfort, luxury, and a sense of community. Make 2 Dogwood Lane your new haven in Darien!

Located in one of Darien's favorite neighborhoods, this sun-drenched beauty is set on a flat half-acre lot abutting the Darien Land Trust. At the back of the property, you'll find a gate that opens to the Darien Nature Center paths and all the fun amenities at Cherry Lawn Park, like playgrounds, gardens, and courts for tennis and pickleball. Inside is 3,656 square feet of comfortable living space. The heart of this home is the high-end chef's kitchen, complete with a pantry and modern appliances. A formal living room with fireplace, large family room, office, and mud room round out the first floor.  Upstairs, the primary suite offers cathedral ceilings, a private balcony, multiple closets, and a luxurious bathroom featuring an oversized shower and a jacuzzi tub. The second floor also offers 3 generously sized bedrooms and two full baths.  Move right into this beautifully updated home close to park, town, schools, and transportation.

Tucked away on the highly desirable cul-de-sac (with all buried utilities!) on Holly Pond, this beautifully updated home offers nearly 4,000 sf of stylish and sun-filled living space. The heart of the home is the designer kitchen, newly renovated and opens to a bright breakfast room, connecting seamlessly to the upstairs vaulted playroom and other expansive living areas. A stunning floor to ceiling glassed family room, recently renovated with a built-in bar, is perfect for entertaining and everyday comfort. The large living room with fireplace is perfect for those cozy winter nights and the formal dining room is perfect for those special gatherings. Five spacious bedrooms provide generous accommodations, including the spectacular vaulted and secluded primary suite with three walls of large glass windows giving views of Holly Pond, custom walk-in closets, and a spa-inspired newly renovated marble bath with heated floors. There are four additional generously sized bedrooms, including a newly redone in-law suite with bath and private entry. Beyond the interiors, the grounds unfold into a true resort-like retreat. Deeded access only for launching kayaks or your favorite water toy. The expansive, flat, and shaded backyard features a large sports court, a new 2021 elegant stone entertaining patio, and a fully appointed outdoor kitchen with Lynx grill for the ultimate in privacy and sophistication.

Nestled on a peaceful cul-de-sac in the highly sought-after Tokeneke School District, this charming 3-bedroom Colonial offers a perfect blend of classic style and modern comfort. Set on nearly an acre of beautifully landscaped grounds, the home features a private, picturesque back patio oasis-ideal for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying nature year-round.  Taken down to the studs in 2004, 6 Queens Lane feels fresh and new. Inside, a stunningly renovated kitchen opens seamlessly to the dining room and living room, creating a warm, inviting space for everyday living and special gatherings. There is also spacious family room with soaring ceilings and abundant natural light-perfect for cozy movie nights or entertaining.  The thoughtfully designed main floor includes a luxurious primary bedroom suite, offering convenience and privacy with an en-suite bath and generous closet space. Upstairs, you'll find two large bedrooms, a full bath, and a home office-ideal for remote work or homework stations.  This home combines comfort, space, and functionality in an idyllic setting, just minutes from schools, shops, and commuting options. A rare opportunity to own a turnkey property in one of Darien's most desirable neighborhoods.

Welcome to 66 Stanton Rd! Yes, that fabulous home with the beautiful VT slate roof! Sitting proudly atop 1.34 manicured acres, this handsome 1938 clapboard clad colonial demands to be noticed. This house underwent a major renovation and expansion that was completed in 2009. Entertaining spaces abound both formal and casual, perfect for hosting both gatherings intimate and large in scale. Step into the generous entrance hall with a gracious curving stairway that sweeps upwards to the second-floor landing that mirrors the curve of the staircase. The South facing front of the house has formal living and dining rooms that flank the entry foyer. The open plan kitchen/family room features a large pantry space, double ovens, Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, a walnut island and separate dining area. Step down into the wood paneled family room with vaulted ceiling, exposed beams, fireplace and a wall of windows looking over the back yard. Just off the kitchen is a generous wet bar with a second dishwasher and desk space.  The spacious primary suite has a vaulted ceiling, separate dressing/closet area and a reading porch! The sun filled bathroom has an oversized steam shower with rain shower, hand-held, and wall mounted shower heads, as well as a soaking tub. There are 5 additional bedrooms on the second floor, 2 ensuite and 2 share a Jack/Jill bath, one that has a coveted sleeping loft. Also on the second level is a study/lounge area and the walk-up attic has ample storage capacity.

Beautifully maintained 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom Cape Cod home nestled on Old Stone Road in the heart of Darien just a very short distance to the Darien Train station, Whole Foods and the new Corbin District. This home offers the perfect blend of small-town charm and modern convenience including an updated kitchen with new appliances, a dedicated work-from-home space, and abundant natural light throughout. French doors lead to the fully fenced-in backyard complete with a spacious patio perfect for outdoor dining and entertaining. Award winning schools and beautiful beaches make #4 Old Stone Road a place to call home.

Welcome to 10 Duffys Lane - A Classic Colonial Gem in a Prime Location! Nestled on a coveted cul-de-sac just one block from Hindley Elementary School, this chic 5 bedroom, 3 bath center hall Colonial offers the perfect blend of timeless charm and modern luxury. Conveniently located near beaches, shops, YMCA, train and top rated schools, this home is ideal for those seeking both style and convenience. Extensively renovated in 2007, the heart of the home is the stunning open-concept kitchen, complete with a large center island and custom cabinetry, flowing seamlessly into the inviting family room-ideal for everyday living and effortless entertaining. The main level also features a versatile fifth bedroom or office, providing flexible space to suit your needs. The primary suite is a true sanctuary, complete with a spacious walk in closet and spa like bathroom featuring a stand alone shower and soaking tub. The finished lower level is designed for fun and functionality, offering recreation space, an exercise area, laundry room and cozy play nook. Sliding glass doors open to the back yard oasis. Enjoy summer days by the gunite pool, relax on the stone terrace, and rinse off in the outdoor shower, or tend to the fenced vegetable garden-perfect for the green thumb in the family. This is a great property for play and entertaining.

Spectacular new primary bath and full house refresh. Light-filled center hall colonial set on a quiet cul-de-sac, walking distance to water and Tokeneke School. The two-story foyer leads into generous dining and living rooms with French doors to front porch. The heart of the home is the gourmet kitchen with spacious dining area open to the family room with soaring ceiling and stone fireplace. French doors lead out to a large deck perfect for entertaining. Butler's pantry with second dishwasher, wine refrigerator and walk-in pantry. A spacious, private office/den, laundry room and 1.5 baths complete the first floor. 5 bedrooms and 3 full baths upstairs. The Primary bedroom boasts two walk-in closets and a gracious en-suite bathroom. Finished lower level with mudroom and lots of storage.

This newly re-built 4-bedroom, 3-bath Colonial offers 2400 sq feet of finely crafted living space on a level .25-acre lot. Set on the corner of Anthony Lane and a cul-de-sac, the property pairs neighborhood charm with privacy. Enjoy the outdoors in a newly fenced yard with professional landscaping and a full irrigation system. Inside, the open layout is defined by natural light and superior craftsmanship. White oak floors run throughout the home, complemented by custom millwork and oversized windows. The living room's fireplace, framed by built-in cabinetry, provides both warmth and architectural interest.The chef's kitchen impresses with custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and high-performance energy-efficient appliances. A large mudroom with integrated laundry is designed for durability and organization. A first-floor bedroom offers versatility as an office, guest suite, den or playroom. The full bath is finished with frameless glass shower ensuring comfort and style. Upstairs, three bedrooms feature ample closets and abundant light. The hall bath includes a glass-enclosed tub/shower, dual windows, heated floor. The primary suite features two large closets and bath highlighted by a walk-in shower, heated floors, double sink vanity and polished finishes. With zoned propane heating, central air, and a balance of classic proportions and modern amenities this home combines elegance and functionality less than one mile to shops, dining and transportation of Noroton Heights.

listings.remarks: Opportunity awaits on this picturesque side street nestled in one of Darien's charming neighborhoods. Originally built in 1926, this impeccably maintained Colonial sits on a lovely, level lot, complete with a fully fenced backyard, professionally landscaped gardens and stone patio. The home seamlessly blends timeless vintage character-including thoughtful millwork, custom built-ins, and antique hardwood floors throughout-with the contemporary functionality of an updated kitchen and two renovated full baths. Generous walk-through living and dining rooms offer flexible space, with a sunlight filled den/ office rounding out the first floor. Upstairs, three generously sized bedrooms offer comfort and privacy, while thoughtfully finished spaces in both the basement and attic provide versatile options for work or leisure. A large, detached two car garage offers yet more storage. Ideally situated near Holmes Elementary and Middlesex Middle School, as well as Woodland Park, the property affords easy access to Noroton Heights Train Station and the vibrant new Darien Commons and Heights Crossing shopping districts, further elevating the convenience and allure of this exceptional home.

25 Tokeneke Trail - Where the Sky meets the Sea. Wake up to breathtaking sunrises, spend afternoons on the water, and end each day with sunset views from your private terrace. 25 Tokeneke Trail isn't just a home-it's a lifestyle. Perfectly perched above the shoreline and not in a flood zone, this stunning waterfront retreat offers direct access to the water with its own private beach and dock. Designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, nearly every room frames panoramic water views. Multiple stone terraces, a firepit, and lush landscaping create the perfect setting for entertaining or quiet relaxation. Inside, over 6,000 sq. ft. of refined living space includes five bedrooms, seven baths, and a private studio suite over the detached garage ideal for a guest house or private retreat. Minutes from downtown Darien and the train to NYC, this rare property blends the serenity of coastal living with the best of modern luxury.

Virtually new following a complete 2024 redesign, this quality-built 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath modern Colonial was extensively rebuilt and expanded to offer three levels of thoughtfully designed living space and an open floor plan ideal for today's lifestyle. The first floor features a bright living and dining area, a custom kitchen with breakfast bar, and a family room with fireplace that opens to a private outdoor patio-perfect for indoor-outdoor entertaining. A separate laundry room adds everyday convenience. The second level is highlighted by a luxurious primary suite with a spa-like bathroom, including a soaking tub, separate shower, and walk-in closet, along with two additional bedrooms and a full hall bath. A bonus room on the upper level provides flexible space for a home office, gym, or playroom. This home offers peace of mind and exceptional comfort with all new mechanicals, electrical, HVAC, high-efficiency gas boiler, spray foam insulation, new Marvin windows, cedar shingle siding, PVC exterior trim, and architect-grade roof shingles. Ideally located just two blocks from the train station in the reimagined Noroton Heights section of Darien, you'll enjoy close proximity to Heights Crossing and Darien Commons developments that offering shopping, dining venues, including The Goddard School all set within one of the East Coast's most sought-after communities.

Townhouse-style condo in the desirable Villager Pond community offering a prime Darien location and thoughtful updates. The inviting living room with fireplace flows into the dining area and kitchen, ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The spacious primary bedroom features a vaulted ceiling, generous closet space, plus attic and crawl-space storage. Enjoy a private outdoor patio and the rare convenience of an attached one-car garage with interior access. Recent upgrades include a renovated upstairs bath, new windows, water heater, and refrigerator. Community amenities include a pool and clubhouse. Located in a coastal town with access to local beaches, along with recent additions of in-town shopping and dining, plus proximity to a movie theater, Whole Foods, Cherry Lawn Park, Trader Joe's, downtown Darien, and the Metro-North station.

listings.remarks: Welcome home to 16 Dubois! This lovely Cape exudes charm and character throughout. Bright filled rooms with special built-ins, newer kitchen and baths, hardwood floors, wood burning fireplace, freshly painted interior and a 4th bedroom added and expanded guest bathroom, all of this on a highly desirable street. The exterior boasts an attached two car garage, cedar shingles, copper gutters and a flagstone patio surrounded by a vintage stone wall. Walking distance to award winning Hindley School, Noroton Heights train station, two town beaches and the new Darien Commons and soon to be completed Heights Crossing development. The home is completely turn-key and ready for its new owners.

Welcome to 20 Denhurst Place - a lovingly maintained Colonial proudly owned by the same family since it was built. Perfectly situated on a quiet private street in highly sought-after Darien, this inviting home combines comfort, convenience, and timeless charm. Enjoy a premier location just a short walk to Holmes Elementary School and the Glenbrook Train Station, with easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and the brand-new Darien Commons shopping and dining center and Noroton Heights Train Station (Darien). Sunlight fills the home's well-designed spaces, showcasing beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The spacious family room features a cozy wood-burning fireplace and opens directly to the screened porch - perfect for morning coffee, reading, or summer entertaining. The updated kitchen boasts granite counters and newer stainless-steel appliances. Upstairs, the serene primary suite offers a walk-in closet and beautiful treetop views. The level lot provides a private, usable backyard with room to play or garden. PLUS, attached two-car garage, CENTRAL AIR, GAS heat and stove. A full unfinished basement with high ceilings provides endless potential for a playroom, gym, workshop, or creative retreat. Laundry and a powder room conveniently adjoin the kitchen area. A rare opportunity to own a cherished home in a coveted neighborhood with award-winning schools and unbeatable access to everything Darien has to offer. Don't miss out - it won't last long.

Charming 1920's colonial-style gem with enclosed front porch and an open floor plan, accented by handcrafted built-ins and oversized windows, creating a bright, airy space that's perfect for hosting lively gatherings or simply enjoying the comforts of everyday life. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances and granite countertops, and has beautiful views of the private rear yard.  Step outside through the mudroom adjoining the kitchen, and you'll find an enchanting outdoor retreat. Relax on the deck, surrounded by beautifully landscaped grounds, stone walls, and vibrant blooms, all offering a sense of privacy and tranquility. A large, detached two-car garage with overhead storage provides additional convenience. Upstairs, there are three spacious bedrooms with hardwood flooring. The primary bedroom features a spacius walk in closet with built-ins. Both bathrooms feature tubs with showers. The lower level has a separate entrance and features a half bath and storage utility room. Nestled on a quiet side street, this home is a commuter's dream -- just a short walk to the Noroton Heights train station for easy access to NYC. Also walking distance is Middlesex Middle School, as well as local shops, markets, Equinox gym, and lovely restaurants. Move right in and enjoy all Darien has to offer, including top-rated public schools that are consistently ranked among the best in the state. Highest and best bids due Sunday at 6pm, please.

19 Edgerton Street in Darien, Connecticut, is a charming Cape Cod-style home situated in the desirable Noroton Heights neighborhood. Built in 1949, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom residence offers 2,083 square feet of living space on a 0.25-acre lot. This home features a large living room with wood burning fireplace, a spacious eat-in kitchen, and abundant natural light throughout. A rear deck is accessible from the kitchen and family room, providing a perfect space for outdoor relaxation and entertaining. There is also a large basement with ample storage. The interior has been recently painted, enhancing its bright and inviting atmosphere. The property is conveniently located within walking distance to the Noroton Heights Metro-North train station, schools, and shopping areas.

Experience luxury, privacy, and convenience at Middlesex Commons. This coveted end-unit condo is ideally set at the back of the community on the circle, offering rare quiet, space, and a serene setting. With two spacious bedrooms plus a sun-filled dedicated office, the home also offers a unique opportunity to convert to a three-bedroom layout without sacrificing living space. Dramatic two-story living room windows frame peaceful views of the fountain pond and fill the home with natural light. Outside, a private deck and rare side yard create a true sense of green space, perfect for play, pets, or relaxing outdoors. Owned by the same family since it was built, the home has been rebuilt from the studs and transformed with a refined modern aesthetic. Every finish is brand new, including pale oak flooring, a white eat-in kitchen with white and pale gray quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and an elegant painted wood-paneled powder room. Each bedroom features its own en suite bath for comfort and privacy. The primary suite bath is a true retreat, featuring Calacatta Gold chevron marble floors, a low-iron glass walk-in shower, freestanding soaking tub, and fluted-front vanity. A pool, pool house, and guest cottage enhance the resort-style feel and provide a welcoming retreat for overnight guests. Just steps to the train and Darien's newly revitalized downtown, this is sophisticated, low-maintenance living in one of Middlesex Commons' most desirable locations.

listings.remarks: This is a rare opportunity to build the home of your dreams on Long Neck Point - one of the most sought after and picturesque communities on the Eastern Seaboard! As part of a 4 unit subdivision, you will have shared use of two boat docks and Long Island Sound access! Your newly constructed home will enjoy amazing views to Gorham's Pond and Long Island Sound. Walk or bike to Pear Tree Point or Darien's newest Great Island Park. Perfectly proximate to town, beaches, shopping, dining and schools. Darien residents enjoy terrific parks, nature center, two unique beaches, paddle tennis, senior activities and additional amazing amenities; many dog friendly as well! Bring your architect and start planning!

Welcome to a perfect blend of warmth, elegance, and modern sophistication. Nestled on a private road in a coveted neighborhood in Darien, this 4,500-square-foot home is an entertainer's paradise, offering both inviting coziness and refined luxury. The beautifully landscaped half-acre lot boasts lush hydrangeas, mature trees, a bluestone patio with outdoor dining, fire pit, and a welcoming front porch-creating an ideal outdoor haven. Inside, the seamless flow of formal living spaces is perfect for hosting holidays and gatherings. The eat-in kitchen, c.omplete with a large center island, opens to a spacious family room with fireplace, dedicated office, and additional flexible space, perfect for playroom, craft room, or second office. A light-filled sunroom, with radiant-heated floors provides direct access to the back patio, offering pure serenity for quiet moments. A generous mudroom provides ample storage for everyone. Upstairs, you'll find five well-proportioned bedrooms, including a stunning primary suite. This luxurious retreat features its own private roof deck, two walk-in closets, and a spa-like bathroom with a steam shower and freestanding tub. Rounding out the second floor is a laundry room and spacious bonus room perfect for a home gym, media room or additional guest suite. This home is more than just a residence-it's a lifestyle. Perfectly situated steps from town and train for ultimate convenience, yet also offers a private sanctuary where you can truly unwind.

Sunlit Colonial with extra high ceilings and great light on .36 landscaped acres is set up high on a quiet street near Tokeneke and Rowayton. Professional decorating is apparent throughout the whole house. Double height entryway unfolds to formal living and dining rooms boasting 10' ceilings and venetian plaster walls. Updated sunlit kitchen / family room with breakfast area opens to lovely terrace and yard. Primary suite with luxury bathroom and walk in closets. En suite double bedroom with tray ceiling and 2 additional double bedrooms that share a hall bath. Finished lower level with high ceilings is perfect playroom and exercise room. Cedar closet and storage closets galore finish off the LL. Updated systems, full house generator, 2 car garage. Don't miss this wonderful home!

Welcome to 25 Gardiner Street - a stunning modern farmhouse thoughtfully blending contemporary elegance with timeless design. Offering three full floors of living space plus a beautifully finished basement, this 6-bedroom home is ideal for both relaxed living and effortless entertaining. Step inside to find soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and high-end finishes throughout. The open-concept kitchen and living area features premium appliances, custom cabinetry, and a large island - all flowing seamlessly to the private backyard oasis. Enjoy outdoor living with a heated gunite pool, spa hot tub, and spacious patio, perfect for entertaining or quiet evenings at home. This versatile home includes two dedicated office spaces, a gym, and generous storage on every level. The attached two-car garage is complemented by an additional detached garage, offering extra space for parking or hobbies. Located close to town, train, and schools, 25 Gardiner Street is a rare opportunity to experience luxury, flexibility, and comfort in the heart of Darien.

Old-World Charm Meets Modern Living. Step into a special place where timeless character blends seamlessly with contemporary comforts. Renovated and expanded in 2009, this spacious home features a generous open floor plan ideal for both intimate gatherings and large celebrations. At the heart of the home is a chef's kitchen, complete with a large professional range, dual sinks, and separate workstations - a true culinary dream. Dine fireside in the cozy kitchen or enjoy meals in the elegant antique dining room. Casually watch TV by the fire in the family room that includes a wet bar with fridge and ice maker. Flexible living spaces include an office and a bonus room, perfect for work, play, or fitness. Upstairs, you'll find ample room for family and guests with 5 to 6 bedrooms. Outside, enjoy a beautifully landscaped, private half-acre lot, designed for both relaxation and entertaining. Conveniently located near many amenities, this is more than just a home - it's a place to make memories.  Come experience it for yourself - from the very first step through the door.

BEST BUY IN DARIEN! Sweet and Petite 2 bedroom home on  private road in desirable Darien. Easy one level living includes updated appliances. Large sliders in kitchen open to fenced rear yard with storage shed. This is a marvelous alternative to restrictive condominium living so bring your pets! Enjoy "as is" or expand and grow your home on this double lot in the popular Noroton Heights area. Around the corner is Darien Commons where there's an array of fine shops and eateries. It's just steps to the Noroton station with express trains to NYC. The Darien lifestyle offers award winning schools, scenic beaches, gourmet dining and much more. This is a rare opportunity so come visit soon!

Welcome to this Beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath colonial nestled on a peaceful cul-de-sac in one of the area's most desirable neighborhoods. With its classic curb appeal, inviting front porch, and thoughtfully designed layout, this home offers comfort, style, and room to grow. Step inside to discover high ceilings and an abundance of natural light that enhance the spacious feel of the main living areas. The open-concept kitchen and family room provide the perfect setting for entertaining, while formal living and dining rooms offer elegant spaces for gatherings. Four generously sized bedrooms upstairs, including a beautiful primary suite with an oversized bathroom and ample closet space. A fun finished basement featuring a built in bar for entertaining and a full bathroom for guests to stay over. Out back, enjoy a private, fenced yard ideal for outdoor entertaining which includes an organic, misting system to keep your yard bug free! Whether you're sipping coffee on the front porch or hosting a summer barbecue in the backyard, this home offers the perfect blend of serenity and community. Award winning Hindley School district.

Back on the Market after improvements! Gorgeous Nantucket-Style Retreat with Spacious Layout & Private Backyard Set behind stately stone pillars, this stunning Nantucket shingle-style home, fully renovated in 2011, offers timeless curb appeal and modern comforts throughout. With 4 bedrooms, 3 full baths, and thoughtfully updated newer construction, this home is designed for today's lifestyle. The heart of the home is the beautifully updated eat-in kitchen, which flows seamlessly into a generous family room, formal dining room, and large living room-ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. A versatile first-floor office or 5th bedroom provides flexibility for guests or work-from-home needs. Upstairs, you'll find spacious bedrooms, including a serene primary suite and bonus/rec room with added french doors for privacy. A two-car garage and ample driveway space ensure plenty of parking for family and guests. Step outside to an expansive patio with fire pit and an enormous private backyard -perfect for summer gatherings, play, or peaceful outdoor living. This exceptional property blends classic coastal charm with modern convenience. A true gem you won't want to miss! Located in the brand new Ox Ridge School District.

Welcome to 333 West Avenue, a stunning four-bedroom, four-bathroom home in the Noroton Green Association. Inside, you'll find over 3,600 square feet of beautifully finished living space with high ceilings, custom millwork, and oversized windows that fill the home with natural light. The open-concept main level is perfect for both everyday living and entertaining, featuring a spacious living and dining area that flows seamlessly into a gourmet kitchen equipped with high-end appliances, sleek countertops, and custom cabinetry. French doors lead out to a private stone terrace. Upstairs, the primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat with a luxurious en-suite bathroom and a generous walk-in closet. Three additional bedrooms and a bonus room offer ample space for family, guests, or a home office. A two-car garage, beautifully landscaped grounds, and the ease of HOA-covered maintenance complete this turn-key lifestyle. Conveniently located to Darien Commons and Noroton Heights train station, this home is a must see!

listings.remarks: Light, space and convenience define this townhouse in award winning Middlesex Commons- adjacent to Whole Foods and a short walk to the Darien Metro North station. The foyer, with custom cabinetry and bookshelves, leads to an open living/dining room with soaring two story windows, a fireplace, and sliders to a private west facing deck overlooking landscaped open space. The eat-in kitchen enjoys bright southeastern light throughout the morning. The primary bedroom features a cathedral ceiling with skylight, a spacious bath with tub and shower, and a private balcony. A second bedroom also offers a cathedral ceiling and skylight as well as a full bath. An office nook sits at the top of the graceful, curved staircase. A detached one car garage and plentiful parking accompany the home. The beautifully maintained ten-acre grounds include sweeping lawns, a pond, a saltwater, heated pool, pool house and a charming guest cottage for visitors. Restaurants, shops, drug stores, boutiques and the Darien Library are all within an easy walk.

listings.remarks: Brand New Home in the Heart of Town. Discover this exceptional 6-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom new construction, thoughtfully crafted with the highest quality materials and meticulous attention to detail. Designed for both comfort and sophistication, this home offers a spacious, open flow ideal for today's lifestyle. Enjoy the prime location - just a short walk to town, trains, shops, and restaurants. Everything you need is right at your doorstep. Backyard offers an oasis...Set on a rare and expansive lot, the home features a huge, private backyard with access to Stony Brook South cul-de-sac. Key Features: 6 generous bedrooms with ample closets & 5.5 bathrooms  Bright, airy open-concept living spaces. Chef's kitchen with top-tier finishes. Luxurious primary suite with spa-inspired bath. Superior construction from an experienced, detail-driven local builder. House will be completed October 2025 - Secure your dream home now and be the first to enjoy this rare new construction in one of the most convenient locations.

Set on 9.4 acres, this exceptional estate offers a private, sophisticated retreat at the end of a Bradford pear-lined gravel drive. The property includes a 10,000-square-foot main residence with pool and pool house, a two-bedroom guest cottage, and a remarkable field house designed by architect Louise Brooks. The main house blends timeless elegance with modern design, while the field house delivers a one-of-a-kind recreational and entertaining experience, featuring an indoor batting cage, two-lane bowling alley, resistance pool, and stylish lounge spaces. This offering is for all three parcels, each with its own address and private entrance, offering rare flexibility, exclusivity, and privacy.

Perched high in the coveted Delafield Island Association, this beautiful colonial with pool and cabana offers a rare combination of privacy, natural light, and effortless indoor outdoor living. Inspired by the relaxed elegance of a California design, the home unfolds with open, airy spaces and dramatic scale. A spectacular two-story wall of windows fills the eat in kitchen with sunlight, creating a striking focal point and connecting the home beautifully to the surrounding landscape. On the other hand, the family room features an oversized fireplace and expansive views of the backyard, with seasonal views of Scott Cove adding to the sense of place. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the living room, creating a natural gathering space at the heart of the home. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a deck overlooking the pool, walk in closet and private bath, complemented by four additional bedrooms that provide flexibility for family, guests and a designated office that opens out to a porch. The windows throughout this home make this home sundrenched! Outside, the property truly shines. An expansive level lawn leads to a heated gunite pool and fully equipped cabana with sink, refrigerator, lighting, bathroom, and storage. Whether hosting summer gatherings or enjoying quiet afternoons locally by the water, the setting is designed for relaxed coastal living. A premier Delafield Island location close to town, train, and beaches, makes this a truly special offering.

This gracious Colonial blends timeless 1930s charm with thoughtful modern updates, ideally located on one of Darien's most sought-after in-town streets, known for its traditions and strong sense of community. Set on a level, one-acre property in a coveted half-acre zone, the home offers rare expansion potential and exceptional lifestyle appeal.Extensively renovated and expanded, the home features a reimagined layout designed for today's living. The updated kitchen with custom cabinetry, granite countertops, and high-end appliances opens seamlessly to the family room with fireplace. A butler's pantry, walk-in pantry, mudroom, and dedicated home office add both functionality and convenience. A versatile room above the garage offers flexible living space, ideal as a fifth bedroom, guest retreat, or potential in-law suite. Recent improvements include renovated bathrooms and a luxurious primary suite with spa-like bath featuring heated floors, soaking tub, marble walk-in shower, and custom built-ins. Mechanical upgrades include multiple air handlers, updated HVAC systems, full-house generator, new boiler and hot water heater, and replaced roof & windows. Classic details such as original hardwood floors and elegant millwork preserve the home's character throughout. The private, level property is framed by mature plantings and features a thoughtfully designed patio-ideal for entertaining, recreation, or future expansion. A rare combination of location, land, community & charm

Spectacular quintessential New England home in Darien has it all! Step into a world of refined elegance with this stately 8,000+SF Colonial masterpiece. Set back on nearly two acres of manicured grounds, boasting a custom 2021 Gunite pool, outdoor kitchen, new patio, huge backyard and firepit, this treasured residence is the ultimate venue for indoor & outdoor living and entertaining. The main level features a soaring 2-story foyer that transitions into a formal living room w/fireplace & stunning formal dining room w/ butlers pantry, wet bar, wine fridge & food pantry. Step into the chef's kitchen w/ 16ft marble island, Miele range, dual Sub-zeros & sun-drenched breakfast area. The kitchen flows into a massive family room w/ stone fireplace & adjoining sunroom w/ 25ft stone fireplace w/French doors to backyard & pool. There's a large, office w/ custom paneling & coffered ceiling, a mudroom w/built-ins, plus a full bath, a powder room and back staircase to upper level rooms. The 2nd floor primary suite is a private sanctuary, defined by 11-foot barrel vaulted ceilings, a fireplace, 2 walk-in closets and a spa-inspired marble bath w/double sink, soaking tub & steam shower. There are 4 additional en-suite bedrooms, a laundry room & open space for study/gaming. The 3rd floor has over 2,400sqft of storage/ potential living space!

Located at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in Darien, this updated 5-bedroom Colonial combines space, comfort, and convenience. The main level features a newly renovated eat-in kitchen with modern finishes and ample space for everyday living and casual entertaining. Upstairs, there are five bedrooms, including a primary suite with an updated bath and a full wall of custom closets with sleek sliding doors. The walk-out basement adds flexibility, complete with a wine cellar and additional space ideal for a rec room, gym, or private in-law suite. Outdoor spaces are equally inviting, with a deck just off the kitchen for outdoor dining and a backyard fire pit for relaxed evenings. Conveniently located within walking distance to downtown, Metro-North, Royle Elementary School, and Tilley Pond Park, this home offers a quiet setting with easy access to everything Darien has to offer. A rare rental opportunity that truly feels like home!

listings.remarks: This highly desirable corner Norwood unit, with a newly redone private patio and secluded backyard is located in a great spot in the Kensett community. The 4 bedroom unit has high-end finishes throughout including professional appliances, extra thick granite countertops and beautiful plantation shutters. The light filled open floor plan with high ceilings invites casual entertaining or cozy time in front of the beautiful gas fireplace. The main floor sun room with two walls of windows and additional fireplace affords private space for a home office. Upstairs the luxurious master suite has a huge walk-in closet with built-ins, and a beautiful master bath with a soaking tub, large shower and double marble topped vanity. Two additional large bedrooms, both with private baths and walk-in closets complete the second floor. The lower level has large finished area for entertainment or recreation. There is another study area with a full bath and walk- in closet which could be an additional office or 4th bedroom. There is additional storage space and an owner's locked closet. Come enjoy the easy, highly energy efficient life style at Kensett including a heated pool, clubhouse, fitness center and firepit. The complex abuts a 4 acre land trust complete with walking trails.

listings.remarks: This lovingly maintained four-bedroom, three-and-a-half bathroom home is the ideal blend of comfort, convenience and natural surroundings. Filled with natural light from its north-south exposure, 34 Intervale Road features nine-foot ceilings, refinished hardwood floors, and generously proportioned living spaces throughout. Recent renovations include master bathroom and powder room, quartz countertops in both the kitchen and wet bar, new kitchen backsplash, along with basement flooring. Mechanical upgrades include a full-house generator, new air handler, boiler, and newer hot water heater - all connected to natural gas. Enjoy outdoor living on the deck overlooking a private backyard that abuts Woodland Park, offering more than 60 acres of trails and open space. Located in one of Darien's most adored neighborhoods, it's walkable to all three schools, Noroton Heights train, shopping, and restaurants. A true move-in ready home in a prime Darien location.

Masterfully renovated and expanded by renowned architect Chad Nehring, this 1929 Colonial features a chef's kitchen boasting a centerpiece 10' island, heated gunite pool, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Set on beautifully landscaped, private, and fully fenced-in grounds and thoughtfully designed for both elegant entertaining and everyday comfort. This home offers a gracious living room with wood-burning fireplace, formal dining room with custom paneling and hand-painted walls, and a stunning kitchen with Vermont White quartzite countertops, custom cabinetry, GE Monogram appliances, Viking refrigerator and freezer columns, dual Bosch dishwashers, and a well-appointed bar area. Completing the main level is a family room with custom built-ins, a music room for your grand piano, a private office with three desk areas, and a thoughtfully designed mudroom and powder room with radiant heated floors. French doors from the family room open to an expansive bluestone and granite terrace with custom stonework and outdoor kitchen, overlooking the private yard and heated 16'X32' pool with automatic cover. Upstairs, the primary suite features a spa-like bath with soaking tub, oversized shower, radiant heated floors and custom walk-in closet. Three additional bedrooms and two full baths complete the second level. A finished third floor with full bath offers flexibility for a guest suite, office or playroom, while the lower level includes a gym, gaming room, and recreation area.
