listings.remarks: Welcome to 171 Raymond Street - a beautifully updated 3-bedroom home offering the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience. The main level features an open floor plan designed for modern living, seamlessly connecting the beautifully renovated kitchen, family room, and dining area. The kitchen is thoughtfully updated with quality finishes and flows effortlessly into the main living spaces, creating an inviting atmosphere for both everyday living and entertaining. The spacious primary suite provides a peaceful retreat, complemented by two additional well-appointed bedrooms. A fully finished and permitted lower level adds valuable living space - ideal for a media room, playroom, home office, or gym. Step outside to enjoy the expansive outdoor area, complete with a generous dining patio perfect for entertaining, relaxing, and enjoying warm evenings with family and friends. Conveniently located just minutes from Rowayton Village, downtown Darien, and a variety of shopping and dining options, this home offers exceptional lifestyle appeal in a prime location.

Welcome to 473 Hollow Tree Ridge Road in Darien - a custom built, stone and shingle Colonial set on 1.3 professionally landscaped acres offering exceptional indoor and outdoor living. This 5-bedroom smart home blends timeless architecture with extensive upgrades and modern technology throughout. The resort-style backyard features a pool with spa, pool house with nano doors, outdoor shower, custom outdoor bar, Lynx grill, fireplace, and covered patio. A slate roof, horseshoe driveway, whole-house 25kW Generac generator, and oversized 3-car garage with heated epoxy floors, built-ins, and wainscoting provide both convenience and peace of mind. The fully remodeled kitchen includes a Wolf range, additional wall oven, Sub-Zero double refrigerator/freezer, double islands with prep sink and second dishwasher, Negresco granite and quartz countertops, island seating, and a wet bar with glass dishwasher and ice maker. A paneled office, homework stations, guest/au pair suite with private access, oversized mudroom, laundry, and two powder rooms complete the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite features a renovated spa bath with heated floors, freestanding tub, oversized shower with rain head, and custom walk-in closets. Two additional ensuite bedrooms, a fourth bedroom with hall bath, game room with full wet bar, media room, and office/workstations provide flexible living.

Welcome to 66 Stanton Road. Set on 1.34 landscaped acres, this classic 1938 clapboard colonial blends architectural charm with thoughtful updates, including a full renovation and expansion completed in 2009. Designed for effortless living and entertaining, the home offers refined formal rooms and relaxed gathering spaces. A gracious foyer with sweeping curved staircase is flanked by sunlit living and dining rooms. The open kitchen and family room anchor the home, featuring Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, double ovens, a walnut island, generous pantry, and casual dining area. A vaulted, wood-paneled family room with exposed beams, fireplace, and a wall of windows overlooks the backyard. A wet bar with second dishwasher and built-in desk sits just off the kitchen. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers a vaulted ceiling, dressing area, reading porch, and spa-like bath with steam shower and soaking tub. Five additional bedrooms include two en suites and a Jack-and-Jill layout, plus a flexible lounge/study area and walk-up attic storage. The lower level includes a bar, fireplace lounge, climate-controlled wine room, and full gym. Outdoor living shines with a screened porch, patio with grill, and a recently added gunite pool with spa and electric cover. Lush lawns and vibrant plantings create privacy and seasonal color for both quiet enjoyment and lively gatherings.

Located on a quiet cul-de-sac in Darien's sought-after Ox Ridge School district, this inviting 4 bedroom home offers timeless character, privacy, and versatile living. Sun-filled living spaces and a well-designed floor plan enhance everyday comfort while maintaining the home's character. The primary bedroom features a fireplace, creating a warm and inviting retreat, complemented by three additional bedrooms thoughtfully arranged for family or guests. Adding to the home's versatility is a 2-bedroom guest cottage, connected to the main house by a breezeway-ideal for extended family, visiting guests, au pair living, or a private home office. Outside, beautifully landscaped, park-like grounds surround a heated pool and patio, providing the perfect setting for relaxation and entertaining. A rare opportunity in one of Darien's most desirable neighborhoods.

Classic Ranch on Expansive Park-Like Acre+ in one of Darien's Most Sought-after Neighborhoods. Nestled on a prime 1.08-acre property, this home offers the perfect backdrop for your dream lifestyle. The light-filled formal living room, highlighted by a wood-burning fireplace and custom built-ins, flows seamlessly into the inviting family room with rich wood paneling and a second wood-burning fireplace, ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The spacious eat-in kitchen features a center island with granite countertops and casual dining area, opening to the formal dining room or the bright sunroom and rear deck, perfect for dining al fresco overlooking the expansive private property. The primary suite provides a true santuary, complete with walk-in closets and primary bath. Three additional spacious bedrooms, all with hardwood floors, share a well-appointed hall bath with double sink vanity and tub/shower. The walk-out lower level features a generous recreation room with bay window and full bath, opening to a back patio for endless options and hours of fun. A workshop, mudroom and abundant storage areas provide exceptional flexibility and opportunity for additional finished space. Two-car attached garage, new HVAC (2023/2024), and a full house generator. Opportunities abound to renovate, expand, or build the home of your dreams on this exceptional property. Close to schools, trains, Great Island, beaches, clubs, downtown, shopping/dining, golf courses.

An oversized three car garage has masterfully designed storage while an expansive unfinished basement offers abundant space and possibilities...all just steps from town, dining, and shopping.

listings.remarks: This exceptional 5-bedroom, 41/2-bath Nantucket-style Colonial blends refined architecture with relaxed coastal living. Thoughtfully renovated in 2012 by Steven Mueller Architects LLC and refreshed by the current owners in 2021, the home welcomes you with a dramatic two-story foyer and beautifully designed interiors filled with natural light.  Crisp millwork, shiplap detailing, coffered ceilings, and custom built-ins create a timeless backdrop throughout. The elegant yet inviting living spaces include a serene living room centered around a sleek fireplace with symmetrical built-ins and wide-plank floors, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.  Water views from many rooms enhance the home's peaceful coastal setting, filling the interiors with light and openness. Outdoors, elegant bluestone patios, an elevated second-floor deck positioned for sunset views, and professionally landscaped grounds overlook the scenic Five Mile River-an idyllic setting for both quiet moments and memorable gatherings.

Step into the effortless elegance of 23 Greenwood Ave., Darien, CT - a fully renovated 5-bedroom, 21/2-bath home offering approximately 2,200 square feet of light-filled living space designed to be felt as much as seen. From the moment you enter, the warmth of brand-new oak flooring flows underfoot throughout the home, creating a natural sense of comfort and continuity.  At the center of it all, the custom chef's kitchen invites you to gather, cook, and connect. Wrapped in stunning quartz countertops with a dramatic full quartz backsplash, the space is anchored by a striking quartz island-perfect for morning coffee, casual meals, or lively evenings entertaining friends and family.  Upstairs, everyday living feels effortless with a conveniently placed laundry area just steps from the primary bedroom, adding ease and practicality to your daily rhythm.  Step outside and take a deep breath as the backyard opens to the peaceful waterfront of the Noroton River. Here, the setting feels calm and restorative-an ideal backdrop for outdoor dining, quiet mornings, or simply unwinding as the water gently flows beyond your yard.  All of this is just a five-minute drive to the train, making your commute to New York City seamless while allowing you to return home each day to the tranquility and charm of Darien living.  Come experience a home that invites you to slow down, settle in, and truly enjoy where you live.

Set in one of Darien's wonderful neighborhoods known for block parties and classic trick-or-treating, it offers a warm community feel. Freshly painted throughout in 2026 with new windows installed in 2023. Gas heat, public water and public sewer-the perfect trifecta. Just 0.4 miles to award-winning Holmes Elementary (A Rating, Overall Niche Grade), 0.5 miles to Woodland Park Nature Preserve, and 1.2 miles to Noroton Heights Metro-North with direct trains to Grand Central. Enjoy Darien's beach rights, vibrant downtown, and the exciting Noroton Heights village redevelopment with new shops, restaurants, and fitness studios.

Welcome to 3 Abby Road in Darien, a charming four-bedroom Colonial that blends timeless character with a bright, inviting layout. This beautifully maintained home features lovely moldings throughout and an abundance of natural sunlight that fills every room. The main level offers a wonderful open floor plan, creating an easy flow for living and entertaining. Spacious living areas connect seamlessly, making the home feel both comfortable and welcoming. Outside, the property truly shines with its meticulously landscaped, fenced garden and backyard-an ideal setting for relaxing and entertaining. Upstairs, the primary suite provides a private retreat complete with a walk-in closet and en-suite bathroom designed for comfort and relaxation. 3 additional bedrooms and bath complete the second floor. The fully finished lower level adds generous flexible living space-ideal for recreation, hobbies, or a home office. Also features a full laundry room. With bright interiors, modern touches, and classic charm, 3 Abbey Road offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy easy living in one of Darien's most desirable communities.

Nestled on one of Noroton Heights' most sought-after streets, this sun-drenched coastal charmer seamlessly blends classic appeal with thoughtful modern updates. With newly renovated bathrooms, a new deck, and beautifully refinished hardwood floors, this home captures the essence of Darien living with an enviable walk-to-everything location. The fully fenced, level backyard has been lovingly landscaped, creating a private outdoor retreat ideal for entertaining, play, or simply relaxing. The lower level expands the home's living space with 440 square feet of finished recreational area. An adjoining unfinished space provides a dedicated laundry area and abundant storage, bringing the total lower-level footprint to approximately 800 square feet per the tax card. Enjoy an unbeatable location just a short walk to the Noroton Heights train station, Darien Commons, and Heights Crossing, where you'll find an array of restaurants, cafes, boutiques, and everyday conveniences. With easy access to I-95 and close proximity to Middlesex Middle School and Darien High School, this special property offers the perfect balance of neighborhood charm and modern convenience. Don't miss the opportunity to make this gem of a house your new home.

Sun-filled, Beachy Colonial ideally located beside a coveted private cul-de-sac just moments from the Darien train & Darien Commons. Thoughtfully updated with numerous improvements and upgrades, including a stylish, top-of-the-line eat-in kitchen designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining.The open, flexible floor plan offers the rare option of a primary suite on either the main level or the second floor. Four bedrooms and two full baths provide comfortable living, complemented by a formal living room and a bright, elevated office/playroom - perfect as a work-from-home space or Peloton room - set among the treetops with beautiful views. Outside, enjoy a fully fenced yard and inviting patio ideal for gatherings, outdoor dining & relaxed afternoons. The charming private court is known for its welcoming sense of community, hosting block parties and cozy fireside evenings. Enjoy exceptional walkability to the train, restaurants, beaches & town. Located in the award-winning Blue Ribbon Hindley School district. Additional features include a basement with new French drains and sump pump.

Welcome to 13 Wakeman Road, a charming home originally built in 1949 and thoughtfully renovated in 2012 to blend timeless character with modern comforts. The main level boasts an open and inviting floor plan, featuring a spacious eat-in kitchen that flows seamlessly into the family room-perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, you will find a serene primary suite complete with private bath. There are two more generously sized bedrooms which share a newly updated, hall bath. Enjoy over 2900 SF of living, set on a beautifully landscaped 0.28-acre lot. The fenced outdoor living space truly shines! The stone entertainment patio, equipped with a full outdoor kitchen, TV and hot tub, is ideal for hosting gatherings or simply relaxing in your own private oasis. Nestled on a tree lined cul-de-sac with a friendly community vibe, Wakeman Road is more than a home, it's a lifestyle.

Nestled down on one of Darien's most sought after streets, this charming farmhouse offers five bedrooms, three full/one half bath, and lots of privacy. Sun filled interiors create a warm and inviting home a long with many different options to make this a dream property. Steps to Five Mile River and walking distance to Rowayton. Ideally located just minutes from town, train, beaches, this rare offering captures the essence of Darien's coastal lifestyle.

Few homes in Darien offer this combination: five bedrooms, five indoor entertainment spaces, a private elevator, gunite pool, hot tub, and pool cabana with wet bar-all on a private .70-acre lot in the Tokeneke School district. Fully updated 2021-2026 and just a walk to Metro-North and downtown. Spanning three fully finished floors, the main floor is built for living and entertaining: a formal living room with fireplace, sunroom with, family room with fireplace, and a renovated chef's kitchen open to the dining room, featuring new cabinet doors, hardware, countertops, sink, faucet, pantry, and updated lighting. The primary suite features a dressing room and a cedar walk-in closet. Upstairs: home office and home gym. The at-grade lower level-built into natural ledge with no below-grade space-opens via French doors directly to the pool and features a pool entertainment room, three bedrooms, playroom, game room, cabana with wet bar, a mudroom, and two attached garages (a two-car garage and a separate third garage bay). Outside: gunite pool, new hot tub (2025), new pool heater (2024), pool cabana with wet bar and fridge, stone patio, large custom playset, full irrigation, fenced yard, and professional landscaping. listings.remarks: Originally the sole residence on Wildcat Road, this distinguished 1925 stone manor blends timeless architectural elegance with a commanding setting. Located within Darien's coveted Delafield Island private association, the property is approached by a sweeping circular drive and surrounded by mature landscaping offering a rare sense of privacy, grandeur, and permanence, just minutes from downtown Darien, the Metro-North train, beaches, and Great Island.  Rich in character and craftsmanship, the residence showcases architectural details rarely found today, including soaring 12-foot ceilings, a dramatic circular staircase, five fireplaces, Juliet balconies, vintage servant bells, graceful arches, skylights, and a sun-filled glass solarium. Thoughtfully designed for both grand entertaining and comfortable everyday living, the spacious country kitchen opens to an expansive deck overlooking the surrounding natural landscape. Rich hardwood flooring, natural wood beams, intricate moldings, and three fireplaces showcase timeless craftsmanship rarely found today.

Additionally, there is a delightful three-season sunroom, perfect for relaxation and soaking up the sunlight. Upstairs, you will discover three inviting bedrooms, ensuring ample space for everyone, along with the additional full bath.

(Don't miss the spectacular waterfront video). On the water in the Tokeneke Association, Short Rocks Manor is poised at the very tip of Arrowhead Way, high above Scotts Cove and Long Island Sound. This breathtaking, updated 1925 English-style stone manor sits on 2.11 acres which includes .362 acres of designated OPEN SPACE. The 5,823 square feet of exquisite craftmanship houses five bedrooms - including a private-entrance apartment perfect for guests or family. Up the circular drive, you enter through a private stone rose-filled courtyard into the fabulous foyer with fireplace and step in the soaring two-story great room with floor to ceiling windows of glass that open directly onto your waterfront terrace, with the cove and Sound shimmering beyond. Every principal room has been oriented to capture the water. The primary bedroom suite window wall overlooks the ever-changing beauty of the sea. The kitchen leads to a private patio. Acres of landscaped gardens unfold across multiple levels, a private swimming pool is nestled within its own secluded garden sanctuary, and a whimsical Fairy Path winds upward to a hidden garden perched high above the cove creating a bird and wildlife sanctuary. The separate viewing terrace overlooks the water and your own private dock and is perfect for evening cocktails or simply watching the sun set over Long Island Sound. This home and property are rare. Make it your own.

listings.remarks: This country cottage with modern flairs provides privacy and convenience just minutes from downtown New Canaan or South Wilton center. Located in the desirable Valley Road Neighborhood, this 4-bedroom 2-bath home is nestled on 3.3 acres of private land overlooking the property's sprawling field. The interior features a 2-story walk-in atrium leading to vaulted ceilings, skylights and an open-concept main floor.  Living areas include a private primary suite with adjacent office and a cozy sunlight flex room with skylights and picture windows. A spacious main living room is ideal for entertaining with a floor-to-ceiling wood-burning fireplace to keep you cozy on winter nights. Extras also include a small deck ideal for grilling and a stone patio that overlooks the woodland valley below.   Three additional bedrooms include details like a walk-in closet and screened porch. The lower level includes a massive extra room for a gym or recreation area. Lower-level also includes ample storage room, laundry (washer & dryer included), and freezer.  Property is ideal for hiking, biking, and running enthusiasts and is 11 minutes from Metro-North commuter rail.

Ideally located on a private lot in close proximity to public and private schools, 25 Hillcrest Rd. is located on a low traffic street on New Canaan's lower west side within minutes of the Merritt Parkway, Talmadge Hill train station and down town New Canaan. Spanning close to 8,000 sq ft, the transitional floor plan masterfully blends open concept spaces with more intimate, private spaces. Featuring 9' ceilings throughout and a clean, contemporary design aesthetic, the gracious home is perfect for entertaining large crowds while at the same time comfortable for everyday living. Entering through the custom designed front door, you are welcomed by a grand foyer with unobstructed views through the living room to the private backyard. As you move through the home, the centrally located family room is connected to both the large formal dining room and the gourmet kitchen which is flooded with natural light through six over sized windows. Featuring a clean, white design aesthetic the kitchen is as functional as it is beautiful. With a large 8.5' island coupled with two sinks and two dishwashers, prep and clean-up is easy. The adjacent pantry with lots of cabinetry and mudroom provide a place for everything, keeping the main living area neat and tidy. Not to be missed on the 1st floor is the large en suite guest bedroom (which could also serve as the primary bedroom) and a large private office.

listings.remarks: Tucked away down a private driveway and situated on 2.25 acres of secluded land, this charming cottage-studio awaits you. The spacious room features vaulted cathedral ceilings and ample closet space. A bay window floods the space with natural sunlight. The eat-in kitchen is equipped with a new stove, refrigerator, dishwasher, and your own washer and dryer. Enjoy relaxing evenings on your private deck. The driveway accommodates parking for two cars, while garages on the premises are reserved for the owner's use. One dog may be considered with the owner's approval; however, cats are not permitted.  The tenant is responsible for the cost of heating oil for the cottage and must obtain a P.O. Box for postal services. The landlord covers the electric bill, cable bill, internet, and trash removal. Excellent credit and references are required, along with renters insurance. The tenant is responsible for shoveling the cottage walkway, while snow plowing and grounds maintenance are provided by the landlord. A new central AC wall unit and a generator are in place. Please note that the cottage is available for single occupancy only. Full house Generator. This property is a must-see!

Laurelrock was built by a branch of the Roosevelt family as a country retreat in 1932. After an extensive renovation and expansion in 2010, Laurelrock today exudes a casual and contemporary elegance that is enhanced by its delightful assurance of historic authenticity.  The residence sits high up on a hill, beyond a running creek, at the end of a long, circular driveway of 500 feet, amidst parklike grounds with stately old specimen trees including red and white oak, sugar maple, beech, hickory and cedar. The property is surrounded by deep borders of woodland that offer privacy and protection.  The main house is constructed of native granite with masonry walls measuring up to eighteen inches in thickness. A large, modern kitchen, a sun-filled conservatory, a library, a new master suite and updated systems were added in 2010. Great care was taken to maintain the historic character and workmanship of the pre-war architecture. The new addition was built with masonry walls, slate and copper roofs, copper gutters and mahogany doors that maintain the beauty and integrity of the original design.   There is a separate carriage house/garage with a studio apartment that could also be used as a guest suite or expansive home office.  The current owners have raised their family of 7 in this private and serene sanctuary and are now ready to pass it on.

Two and half bathrooms per field card. Lower level does have a full bathroom not half bathroom.

1936 Vintage Colonial Home is sited high on over 6 acres of private land in the estate section of New Canaan located in the West School District. The home features 5 bedrooms and 4 1/2 baths, a gourmet country kitchen, generous sized rooms, and lots of vintage charm. The beautiful professionally landscaped property has seasonal water views of the Laurel Reservoir and includes a pool and spa, a flagstone patio, and a covered porch. The 3-car garage offers a finished space above that could be used as an additional bedroom, gym, studio/office, or pool house. A very special and unique offering. Sold 'as-is.'

Welcome to 256 Mill Road, a charming and enchanting home nestled on a picturesque country road. Overlooking the tranquil Silvermine River, this property offers the ideal setting for your own personal retreat. The home features three bedrooms, two and half bathrooms, living room with fireplace, dining room, walkout lower level with a picturesque sitting room/library. The light-filled rooms provides a warm and inviting atmosphere. With easy access to outdoor living areas with stunning gardens, it is perfectly designed for both entertaining guests and enjoying everyday life in comfort and style. Located in the heart of Silvermine, residents can enjoy the convenience of local dining at renowned establishments such as Gray Barns, The Mercantile, and Silvermine Market. The property is just minutes from New Canaan town center and only 60 minutes from New York City.

Rare opportunity to own at Chatham Walk. The perfect location for walking to the Train, in town Shopping, the Library and Grocery Stores. This Townhouse offers you 1,524 sq.ft of living space with an additional 756 sq.ft in the finished basement. The spacious living/dining room open floor plan offers a comfortable living entertaining space. From the dining room walk onto the deck overlooking a private grassy area. The kitchen off of the dining room has granite counters, Fisher & Paykel refrigerator and a Miele dishwasher.  The primary bedroom upstairs has an en suite marble bathroom walk in shower. Very spacious his and her closets. Two other bedrooms offer spacious closets as well. A full bathroom in the hallway upstairs is for the other two bedrooms and a half bath for company on the main level. All bathrooms are renovated . The lower level offers lovely living space with a custom wine room. A separate laundry room is in the lower level with cabinets for storage. Many improvements have been made. New storm doors, all hardwood floors refinished, new HVAC system, new hot water heater, new panel for 200 amp service, wiring for tv in the finished lower level, new attic stairs, new fan in the en suite bathroom. Move in to enjoy the holiday season .

listings.remarks: Nestled on 1 beautifully landscaped acre, this charming 3 bed, 2 bath one level home is a perfect blend of charm and modern design. From the foyer step into the spacious & modern open concept living, dining and kitchen rooms. The light filled living room with inviting fireplace includes an oversized picture window that showcases stunning property views. Adjacent, a warm family room / library offers equally beautiful views and a calming area to read and unwind. The open kitchen includes handsome granite counters, spacious dining area, and deluxe appliances. The primary bedroom is a wonderful retreat with beautiful views, large closets, and en suite bath with shower, tub, and vanity. The second and third bedrooms are perfect for family, guests or could also double as an additional den/office. Completing the home is the wonderful level lot with specimen trees, gardens, and handsome stone walls. Ideally located just minutes from the most charming New England village, New Canaan, known for its shopping, library, theater, outstanding restaurants, train and parks.
Move right in!

High floor 2Bd/2Bth with lovely open town views! Experience sophisticated single-level living at the VUE, an exciting premier luxury condominium community in the heart of New Canaan. The condo features fine interior finishes & architectural details with a light filled open floor plan, custom kitchen, private balcony, fireplace, high ceilings and a master bedroom suite with spa-like bath. The 2nd bedroom features a lovely custom built Murphy bed with stylish shelving & drawers. Unparalleled building amenities include a variety of concierge services, 2 state of the art fitness centers, natural playscape & Zen garden, underground parking with car detailing & pet washing room. Entertain guests in the Club Room and on the two rooftop terraces with outdoor kitchen, firepits & stunning sunset views. Enjoy this luxurious lifestyle just steps from the village!

listings.remarks: Experience a sophisticated carefree lifestyle at sought after Jelliff Mill Falls. Designed by Judy Larson & built by Gardiner Group renown for quality construction, special architectural details & luxurious finishes.  There is no condo of this caliber that compares. This particular unit is unique and offers direct water views of the Noroton River & magical waterfall. Experience an elegant blend of classic comfort and modern amenities in this stunning waterfront home. From the high ceilings, wide-plank flooring, custom features throughout, no detail has been overlooked in the creation of this bespoke abode. The kitchen on the main level is a chef's dream with waterfall island with seating, top-of-the-line appliances paired with sleek cabinetry, Waterworks fixtures, two sinks and oversized walk-in-pantry. The open concept layout family room/kitchen/ dining room provides access out to the waterfront terrace equipped with awning. A chic office could double for a living room. The primary suite is plush with vaulted ceiling, fireplace, walk-in closets and marble bathroom. A guest bedroom with ensuite bath, 2nd floor laundry room, and large bonus space is currently used as a second office space & reading nook. On the walk out lower level, there is an additional en suite guest bedroom, plentiful amounts of storage and a warm and inviting family room with fireplace. Elevator capacity & tons of storage. Almost every room enjoys glistening views overlooking Jelliff Pond waterfall.

Nestled on one of New Canaan's most prestigious streets, discover the epitome of classic charm reimagined in this stunning post-and-beam barn residence originally built in 1906. Welcome to a unique home exuding warmth and character at every turn. Situated on nearly 3 acres of picturesque park-like grounds, this residence provides a private, tranquil retreat from the hustle and bustle of daily life. As you enter, you're greeted by an abundance of natural light that fills the spacious rooms, creating an inviting ambiance throughout. Step into the heart of the home, where the soaring 19-foot ceiling of the great room and loft, serves as a breathtaking focal point. Here, the timeless charm of post-beam architecture seamlessly blends with modern updates, resulting in a space that is both cozy and elegant. The allure continues with sunny bedrooms providing comfort and serenity. Fresh, white interiors accentuate the home's airy atmosphere, while a splendid custom wood roof adorned with solid copper gutters and trim adds to its architectural appeal. Conveniently located just 1.5 miles from town, this residence is the perfect combination of privacy and accessibility.

A well-maintained treasure designed for the original owners. Nestled on 2.86 acres of private land, this residence is a secluded retreat, hidden away from the street, offering a sense of exclusive tranquility. The home's grandeur is discreet from the front approach, yet it boasts over 7,500 square feet of finished living space, complete with an array of ceiling designs that add to its modern flair. This expansive property features 5 to 6 bedrooms, 6 full and 2 half baths, all within an open floor plan that encourages a seamless flow of indoor and outdoor living. The large primary suite serves as a luxurious haven, while the manicured grounds and large deck provide the perfect backdrop for relaxation or entertaining guests. The walk-out lower level adds to the home's spacious feel, and the beautiful hardwood floors throughout are complemented by designer finishes that exude charm and elegance. This modern-style home is a true treasure, offering both privacy and sophisticated living spaces. Invite potential buyers to experience the unique charm and luxurious lifestyle this property offers.

Within a desirable community and through a private gated entrance, a dream retreat on over four bucolic acres awaits. Designed for privacy and entertainment, this exquisite country estate is a perfect multi-generational compound. The colonial-style home spans 6,560 sq. ft. over three levels, featuring an updated kitchen with quartzite countertops that flows into a large family room with high ceilings, a cozy fireplace and French doors leading to a welcoming deck. The adjacent dining room is ideal for gatherings, while the front-to-back living room showcases beautiful millwork. The first floor also includes a cherry wood billiards room/office, a den, and a sunroom. On the second floor, the updated luxurious primary suite features a fireplace, a spa-like bathroom, dual walk-in closets, and a private office with a wrap-around deck. Four additional bedrooms and a finished third floor complete the main residence. Separately, a 2,500 sq. ft. cottage serves as a delightful escape with 2 bedrooms, a full kitchen, a living room with cathedral ceilings and a fieldstone fireplace, an office, and a gym. For the wine and car enthusiast, there are two temperature-controlled wine rooms and space for nine cars. Enjoy outdoor living with expansive patios, a pool with a spa & waterfall, a putting green, and a gazebo. This property is a blend of luxury & comfort, conveniently located near New Canaan's vibrant village & train.

Be wowed by the second floor recreation room space that can serve a multitude of purposes. Select your driveway entrance of choice to access four car garage w/guest parking galore. Don't miss out on this opportunity to own a fantastic home in one of New Canaan's most desirable neighborhoods!

listings.remarks: This dream 5 bedroom home, set on 2.16 acres in a peaceful cul-de-sac, features a beautiful pool, spa and firepit, perfect for entertaining. The light-filled kitchen has been exquisitely renovated with skylights, a Wolf 60" gas cooktop, double full-size ovens, two Carrara marble islands, two Miele dishwashers, two full-size sinks, wine refrigerator and more and is open to the spacious family room with a door to the backyard, creating a seamless indoor/outdoor living experience. In addition, on the main floor, there is a large office and living room, both with fireplaces, dining room, two powder rooms, large screened-in porch and custom mud-room with a lot of storage, leading to the laundry room. The second floor was completely renovated and expanded in 2020. The luxurious primary bedroom suite has skylights, a fireplace, two walk-in closets and a gorgeous 27ft bathroom with heated marble flooring. There are four additional bedrooms with designer bathrooms. The attic was expanded and renovated in 2020 providing extra living space and storage. Whole house generator.

Welcome to a unique oasis in the heart of New Canaan. This 4 bedroom/2.5 bath colonial gem offers elegance, space, and convenience throughout 3,100+ sqft. Enjoy picturesque pond views and abundant natural light throughout the home. The main level features seamless flow for entertaining, with a spacious kitchen, dining area, living room and an expansive family room with a cozy fireplace and wet bar. Upstairs, the master suite awaits, offering a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of daily life. Complete with an ensuite bathroom and ample closet space, this sanctuary is the epitome of comfort and relaxation. Three additional bedrooms share a full bathroom, each thoughtfully designed and generously sized, providing plenty of space for family and guests. The lower level spans over 1,700 sqft. of unfinished space with many possibilities in addition to an attached two car garage. Outside, the park like grounds on 1.3 acres, offer endless opportunities for outdoor enjoyment and recreation. Whether you're hosting a barbecue, playing catch on the lawn, or simply relaxing in the shade of the majestic trees, you'll find that this property is an amazing extension of your living space. Located in close proximity to schools, renowned restaurants and local shops, this home offers the ultimate in convenience and lifestyle. With easy access to major transportation routes, commuting is a breeze!

This stunning Nantucket-style home showcases exquisite craftsmanship with stone and shingle details outside and gorgeous design inside, perfect for luxurious living and entertaining. Beautifully sited on an elevated, private and lush 3.3-acre lot in a coveted west-side neighborhood, this property offers a serene retreat on a quiet cul-de-sac so close to everything. Mature evergreens and stone walls create a picturesque setting that is conveniently located near both train stations and town, providing an oasis of privacy and accessibility. Step inside through the grand Dutch door into the spacious foyer with soaring ceiling and natural light. The main level features stately and serene public rooms with fireplaces, oversized windows, and cathedral ceilings. The sun-filled kitchen is a chef's dream, with marble countertops, double islands, and top-of-the-line appliances, including a built-in cappuccino machine. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a super-luxe bathroom with double vanities, spacious walk-in closets, and private separate sitting area. Four more bedrooms and a great room on the second level, PLUS fully finished lower level, movie theater, playroom/dance studio, and gym, offers entertainment options for all ages. A sixth bedroom, bath, and office area is versatile main floor space for guests or au-pair suite. Gorgeous patio, pool, hot tub, luxurious flat lawn and basketball court provide outdoor recreation and relaxation in a spectacular setting all year long!

listings.remarks: Sparkling, modern and just renovated, this totally revamped townhouse on 4 floors is in the prime of downtown New Canaan. Over 3500 sq ft and 3-4 bedrooms, 4 1/2 baths, outrageously gorgeous new kitchen and full movie theater, this special home is located in a small 5 unit complex within steps to the new library, vibrant town center, award winning restaurants, lush parks and train to NYC. Front to back entry w/refinished light H/W flooring leads to open floor plan w/dazzling new kitchen, generous eating island w/ quartz counters, high end stainless range, pot filler, built in microwave, 2 dishwashers, statement refrigerator and wet bar. The open living room has light H/W floors, built-ins and Fr door to private terrace. All new recessed lighting and light fixtures throughout. Separate formal dining room, renovated powder rm and attached garage complete the ground floor. 2nd floor has primary suite, 2 part walk in closet and stunning marble bath w/double sinks and shower and an office with walls of shelves and a separate laundry room. 3rd floor is a suite w/sitting rm, cabinetry and palladium window. Also a bedroom/den w/ skylight and new bath with shower. The LL is a recreational delight w/ full sized movie theater, specialty lighting, audio, entertainment center w/wetbar and frig, newly renovated full bath w/shower and exercise room/gym. Wireless Sonos sound system. Move right into this incredible home and enjoy luxury living with a wonderful new vibe.

All this...and Heaven, too! In a spectacular setting overlooking the reservoir is New Canaan's one and only "Breezehouse"! This unique structure from Blu Homes (high-end designer/builder of modular homes) combines advanced building technology, eco materials, the highest green and quality standards, and striking design that features the best of indoor-outdoor living. The sun-filled interior has a dramatic open floor plan with soaring ceilings, high-end finishes, top-of-the-line appliances, 2 primary suites and walls of windows to bring the outside in. A 3000+sf walk-out lower level is prepped and ready for additional rooms, and a fabulous exercise studio is just a few steps away! The setting is nothing short of magical! With deep blue water views in the distance, the seasons unfold in a dazzling array of colors and shapes -- with exquisite hardscapes, natural pollinators, and fields of flowers -- meticulously designed with a deep sensitivity to the natural habitat. This is a totally captivating property that will capture your imagination and provide a lifetime of blissful carefree living!

Step inside & be enchanted by the timeless elegance that defines this unique New Canaan landmark. The Matthew Finch House exudes historical charm & has been meticulously restored & thoughtfully enhanced & expanded for modern living. Entertain with ease in the great expansive entertaining room with central stone FPL The family room w/fireplace & wet bar features French doors opening to a patio area & screened-in porch overlooking the stunning pool & spa area seamlessly blending indoor & outdoor living. The gracious library w/FPL, bay window & custom built-ins provides a perfect in-home office. The primary suite w/FPL & sitting area provides a luxurious & spacious retreat with two sets of French doors opening to a west facing balcony overlooking the picturesque property & breathtaking sunsets. The primary bedroom also features high ceilings, generous custom dressing rooms & spa bath. The expansive light filled 2nd floor family room/playroom w/vaulted exposed beamed ceilings & floor to ceiling windows is a fabulous highlight and leads to a spacious guest suite. Three additional bedrooms, one with en-suite bath complete the 2nd floor. Additional highlights include a finished lower level, wine cellar, 3 car garage & sports court. Experience the allure of the Matthew Finch House and make this exceptional New Canaan gem your own

Come experience this handsome English manor house. A gracious family home and entertainer's dream at 8572 SF with multiple oversized entertaining areas. Marvel at the 28 by 30-foot grand living room with coffered ceilings and double doors that lead out to the gardens. Gather with family and friends near one of the six fireplaces. The dining room glistens with attractive molding and built in cabinets. Your spirits will soar as you enter the sun-drenched kitchen with your own vegetable garden just outside. Vaulted ceilings throughout will impress your guests. Unwind in the handsome and light filled billiards room complete a wood burning stove. The unique "L" shaped floor plan grounds a central hub of entertaining spaces with two separate wings for sleeping and productivity. On one side, a two-bedroom master suite and office sit while four additional bedrooms, two home offices and an oversized three-car garage sit on the other side of the layout. Now step outside and start to appreciate 7.5 sprawling acres. Thoughtful and mature landscaping graces every corner of this pastoral oasis. Stroll past the tennis court and koi pond to arrive at the European style pool house with 3595 SF of living space. The indoor pool glows surrounded by sliding glass doors on all sides and features a state-of-the-art jet propulsion system for lap swimming. Relax spa-style in this dreamy space.

listings.remarks: Welcome to this extraordinary townhouse that offers the ultimate convenience and comfort of home. Located just steps away from New Canaan's renowned library, restaurants, premier shopping, and the train station for easy access to NYC, this home brings the best of the town to your doorstep.  Not only is this townhome perfectly situated, but it also offers exceptional features that make it truly special. Spanning three finished levels, with the potential for expansion on the third floor, this quality-built home is designed to meet your evolving needs.  Step into the bright and sunny living room, where large windows allow natural sunlight to fill the space, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The cozy wood burning fireplace adds a touch of charm and provides a perfect spot to relax and unwind.  The eat-in kitchen, complete with sliders to the patio, is ideal for easy entertaining. The spacious primary bedroom features an office area and his-and-her primary baths, ensuring comfort and convenience. An additional en-suite bedroom and a den/office provide ample space for guests or a home office setup.  The finished lower level boasts a cozy family room, perfect for movie nights or quiet relaxation. The private backyard offers a serene oasis for grilling and enjoying the outdoors. Additionally, a one car attached garage, with one additional parking space available. Experience luxury living in this prime location.

Discover 60 Ferris Hill Road and enter into stylish elegance balanced with gracious charm. This newly renovated five-bedroom center hall Colonial with six full baths provides chic spacious living with well scaled proportions and the surroundings of a secluded retreat. The main level offers versatile living spaces with a chef's kitchen flowing into both formal living and open spaces, including LR, DR on one side and FR and home office balanced on the other. All connected by a welcoming two-story foyer. The secondary level features primary suite with spa bath, walk-in closet and dressing area. There are three additional en-suite bedrooms and a laundry area. The great room with cathedral ceiling and sliding glass doors open onto the wrap-around deck which maximizes outdoor living and entertaining, an additional terrace and private flat yard with Gunite pool create a wonderful setting. This home is sun drenched with natural light from Bay windows, large picture windows, transoms, sliding doors and French doors. Additional stylish features included are new hardwood floors throughout, new lighting, exposed beamed ceilings and all with meticulous attention to details inside and out. Lovely landscaping with stone walls, mature plantings, heated four-car garage with workshop, and a whole house generator. Convenient location to town; near parks, schools, train, and amenities.

Here you will relax next to the cozy fireplace and built-ins while a wall of French doors provide a bright atmosphere and gorgeous views to your private terrace with a stunning flowering garden. The primary bedroom has ample closets and exquisitely updated bathroom with oversize glass shower. The second spacious bedroom (currently used as office) also has plenty of closet space, a wall of custom built-in cabinetry and shelving, and ensuite bathroom. The finished lower level has new carpeting and offers space for an office/gym/family room and more. A separate laundry room, complete with a double sink, also has a large storage area. Step out your door and find the gym, club room, terrace, and storage room just across the hallway.  The living room, with its vaulted ceiling and skylights, is filled with natural light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere that you'll love coming home to. The primary bedroom features an en-suite bathroom, a walk-in closet, and a cozy gas fireplace. The bonus room, with its useful skylight, is perfect as an office, additional bedroom, or playroom-whatever suits your needs.  Imagine unwinding on the spacious rooftop terrace, watching the sunset while grilling dinner or relaxing by the fire pits. listings.remarks: Nestled in a serene setting, this storybook New England Colonial blends luxurious living spaces with picturesque outdoor amenities. Renovated and expanded throughout 2014-2016, this meticulously designed residence offers modern comforts and timeless elegance. The property features lush, landscaped gardens and mature trees surrounding a sparkling pool, rejuvenating spa, stone patios, a covered pergola with outdoor dining, fire pit and a well-equipped outdoor kitchen, ideal for relaxation and entertaining. Inside, the main level boasts a sunlit chef's kitchen and breakfast room with panoramic garden views, an adjacent family room with paneled ceiling and fireplace, formal living and dining rooms both with fireplaces and a stylish private library with built-ins, window seats and fireplace. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite in its own wing includes a 11' paneled tray ceiling, fireplace, a spa-like marble bath and custom dressing room, complemented by additional bedrooms, bathrooms and a versatile bonus room with 12' vaulted ceiling, fireplace and outdoor deck. All this plus a three-car garage, mudroom, recreation room and convenient location complete this rare offering of refined living.

A Gracious In-Town Retreat with Timeless Elegance  Nestled on a picturesque, park-like acre just minutes from the village center, this meticulously renovated historic Colonial embodies the perfect blend of historic charm and modern sophistication. This classic antique four-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom residence was fully reimagined in 2015, preserving its storied past while infusing it with contemporary luxury.  Upon entering, you are greeted by formal rooms that echo a bygone era of gracious living, seamlessly transitioning into expansive spaces designed for today's lifestyle. The family room, an elegant addition, features a cozy fireplace and French doors that open onto a breathtaking terrace. This outdoor haven, complete with an inviting fireplace, is framed by mature gardens and exquisitely executed stonework, creating a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor living.  The updated kitchen is a chef's dream, while the primary suite offers a serene retreat with a luxurious bath and custom walk-in closet. The guest cottage and pool house, with a full bath and HVAC, add versatile space, ideal for guests or a home office. The newly added elegant pool cabana enhances the outdoor living experience.  With morning sun gracing the front and afternoon light filling the backyard, patio, and kitchen, this unique mini-estate is a rare find that harmoniously blends history and luxury.

LOVELY SUN-FILLED PRIVATE RIVERFRONT END TOWNHOUSE at desirable Canaan Close offers spectacular views of the Five Mile River and all its tranquility. This is the lifestyle you've been waiting for. Set on 7 serene acres of lush green property, this complex is known for its extensive landscaping, private gardens and meandering walking paths. This updated 3-4 bedrooms, 2.5 bath townhouse offers a mid century vibe, sunny living spaces and floating staircases that lead to spacious bedrooms with walk-in closets. There is a finished full walk-out lower level (an additional 1175 sq ft), leading to a second deck and courtyard overlooking the river. The uniquely sited river-front swimming pool overlooks a natural waterfall and offers expansive decks shaded by mature maple trees. This is a rare opportunity for a low maintenance lifestyle, without sacrificing space, privacy, or serenity, and all within walking distance to the train and downtown New Canaan. This is quite the find! *Parking garage is down a short path off of same level as front stoop (see map on dining table at townhouse). See agent remarks regarding offers.

listings.remarks: Welcome to this meticulously maintained, bright, and spacious end-unit townhome in the sought-after Leefair complex. Boasting a comfortable and inviting floor plan, this home offers an abundance of natural light and a sense of privacy that's hard to beat. The heart of the home features a lovely white eat-in kitchen perfect for casual dining. A formal dining room is ideal for hosting guests, while the cozy den with built-ins offers a great space for work or relaxation. The expansive living room is highlighted by a wood-burning fireplace, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Sliding doors lead to a professionally landscaped private terrace-your own peaceful outdoor retreat. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers a serene space to unwind. Two additional well-sized bedrooms and a full hall bath round out the upper level, providing ample space for family or guests. The lower level, though unfinished, provides abundant storage and includes a large walk-in seasonal closet, perfect for keeping your home organized. 2-car attached garage with easy access directly into the kitchen. Numerous updates to the complex, including a new roof, roads, and fences-all paid off by the current owners. This home combines comfort, convenience, and peaceful living in a vibrant community. Don't miss the opportunity to make this beautiful townhome yours!

Renovated sun-filled New England Cape in an in-town sought after neighborhood! Bright, open living spaces with picture windows and hardwood floors. Park like backyard with patio. Features include an updated kitchen, three generous bedrooms, two modern baths, a finished lower level flex-space, an attached two-car garage, and a private backyard. Conveniently located just minutes from downtown, the train, and shops.

Relax on your front porch and enjoy all the delights of living in the heart of New Canaan. Convenient to town, train, schools, etc. This fully renovated and tastefully designed 4 bedroom home on Main Street is move-in ready. Enter the 2 story foyer with elegant millwork and gleaming custom bleached and whitewashed wood floors throughout. Updated kitchen, bathrooms, doors, roof, HVAC, extensive landscaping, etc., etc.  This beautiful home has a first-floor primary bedroom, eat-in kitchen, dining room, custom designed office/study and a large family room. On the second floor are 3 more bedrooms, brand new bathroom and a home gym. The lower level has high ceilings, natural light and is ready to add up to 850 SF of finished living space. There is a Tesla solar panel system (8.8 KW/22 panels) supplying almost 50% of electricity requirements, plus 2 Tesla Powerwalls providing solar power storage and home power backup source, plus 2 EV charging ports. System installed in August 2022 and conveys free and clear with home. This house has it all and is a great opportunity for the next lucky owner. Don't delay!

In town living at its best in this chic, architect owned and designed 4,000+ sq. ft. 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath gem in the heart of New Canaan. Three beautifully appointed floors with designer finishes, high end appliances, radiant heat and built in beds (1 King/2 Full) and dressers in all 3 upper bedrooms. Enjoy the outdoor entertaining space with cobblestone yard and fireplace for year round entertaining. Walk out fully finished lower level with a 4th bedroom, full bath, entertainment and gym area and additional storage. Lives like a condo, feels like a home!

533 Valley Road is one of the prettiest houses in New Canaan. It has a beautiful wrap around porch, built in outdoor kitchen and fireplace, porch swing, Sport Court, Heated pool with built in Spa and views of the Silvermine River. Completely rebuilt and sold as new construction in 2005 with extensive additions and renovations in 2011, this five bedroom home has four finished levels, 5 full baths and 3 half baths, brand new Primary bathroom, truly stunning foyer with view to the back porch, gourmet eat-in-kitchen, grand living room with bar, wine chiller, ice maker and open shelving for glassware, paneled office with French doors to the covered porch, indoor sports court, gym, cabana room with accordion doors and bath with steam shower. Lower-level guest lounge with fireplace. This is the perfect home to entertain! It was featured in the Darien New Canaan cover and magazine.

Iconic Landmark Building Awaits Your Vision in Prime Downtown Locale... Own a piece of history! Discover a rare gem in the heart of downtown New Canaan - an iconic landmark building that beckons visionaries and entrepreneurs alike. Nestled at the bustling crossroads of South Avenue and Cherry Street, this magnificent two-story structure offers a canvas of 5,000 square feet, ripe with possibility. As you step through the doors, a grand waiting room welcomes you, leading to a stunning wood-paneled library that exudes timeless elegance. With twelve private rooms, three expansive work areas, and kitchenette the building's versatile layout adapts effortlessly to your ambitions, be they retail, residential, professional or a dynamic mix.  Unique features abound, from dual entrances and staircases that ensure smooth foot traffic, to a historic Mosler Vault that adds both character and security. Practicality meets potential with a basement for storage and an attic for future expansion. Convenience is key, with easy parking and the train station just a stone's throw away. This isn't just a property; it's a statement piece in the suburban landscape, a chance to etch your legacy into one of New Canaan's most highly sought after pieces of real estate. Rich in history and brimming with opportunity, this exceptional landmark could become the cornerstone of your success. Don't let this opportunity slip through your fingers - arrange a private tour and ... (continued)

Live well among the treetops in this special slice of heaven. A recently featured property on the New Canaan Homes Tour.  The renovation of the entire kitchen-breakfast nook-family room  was reimagined by renowned architectural design firm Brooks and Falotico, and it's a knockout. A wall of windows cascade across the entire expanse of the impressive GREAT ROOM with fireplace, detailed millwork, tray ceiling and French doors that lead to elegant outdoor entertaining spaces overlooking pond & waterfall. Completely re-built and expanded with flexible space for in-law apt and office spaces. Flexible space allows for 3 to 5 bedrooms, 4 full baths and 2 offices for ease of work from home. Beautiful grounds, extensive stone walls, patios & terraces, multiple outdoor seating spaces, lighting and mature landscaping, and quiet cul-de-sac location make this private oasis a peaceful and serene place to call home. A California-Style sophisticated country retreat with expansive valley views from every room. Truly a one-of-a-kind home.

This charming Colonial is set on two level acres with pool, 4 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms in the Silvermine area of New Canaan. Large eat-in kitchen, living room with fireplace leading to sun-filled family room, with fireplace, skylights and sliding doors to pool and large back yard. Spacious office with fireplace and wet bar. Full bathroom with shower, a powder room and mudroom complete the first floor.      Upper-level features primary bedroom suite with three additional bedrooms and bathroom with hardwood floors throughout. Laundry room and attic with pull-down stairs.   Large partially finished basement. Two-car garage.

Welcome to this exquisite property situated on a peaceful cul-de-sac, just minutes away from town and the train station. This 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom center hall colonial home is perfectly nestled on 2+ acre setting, offering both tranquility and seclusion. Surrounded by mature trees and overlooking a serene stream, this home provides the perfect sanctuary for relaxation. The backyard is a retreat with its large deck and flat, fully fenced-in space, ensuring your utmost enjoyment and privacy. Step inside, and you'll be greeted by a warm and inviting kitchen with a casual dining area. The oversized living room with a fireplace, creating a cozy ambiance. The bright sunroom boasts high ceilings and large windows, allowing you to immerse yourself in the beauty of nature. Hosting gatherings and creating cherished memories is effortless in the dining room. In need of a versatile space? The office-den, complete with its own fireplace, offers endless possibilities to suit your lifestyle. Additionally, the first-floor 5th bedroom adds even more flexibility to accommodate your needs. Upstairs, the primary suite features a walk-in closet and a full bath, providing a private haven for relaxation. Three additional bedrooms offer ample space for family or guests. The finished lower level, 2 car garage, and abundant storage space ensure that practicality is never compromised. Don't let this opportunity slip away - make this home your dream haven.

Gracious and inviting, this 4-bedroom center hall Colonial is perfectly situated on 1.38 private acres in a quiet yet convenient New Canaan location. The home has timeless charm with sunlit interiors, including a spacious living room with a fireplace and a large picture window, and a cozy wood-paneled den featuring built-ins. The eat-in kitchen has been refreshed with new flooring and appliances, offering both style and functionality, and is conveniently located adjacent to the formal dining room.  The layout is designed for easy living, with a separate mudroom off the two-car attached garage and access to an expansive wood deck, perfect for outdoor entertaining. A delightful screened porch overlooks a sprawling grassy play yard ideal for outdoor enjoyment. The walkout lower level provides opportunity for additional living space with a fireplace, a large window, laundry, and ample storage.  Hardwood floors throughout, paired with recent updates such as a new furnace and hot water heater (2020), make this home move-in ready.

Welcome to 100 Kimberly Place, a contemporary lifestyle in the heart of New Canaan. Just a short stroll to local shops, dining spots, and the train station, this home is ideally located to enjoy the town's vibrant charm . The home was thoughtfully upgraded between 2000 and 2006, including a stunning second story addition, a fresh open floor plan, a stylish portico entrance, and a spacious rear porch. Bathed in natural light, the home offers a seamless open layout perfect for entertaining and is nestled on a tranquil cul-de-sac within a peaceful neighborhood. The design features soaring ceilings and fluid spaces, with a main suite showcasing a cathedral ceiling. Additionally, you have an office or a 5th bedroom with full bath on the first floor, and three additional bedrooms upstairs. The backyard patio, complete with a stone fireplace, serves as an ideal sanctuary for relaxation. Additionally enjoy the upgrades of a new roof and furnace from 2023 and new water heater in 2022. Exceptional in-town location and a fabulous overall home.

Located on a serene, picturesque street on the west side of New Canaan, this 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home provides an exceptional opportunity to create a personalized haven in one of the area's most coveted locations. Enjoy the spacious rooms throughout this 3,000 square foot home, beautiful natural light, and expansive 1.14 acres of sweeping lawn, ample space for outdoor living play, or expansion. A gracious foyer welcomes you to the home and invites you to explore the open living spaces, which flow easily from room to room. The large living room features a wood fireplace and ample space for multiple seating areas - perfect for family gatherings. Enjoy spending time in the cozy den, bright sunroom, and kitchen, all of which look out over the property. The primary bedroom is conveniently located on the main level with two additional bedrooms on main floor and two upstairs. The layout and beautiful setting are ready for a new owner to refresh and revitalize. Embrace the chance to invest in a fantastic location with outstanding potential. Highest-Best Due Thursday, Sept. 5th at noon.

Beautifully sited at end of cul de sac w/ mature, lush landscaping, this quintessential New England Colonial offers the best in lifestyle living with 5 bedrooms and 5.2 baths. Enter into an oversize foyer with a graceful, sweeping staircase setting the mood for this home with a seamless blend of formal rooms & casual living in well thought-out room layout. The formal living room boasts a fireplace and built-ins with French doors opening to a book-lined library as well as opening to an all-weather sunroom with palladium windows. Chef kitchen featuring Viking 6-burner gas stove top & SubZero commercial refrigerator with island & breakfast room and French doors leading to terrace. Butler's pantry joins the formal dining room. Inviting coffered-ceiling family room with fireplace. Second floor features exquisite primary suite with fireplace & built-ins, sitting room with balcony, and lavish marble bath. Four additional en suite bedrooms and laundry complete 2nd fl. Lower level playroom & wine cellar. Additional amenities include mudroom, back stairs and 3-car garage. Extensive landscaping & stonework with expansive blue stone terrace featuring a Pergola-covered dining area. Perfect home for entertaining! Close to town, restaurants, and train.

Welcome to a very special Oenoke Ridge Estate. Effortless and elegant living in this exquisite home, mere minutes from town. Designed by renowned architect Douglas Cutler, this residence offers a magnificent light-filled main open floor plan with stunning views of the pool and property from every rear window-ideal for gatherings and parties. No expense was spared in this 11,000+ SF estate, a true testament to luxury and comfort. Situated on nearly 2.5 acres of perfectly manicured, flat land (no wetlands) in a prime westside location, this 6-bedroom, 9 bath estate is designed for both intimate family living and grand entertaining. 3-story windows cascade across the span of the house flooding every room with sunlight. The brand new kitchen features quartz countertops, Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, double dishwashers, Rutt cabinets, 3 refrigerator drawers, and a built-in banquette seating up to 14 guests. Additional luxuries include a heated 3.5 car garage, a full-house automatic generator, a 1500 SF fully finished walkout lower level with a Ziegfeld-Style home theater, and a primary suite with 2 baths & WI-closets in separate wings for ultimate privacy. Radiant heated floors and a cozy fireplace make this home feel like a luxurious vacation retreat. Resort-style amenities abound, oversized 30 x 50 outdoor lagoon pool and sprawling yard and pool/guest house with kitchen full bath & bedroom.There's so much to love about this amazing mansion.

listings.remarks: A private sanctuary awaits with this renovated gem. This sunny and move-in ready four bedroom colonial overlooks over two acres of spectacular property complete with heated pool, pool house, gardens and the Silvermine river flowing along the bottom of the property. A multi-level, completely rebuilt deck provides an elevated, breezy space with a view for entertaining, dining al fresco, or relaxing with coffee, surrounded by the subtle sounds of the river, birds and wildlife. En suite primary bedroom, two additional bedrooms and a shared bath upstairs, and another bedroom and full bathroom on the first floor. A formal dining room, formal living room, family room and sunroom turned gym (heated and cooled) complete the first floor. A walk out finished basement provides easy access to the back yard and garage.

Paradise found! Don't miss this fantastic opportunity in pastoral and desirable Canaan Close. Enjoy carefree living in this spacious and gracious 3-4 bedroom home with 4 full baths! One of the largest units in this coveted walk-to-town complex. Just the perfect size and finished on 3 levels, including a walk-out lower level. This unit benefits from a very flexible, sunlit floorplan with multiple decks, and bedrooms on all 3 levels to welcome guests, create a home office, library or gym. Freshly painted and newly refinished hardwood floors on the main and upper levels. Expansive eat-in kitchen with updated stainless appliances and pantry. Most of the principal rooms are enhanced with sliders to the private decks overlooking the Five Mile River and extensive landscaping. Enjoy the gorgeous heated pool and walking trails.  One car garage and ample guest parking.

listings.remarks: Walk to town and train from this lovely, 3 bedroom condominium in a park-like setting. Updated kitchen with granite countertops, new hardwood floors on the main level, updated bathrooms throughout, and a sunny private deck. Chatham Walk units all have Hardy board exterior planking.

Discover this stunning new build by Woodcrest Homes on a prime cul-de-sac, in the West school district, set on 2.2 private acres with ample space for a pool and pool house. This transitional-style home features 10-foot ceilings, custom millwork, and six ensuite bedrooms, offering both luxury and comfort. Enjoy the elegance of four fireplaces that create a wonderful flow throughout the living spaces. A bright chef's kitchen with an adjacent breakfast room, and a family room with a coffered ceiling. A private paneled library and formal dining room with butler's pantry. The primary suite boasts a breathtaking cathedral ceiling bath with radiant heat floors, providing a spa-like retreat. The finished walkout lower level and 6th bedroom with a full bath offers even more living options. A large mudroom with radiant heat floors and enclosed cubbies adds practicality to this exquisite home. Design services are provided by Haley Design Company, ensuring every detail is thoughtfully crafted. Experience luxury living at its finest - January 2025 occupancy.

Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this freshly painted one-bedroom apartment located in the sought-after Woodside Green complex. Featuring hardwood floors, large sunlit rooms, newer windows, and a kitchen with new stainless steel appliances, this charming corner unit is ideal for first-time buyers, downsizers, or those seeking a great rental alternative. The well-managed, pet-friendly complex offers beautifully landscaped grounds with a central green, walkways, grills, a gazebo, a secure bike room, and plenty of onsite parking. Enjoy the unbeatable location, less than 2 miles to the train station, with easy access to major routes and walkable amenities like LA Fitness, Starbucks, Scalzi Park, and Ridgeway Shopping Center. With hot water and cooking gas included in the common charges, this is low-maintenance living at its best. Woodside Green offers a friendly community atmosphere, perfect for those seeking convenience, charm, and a commuter-friendly lifestyle. Don't miss this fantastic opportunity!

listings.remarks: Chic & sophisticated, this stunning 3200SF townhouse, in the beautiful Oak Park complex, offers the best in luxurious carefree living. Special in every way, this unit has a large gracious entrance hall, fabulous living room with fireplace, dining room and gourmet kitchen with high end appliances and island. There are four ensuite bedrooms, a lovely powder room, large study, rec room, mudroom, huge storage room and attached one car garage. With its freshly painted interior, newly refinished hardwood floors, 9 ft. ceilings, deep moldings, fine detailing, expansive bluestone terrace with new privacy fencing and tons of closets, it lives like a house. An extensive list of improvements is available in documents. Sun-drenched and inviting, this exceptional condo is conveniently located close to Mead Park, town and train. A GEM!

Nestled on a serene street just steps from the vibrant core of New Canaan, 127 River St. invites you to experience the essence of this charming community. This recently updated single-family home blends modern sophistication with classic comfort, offering four bedrooms and three bathrooms that cater to every need. As you approach, the welcoming facade hints at the warmth within. Cross the threshold, and you'll be greeted by a luminous family room which offers a cozy retreat with its charming fireplace and custom built-ins that effortlessly merges elegance with functionality. The heart of this home, a brand-new kitchen, is a culinary dream come true. Featuring sleek finishes and thoughtful design, this space flows seamlessly into a generous dining area, ideal for both intimate family meals and lively gatherings. Beyond, the screened porch beckons-a tranquil spot to enjoy your morning coffee or an evening with friends, wrapped in the gentle breeze of a New Canaan summer night. For those seeking flexibility, the expansive bonus room presents endless possibilities. Imagine it as a private home gym, a creative studio, or a vibrant playroom-the choice is yours. Whatever your needs, this room adapts to fit your lifestyle. Outside, the story continues. Step onto the rear porch and let the day melt away as you overlook your own private oasis. The well-maintained yard and garden area offer a peaceful retreat, where you can cultivate your green thumb or simply relax amidst the beauty

Tucked away in a serene and private setting near the heart of New Canaan, this meticulously updated residence offers a seamless blend of classic charm and modern luxury. Located just minutes from the highly regarded public schools and the village center, this home is perfectly positioned for both convenience and tranquility.  The main house features extensive recent renovations, including a new cedar shingle roof, copper gutters, custom windows, and modern systems like a full HVAC upgrade and comprehensive drainage improvements. The interiors are equally impressive, with refinished antique wood flooring and a completely renovated kitchen with new countertops and appliances. The reimagined primary suite has a newly appointed bathroom with private access from the back stairs. Enhancing the property's appeal is a fully updated cottage, complete with its own kitchen, bathroom, and HVAC system, offering an ideal space for visitors or extended stays. Additionally, a separate barn or art studio with refinished original flooring and a new wood-burning stove serves as a creative retreat, perfect for inspiring work or quiet relaxation. Surrounded by beautifully landscaped grounds with mature trees, new plantings, and a tiered entertaining patio off the sunroom, this home offers a rare combination of privacy, luxury, and convenience in one of New Canaan's most desirable locations.

Charming Single-Level Home with Great Investment Potential  This cozy 3-bedroom, 1-floor home sits on a private 0.54-acre lot, offering plenty of space and seclusion. Conveniently located near the Talmadge Hill Train Station and the Merritt Parkway, it's perfect for commuters and those who value accessibility. The property is a fantastic investment opportunity and, while it needs a bit of TLC, it's brimming with potential. Ideal for anyone looking to customize their home or capitalize on a promising investment. The exterior siding, roof and some windows were new in 2010.

For the first time in over 80 years, one of New Canaan's most iconic estates is ready for its next steward. Perched on one of New Canaan's highest points, with clear views of the Manhattan skyline, this classic Georgian home overlooks 10+ acres of lush lawn, gardens, orchards, a beautiful pool and an artist's cottage. Drenched in sunlight, ''Rockin' Chair Hill's'' formal and informal spaces invite both gracious entertaining and quiet reflection with well-proportioned rooms, high ceilings and abundant natural light. It is difficult to overstate how rare this opportunity is-a once in a lifetime event- a chance to create new memories on one of New Canaan's most storied, gracious and admired properties, just minutes from town yet buffered by expansive land and privacy. Agent is related to the seller.

listings.remarks: Welcome to 179 Park Street A (or Unit 14) located in the Parkview Condominium Association in the heart of New Canaan. With three finished floors and over 2000 square feet, this end unit is light filled with 3 sides of windows overlooking the grassy yard and private terrace. The gracious entry opens to the spacious living room, dining room, powder room and eat in kitchen while the second floor has 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths. The master bathroom boasts a separate shower and soaking tub along with a large walk in closet. The lower level provides ample storage, a finished family room/playroom, small office and half bath. There is an assigned parking space and a one car garage. The location provides easy access to Mead Park through a private path from the complex. Enjoy all that downtown New Canaan has from this conveniently located sunny and spacious townhouse.

Rare opportunity to own a two-family home with rental income in New Canaan. Close to the village, train, parks, schools. Two one-bedroom apartments. First level with lovely front and back porches, eat-in kitchen, high ceilings, laundry/mudroom. Second level is lovely and bright, with vaulted, wood-clad ceilings in the eat-in kitchen and family room, very large closets and its own private porch. Full unfinished basement with mechanicals and extra storage. Both units currently have long-term tenants on month-to-month leases.

Tucked just steps away from downtown New Canaan, this charming 3 BR/2.5 bath town home offers the perfect blend of comfortable living, modern amenities, and a prime location. The sun drenched eat-in kitchen features premium finishes and appliances, as well as ample storage. The living room boasts beautiful custom built-ins, a gas fireplace, hardwood floors and french doors leading to a private fenced-in patio. This seamless layout also includes a cozy home office/den with built-ins. The sizable primary suite has a walk-in closet and updated bathroom. Two spacious bedrooms and a laundry complete the 2nd Floor. The lower level provides an additional 600 square feet of finished living space! Ideal for a recreation room or family room. This unit has an attached garage with 3 additional designated parking spots. In town living at its best!!!

listings.remarks: Fully Upgraded & Move-In Ready Newly renovated legal 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Cape Cod on a coveted West Side cul-de-sac. A natural berm behind the home ensures complete privacy with no Merritt Parkway views. Thoughtfully redesigned to blend classic charm with modern comfort, this home boasts a new well pump, HVAC enhancements, new roof, new driveway, new new appliances, new smart thermostat with wireless sensors, three stylishly renovated bathrooms, and a luxurious new first-floor primary suite. All work was fully permitted and filed with the town. The chef's kitchen is beautifully appointed with Carrara marble countertops, custom cabinetry, and an open layout flowing seamlessly into formal and casual living areas - perfect for entertaining and everyday living. A spacious living room and cozy den provide inviting spaces to relax, while the flexible lower level (not included in town records) offers endless possibilities, from a home office to a fitness studio, playroom, or media lounge. Set on a private, level 1.1-acre lot, there's room to expand, including options for an in-law suite or accessory dwelling unit. Energy-efficient, stylish, and truly move-in ready, this home offers easy access to Waveny Park, top-rated West School, Talmadge Hill Station, and the vibrant Hope Street shopping district - all just minutes away.

This attractive ranch provides a wonderful opportunity to own a 3-bedroom home in beautiful New Canaan! Situated on .42 fenced acres, the home features comfortable and bright living spaces including beautiful wood floors, a living room with a fireplace, sunroom surrounded by large windows to let in the natural light, and a newly renovated bathroom. Located only a 5-minute drive to downtown New Canaan and with easy access to The Merritt Parkway, this home is perfectly situated for trips to town or commuting. The home has been in the family since it was built in 1954 and has been loved and cared for over the years. Whether you're looking for your forever home or a rewarding investment opportunity, this property has the potential to shine with your unique vision.
