A light-filled open floor plan with custom kitchen, spa like baths , fireplace , and balconies with park views and gorgeous sunsets is just the beginning of life at this sophisticated condominium community. The exceptional building amenities include concierge, state of the art fitness centers, rooftop terrace, outdoor kitchen and fire pits for entertaining guests, underground parking with a dog washing station and zen-like gardens all within walking distance to the village. Come experience this sophisticated lifestyle at The Vue

listings.remarks: Step into this stunning home that combines classic charm with an unexpectedly spacious and open layout! Beyond its elegant facade, you'll find cathedral ceilings that soar above expansive living areas, creating a bright and airy ambiance throughout. The home features a variety of rooms and additional hidden spaces, offering endless possibilities for personalization. Each room flows seamlessly into the next, giving a sense of openness rarely found in traditional Colonials.  Radiant heated floors throughout the entirety of the home..

Don't miss this single family home steps from downtown shops, restaurants, train & parks. With soaring ceilings, loads of sunlight & open spaces, this home offers generously sized rooms, 2 fireplaces & space for all. Enter the double heigh entry foyer to a formal living room with fireplace & a formal dining room behind. The gourmet eat in kitchen with island & high end appliances opens to the family room with loads of storage & large sliders beckon you to the terrace behind for loads of entertaining inside & out. A beautiful office / den with customized built-ins offers a great quiet space. The large primary suite boasts a huge walk in closet, changing room with custom built-ins & spa bath with double sinks, tub & shower. A 2nd bedroom offers an en suite bath. The 3rd and 4th bedrooms share a generously designed jack / jill bath. The third floor features a rec room or gym with a large storage area hidden behind. The full basement can be finished for additional 1500 SF of space. The lovely back yard offers place for pooch & play. Enjoy tennis at Mead Park and walk to almost everything!

This newly reimagined Colonial, fully renovated in 2024, is set on 2.38 impeccably manicured acres and offers complete privacy. The property features a large stone patio, a sparkling pool, a charming pool house, and a soccer field. Located in the desirable Silvermine Area, the home is nestled in a private cul-de-sac, perfect for dog walking and ensuring safety for children. Inside, you'll find designer finishes by Haley Design Company, soaring ceilings, and an open-concept floor plan. The renovations were masterfully completed by Farrell Remodeling Inc. The residence includes 6 bedrooms, 8 full and 3 half bathrooms, a private home office, 3 fireplaces, gym, home theater and a 700 bottle wine cellar with a tasting room. With all-new high-efficiency mechanicals, a 48 kW generator and a 3-car garage with epoxy floors, this home is truly irresistible.

Welcome to this stunning five-bedroom colonial, nestled on a highly sought-after cul-de-sac on Bennington Place. This charming residence is set on 3.66 acres of private, tranquil land, providing the perfect backdrop for serene living. As you approach the home, you're greeted by a picturesque covered wraparound porch, ideal for enjoying your morning coffee or relaxing in the evening. Step inside to find a beautifully appointed formal living room, dining room, and library each exuding elegance and style. The heart of this home is its renovated kitchen, featuring a spacious island and a cozy dining area with a vaulted ceiling and French doors that open onto a deck. The adjacent great room boasts a cathedral ceiling, window seat, fireplace, built-ins and French doors that also lead to the deck-making it perfect for both entertaining and everyday living. Retreat to the primary suite, which offers a private balcony, walk-in closet and luxurious en-suite bath. Additionally, the finished third-floor suite provides a versatile space with a bedroom, sitting area and full bath, ideal for guests or as a serene hideaway. The walkout lower level is equally impressive, complete with built-ins and a wine cellar, offering an exceptional space for leisure and gatherings. This exceptional home combines classic charm with modern amenities. Don't miss your chance to make this dream home your own.

listings.remarks: This beautifully renovated 4 bedroom, 3.5 baths townhouse boasts excellent finishes throughout, featuring a stunning kitchen with high end Thermadore appliances, modern design elements, recess lighting that creates a warm inviting ambiance.The open floor plan on the main level creates a seamless flow between the family room, dining, kitchen and living room. The home is adorned with elegant hardwood floors and all new staircase banisters, adding a touch of sophistication. The lower level has a guest suite with privacy and comfort for visitors or extended family. This home combines style, functionality and luxury. The 2nd level includes 3 spacious bedrooms with two sharing a convenient Jack & Jill bathroom. The primary bedroom is a luxurious en suite.

Welcome to 25 Lukes Wood Road (aka Father's Folly), one of the most unique homes and desirable neighborhoods in New Canaan. A straight shot along beautiful Oenoke Ridge from the vibrant downtown, you will be immediately captivated by its covered front porch and sunny upper deck. You will not be disappointed when you walk in the front door and see all the light! The heart of this home lies in the inviting living spaces, especially a gracious living room with a fireplace, picture window overlooking the private yard and access to the terrace with a stone fireplace. The eat-in gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream. A butler's pantry leads to the formal dining room and light filled family room, a favorite gathering spot. The designated office, first floor guest suite, and expansive mudroom complete the first floor. Upstairs you'll find an incredible great room with a cathedral ceiling, rustic beams and balcony. The two story primary suite, with dressing room and spa like bath, opens to a large western facing balcony. The four additional bedrooms have en-suite baths. The finished 3rd floor provides endless possibilities, from a gym, art studio, playroom ... The expansive flat yard is perfect for outdoor recreation and entertaining, from soccer games to garden parties and a potential pool site. There is even a sugar shack for continuing the tradition of making your own syrup. LOCATION is key! Nearby Scotts Corner, Bedford and Vista provide even more options for dining and shopping.

Discover this charming 3-bedroom, 1-bath ranch home nestled in the heart of New Canaan. This property features a beautifully renovated kitchen with white cabinetry and stunning millwork, along with hardwood floors throughout. The three bedrooms are filled with natural light. Huge unfinished area next to garage with ample storage. Enjoy the spacious, level backyard perfect for outdoor activities, and take advantage of the home's prime location just minutes from the vibrant downtown area, filled with shops, restaurants, and the convenient Metro North train station for an easy NYC commute. Sold As-is.

Convenient 2nd floor office suite in South Main Commons, ideally located on Route 25 with access to Newtown, Monroe, and surrounding business districts. The suite features two spacious private offices, entry/office area, and professionally finished common areas. Furniture is available with purchase/rent!   **Needs new HVAC or total repair. Price reflects HVAC

This is the land you have been waiting and searching for. Create your own nature center, compound or private retreat on this 32 acre property in prime New Canaan location. Enjoy perfect solitude and open space just one hour from NYC and just minutes from village center. Walking trails meander through the property's rolling hills, park-like lawns, woodlands, meadows, pond and stream. Nothing compares to this quality land.

Discover luxury and privacy at this stunning colonial on iconic Ponus Ridge. Set on 2.2 lush acres with perennial gardens and bordering conservation land, this west-side oasis is minutes from town, trains, and West Elementary School. Move-in with a new roof, renovated bathrooms, freshly painted interiors, and meticulous mechanicals, this home blends elegance with modern convenience. The grand two-story foyer with custom millwork throughout leads to gorgeous living spaces, including a living room with a marble mahogany fireplace, a formal dining room with a wet bar, and a family room featuring a cathedral ceiling, fieldstone fireplace, and a wall of windows showcasing the tranquil backyard. The chef's kitchen is a dream, offering Sub-Zero, Bosch, and Miele appliances, an oversized island, a walk-in pantry, and a sunny dining area with deck access. A screened three-season porch with vaulted ceilings, exposed beams, and mahogany floors is perfect for enjoying indoor-outdoor living. The luxurious primary suite boasts a spa-like bath and three walk-in closets. Four additional bedrooms, updated bathrooms, and an au pair/in-law suite with private stairway complete the upper level. The walk-out lower level offers versatility with a great room, gym, second office, half bath, and storage. Outside, relax or entertain on the expansive deck, slate patio or around the firepit, all while enjoying unmatched privacy. This estate is a rare blend of luxury, privacy, and convenience!

listings.remarks: A unique opportunity for investors. 5 unit multi-family on 1/3 acre close to town, train, schools, etc. All apartments are 1 bedroom. Current tenants are on month-to month leases. The Owner's apartment is attached to the side of the main building, which houses 4 apartments, and is interestingly designed to resemble the interior of a yacht!

Welcome to 17 River Street - a 2000+ square foot townhouse tucked away on a private lot and on the market for the first time in almost 40 years. Filled with light from large windows and skylights, this spacious condo, on three separate floors offers 3 generously sized bedrooms and 3 full baths that have recently been renovated. With a one car attached garage, recently paved driveway, family room with soaring ceilings, west facing living room with a bay window and fireplace, adjacent to the formal dining room, this wonderful homes offers endless opportunities. There is plenty of parking and sidewalks to downtown New Canaan Enjoy all of the wonderful activities New Canaan has to offer. Come visit 17 River Street today!

Charming In-Town Colonial Near New Canaan's Best Amenities  Nestled in the heart of New Canaan, this classic colonial offers the perfect combination of charm and convenience. Centrally located on a beautifully landscaped .58-acre lot in the desirable 1/3-acre zone, this home is just moments from New Canaan's stellar public schools, the vibrant village center, and quick access to the Merritt Parkway.   Featuring a new roof (2014) and new siding (2013), this well-maintained property is move-in ready with room to make it your own. Whether you're looking for proximity to schools, dining, and shopping or an easy commute, this location has it all. Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy in-town living with a suburban feel.

Walk through the front door and be wowed by the gorgeous views and sunsets over Mead Park and the Pond. This luxurious and spacious end unit feels like a house and features elegant living and dining spaces all with expansive views of the park. All rooms have beautifully painted millwork, much of which was added by the owners. There are new sound reducing, low-e windows in the living room, dining room and the primary bedroom, pristine hardwood floors throughout the home, and a sunny and fully finished lower level which adds flexible living space. The private and large stone patio which is accessed from the lower level has extensive plantings and a grassy area, perfect for a dog! The lower level also boasts a full bathroom, laundry room, extra storage and a utility room. The upper level has three spacious bedrooms including the impressive primary bedroom with a tray ceiling, built in speakers for music/tv, firepace, and an en-suite marble bath with separate shower and whirlpool bath, custom walk-in in closet which also has a pull-down to access the newly-floored large storage attic. The other two bedrooms are both comfortably proportioned, also have custom closets, and share a hall bath. The large custom kitchen with stainless Viking appliances, granite counters, copious cabinets and has a large area for a table or conversation seating. Drive into your attached garage and enjoy all the New Canaan lifestyle has to offer. Walk to restaurants, train and shopping.

NEW HOME JUST COMPLETED by Woodcrest Homes and ready for immediate occupancy. Ultra-Prime Location on 2.45 private acres w/room for a pool & pool house. Sited on cul-de-sac with spectacular western views & sunsets. 10' ceilings, seven ensuite bedrooms, transitional style throughout w/beautiful finishes. 4 fireplaces w wonderful flow. Primary suite w/stunning bath w/radiant heat floors & cathedral ceiling. Paneled library, custom millwork throughout, bright chef's kitchen w/adjacent breakfast room, family room with coffered ceiling, finished lower level & 3rd floor, large mudroom w/radiant heat floors. Design services provided by Haley Design Company. Woodcrest Homes has a stellar reputation & a roster of highly satisfied clients.

There is something to be said for an easy, convenient, low maintenance lifestyle! Feel right at home in this 3-bedroom 2.5 baths New Canaan Townhouse featuring hardwood floors, an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, custom cabinetry and stone flooring. The adjacent dining room walks out to a spacious deck for outdoor dining as well. Enjoy beautiful, natural views of the Five Mile River and relaxation from the private deck. The home includes a walk-out finished lower level including a newer full bathroom and laundry room (potential in-law/au-pair suite space, family room, or extra bedroom). There are two designated off-street parking spaces with supplemental visitor parking. Located close to town, train, shopping, dining, parks, award-winning schools, and all the charm New Canaan has to offer. Come see for yourself! *ASKING FOR HIGHEST & BEST OFFERS BY 9/24/24 6pm

listings.remarks: This charming storybook vintage classic, in the heart of New Canaan, is waiting for its new owner to make it their own. The generous sized rooms are full of character, architectural interest, beautiful natural light and original hardwood floors. The elegant and gracious living room with gorgeous period windows, fireplace and built-ins is stunning. Through pretty French doors, the dining room opens into a delightful screened porch with a skylit cathedral ceiling. The kitchen is adjacent to the step-down family room with high ceilings, bay window and door accessing the brick terrace. The circa 1900 barn has endless possibilities. Sited on a beautiful private lot with lovely gardens, this magical home offers a special opportunity for in-town living.

Discover an incredible investment opportunity with this bright and inviting two-family townhouse. Both units currently have tenants in place, making this a fantastic income-generating opportunity. Located in a highly desirable area, you'll appreciate the convenience of nearby town amenities and easy access to the train station.  **Unit 1** boasts 2 spacious bedrooms, 1.5 baths, a welcoming kitchen, and a comfortable living and dining area, along with an attached garage.   **Unit 2** 3 generous bedrooms, 1.5 baths, a charming kitchen, a cozy living room with a fireplace, a dining area, and a finished lower level, also featuring an attached garage.   Enjoy outdoor living with private decks for each unit, along with separate entrances that provide added privacy. The tranquil backyard serves as a relaxing retreat. While, attached garages, ample parking and in-suite laundry enhance the convenience. This townhouse is more than just a property; it's a lifestyle waiting to be claimed!

Great Location, Close To Town. Owner Will Build A Custom House To Buyers Specifications Or Land Can Be Purchased Alone. Very Private. Can be combined with purchase of property at 244 West Road to build your own custom estate on flat, wooded and open private 4.91 acres less than 1 mile to town.

This Unique Prime Property has a close to town location and is extremely private. It Borders A 42 Acre Land Trust That Cannot Be Developed. This land has never been built on and is ready for a custom home! Property can be combined with Land Listing for 230 West Road to build your own custom estate on flat, wooded and open private 4.91 acres less that 1 mile to town.

Welcome to this exquisite 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome in the heart of New Canaan's Prides Crossing. This beautifully renovated Georgian gem offers luxurious living with modern amenities and elegant design. Enjoy the open-concept living area with a wood-burning fireplace, updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and a private garden patio perfect for relaxation. The home boasts hardwood floors, custom lighting, and thoughtful updates throughout. Upstairs, find a spacious primary suite and two additional bedrooms. A finished lower level provides extra living space and storage. Residents of Prides Crossing enjoy access to a private pool and clubhouse. Located just minutes from town, parks, shopping, and the train station, this home has the perfect blend of suburban charm and urban convenience, all within an hour of Manhattan.

listings.remarks: What a charmer! A remarkable find in New Canaan! Move right into this 1927 antique with covered front porch and stone fireplace. Three bedrooms and two full baths. Lovely 1.16 acre property with sweeping back yard, mature trees and landscaping. There is a separate barn garage with additional storage. Plenty of room for expansion. Automatic generator. Conveniently located just one short mile to the town center, express train to NYC, schools, parks, shops & restaurants. A wonderful place to call home.

Move right into this storybook 3300SF Nantucket-style cape on lovely in-town cul-de-sac minutes to town and train. Recently reimagined and updated with great style and sophistication, this fabulous 5 bedroom 4.5 bath home has a flexible floor plan for easy living , working and comfortable entertaining. Extensive list of improvements is available. Notably the addition of a full bath and laundry room on the second floor, creation of first floor powder room, new mudroom with built-in cubbies, new propane fired HVAC system, new roof, kitchen refresh...the list goes on and on. The park-like setting with new landscaping, lovely gardens, bluestone terrace, new fencing and a large play yard is private and inviting. A GEM!!!

Charming 5-BR Colonial is a perfect blend of space & comfort, set on 4.5 acres in a serene woodland oasis. You'll enjoy easy access to shops, restaurants & Metro North. Home has been meticulously maintained, featuring fresh paint, new boiler & hot water tank. With a possible in-law/au pair suite on the first floor, this layout is perfect for versatile living. The inviting three-season sun porch flows into a spacious family room, creating an ideal spot for relaxation. Upstairs, the generous bedrooms boast hardwood floors, ample closet space & updated baths. Finished Lower Level adds 724SF of heated living space, complete w/new carpeting, perfect for playtime, exercise or movie nights. Plus, you'll benefit from award-winning New Canaan schools. Don't miss out on this hidden gem.

Discover a unique opportunity in Silvermine with this charming property featuring three distinct buildings. The main house is move-in ready, showcasing a bright, open living room filled with natural light, a cozy corner window seat, recessed lighting, and abundant windows. The remodeled kitchen boasts quartz countertops, a marble backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and a convenient powder room. The inviting dining room opens to a terrace, while a cozy home office adjacent to the living room has scenic views of the property. The second floor includes two bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a custom walk-in closet. On the ground floor, you'll find a welcoming entry foyer, ample closets, a laundry room, and a mechanical/storage area. The property also includes a two-car barn-style garage with loft storage and a separate artist's studio or office featuring a wood-burning stove. Enjoy entertaining on the stunning stone patio with picturesque views of the Silvermine River. Additional features include central air, custom window blinds, attractive stone driveway and a new septic system installed in 2018. Nestled in historic Silvermine, this home is just a short walk to GrayBarns and the Silvermine Arts Center, making it the ideal enclave for those seeking both charm and convenience.

Nestled in a tranquil setting this beautiful home has 6 bedrooms and 4.2 bathrooms. Newly renovated kitchen and family room, 5 fireplaces plus walk out finished lower level. The pool and pool cabana offer the perfect entertainment  outdoor space. Recent updates:kitchen new quartz countertops, new backsplash & fixtures, new cabinet drawers & panels plus new hood. New family room w/gas fireplace & hardwood floors plus built-ins. Pool cover and fence recently replaced. Many more improvements!

Welcome to this sunny townhouse located on a cul-de-sac. Walk to town and to train station. Open concept with updated kitchen, overlooking dining room and living room. Private deck off of kitchen. Three bedroom and one- and one-half bath that both have been remodeled. Large, finished basement great for family room or a home office, also a laundry room. Harwood floor through out and central air. The roof is newer and new siding on this home is ready for a new owner.

Nestled on one of New Canaan's "close to everything" streets, 48 Douglas is a charming three-bedroom home with endless possibilities. Situated on a perfectly flat and private lot, this property is just minutes to the elementary, middle and high schools, a walk to downtown New Canaan's vibrant shops, restaurants, and easy commute to both Metro-North train stations in town.    Whether you're looking to renovate, expand, or build new, this prime location ensures lasting value. Enjoy the convenience of living close to town while benefiting from the serenity of this sought-after neighborhood.   Don't miss the opportunity to start a new chapter at 48 Douglas Road!

Welcome to a beautiful country estate in a storybook setting on  park-like gated 4-acre level property with front porch and all on a quiet, private lane (223 Michigan is also known as Lee Lane). Experience unparalleled luxury in this stunning 5-bedroom, 7-bath home, boasting high ceilings, open format and an updated kitchen perfect for entertaining. The great room/breakfast room/kitchen with vaulted ceiling, fireplace, sitting island and cozy eating nook are all favorite gathering spots. Admire the beautiful millwork throughout, and bask in the abundant natural light that floods the kitchen, breakfast room, and family room. Additionally, the home features a large mudroom and a dedicated dog room, catering to all your practical and pet-friendly needs. There are multiple work from home office options on the main floor and second floor. This exquisite property combines elegance, comfort, and functionality. Outdoor amenities include a newly installed gunite pool with auto cover, large patio with stone chimney fireplace all surrounded by lush lawns, nature, peace and tranquility.

CUSTOM HOME-To be masterfully built by Coastal Luxury Homes, 74 Pastures Lane will embody the the perfect culmination of classic design with a nod to a modern aesthetic. Inclusive of six bedrooms, all en suite, this home will boast three finished floors with an opportunity to finish the lower level based on the needs of your busy lifestyle. Indoor spaces will feature exceptional materials, meticulous attention to detail and 9'+ ceilings throughout. Outside broad stone terraces will overlook a sweeping back lawn. The location is second to none; located on an sought after east side cul de sac just minutes to the Village.

Welcome to 168 Lost District Drive, an estate property nestled on over 4 acres of serene, professionally landscaped grounds. Designed by prominent New Canaan architect James Schettino, this meticulously maintained home boasts 6 generously-sized bedrooms including a possible in-law suite and 4.1 elegantly appointed bathrooms, offering an exceptional living experience. Upon entering, you are greeted by a dramatic foyer with soaring two-story ceiling and a sweeping curved staircase. The sun-drenched art gallery, adorned with spotlights, sets the tone for sophistication. The skylit formal living room, with its vaulted ceiling and wood-burning fireplace with granite surround and custom mantle is a space to cherish. The expansive formal dining room features a gas fireplace, perfect for special gatherings. The octagonal-shaped first-floor office, bathed in natural light and featuring a spiral staircase, offers a unique and inspiring environment. A study/den with a wall of bookcases, has a spiral staircase that connects to a library loft retreat. The eat-in kitchen, equipped with high-end stainless steel appliances including a Thermador double oven, Sub-Zero refrigerator, Jenn-Air gas cook top and twin Kenmore dishwashers, opens to a cozy family room with a wood-burning fireplace, a screen porch and a deck. The adjacent butlers pantry/chef's kitchen includes a second Sub-Zero refrigerator, Jenn-Air electric cooktop and sink.... Click arrow for additional remarks...

listings.remarks: Renovate, rebuild or restore! This is the best in town village location with endless opportunities to customize and renovate. First time on the market since 1970. 101 is currently being offered as the perfect renovation project. See and experience the endless possibilities to create your perfect home.  Currently a 3 bed, 1.5 bath, 1,304 SF ranch home on a 0.19 acre lot.  This opportunity of a home awaits the next visionary to love and adore while creating their new-found 'home sweet home'. If you like home makeover shows and fixer-uppers, then you will love the opportunity to customize this home to your own lifestyle needs.   Discover the preserved past and reimagine the possibilities to design or rebuild your own New Canaan dream home!

Welcome to 42 Alan Lane in New Canaan, where modern luxury meets classic beauty. Built by renowned design-build team Gardiner Larson in 2000 and completely reimagined and renovated in 2022-23 to reflect today's modern classic aesthetic, this beautiful estate overlooks almost 5 acres of lush, sweeping Connecticut landscape complete with heated pool and potential tennis court site. Built for entertaining, the first floor features a magnificent kitchen with an oversized island designed to comfortably seat 6 people, opening to a generously proportioned family room and expansive patio - perfect for casual gatherings inside or out. Experience your wine collection from the integrated dining room wine room or enjoy cocktails by the double sided fireplace in the adjacent conversation room. A formal living room flanked by french doors, leads to a beautiful office with a wood burning fireplace and extensive millwork. Every room opens to outdoor wonder - a sunken firepit that seats a crowd, a covered conversation area with firepit, a large patio for dining and built-in spa overlooking the gorgeous property and trees.

Country Living at its finest! This charming Colonial is set on over 3 acres with 3 bedrooms and two baths. An entertainers dream with a large eat in kitchen open to the family room with a fireplace and French doors leading out to a spacious deck. The open floor plan flows seamlessly from room to room with French doors throughout and a finished basement with a fireplace. This gem is South facing, filling the house with sun from morning until dusk and great for gardening. Organically maintained grounds. Just a few steps to the walking trails at Brown Preserve on the Resevoir and St.Lukes School.

Situated on a cul de sac within minutes to town on 1.3 acres along the Noroton River. Beautiful open floor plan with two sided fireplace opening into Living room and updated kitchen and dining area. Living room and kitchen open out to expansive deck with amazing views and privacy. Lower level family room with fireplace, built-in bar area and office. Bedroom opens out to lovely patio with hot tub. Wonderful main level primary bedroom with completely renovated bathroom and walk-in closet. Cozy den/office off kitchen. Amazing Park like setting!

Solidly built by well-regarded Nordic Builders, this timeless six bedroom colonial on New Canaan's West side awaits. The intuitive floor plan offers an easy, flowing combination of formal and informal spaces allowing for effortless entertaining and time with friends and family. A beautiful primary suite provides a sanctuary to re-energize with a fireplace, private deck overlooking perfectly flat two acres, a large bathroom and two enormous walk-in closets. Five additional en-suite bedrooms, a formal dining room, a fully finished basement with a wine-cellar, recreational space and full bath, a finished third level with full bath, bedroom and bonus space, a gorgeous office with fireplace, a mudroom, a large multi-level patio with a fieldstone fireplace and a pool site provide a well-rounded and inviting retreat. Classic architectural details combine with welcome amenities including a generator, heated four-car garage and fenced-in property with mature perimeter landscaping, providing privacy, peace of mind and comfort for years to come.

listings.remarks: This is the one for you. This centrally located 1 bedroom condo is a ground floor end unit with assigned parking directly in front of the unit. It is close to everything New Canaan has to offer and conveniently close to the Merritt Parkway. The entire interior is 3 years new. There is a storage room and mechanical room in the basement. Parking space assigned to the unit is #14

HIGHEST AND BEST due by Monday 10/28 at 5:00 PM Don't miss this renovated, in town Colonial that's only steps from Mead Park, the train and New Canaan's charming village! The gourmet kitchen includes a new Bertazzoni Induction Range, Whirlpool Refrigerator and a walk-in pantry. In addition, there's a cozy family room with new carpeting and a wood burning fireplace that's right next to the kitchen. The second floor includes a primary suite with his and her walk-in closets, a gas fireplace and a laundry room. Outside, there's a new construction garage with 432 square feet of additional room, a freshly repaved driveway and a new patio with landscaping. Welcome to the neighborhood!

Wonderful top floor condo is exceptionally appointed with high end finishing and is move in ready. Amazing transformation to a luxury, elegant residence with 2 bedrooms in New Canaan's most prime sought after location. This condo is unique with a separate home office accessed by French doors. The granite kitchen is bright and modern and the upgraded bath is light and white. Experience this luxurious residence with custom moldings and radiator covers, recessed lighting, generous closets plus additional storage. Gas heat and hot water are included in the low monthly common charges. This condo has a gorgeous view of a treelined landscape and is located in the quiet rear corner of the complex with easy back door access. Loads of storage including lower level area storage. Reserved parking and private patio are right outside the door. Whether you are a first time purchaser or looking for a relaxed life style or even an investment opportunity, this perfectly located condo checks all the boxes. Situated across from dog friendly Mead Park with gorgeous pond for skating and fishing, baseball fields, tennis and pickleball courts, playground and outdoor cafe, the location is perfect. Also just steps away from New Canaan's vibrant town center with it's award winning restaurants, movie theater, shops, brand new library, galleries and train to NYC. For in town living, this is a dream come true.

An Amazing Opportunity to see a Designer Showcase home totally transformed by the current owners. Treat yourself and treat your clients. Come preview a chic sophisticated home with an outstanding floor plan, spacious rooms, high ceilings and the finest finishes. Enjoy an elevated lifestyle with rooms for every occasion. The Living Room with beautiful millwork is a special haven for entertaining. The open floor plan of the Family Room with fireplace opening to a gourmets dream Kitchen is undisputably perfect. Working from home is not a challenge with several sun filled Offices. Join friends & family in the Great Room for games, billiards, and conversations. Or watch serious sports, movies and more in the lower level Media Room Beautifully sited and beautifully landscaped on over an acre, you are minutes from shopping, parks, trains and schools.

Walk to town, the train, the new library and restaurants in minutes from this vintage classic at 20 Hoyt! Step into this 3,388 sq ft home that has been updated to look chic and modern. Enchanting wrap around front porch leads the way to a cozy & comfortable 1st floor with bar, lovely dining room. Kitchen opens up to family w/ fireplace. Glass doors take you to terrace with firepit and 3 car barn garage. 4 bedrooms include gorgeous primary suite w/ marble bath. In town living at its BEST!

Welcome to this sunny townhouse located on a cul-de-sac. Walk to town and to train station. Open concept with updated kitchen, overlooking dining room and living room. Private deck off of kitchen. Three bedroom and one- and one-half bath that both have been remodeled. Large, finished basement great for family room or a home office, also a laundry room. Harwood floor through out and central air. The roof is newer and new siding on this home is ready for a new owner.

Nestled in an exceptional location close to town, 181 Lambert Rd offers an unparalleled living experience. Architecturally enhanced, this estate exudes timeless elegance while embracing modern luxury. Built like a fortress & with the highest standards, it is designed to entertain on a grand scale. A two-story foyer welcomes you with front-to-back views of the meticulously manicured grounds. Soaring ceilings and stunning vistas grace every room, creating an atmosphere of light and space. The formal living & dining room open seamlessly to a spacious terrace, showcasing the serene surroundings. At the heart of the home is a state-of-the-art kitchen & spacious family room featuring a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace, custom built-ins, & French doors that open to a sunroom, all leading to the east facing terrace with views of the gardens & river. A separate entrance leads to the mudroom with direct access to the three-car garage for effortless organization. The main floor is highlighted by a stately, wood-paneled library & a luxurious primary suite with bath, sitting room, & two walk in closets. Upstairs, three en-suite bedrooms offer privacy & comfort. The lower level offers a wealth of additional space, including a game room with fireplace, full bar, media room & in-law/guest suite with separate entrance. The Har-Tru tennis court, Monet-inspired bridge, exceptional stone walls and patios, perennial gardens and specimen plantings complete this one of a kind offering.

Magnificent Federal Style Colonial built in 1835 with Red Barn, minutes to downtown New Canaan. The home features 7 bedrooms and 4 full baths, powder room on main level, additional half bath in the basement, large primary suite and a second junior suite with 2 additional bedroom on the second floor, 2 additional bedrooms with full bath on the 3rd floor. fantastic floorplan including a butlers pantry, sunroom porch, den, family room, large entertainment deck/patio and mudroom laundry conveniently located on the main level, full walkout basement with 2 car attached garage and space for workshop. Quick drive to the Merritt Parkway and convenient to Downtown Train.

listings.remarks: ***BEST & FINAL OFFERS DUE BY 2:00PM Wed, 11/27.*** This beautifully updated ranch-style home in desirable New Canaan offers 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 full baths, making it an ideal choice for those seeking modern living in a tranquil setting. The large family room, complete with a cozy fireplace, flows seamlessly into a chef's kitchen featuring stone countertops, a stylish tiled backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and tile flooring. The open-concept layout continues into the dining and living areas, where gleaming hardwood floors and recessed lighting create a bright, inviting atmosphere throughout. The home's thoughtful design includes a primary suite at each end for added privacy. The first primary suite offers a serene retreat with a full bath featuring a tiled shower. Two additional well-sized bedrooms share a beautifully tiled full bath. On the opposite end of the house, the second primary suite is an impressive space, featuring a luxurious full bath with both a tiled shower and a soaking tub for ultimate relaxation. Outside, enjoy a large paver deck that overlooks the fenced-in backyard, perfect for entertaining or simply enjoying the outdoors. A one-car attached garage adds convenience, while the full, enormous basement offers endless potential-ready to be finished for additional living space, playrooms, or home office options. With its prime location, spacious layout, and thoughtful updates, this home combines modern comfort with the charm of New Canaan living.

Wonderful 4 BR 2 1/2 bath condo just two blocks from RR Station and shopping on Elm St, or one block from Mead Park. Primary BR with full bath and walk-in closet on main floor, with lovely balcony to enjoy sunsets. LR is oversized with fireplace and sliders to balcony. Private dining room adjoins kitchen and big enough to hold 8-10. Sunny eat-in kitchen fully equipped but still cozy. Upstairs there are two BRs with an oversized bathroom where the washer/dryer reside. The 4th BR is better called an office since it is so large at 23 ft.  Downstairs the unfinished basement has an additional 450 sf waiting for the next owner to finish it as a playroom or office. Parking is easy with an indoor garage under the unit with interior access to avoid rain and snow. Additionally, there is a marked space closeby in the parking lot outside.

listings.remarks: Welcome to Currier Court. An exciting opportunity is here to come and see a stylish two bedroom end unit ranch townhouse with a finished lower level and, believe it or not, an attached two car garage. This sparkling, bright corner ranch has brand new windows throughout, freshly painted, skylights, pocket doors, and ready to move in. It offers a cathedral ceiling living room with lots of windows, a family room adjoining the skylit kitchen with lots of built-ins and a fireplace. There are two bedrooms and two baths, one with skylights, and laundry all on the main level. On the lower level there is a nice large bonus room with new floors and three small windows bringing in natural light, a full bath and a wet bar, a good sized storage room which could be a potential office. There is also a large 2 car garage with two entrances to the lower level. A private garden is off the family room. This unit was originally the builder's model unit so there are extra custom features. One can walk to town, the train and all that the village of New Canaan has to offer.  Excellent value and priced to sell.  Run...do not walk!!

Prepare to be enchanted by the timeless elegance of this classic New England estate sited on 5.5 acres of sweeping lawns and mature gardens. An outdoor kitchen, patio and stone porch complete this offering. Don't miss the chance to make this exquisite piece of history your own!

listings.remarks: Classic Colonial with Stunning Views in a Prime Location Nestled on a coveted cul-de-sac, this classic four-bedroom Colonial offers sweeping views of the Forever Green Land Trust and the serene Five Mile River. Set on one acre of beautiful park like property, the home features Connecticut stone walls and a level front and back yard, elevated for optimal vistas. This spacious home is connected to public water and sewer, offering both comfort and convenience. Enjoy the outdoors from the charming screened porch or the patio, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. A new roof adds to the home's appeal, ensuring years of worry-free living. Ideally located close to town, this property provides the perfect balance of privacy and accessibility. Bring your vision and make this incredible home your own!

LOCATION! LOCATION! LOCATION! Nestled in a prime New Canaan neighborhood, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath colonial offers classic charm and a spacious layout, An incredible opportunity to make this your dream home. The main level features generous living spaces, including formal living room with fireplace, sun-filled family room with fireplace, a formal dining room, and a kitchen overlooking sunroom offers great potential for multiuse. Upstairs, the primary suite includes an en-suite bath and walk in closet., while three additional bedrooms and a full bath provide ample space. The lower level offers flexibility for a future playroom, home office, gym, etc... Situated on a beautiful lot in one of New Canaan's most sought-after neighborhoods, this home is just minutes from YMCA, top-rated schools, town, parks, and the train. A rare opportunity to find a location like this!!!

Welcome to this exquisite stone and shingle home, an extraordinary masterpiece built in the timeless English Cotswold tradition. Updated in 1999 and again in the early 2000's, this impeccably designed home showcases unparalleled craftsmanship, and captivates with its attention to every detail, offering a truly custom living experience. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by the allure of Palladian windows, arched doorways, and meticulously crafted custom moldings that adorn the interiors. The ambiance of this home is one of elegance and charm, with a seamless blend of classic antiques and modern comforts, creating a harmonious living space. The heart of this enchanting estate is its stone pool, where you can bask in the sunlight and enjoy refreshing swims on warm summer days. A gated entrance leads to the meticulously landscaped gardens surrounding the fenced-in property, which boasts a myriad of vibrant flora and whimsical sculptures. This stone and shingle manor house offers a rare opportunity to reside in a truly unique and captivating residence. Embrace the charm of the English Cotswold tradition, paired with modern luxury and convenience, in this exceptional home.

Designed by renowned architect Rink Dupont, Sunneywood is a masterpiece of style and sophistication. Every space in this five-bedroom home is beautifully proportioned, featuring exquisite millwork, high-end finishes, and a seamless floor plan. The gracious foyer leads to a sunlit living room, elegant dining room, and inviting family room-all with walls of windows that frame the breathtaking 4.25-acre property. A stunning chef's kitchen, complete with luxury appliances, custom cabinetry, and rich stone countertops, offers the perfect space for everything from casual breakfasts in the charming banquette to elegant dinner parties. The family room and adjoining solarium overlook the spectacular grounds, featuring lush gardens, a pool, and a pool house. A paneled library doubles as a private retreat or fifth bedroom. Two luxurious primary suites-one on each level-are designed for comfort and serenity, while additional bedrooms boast window seats, bow windows, and custom details. Nestled on a private lane just minutes from the heart of New Canaan, Sunneywood offers an unparalleled blend of luxury, privacy, and convenience.

listings.remarks: Nestled in the sought-after Graystone neighborhood association, this beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bath end unit offers the perfect blend of convenience and comfort. The sun-filled, spacious layout boasts an eat-in kitchen with private deck off of the living area and is perfect for relaxing or entertaining. All three bedrooms are on the second floor to add ease to daily living. The newly finished basement provides a versatile space for a media room, home gym, or office. Additional features include laundry on the main level, detached garage and convenient guest parking. Don't miss this opportunity to own a move-in-ready home just minutes from the center of town, parks, and train.

This stunning home is designed to impress, offering both style and functionality in a highly desirable location. You're greeted by a sense of timeless elegance and thoughtful craftsmanship. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring custom cabinetry, a well-organized message center, and a butler's pantry. The family room serves as the heart of the home, with a striking stone fireplace as the focal point, complemented by built-ins. A formal living room exudes sophistication, with a custom mantle framing the polished slate fireplace, while the formal dining room offers rich paneling. The office is a true standout, with cathedral ceilings and hand-hewn antique beams. The primary suite is a luxurious retreat, featuring custom cabinetry and a spa-like marble bath. Waterworks faucets and fixtures throughout. A lower level offers a variety of spaces including a playroom, art & crafts area, gym, and cedar-lined bath with steam shower. Outside, a bluestone patio invites you to enjoy the fresh air, while stone walls, a fire pit and a professionally landscaped yard provide a beautiful space. A special offering!

Fabulous west facing end unit in desirable Hathaway Common Condominium in the heart of New Canaan. This well maintained condo has a light filled first with a spacious living room with two sets of French doors opening to the gracious patio, side yard and pool. The second floor has 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths and a finished lower level family room. There is a gracious foyer and attached garage. As an added bonus, there is a second detached garage perfect for a second car or storage. The garage is one of 8 detached garages in the complex. This is a must see home moments to everything New Canaan has to offer.

listings.remarks: A rare opportunity to own a legacy estate that would command over $50 million to recreate in today's market. Orchard's End, built in 1929 designed by New York architect William B. Tubby, his outstanding designs include Waveny House in New Canaan, Dunnellen Hall in Greenwich and the William H. Childs House in Brooklyn. Beginning in 2014, the current owners retained world renowned architect Dinyar Wadia to embark on a 3-year 6 million dollar renovation perfecting the already expansive 10,000 square foot addition completed by the previous owners. Not only was the main residence improved and expanded upon a brand new 2,000 square foot 4-bedroom guest house, along with a custom designed 5,000 square foot wellness center, a custom pool with spa and new terraces transformed Orchard's End Estate into a true masterpiece. The main residence's addition includes a new kitchen, great room, outdoor courtyard, and study. Providing the inspiration for the great room was Castle Duart, located on the Isle of Mull and featured in the 1999 movie Entrapment in which Sean Connery and Catherina Zeta-Jones, playing art thieves, practice their moves for a high-tech heist. FURNISHED option available for separate pricing.

listings.remarks: This exquisite 7 bedroom & 11 bath residence set on 4.78 flat acres offers old world aesthetics with modern artistry. The craftsmanship of the millwork, finishes and features is unparalleled including reclaimed oak flooring imported from France and Hope's custom designed steel windows and doors. The living room w/fireplace leads to billiards room and sunroom w/access to back patio w/fireplace. The formal dining room includes custom designed hand painted Gracie wallpaper, and the open gourmet kitchen enjoys luxury appliances, eating area w/ fireplace, pantry, home office & French doors for a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The family room has a soaring double-height ceiling surrounded by floor to ceiling windows, double doors & fireplace. The primary bedroom suite is a sanctuary on the second-floor w/double doors leading to terrace, two separate bathrooms w/dressing areas and walk in closets. There are 4 ensuite bedrooms, home office, study and laundry area on the second level. A playroom & media room occupy the top floor. The harmonious transition between interior and outdoors is facilitated by numerous access points, connecting the elegant indoor spaces to expansive outdoor spaces, including guest house/pool house leading out to the pool & spa with pergola. The lower level offers versatile space with golf simulator & putting green, bar area, gym/yoga studio, wine cellar & home theatre. Renovated barn w/inlay hardwood floor & sport court is next to tennis court. Prop in CT & NY

In-town colonial charmer with income Potential & single-family flexibility. Nestled on a quiet residential street in the heart of town, this classic two-family colonial offers timeless charm, impressive flexibility, and a truly rare investment opportunity. With its high ceilings, oversized windows, and sun-filled rooms, this home effortlessly blends historic character with everyday functionality. Currently configured as a legal two-family residence, the property includes a versatile studio/home office space above a two-car garage-ideal for a remote work setup, guest suite, or potential in-law/nanny suite. The home's layout allows for easy conversion into a spacious single-family residence, making it perfect for a variety of lifestyle needs, whether you're looking to grow, downsize, or generate rental income. This property has delivered consistent, dependable rental income for 20 years. Live in one unit and rent the other, or lease both for maximum return. The private fenced yard is a serene escape, framed by mature trees and gardens, offering both tranquility and convenience. Located just steps from the new world-class library, shops, restaurants, movie theater, Metro-North train station, and top-rated schools, this property truly delivers the best of in-town living. Whether you're starting out, investing, or retiring, this home presents a unique opportunity to build equity in a highly desirable location. Don't miss your chance to own this one-of-a-kind gem!

Spectacular single-floor living nestled on an oversized lot in the 2 acre zone - 3.85 serene acres overlooking Collins Pond. This remarkable property features breathtaking landscapes, a private dock, in-ground pool, and expansive sun-filled terrace-perfect for entertaining. Surrounded by magnificent old trees, enjoy unmatched privacy with 4 garages, a workshop, and a guest/caretaker apartment. Located on a quiet West side cul-de-sac off Ponus Ridge. Full of potential, sold as-is. A rare opportunity in a private, tranquil setting.

Embrace the convenience of in-town New Canaan living with this exquisite 2-bedroom condo, ideally located within walking distance to the train station and the village. Built in 2001, this home offers a modern and sophisticated lifestyle with its open floor plan and 9-foot ceilings that create an airy and spacious ambiance. The heart of the home is the kitchen, where granite countertops and stainless steel appliances offer both beauty and functionality, perfect for the home chef who loves to entertain. The seamless flow from the kitchen to the living areas ensures that you're never far from the conversation. Hardwood floors and a wonderful wood burning fireplace add to the first floor's warmth. The primary bedroom, a second bedroom, a recently remodeled full bath and a laundry room are found on the second floor. The newly finished third floor adds a versatile space that can be tailored to your needs, whether it's a home office, a media room, or a quiet retreat. The lower level is also finished, providing additional space for a playroom or relaxation. Step outside to your private fenced yard, an urban oasis where you can play and unwind. The terrace offers a lovely spot to enjoy your morning coffee or evening cocktails. This condo is not just a home; it's a lifestyle choice for those seeking comfort, convenience, and a touch of luxury in their everyday lives. And best of all there are NO HOA charges! Move in and start your enviable in town living lifestyle.

Stone walls and white entry gates open to a manicured gravel courtyard and a welcoming residence-an expanded and refined carriage house in the historic Silvermine district of New Canaan. Thoughtfully renovated & expanded in 2018, this timeless home blends Connecticut charm with a touch of whimsy. Large barrel vaulted windows & French doors fill the interior with natural light & create a seamless connection to the professionally landscaped grounds. Cathedral ceiling great room features radiant heated floors and soaring glass walls, offering stunning views and effortless indoor-outdoor living. The chef's kitchen is anchored by a striking French blue La Cornue 6-burner range & hood, with quartzite counters, Sub-Zero fridge, Bosch dishwasher, island, window seat with detailed custom cabinetry. A cozy sun-filled living room with fireplace, intimate dining room, main and upper-level offices, & hardwood floors throughout complete the inviting layout. A barrel vaulted glass-windowed hallway leads to the luxurious primary bedroom retreat with soaring ceilings and dramatic barrel vaulted windows, spa-like bath with the most elegant finishes, huge fitted dressing room, coffee & beverage station, and a large private balcony/deck draped in white canvas & flowing curtains. Outside, specimen trees surround a heated saltwater pool & patios, while the sunroom with radiant floors offers year-round comfort and garden views. This unique and elegant estate is truly one-of-a-kind.

listings.remarks: Discover elegance at this custom stone and shingle French Colonial on 4.9 bucolic acres on New Canaan's coveted west side. Bordering an 11-acre land trust, this 8,332 SF home, plus 2,300 SF finished lower level, offers privacy and proximity to downtown New Canaan and NYC commutes. The exquisite gardens, Inspired by Villa d'Este, create a resort-like setting with spectacular views from every window. The grounds feature parterre gardens, a pool, cabana, bluestone terraces with custom wrought iron railings, and a treed meadow. A Belgian block-lined driveway leads to two 2-car garages with a porte-cochere. Grand interior spaces have oversized windows, 10-12' ceilings, Brazilian cherry floors, five marble fireplaces, and deep moldings. The 1,500 SF kitchen and family room dazzle with a Pietra Cardosa island, Viking range, Sub-Zero appliances, and French doors to terraces. The primary suite features a 13' cathedral ceiling, balcony, and luxurious bathroom. Four additional large en-suite bedrooms provide overnight guests and family complete privacy.  A study area, lower-level sixth bedroom, playroom, wine cellar, gym, and sauna complete the home. Fencing, electronic gates, and alarm system ensure a safe environment for the entire family. Modern systems include central vacuum, security, water purifier, and EV charger. This is a forever home to be treasured through the generations.

listings.remarks: WALK TO TOWN from this lovely renovated condo minutes from downtown New Canaan. Spacious and bright rooms in this elegant townhouse boasting a brand new eat-in kitchen with a subzero, marble counters and high-end cabinets. Large dining room and Living Room with a fireplace and French Doors. The newly decorated lower level with a fireplace opens to the private patio complete with beautiful sunsets. The primary bedroom and newly renovated marble bath and guest room/office with a bath give you all the space you need. In the Cobbler's Green Association, you can enjoy the summers at the large in-ground community pool. One car attached garage and additional guest parking. Don't miss this opportunity.

Nestled on Valley Rd, this gardener's paradise welcomes you to a 4 bedroom Colonial with heated pool. This sunlit home features a first floor primary bedroom, spacious living room and vaulted family room opening to a lovely pool and terrace. The kitchen leads to an oversized screened in porch. A four season sunroom, den and generous dining room complete the first floor. 3 additional bedrooms are on the second floor. The mature plantings and grounds are beautifully maintained and borders a 20 acre New Canaan Land Trust. Welcome to 378 Valley Rd. *House will be sold in its present condition*

Welcome to 321 Frogtown Lane, a pristine stone and shingle Colonial home nestled on 2 acres in a private cul-de-sac, just minutes away from the Village of New Canaan. This 6-bedroom, 4.5-bath residence with Guest Quarters is ideal for a family eager to enjoy the quality of life and amenities New Canaan has to offer. The home has been completely updated and meticulously maintained, featuring wood floors throughout. The upper level boasts 5 spacious bedrooms, including the master suite with a luxury bath, fireplace, and walk-in closet. A second bedroom also offers a full bath, fireplace, and walk-in closet. The large, eat-in chef's kitchen is outfitted with top-of-the-line appliances, perfect for daily dining and entertaining guests. Special features include a sunroom with a 9-foot ceiling and expansive windows providing a view of the wooded back lot and pond. The fully finished lower level offers versatile space for a home office, gym, guest accommodation, or an in-law suite. Lower-level doors open to a walk-out terrace and an inviting pool patio, ideal for entertaining or quiet relaxation. A backyard path leads to a peaceful pond, enhancing the serene setting. The residence also offers ample parking with a circular front drive and a 3-car attached garage. At 321 Frogtown Lane, enjoy privacy and serenity with the convenience of being less than half a mile from shopping, restaurants, parks, and recreation facilities in the center of the village.

Inspired by the grandeur and sculptural decoration of the Gilded Age this home is a celebration of artistic heritage and meticulous craftsmanship. Presenting a Masterpiece by Dinyar Wadia: A Georgian Colonial of Distinction. Professionally landscaped parklike property boasting specimen trees and plantings with identified site for pool & pool house. Step into a realm of timeless elegance with this one-of-a-kind Georgian colonial. Built to stand the test of time, constructed using steel, concrete, brick & slate. The intricate brickwork & gabled slate roof pay homage to an era of craftsmanship. Quality is paramount with premium materials gracing every surface. The high ceilings amplify the sense of well proportioned space & luxury. Be WOWED by the soaring front to back entry, formal living room, dining room and wood paneled office. A gourmet kitchen is a culinary haven with a sunlit breakfast nook that gracefully opens out to a serene patio courtyard. The 2nd floor features 5 gracious sized bedrooms with sumptuous en-suite bathrooms and walk in closets. There is an additional 3,300 SF in the LL, already outfitted with a full bathroom and gym. Transform the UFLL space to home theater, playroom & sports/rec space. A sun-drenched finished 3rd floor is currently used as play space & art studio. Simply the best of everything at 794 Oenoke Ridge.

Welcome to 24 Orchard Lane. Nestled at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in one of New Canaan's most sought-after neighborhoods, this charming 1939 Cape Cod-style home provides the perfect blend of character, comfort, and modern convenience. Set on 0.49 acres of thoughtfully landscaped grounds, the property is adorned with mature plantings that burst with color throughout the seasons, creating a picturesque and inviting setting. The home has been beautifully expanded to include a spacious open-concept family room and kitchen, an ideal gathering space. The second floor showcases a generously sized primary bedroom with soaring ceilings, abundant closet space, and a serene fireplace that serves as the focal point, adding a touch of luxury to your private oasis. Additional highlights include a welcoming front screened-in porch, a two-car garage, and a large backyard with a pergola & patio which is perfect for outdoor entertaining or relaxing in a very peaceful setting. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to own a home that combines timeless charm with thoughtful updates in one of the most desirable locations. Homes like this - brimming with character and potential to customize to your personal style - rarely come on the market. This is truly a special find!

Discover the perfect blend of historic charm and modern comfort in this stately Silvermine antique set above picturesque Mill Rd. The property is beautifully landscaped with flat lawns, stunning stone walls and a series of garden rooms. The large bluestone patio off the kitchen/family room overlooks a manicured garden glade with serene sounds of the Silvermine River rustling below, a perfect place for morning coffee or summer dinners. The living room /primary bedroom wing, family room additions, and kitchen renovation all were executed by master craftsmen and curated by a world- renowned antiques expert to honor the home's period. The family room is infused with light morning to evening, and is surrounded by garden and barn views. The property offers 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths and four fireplaces in the main house. The completely rebuilt two-story barn features a living room, bedroom, office and full bath as well as two garage spaces. Ceiling height, room proportions, flow between rooms, and authentic details make this an exceptional antique A perfect country lifestyle in an idyllic walking community convenient to everything.

This stunning home, crafted by acclaimed architect Christopher Hull, boasts elegantly proportioned rooms and a seamless flow, perfect for both entertaining and family living. Upscale features include 9' coffered ceilings, custom millwork, and four fireplaces throughout. The dramatic 2-story foyer includes a custom designed wine cellar and interior balcony. The chefs eat-in kitchen is a true highlight with a spacious marble island, stainless steel appliances, and large butler's pantry. Formal living and dining rooms, both with a fireplace and coffered ceiling, are complemented by a bright family room with fireplace and breakfast room that opens onto a covered deck, overlooking the beautifully landscaped fenced yard, pool, and spa. En suite bedrooms with vaulted ceilings, while the spectacular primary suite includes a fireplace, large dressing room, beautiful spa-like bath with vaulted ceiling and private balcony overlooking the pool and gardens. The lower level is a walk-out finished recreation room that opens directly to the pool area, complete with a full bath, large gym and mudroom with cubbies. The attached and detached garages can accommodate up to four cars, with a workshop and ample storage space. Ideally located within walking distance to the train, schools, and parks.

Welcome to Gramercy Park! Exquisite, boutique enclave of eight luxury residences nestled in the heart of sought-after New Canaan, CT. Private and pristine, Unit 201 offers turn-key single-floor living, complete with elevator access (no stairs) & in-unit washer/dryer. This 2 bedroom, 2 full bath residence features 1,395 sq. ft. of carefully crafted living space centered around a chef's kitchen with top-of-the-line SubZero/Wolf appliances, custom cabinetry & marble countertops, with seamless flow into an elegant main living/dining area. Light & bright primary bedroom with en-suite spa-like full bath w/marble finishes & generously-sized walk-in closet; 2nd bedroom, conveniently located steps from hallway full bath. Stunning, oversized covered balcony overlooking the serene & tastefully landscaped community garden for year-round outdoor enjoyment. Two dedicated parking spaces (one covered - #8), ample guest parking and complimentary use of the community clubhouse with outdoor kitchen, seating area and fitness center w/TV & Internet access. Offering secure entry and 24-hour package room for added peace of mind, Gramercy Park is a modern sanctuary brimming with charm, steps from exceptional dining, bespoke retail shops, parks, and vibrant local events -- all one hour from Manhattan. Several floor plans available; inquire with listing agent for details.

Welcome to this turnkey light-filled home moments from town and train. Featuring gorgeous wide-plank floors, vaulted ceilings, and exceptional finishes throughout. Gracious entry foyer with built-ins effortlessly flows into the spacious living room, complete with vaulted ceilings and a wood-burning fireplace, offering views of the flat, fenced-in yard. The chef's kitchen is a dream, featuring soaring ceilings, stainless steel appliances, and sleek granite countertops. The primary bedroom is a true retreat, offering an updated en-suite bathroom with double sinks, a large walk-in shower, and a soaking tub. Enjoy outdoor living on the beautiful patio, overlooking the private backyard. Located on a desirable cul-de-sac street only minutes to all the best that New Canaan has to offer.

Discover this charming 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom condo, perfectly situated just moments from town. Flooded with natural light, this inviting space features an open layout that maximizes comfort and functionality. The well-appointed kitchen flows seamlessly into the living and dining areas, creating an ideal setting for both relaxation and entertaining. With its convenient location, you're just steps away from shopping, dining, parks, tennis and the train, making it a great choice for commuters and city lovers alike. Whether you're looking for a smart investment property or a cozy place to be your home, this condo offers great value in a desirable area.

Charming Two-Bedroom Townhouse-Style Condo in the Heart of New Canaan  Discover the perfect blend of convenience and comfort in this well-appointed two-bedroom townhouse-style condo, ideally situated in the heart of New Canaan. Just minutes from the train, shops, restaurants, and all that downtown has to offer, this home is also directly across from picturesque Mead Park and its playground.  The main level features a spacious living room and a beautifully updated kitchen, complete with granite countertops, white cabinetry, and stainless-steel appliances. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms with ample closet space and a full bath.  Enjoy the best of in-town living with easy access to parks, entertainment, and commuter options. Don't miss this fantastic opportunity to own in one of New Canaan's most sought-after locations! Reserved Parking spot #12. Unit comes with storage unit 12 in lower storage area.  Electric Bill is not included in the common charges.

A unique find in the heart of New Canaan-opportunities like this don't last!

Historic New Canaan Landmark...  Experience the allure of New Canaan's rich past with this extraordinary estate, originally The Waring Farm established in 1863. Enclosed by timeless New England stone walls and adorned with climbing hydrangea, the 3-acre property exudes charm from the moment you arrive. This distinguished residence masterfully blends historic elegance with modern luxury across three impeccably finished floors. Soaring 9.5-foot ceilings in several rooms create an airy, sophisticated atmosphere throughout. The living room, with its inviting fireplace and dual sets of French doors, radiates warmth and refinement. Adjacent to it, a beautiful solarium/garden room opens up with brick inlaid floors and all-glass windows overlooking the backyard and pool area, creating a serene connection to the outdoors. A chic dining room, butler's pantry, eat-in kitchen and cozy den are seamlessly connected and open onto three gracious porches, perfect for effortless indoor-outdoor living and entertaining. The grand primary suite offers a serene retreat with a private sitting room, complemented by five additional generously sized bedrooms, five full bathrooms, and one half bath-providing both comfort and versatility. The third floor presents a flexible space ideal for a home office, playroom, or studio, while the expansive lower level offers abundant storage options and a wine cellar to suit the most discerning collector.

Situated in this oasis is a classic 4-bedroom center hall colonial. Offering exceptional living spaces and great flow the home includes a formal living room with fireplace, dining room and paneled den with fireplace. The eat-in kitchen leads to an enclosed sunroom with wraparound windows which provide views of this breathtaking property. Upstairs, the primary suite has its own dressing room and generous bath. Three more roomy bedrooms complete the second floor, offering comfort and flexibility for every lifestyle. Every season brings new beauty to this stunning two-and-a-half-acre property. The parking courtyard leads to a glass enclosed entry with formal living and dining rooms at either end. The white custom kitchen with quartz countertops and new high- end appliances, has a light filled dining area overlooking the property. Walk out to a stunning bluestone patio with a hot tub and pool featuring a waterfall and clear glass fencing surrounded by green lawn-perfect for entertaining or unwinding. Adjacent to the kitchen are a family room with fireplace and large screen tv, and an office with wood paneled modern cabinets. Four fireplaces add warmth and elegance throughout. Retreat to the primary suite with a fireplace, white marble bathroom and an extra-large walk in dressing room. In the lower level enjoy a state-of-the-art 9-seat home movie theater, gym with a dance floor, and a 3-car garage with custom high-lift garage doors and two storage lifts. Cutting-edge technology includes a new touch-screen security system, touch info screens, wall-mounted LCD TVs, and in-ceiling speakers. Additional upgrades include a new driveway with a lighted basketball hoop, a 20KW automatic generator, new 5 zone HVAC systems, a natural gas boiler, and town gas and water. No need to wait for new construction. Time to live your best New Canaan life.

There's a convenient common basement with oversized, storage cage & coin laundry. Assigned parking space is 155-B. Oenoke Condo's has 2 pools, is conveniently close to center of town, train & everything New Canaan. Don't miss this one!

listings.remarks: Walk to town and train from this beautiful 4 bedroom, 4 bath home with dramatic vaulted ceilings, loads of sunlight and 3900+ sf of space galore! With hardwood floors throughout, newly renovated kitchen and baths and 2 outdoor spaces to relax, you have found home. The 2 story entry foyer leads you to the living room with vaulted ceilings, a wood burning fireplace and wall of windows w French doors to a beautiful deck. Adjacent is the large formal dining room to enjoy holiday gatherings with all. Entertain to your heart's delight in the newly renovated gourmet kitchen boasting 2-inch quartz countertops, a sub zero refrigerator, double ovens, under counter lighting and a large eat in area for cozy gatherings. The primary suite on the first floor makes one floor living easy with walk in closets and recently renovated his and hers baths. A large den or 4th bedroom is located on the first floor. Upstairs you will find 2 large sunny bedrooms with renovated en suite baths and loads of additional closets and storage. The enormous lower level is partially finished with a large rec room and French doors to the large terrace behind to gather for a meal or around a firepit. Much more space can be finished in the lower level. Walk to restaurants, train, shopping and the farmers market. This special unit in Canaan Mews wont last! One of 11 Units in private complex.

listings.remarks: Nestled at the end of a quiet, tree-lined cul de sac, with tranquil views of beautiful Raymonds Pond, this chic and sophisticated 4-bedroom home is a rare find and a commuter's dream. Thoughtfully designed, primed for entertaining and move-in ready. Step inside to soaring ceilings and an effortless open floor plan, where natural light pours through walls of windows. The formal living room and private library offer quiet elegance, while the true centerpiece is the stunning open-plan kitchen, dining and family rooms. Outfitted with top-of-the-line appliances and sleek contemporary finishes, the kitchen and dining area flows seamlessly into an inviting family room, anchored by a large fieldstone fireplace-perfect for cozy evenings or stylish entertaining. Large French doors open to beautifully terraced patios, offering a private oasis with a breathtaking backdrop of water views. Upstairs, the serene primary suite is a true retreat, featuring 9-foot ceilings, a fireplace, a private sitting area, and a secluded balcony--the ideal spot for morning coffee with a view. Three additional bedrooms and a well-placed second-floor laundry add practicality to the elegance. The finished walk-out lower level with a 2023, 6-person hot tub offers everything you need for work, play, or fitness, plus generous storage throughout. Privately set and surrounded by nature, yet just a short distance to Metro North and Waveny Park. This is luxury living that feels both elevated and effortless.

Not to be missed! 86 Old Norwalk Road, New Canaan, a charming gambrel colonial set on an oversized corner lot of cul de sac street.  Enjoy both natural beauty and convenient access to schools, parks, and downtown New Canaan.  Located on a sidewalk-lined street, enjoy a scenic stroll to New Canaan's top-rated schools or take the nearby hiking trails to Kiwanis Park, featuring a playground. The peaceful property boasts beautiful English-style gardens with stonework, including a hummingbird & pollinator garden for viewing from the screened porch. The original carriage house with loft provides additional space for your wildest dreams.  Enjoy outdoor living & entertaining with a newly finished over 1000 Sq Ft deck off the kitchen. Inside, the home offers three spacious bedrooms, two and a half bathrooms, and a finished basement with a family room and office. This bright home has oversized windows in living and dining room with nature views from every room. With a freshly painted interior and exterior, generator hook-up with an included gas generator, and thoughtful updates throughout, this home is ready for you to move in with fewer worries and more time to enjoy everything New Canaan has to offer.

Discover this stunning Colonial home, set on a premier cul-de-sac next to a Land Trust preserve, just minutes from Town and perfect for walking or jogging. Spanning over 5,000 sqft across three beautifully finished levels, this home impresses with a bright, open concept floor plan, cathedral ceilings, and Palladian windows that frame picturesque pond views. Both the front and back yards are adorned w/perennial gardens, professional landscape lighting and wooded areas, enhancing the home's privacy. The spacious family room is bathed in natural light, boasting a gas log fireplace, custom-built bookcase/entertainment center, and double sets of French doors leading to a generous deck - ideal for indoor-outdoor living. The chef's kitchen offers ample counter space and a convenient layout for both cooking and entertaining, and direct access to the formal dining room, perfect for hosting gatherings, w/plenty of room for a large dining set. A sophisticated formal living room w/a gas log fireplace leads to a private office w/ tranquil water views, creating an inspiring work-from-home retreat. Upstairs, the primary suite features vaulted ceilings and spa-like bath, while 3 additional en-suite bedrooms provide comfort and privacy for family or guests. The 3rd-floor walk-up attic offers abundant storage and the potential for future expansion. The bright lower level has a rec-room w/custom built-ins, full bath, and a slider that opens to a patio. Nestled behind a circular driveway at the end of a picturesque cul de sac near town is an updated colonial gem, the perfect blend of classic elegance and warmth. Built for entertainment, with a foyer that opens directly into a two-story living room, anchored by an inviting fireplace that leads into a beautiful formal dining room. The open-concept eat-in kitchen and den flank the main level on one side and a light-filled, over-sized office with wood paneling and built-ins on the other. On the midlevel is a cathedral ceilinged primary bedroom featuring a double-sided fireplace that creates a cozy bedroom suite and spa-like bathroom, complete with double walk in closets. The primary bedroom includes a loft-perfect secondary home office. All four bedrooms in the home are well-sized and en suite. A walkout finished basement creates a layout that has room for all. Lastly, the beautiful landscaping makes this home the perfect 2.57-acre retreat without compromising proximity to town, the Merritt, and other amenities.

First-floor end Unit with Breathtaking Mead Park & Pond Views! Wake up to stunning water views and enjoy an unparalleled lifestyle in this highly sought-after first-floor end unit directly across from Mead Park! With three exterior walls, this home is bathed in natural light and offers gorgeous western sunset views over the park's pond. This exceptional unit is move-in ready and features a designer-renovated kitchen and bath, complete with granite countertops, ample cabinetry, and stainless-steel appliances. Beautiful hardwood floors, oversized closets, and two brand-new A/C units ensure comfort and style. Plus, with an attached heated garage and additional lower-level storage, convenience is at your fingertips. Location is everything! A short stroll takes you to downtown New Canaan, the train station, top-rated restaurants, shopping, and the brand-new library. Right across the street, Mead Park offers tennis, pickleball, walking trails, ice skating, and a fun playground - not to mention the Apple Cart Food Co. (Yum). With low taxes and common charges that include heat and hot water, this home is not just a place to live - it's a lifestyle upgrade in one of the most desirable locations in town. Don't miss out on this rare gem - it won't last long! Schedule a showing today!
