listings.remarks: Exceptional Opportunity in coveted New Canaan location. Don't miss this rare chance to own a beautifully updated home at the end of a quiet, protected cul-de-sac with just eight residences. Ideally situated within walking distance to schools, YMCA, Waveny Park, and downtown New Canaan, this property with over 3500 sq ft of living space, offers convenience and serenity in equal measure.  Enjoy effortless one-level living with an open-concept layout featuring a stunning Great Room, kitchen, and breakfast area - complete with cathedral ceilings and two fireplaces. The sun-filled living room boasts a fireplace, custom built-ins, and expansive views of the lush garden and flat, picturesque 1+ acre lot.  The home offers 4 bedrooms, the 4th bedroom is currently used as a home office. The spacious primary suite includes French doors leading to the backyard and a beautifully remodeled bathroom. A finished lower level provides versatile space for a recreation or playroom.  Additional highlights include an attached two-car garage, oversized septic system, Ct Basement system, new A/C, water heater, washer/dryer and the potential for a pool site. House is wired for portable generator included in sale. This is a truly special offering that rarely becomes available - an exceptional lifestyle opportunity in one of New Canaan's most desirable neighborhoods.

UNDERSTATED GRANDEUR. UNFORGETTABLE LIVING. At the end of a quiet New Canaan cul-de-sac stands a rare blend of timeless elegance and modern livability. Architect-designed and set amidst landscape architect-crafted gardens, this stone and shingle estate is grand yet understated with every inch reflecting thoughtful design & refined materials. The gracious foyer leads to a sunlit living room, elegant dining room, and inviting family room-all with walls of windows that frame the breathtaking property. A stunning chef's kitchen awaits with luxury appliances, custom cabinetry, and rich stone countertops. Inside, six ensuite bedrooms and seven full and two half baths offer exceptional comfort and privacy. The main level is rich in architectural detail and warmth, with six fireplaces and seamless flow for everyday living or elegant entertaining. The lower level truly elevates the experience. Designed for memorable gatherings, this expansive space includes a custom wine cellar, full home theater with fireplace, billiards room, sauna, and a bespoke bar that rivals any private club. Stone patios, lush lawns, and an outdoor fireplace set the scene. The pool and its beautifully appointed pool house-with a full kitchen-offer resort-style relaxation. A separate guest house complete with its own garage is perfect for extended stays.  Sited high to capture long, leafy views, this estate invites you to slow down, soak it in, and savor every moment. Just minutes to town, yet a world away.

listings.remarks: Crafted from mahogany, steel and stucco with exterior design by renowned Bassam and Fellowes, this striking contemporary is sited high on Ponus Ridge. The light filled interior features custom designed walls of glass that open to lovely courtyards. Throughout you'll appreciate the attention to detail and high end finishes. All 5 bedrooms, including 2 master suites, are on the main level. The gallery like layout of this home is an art collectors dream. A state of the art kitchen has European porcelain floors and Brazilian quartzite countertops. It opens to a stone patio perfect for entertaining: a built in bbq, gas firepit and a "summer kitchen" in the garage. Downstairs there is room to exercise, hang out or savor wine from the cellar. The flat, professionally landscaped 2 acre retreat has amazing sunsets in the front and salt water pool, spa and tennis court in the back. You'll never want to leave.

Experience the epitome of modern living at the Lounsbury Carriage House found in New Canaan's most sought-after condominium development at Jelliff Mill Falls. This exceptional loft-style residence boasts remarkable architectural details, gorgeous high ceilings and luxurious finishes throughout. With an open floor plan, two fireplaces (one gas, the other wood burning), a lovely private terrace and an exceptionally convenient location, 41 Jelliff Mill Falls represents a chic, carefree lifestyle where superior quality construction meets elegant living. The charming complex is beautifully nestled along the banks of the Noroton River offering breathtaking water views, exquisite landscape design and expansive green spaces.

Discover refined living in this meticulously maintained 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhouse nestled within the sought-after Heritage Common community. One of 12 units, spanning approximately 2,863 sq. ft., this residence is a harmonious blend of comfort and sophistication. The home offers an open-concept design, with a sunlit living room featuring a cozy fireplace, perfect for relaxation or entertaining. The gourmet chef's kitchen is fully equipped with modern stainless steel appliances, including an induction range, custom cabinetry, and a large quartz island.  Upstairs, retreat to the expansive primary suite complete with a luxurious en-suite bath with radiant floors. Two additional bedrooms provide space for family, guests, or a home office. A finished lower level and a private outdoor patio extend your living and entertaining options. Located just minutes from premier shopping, dining, and top-rated schools, this exceptional home offers both convenience and community. A must-see!

A special offering on one of New Canaan's most sought-after streets, 1129 Oenoke Ridge is the definition of sophisticated, turn-key living. This sun-drenched 2012 Colonial boasts over 7,000 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space across three finished levels. High ceilings, stunning millwork, and extensive built-ins abound. The first floor features a grand two-story foyer; comfortable Living and Dining Rooms with fireplaces; a stunning office with coffered ceiling, fireplace and built-in bookcase; and a gourmet kitchen with large eat-in area that flows seamlessly into the light-filled Family Room. With 5/6 en-suite bedrooms - including a serene Primary Suite with fireplace, soaking tub, steam shower, and two walk-in closets - this home offers exceptional space for every need. The finished third floor offers another bedroom, full bath, and expansive bonus space. Outside, entertain under the pergola or gather around the stone fireplace in the manicured yard, with room for a pool. Just minutes to New Canaan's beautiful town center, this move-in-ready stunner is not to be missed.

OFFER DEADLINE MONDAY 12PM NO ESCALATION CLAUSES AND MUST BE EMAILED TO ATTY KEN GAMMILL: KMG@gtlslaw.com Meticulously maintained and located on one of New Canaan's most coveted streets, 50 Chichester offers a timeless combination of classic construction, exceptional millwork, and modern must-haves. A gracious two-story entrance greets guests, family and friends, leading seamlessly to both an elegant living room with fireplace and large formal dining room. A gourmet kitchen with double everything - islands, sinks and dishwashers- opens to a generous and sunny eat-in area and family room with french doors to a sunny terrace, featuring a coffered ceiling, gorgeous built-ins and a gas fireplace.  A private library with another fireplace and ample built-ins and a front to back mudroom featuring built-in cubbies and a separate entrance complete the first level. On the second level, the primary suite is a sanctuary for rest and regeneration with a fireplace, incredible walk-in closet, spa-like bathroom and private sitting room, while four additional bedrooms on the same floor provide room for all. An additional third level with a full bathroom provides flexible use space for overflow and the 1800 sq ft lower level offers abundant recreational space with a full bath, a gym, media area, and direct walkout access to the back yard and potential pool site.

listings.remarks: Updated and sunny Colonial w/two park-like acres on a quiet cul-de-sac is waiting for its new happy residents. Formal living room w/bay window has a fireplace. Dining room's perfect for starting your new traditions. The renovated kitchen's a chef's dream w/quality appliances. Family room w/fireplace is right off the kitchen and it opens onto one of the two newer high-end Concordia Symmetry decks. A huge cathedral ceiling solarium is next to the dining room. There is a study with dry bar for WFH days. Additional space above the garage for pool table or make it a gym or playroom.  Upstairs, you'll find a lovely primary w/renovated bath and walk-in closet. Three other nice sized bedrooms share the large sparkling hall bath.  Property is beautiful with its picket fence and curved arbor gate, which beckons to activities for family and friends. A 14KW generator provides peace of mind to whatever Mother Nature sends our way. This is a very special and move-in ready offering.

Discover this charming corner unit at "Prides Crossing," a collection of 51 elegant brick townhouses just steps from the vibrant village center, offering easy access to restaurants, shops, and the train station. Nestled on a gentle knoll, this home is exceptionally private, featuring a fenced south-facing back patio and garden that bathes the space in natural light. The cozy interior has a bright, spacious kitchen with south and west exposures, perfect for enjoying sunny mornings. A separate garage is conveniently located just off the private terrace. The finished lower level provides ample space for versatile use. Residents also enjoy access to Prides Crossing's exclusive clubhouse and pool.

listings.remarks: Don't Miss this Classic Colonial on 2 Acres Near Town - Quiet Cul-de-Sac Location! Set on a serene 2-acre lot on a sought-after cul-de-sac, this lovingly maintained 4-bedroom, 3-bath Classic Colonial offers timeless charm, abundant space, and unbeatable convenience just minutes from town. Inside, you'll find hardwood floors throughout, complemented by elegant granite flooring in the entrance/foyer, kitchen, and dining room-adding a touch of luxury to these central gathering spaces. The gracious formal living room, elegant dining room, and warm, inviting family room are perfect for entertaining or relaxing. The well-appointed kitchen opens to a screened porch that overlooks a flat, level backyard enclosed by long stone walls-providing exceptional privacy and a beautiful setting for outdoor living. There's also plenty of room to add a pool, making this backyard a true oasis with endless possibilities. A dedicated office and a cozy library provide flexible work-from-home options. The spacious bonus room over the 3-car garage is ready to be finished to suit your needs - adding 769 square feet of finished space, increasing the total to 4,898. The full basement offers even more potential for expansion or storage. Other highlights include a whole-house generator, impressive curb appeal, and classic colonial detailing throughout. This is a rare opportunity to own a move-in-ready home with space to grow, custom built by the original and sole owner - in a highly desirable location.

HIGHEST AND BEST DUE BY SATURDAY DEC 6TH 5PM. Welcome to this inviting four-bedroom high ranch home, perfectly situated on a quiet cul-de-sac just minutes from town. Thoughtfully maintained and updated, this residence offers modern comforts, flexible living spaces, and an unbeatable location. The main level includes a spacious family room with wood burning fireplace and a first-floor bedroom with a full bath, providing excellent versatility for guests, in-laws, or a home office. Walk upstairs to the beautifully renovated eat-in kitchen featuring crisp finishes and direct access to a screened-in porch and open deck, ideal for morning coffee or warm-weather entertaining. The upstairs also boasts a primary bedroom, two additional bedrooms, a formal dining room, and an expansive living room filled with natural light-perfect for gatherings and everyday living. This home has been freshly painted and boasts numerous recent upgrades, including new Hardie siding, new windows, a new generator, and a new furnace. A 2-car garage and professionally landscaped grounds complete with irrigation system add to its appeal. The beautiful, level backyard offers exceptional outdoor enjoyment. Ideally located, this home is just a short walk to Kiwanis Park, minutes to town, and provides an easy commute to the Merritt Parkway or the train station. Located on a picture-perfect cul-de-sac in an ideal neighborhood, this adorable New Canaan home is waiting for you!

Elevated luxury. Prime location. Unmatched privacy. Scenic views.  Discover the pinnacle of privacy and sophisticated living in this magnificent Brick Georgian Colonial. Poised at the end of a private Lane with gated entry high atop 3.8 professionally landscaped acres, this estate is a rare nature sanctuary just minutes from the heart of town. Exceptional Craftsmanship: Built to endure, this steel-reinforced residence features a classic brick exterior and a 100-year slate roof. Inside, the 7,300 SF floor plan is grand and light-filled, offering a flexible layout perfect for a multi-generational lifestyle. Soaring 10-foot ceilings define the spacious interiors, which include 6 generous en-suite bedrooms and 3 dedicated home offices and a library designed for the modern professional. Outdoor Oasis: The park-like grounds are anchored by a 50' x 20' heated pool with an electric cover and a professional-grade greenhouse-perfect for year-round horticultural pursuits. Utility & Security: Every convenience is considered, featuring a 5-car heated garage and a full-house automatic generator for seamless, year-round comfort and peace of mind. Unrivaled Location: Experience the serenity of a private retreat with the convenient sought after neighborhood location.

Luxury New Construction in the Heart of New Canaan!    Experience the finest in modern living with this exceptional new home by Kaeser Custom Homes, renowned for quality craftsmanship and timeless design. Ideally situated near Mead Memorial Park and Bristow Bird Sanctuary, this elegant residence offers the perfect blend of nature, convenience, and luxury-with sidewalk access to town for ultimate enjoyment.   Spanning over 6,600 square feet across four beautifully finished levels, this 5 ensuite bedroom, 6 full and 2 half-bath masterpiece is thoughtfully designed for both everyday living and stylish entertaining.   Highlights include:  Gourmet chef's kitchen with top-tier appliances opens to a spacious family room with a fireplace.  Luxurious primary suite with fireplace, spa-like bath and walk-in closet. Private home office, formal dining, and flexible living spaces. Finished lower level ideal for a gym, media room, or golf simulator.   Set on a picturesque lot with professionally landscaped grounds, this home is a rare opportunity to own a newly built property in one of New Canaan's in-town neighborhoods. Pool Site Permit has been approved!

Perfectly Located Luxury, Unmatched Convenience!  Experience the best of New Canaan living in this luxurious, recently renovated (2023) townhouse, ideally situated IN TOWN!. Enjoy unparalleled convenience with easy strolls to the Metro-North station, local cafes, coffee shops, acclaimed restaurants, shops, and the movie theater-everything is within reach. This end unit townhouse offers ultimate convenience with four dedicated parking spots, including an attached garage and three reserved spaces at your doorstep. Step inside to a stunning 2023 renovation featuring wide-plank white oak floors throughout and a showpiece kitchen with quartz countertops, prestigious Thermador appliances, and a cleverly integrated laundry/pantry. The sun-filled living area, complete with gas fireplace  opens to a private, fenced patio. Upstairs, find two spacious en-suite bedrooms, including a primary suite with a newly renovated bathroom. The finished and expansive lower level offers flexible space for a family room, office, and gym. All core systems are top of the line(Bosch A/C, Weil McLain boiler, Bradford White hot water heater) and brand new from 2023, ensuring total comfort and peace of mind. This isn't just a townhouse; it's a seamless, integrated lifestyle in the heart of town. Welcome home.

Bordered by a classic Connecticut stone wall and lined with flowering crabapple trees, this distinguished Colonial offers a picturesque and timeless setting. The property is sited on 2 spectacular -park like acres with a fenced in yard and in-ground pool.  Inside, the first floor boasts an open, airy layout that flows effortlessly between the custom kitchen, the family room with fireplace, playroom, and a handsome library with built-in cabinetry. The elegant butler's pantry connects to a grand dining room with a fireplace, while the formal living room, adorned with French doors, opens to serene backyard views-completing the main level.Upstairs, six generously sized bedrooms and five full bathrooms provide ample space for family and guests, ensuring comfort and privacy throughout. A major renovation in 2009 transformed the home, seamlessly blending traditional charm with modern functionality. The former back porch was converted into a stunning chef's kitchen, while the original kitchen was reimagined into a custom butler's pantry and a welcoming entrance area. Enhancements also include a walk-in pantry, a back staircase, an additional bedroom, two full bathrooms, many new windows,and extensive updates throughout the home. In 2018, a spacious playroom was added off the kitchen and family room, featuring new flooring, walls, windows, a closet, and doors. This inviting space offers direct access to the back yard and pool- perfect for entertaining.

Please submit Best and Final offers by 5pm Monday May 12th, thank you.  Fully Renovated Gem in the Heart of New Canaan  Welcome to 171 Richmond Hill Road, a beautifully reimagined residence blending classic charm with modern elegance. Fully renovated in 2020 with over $550,000 in thoughtful updates, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers 2,340 square feet of meticulously finished living space.  Step inside to discover a sun-filled interior featuring a seamless floor plan, hardwood floors, and refined finishes throughout. The spacious primary suite includes a luxurious ensuite bath and a generous walk-in closet, creating a serene and private retreat. Two additional bedrooms share a well-appointed full bath, and a stylish powder room serves guests with ease.  The main floor offers a warm and inviting living area complete with a wood-burning fireplace-perfect for cozy gatherings. Additional highlights include a partial basement ideal for storage or future expansion, central air conditioning for year-round comfort, and two oversized back-to-back garages offering rare flexibility for parking, a workshop, or extra storage.  Ideally located near town, parks, and top-rated schools, 171 Richmond Hill Rd combines high-end renovation with unbeatable convenience in one of New Canaan's most desirable neighborhoods.

EXTRAORDINARY luxury townhouse featuring more than 3,000 sq. ft. of space situated within walking distance to New Canaan's favorite restaurants, shopping district and train station. This home's interior finishes are the epitome of luxury and modern design. Gorgeous wide plank, white oak floors, tons of natural light, beautiful moldings and architectural details throughout are all connected by a four-stop elevator. The First floor showcases an open floor plan with a clear delineation between Living Room, Dining Room and Kitchen and Sitting Area. The living room features modern design and sophistication with custom built-ins and a fireplace with marble surround. From the living room enter the dining room, which connects effortlessly into the kitchen and sitting area. The designer chef's kitchen is equipped with custom milled cabinetry, a waterfall leathered granite island and top of the line appliances. The kitchen is open to an integrated sitting area. Built-in wall-length cabinetry and modern floating shelves were added by the homeowner for additional storage. All of this provides for casual as well as formal entertaining possibilities. The Second floor offers a media/office room with ample built-ins, modern coffered ceiling and spacious windows providing natural light. Down the hall from the adjacent laundry area is the Primary suite complete with two spacious walk-in closets and custom built-ins. The ensuite spa inspired bathroom is finished with artesian cut

Experience extraordinary living in this sophisticated, estate-style majestic brick townhouse with slate roof - a truly unique custom-built home showcasing timeless elegance & impeccable architectural detail across 4 expansive levels. A gracious gated entrance opens to a charming cobblestone courtyard, setting the stage for an unmatched living experience. Inside, you'll find beautifully appointed formal living and dining rooms, both featuring elegant fireplaces & rich millwork. The heart of the home is the open-concept chef's kitchen, with a spacious breakfast area & inviting family room with coffered ceiling & fireplace. Walk out to the professionally landscaped brick patio, where you'll enjoy a built-in BBQ, outdoor fireplace, & covered seating areas-perfect for year-round entertaining. The luxurious primary suite is a private retreat, offering a cozy sitting area, fireplace, dual dressing rooms, & 2 spa-inspired ensuite bathrooms. 4 additional bedrooms-each with their own ensuite bath & walk-in closet-ensure ultimate comfort & privacy for family & guests. The home also features 3 dedicated home offices, ideal for today's flexible lifestyle, & an elevator. The impressive lower level is designed for entertaining & relaxation, featuring a fireplace, coffered ceiling, bar, wine cellar, billiards, & well-appointed exercise room. Professionally landscaped with mature trees & perennial gardens, offers exceptional privacy & natural beauty. An architectural masterpiece.

listings.remarks: Located in the highly sought-after "Behind the Y" neighborhood, this expanded and beautifully renovated 5-bedroom Colonial is truly move-in ready. Sited on 1.25 acres of flat, open land, the home offers three finished levels of thoughtfully designed living space. The renovated chef's kitchen features a breakfast bar, eat-in dining area, and opens seamlessly to the family room with custom built-ins-perfect for modern living and entertaining. The impressive addition boasts 9 ft ceilings, a vaulted great room with a striking fieldstone fireplace, a private study, and a stylish wet bar. French doors lead to a covered porch overlooking the professionally landscaped pool and terrace. The spacious primary suite includes two walk-in closets and a spa-like bath. Enjoy the perfect blend of indoor and outdoor living-all with sidewalks to town, Waveny Park, the YMCA, and top-rated schools.

Located on a much sought-after cul-de-sac surrounded by estate properties, 77 Winfield Lane presents a compelling opportunity to re-envision a 4,100 square foot, 5-bedroom, 5-bath residence set on 2.88 acres of private grounds. The home's traditional architecture and balanced proportions create a strong framework for renovation, expansion, or enhancement. The property features a pool and generous outdoor space, offering privacy and flexibility for future improvements. Walkable to West School and nursery school, and offering easy access to New Canaan village, this is a rare opportunity to secure land, location, and long-term upside. Property is being sold in its present condition.

This property wins BEST-IN-CLASS with brand new renovation, perfectly situated in a prime west-side neighborhood location near New Canaan village. This turnkey home blends modern elegance & timeless charm, offering five bedrooms, four and a half bathrooms, and 3 floors of sophisticated living space on two private, park-like acres.  Main floor key features: Gourmet Kitchen: New, classic-modern kitchen featuring double islands, top-tier stainless SubZero & Wolfe appliances, a walk-in pantry, an adjacent sun-filled family room with fireplace, formal dining room, living room with fireplace & access to the wrap-around slate patio. Primary Suite: A spacious addition includes a private balcony, tray backlit ceiling, sitting area, enormous walk-in closet, and a spa-like bathroom with a soaking tub. Generous Living Spaces: home office, laundry room, mudroom area and a finished basement with a fireplace, half bath and wine fridge offer expansive space for both relaxation and recreation. Exceptional Outdoor Amenities: Enjoy quiet privacy with surrounding Ct stone walls, a large slate patio, a lovely front yard pond with aerator fountain, and a level private backyard. Practical Luxury: Includes a heated/cooled three-car garage with double-height ceilings to accommodate car lifts. Prime Location: Only 6 minutes from New Canaan village amenities and the Metro North train station.  This move-in-ready property offers an unparalleled lifestyle opportunity. Don't miss this opportunity.

66 Seminary The Watts Comstock House (c. 1872) is a 3 BR 3 1/2 bath home in the heart of downtown New Canaan. Fully restored and lovingly reimagined for today's living this 2,300 sq ft home with large 2 story barn/studio offers all new infrastructure while maintaining the original charm and the rare moldings and trim work. Located in the heart of town and an ideal distance to the train station, shops, and restaurants on one of New Canaan's oldest streets, the house includes a gorgeous new gourmet kitchen with pantry, all new bathrooms, new 8" plank flooring-a nod to the original hardwoods. 9' arched ceilings and sashed oversized windows allow natural light to flood this elegant home. In addition to the kitchen, living and dining rooms the main floor also includes an artfully tiled room with marble and soapstone, perfect for a breakfast nook or home office. Downstairs a mudroom leads to the cozy den with full bath and large laundry room. The top floor is complete with three airy sunlit BRs. Beautifully designed land and hardscapes offer myriad opportunity for 4 season living. Barn is easily converted to a garage and/or connected to heat and plumbing. Don't miss this unique opportunity to be a part of New Canaan history!

Experience the timeless charm of this stunning 1930s stone and shingle vintage home, beautifully updated to blend classic elegance with modern amenities. Nestled on a private lane and just a short walk from Award-Winning schools, Waveny Park, and the vibrant Town center with its array of shopping and dining options, this home offers both convenience and tranquility. Set on nearly four acres of meticulously landscaped grounds, this property boasts ivy-covered stone facade, mature trees, and ample natural light throughout. The expansive fenced-in back yard is nearly entirely flat, a true rarity for a ridge home in New Canaan with ample space to add a pool. From the moment you arrive, you'll be captivated by the home's serene setting, fully fenced front & back yards, & its inviting curb appeal. Opportunity Awaits! Bring your vision to this COLONIAL in desirable New Canaan. Potential for customization is limitless.  Gorgeous 2 park-like acres with pond access and aerator welcomes you. Property features a peaceful yard, mature shade trees that line the driveway and lend privacy. Picturesque walking/biking community where neighbors gather. Wrap around porch invites you to sit, read, chat leisurely. Large foyer leads you to ample living spaces including; kitchen with island, dining room, living room and family room w/ wood burning brick fireplace. Three season porch. Baths are finished with neutral colored tiles. Four garage bays total; 2 car attached garage and additional detached 2 car garage with bonus finished space above- perfect for home office, studio, gym, multi-generational living. Close to award winning New Canaan Schools, main commuting roads, Metro-North train, the Silvermine Art Guild and only a few minutes to shopping too! This home has a great floor plan to enjoy entertaining and everyday living. Portable generator to keep you running if ever needed. Untapped potential. Perfect to renovate into your dream home.

The coveted address you've been waiting for. Nantucket-Shingle coastal-chic style home with exceptional amenities in Hoyt Farm. The step down library is stunning and dramatic; wrapped in color, featuring French doors out to the terrace and private spa. The primary bedroom suite is well appointed with a walk in closet and a large, updated bath.  All of these lovely spaces have direct access to sweeping vistas of this bucolic estate featuring a beautifully illuminated landscape in the evenings. Convenient to downtown New Canaan, Darien and Norwalk, Shadowlyn is accessible and exceptional. Schedule your private tour today.

Inside, a cathedral-ceiling living room with a dramatic Palladian window sets the stage for both lively entertaining and peaceful lounging. The large, eat-in kitchen is the true heart of the home-flowing into a cozy family room with a fireplace and built-ins, then out through French doors to a large, private deck. Perfect for summer BBQs or quiet evenings, the backyard is a private haven with a wildflower meadow, vegetable garden, and open lawn ideal for play or gardening. The expansive primary suite is a peaceful retreat with a luxurious en suite bath and its own private deck-perfect for morning coffee with garden views. Three additional bedrooms offer comfort and flexibility, while the finished lower level provides a great space tailored to your lifestyle. Whether you're entertaining guests or enjoying a quiet weekend at home, this light-filled, lovingly updated Cape offers the perfect setting for modern living with a touch of nature.

Inside, you'll find 5 bedrooms (plus a 6th on the 3rd floor level), 4 full and 2 half baths, a wrap-around porch, and a 3-car garage. The main level features a welcoming foyer, a bright living room with gas fireplace, a formal dining room, a chef's kitchen with large island, an oversized family room with sliders to the back deck, and a private office. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite includes a dressing room and spa-like bath with double vanities, whirlpool tub, and walk-in shower. Outdoors, the property has been thoughtfully transformed with new stone walls and professionally landscaped grounds. Enjoy the private fenced-in pool, new garden installations, new bluestone patio and walkway, new exterior lighting, stunning pergola with purple wisteria and 13-zone irrigation system.

Set on over five private acres along New Canaan's coveted Oenoke Ridge, this extraordinary estate is a reimagined 1890s cow barn masterfully transformed by the Hobbs family with architects Joeb Moore and Louise Brooks. Blending agrarian charm with refined modern design, the residence honors its heritage while offering sophisticated comfort.  A tree-lined drive and landscape lighting set a gracious tone on arrival. Inside, the dramatic two-story great room features a soaring stone fireplace, post-and-beam framing, and antique pine floors. A storybook catwalk leads to a second-floor library, while the sunlit gourmet kitchen flows into a breakfast room and formal entertaining spaces. The six-bedroom layout includes a first-floor primary suite with a sitting room ideal for a nursery or office. The walk-out lower level offers a wine cellar, playroom, bedroom, and full bath.  A detached three-car garage includes a guest apartment with its own entrance, living room, bedroom, and bath-perfect for in-laws or extended stays. Outdoor living is elevated with a heated gunite pool overlooking the reservoir, a fireplace, meditation pool, and secret garden path. Designed by Kathryn Herman Design, the award-winning landscape features terraced gardens, meadows, specimen trees, and a producing apple orchard.  Just minutes from town, this is a rare opportunity to own a timeless piece of New Canaan's history.

Tucked at the end of a long, sweeping driveway in one of New Canaan's most coveted enclaves, this stately residence is a masterclass in timeless design and exceptional craftsmanship. Created for both elevated entertaining and everyday comfort, the home unfolds with sophisticated ease-from the grand front entry to the beautifully curated interiors. Every space is thoughtfully scaled and exquisitely finished, with abundant natural light and views of the spectacular grounds from nearly every room. At its heart is a stunning, expansive chef's kitchen with a large center island, high-end appliances, and custom cabinetry that flows into the inviting family room-a perfect blend of elegance and ease. Formal rooms are gracious yet welcoming, offering effortless transitions to the outdoors. The rear grounds are extraordinary: manicured gardens, a pool surrounded by lush vines reminiscent of a Napa retreat, and a terrace spanning the length of the home-ideal for alfresco dining, entertaining, or quiet evenings under the stars. Upstairs, all bedrooms are ensuite, including a remarkable primary suite with spa bath and oversized walk-in closet. A guest wing offers its own skylit sitting room, while the finished lower level features a golf simulator, wine room, fitness room, elevator, and abundant storage. A full-service elevator connects the lower, main, and second levels of the home, offering ease and accessibility throughout. A rare opportunity to own an iconic home.

The dining room also features a sophisticated wet bar with a marble countertop, Sub-Zero bar fridge with ice maker, and glass shelving for barware. The luxurious main-level primary suite offers a spa-like retreat with a marble vanity, oversized walk-in shower, and an expansive walk-in closet. Both the dining room and primary suite open onto a beautifully landscaped patio with mature trees and perennial flower beds-an ideal spot for private, al fresco dining. The heated pool off

Located in the sought-after Hoyt Farm neighborhood, this exceptional 5-bedroom residence sits at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, offering privacy and serenity in a prime setting. A rare first-floor primary suite serves as a private retreat, complete with a dedicated office, walk-in closet and spa-like bath. The heart of the home is a large custom kitchen, perfectly designed for both daily living and entertaining, and complemented by an adjacent breakfast room featuring a striking shiplap-paneled vaulted ceiling. The formal living room exudes elegance with a gas fireplace and detailed coffered ceiling, while the expansive family room offers built-in cabinetry and sliders that open to a spacious outdoor deck-ideal for seamless indoor-outdoor living. Enjoy quiet mornings or summer evenings in the charming screened porch, surrounded by nature. The enormous finished lower level provides endless versatility with multiple living spaces, perfect for a media room or play area, half bath and a dedicated exercise room This meticulously maintained home offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and style in one of the area's most desirable neighborhoods.

Over 13,400 square feet of luxury on four finished floors with elegant rooms and flow, including a double story library, lavish primary suite, and fantastic lower level with bar, wine cellar and gym.

Welcome to 31 Selleck Place -- a captivating vintage Colonial in a fabulous location (halfway between the schools and town) at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac! The house has a fresh young vibe and is brimming with character and charm. The setting is picture perfect, too, framed by beautiful shrubs and trees and featuring a gorgeous umbrella pine tree, colorful perennial gardens and a spacious stone terrace that is the most wonderful place to relax and entertain!   The home has been lovingly cared for and is freshly painted both inside and out. On the first floor are light-filled formal rooms, a quaint country kitchen, an inviting screened porch and a guest room, or alternate master. Upstairs are three more bedrooms, including the master suite, plus an office. The partially finished lower level is plumbed for a bath and ready to become an ensuite bedroom room, family room or whatever kind of room you'd like it to be -- and it walks out onto a stone patio and the best backyard in the neighborhood!

listings.remarks: Generational Compound with all the luxuries & amenities one desires. Cascading waterfall pool, pool house, tennis court with viewing gazebo, barn, guest house, fenced garden and meandering sculpture rock garden. Set off New Canaan's highest ridge and down a private lane this resort-style estate is prime living-just one hour from NYC. This is for the discerning buyer who can spot value & potential. With 5+ bedrooms, multiple living areas, the home is designed to suit a variety of lifestyles. Additional features include a five-car garage, spa and gym suite with a jacuzzi, indoor garden room, and a very spacious in-law or caretaker suite. The beautifully landscaped 5-acres includes lush destination gardens, a fenced vegetable garden, and a dedicated pet area. A gated entry leads down a long, tree-lined drive, setting the stage for timeless charm. Outdoor living is just as impressive, with a resort-style pool framed by cascading waterfalls, a romantic pergola with outdoor kitchen, dining terrace, and a charming pool house-perfect for entertaining.This is a rare opportunity to own a peaceful retreat with mystique that has space, beauty, and versatility - all in an exceptional New Canaan location.

listings.remarks: Convenience & sophisticated style is what you get with this ultra-chic 3 bedroom, 3 full, 2 half Bathroom masterpiece located within walking distance to New Canaan's favorite restaurants, shops and train station. Built with the best finishes in mind, this 3,800 sq ft home features a flexible open floor plan, Elevator, private office, large-pane oversized windows, formal rooms that flow seamlessly from one to another, and the ultimate dream kitchen featuring a gorgeous island with 2" countertops, chefs appliances and custom walk-in pantry. Enjoy the gorgeous family room with gas fireplace and 15 ft sliders that open up to your private terrace overlooking the beautifully manicured back yard creating the perfect indoor/outdoor living experience. Exquisite mill work, white oak floors, custom staircases, and built-ins truly show meticulous attention to detail. Absolutely spectacular primary bedroom with dual closets and spa inspired bathroom that will take your breath away featuring a 10ft x 4ft walk in shower, soaking tub, 8ft floating vanity, and heated floors. (All bedrooms have en-sutie bathrooms). Gorgeous mudroom with elevator that travels from bedroom level to the finished walkout basement. Additional features include Spray foam and sound proofing insulation, irrigation system, Hydro HVAC system, and more. Too many features to list.

Don't Miss This Hoyt Farm Charmer! Nestled at the end of a sought-after cul-de-sac, this pretty Colonial home sparkles with sophistication and charm. Phenomenal curb appeal, freshly painted interiors and a great floor plan lend themselves to easy, upscale living. Surrounded by mature trees, yet only minutes to town, this home offers both privacy and convenience in one of New Canaan's favorite neighborhoods. There are bright, generously-sized rooms throughout the house, with the family room and primary bedroom having soaring vaulted ceilings with skylights. Sunlit, chic and cheery, the house is beautiful inside and out with manicured landscaping and grassy play spaces. Relax on the inviting screened porch located right off the kitchen or serve dinner al fresco on the deck. In addition to everything this stunner offers, the Hoyt Farm Neighborhood Association is a wonderful way to meet new friends and enjoy block parties throughout the year!

Modern Light-Filled Retreat in the Heart of Silvermine  Welcome to this spacious modern home, perfectly nestled in the heart of New Canaan's sought-after Silvermine neighborhood on two bucolic acres. Just moments from the iconic Silvermine Arts Center, Silvermine Market, GrayBarns, and The Mercantile, this vibrant and historic community is where neighbors gather and friendships grow.  Brimming with natural light and thoughtfully designed for comfortable living, this airy residence offers versatile spaces and timeless appeal. Enjoy everyday living and entertaining in the open-concept layout, with a bright sunroom just off the kitchen that overlooks a peaceful, private setting-ideal for morning coffee or quiet reflection.  A dramatic first floor great room with soaring ceilings, a cozy fireplace, and a full bath offers endless possibilities whether as a home office, media lounge, or guest suite. Upstairs, the serene primary suite features a fireplace, walk-in closet, spacious dressing area, and a luxurious bath with dual vanities-your private sanctuary. Another out standing feature is the attached and detached garages that accommodate four cars. This is modern living in one of New Canaan's most charming enclaves offering character, community, and convenience.

Ideally located in the heart of the village of New Canaan and just moments from scenic Mead Park-with tennis courts, pickleball, a playground, and a picturesque pond-this impeccably maintained townhouse is part of the charming and sought-after Laurel Green complex. The bright and spacious living room opens to a private stone terrace and garden, offering a peaceful retreat for outdoor relaxation and entertaining.  Enjoy the convenience of an attached garage on the main level, a versatile den or office, and a comfortable open floor plan that features hardwood floors throughout. This home offers the ideal blend of location, lifestyle, and low-maintenance living-just steps from town, train, shops, and restaurants.

Set on 2.28 beautifully landscaped acres in a premier neighborhood, this stunning Colonial showcases custom millwork, soaring windows, and sun-filled spaces throughout. Offering 6 spacious bedrooms and 5.2 baths, the home balances both formal elegance and relaxed living. The heart of the home is the gourmet kitchen-with top-of-the-line appliances, a large island, custom cabinetry, and butler's pantry which flows seamlessly into the family room with fireplace and opening to a terrace overlooking the spectacular fenced backyard. Entertain in style with a handsome library including fireplace and custom features, elegant living and dining rooms, and an outdoor oasis with heated pool, spa, and sweeping lawns.  The luxurious primary suite features three walk-in closets, a coffered ceiling, custom built-ins, and elegant bath. Four additional generous bedrooms: two of which are ensuite with walk-in closets, an office option, and a convenient laundry complete the second floor. An expansive finished third floor offers space for pool table, games and multiple seating areas, while the lower level provides a rec/play room with fireplace, full bath, bedroom, exercise room, and private patio walkout-ideal for an in-law or au pair suite. A three-car garage, large mudroom and multiple aesthetic and mechanical upgrades throughout complete this versatile, breathtaking home.

Discover Cozy Elegance at The Village at New Canaan! Welcome to a charming one-bedroom, one-bath condo nestled in one of Fairfield County's most desirable communities. This 743-square-foot home features an inviting open floor plan uniting the living, dining, and kitchen areas. You'll find granite countertops and premium GE and Fisher & Paykel appliances in the kitchen, complemented by hardwood floors throughout.  Admire the elegance of Hubbardton Forge lighting fixtures and enjoy your own private patio for a bit of outdoor relaxation. As a bonus, this home includes a spacious 290-square-foot storage unit on-site, perfect for all your extra belongings.  Just minutes from local shops, dining, and the train station, this condo blends convenience with a touch of luxury. Come see why it's the perfect place to call home.

This lovely, newer construction home offers the perfect blend of modern amenities and classic style, nestled in a prime in-town location just steps from the village. Situated on a peaceful cul-de-sac, this residence boasts 9' ceilings and beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The formal living room with gas fireplace and expansive formal dining room add a touch of elegance, while the open-concept chef's kitchen with a breakfast room is perfect for culinary enthusiasts. French doors lead out to a serene backyard terrace, seamlessly connecting the indoors to the outdoors. The adjoining family room is a cozy retreat, complete with built-ins and a gas fireplace. With 4 generously sized bedrooms, including a glamorous primary suite, the home provides ample space for relaxation. The finished lower level offers a large recreation space, a full bath and a dedicated movie theater-ideal for movie nights or hosting guests. An expansive, unfinished 3rd floor provides endless possibilities for future expansion. Perfectly situated, this home combines comfort, convenience, and sophistication, making it an ideal choice for those seeking an in-town oasis.

Welcome to this fully renovated 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo located in the Woodside Green community, just minutes from downtown Stamford. The unit features hardwood flooring, a modern kitchen with quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances, and a newly updated bathroom. Woodside Green offers ample on-site parking, expansive green space with a gazebo, a designated dog area, and a grilling area for residents. The complex is conveniently situated within walking distance to shopping centers, Scalzi Park, and provides easy access to major highways.

listings.remarks: Welcome to the South-of-the-YMCA neighborhood! Beautifully rebuilt in 2014, this custom Colonial sits on just over an acre of flat, park-like property in one of New Canaan's most coveted locations. Set near the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, it delivers luxury, privacy, and unbeatable convenience to top-rated schools, the YMCA, Waveny Park trails, paddle courts, the dog park, and every activity the park has to offer. Step inside and prepare to be wowed. The luxurious primary suite offers a spa-worthy bathroom and an enviable walk-in closet. Each additional bedroom includes its own en-suite bath and walk-in closet, and the legal 5th bedroom with bath and kitchenette on the lower level is perfect for guests, in-laws, or an au pair. High ceilings, 7-inch-wide oak floors, Porcelanosa tile, Grohe fixtures, and premium stonework make it feel exceptional. The chef's kitchen is a showstopper with its high-end appliances, a Wolf range with 6 burners, griddle, and double ovens, and custom Birchcraft cabinetry by Euphoria Kitchens. You'll enjoy more cabinet space than you ever thought possible. The fenced backyard feels like a private resort, complete with a heated in-ground pool, stone walls, mature landscaping, and an irrigation system. A 1,000-gallon underground propane tank powers heat, hot water, cooking, the full-house generator, and the pool heater - ensuring comfort year-round. The oversized 3-car garage offers 841 sq. ft. of clean, versatile space for cars, hobbies, or storage

The light-filled main level features hardwood floors, LR w/wood burning fireplace, and an updated kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. A private deck with retractable awning extends the main living space outdoors. The main level office can easily be a 4th BR or guest room. Upstairs, the generously sized primary suite includes an en-suite bath, walk in closet and additional storage. Two additional bedrooms and a full bath complete the upstairs. The finished walkout lower level is perfect for a family room, gym, or guest suite with a deck overlooking the Five Mile River. Other features include central air, central vac, and a detached garage with additional parking onsite. Canaan Close offers beautifully landscaped grounds, a heated pool and a sought after lushly landscaped welcoming community. Prime location within walking distance to downtown, the Metro-North train (with Express service to Grand Central in about an hour) and top-rated New Canaan schools. A rare opportunity for low-maintenance, turnkey living in a peaceful and convenient setting!

First Floor unit has 2 bedrooms, large eat in kitchen and access to covered front porch, finished basement with laundry area and storage. Second Floor unit features, open deck, 1 bedroom plus a study/den (could be used as 2nd bedroom), tall ceilings, laundry room area and eat in kitchen and oozes charm. Rent both units out or live in one and rent out 2nd unit. Also possibility of converting back to Single family residence as the staircase is still intact. Property is being sold AS IS.

listings.remarks: Through stone columns along a scenic approach is this first time on market custom-built five bedroom brick house on four private acres. Spacious rooms with 10ft ceilings and detailed mill work on the main floor include a cathedral height family room with dramatic fireplace, a front-to-back living room, a wood paneled office, and a four-season sun room to enjoy the stunning property. The large bonus room with bath and hardwood floors has just been approved as a fifth bedroom and is large enough to be divided into a bedroom and second office, playroom, or sitting room. The custom wood-paneled kitchen overlooking a natural setting has top quality appliances. The property includes a fenced pool, flat lawns on two levels, and a man made pond for skating and fishing. The lower level has a marvelous game room with wet bar, a full bath, a gym, and a large cedar closet. The landscaping is lovely without being high maintenance. A private patio outside the kitchen and family room is convenient to the pool and is the perfect place to grill. The pool has recently been refinished, the driveway refinished, and the pond dredged. Electric on the property is buried.The 3-car garage has high ceilings, good storage and a separate entry pad for each door. Move in and live comfortably or customize this stately home. An amazing opportunity.

Experience the perfect blend of historic charm and modern living in this beautifully renovated 1840 home, ideally located in one of the most desirable in-town neighborhoods. Fully restored in 2013, this classic New England property features timeless architectural details alongside thoughtful updates throughout. Step inside to find sun-filled rooms, warm hardwood floors, and high-end finishes that create a welcoming and sophisticated atmosphere. The updated kitchen boasts premium appliances, custom cabinetry, and a seamless flow into the living and dining areas-ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. With three  finished levels, this home offers four spacious bedrooms, including a versatile lower-level suite perfect for guests, a home office, or au pair quarters. Bonus spaces on the lower and third floors provide flexibility for a gym, media room, or playroom.   Enjoy outdoor living in the professionally landscaped yard with a private stone patio and a stunning outdoor fireplace-perfect for morning coffee or evening gatherings. A charming two-story red barn adds additional storage or workshop potential. Explore the vibrant downtown, featuring upscale shops and diverse dining  options, or take a walk to nearby Waveny Park with its scenic trails and expansive green spaces. Situated in a top-rated school district and close to two train stations, this turnkey property seamlessly blends historic charm with modern convenience.

Significant price improvement! It's all about the garden! Imagine having your very own park and a house that comes with it! Beautifully laid out 4 bedroom, 3 1/2-bath Colonial with high ceilings sits on a 2+ acre corner lot with stunning mature plantings. Situated minutes from the Merritt Parkway, 213 Marvin Ridge Rd invites you to experience the perfect balance of convenience & serenity! Step outside, & you're moments away from New Canaan's vibrant cultural scene, including Grace Farms, the iconic Summer Theater, & weekly Farmers Market. As you approach the house via the private asphalt driveway, you're greeted by a professionally landscaped yard that reflects years of care & attention: something close to a botanical garden, a little bit of paradise. Stunning mature trees & vibrant plantings create a peaceful, private oasis-perfect for relaxing, entertaining, & enjoying the changing seasons. Upon entry to the house you'll see a powder room, a welcoming living room with fireplace, a dining room with bay window, an eat-in kitchen with den, a laundry room, a cozy study, another dining space which leads out to a beautiful screened in porch, a great room with an incredible vaulted ceiling & fireplace & built-ins. To the left of the entry is a main level primary suite with ample closet space. The 2nd floor offers three bedrooms (1 ensuite), & hallway bath. The walk out lower level is huge & offers versatile space - a library, a gym, plus a home office. Welcome Home!

Situated on over two acres on one of New Canaan's most coveted cul-de-sacs, this five-bedroom Colonial offers gracious living in a serene west side setting. The home's thoughtful layout provides both formal and casual spaces for daily life & entertaining. The main level features a generous living room with fireplace, formal dining room, and private study. The heart of the home is an expansive step down 27-foot family room with soaring ceilings, skylights, fireplace, built-ins, and French doors leading out to the flagstone patio, flowering gardens, and in-ground pool and spa.  Upstairs, the primary suite includes a spa-like bath w whirlpool tub, while four additional well-proportioned bedrooms and two additional baths offer flexible space for family and guests. Professionally landscaped grounds designed for outdoor enjoyment, level lawn areas, and mature trees provide natural privacy. An attached 2-car garage offers exceptional storage and convenience, and an additional freestanding 2 car garage with stairs to an enormous floored upper level opens endless possibilities. Located minutes from New Canaan's village center, this tranquil setting combines privacy with the ease of town amenities.

TURNKEY townhouse that feels like home in the heart of New Canaan with 3 full floors of fantastic versatile space. Purchased as a summer home, this easy floorpan flows nicely and includes chef's kitchen with breakfast area, open living/dining room, wet bar and wood burning fireplace. Study or bedroom on the main floor also includes fireplace and large windows. The second floor includes primary suite with newer all white bathroom and 2 large closets, and two more bedrooms, full bath and laundry area. The lower level has a bonus area of almost 1000 square feet of living space with high ceilings, full bath and fantastic wine cellar. So close to 17 acres of manicured nature trails in the Bristow Bird Sanctuary directly behind the home which leads to Mead Park and to the center of New Canaan shops, train, restaurants and schools. New Canaan living at its best!

Opportunity knocks! Minutes from town, 46 Norholt Drive - on a flat, park-like one acre - awaits its new steward either to start from scratch or reimagine what's there. Surrounded by mature, flowering trees and bushes and sited on a quiet cul de sac, this opportunity rarely comes along. Seller makes no representation about what can be developed on the property, due diligence is the responsibility of the buyer. House needs complete renovation. Central AC on first floor only. House being sold as-is.

The main level boasts a spacious dining room perfect for entertaining, a newly updated kitchen with modern appliances, and an inviting living room with built-in bookshelves and sliders that open to a large deck overlooking a lush lawn and garden.  Upstairs, you'll find three generously sized bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The fully finished lower level offers a bright playroom with garden views, a fourth bedroom, full bath, laundry room, and ample storage.  Low-maintenance living at its best - just moments from everything and an easy commute to NYC!

GREAT VALUE!

A dramatic foyer opens into a stunning great room featuring 10' foot coffered ceilings, carved marble fireplace, and French doors leading out to a limestone terrace, beautiful pool, expansive lawn, and lush garden. The chef's kitchen boasts exquisite granite countertops, high-end appliances, and a spacious eat-in area perfect for casual dining.  A mahogany paneled library, complete with fireplace, custom built-ins, and French door access to the backyard, provides a refined retreat. The luxurious primary suite features a large walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bath. Three additional ensuite bedrooms offer comfort and privacy for family or guests. This meticulously maintained, like-new residence combines timeless elegance with modern amenities, offering breathtaking views and ultimate privacy.

listings.remarks: 19 Father Peter's Lane is a classic Connecticut Colonial set on one of New Canaan's highly desired cul-de-sacs. Lovely Estate setting with stone walls and landscaped gardens offers unparalleled living space. The Great Room with field stone fireplace and vaulted ceiling opens to the lovely terrace and flat backyard. Updated chef's kitchen with oversized island, butlers pantry, breakfast area with coffee bar opens to the fabulous bluestone patios with outdoor kitchen, sitting walls and views of the refinished heated pool and landscaped 4 acre property. The first floor Primary Suite with sitting room is spacious and bright and features a dressing area and large primary bath. The second story features four spacious bedrooms; one of which is an alternative primary bedroom with walk-in closet, sitting room/office, and another primary bath. Back stairs near the mudroom, great laundry room, pantry, and the sixth bedroom could be a convenient au pair/nanny room near full bath and separate entrance rounds out the first floor. Extensively updated since 2020 with New HVAC, Generator, Water treatment, Roof, and more.

This Old (New) Smart House! No detail has been overlooked in this beautiful antique home, completely restored with grace and charm at every turn. From the eat-in kitchen with walnut island, soapstone countertops, and authentic English hardware, to the cozy and comfortable layout of the indoor and outdoor spaces, you'll feel right at home here. The family room flows into living and sunroom, with formal dining room, library and powder room on the main floor. Four+ bedrooms plus two offices and 3 baths on the upper levels, all recently refurbished. The wraparound porch and painted latticework is reminiscent of the lovely Charleston/New Orleans charisma that carries through the interiors, with a carefully curated fresh take on historic paint colors, moldings, flooring and decor. The outdoor kitchen with built-in Weber grill and wood-burning fieldstone fireplace, surrounded by Connecticut bluestone patio make for an all-season getaway right outside the back door. The freeform pool and surrounding patio and landscaping make a sunny oasis to soak up the good life!

Step into this beautifully crafted 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath townhome by renowned Kaali-Nagy Partners, perfectly situated on a private, professionally landscaped property in the heart of New Canaan. From the moment you arrive, the gracious front porch, classic wood shingle roof, and exquisite stonework set the tone for a home that's both luxurious and welcoming. Inside, refined details abound, from rich moldings and raised wainscoting to soaring 9'+ ceilings and gleaming hardwood floors. The light-filled, open-concept living and dining areas flow effortlessly into a state-of-the-art chef's kitchen, perfect for both quiet mornings and lively entertaining. Plantation shutters and custom built-ins add charm and character throughout. A private study offers the ideal space to work or unwind, while the serene primary suite provides a true retreat with a spa-like bath and walk-in closet. Two additional en suite bedrooms offer comfort and privacy for guests or family. Downstairs, the spacious walkout lower level features a versatile game room, a full bath, and a flexible space ideal for a fourth bedroom, gym, or media room. Outdoors, a bluestone terrace opens to a beautifully fenced-in backyard with private mature plantings, offering an outdoor oasis. Every inch of this home has been thoughtfully designed to offer warmth, elegance, and effortless in-town living.

Discover the epitome of charm in this delightful expanded Cape Cod-style home, perfectly situated on the most coveted private lane in all of New Canaan. Walk to the Village, Nature Center and The Roger Sherman Inn in minutes from this captivating jewel at 2 Hampton Lane. Boasting expansive living spaces both inside and out, this lovely home has four generous bedrooms, one suite on the first floor, and three and a half beautifully appointed baths. Enjoy touring the extensive flowering gardens or relax on your private gravel terrace offering a serene escape in your own backyard. This residence is designed to accommodate all of your lifestyle needs effortlessly in the most convenient location. Make this enchanting home your own...

Can be shown before BOH, Tuesday, 7/29.  Impeccable townhouse with 2025 elevator servicing 3 levels. This luxurious and spacious end unit overlooks Mead Park and the pond. Beautiful millwork and high ceilings. Both living room and primary bedroom have a fireplace. In the lower level family room there is a bath. Stairs from the guest parking area lead to a Park Slope owned gazebo, and Mead Park. Close to the charming village of New Canaan and its variety of fine restaurants.

California meets New Canaan in this William Wurster inspired transitional-style masterpiece set on 2.54 private acres on New Canaan's desirable west side that's so convenient to town. This extensively renovated home has over 100 custom windows and 16 doors bringing the outside in from every room. Amazing sun-drenched living space with wonderful views from EVERYWHERE. French doors lead to expansive bluestone terraces, a beautiful gas fire pit for entertaining, meticulously manicured flower gardens, pool, spa and river. Five bedrooms, 4-car garages, au pair suite and an exceptionally designed layout make this home a sensational haven with the warmth of a colonial but so fresh!

This beautifully renovated colonial, rebuilt in 2019, offers a perfect blend of classic charm and modern luxury in a highly sought-after neighborhood. Live the dream. Seamless Open Concept: The heart of this home is the expansive kitchen, breakfast nook, & family room combination, bathed in natural light and anchored by a cozy fireplace. Perfect for both casual living & grand entertaining, this space boasts a center island, ideal for gatherings. A dedicated service pantry adds convenience and elegance to your entertaining endeavors. Classic & Sophisticated: A traditional living room, also featuring a fireplace, offers a welcoming space for relaxation, while the formal dining room sets the stage for memorable meals. Work & Rest in Style: A main-floor office with a vaulted ceiling provides a private and inspiring workspace. Unwind in the tranquil and luxurious owner's suite, complete with a vaulted ceiling, a spacious ensuite bathroom with a soaking tub, and a generous walk-in closet. Family Fun: The lower level offers a versatile playroom, providing extra space for recreation and relaxation. Outdoor Paradise: Enjoy the privacy and beauty of a large deck overlooking the level back yard perfect for outdoor activities. A storage shed and swing set add convenience and fun for the whole family.This colonial blends modern amenities with classic charm, offering the perfect blend of luxury and comfort in a highly sought-after location. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity.

*Highest and Best Deadline 9/23 at 5pm* Welcome to 99 Wardwell Drive, a beautifully updated split-level home offering 4 bedrooms, 3 full baths, and over 2,300 sq ft of versatile living space. The main level is designed for today's lifestyle with an open flow between the bright all-white kitchen, dining area, and living room with fireplace. The kitchen features a large island, quartz countertops, and stainless steel appliances, while sliders lead to a stone patio overlooking a full acre with level yard, stone patio, and playset. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a full bath, a dressing room with dual closets and vanity, plus an additional closet. Two more spacious and bright bedrooms and a fully updated bath complete this level. The lower level is perfect for entertaining with a family room and wet bar, a bedroom and full bath, a mudroom, and walk-out access to the backyard and garage. The bedroom can be used as an office or playroom. There is an additional 500 square feet of unfinished basement space with laundry that adds storage and flexibility--or future finished space. Set at the end of a cul-de-sac in a quiet, close-knit community, the home is nestled just minutes from town and in desirable Silvermine, with award-winning schools, shops, dining, and Metro-North nearby. Updated systems, fresh modern finishes, abundant natural light, and outdoor space for play and entertaining make this home truly move-in ready.

Experience condo living at its best at Hathaway Commons!! This beautifully transformed three-bedroom, three-bath residence offers the perfect blend of modern style and ultimate comfort. Enjoy the convenience of an attached one-car garage that leads into a spacious mudroom equipped with a full-sized washer and dryer. The sophisticated eat-in kitchen alongside welcoming dining and living areas, are all enhanced by a cozy fireplace and walk out to a private bluestone terrace, offering seamless access to green space. The main level features a large bedroom with an adjacent full bath, providing flexibility and ease; two more generously sized bedrooms with ensuite baths round out the second floor. The finished basement adds an extra dimension, serving as an ideal space for recreation and home gym/office.   Located on South Avenue, Hathaway Commons offers all the benefits of in-town living via a secluded oasis with a pool-just a short walk from premium shopping, dining, New Canaan's world class library, the Metro-North train station, and celebrated public schools rated #1 in Connecticut. Experience a vibrant community and a residence that perfectly embodies modern, updated living.

listings.remarks: On picturesque Greenley Road in the heart of New Canaan, this beautifully crafted residence blends charm, comfort, and sophistication on two private acres with a sparkling heated pool. Perfectly scaled, the home offers generous spaces for entertaining while maintaining a welcoming, manageable feel. Step inside to discover elegant living areas filled with natural light, high ceilings, and thoughtful details. The vaulted breakfast area with exposed beams and arched window opens to serene views through two sets of sliding French doors. A gracious living room features a fireplace, transom window, and French doors leading to a terrace that overlooks the pool, perfect for indoor-outdoor gatherings. The formal dining room is anchored by a lovely built-in corner detail and chair rail, while the study offers a bay window and fireplace, ideal for work-from-home or quiet reading. At the heart of the home, the custom Deane kitchen is appointed with top-tier appliances: Viking cooktop, dual Dacor ovens, Sub-Zero refrigerator, Miele dishwasher, and Marvel wine refrigerator. Overlooking the breakfast area, the kitchen flows seamlessly into the family room with built-ins and French doors. Built-in speakers in the kitchen, family room, breakfast area, and dining room enhance every occasion. Upstairs, there is a luxurious primary suite and additional bedrooms and baths providing flexibility, including one with striking windows that works beautifully as a home office or guest suite.

Four finished levels offer a generous living space with high - end kitchen, first floor bedroom with full bathroom and an office with attached deck. Large blue stone patio with build in grill is ready for outdoor entertaining. Glass staircase railing leads to the second floor where large master suite with walk in closet awaits you. Three additional bedrooms and two full bathrooms provide a comfort and space for family and guests. The walk up finished attic offers additional space for gym, playroom or office. The walk out 1179sf lower lever is ideal for a gym, playroom or a media room.

Classic 5-bedroom Colonial in the coveted Behind the Y neighborhood-just a short walk to schools, the YMCA, and Waveny Park. With over 3,500 sq. ft. of living space, this home features a front-to-back living room with fireplace, a sun-filled dining room, and a kitchen that opens to a step-down family room with fireplace and French doors leading to the terrace and private backyard. A study with fireplace provides a quiet retreat, while the flexible layout includes an au pair or in-law suite with sitting room and separate entrance. This home also offers a lower-level playroom and attached potting shed. With great bones and a fantastic location, it offers an excellent opportunity for updates and personal touches to make it your own. With sidewalks to town, you cannot beat this location. Welcome to 44 Putnam Rd!

There are homes that shelter, and then there are homes that embrace. Welcome to 515 Carter Street, a Louise Brooks masterpiece and one of New Canaan's most beloved homes. This long admired custom-built 2004 residence blends timeless craftsmanship with thoughtful modern design. A circular floor plan connects light-filled spaces designed for entertaining, with 10-foot ceilings, glass pocket doors, and exquisite millwork throughout. The conservatory-style living room features floor-to-ceiling windows and seamless garden views, while the fireside dining room offers arched built-ins and intimate charm. At the center of the home, a chef's kitchen features dual marble islands, glass-front cabinetry, vintage-style refrigerator and freezer, and a charming wall-mounted drinking fountain - an unexpected detail that delights guests. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a wood-burning fireplace, limestone spa bath, and large dressing room. Additional highlights include a potting room with copper sink; dual home offices; a carriage house-style garage with playroom above; three additional en suite bedrooms, plus a vaulted en suite guest room and gym on the third floor. Every corner tells a story, every material chosen with care.  515 Carter Street is more than a house - it's a love letter to craftsmanship, family, and the quiet beauty of Connecticut country life.

Enjoy the convenience of a private garage (#92) plus a reserved parking spot, along with access to a laundry and storage room in the basement. The well-managed complex offers two pools, and common charges include heat, hot water, and A/C for added ease.  Perfectly located within walking distance to town, train, shops, and restaurants, this condo is a fantastic opportunity for those seeking both space and convenience in a vibrant community.

Convenient to schools, train, parks and New Canaan town center.
