listings.remarks: Stunning Contemporary-Style home set on 1.33 serene acres at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in the sought-after West School District, just moments from downtown New Canaan. Completely renovated, this residence offers an open-concept layout with soaring ceilings and high-end designer finishes throughout. The seamless flow between the living room, family room, and gourmet kitchen is anchored by a striking double-sided fireplace, all opening to an expansive deck with picturesque views of the Noroton River. The luxurious primary suite includes a recently updated spa-like bathroom, walk-in closet, and a cozy sitting area. The walk-out lower level boasts a spacious family room with fireplace, built-in bar, private office, gym, and three additional guest bedrooms with a full bath-leading to a bluestone patio with tranquil, private views. This truly exceptional property is walking distance to Irwin Park.

587 Carter Street is an extraordinary discovery. Built in 1825, this high-ceilinged 19th-century antique is rich with original character and ready for its next chapter. It's historic fabric remains intact, offering a rare opportunity to revive something truly authentic. With approximately 3,220 square feet, the home includes four bedrooms, three full and one half baths, and four fireplaces. The updated kitchen features a warm, country-inspired feel with a center island and an inviting eat-in area, ideal for everyday living. A grand foyer anchors the home and showcases its early architectural charm. Set on two parklike, level acres in New Canaan's desirable Hoyt Farm, this sun-filled property features an open, pastoral landscape framed by mature trees and classic stone walls. Natural borders and gentle elevation contribute to a serene and distinguished setting. Just minutes from the heart of New Canaan, the convenient location offers peaceful surroundings with everyday accessibility. Whether you envision a thoughtful restoration or a newly imagined home that honors the setting, the opportunity here lies in both its legacy and its land.

Nestled at the end of a picture-perfect cul-de-sac in the heart of New Canaan, this inviting 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom Cape-style home offers the rare combination of in-town convenience and serene privacy. Just a short stroll to local schools, restaurants, library and train, this location can't be beat. The home welcomes you with a spacious and flowing floor plan, highlighted by a large open-concept kitchen and family room with cathedral ceilings, skylights, and a cozy fireplace - perfect for entertaining and everyday living. A sun-drenched, heated sunroom with wraparound windows opens directly to a private patio with retractable awning, offering the ideal indoor-outdoor lifestyle. The main level also features a formal dining room, a gracious living room with built-in bookcases and its own fireplace. The upstairs features a master bedroom with en-suite and two additional bedrooms with a full bathroom. An office/playroom with full bath above the attached three-car garage provides endless possibilities. Enjoy a spacious backyard, offering rare seclusion just moments from town. With classic curb appeal, multiple living spaces, and a premier location, this is in-town New Canaan living at its best.

Welcome to 16 Grace Street - a truly special find! Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac within walking distance to all three in-town schools-South, NCMS, and NCHS-this charming 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial is located in one of New Canaan's most sought-after neighborhoods. Owned by the same family for 80 years, the home is brimming with timeless character and offers incredible potential. Whether you're looking to restore and customize to your personal style or build new on premium, level property, the possibilities are endless. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a property that combines classic charm, a prime location, and exceptional potential.

Welcome to 289 Wahackme Rd, a fusion of modern style and classic charm. This jewel box was meticulously renovated and expanded by the award-winning Gardiner Larson Homes and is tailored for today's modern lifestyle with sophistication and practicality. The original 1955 home was taken down to the studs and rebuilt in 2021-2022. This "Smart House" spans 3,056 square feet on 2 levels with approx. 600 additional square feet of finished space in the lower level. It features 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 and a half sleek bathrooms. Sunlight streams through the oversized Marvin windows, accentuating the open, airy layout and highlighting the seamless flow between rooms. Every detail has been thoughtfully updated including Hardie board siding, a maintenance free deck and pristine hardwood floors throughout. House is on city water, too. At the heart of the home is an exquisitely designed kitchen, equipped with premium finishes that cater to culinary enthusiasts. Set on a professionally landscaped 1.21 acre, this property offers private outdoor space perfect for entertaining or simply unwinding, with a potential pool site enhancing its allure. This residence is ideally situated, offering a harmonious blend of peaceful living and accessibility to local amenities, award winning schools, parks, and transport links. Experience luxury and innovation at its finest in this exceptional New Canaan home.

A sophisticated Victorian home on a sought after in-town street with the amenities for today's lifestyle. This 5 bedroom home features an open floor plan with a first floor primary suite, gourmet kitchen with spacious island, dual-fuel range and wine cooler. A spectacular light filled family room has soaring ceilings and a gas fireplace, it opens to a lovely stone wall terrace. Beautiful gardens surround this fenced in backyard making it an oasis of nature. Charming covered wrap around porch with fabulous curb appeal and walk to everything!

This enchanting stone home is on the market for the first time in 40 years. It is in the heart of downtown New Canaan presenting a rare opportunity to embrace a property rich in character. Nestled on nearly half an acre of meticulously landscaped grounds, this charming colonial offers a private and tranquil atmosphere just a short stroll from the vibrant town center. Over the years, certain areas of the home have been beautifully updated and maintained, while other areas may benefit from renovation. The home being sold "as is" spans 3,557 square feet across three levels, the generous first floor layout features a comfortably sized living and dining room filled with charm, leading to a well-equipped open-concept kitchen and a spacious family room with glass doors that open onto secluded patio areas. A first-floor full bath completes the main level. The second floor hosts the primary suite with a full bathroom, two additional bedrooms, and another full bath. The third floor can be utilized as extra sleeping quarters or office space. This property is enhanced by a detached oversized three-car garage which also includes a large loft above boasting over 700 square feet of unfinished space. It is a blank slate, ready to be transformed into additional living, work or studio space. This home is a unique gem in New Canaan, with immense potential to become a cherished town icon.

Nestled on a country road in the heart of New Canaan, this classic 1989 Colonial offers 5,094 sq. ft. of finished living space with timeless charm and modern updates. Featuring five spacious bedrooms and 4.5 baths, the home is filled with abundant sunlight thanks to its desirable east/west exposure and open layout. The large and inviting Great Room, updated kitchen, and breakfast room flow seamlessly into inviting outdoor living spaces. The dedicated home office and a serene screened-in porch make daily living productive and relaxing. Hardwood floors span the first and second floors, enhancing the warmth of each room. Practicality meets design with two mudrooms (one on the first floor combined with the laundry room, and one on the lower level), plus a two-car garage and custom-built storage areas throughout. The fully finished, walkout lower level adds versatile living space and includes a wine cellar with custom built-ins, a gym, and a playroom, creating a perfect space for all ages. The lower level 5th bedroom and full bath allow for an ideal guest, nanny, or in-law suite. Set on a beautiful, professionally landscaped .72-acre lot with town water and septic, this home combines country charm with convenience. Enjoy being close to The Silvermine Arts Center, GrayBarns on the Silvermine River, multiple parks, green space, the new New Canaan Library, the 300-acre Waveny Park, Grace Farms, highly rated schools, and the charming village of New Canaan.

PRICE IMPROVEMENT, BEST VALUE IN NEW CANAAN! Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac, this fully renovated ranch offers a combination of comfort and style, sure to impress! It also includes its own full bathroom, laundry area, storage, and direct access to the two car garage. Step outside to the expansive, level lot that surrounds the home and get ready to enjoy the large deck and pavers patio all summer long. Additional features include central air, new windows, generator hookup, and freshly painted exterior and interior. Conveniently located near the Merritt and I-95, and just a short drive to downtown, where you'll have easy access to shopping, restaurants, parks, schools and the New Canaan train. The main level boasts soaring 9-foot ceilings and beautifully arched doorways, creating a sense of architectural harmony and understated grandeur. At the heart of the home, the sun-drenched family room is framed by a wall of west-facing windows, offering serene views and seamless access to the heated gunite pool, a generous stone terrace, and a private backyard surrounded by flowering trees and lush landscaping. Designed with both style and versatility in mind, the home features a chef's kitchen, a dramatic living room with fireplace, an intimate dining room, and a quiet office-perfectly suited for entertaining, relaxing, or working from home. Upstairs, discover three generous bedrooms in addition to a sumptuous primary suite, complete with a dressing area and updated bathroom. A bright and spacious great room with built-in storage completes the second floor, offering endless possibilities for recreation or additional living space. This timeless home offers a rare combination of privacy, character, and convenience-all in a premier location.

Walk or take a quick ride to New Canaan's top rated schools: Community Preschool, South, Saxe, New Canaan High School. We invite you to explore this exceptional property, which is now available on the market again-not due to any deficiencies, but as it eagerly awaits its next suitable owner.   Discover a stunning new construction home that combines traditional elegance with contemporary flair. Stonegate embodies superior craftsmanship. Imagine textured plaster limestone walls, meticulously crafted through specialized training in Canada, radiating old-world charm. Three spacious levels are flooded with light, and oversized windows capture morning sunshine and breathtaking sunsets, making every corner warm and welcoming.  Step into your gourmet kitchen- a sophisticated space that will inspire even the most discerning chefs. listings.remarks: Nestled on over an acre in New Canaan, 51 Oenoke Lane, the first home built on this historic street in 1938, blends timeless charm with modern luxury. Meticulously renovated, this 5,044-sq-ft masterpiece offers 6 en-suite bedrooms, 6.5 baths, including a poolside bathroom, across four refined floors. The sunlit kitchen and breakfast room flow into a hearth room with a Dutch door to the lush backyard. The living room with a vintage paneled fireplace and gleaming hardwood floors, spans from the front to the back of the home. An expansive patio with a fireplace overlooks a flat, emerald lawn, perfect for summer gatherings. Mature peony gardens, ancient lilacs, and a formal garden add pastoral allure. The in-ground pool, enhanced by a new 2.5 car garage and cabana, invites relaxation amid vibrant greenery. Versatile spaces for work, play, or reflection are wrapped in historic warmth. Moments from downtown New Canaan's coffee shops and vibrancy, this expansive lot feels like a private estate yet pulses with town life. More than a home, it's a legacy-the original gem of Oenoke Lane, whispering stories of the past and promising cherished memories. Don't miss this rare chance to own a piece of New Canaan's heart.

Discover a rare opportunity to own this light-filled and versatile one-level ranch with a fully finished walk-out lower level-perfect for a young adult suite, nanny or in-law. Thoughtfully designed for flexibility and comfort, this home offers 5 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, including brand-new stainless steel appliances in the eat-in kitchen. Enjoy the warmth of the fireplace in the living room, freshly painted interiors, and plenty of natural light throughout. Outdoor living is just as inviting, with two private patios and a level, usable yard-ideal for entertaining and relaxing.  A standout feature of this property is its two separate and private driveways, 2 kitchens, providing convenience and plenty of privacy for multi-generational living or guests. Located in a highly desirable in-town neighborhood, this home is just a 15-minute walk to the town and train station, and only 20 minutes on foot to New Canaan's award-winning public schools.

Set on one of New Canaan's highest elevations, this iconic country estate offers a rare combination of architectural distinction, modern functionality, and understated luxury. Exquisitely restored by renowned architects Wadia Associates, the 14-room manor balances timeless design with contemporary ease. A grand reception hall introduces a sequence of formal rooms with soaring ceilings, curved glass windows, lacquered finishes, and classic French doors that open seamlessly to the outdoors. At the heart of the home, the Smallbone of Devizes kitchen with walls of Calacatta marble and top-tier appliances flows seamlessly into a light-filled family room overlooking four stunning sculpted acres. The primary wing, is a private retreat of more than 1,100 square feet, featuring a spa-style bath and expansive dressing room. Four additional en-suite bedrooms graciously complete the second floor with an additional spacious & sunny room/office on the third floor. Thoughtfully equipped as a smart home, the property places technology and convenience at your fingertips. Outside, landscaped grounds unfold with an expansive terrace, covered porch, heated pool, and cabana-an environment designed equally for quiet weekends or refined entertaining. Every detail reflects a commitment to craftsmanship and lifestyle, creating a residence that is both stately and livable. This is New Canaan at its most elevated-a rare opportunity to own a property where design, privacy, and comfort converge.

Simply charming ranch on Jonathan Road, a most inviting and quiet country cul-de-sac. Enjoy the ease of one-level living in a setting that feels both like a private retreat yet is convenient to downtown New Canaan. Nestled amongst grand estates and farm houses, and with plenty of room to expand, it is easy to bring your own ideas and create the experience you've always wanted home to be. The expansive front yard has beautiful stone walls and the back yard is highlighted by a sparkling pool and a fun little cabana. Just minutes from town and close to lovely Scotts Corner. Enjoy the local cafes, farmers markets, galleries, nurseries, and shops. A rare chance to enjoy all this potential in one special property. House is being offered "As Is'

Just off Ponus Ridge and moments from Talmadge Hill Train Station, this exceptional Colonial home offers easy access to the Merritt and downtown amenities. Set on 1.67 acres of beautifully landscaped, gated grounds, the property boasts a newly renovated, resort-style gunite pool and spa, an oasis for outdoor living. The professionally manicured backyard is complemented by a stunning bluestone patio, complete with a dramatic fountain centerpiece, ideal for entertaining. This home welcomes you with a grand two-story foyer, leading to an open-concept Kitchen's By Deane chef's kitchen featuring high-end appliances, including dual refrigerator/freezers, a butler's pantry, and a sun-filled breakfast nook. The adjacent family room offers a cozy gas fireplace and French doors that open to a balcony overlooking the serene pool area. The second floor showcases a sophisticated primary suite with custom built-ins, a spacious walk-in closet, and an updated, spa-inspired bath complete with a heated floor and towel rack. Three additional bedrooms and two full baths provide ample family space. A private staircase leads to a bedroom suite, complete with a sitting room and full bath, ideal for an in-law or au pair suite. The lower level has 2334 addt'l finished SqFt with a gym area, a living space with a cozy fireplace, and a wine cellar. In addition, there is a 3-car garage, a full house generator and separate storage shed. This meticulously maintained estate is truly an extraordinary prope

Charming Cape on a Private One-Acre Lot in Southwest New Canaan Nestled down a quiet drive, this beautifully maintained Cape offers the perfect blend of privacy, charm, and convenience. Set on a level one-acre lot surrounded by mature trees, lush plantings, and a lovely garden, this sun-filled home provides a peaceful retreat with easy access to town, train, the Merritt Parkway, and all local amenities.  The inviting family room features exposed beams, a striking picture window that fills the space with natural light, and a cozy fireplace-a perfect gathering place for family and friends. The home's flexible floor plan also includes a spacious eat-in kitchen with new appliances, a full bath, and a main-floor room ideal as a fourth bedroom or home office. Additional highlights include hardwood floors throughout, a convenient mudroom and laundry area, an attached two-car garage, a tranquil patio-perfect for al fresco dining or entertaining and a fire pit area which provides the perfect spot to unwind-relax and take in the serene surroundings. Lovingly cared for and thoughtfully updated, this home offers timeless comfort in one of New Canaan's most convenient and desirable locations.

This five bedroom Classic Colonial, updated throughout and located on a beautiful cul-de-sac in the popular Rosebrook area, is set on a park-like professionally landscaped two+acre parcel. Formal front to back living room w/ fireplace and dining room, sparkling white eat-in kitchen, family room, oversized study w/fireplace, one of two primary suites, a laundry room, as well as a great screened-in porch complete the first floor. Upstairs, there is another primary suite, a bedroom with bath and two other bedrooms by an updated hall bath. Storage galore is in a huge attic space on the second floor. The lower level has a playroom and billiard room. Flagstone terrace runs behind the home with an included fire pit and heat lamp. This offering provides excellent living interior, as well as exterior spaces for family and friends. Stone walls around the back exudes what makes New England so desired. Close to everything, but a world apart.

Presenting an exquisitely crafted, new construction by a prominent local builder. The timeless colonial design is accentuated by brick chimneys, classic shutters, and a welcoming covered front porch. White oak floors, custom paneling, and handpicked finishes enhance the home's interior, welcoming you with soaring ceilings. Sleek spaces include the family room with coffered ceiling and granite-surround fireplace, chic dining room with a bar and floating shelves, and a formal living room. The study, graced with walls of windows, has ample natural light and a private exterior entrance. A true showpiece, the chef's kitchen boasts Wolf and SubZero appliances, thick quartz countertops, custom shaker cabinetry, beverage center, and an eat-in island framed by French doors. Upstairs, the en-suite bedrooms include a primary suite with a fireplace, 2 walk-in closets, and a vaulted ceiling sitting room, ideal for sunset views. The spa-like primary bath showcases marble floors, dual custom vanities with quartz counters, and a soaking tub. A playroom with 12' shiplap ceilings adds to this floor, while the finished 3rd level offers a 5th bedroom and playroom. Other highlights: tiled mudroom with full bath and backstairs, 3-car heated garage, and generator. Lush landscaping, flagstone patio, stone walls, and a pool site create a backyard retreat with no wetlands. Masterfully designed and just minutes from the Village, this home sets a new standard of living.

Sophisticated townhouse offers in town living with fully fenced yard and attached garage. Just a short distance to the center of town, enjoy New Canaan's great restaurants, boutiques, Playhouse, parks and Metro North train to NYC. This well built 3 story home has newly refinished hardwood floors and quality details like a marble gas fireplace and classic moldings, giving it an elegant tone. Sunny and fresh throughout with custom window treatments and modern lighting for added appeal. The eat in kitchen boasts a bay window, pantry cabinets, newer stainless appliances including gas stove with griddle and French door fridge. Spacious dining room has new Anderson sliders opening to a stone terrace. Enjoy the spacious primary suite that includes a generous walk in closet with custom built ins as well as two additional closets. Luxuriate in the marble bath with double sinks, jetted tub and shower. A nice sized second bedroom has full en-suite bath and laundry area with newer front loaders is on second level. Finished lower level family room/playroom/office space has high ceilings plus great storage. Attached, extra deep garage with additional driveway parking and private, fenced yard create the feel of single family living. Propane heat, up to date systems and wired for Google Home System. Ready for immediate occupancy. Come check out this in town gem.

Expanded and fully renovated in 2005, this exceptional Colonial is located in the prestigious Hoyt Farm neighborhood, close to the village. Set on two acres of beautifully landscaped property, the home features five bedrooms and five and a half baths, offering a perfect blend of sophistication and comfort. The main floor welcomes you with a dramatic two-story foyer, an open chef's kitchen flowing seamlessly into the spacious family room, a breakfast room, formal living room with French doors to the backyard, formal dining room, a custom mahogany library, a separate den with fireplace with views of the pool, and a spacious mudroom with a separate entrance. Upstairs, a serene primary bedroom suite with fireplace, private balcony overlooking the pool, a spa-like bath, and a large walk-in closet. Four additional bedrooms, three full baths plus a study room complete this level. A separate back staircase leads to a private office and large bonus room with full bath, ideal for working from home or using as an in-law or au pair suite. The walkup third floor is finished as an exercise room. Outside, enjoy the tranquil stone terrace, stunning gunite heated pool with complete privacy and beautiful mature landscaping and specimen trees - perfect for enjoying the outdoors. House enjoys benefits of solar panels and 50% reduction in electricity costs. 3-car garage and plenty of storage throughout. All this within minutes of the train and part of a vibrant community with top-rated schools.

Wonderful rental within walking distance to town.Spacious and updated 2nd floor unit with living room, kitchen, 1 bedroom, 2 bathrooms plus walk-in closet and laundry room. A must see...truly a charming unit!

The bathroom has been completely renovated featuring new floors, wall tile and vanity. The complex is ideally situated close to everything including Scalzi Park, Starbucks, LA Fitness, Stop and Shop and more. Schedule a tour to see this beautiful unit today!

In the Heart of New Canaan, enjoy the best of "in-town living" with this lovely refreshed 2-bedroom condo, ideally located directly across from Mead Park. Start your mornings with a peaceful walk in the park and take advantage of everything this vibrant neighborhood has to offer: close to New Canaan Train Station, local shops, restaurants, and grocery stores, this home offers unmatched convenience for commuters and those who love being close to everything! Freshly painted, the home feels bright, clean, and move-in ready. Enjoy the ease of first-floor living with both a front and back door, providing easy access to your parking spot. HEAT and WATER are INCLUDED in the rent, adding extra value and comfort. A rare opportunity to enjoy a prime location, modern updates and effortless living, right in the center of charming New Canaan. Photos coming soon...

listings.remarks: Experience elevated living in the heart of downtown New Canaan with this exquisite boutique enclave offering just 7 luxury residences. Built with the best finishes in mind, this home features 2,954 sq ft of finished space, Elevator, large-pane oversized windows, and a thoughtfully designed layout that centers around your gourmet kitchen featuring custom cabinetry, gorgeous island with 2" countertops, chefs appliances, and breakfast area that opens to the family room with gas fireplace and sliders overlooking the fabulous terrace creating the perfect indoor/outdoor living experience. Exquisite mill work, white oak floors, custom staircases, and built-ins truly show meticulous attention to detail. Absolutely spectacular primary bedroom with walk-in closet, and spa inspired bathroom that will take your breath away featuring a 8ft x 4ft walk in shower, soaking tub, floating vanity, and heated floors. Take the elevator or stairs to the finished 3rd floor and enjoy sunsets from your private rooftop deck overlooking Mead Park. "The Enclave on Richmond" offers privacy, elegance, and convenience with just a few steps to New Canaan's shops, restaurants, and Metro-North station. Truly a one-of-a-kind residence.

The Law Building - Professional Office Suites Available... Premium professional office space for lease at New Canaan's gateway! The Law Building offers flexible suites from 300-650 sq. ft in a recently renovated brick building with timeless charm. New roof, energy-efficient windows, gutters & designer entrance doors. First-class finishes throughout. Ideal for attorneys, financial advisors, family offices, consultants & professional services. $50/sq. ft. Walk to downtown shops & restaurants. Professional tenant mix. Move-in ready. Flexible lease terms available. Don't miss this prestigious New Canaan address!

Relax and enjoy country living in this nearly 5,000 SF, 5-bedroom meticulously maintained rustic colonial. This home overlooks a large and serene pond with access to a canoe, a paddleboat, skating and fishing. In the winter season, enjoy a crackling fire in the family room or relax reading a book in the cherry paneled library. The large chef's kitchen steps out to views from the stunning stone patio making this home perfect for entertaining and casual everyday living. There are 4 finished floors, including a double story entry, handsome living room and dining room, and private office on the 3rd floor. Workout in the gym or just relax in one of the many spaces this home offers.  Enjoy Grace Farms, Irwin Park, Waveny Park, shopping and restaurants just minutes away from this spectacular location.

Exceptionally crafted new construction by a highly regarded local builder, this home offers 5 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and 4 finished levels directly across from Bristow Bird Sanctuary with access to Mead Park, shops, train, and restaurants. Combining quality construction, 4 finished levels, and a premier walk-to-town location, this new home delivers details and functionality that set it apart.

listings.remarks: Privately set on 3.2 picturesque acres, this distinguished 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath residence blends classic architecture with sophisticated living in a peaceful, private setting. A double-height foyer welcomes you into sun-filled interiors with elegant architectural details and generously proportioned rooms. At the center of the home is a beautifully designed gourmet kitchen that opens to a bright breakfast room and an impressive family room with cathedral ceilings, skylights, and a fireplace. French doors lead to an expansive deck, extending the living space outdoors. Gracious formal living and dining rooms, each with a fireplace, provide refined settings for both intimate gatherings and larger-scale entertaining. The finished walk-out lower level offers exceptional flexibility with a family/bonus room, playroom, guest bedroom or fitness room, and wine cellar. Modern upgrades include a new generator, updated heating and cooling systems, and smart home automation. A three-car garage with loft space above provides additional storage or flexible use. The property features open lawn areas, a heated pool and spa, and an inviting deck for outdoor entertaining-creating a peaceful retreat for everyday living and gathering with family and friends.

27 Raymond St blends move-in ready, in-town convenience with scale usually found farther from town. Set on a generous private feeling .36 acres, 27 Raymond offers a flat, fenced backyard and large patio at the end of a cul-de-sac neighborhood, all mere steps from town. With five en-suite bedrooms on the second floor, including a luxurious primary suite with two walk-in closets and the sanctuary of a large spa-like bathroom, an open chef's kitchen and family room, dining room, intimate living room, private office, finished third floor, and a fully finished lower level with a sixth en-suite bedroom and separate gym, this New Canaan gem checks all the boxes for convenience and low-maintenance modern living. Complete with an oversized two-car garage, spacious mudroom, and beautifully scaled living spaces, this exceptional, like-new home is just minutes from New Canaan downtown's shops, restaurants, New Canaan's brand new library and Metro North.

An extensively updated home on a quiet cul-de-sac offers a serene setting, while still conveniently close to the YMCA, public schools and Town center.  Step inside this three-level residence and be greeted by an abundance of natural light streaming in through plentiful windows and French doors. The home's open and airy ambiance has a thoughtful design and layout. Four spacious bedrooms and 3.5 modern bathrooms offer ample living space for all.  The heart of the home, the award-winning gourmet kitchen combined with the adjoining family room, is an entertainer's dream come true. Fully equipped and designed with functionality in mind the perfect place to create meals with family and friends. Then retreat to the cozy living room with vaulted ceilings to enjoy a book alongside a roaring fire.  Flooded with natural light, a finished lower level provides additional space for relaxation, entertainment or exercise. This home truly has it all, including an in-ground heated pool for summer enjoyment plus a 24kW full house generator.  The impressive outdoor living space features a great stone terrace and an abundance of French doors for easy indoor-outdoor flow. The expansive backyard is level and adorned with beautiful perennial gardens, charming stone walls and mature trees that provide a sense of privacy and tranquility.  Experience the charm of New Canaan living at 34 Horton Lane, a home that combines comfort, style, and convenience.

This stunning shingle and stone Colonial perfectly blends traditional architecture with modern luxury amenities, offering a resort-at-home lifestyle while maintaining close-to-town convenience.  The heart of the home is a brand-new Deane kitchen, featuring an oversized center island, high-end side-by-side refrigerator/freezer, two sinks, two dishwashers, and a premium range. This space is complemented by a dedicated bar area equipped with a large wine fridge and additional refrigerator drawers. The main level also boasts a magnificent great room with vaulted ceilings, along with a formal dining room, living room, and a separate family room, providing the open floor plan that today's buyers prioritize.  Situated on two peaceful acres near the New Canaan village center and Metro-North, the property also offers exceptional outdoor living. You will find a bluestone terrace with a full outdoor kitchen and a heated saltwater pool with a cascading waterfall spa.  With three finished, move-in-ready levels, this property is a rare find.

listings.remarks: Designed by acclaimed architect Dinyar Wadia, this exceptional 5-bedroom estate is set on park-like grounds just minutes from downtown New Canaan. Tranquil gardens, a scenic pond, meandering stream, and curated perennial plantings create a rare sense of serenity and privacy - an ideal setting for both entertaining and everyday living. In the main residence, a gracious foyer introduces elegant, well-proportioned interiors, with dining and living rooms anchored by a double-sided stone fireplace. The gourmet kitchen opens to the family room, sunroom, and front and rear covered porches. The home also features multiple private offices and sun-filled bedrooms, including a serene primary-suite with vaulted ceiling, fireplace, private porch, and own sauna. A third-floor suite provides a private guest retreat, while the fully finished lower level includes a dedicated gym with separate entrance. Exceptional outdoor living unfolds with a heated pool, outdoor kitchen, fieldstone fireplace, spa tub, stone terraces, and covered dining areas. A six-person sauna with full bath enhances the spa-like atmosphere, while an authentic tea house provides the ideal setting for yoga or meditation. A refined separate barn/garage includes a beautifully appointed 1-bedroom apartment-perfect for guests, extended family, or a private retreat. The expansive garage accommodates up to six cars, with space for lifts and multiple charging stations, offering a rare opportunity for the discerning car collector.

listings.remarks: Discover the perfect balance of comfort, connection & a prime location in this inviting 4-bedroom home, ideally sited in a highly desirable neighborhood on a corner lot with sidewalk-lined streets. Designed w/both everyday living & memorable entertaining in mind, this home offers great space & flow. The sun-filled home welcomes you with a large living room w/picture window creating a warm & inviting atmosphere for relaxing or hosting guests. At the heart of the home, the beautifully updated Mohawk designed kitchen, featuring stylish cabinetry, skylights, generous counter space, & a casual dining welcome all to gather and linger. Multiple communal spaces provide flexibility for easy living. Enjoy dedicated, additional areas that serve perfectly as a media room, playroom, fitness area, or home office. The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat, while 3 additional bedrooms, conveniently located on the same level, provide comfortable accommodations for family, guests, or remote work. Step outside & experience your own private escape - a flat, picturesque yard paired w/a covered patio, easily accessible from kitchen and dining area, that's ideal for summer barbecues, outdoor dining, or simply unwinding. Two car attached garage & generator. Live at the center of it all-just moments from a vibrant downtown, train, top-rated schools, the popular YMCA, & everything that makes daily life effortless. 6 Field Crest isn't just a home-it's the lifestyle you've been yearning to find!

2024 complete renovation of this 3-bedroom townhouse that is walking distance to town, train, shops and restaurants! New kitchen and baths, newly finished floors and freshly painted walls. New Central Air and high-efficiency heating system! Lower level completely finished with family room, large laundry/utility room and additional bonus room/home office. Look no further than this beautiful home in a quiet residential neighborhood. Listen to the babbling Five Mile River from your large deck overlooking a private back yard. Additional storage area in detached barn for motorcycle, bicycles, sports gear, etc.

Pristine move in ready five-bedroom Colonial residence situated on 2.9 acres of parklike grounds. Spanning over 6,000 square feet, this home features an open floor plan with formal rooms, elegant moldings, graceful archways and French doors. The interior includes a gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances, a marble center seating island, breakfast room with coffee bar, all which open into a family room with vaulted ceilings and a fireplace. Additional highlights include a library/office with built-ins, and a primary suite featuring a private balcony overlooking the pond, a sitting area, and a marble bathroom.  The property also includes a separate-entry apt. equipped with a kitchenette, a large living and dining area, a bedroom, and a full bath. The home is finished with hardwood flooring, custom millwork, and three fireplaces. Exterior amenities include a spacious deck and room for 5 cars, a heated main level 3 car garage, large mudroom, and an additional two-car garage on the lower level.   The residence is conveniently located near local schools, the village center, Metro-North New Canaan station, The Field Club, and the Merritt Parkway.

Welcome to the Original Norman Dairy Farmhouse, where 1900s craftsmanship meets 21st-century convenience. Originally the heart of a local dairy operation, this stately 5-bedroom residence sits on nearly an acre of level, sun-drenched land. Enter through the home's iconic wrap-around porch and beautiful entry door to soaring 9 foot ceilings throughout the primary living spaces. The main level is designed for gathering, a stately parlor with custom built-ins, a formal living room & dining room, and an expansive family room. The updated kitchen serves as the hub of the home, featuring granite countertops and a sunny breakfast nook overlooking the grounds. With 5 generous bedrooms and three finished levels-including a private third-floor retreat and a dedicated media room - floor plan offers endless flexibility. Located just a stone's throw from the Talmadge Hill train and top-rated schools, this landmark home offers a lifestyle of quiet elegance and historical depth.

Welcome to refined townhouse living in Old Forge Green, one of New Canaan's most sought-after communities. This beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 3-bath residence offers the perfect blend of comfort and style. The thoughtfully designed floor plan features a generous eat-in kitchen, formal dining room, and an inviting living room anchored by a fireplace and custom built-ins. French doors open to a private terrace with a chic awning-ideal for al fresco dining surrounded by professionally landscaped gardens. Enjoy walkability to New Canaan's vibrant village center, where award-winning restaurants, boutique shopping, and Metro-North access await. A rare opportunity to experience low-maintenance living without sacrificing space or location. --

Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac on a private lane, 46 Wakeman Road is a quintessential Country Colonial set on 4 beautifully landscaped acres. Meticulously maintained, the home blends timeless elegance with modern comfort, offering bright, expansive living spaces in a serene setting.  The main level features soaring ceilings, refined details, and a gracious flow. The large, elegant living room and formal dining room open to an expansive screened porch creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. A stunning kitchen with spacious breakfast area, transitions effortlessly to the inviting family room with walls of windows and glass doors creating a dramatic, sun-drenched space that accesses the wraparound deck framing the picturesque grounds.  The 1st-floor primary suite is a serene haven with glass doors to its own deck, dual walk-in closets and sitting area. A handsome library/office with fireplace and built-ins offers a warm workspace. Upstairs are 3 bedrooms, including a spacious secondary suite. A large bonus room with vaulted ceiling and built-in workspaces is ideal for play, media or studio use. The walkout lower level recreation room/gym has potential for a 5th bedroom or guest suite.  Outdoors, rolling lawns and mature trees create a peaceful backdrop. Additional highlights include 4 fireplaces, 3-car garage, generator, 2 laundry rooms, and a windowed butler's pantry. A rare blend of privacy, space & convenience just minutes from town, top-rated schools and commuter access.

Highlights: spacious custom chef's kitchen with dining area, magnificent great room with cathedral ceiling and a paneled wood-burning fireplace, dining room with bay window and a family room with its own fireplace and French doors opening to the wrap around deck overlooking a serene and bucolic backdrop. A perfect setting for entertaining. Ideal for everyday living. Upstairs, the sun-filled primary suite offers a vaulted ceiling, dressing room and luxurious marble bath. Three more bedrooms, one en-suite, and a hall bath complete the second floor. The walk-out lower level is equipped with a kitchenette and full bath, providing flexible space for recreation, work or extended living. Overlooking the heated pool, the charming guest house is perfect for weekend guests, in-laws, a private office or a fitness studio. Whether hosting gatherings or enjoying quiet moments at home, this remarkable property offers endless possibilities. A rare opportunity not to be missed.

listings.remarks: Welcome home to this beautifully maintained condominium in coveted Graystone! Offering the perfect blend of space, comfort, and an unbeatable prized in-town location, this is the one. This bright and spacious residence features hardwood floors throughout, three generously sized bedrooms, all thoughtfully situated on one level, along with three full bathrooms. The home is ideal for both everyday living and effortless entertaining.The renovated and expansive kitchen is warm and inviting, complete with a large bow window dining area- ideal for morning coffee or casual meals. A sun-filled family room highlighted by four skylights, complemented by the living and formal dining areas, offers versatile spaces for both relaxation and entertaining. The large unfinished lower level offers additional possibilities, perfect for a home office, gym, or recreation area. Step outside to your own private, fully fenced stone patio, a peaceful retreat for outdoor enjoyment. An attached one-car garage offers convenient year-round access, while second-level laundry adds everyday ease. Set within a beautifully maintained condominium community, this home places you just steps from the best of New Canaan's downtown living-dining, shopping, parks and more. Move right-in to this delightful unit, and enjoy this easy lifestyle.

This is home is exactly where the New Canaan market is right now. Tucked down a private lane, this is the kind of home buyers are looking for-clean, updated, and completely move-in ready.  254 White Oak Shade has just been refreshed with new paint, refinished floors, and thoughtful staging that makes the entire home feel light, bright, and easy. The living spaces are filled with natural light, and the layout works for both everyday living and entertaining without trying too hard.  It's a classic New Canaan home with the right updates already done-so you're not walking into a project. The setting is what makes this one stand out. Quiet, private, and surrounded by greenery, yet just minutes to town, the train, and an easy commute. You have quick access to Norwalk for everyday convenience-Costco and Target runs-while still living in New Canaan with top-tier schools and the charm of a true village.  Homes like this-updated, well-located, and ready to go-make this a choice you will not want to miss. Deadline for offers is Monday 5/4 @ 5pm

Tucked into one of New Canaan's most desirable in-town neighborhoods, 33 Village Drive offers the perfect blend of thoughtful renovation, comfortable living, and unbeatable convenience. Recently updated, the home features bright, open living spaces designed for today's lifestyle, with a seamless flow ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Generous room sizes, updated finishes, and great natural light create a warm and inviting feel throughout. Whether gathering in the main living areas or enjoying quieter moments at home, the layout offers flexibility and ease. The location is hard to beat. Just moments to schools, Waveny Park, the YMCA, and downtown New Canaan, everything you need is right at your fingertips. A turnkey opportunity in a truly special neighborhood.

Beautifully updated and full of charm, this surprisingly spacious townhome offers the ease of in-town living in one of New Canaan's most convenient locations. The kitchen has been thoughtfully updated, while beautiful hardwood floors shine throughout, abundant natural light fills the home, and 7 inch crown moldings bring warmth and character. The grand primary suite is a true retreat with an oversized bathroom, a massive walk-in closet, and two additional closets for effortless organization. The finished lower level is a standout feature, offering wonderful flex space for a family room plus a home office and workout space. Outside, enjoy a private fenced in backyard with a charming slate patio where the peaceful sounds of the nearby river create a relaxing backdrop. There is excellent storage throughout in addition to a vaulted attic with full flooring for even more room, and a one car attached garage. All of this in a low-maintenance setting just moments from town, shops, restaurants, and the train, with the rare benefit of no HOA dues. A special opportunity to enjoy comfort, convenience, and easy living in the heart of New Canaan.

The seller is requesting highest and best offers by Tuesday at 3:00 PM.  Perched gracefully atop a scenic hill, this quintessential Connecticut home offers a rare blend of privacy, charm, and opportunity. Set among grand estates and located just two miles from the New Canaan train station, the setting alone is enough to capture your heart. This is an exceptional opportunity to reimagine and elevate a truly special property into your own masterpiece. The home features generously scaled rooms, beautiful hardwood floors, and a screened-in porch you may never wish to leave. A welcoming family room with a striking brick fireplace overlooks the serene, private backyard, creating the perfect space to unwind or entertain. The residence includes a spacious living room and dining room, a private office ideal for working from home, and a lovely primary suite with en-suite bath. Three additional bedrooms and a two-car garage complete the offering. Please refer to the floor plan for full layout details. Beyond the home, enjoy all that New Canaan has to offer, from award-winning restaurants and unique boutique shopping to top-rated schools, beautiful parks, and an Olympic-sized town pool. With Metro-North access, commuting to New York City is seamless. Adding to the charm, Lee Memorial Garden is just a short stroll away, offering breathtaking displays of azaleas and rhododendrons each spring. A rare setting, a special home, and an opportunity not to be missed... welcome home.

Hurry to see this New Canaan charmer! Custom designed and meticulously maintained by the same family for 30 years this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom ranch is handsomely sited on a beautiful, level 1-acre lot with lovely landscaping. With an impressive floor plan, this spacious home offers wonderful rooms for every lifestyle-whether relaxing, working, playing, studying, or gathering with family. Take your choice: Great Room, Library/Office, Sitting Room, or Recreation Room. Three generously proportioned bedrooms and three full bathrooms provide ample space for gracious living, remote work, and relaxation. As a bonus, there is an in-law suite on the lower level. A beautiful home with classic New England character and the essential modern amenities needed for today's living. Located in New Canaan, known for its top-rated schools, exceptional library, community amenities, fine shopping and restaurants, plus easy access to the Merritt Parkway and Metro-North.

176 Carter Street is a rare retreat tucked down a quiet lane on nearly two park-like acres surrounded by mature specimen trees, perennial gardens, and sweeping open lawns. Peaceful and picturesque, this bucolic setting offers exceptional privacy without ever feeling remote.  Thoughtfully improved throughout, the light-filled Gambrel Colonial flows across three finished levels. Light pours through oversized windows across gracious main rooms - a spacious living room with fireplace, lacquered office with custom built-ins, generous dining room, and updated chef's kitchen with bay window overlooking the breathtaking grounds. A first-floor bedroom and full bath are perfect for guests or a private suite.  Upstairs, five serene bedrooms include a beautifully updated primary suite, three additional full baths, and a flexible bonus room currently used as a playroom.The walk-out lower level, complete with fireplace and wet bar, opens through a sweeping wall of French doors to a private ivy-covered stone patio, where evenings unfold around the fire pit under open skies. Outside, a spectacular heated pool and sprawling lawn create the perfect backdrop for entertaining.   A charming barn sparks endless possibility, while a full-house generator and detached two-car garage add everyday practicality. The property also offers exceptional potential for future expansion or reimagination. Ideally located just minutes to downtown New Canaan, train, top-rated schools, and the Merritt Parkway

listings.remarks: In-town living at its best. This beautifully updated corner-unit townhouse offers the perfect blend of convenience, ease of living, and refined style in a prime, convenient location in New Canaan. The classic brick exterior sets a timeless tone, while its desirable end-unit positioning provides added privacy and abundant natural light. Inside, thoughtful updates elevate every space. The kitchen features refreshed countertops and a stylish backsplash, seamlessly flowing into a welcoming living area enhanced by custom built-ins. The sunlit primary bedroom is completed with a beautifully renovated en-suite bath. Step outside to your own private garden patio-an ideal retreat for morning coffee or relaxed entertaining. The finished lower level offers a versatile living space: perfect for a family room, playroom, or home office. Whether you're downsizing or searching for a turnkey first home, this exceptional property delivers easy living conveniently near the shops, dining, and everything downtown New Canaan has to offer.

Rich in warmth and history, this enchanting antique gable-front home has been thoroughly updated to offer the rare combination of timeless character and modern ease. A townhouse in a small condo association, the home lives like a single-family home, blending privacy, space, curb appeal, and charm with the convenience of shared exterior maintenance. The home welcomes guests with an inviting foyer leading to open living spaces. The thoughtfully renovated chef's kitchen features elegant marble countertops and a stunning Lacanche range, handcrafted in Burgundy, France. Upstairs are three bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with an updated en suite bath. The third floor, with its sun-filled skylights, built-in shelving, and new flooring, offers exceptional flexibility. It is ideal as a home office, playroom, private guest space, or as the coolest kids' bedroom ever, with its hangout area featuring a rattan swing chair. The recently fully-finished basement provides bonus space and is perfect for recreation, fitness, or a media room. Other significant recent upgrades include a new heat pump system, tankless water heater, and built-in cabinets. A private, south-facing deck invites morning coffee, outdoor dining, and summer entertaining. Dedicated outdoor parking spaces and a private garage add daily convenience. Located in a quiet, walkable neighborhood with a great sense of community. Near to New Canaan's village, schools, Bristow Bird Sanctuary, and Mead Park.

IN TOWN LIVING! Gracefully set on a charming in-town street, this lovely 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers the perfect blend of character, comfort, and convenience. Filled with natural light, this inviting home showcases timeless appeal, warm and welcoming living spaces, and the flexibility to suit today's lifestyle. The open kitchen with a comfortable sitting area with bay window serves as the heart of the home, seamlessly connecting to the formal dining room and creating an ideal setting for both everyday living and entertaining. The living room, centered around a wood-burning fireplace, creates a cozy and comfortable gathering space. Just beyond, a screened-in porch provides the perfect place to relax or entertain while enjoying seamless indoor-outdoor living. The lovely brick patio and spacious yard further enhance the outdoor experience, offering a beautiful backdrop for al fresco dining, play, or quiet enjoyment. The sun-filled finished third floor adds exceptional versatility, ideal for recreation, a playroom, home office, gym, or guest overflow space. Perfectly positioned in a coveted in-town location, this special home is just moments from New Canaan's vibrant village center, with easy access to shops, restaurants, parks, schools, and the train. A rare opportunity to enjoy the very best of in-town living in one of New Canaan's most desirable settings.

In-town Oasis! Expanded 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath cape on private, professionally landscaped property. Renovated for today's lifestyle with generous room sizes and an open floor plan. Vaulted ceiling family room features a brick fireplace and French doors opening to an extensive terrace w/spa tub and outdoor shower. Brand new designer kitchen with quartz counters, Wolf range, Subzero refrigerators, Bosch dishwasher. Formal living room with fireplace and French doors opening to terrace. Master suite features a spa bath with radiant heat floors, steam shower, whirlpool tub & walk-in closet. 4th bedroom or in-home office with built-ins. 2 car garage and state of the art recessed lighting & sound system inside & out! Enjoy being in the heart of town on this sought-after street. Walking distance to schools, park, restaurants and more. Move-in ready in the heart of New Canaan!

listings.remarks: Discover this stunning five-bedroom contemporary on a premier quiet New Canaan cul-de-sac- just five minutes from town. Soaring ceilings and expansive glass windows flood the open floor plan with natural light, backed by lush landscaping for total privacy. Step into the dramatic living room anchored by a custom gas fireplace. Move seamlessly to the sunlit dining area and custom wood-paneled kitchen with new appliances, walk-in pantry, and breakfast nook-opening to a patio and enclosed garden and lawn, perfect for effortless entertaining. The first-floor primary retreat boasts a sitting area, spa-like bath, and large walk-in closet. Sip morning coffee or catch sunsets overlooking your own nature preserve from the wraparound deck. Nearby are a private office and guest bedroom. Upstairs: three generous bedrooms and vaulted media room. The light-filled walk-out lower level features gym/exercise space and a rec room ready for a wood-burning stove. Mudroom and storage areas add flexibility. All floors were refinished or replaced. A pristine utility room includes recently installed propane heat, on demand hot water and whole house generator. Fiber optic connected and security system upgraded. The oversized three-car garage with high ceilings and epoxy floors stores bikes and gear easily. Owners shared their inspired property vision images (onsite) planned before their transfer. Don't miss this incredible opportunity.

A rare opportunity to secure a beautiful, flat, dry acre+ parcel on the west side of town. Framed by mature wisteria and offering a serene natural setting, this location combines privacy and convenience in equal measure. Ideally situated just minutes from town, shopping, dining and major commuting options, you have the perfect blend of tranquility and accessibility.

Set on nearly two acres of beautifully landscaped, park-like grounds, this enchanting 1930s Colonial is tucked away on a private lane just moments from the village and train. Classic architectural details grace the formal living room with fireplace and the elegant dining room, accented by custom built-ins. A richly paneled library with window seat offers an inviting retreat - equally suited as a sophisticated home office. The country kitchen flows effortlessly into a warm and welcoming family room centered around its own fireplace, perfect for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. A generous stone terrace extends the living space outdoors, framing sweeping eastern views across the expansive lawn, flowering trees, and mature plantings. Upstairs, a spacious primary suite is complemented by three additional bedrooms - completing a home that is as timeless in its charm as it is serene in its privacy.

Highest and Best Sunday, May 24th at 1PM. Quietly set back from the road in one of New Canaan's most serene settings, 493 Valley Road is a beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 4-bath Colonial offering an exceptional sense of peace and privacy-just minutes from downtown New Canaan, Wilton, and the Silvermine area.  Move-in ready and extensively improved, this inviting home blends timeless character with modern comfort: a renovated kitchen, updated bathrooms, refinished hardwood floors, and fresh interior and exterior paint are among many recent improvements throughout. A beautifully appointed chefs kitchen opens to a stunning dining room where a full wall of windows looks out to an expansive yard and water views that create a truly idyllic backdrop. The living room, anchored by a wood-burning fireplace and custom built-ins, flows directly to the deck for seamless indoor-outdoor living. A spacious family room with its own fireplace and French doors offers a relaxed setting for everyday gatherings. A private office and separate den provide flexible spaces to work or retreat. Upstairs, four generously sized bedrooms include a spacious primary suite with a newly renovated bath, plus a secondary bedroom privately situated alongside an updated full bath, offering flexibility as a guest suite when needed. The finished lower level adds bonus space for recreation/fitness, or media, with ample storage.

Set on 1.53 beautifully landscaped acres on a quiet New Canaan cul-de-sac, this single-level home offers a rare blend of style, functionality, and flexibility in one of Fairfield County's most sought-after towns. The setting alone is worth the visit. Mature trees, lush greenery, and substantial new landscaping create a private retreat, while the heated in-ground pool anchors the backyard as a true summer destination. A circular drive and refined plantings deliver a sense of arrival the moment you turn in. Three en suite bedrooms and a half bath are arranged in a thoughtful, distinctive floor plan. The primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a fireplace, a spa-inspired en suite bath, and direct access to the grounds beyond. A second bedroom with its own en suite, atrium, and adjacent studio space offers exceptional versatility, easily serving as a guest suite with a private entrance, home office, creative retreat, or second bedroom. A third en suite bedroom rounds out the layout. Extensive upgrades are evident throughout: a redesigned kitchen with granite counters and custom built-ins, updated bathrooms, refinished flooring, vaulted ceilings, and a sun-filled living room anchored by a Palladian window. Located in the award-winning New Canaan school district and just minutes from town, the train, and the Merritt Parkway, the home delivers the rare combination of privacy and proximity.

Additional amenities: heated garage on main level with an electric vehicle charging station, irrigation system, town water and sewer, natural gas connected in street, and custom pull-down blinds throughout. Combining quality construction, 4 finished levels, and a premier walk-to-town location, this new home delivers details and functionality that set it apart.

Completely reimagined and remodeled in 1998 by distinguished architect, Carol Kurth, and renowned builder, Joseph Sisca, the home was awarded the Society of American Registered Architects' Design Award of Merit for superior achievement and professional design excellence. The spacious chef's kitchen, featuring an eat-in breakfast nook with panoramic windows, adjoins an inviting family room with fireplace. Privately positioned on the main level, the primary suite includes a fireplace, private deck, and large bathroom with radiant floor heating. The upper level provides four additional bedrooms; two with ensuite baths and private balconies. The expansive finished lower level adds a rec room with wet bar, gym, workshop, and wine cellar. Beautifully integrated with its natural surroundings, the property offers exceptional privacy, scenic views, and inviting indoor-outdoor living throughout the seasons. The garage is equipped with a Tesla charging station.

Your Private Resort Awaits: Pool, Pool House, and Perfection. A New Canaan stunner on Smith Ridge. Discover unparalleled luxury living in this exquisite 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom residence. High ceilings 9 FT + and large windows flood the interior with natural light, highlighting beautiful hardwood floors and custom millwork that add to the home's character and sophistication. Four Levels of Living: Multiple expansive recreation rooms across the finished lower level and the third floor offers versatile space for play, a home theater, gym, or relaxation. Elegant Design: From the inviting foyer and parking courtyard, formal living/dining rooms to a dedicated home office and workshop, every space has been meticulously crafted for refined living. Outdoor Oasis: An oversized pool and dedicated pool house create a perfect retreat. The pool house includes a designer lounge and full bathroom, ideal for guest house or ease of poolside entertaining, all set within a large, level backyard perfect for any outdoor activity. Discover unparalleled luxury living in this exquisite estate.

A unique collaboration between past and present, 202 Weed Street is a 4,628 sq ft Colonial integrating its original 1880s structure with a stunning addition by Sam Mitchell of the acclaimed Mitchell Studio. A Harvard-educated architect published in Architectural Digest and Veranda, Mitchell prioritizes proportion, livability, and timelessness-a philosophy best described as "Contemporary Architecture Rooted in the Classical Tradition. The gourmet kitchen is a masterpiece, featuring custom wood cabinetry, butcher block and soapstone countertops, a large island, a fireplace with stone surround, and premium appliances including a DCS range, Miele dishwasher, and Fisher & Paykel refrigerator. A gated drive leads to a spectacular iconic stone home anchored by a breathtaking historic elm tree. A welcoming Dutch door leads to the expansive foyer. A second staircase leads to the masterfully designed custom kitchen w/ a generous butler's pantry and scullery. The family room with fireplace offers views of the large stone terrace and expansive gardens. The first level also includes four-season sunroom, elegant dining and living rooms each with a fireplace. A paneled library with picturesque privacy, built-ins and wet bar is the ultimate home office. Storage abounds throughout the home, including a large primary suite with an oversized marble bath, walk-in closet, fireplace, and Juliet balcony. A wide, gracious hallway, leads to four more bedrooms and one with its own oversized private balcony. Basement level is complete with a home gym, wine cellar/tasting room, sauna, fp, and large utility space. This scenic property includes a breathtaking two-story multi-use modern barn and professional garages with eight-car parking, entertaining, and living spaces. Beautifully landscaped pool w/ pool house has a full bath and outdoor kitchen. The tennis court is a private gem bordered by stone walkway & pergola. Your own private club and oasis, this is a generational country estate not to be missed!

A masterpiece of modern luxury, this 8,400 sq ft estate by Arena Development has been meticulously crafted to elevate everyday living. Thoughtfully designed and majestically sited with a dynamic, light-filled layout, the home unfolds across four exquisitely finished levels, anchored by a spectacular chef's kitchen and expansive family room that form the true heart of the residence. Five beautifully appointed en suite bedrooms offer refined comfort, while the home's position on the coveted West Side places you just minutes from the transportation and village.  Every detail speaks to sophistication and craftsmanship-soaring ceilings, four elegant fireplaces, graceful transitions between living spaces, and a stunning walkout lower level designed for recreation and relaxation. This 8,000+ sq ft home strikes a balance that is genuinely difficult to achieve: light-flooded and effortlessly modern, yet layered with warmth and character that only time can give. The four rooms at the heart of this home - the primary bedroom, kitchen, sunroom, and family room - each received transformations of the highest order. In both the primary suite and sunroom, rooflines were lifted to create spaces of extraordinary volume and light. The primary bedroom is a true sanctuary: soaring ceilings, new Marvin windows framing the treetops, an antique Delft-tiled fireplace, and a spa bath of the finest standard. The rebuilt sunroom, with vaulted beamed ceiling and Paris Ceramics heated reclaimed marble tile floor, is simply breathtaking, and the showpiece kitchen looks directly into it, featuring custom cabinetry, honed black granite, a butler's pantry, and Miele coffee station. This unique home boasts an open floor plan, family room with fireplace, beautifully designed kitchen with all of the amenities and French doors opening to private patio and lush yard. Master bedroom with fireplace, elegant master bath with soaking tub and shower. The home offers four bedrooms, four and a half baths. Fully finished walk out basement with cutstom cabinets potential 2nd office / in-law suite. Two car garage & lawn sprinkler & security system.

listings.remarks: Featured in multiple publications and set along New Canaan's coveted Smith Ridge Road, this magazine-worthy, extraordinary estate is a masterclass in privacy, beauty, and timeless luxury. Privately nestled on more than five spectacular acres just moments from town and the New Canaan Country Club, the property offers a lifestyle that feels remarkably tucked away and private. Surrounded by sweeping lawns, curated grounds, and an atmosphere of complete tranquility, it is the kind of place that instantly slows time and is rarely available. Sunlight pours through every room, illuminating interiors that have been meticulously maintained and thoughtfully designed with an uncompromising commitment to quality. From the highest-end designer kitchen to the gracious entertaining spaces, every detail reflects exceptional craftsmanship, sophistication, and enduring style. The primary suite is a destination unto itself-a private retreat defined by sumptuous finishes, spa-like comforts, and an effortless sense of luxury. Generous secondary bedrooms, multiple work-from-home spaces, and a versatile private wing provide flexibility without sacrificing elegance. Whether hosting friends or family or enjoying the quiet beauty of the surroundings, every space has been designed to elevate daily living. Expansive patios, open lawns, and exceptional privacy create a setting that feels more akin to a private resort than a residence.

Rare opportunity to enjoy idyllic setting overlooking river, pond and lush landscaping on two acres. Peaceful and serene oasis off cul-de-sac on west side of town just seven minutes from downtown New Canaan. This one-story home has an open floor plan with a distinctive modern vibe. Tastefully updated throughout with access to multiple entertainment spaces. Views from each room to enjoy the ever changing scenery of the seasons. Experience life in the vibrant community of New Canaan-home of the Philip Johnson Glass House, trendy restaurants, shopping and other cultural attractions-all within an hour of NYC. Landlord would consider furnished at $12,000/month

listings.remarks: Imagine a little bit of New York City in New Canaan! Incredible opportunity for a townhouse rental in an extraordinary enclave of luxury lofts and townhouses and experience refined design and the finest hand-crafted finishes. This 3 bedroom, 3 bath townhouse has gorgeous wide plank white oak floors, living room with custom build-ins galore, fireplace with marble surround, 2 car attached garage, designer chef's kitchen with custom milled white oak cabinetry, waterfall leathered granite island, deluxe appliances, ensuite baths with artisan cut marble counters, and primary bath with heated floors. Access to an incredible 1,000 sq/ft roof deck with outdoor kitchen, and grill. The space is perfect for entertaining, dining, and socializing! Enjoy a view of New Canaan like no other! Just off of New Canaan's Restaurant Row and all this that an idyllic historic village has to offer. Small town charm with a NYC vibe. Far enough yet close enough to NYC. *Virtual photos by Bespoke Marketing.

Set just four minutes from town on nearly three acres adjacent to protected Land Trust property, this exceptional residence offers the privacy, scale, and tranquility of a country estate without sacrificing convenience. Sprawling lawns, stone walls, and a fully finished pool house with pool accessed through a dramatic hornbeam archway, underscore the property's exceptional outdoor living experience. The entry foyer establishes the home's architectural character, unfolding into a generous front to back gallery anchored by mahogany doors that open directly to the 33 foot covered porch and outdoor terrace. Detailed millwork, oak floors, and beautifully proportioned rooms create a sense of continuity throughout, while French doors across the principal living spaces provide a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. The kitchen, family room, and informal dining area are thoughtfully arranged in an open, flowing layout oriented toward the grounds, balancing everyday comfort with effortless entertaining. A well appointed mudroom serves the practical demands of daily life with equal attention to detail. The primary suite is distinguished by soaring 12 foot ceilings and dual walk in closets. Four additional en suite bedrooms, a substantial bonus room, and a third floor guest suite/lounge complete the upper levels. The lower level is finished with a generous recreation space, half bath, media room, and a gaming room that walks out to a private terrace.

Beautifully sited on 1.46 acres at the end of a quiet and peaceful westside cul-de-sac, this private oasis is perfection! The impressive and sun-drenched 6,200 SF classic colonial offers a thoughtful and versatile floor plan to accommodate a modern lifestyle for easy living, work and entertaining. With four fully finished floors, highlights include high ceilings, two-story entry, detailed millwork, hardwood floors, 5/6 bedrooms, eat-in-kitchen with cozy breakfast room, dramatic family room with wood slat ceiling and fireplace, gracious living room with fireplace, formal dining room with built-ins and home office. The spectacular primary suite has a luxurious updated bath, sitting room and walk-in closet. In addition, there is a huge third floor bonus room with full bath, and a multi-purpose fully finished lower level with full bath and wine cellar. Enjoy the gorgeous heated pool and spa, park-like setting with flat play yard and expansive bluestone terraces, which are surrounded by lush landscaping and mature trees. This exceptional country estate is conveniently located to town, nationally ranked schools and trains.

Enjoy effortless one-level living in this beautifully appointed New Canaan residence, ideally located just a short stroll from everything downtown New Canaan has to offer - boutique shopping, acclaimed dining, cafes, Mead Park, and the train. Overlooking the picturesque beauty of Mead Park, this home offers the perfect blend of tranquility, convenience, and sophisticated in-town living. Sunlight pours into the inviting living room, anchored by a classic fireplace and flowing seamlessly into a gracious dining area ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The oversized primary suite serves as a private retreat, complete with a dressing area and full bath. A thoughtfully updated bath features quality finishes and timeless style. An additional bedroom plus a versatile third bedroom or home office provide flexibility for guests, remote work, or today's evolving lifestyle needs. Step outside to a private patio perfect for al fresco dining, morning coffee, or simply relaxing while taking in the serene park views. AND, there's a spacious lawn area for frolicking or picnicking. Offered UNFURNISHED or FURNISHED (additional charge) for ultimate convenience and flexibility, this exceptional rental presents a rare opportunity to enjoy turnkey living in one of New Canaan's most desirable in-town locations. (NOTE: There are about eight steps down to get to the unit door.)

Welcome to this fabulous, completely updated corner-unit townhome, perfectly situated in the heart of New Canaan, steps from downtown. Bathed in natural light from multiple exposures, this exceptional 3-bedroom, 2-full bath residence seamlessly blends timeless style with modern comfort, offering a turnkey lifestyle in one of Fairfield County's most sought-after communities. The thoughtfully designed open floor plan creates an inviting atmosphere for both everyday living and entertaining. Beautifully updated interiors flow effortlessly from room to room, including a flex-space bedroom with a Murphy Bed that converts into a desk for office use. A highlight and one-of-a-kind feature is the recently renovated screened-in porch. This charming outdoor retreat extends your living space and offers the ideal setting for morning coffee, alfresco dining or simply unwinding while enjoying nature. Rarely available in these townhomes, #84 features an in-unit washer and dryer which adds to the home's exceptional functionality. In addition to the assigned parking space, a detached garage is included, which provides valuable parking and additional storage. Residents enjoy a resort-like lifestyle with access to 2 community pools and beautifully maintained grounds. A quick walk to New Canaan's vibrant village center provides access to acclaimed restaurants, boutique shopping, and the train station.
