listings.remarks: Timeless character and thoughtful, recent updates come together beautifully at this classic 1930s Colonial set on over three private acres in one of New Canaan's most serene settings. Lovingly maintained and enhanced over time, you'll find a rare combination of architectural charm, graceful living spaces, and a sense of quiet retreat surrounded by protected land. The gracious foyer introduces interiors filled with warmth and personality, where rich finishes and curated details create a home that feels both refined and deeply comfortable. The living room, anchored by a fireplace, opens seamlessly to a terrace, inviting an easy connection between indoor and outdoor living. A very generous dining room and a cozy, wood-paneled family room offer intimate spaces for gathering or unwinding, while the recently renovated kitchen is both functional and beautifully designed, with custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, and beautiful western sunlight with views across the property. Upstairs, four well-proportioned bedrooms include a serene primary suite with a newly designed bath and custom closet. Each additional bedroom offers its own sense of privacy and comfort. A separate studio complete with its own full bath and walk-in closet, provides exceptional flexibility for guests, extended family, or a private work-from-home suite. The grounds are as special as the home itself.

Nestled on 2+ beautifully landscaped acres with a spectacular heated in-ground pool, this exceptional Colonial has been completely renovated to the highest standards, offering the perfect blend of timeless elegance & modern luxury. Thoughtfully redesigned inside & out, every major component has been updated, including the roof, siding, windows, mechanical systems, & generator, providing true turnkey living. Designed for both everyday comfort & effortless entertaining, the home features a modern, flowing floor plan w/sun-filled living spaces & seamless transitions throughout. At its heart is a beautifully appointed kitchen that opens to inviting gathering areas and outdoor living spaces, creating the ideal setting for family & friends. The lux primary suite serves as a private retreat, highlighted by a spa-worthy marble bath with sophisticated finishes & timeless appeal. Step outside to your own backyard oasis featuring the impressive heated pool, expansive entertaining patios & professionally designed landscaping providing exceptional beauty and privacy throughout the seasons. Whether hosting large gatherings or enjoying a quiet evening at home, the outdoor living experience is second to none. Car enthusiasts, hobbyists, & collectors will appreciate the custom outfitted oversized 2.5-car garage offering for vehicles, storage, & workspace. Rarely does a home of this quality, condition & setting become available. Simply move in & enjoy the very best of New Canaan Living!

This bright and airy two-bedroom duplex spans two levels and offers picturesque views of Main Street. Fully reimagined through a complete gut renovation, the residence seamlessly blends modern design, exceptional comfort, and top-tier energy efficiency.  The sun-filled open-concept layout features gleaming white oak floors, expansive windows, quartz countertops, and a sleek Bosch stainless steel appliance suite. Both bedrooms offer beautifully appointed ensuite, spa-inspired bathrooms, while additional highlights include a home office space, recessed lighting throughout, and a charming private porch. Ideally situated in the heart of town, this exceptional home is just moments from acclaimed restaurants, boutique shopping, the commuter express train, and the very best of in-town living.

Discover the epitome of timeless luxury in this magnificent Colonial Chateau-style residence. Perfectly situated on two flat, meticulously landscaped acres in a coveted walking neighborhood, this home offers unparalleled privacy while remaining just moments from town and top-rated schools. This quiet, no-cut-through street is a haven for outdoor enthusiasts, offering exceptional bike riding and walking routes right from your door. The active neighborhood association fosters a true sense of community-think spirited trick-or-treating, seasonal gatherings, and friendly faces at every turn. Enjoy the best of both worlds: peaceful residential living with convenient access to prime roadways for an easy commute.   The interior is a masterful blend of elegance and comfort, featuring six spacious en suite bedrooms and an astounding eight indoor fireplaces that create warmth and ambiance throughout. Designed for grand entertaining and modern family living, the home boasts multiple family rooms, ensuring ample space for every occasion. Indulge your passions in the dedicated wine cellar and the custom-designed sports den.  The sophisticated primary level flows seamlessly to the breathtaking exterior amenities, which include a built-in pool for summer relaxation and a beautiful outdoor fireplace for year-round enjoyment. Completing this exceptional estate are four spacious garage bays, providing abundant storage and convenience.

Exceptionally crafted new construction by a highly regarded local builder, this home offers 5 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and 4 finished levels directly across from Bristow Bird Sanctuary with access to Mead Park, shops, train, and restaurants. Distinctive craftsmanship is found throughout, with custom millwork and cabinetry, detailed mouldings, white oak floors, quartz counters, and designer fixtures. The main level features an open floor plan centered around a beautifully appointed kitchen, expansive dining area, and living room with access to a private fenced patio and landscaped grounds. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a walk-in closet and spa-like bath with double-sink vanity, soaking tub, water closet, and walk-in shower with ceramic walls and Carrera marble flooring. Completing the 2nd level are 2 additional bedrooms, full bath, and spacious laundry room. The finished 3rd level features vaulted ceilings, 4th bedroom, full bath, and flexible playroom. The finished lower level includes a 5th bedroom, full bath, and rec room, offering versatility for guests, work, fitness, or media use. Additional amenities: heated garage on main level with an electric vehicle charging station, irrigation system, town water and sewer, natural gas connected in street, and custom pull-down blinds throughout. Combining quality construction, 4 finished levels, and a premier walk-to-town location, this new home delivers details and functionality that set it apart.

listings.remarks: Tucked away at the end of a coveted cul-de-sac, this storybook expanded Cape blends timeless charm with exceptional craftsmanship and beautiful indoor-outdoor living. Surrounded by spectacular gardens, this special home offers four bedrooms, four full and one half baths, and thoughtfully designed spaces filled with warmth and character.  At the heart of the home are inviting living and entertaining spaces, including a gracious living room, elegant dining room, cozy family room, and a sun-drenched sunroom wrapped in glass doors that open to the breathtaking grounds beyond. An office tucked beneath the dormers provides a private and inspiring workspace, while recently added first-floor laundry room adds everyday practicality with built ins, storage and a wine refrigerator. The serene primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a large west-facing deck perfect for enjoying sunset views over the gardens. Every room reflects the quality and care with which this home was built and lovingly maintained. Offering the rare combination of privacy, charm, and an exceptional cul-de-sac location, this is a home that feels both timeless and welcoming from the moment you arrive. Once there, you won't want to leave!

Experience elevated living in the heart of downtown New Canaan with this exquisite boutique enclave offering just 7 luxury residences. Built with the best finishes in mind, this home features 2,998 sq ft of finished space, Elevator, large-pane oversized windows, and a thoughtfully designed layout that centers around your gourmet kitchen featuring custom cabinetry, gorgeous island with 2" countertops, chefs appliances, and breakfast area that opens to the family room with gas fireplace and sliders overlooking the fabulous terrace creating the perfect indoor/outdoor living experience. Exquisite mill work, white oak floors, custom staircases, and built-ins truly show meticulous attention to detail. Absolutely spectacular primary bedroom with walk-in closet, and spa inspired bathroom that will take your breath away featuring a 8ft x 4ft walk in shower, soaking tub, floating vanity, and heated floors. Take the elevator or stairs to the finished 3rd floor and enjoy sunsets from your private rooftop deck overlooking Mead Park. "The Enclave on Richmond" offers privacy, elegance, and convenience with just a few steps to New Canaan's shops, restaurants, and Metro-North station. Truly a one-of-a-kind residence.

Experience luxury living at its finest with this exquisite brand-new masterpiece built by award winning builder. Convenience & sophisticated style is what you get with this ultra-chic 4 bedroom 4.5 bathroom one of a kind property that will take your breath away from the moment you walk through the front door. Built with the best finishes in mind, you'll enjoy 9ft+ ceilings, Elevator, flexible open floor plan, office, gorgeous family with gas fireplace and walls of large-pane oversized glass that open up to your private terrace overlooking the beautifully manicured back yard creating the perfect indoor/outdoor living experience. Exquisite mill work, white oak floors, custom staircases, and built-ins truly show meticulous attention to detail. Absolutely spectacular primary bedroom with large walk-in closet and spa inspired bathroom featuring a 7tt x 4ft walk in shower, soaking tub, floating vanity, and heated floors. (All bedrooms have en-sutie bathrooms). Gorgeous mudroom with elevator that travels from bedroom level to the finished walkout basement. Additional features include Spray foam and sound proofing insulation, irrigation system, Hydro HVAC system, and more. Too many features to list. Walking distance to New Canaan's favorite restaurants, shops and train station.

Enjoy in-town New Canaan living in this sunny and charming 1-bedroom, 1-bath townhouse-style apartment featuring a private entrance, private yard, and off-street parking. Tucked away on a quiet street, yet just moments from everything New Canaan has to offer, this special East Maple Street location provides the perfect blend of privacy and convenience. Imagine strolling into town for ice cream on a beautiful evening or enjoying easy access to New Canaan's award-winning restaurants, the new world-class library, boutique shopping, parks, and Metro-North train service to NYC. Privately set at the end of a long drive and elevated to capture tranquil reservoir views, this more than 5,500 square foot Colonial offers a rare sense of serenity and scale. Designed to embrace its natural surroundings, the home features beautifully proportioned interiors and oversized windows that bathe each space in light. The grand living room with fireplace opens seamlessly to a screened porch, creating an effortless indoor-outdoor experience ideal for quiet mornings or relaxed entertaining. A spacious eat-in kitchen with SubZero, Wolf and Miele appliances, huge center island, and skylight connects to the inviting family room with fireplace. The second level offers a refined primary suite along with five additional bedrooms, including ensuite and Jack-and-Jill configurations. Surrounded by professionally landscaped grounds, with a tennis court and charming gazebo, the property offers a peaceful retreat just minutes from town.

99 Hickok Road is a beautifully updated and meticulously maintained Dutch Colonial set on stunning landscaped property with exceptional privacy and outdoor living. Thoughtfully improved over the years, the home blends timeless elegance with modern comfort and functionality. Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the home features gracious formal and informal spaces, a paneled first-floor office, updated kitchen with premium appliances, first-floor ensuite bedroom, new HVAC, whole-house generator, and smart-home/Sonos integration. The flexible second floor includes a spacious primary suite with sitting area and walk-in closet, two bedrooms with Jack-and-Jill bath, a large bonus/media room, and an additional flexible room ideal as a second office or potential fifth bedroom. A newly added full bath and second-floor laundry enhance convenience and versatility. Outdoor spaces feature bluestone patios and walkways, Belgian block detailing, mature landscaping, irrigation, lighting, and a newly paved driveway-creating a private, resort-like setting perfect for both relaxation and entertaining. Exceptionally cared for and turnkey, this pristine home is set on one of New Canaan's picturesque tree-lined streets.

In the heart of New Canaan, The Quartier presents 21 bespoke luxury residences that pairs classic architecture and stately materials with sustainable energy features. This thoughtfully-designed free-standing 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath free-standing Townhome offers almost 1,800 square feet with gorgeous views off the spacious living room with oversized windows and doors, and 7" white oak flooring. Chef's kitchen with Leicht cabinets, quartzite counters and state-of-the-art appliances. A private primary suite with spa-like bath and walk-in closet on the top level. This refined, boutique development includes a full suite of modern amenities. Residents enjoy two luxurious lobbies with a full-time concierge, exclusive access to a professional fitness studio, an entertainment lounge with catering kitchen, a state-of-the-art golf simulator, outdoor grilling station and firepit, and advanced building security. Located just steps from world-class dining, boutique shopping, and the NYC train line. The Quartier offers luxury, convenience, and connection all in one. Timeless luxury reimagined for modern living.

Clark House, a legacy property with extraordinary provenance, was re-imagined by design legends Delphine and Reed Krakoff, adding their imprimatur of spare modern elegance. Reminiscent of a French hunting lodge and built like a fortress from steel and concrete in 1937, the property was purchased as a country residence by copper heiress Huguette Clark, and remained unoccupied and untouched until a 2014 transformation. The volume of the rooms, soaring ceilings, proportion of the windows and quality of light create a sense of serenity and openness. Stately yet modern, this is a house that can be lived in with comfort and ease. Adjacent to the dining room gallery is a walled garden with a custom pavilion for entertaining. The 52 acres were transformed in collaboration with noted landscape architect Perry Guillot into a private park with a dramatic meandering approach, a great lawn, and woodland trails amongst streams and waterfalls. A 60 x 22 pool and tennis court were also added. At the discrete entrance to the property are twin cottages; a caretaker residence and a gym. Privacy and proximity to NYC and airports along with this caliber of property make this a world class offering and a rarity by any standards.

Every room is immersed in natural light and surrounded by serene wooded views, offering unmatched privacy and a sense of retreat. The main level features an effortless open flow with a primary suite, living room, dining room with a see-through fireplace, office/study, powder room, and expansive sliding doors that connect seamlessly to the wraparound deck. The fully finished, walk-out lower level offers four additional bedrooms, two full bathrooms, a dedicated laundry room, and storage. This rare architectural gem is not just a home, but an experience in design, nature, and modern living.

The newly completed home now offers over 9,000 square feet of exquisite living space with 6 bedrooms, 7.5 baths, and every modern comfort imaginable, all while preserving the timeless character of its hand-cut fieldstone construction. Five fireplaces anchor inviting gathering areas, while French doors lead to light-filled suites and sweeping terraces overlooking the serene landscape. From its architectural heritage to its meticulous, top-to-bottom reinvention, this residence stands as a true work of art-a rare fusion of history, craftsmanship, and modern sophistication-just minutes from downtown New Canaan. Presenting the historic Landis Gores House, an architectural masterpiece epitomizing post-WWII Modernism. Designed in 1946 by Harvard Five architect Landis Gores for his own family, it stands proudly as one of New Canaan's first Modern homes. Gores was at that time working in association with Philip Johnson. He set his own home on a narrow granite ridge astride a majestic 4-acre wooded lot; the residence brilliantly leavens the glass-walled austerity of the International Style with the natural warmth of Wrightian organic architecture.The 130-foot long, single-story form is defined by sweeping horizontal planes, full-height plate glass walls, grey-stained cypress siding, and by natural stone fireplaces, walls and terracing. Its informal, open plan is divided into three distinct pavilions, anchored by the dramatic central living and dining area featuring a raised roof and tall ceilings. Original exterior lighting design by Richard Kelly enhances the seamless integration between the avant-garde interior and its environment. An expansive rear terrace, added by Gores himself in the 1980s, features circular seating areas and an elegant oval swimming pool.Listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 2002 and held by the Gores family since its inception.  The Gores family granted a perpetual preservation easement to the National Trust for Historic Preservation. This iconic property offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to own a foundational piece of architectural history

This distinctive new complex built in 2024 features 12 residences, offering one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and two-bedroom loft options. The loft residences feature private rooftop decks. Each unique residence boasts open layouts that flood with natural light, soaring 9+ foot ceilings, and beautiful white oak flooring. Experience chef-inspired kitchens equipped with custom cabinetry, premium appliances, and quartz countertops. Master bedroom suites are designed for comfort, complemented by bathrooms with heated floors. Enjoy the benefits of smart home technology, in-residence washers and dryers, private security system, and custom solar shades for added convenience. Husted Commons also features elevator service, private balconies or terraces in select residences, reserved underground and courtyard parking for two cars with car charging stations, and inviting outdoor green spaces, making it the ideal choice for in-town living!

listings.remarks: PLEASE SUBMIT ALL OFFERS BY 5PM TUESSStep into a seamless blend of historic charm and modern luxury, ideally located in the heart of New Canaan. Nestled on 1.46 lush, private acres, this beautifully maintained Farmhouse Colonial offers the quintessential New England lifestyle. Spanning 3,383 square feet, this unique home has been thoughtfully updated to feature 5 spacious bedrooms and 5 full bathrooms.  From the moment you step inside, you are greeted by pristine interiors and gleaming refinished floors. The inviting, sun-drenched layout is tailor-made for both relaxed everyday living and elegant entertainment.  Outside, a true sanctuary awaits. Spend your summers enjoying the sparkling pool, running across the expansive play space, or picking fruit from your very own apple trees. Attached is a year-round pool house featuring a full bath and a gym room.  A standout feature of this property is the spectacular detached guest house. Complete with a kitchenette, a spacious great room, and a beautifully appointed bathroom, it offers unmatched versatility. Whether you envision a welcoming suite for extended family and au pairs, a quiet home office away from the main house, or a creative studio for music and art, this space easily adapts to your imagination.   Ideally located just minutes from the train, the Merritt Parkway, and award-winning schools, this move-in-ready gem delivers absolute convenience without sacrificing tranquility.

listings.remarks: This beautiful townhouse with an elevator at Richmond Mews offers an easy, low-maintenance lifestyle just a short walk from town, with views of Mead Park and thoughtful design throughout. Inside, 9+ foot ceilings and oversized windows make the home feel bright and open, with hardwood floors throughout. The double-height entry welcomes you right in. The floor plan is very flexible, allowing for a formal dining room, family room, and living room depending on your needs. The gourmet kitchen has a large center island with French doors opening to a private patio. The spacious primary suite offers bedroom views of the park paired with a large sitting room or office, plus 2 walk-in closets and ensuite bath. Two additional bedrooms and a full bath complete the upper level. The finished lower level adds valuable, versatile square footage - ideal as a home gym, playroom, or additional office space. There is ample storage throughout and an attached 2-car garage. The cedar roof was replaced in 2025. Located close to New Canaan's shops, restaurants, and train station, 30 Richmond Hill Road offers a convenient, well-designed home in a sought-after location.

716 Cheese Spring Road in New Canaan was built completely new in 2019 and customized by the current owners even further. This turn-key home with five bedrooms, five and a half baths and 5,135 square feet sits on 2.84 acres in the northeast side of town. The kitchen was renovated with an Italian stone island, upgraded Sub-Zero, Wolf and Miele appliances. A built-in coffee bar, patio access and spacious dining area complete the kitchen area. A cozy fireplace anchors the oversized and sun drenched living room. Downstairs, a den and bedroom double as a pool house with a full bath and shower. The luxurious primary suite offers a bedroom with a fireplace, built-ins, two walk-in closets, generous primary bath and two separate office and study areas. The in-ground pool takes full sun all day and is in view from the key living areas. The expansive property has two fire pits, professionally manicured landscape and a path cleared through the woods to an insulated treehouse with power. Above the garage, a renovated guest suite gives guests completely separate quarters. The updated mechanicals match the finishes. New Lennox furnace, air conditioning and condenser in 2026, whole house dehumidifier, airtight foam insulation through every wall and the roof, and a well rebuilt in 2025 with filtration and a high pressure pump. Every detail executed to the highest standard. Equidistant to the New Canaan and Wilton village centers, with Metro-North to Grand Central.

Fabulous corner unit townhome with very private gardens & lawn area. This bright and beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1.5 bath residence offers the perfect blend of style, space and convenience. Flooded with natural light, this home features an open flow ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Step outside to your own large private terrace - a rare find, perfect for alfresco dining, morning coffee or quiet evenings. Additional highlights include a detached garage for additional storage just a few steps away. Enjoy resort style living with access to two community pools, New Canaan's award winning schools, vibrant downtown and easy commuter access- all from this exceptional corner location.

listings.remarks: 119 Proprietors Crossing is an entertainer's dream, featuring stunning architecture by James E. Gearity. Nestled on four private acres, this six-bedroom estate blends timeless elegance with modern luxury. A private drive leads to an elegant fountain, setting an unforgettable tone. Inside, a soaring foyer showcases a dramatic Baccarat chandelier and seven fireplaces, enhancing the warm atmosphere. Spacious entertaining areas flow seamlessly to a tranquil terrace. The heart of the home includes a chef's kitchen that opens to a Great Room with a remarkable 35.5 foot vaulted ceiling, centered around a large quartz island with integrated audio. A formal dining room beneath another Baccarat chandelier sets the stage for memorable gatherings. The West wing hosts the primary suite, featuring a cozy retreat and a study with a hidden staircase leading to a gym and an 800-square-foot dressing room. An adjacent Junior Primary Suite has its own entrance and living area. Upstairs, four additional bedrooms include two ensuite and two with a jack-and-jill bath. The finished lower level boasts a media room, fitness center, and wine cellar. Outdoors, curated grounds offer a dining pavilion, outdoor kitchen, and a newly constructed pool and spa, with space for a tennis/pickle-ball court. Engineered for efficiency, the estate features commercial-grade systems, radiant heat, and a rare Welsh slate roof. A four-car garage and an elevator service complete this exceptional offering.

listings.remarks: Newly renovated four-acre estate majestically perched overlooking the Laurel Reservoir, complete with seasonal water views. Ideal for outdoor recreation, the property features a large, level soccer-field-sized yard and a basketball court in the driveway. At the heart of the home is an open-concept living space seamlessly connecting the kitchen, dining, and family rooms.  Property Highlights- - Kitchen & Dining: The brand-new Bilotta kitchen features a center island with seating for six, premium appliances (including a Wolf range with eight gas burners, two ovens, and an additional wall oven), two dishwashers, two sinks, a microwave, ample counter space, and a large walk-in pantry with high storage capacity and enough room for a 2nd refrigerator.   -Dining Room opens directly to the kitchen and comfortably seats 20. -Main Level: Adjacent to the kitchen and dining area is a large family room with skylights, a fireplace, and direct access to the outdoor deck. The main floor also includes two home offices, a powder room, and a formal living room with a fireplace.  -Upper Level: Features five bedrooms and three full baths, including a primary suite with a brand-new luxury bath equipped with a soaking tub, double sinks, and a glass-enclosed shower. -Lower Level: The fully finished lower level provides excellent indoor recreation space, including a playroom and home gym.  This move-in-ready home is a fantastic opportunity.

Nestled at the end of a long private drive south of the Merritt Parkway, this classic Colonial offers timeless character, generous living space, and a highly convenient location. Beautifully expanded and thoughtfully updated years ago, the home showcases exceptional craftsmanship, enduring quality, and solid construction described as having "great bones." The main level is rich with architectural detail - an elegant front-to-back Living Room with fireplace and exquisite custom built-in cabinetry and the Dining Room with beautiful built-in details. At the heart of the home is an expansive Kitchen featuring high-end appliances, custom built-ins, and a second fireplace in the casual dining area-an inviting space for morning coffee, relaxed meals, or entertaining. The adjacent light-filled Family Room offers beautiful views of the changing seasons and provides a comfortable extension of the main living areas. The house includes four spacious bedrooms and 2.5 baths, while a private suite above the garage adds a fifth bedroom with full bath, offering flexibility for guests, a private office or additional living space. Finished recreational space on the lower level provides room to work, play, exercise and the generous terrace creates an inviting setting for outdoor dining and entertaining. With its distinctive architecture, thoughtful layout, and quality details, the home offers an exceptional foundation for personalization, including some cosmetic updating to the exterior.

This charming two-bedroom, 2.5-bath condo is located just minutes from the center of town. The newly renovated kitchen is fresh, bright, and thoughtfully designed, with an easy flow into the living and dining areas. The private outdoor deck extends the living space and is an ideal spot for morning coffee or gathering with friends for dinner outside. The two bedrooms offer comfortable, private spaces, while the fully finished lower level provides flexible additional space for a family room, home office, gym, or guest area. With a full bath and laundry on this level, it adds both functionality and convenience. A detached one-car garage provides private parking and extra storage. Turnkey and ideally situated within the well-maintained Graystone Circle complex, this condo offers exceptional convenience, flexibility, and easy living just minutes from town.

Set high above West Road on nearly five sunlit acres, the Leuthold House embraces south and west light and looks out over its own spring-fed pond from every room. Allan Gelbin, the Frank Lloyd Wright apprentice who supervised the building of Tirranna, designed it in 1966 with an unlimited budget and considered it his finest work. Offered for the first time in 29 years. A long curve of glass, white plaster and mahogany follows the land beneath deep overhangs and two planted green roofs. Life flows easily inside and out. The generous living room, with clerestory windows, fireplace and wet bar, opens through walls of glass to the terrace and a pool that traces the curve of the house. The dining room opens to the kitchen and its curved breakfast nook, or closes off for formal evenings. The first-floor primary suite spans its own wing with dressing room, two mahogany closets, spa bath and a private terrace with the best view in the house. Upstairs, four bedrooms and three baths open to a roof terrace. The office hides its files behind a disappearing mahogany wall and steps out to a private garden. Gelbin's teak and mahogany millwork runs throughout. A covered breezeway connects the private guest house with bedroom, bath, kitchenette and living area. 150 specimen trees, gardens and landscape lighting. Restored by Hobbs Inc. and JMK Architects with geothermal radiant heat and cooling. Cover of Connecticut Cottages & Gardens. Architecturally important and completely livable.

A rare find in the heart of New Canaan - walkable to both town and train - this beautifully renovated (2012-2014) 4/5 bedroom, 5 bath home features a backyard oasis few properties can match. Inside, a beamed cathedral ceiling soars above the great room, where a grand arched hearth of rare scale invites long fireside evenings. Mornings, gather around the marble island in the chef's kitchen, outfitted with top-of-the-line appliances and open to the family room. A den/study, bedroom or office, full bath, powder room, huge mudroom, and laundry complete this level's easy flow. The upper floors feature a primary bedroom with its own fireplace, walk-in closet and marble bath; two additional bedrooms; a third-floor suite with bath - and there's even an exercise room over the garage. Then comes the surprise: behind the house, towering evergreens and fieldstone walls enclose a secret garden so private you'd never guess that town is steps away. As dusk falls, the heated pool and spa glow, while the fire pit flickers. This special property is not to be missed.

Redesigned for elevated living, this fully renovated 4-bedroom home combines open-concept style with seamless functional flow, offering near single-level living on a private, scenic lot. An inviting entry opens into an informal living room with a cozy fireplace, a high-impact great room featuring soaring cathedral ceilings, stylish beams, and French doors that flood the space with natural light. At the heart of the home, the chef's kitchen boasts exceptional counter space, professional-grade appliances, and a massive center island with seating for effortless entertaining or ease of everyday living. The main living space opens to a private wrap-around back porch with built-in corner seating & planters, perfect for outdoor relaxation overlooking the tranquil, tree-lined yard with an area for a garden.A separate wing houses the private primary suite-a serene retreat styled with shiplap walls, vaulted ceilings, large picture window, and spa-inspired bath complete with dual sinks, a freestanding soaking tub, a custom marble shower, and skylights. Three additional light-filled bedrooms and a full bath provide comfortable accommodations for guests or family.Complete with an attached 2-car garage, lower level flexible space and laundry, storage shed, and a lush, rolling lawn.This turnkey residence offers easy living just minutes from everyday conveniences, award-winning New Canaan schools, the Nature Center, Waveny Park, designer boutiques, NYC-inspired dining & the Metro North train

listings.remarks: A classic 18th-century New England farmhouse, reimagined for the 21st century after a comprehensive five-year renovation. Thoughtfully modernized, the home retains its original character while seamlessly integrating contemporary comforts and style. Light-filled, open living spaces create an airy, modern feel, grounded by whitewashed Douglas fir flooring and anchored by a large, updated kitchen with a working fireplace. Generously sized bedrooms include a primary suite with a custom walk-in closet and a beautifully appointed bathroom featuring a soaking tub. Throughout the home, period details pay tribute to its rich heritage, while extensive mechanical upgrades ensure effortless, move-in-ready living. Set on a beautifully landscaped acre filled with mature trees and flowering shrubs, the property offers a peaceful retreat. A sun-drenched pool is discreetly nestled in the rear, and a charming covered porch provides the perfect setting for summer gatherings, quiet mornings, or evening entertaining. Additional highlights include an expansive walk-up attic offering potential for future expansion. Ideally located across from Waveny Park and just under two miles from downtown New Canaan and its top-rated schools.

Downtown Darien's Corbin District! Experience downtown living in this stunning 2,040 sq ft top floor corner unit. This beautifully designed corner residence offers and incredibly spacious open concept kitchen/living area. The chef's kitchen offers quartz countertops with a combined living area with oversized windows. This residence offers lots of natural light, a home office as well as a powder room all with 9+ft ceilings. There are 2 generous sized bedrooms each with their own bathrooms. This residence has tons of storage as well! Building amenities include access to a shared rooftop terrace/courtyard, elevator service from a secure lower-level garage and professional management. This residence perfectly blends modern luxury with an unbeatable location with walk to shop/restaurants and fitness options all located in downtown Darien.

Welcome to easy in-town living at Oenoke Condominiums! This sun-filled, immaculate two-bedroom residence on the 2nd floor enjoys a wonderful location overlooking the large, inviting pool, making a refreshing summer dip just steps from your door. Freshly painted and move-in ready, the home features a spacious living room, an easy-flow floor plan, two generously sized bedrooms with large closets, and abundant natural light throughout. Recent updates include a new GE five-burner glass-top range and Whirlpool over-the-range microwave. Replacement windows were installed in 2014 and include a limited lifetime warranty. Additional conveniences include private storage and laundry facilities in the basement, while heat and hot water are included in the common charges. Best of all, leave the car behind! Enjoy an easy stroll to the heart of New Canaan for exceptional dining, unique shops, parks, the library, and Metro-North service to NYC. With New Canaan's highly regarded schools, beautiful parks and outstanding recreational amenities nearby, this bright and beautifully maintained home offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience and an exceptional in-town lifestyle.

listings.remarks: Sunlit, nicely updated 2-3 Bedroom townhouse with 3.5 Baths, just steps from the New Canaan Town & Train. This spacious rental is right in the heart of New Canaan, where everything you need is right outside your door. Beautifully updated throughout, this bright residence offers generous, versatile living spaces that adapt to your lifestyle: a true two-bedroom with a flexible third room that works perfectly as a home office, guest room, or rec room. Every bedroom enjoys the comfort and privacy of its own bath, and a 1/2 guest bath is on the main floor. The newer eat-in-kitchen spacious kitchen is well equipt. Ready for quick weeknight dinners to weekend entertaining. Downstairs, a walk-out lower level adds a whole additional layer of living space, ideal for a family room, media room, home gym, or private guest suite, with direct access to a private backyard garden area. A deck, accesible from the main level off the living room/dining room area is a perfect spot for morning coffee or evening dining. Two dedicated parking spaces and an in-unit washer and dryer make daily life effortless. Best of all, you're just steps from the New Canaan train station for an easy commute, and moments from the charming shops, award-winning schools, acclaimed restaurants, cafes, and amenities of one of Connecticut's most beloved downtowns. Move-in ready-schedule your showing today.

Enjoy living in this beautifully renovated end-unit townhouse in the heart of New Canaan. This sun-filled home has it all with wide-plank white oak flooring, stunning eat-in kitchen with quartz countertops, Thermador appliances, dry bar and a custom pantry and laundry room. The spacious living room has a gas fireplace, dining area and opens seamlessly to a private fully fenced patio- perfect for a morning coffee, outdoor dining or relaxed entertaining. The upper level offers two large en-suite bedrooms with walk-in closets. The finished expansive lower level with a half bath provides exceptional living space for a family room, private office, fitness area or media room. All major mechanical systems were newly installed in 2023 including Bosch central air conditioning, a Weil-McLain boiler and a Bradford White hot water heater. Located steps to the train station, dining, boutique shopping, cafes and the vibrant downtown that New Canaan has to offer. This turn-key townhouse with three reserved parking spaces and a attached garage is not to be missed. A must see!

*Highest and Best by Tues. Sept. 8th @ 10am.* Welcome to this inviting 1BR unit located in the heart of New Canaan, across from beautiful Mead Park where tennis, pickleball, and a lake for contemplation is just steps away. Enjoy the convenience of walking to the train, shops, restaurants, and library, offering an easy and very connected lifestyle. Located on the main level, this condo features hardwood flooring, a reserved parking space, and a rear walk-out for direct access to parking. Ideal for a first-time buyer, downsizer, or investor (tenant in place). Heat and hot water included in HOA. (Virtually staged to preserve tenant's privacy).

listings.remarks: The Ultimate Canvas on the Cul-de-Sac: Build Your Vision in the Village Corridor! Tucked away on one of the neighborhood's most coveted, postcard-worthy cul-de-sacs, this rare 0.32-acre land opportunity serves up the ultimate blend of peaceful seclusion and unbeatable village convenience-complete with sidewalks leading right to the heart of town. Perched on a flat, dry, and sun-drenched south-facing parcel, the site provides an optimal level footprint with all-day natural light, ready for you to bring your dream team and build a custom masterpiece from the ground up. Set among a gorgeous tapestry of mature greenery and impressive multi-million-dollar new construction, you are investing in a premier street where location is king, upside is limitlessly bright, and top-rated New Canaan schools and the train are just minutes away.

The Ultimate Canvas on the Cul-de-Sac: Shine Bright in the Village Corridor! Tucked away on one of the neighborhood's most coveted, postcard-worthy cul-de-sacs, this rare gem serves up the ultimate blend of peaceful seclusion and unbeatable village convenience-complete with sidewalks taking you right to the heart of the action! Perched on a flat, dry, and bathed-in-sunlight .32-acre parcel, the south-facing orientation floods the property with natural light all day long. Whether you choose to reimagine the existing, 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home or bring your dream team to build a custom masterpiece from the ground up, the possibilities here are endless. Set among a gorgeous tapestry of mature landscaping, meticulous existing homes, and impressive multi-million-dollar new construction, you are investing in a premier street where location is king and the upside is limitlessly bright. Just minutes from the train, vibrant village life, and top-rated New Canaan schools.

Experience refined living in this beautifully renovated townhouse-style condominium, ideally situated in the heart of New Canaan. Offering four bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and a finished third floor, this exceptional residence combines timeless elegance with modern comfort and effortless functionality. The thoughtfully updated interior features a designer-inspired kitchen with elegant quartz countertops conviniently opens to an expansive deck. Beautifully renovated bathrooms, pristine hardwood floors, and an abundance of natural light throughout. The spacious and versatile layout provides plenty of room for both everyday living and entertaining. The first floor offers a private bedroom and full bathroom, perfect for guests, a home office, or flexible living arrangements. The finished third floor provides additional space that can be tailored to your lifestyle.  Ideally located just moments from New Canaan's brand-new library, charming downtown, acclaimed restaurants and shops, and the train station, this home offers the rare combination of sophisticated living and unparalleled convenience. Plenty of parking space. A truly exceptional opportunity to enjoy the best of New Canaan living.  Qualified tenants only. Good credit, verifiable income, and strong references required. Two months' security deposit and one month's rent in advance required.

listings.remarks: This exceptional and meticulously crafted residence offers the perfect synthesis of luxury, space and privacy in one of New Canaan's most coveted in-town locations. Nestled on a rare.52-acre private parcel, this thoughtfully and beautifully recently renovated home provides a serene retreat while remaining uber convenient to schools, shopping and cherished downtown amenities. Spanning four beautifully finished levels, the home offers elevator access to three floors, providing exceptional convenience and seamless flow throughout. Expansive living and family room areas showcasing striking millwork are perfectly suited for entertaining and gatherings while the main level office with coffered ceiling provides a refined space for work from home life. At the heart of the home-and sure to impress-is a stunning open-concept chef's kitchen, thoughtfully designed to balance functionality with elevated style. Featuring double sinks, a spacious pantry, custom built-ins, and a large communal quartz island, the space is as practical as it is stunning. A newly installed 2026 Wolf range anchors the kitchen, making it a true culinary enthusiast's dream and open sight lines from kitchen to breakfast room, to family room and welcoming deck create a natural gathering space for both everyday living and entertaining. Two adjacent mudrooms with ample closets and storage throughout offer effortless organization and complement the first floor.

Welcome to this pristine, move-in-ready 4-bedroom, 3-bath Center Hall Colonial, ideally situated in the highly desirable Hoyt Farm Association. Thoughtfully updated and meticulously maintained, this exceptional home offers a modern floor plan designed for comfortable living and effortless entertaining. The stunning chef's kitchen features top-of-the-line appliances, a granite center island, and hardwood floors, with new sliding glass doors opening onto a mahogany deck overlooking a park-like, level backyard. The gracious family room with a fireplace creates a warm gathering space, while the expansive living room boasts a second fireplace and an oversized picture window. A generous dining room is perfect for hosting family and friends, and a first-floor office makes working from home a pleasure. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite offers a beautifully updated bath and a spacious walk-in closet, while three additional bedrooms and an updated bathroom provide ample space for family and guests. Hardwood floors extend throughout the home, enhancing its timeless appeal. Outside, lush gardens and mature landscaping create a private backyard retreat on stunning grounds. Ideally located just minutes from town, schools, the train, and major parkways, this beautifully maintained home combines classic Colonial charm with today's modern amenities.

Prestigious Hoyt Farm Tudor: An Elegant Two-Acre Oasis Near the Village. Nestled on two beautifully landscaped, ultra-private acres in the highly coveted Hoyt Farm neighborhood, this exceptional Tudor offers over 7,400 square feet of sophisticated luxury and warmth. A grand, two-story foyer welcomes you into a seamless, light-filled layout featuring a formal living room with dramatic vaulted ceilings, a handsome wood-paneled library, and an open chef's kitchen that flows effortlessly into a spacious family room with a fireplace. The primary suite is a true sanctuary, boasting its own cozy fireplace, a private balcony overlooking the grounds, a generous dressing room, and a sun-drenched, spa-like bath. Four additional bedrooms and four-and-a-half baths ensure plenty of space and comfort for everyone. Outside, your personal resort awaits: host gatherings on the tranquil brick terrace by the outdoor fireplace, swim in the stunning heated pool, or simply enjoy the park-like property framed by mature specimen trees. Complete with a three-car garage, this magnificent estate offers unparalleled privacy and convenience, located just minutes from the train, vibrant village life, and top-rated New Canaan schools.

Two blocks to downtown, this highly desirable end unit in Park Slope offers beautifully detailed, elegant living with a rare oversized two car garage, elevator, and abundant storage. The first floor features a large eat in kitchen, den with wet bar, separate dining room, and living room with fireplace and a charming private terrace. The second floor includes a generous primary suite with a walk in closet, plus two additional bedrooms and a full bath. Park Slope's coveted in town setting offers a simple 5 minute walk to the train. With just 13 residences, Park Slope is one of New Canaan's premier townhome communities.

Cherished by the same family for nearly 30 years, this beautifully updated Colonial sits on a desirable New Canaan cul-de-sac that has recently welcomed multi-million-dollar new construction - offering exceptional value at this price point, just moments from town. The recently renovated kitchen opens to a spacious layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining, complemented by a large living room with fireplace, a formal dining room and a Great Room with soaring cathedral ceiling that is a showstopper. Upstairs, the primary bedroom is joined by three additional sun-filled bedrooms, all with hardwood floors that carry the home's warmth throughout. Outside, a private deck overlooks a beautifully landscaped yard framed by mature evergreens - great for gathering or play. This is a home where all that's left to do is move in.

Gracious colonial set on 3.74 private acres along a quiet west-side cul-de-sac. This cherished estate setting offers an exceptional blend of privacy, recreation, and convenience, just two miles from town and the train. The private grounds feature a Glengate Gunite pool, cabana with bath, and a barn with stables where the owners once kept horses for riding on nearby Land Trust trails. Offered for the first time in more than 50 years, this center-hall Colonial features six bedrooms, five full and three half baths, with 6,300 square feet of living space, and an additional 800 square feet of finished lower-level space. Thoughtfully renovated and expanded by Judith Larsen designs in 2005, the residence includes a beautifully appointed kitchen, an open family room with vaulted ceilings, lovely breakfast room overlooking grounds and a private in-law suite with its own entrance . Other features are 4 car garage, full house generator, pond views and driveway alert.  Beautifully proportioned interiors and multiple gathering spaces make the home equally suited to comfortable everyday living and gracious entertaining. French doors spanning the rear of the residence open directly to the grounds, creating a seamless connection among the home, pool, cabana, and expansive property. A truly rare and treasured offering in one of New Canaan's most desirable west-side settings.

Experience sweet neighborhood-y, in-town living on this adorable one-way street perched high above the Five-Mile River. Four levels of pristine living space, encompassing 3++ bedrooms, 4 full baths and one half bath on the main floor. ELEVATOR to all levels. The patio is an oasis with built-in gazebo for summer relaxing or cooler cozy nights under the stars. Attached garage PLUS 4 other designated parking spaces. Feels like a brand new single family home in prime location close to everything. Come see for yourself!

Opportunity knocks in New Canaan! Set on .33 acres in a convenient location close to the heart of town, 38 Urban Street offers an exciting opportunity for a buyer with vision. This three-bedroom ranch is ready for its next chapter and will require significant updating, but the possibilities are well worth exploring. For a first-time buyer willing to roll up their sleeves, this could be a chance to enter the New Canaan market, renovate over time, and create a home of their own. For those with a bigger vision, consider partnering with a builder or architect to explore renovation, expansion or redevelopment possibilities, subject to town approvals.  The existing home features one-level living, a full unfinished basement and basement garage, all on a .33-acre parcel. The location adds tremendous appeal, with New Canaan's vibrant village, restaurants, shops and Metro-North train station nearby.  Bring your contractor, your imagination and your vision. 38 Urban Street is ready for someone to see the possibilities and make it their own.

listings.remarks: An icon of American modernism, the celebrated Celanese House presents a rare opportunity to own one of New Canaan's most architecturally significant residences. Designed in 1959 by acclaimed architect Edward Durell Stone, this internationally recognized masterpiece has been admired for decades for its timeless design. Meticulously restored to honor Stone's original vision while embracing contemporary living, the home showcases his signature architectural vocabulary-from the striking lattice facade and sculptural glass roof pyramids to soaring walls of glass that dissolve the boundary between indoors and out. Light becomes an architectural element, filling every space and transforming the home throughout the day. Nearly 5,000 square feet of thoughtfully curated living space blend historic integrity with refined modern luxury. Satin-bleached oak floors, floating walls, museum-quality lighting and a dramatic illuminated glass entry create interiors that feel simultaneously iconic and effortlessly livable. Four bedrooms, four-and-a-half baths and beautifully proportioned entertaining spaces provide exceptional comfort without compromising the purity of the original design. Set on 2.06 private acres along a distinguished road, the landscape complements the architecture with tranquil views and remarkable privacy. More than a residence, the Celanese House is an enduring work of architecture-offering the privilege of becoming the next steward of a true design landmark.

listings.remarks: Enjoy Westport summer life to the fullest in this gorgeous newly renovated home with brand new pool. Bright open floor plan offers 4 Bedrooms, 5 Baths, Home Office, Gym and more. Seamless indoor-outdoor living with large flat backyard, refreshing pool, two bluestone terraces that are perfect for relaxing with your morning coffee and dining alfresco, as well as a wonderful outdoor fireplace to gather around to warm your cool seaside nights. In today's market, why rent when you can own ~ Pay yourself and enjoy easy home ownership!

Enjoy the convenience of being within walking distance to the Westport train station, Saugatuck rowing club and restaurants in the vibrant Saugatuck area. As the sun dipped below the horizon, casting a warm glow over Red Coat, the For Sale sign outside 3 Viking Green stood like a beacon of possibility. For Evelyn, a seasoned architect with an eye for potential, this wasn't just a house; it was a canvas waiting to be transformed!  The property was nestled among multi-million $$ homes. Evelyn had spent years designing luxury abodes, but she yearned for a project that ignited her passion. The listing promised 1.12 acres of land & 3,302 square ft of existing space.  It was the yard that captivated her most - a sprawling expanse framed by mature trees. Evelyn envisioned an outdoor oasis: a garden bursting with flowers, a cozy fire pit for stargazing, and a space for children to laugh & play.  However, she wasn't the only one with a vision for this property. As she sketched ideas in her notebook, a car pulled up in the driveway - it was David, the realtor. "Beautiful place, isn't it?" he said, glancing around. "Just waiting for the right touch."  As they discussed potential renovations, the atmosphere shifted. Ideas flowed freely, & Evelyn felt a spark of connection with David.   Evelyn, now officially the owner of 3 Viking Green, began the transformation.  One crisp fall evening, as the sun set over the yard, Evelyn stood with David, sipping cider beside the fire pit...David smiled, his eyes reflecting the glow. "We've created something beautiful" he said, " & it all started with a dream at 3 Viking Green!" Sold As-Is.

The privacy afforded by the lush surroundings creates a peaceful & romantic retreat from it all.One of the property's enticing aspects is its unbeatable location, an easy walk to down town Westport .This rare antique gem is a canvas awaiting your personal touch. listings.remarks: This charming home is situated within the Downtown North neighborhood. This Westport home sits on a 0.29-acre lot and 2,241 square feet of living space. This well-loved, beautifully maintained home will steal your heart. The spacious rooms boast lovely windows and gleaming wood floors. Custom-built cabinets and bookshelves add charm throughout. A wonderful deck overlooks the flat, private property, perfect for enjoying the tranquil surroundings. The home features attractive accents on the exterior while maximizing space and inviting light and bright natural elements inside, with a primary bedroom on the upper floor. This colonial home is in pristine condition. The standout feature is the large, updated kitchen, which boasts ample counter space and modern appliances, making meal preparation effortless. Conveniently located within walking distance of Main Street and close to schools, Compo Beach, and the train station. Enjoy easy access to the vibrant downtown scene, featuring amazing shopping and dining experiences in downtown Westport, as well as proximity to the YMCA and Merritt Parkway, making this an ideal location. Don't miss your chance to make this wonderful home your own!

Your chance to live on one the best streets in Westport. Set among the highest priced homes in town, this charming farmhouse offers plenty of options. Walk to either Southport or Burying Hill beaches and enjoy the sunset next to Sasco Creek Pond. The house is an eclectic mix of old and new. The original circa 1900 Farmhouse has been graced with a more contemporary 1980's addition offering wonderful views over Sasco Creek Pond. The house features an open family room and living room with doors out to elevated deck. The primary is on the lower level with walkout to the backyard. Secluded and private yet convenient to multiple town centers and train stations. Enjoy as a weekend retreat or renovate/expand to make your full-time home. Here you get all that Beachside Avenue is famous for but at a price not often seen.

For over 100 years, 25 Soundview Drive has been owned by one family and has served as a sanctuary for summer celebrations, cozy winter weekends and endless beach days spilling from the front door right out to the sand. The 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath home has 3,492 sq ft of living space with direct water views on all three floors. On the main floor, the living and dining rooms span the front of the home with walls of windows and lead directly into the kitchen and bar areas. In addition you'll find a bedroom suite, laundry room and powder room. On the second floor, the primary bedroom is front facing to take in the 180 degree water views, it includes a sitting area with a bay window, a custom walk-in closet, and large bath with separate shower and soaking tub. There are two additional bedrooms and a hall bath before leading up to the third floor. A spacious flexible space with full bath graces the top floor - there is a balcony overlooking Compo Beach, tons of space (with gorgeous original woodwork) for work, play or additional bedroom usage. The landscaped private backyard is rare at Compo Beach. There is a two car detached garage, private driveway and of course, a coveted Soundview front yard enclosed by a stone wall, sweet front gate and dozens of hydrangea bushes that bloom brightly through the sunny New England summers. * Renovations by architect Robert Gault. Recent updates: house & garage roofs, exterior paint, appliances,gutters,gas conversion, AC & Water Heater, 3rd fl deck.

listings.remarks: Nestled in the heart of Westport, 495 Main Street offers an amazing opportunity for those looking to move in, add on or build new in a prime location. Lovingly cared for by the same family for over 60 years, this home is situated in one of Connecticut's most sought-after coastal towns, known for its scenic landscapes, vibrant arts scene, and top-tier amenities. Westport is celebrated for its picturesque beaches and its proximity to New York City, making it an ideal location for commuters seeking a tranquil yet convenient lifestyle. The layout of this home provides generous living space on one level. Each room has ample natural light adding an inviting warmth to a well loved home. Boasting 3 bedrooms, a well sized eat-in-kitchen for entertaining and a spacious living room which opens to a sunroom that overlooks the perfectly level yard. 495 Main Street offers a unique opportunity to enjoy all that the area has to offer. A beautiful home in an unbeatable location! Don't miss your chance to own a piece of Westport's charm.

This is the one! Welcome to 3 Mystic Lane, a home that exudes charm and many of the high-end updates you desire. Set privately at the end of a small cul-de-sac, the 2+ acre setting with footbridge over a tiny stream displays beautiful perennial gardens, flat yard for play, garden shed, deck, and pool with patio. Come inside and you will love the light and bright spaciousness in the public rooms. The oversized Living Room has a fireplace and opens to the Dining Room. The Family Room is cozy with another fireplace and French doors to the Sun Room with 1/2 bath and doors to the deck. The eat-in kitchen is renovated beautifully with high-end appliances and walk-in pantry. There are 3 Bedrooms on the main floor and 2 beautifully renovated full baths. One of the bedrooms has been converted to an office with bookshelves. Upstairs there are 2 additional bedrooms, a full bath, and large attic storage space. The basement is enormous boasting a cedar closet and unfinished space galore. This home won't disappoint! Look forward to seeing you!

This exceptional home spans 1.01 acres in the heart of Westport. Open Floorplan is a ideal layout for everyday living and convenience. Enhancements include tasteful bathroom renos, re-stained flooring, and new paint brightening interior and exterior. 10 FT ceilings and abundant natural light create inviting spaces w/ views of pool, deck & lawn. 1st FL features a stunning kitchen equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and a 12-FT marble-topped island, which seamlessly connects to a cozy family room with FPL and dining room adorned with vintage wine cabinet. Barn doors lead to office designed for optimal privacy. Addt'l room can be transformed into another bedroom, office, or playroom. A secondary informal entryway provides versatile options for first-floor usage. 2nd level comprises 4 bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with FPL, sitting area, two expansive walk-in closets, and a completely renovated primary bath. 4th bedroom could also be a den/media room for luxurious family movie nights. Upper level has possibilities for a playroom/guest suite. Finished lower level includes walk-out, gym/play area, & potential in-law suite complete w/ a kitchenette, bedroom, & full bath. Serene outdoor space features gunite pool, patio area perfect for grilling and sunbathing, and a large deck with a shaded pergola. Addt'l features include custom 2-car garage configuration, generator, and professional landscaping w/ irrigation. Mins to Downtown, Beach, Train, I-95 and Merritt.

If you've been searching for an opportunity for a maintenance-free lifestyle in one of Westport's most desirable communities, 137 Lansdowne might just be the home you've been waiting for! This 2 bed, 2.5 bath residence offers 2100 of living space. Located in the coveted Lansdowne Community, you'll enjoy breathtaking surroundings, top-tier amenities, & an unbeatable location near shopping, schools, and commuter routes. The home's thoughtful layout is designed for both entertaining & everyday living. The large living room is perfect for gathering & features a fireplace that adds a touch of warmth & charm. There is a formal dining room & for those who need a work space, the office/sunroom is an absolute highlight; bathed in sunlight with views of the backyard & patio. The oversized eat-in kitchen is a true gem, complete with hardwood floors & a brick wood-burning fireplace. Whether you're preparing a casual meal or entertaining guests, the kitchen offers plenty of counter space & cabinets to suit all your needs. Upstairs, you'll find the primary bedroom suite which features a spacious bathroom with both a jacuzzi tub & a separate shower stall. The 2nd bedroom offers a walk-in closet & a large dressing room/storage area. Living in Lansdowne means you'll have access to a wide range of amenities designed for relaxation & recreation. A short walk from your front door is the gazebo, walking paths, pool & tennis/pickleball court. Quarterly District Tax of $1578.25

listings.remarks: Welcome to 14 D Cross Highway, a hidden gem nestled in the charming enclave of Westport Village, one of Westport's best-kept secrets. This home offers a unique blend of style and sophistication, perfect for those seeking a modern and elegant lifestyle. This exquisite 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence spans 1,200 square feet and is truly turnkey. Step inside to discover a beautifully updated kitchen with Carrara marble counters all complete with modern appliances. The open-concept living area is enhanced by vaulted ceilings and a cozy gas fireplace, creating an inviting atmosphere for relaxation and entertainment.  The home's character and charm are further accentuated by its thoughtful amenities gas heat and central air for year-round comfort. Conveniently located close to town yet secluded at the end of the private drive. This is truly the ideal oasis.

listings.remarks: Bring your curiosity and your imagination because you just don't see homes like this anymore! This is a hidden Old Hill surprise, a vintage country house built by the artist and illustrator, Karl Godwin, in 1920. Loaded with character and incredible potential, it now needs new owners. Unique custom details, including wavy edge cedar lap siding and impressive stonework welcome visitors on a beautifully landscaped 1.08 acre parcel, which also has room for a pool. Original floors, wooden beams and built-ins set you up for comfort in all four seasons. The property is being sold as is and was recently inspected by the sellers. Private well, oil heat, septic system and generator. Part cottage, part artist's studio, part bird- watcher's lair...this one is incredibly special. An amazing travel-back-in-time experience or a perfect weekend escape with easy access to downtown and all Westport amenities.

listings.remarks: Live in the highly coveted Compo Beach community! This home is a 5 minute walk to Compo Beach, and a 5-10 minute drive to restaurants, train, etc! Built in 2006, this Nantucket shingle-style home sits on an oversized, uniquely private lot, boasting over $700,000 in additional upgrades including oak custom cabinetry, bar, closets and millwork, exterior mahogany railings and shutters, Italian glass and marble details, limestone and shell/pebble kitchen counters, brand new roof, Control 4 TV/Audio system, central vac, new HVAC system, family room fireplace, garage built-ins, electric and alarm upgrades, additional kitchen cabinetry, irrigation, landscape and much more! An abundance of trees and shrubs define this home's ultimate coastal garden, offering a lush, serene backdrop for indoor/outdoor living. It's designed for ease and privacy in a lively beach community. The open floor plan layout offers both an entertainment space of living room and lounge and a family space with gourmet eat-in kitchen and family room. Both areas have a half bath. Dining area and mudroom/pantry complete the first floor. On the 2nd level, the luxurious master wing includes a vaulted bedroom with fireplace, walk-in custom oak closet, entry area with oak closets/cabinets, bath, private office (or nursery, etc) and small walk-out balcony overlooking the property. Another multi-purpose wing includes 2 bedrooms en suite, and a vaulted den/bedroom with bath access.

Stunning New Construction in Sought-After Greens Farms:Discover the pinnacle of modern living in this exquisitely crafted new construction home, offering 5 spacious ensuite bedrooms and an elegant blend of contemporary design and timeless craftsmanship. Thoughtfully designed with high ceilings, abundant natural light, and impeccable finishes throughout, this home is a true sanctuary of comfort and sophistication.The expansive chef's kitchen, featuring top-of-the-line appliances and a generous island, seamlessly flows into a spacious family room with built-ins and gas fireplace, creating the perfect space for gathering and entertaining. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite is a private retreat, complete with a spa-like bath and custom walk-in closet. The third floor provides additional space for play or relaxation as well as a home office or the option for a 6th bedroom. The lower level hosts another spacious relaxation area, a gym or den and a full guest suite with walk-in closet and full bathroom. The spacious mudroom is conveniently located at the garage entrance, tucked away from the living spaces. Enjoy easy indoor-outdoor living with a private fully fenced-in yard - a perfect backdrop for relaxation and entertaining. Located in this prime neighborhood with easy access to three beaches, top-rated schools, shops, and dining, this home provides both luxury and convenience. A rare opportunity to own a truly exceptional new home.

30 Park Lane is more than just a home; it's a uniquely charming retreat where you can enjoy the best of both worlds - a peaceful, nature-filled setting with easy access to all the amenities and conveniences of town living as well as being only 5 minutes from Compo Beach. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by a warm and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Large windows bathe rooms in natural light and provide picturesque views of lush surroundings. A spacious, newly renovated deck serves as an ideal spot for alfresco dining or relaxing with a good book. The primary bedroom is a peaceful retreat with ample closet space and a serene ambiance. Three additional bedrooms provide plenty of space for guests, a home office, or a creative studio.  Please see Agent Only Remarks.

Welcome to your dream home in the Prime location of the picturesque area of Saugatuck in Westport! This exquisite 6-bedroom, 5.5-bath residence is the perfect blend of luxury and comfort, nestled in a serene neighborhood just moments from Compo Beach, charming local shops, and a short walk to the Westport Train station. Enjoy over 5200 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space with an open floor plan that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas. The heart of the home, the kitchen features high-end Thermador appliances, Carrara marble countertops, a large island, Oversized Farm sink and custom cabinetry-perfect for both casual dining and entertaining. Six generously sized bedrooms, including a stunning zen-like primary suite and en-suite bath, walk-in closet with built-ins and center island, and a gas fireplace. Down the hall from the primary suite are three additional bedrooms, one with an en-suite bathroom and two connected by a Jack & Jill, and a well-appointed laundry room with Electrolux washer/dryer. Step outside to your private backyard retreat, complete with a spacious bluestone patio, beautifully landscaped gardens, and spa-like pool, perfect for creating quiet vacation-like moments or for outdoor entertaining. The Home also has a fully finished basement with gym, Full bath, bedroom, media room and storage. Fully finished third floor w 9ft ceilings, bedroom and Full bath.

listings.remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 3-bath condominium in the highly sought-after Harvest Commons community of Westport, CT. This home provides the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and convenience. The bright, open floor plan features soaring ceilings and oversized windows, filling every room with natural light. The spacious living room boasts a gas fireplace and sliders that lead to a private patio, perfect for entertaining or relaxation. The stylish eat-in kitchen includes granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. There is a light, bright dining room with direct access to a private courtyard for al fresco dining - perfect for entertaining. The main level primary suite with vaulted ceilings, double California closets, & a spa-like ensuite bath is truly a sanctuary. The first floor also features even more flexibility with a second bedroom with built-in Murphy Bed, second full bath, and ample storage. Additional conveniences include a separate laundry area, and attached, direct entry two-car garage. The partially finished lower level features a family room, third full bath, and additional, versatile living space perfect as an office or den. A rare, whole house generator offers added security. Harvest Commons features a heated pool, two tennis courts, & a clubhouse with lush, professionally landscaped grounds. Ideally located just minutes from downtown, beaches, and train station, this exceptional property offers tranquil living in the heart of Westport.
