listings.remarks: With this home, you don't have to compromise on anything! This sophisticated 4-year home, built in 2019, is solid and settled, and situated in the Compo Beach neighborhood. Truly better than new, it's exceptional quality and the perfect escape, while still reading like a brand-new home. FEMA-compliant. Just steps from the beach, it blends with coastal living, a true lifestyle choice. Enjoy morning beach walks and or an evening walk after dinner. The living area flows seamlessly into the outdoors, with an open layout, ideal for relaxation and gatherings. Featuring accents on the exterior, the home maximizes space and invites natural light inside, creating a harmonious connection between indoors and outdoors. The light, bright, and spacious open kitchen and dining room are perfect for entertaining, with the gourmet kitchen featuring top-of-the-line appliances. The flexible floor plan has versatile spaces, including a detached area ideal for an office, gym, playroom, or party space-adaptable to suit any need. The second floor includes a primary bedroom with a vaulted ceiling, a stucco, a spa bath, a fireplace, and two walk-in closets along with two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and laundry. The third floor features a loft bedroom, staged as an office, with a full bath, offering the potential for a 4th bedroom, 2nd office, gym, guest, or playroom. Close to the train station, Longshore, and Westport amenities!

Situated on a private, serene acre on a quiet cul-de-sac, this expansive 5,655 SF w/10' ceilings residence masterfully blends modern updates with timeless sophistication.Upon entering, you are greeted by a dramatic staircase in the foyer that leads to an inviting Family Room, offering a warm atmosphere w/abundant natural light-ideal for both relaxation & entertaining.This home boasts a meticulously renovated Primary Suite w/ a state-of-the-art, gutted & reimagined Primary Bathroom, featuring exquisite finishes. Stylish updates including Schumacher and Thibault wallpaper add an extra layer of elegance in the Dining Room and renovated Powder Room,while updates continue with a new Roof, (2021) updated HVAC System & natural gas hookup for added convenience. The Gourmet Kitchen with new backsplash, equipped with a Sub-Zero refrigerator, flows seamlessly into the living areas, perfect for hosting gatherings. The 2nd floor features 4 BR's and an option to add more on the 3rd level which currently features a private gym. There is a dedicated office, ensuring the utmost in comfort & functionality.Further enhancing the property, an Aladdin lift system is installed to effortlessly raise & lower the chandelier in the entryway, adding a touch of ease and grandeur. The 3-car garage has ample storage, and the impressive grounds provide a beautiful setting for outdoor living. Room for a pool.

Crafted by Tomas Brothers Builders, 27 Narrow Rocks is a modern masterpiece on 1.86 acres. This newly built estate offers 7 bedrooms, 8 full baths, and 2 half baths across four levels, including a walkout lower level. The home features 10-ft ceilings, oversized windows, and a grand foyer with triple glass doors and a two-story oak staircase. Everywhere you look, there's a captivating moment-this home is next-level living.  Designed for effortless living, the home showcases uniquely crafted ceilings designs, a Venetian plaster fireplace, and an entertainer's wet bar off the living room. The chef's kitchen stuns with taupe cabinetry, Taj Mahal Quartzite counters, a 10-ft waterfall island, Wolf & Sub-Zero appliances, and a walk-in pantry.  The grand primary suite features breakfast bar, vaulted ceilings, fireplace, double walk-in closet, dressing room, and a spa-like bath with a seamless 5x8 shower, soaking tub, and radiant heated floors.  The 2,200 sq. ft. walk-out lower level garden level offers a great room, bedroom, fitness room, wet bar, media room, and cabana bath with washer/dryer and pool access.  Outdoor highlights include a heated gunite pool, retractable safety cover, paver patio, and 16-ft outdoor kitchen. A three-car heated garage, EV charging, whole-house generator, and elevator-ready design complete this stunning home.    Once you see it, how could you go back to the ordinary?

Expected for completion in mid-spring 2025, this new construction by the esteemed Johnny Schwartz of Sam Development is situated on a highly sought-after cul-de-sac in Long Lots. This 5/6 bedroom, 6.5-bath residence will combine thoughtful design, exceptional craftsmanship, & modern luxury across four beautifully finished floors. This open-concept home is designed to impress, with generously proportioned living spaces perfect for today's lifestyle. Expansive windows will bathe the interiors in natural light, & premium finishes have been carefully selected to create an environment of refined elegance. The chef's kitchen will feature Thermador appliances, custom cabinetry, & a large center island, flowing seamlessly into the living and dining areas. The walk-out lower level will offer flexible spaces for recreation, fitness, or entertaining, while the upper floors will provide private retreats for rest and relaxation. The primary suite will be a haven of luxury, complete with a spa-like bath & custom walk-in closet. Step outside to your private oasis, where a 15 x 30 pool will serve as the centerpiece of a backyard designed for relaxation & play. Whether enjoying quiet mornings on the patio or hosting summer gatherings, this outdoor space will elevate your lifestyle. Located in the desirable Long Lots neighborhood, 6 Morningside Lane offers proximity to Westport's top-rated schools, vibrant downtown area, stunning beaches, and all the amenities that make this town special.

Elegant MOVE IN ready, this 2012-built classic colonial is fully dialed in and ready for your next chapter.  Set right in the lively heart of Westport, you're moments from crave-worthy restaurants, stylish boutiques, sun-soaked beaches, and easy commutes via train or highway.  Inside, the vibe is open, bright, and built for connection. The first floor flows like a conversation-seamless, social, and spacious enough to host anything from impromptu dinner parties to milestone celebrations. The chef's kitchen is both centerpiece and workhorse, anchoring five oversized bedrooms and five bathrooms, including a primary suite that feels like its own getaway.   Downstairs? Think beyond storage-create a gym that actually inspires you, a media room that becomes movie-night legend, or a pool lounge to unwind in style (with a full bathroom, no less). And the third floor? Whether you're dreaming of a peaceful yoga studio, a light-filled art sanctuary, or the kind of office that fuels deep focus, you've got the space to make it real.   This home isn't just move-in ready-it's life-ready. The only thing missing is you.

Remodeled Vintage Cottage at Saugatuck Shores. Live the beach life in this beautifully remodeled vintage cottage, perfectly nestled in the sought-after Saugatuck Shores neighborhood. Just a short stroll to the sandy shore, enjoy swimming, kayaking, sailing steps from your doorstep. This inviting home welcomes you with a delightful screened front porch to relax with morning coffee while taking in breathtaking water views of Saugatuck Harbor. Watch the sunrise over the water and feel the tranquility of coastal living. A thoughtfully designed open floor plan offers a surprisingly spacious living area perfect for gathering and entertaining. The dining space with access to the renovated rear deck is framed by windows overlooking the yard with new fencing for complete privacy. Built-in open shelving adds charm and functionality. The remodeled kitchen boasts granite countertops, a breakfast bar, classic white subway tile backsplashes, and newer appliances, making it a dream for any home chef. The 1st floor full bath has also been updated and features white mosaic tile flooring. Upstairs, 3 comfortable bedrooms provide a peaceful retreat. A nearby half bath offers room for expansion if needed. Energy-efficient windows, a new hot water heater, freshly painted and new fencing add to the home's modern comforts while preserving its vintage charm. Embrace the Saugatuck Shores lifestyle where every day feels like a getaway. Minutes to the Westport train station, fine dining, shops & more

LOCATION!!! This new listing is located in the center of Westport on a quiet street in a walkable neighborhood. This house is sited on over an acre with mature trees creating privacy in the rear yard. Convenient to shopping, trains, and schools, this spacious home offers versatility on 3 levels w/an open layout. Huge windows expose tremendous natural light and give a modern feel. An oversized family room with a vaulted ceiling & a floor to ceiling stone fireplace is the heart of the house. The soaring ceilings in this space are a show stopper.  With 6 bedrooms this house offers flexibility with many options for work from home, long term visiting guests and entertaining. Walk-out lower level includes a playroom, as well as a bedroom and full bath. Huge front yard and ample parking, this home is not to be missed.

Custom-built in 2023 & set at the end of a desirable Long Lots cul-de-sac in Westport, this Modern Colonial filled w/high end features not found in a spec home offers over 6,000 sqft across 4 finished levels. Designed for today's lifestyle, the open floor plan features a custom kitchen w/high end appliances, 2 islands, & walk-in pantry which flows seamlessly into the large dining room & spacious family room. The dining room, which can accommodate both intimate & large gatherings, offers a full wine fridge & wet bar area w/custom cabinetry. The family room w/custom built-in cabinetry, gas fireplace, & full access to the pool & outdoor entertaining spaces for harmonious indoor/outdoor living. The primary suite offers a vaulted ceiling, gas fireplace, dual walk-in closets, & a spa-like bath w/heated floors creating an oasis for rest & relaxation. Three additional bedrooms, custom built-in workstation & laundry complete the second floor. The third floor designed as a possible 6th bedroom option w/walk-in closet & full bath would also make an excellent bonus room or even second office. The finished walk-out lower level features a sun filled bedroom, full bath, spacious family room space, & gym w/dry bar. The private, fully fenced yard is meticulously landscaped creating an ideal place to relax by the saltwater pool & spa, cook in the outdoor kitchen, or relax on the patio with automatic screens. Minutes from schools, commuting, & shopping make this a home not to be missed.

PRESENT OFFERS BY 6:00 PM MONDAY 4/7. Gaze at the Saugatuck River from your covered front porch or take a leisurely stroll into downtown Westport from this updated and much loved circa 1911 "Ennis House". This 5 Bedroom, 3.5 Bath Colonial offers three finished floors with original vintage details, such as beautifully crafted woodwork, restored lighting fixtures, decorative leaded windows and a wood-burning fireplace with glass tile insets. The recently renovated Kitchen, with quartz center island, opens to the well-proportioned, light-filled Living and Dining Rooms. The Family Room, with private entrance, can serve as an Office or Exercise Area. The charming 2nd level has 4 lovely Bedrooms and 2 updated Baths. The spacious finished 3rd level features a 5th Bedroom /Flex Space and full Bath. Other recent improvements are conversion from oil to propane heat, with a new boiler recently installed, updated electrical and many loving touches. Enjoy this wonderful, conveniently located home and all that Westport has to offer.

Refined living awaits on Boxwood Lane, a prime Hunt Club cul-de-sac featuring tranquil private entrances to stately colonial style homes. From its cobblestone-lined, semi-circular driveway to the backyard pool and bluestone patio oasis, the grounds of 5 Boxwood Lane are simply spectacular. The home itself stands apart, meticulously designed with exquisite details and custom amenities. Four levels, soaring ceilings, and a thoughtful layout offer spectacular living and entertaining spaces. Discover the newly styled gourmet kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances, custom cabinetry, and a generous island. It flows easily to the outdoor living areas, or into the great room with coffered ceiling and stone fireplace. Fireplaces add character and warmth to the already luxurious living room, dining room and home office. The upper levels reveal a sprawling primary suite with two ensuite bathrooms, walk-in closets, and an office/relaxation niche. Four additional bedrooms with bathrooms ensure privacy. Two separate sections of the home includes a great room + ensuite bedroom - a perfect refuge for guest or long-term visitors. The lower level is the ultimate "hang-out space" - an expansive recreational area for games and movie nights. It has been said, with stunning perennial gardens, velvety lawns, and a blissful poolside retreat featuring a charming cabana, the outdoors are hard to beat at 5 Boxwood Lane! Convenient to schools, transportation and all of Westport wonderful amenities.

This spectacular architect designed 5 Bedroom, 4 full Bath Contemporary is beautifully sited on an extraordinary and private 1.3 acre property with Pond, and just minutes to all of Westport's fabulous amenities and train Service to NYC. Tasteful renovations throughout 3700 square feet of living space offer dramatic, sun-filled interiors, Dining Room overlooking step-down Living Room with soaring ceiling, Fireplace, and access to expansive Deck, Office opening onto Screened Porch, Chef's Kitchen with Dining Area, private Primary Suite, Walk-out Lower Level with very versatile Great Room with Fireplace, Bedroom and Bath, an immaculate attached over-size Two-Car Garage with generous storage, and a Whole House Generator. First Floor: Foyer with random-width oak flooring, Guest Closet and access to Over-size attached Two-Car Garage. Dining Room with random-width oak flooring overlooking Step-down Living Room with random-width oak flooring, gas-log Fireplace, 2-story ceiling with Fan and Track Lighting, and twin Sliding Doors to expansive Deck. Chef's Kitchen with 12' ceilings and Skylight, oak flooring, Center Island Cook-top, timeless laminate Cabinetry, semi-circular Dining Area with wainscoting, and Built-in Desk. Wonderful Office/Bedroom with oak flooring, built-in Bookcases and Cabinetry, and sliding door to delightful Screened Porch. Full Hall Bath with oak flooring. Second Floor: Laundry Room with tile flooring. Bedroom with oak flooring.  PLEASE OPEN ADDENDUM.

Stunning Custom Built Colonial by Chris Montanaro of Redcoat Homes. Designed by Renowned Architect, Judith Larson. This Home Exudes Sophistication, every detail has been meticulously crafted to offer extraordinary living experience on a 1.10 flat manicured acre. Over 8,000 SQ FT w 8-inch wide plank wht oak floors throughout. 1st FL features a Chef's dream kitchen, generous Dining & Family room that share a dual fireplace, spectacular movie theater, 2 Private Offices. The 2nd FL features a Lg primary suite w a spa inspired bath w luxurious heated floors, a separate guest suite,4 additional bedrooms all ensuite in total. listings.remarks: Located just 1 mile from Compo Beach, 32 Valley Road is a serene and secluded oasis in one of Westport's most desirable neighborhoods. This beautifully restored 1900 Colonial farmhouse seamlessly blends historic charm with modern upgrades, including a new HVAC system with central AC, city water and sewer. The sun drenched 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home spans 1500 square feet on a .79 acre lot. A separate 242 square foot heated office or playroom features cathedral ceilings and woodland views. The chef's kitchen includes stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, cathedral ceiling and a reverse osmosis water filtration system while steps away French doors in the dining room allow natural light to flood in. The front to back family room boasts new hardwood floors and the living room offers floor-to-ceiling bookshelves and a wood-burning fireplace. The main level primary ensuite features a vaulted ceiling, abundant windows, and direct access to the back patio. The upper level includes two charming bedrooms and a full bathroom. Minutes from town, Metro North, I-95, award-winning restaurants, and Westport's top-rated schools, 32 Valley Road is perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat or a home ideal for entertaining.

Conveniently located just 1.2 miles from the Saugatuck train station and downtown Westport, and under 2 miles from Longshore Club Park and Compo Beach, this home offers a unique opportunity to enjoy comfort, space, and location in one of Westport's most sought-after areas.

listings.remarks: Welcome to 30 Easton Road, a beautifully renovated and meticulously maintained home set on a flat and private 1.24-acre lot in the heart of Westport. This stylish home seamlessly blends classic charm with modern updates, offering the perfect retreat for today's lifestyle.  Step into the home and be greeted by expansive, open-concept living and dining areas. The chef's kitchen, with modern appliances, a breakfast counter and dining nook leads to the back deck. A perfect set-up for indoor-outdoor dining. The adjacent family room is bright and inviting, with cathedral ceiling and views of the backyard and pool. The bedrooms are spacious and the bathrooms have all been updated, offering lovely private spaces for family and guests. Take your choice as there are primary suites on the main floor and the second level. A bonus recreation room and home gym provide even more options to spread out, relax and stay fit. The gorgeous, professionally landscaped grounds offer mature plantings for privacy and a sparkling in ground pool, for summer entertaining and relaxing weekends. Flat, usable yard is perfect for play, gardening, or gatherings. The roof and driveway are both new. Located just minutes to Westport's vibrant downtown, shopping, dining, and cultural attractions. Move right in and enjoy the best of Westport living in this turnkey home with timeless character and every modern amenity. Schedule your private tour today!

Welcome to this sun-filled Colonial in the heart of Westport! This beautifully updated 4-bedroom home offers the perfect blend of classic charm and modern convenience. Enjoy peace of mind with city water, city sewer, a generator, and an outdoor sprinkler system. Inside, an expanded Kitchen and Family Room create a bright, open-concept, ideal for everyday living and entertaining. A spacious Screened Porch invites indoor-outdoor enjoyment, while the Mudroom adds functionality and ease of entry from the garage. Upstairs, the freshly added Jack & Jill bath offers smart convenience for busy mornings. A flexible main-level office with an adjacent full Bath can easily convert to a first-floor Bedroom-perfect for guests or multi-generational living. There is even additional open finished space in the lower level for a playroom. Located in a sought-after Westport neighborhood close to town, schools, and commuting options, this home checks every box for comfort, space, and style.
Nestled on a secluded cul-de-sac just off Hogan Trail, this peaceful residence sits on a spacious 0.45-acre plot.

This better than new modern farmhouse nestled on 1.28 acres is a masterpiece of architectural design and sophistication and just steps from the beach, train, and shopping. Every detail of this 6,000 SF 5 Bedroom home has been meticulously curated, from the high-end materials to the advanced technology offering a modern, refined aesthetic to deliver unparalleled comfort. The double-height entry leads to open, light filled interiors, featuring expansive glass walls that seamlessly blend indoor & outdoor living. Stunning spaces on the main floor exceed every expectation, especially the Great Room with its cathedral ceiling and walls of glass that infuse the space with a sense of calm. The Kitchen is a sleek and modern central space with an oversized show-stopping marble island. An adjoining Butler's Pantry is equally well-equipped. A chic Dining Room, two stylish Bedrooms and Laundry complete the floor. A Zen-like Primary Suite anchors upstairs with a spa-like Bath, custom walk-in closets, additional ensuite Bedroom, Den, flexible Rec space and half Bath. A Lounge area and Bedroom/Home Office above has expansive views. Downstairs includes a Bedroom, Playroom, Gym, and Mudroom. Complementing the exceptionally chic and ethereal vibe within, the professionally landscaped exterior features a hot tub, outdoor loggia, and entertainment areas, perfect for enjoying the serene surroundings. Mature trees, manicured lawns, and stunning views complete this idyllic property.

Built by Mattera Construction and tastefully updated throughout by the current owner, this home exemplifies timeless design, top of the line craftsmanship, and features stunning custom details as well as extensive upgrades throughout. Perfectly sited on a professionally landscaped acre down a private lane in the heart of Westport, this spectacular property offers an ideal location combining both privacy and convenience. The first floor is open and bright and is highlighted by its updated gourmet kitchen w/ large center island, top of the line appliances, & large pantry. A spacious family room w/stone FP ,well appointed formal areas, paneled office w/coffered ceilings & built ins and sizeable mudroom complete this level. The second-floor features 5 en suite bedrooms ,including a serene primary suite complete w/fireplace, 2 closets & Luxurious new primary bath featuring heated floors and soaking tub. The Finished 3rd floor media space offers so many options. The walk out lower level offers an additional family room, 1000 bottle wine cellar, rec space, 1/2 bath & gym. Over 8800 SF of finished space overlooking a stunning outdoor space perfect for entertaining w/ mature plantings, expansive blue stone patios, outdoor kitchen & fireplace, gunite pool, spa & full property irrigation. Addl upgrades include control4 smart home, audio, golf simulator, heated 3 car garage, newer mechanicals and much more. Modern luxury meets flawless design to create a home for a lifetime!

Welcome to 6 Weathervane Hill, a 4,196 sq ft sun-drenched home on over a private acre in a quiet cul-de-sac. Enjoy a versatile floor plan ideal for modern living. This classic colonial features a formal living and dining room, bright white kitchen, and cozy family room with a stone fireplace. The sunroom/playroom opens to a wraparound stone patio, Gunite pool. Upstairs are three spacious bedrooms, renovated baths, and a primary suite with a Romeo and Juliette balcony. The third floor offers a light filled den and/or office, perfect for guests. The basement has a recreation room or can be a private office with private entry. This home has been meticulously maintained over the years with MANY upgrades. It's conveniently located near town, transportation, beaches, and top-rated schools. Don't miss this "life-ready" home - it is special!

Live the ultimate Westport lifestyle from this serene hilltop retreat just 1700 feet from Main Street. Lounge by your private pool, surrounded by nature, then stroll into town for coffee, shopping, or dinner - all within minutes. It's the best of both worlds: peaceful seclusion with unbeatable convenience.  This expanded luxury Cape offers three finished levels with four official bedrooms plus a flexible fifth - ideal whether you're upsizing or downsizing. The main floor provides sought-after single-level living, featuring a spacious primary suite with a renovated full bath and walk-in closet.  Living spaces include a classic living room and den, along with a bright, airy open kitchen. The dramatic dining room - with its cathedral ceiling, skylight, fireplace, and French doors - opens to a high deck with sweeping views over the Saugatuck River valley.  The mudroom/laundry connects directly to the garage for added convenience. Upstairs, three generous bedrooms share a full bath off a balcony landing with a cozy sitting nook. The finished walk-out lower level offers endless flexibility - ideal for a gym, playroom, home office, or lounge - plus a fifth bedroom and third full bath.  The grounds feel like a private park, with a resort-style backyard complete with pool, spa-like decks, and lush landscaping. Quality construction, fine finishes, and excellent condition make this home a rare find just steps from downtown. [INTERIOR Photos Expected Friday 5/16]

Set in Greens Farms on the premier "Sherwood Farms" cul-de-sac of upscale homes with an Association pool and clubhouse, this Nantucket Shingle-style residence designed by prominent architect, Roger Ferris, is in excellent, move-in condition. Meticulously maintained, this 6-bedroom home offers thoughtful updates throughout the spacious floor plan. The gracious interior begins with a soaring double-height foyer, introducing the bright, well-appointed rooms. Hardwood flrs, high ceilings, large windows & many glass doors combine to create a refined atmosphere. LR w/1st fpl, double sets of doors to porch. DR offers space for large gatherings and steps out to a bluestone patio. Newer custom dine-in kitchen has soft close cabinetry, stone counters, stainless steel appls incl gas cooktop and an open flow to the sunny breakfast rm w/doors to both a porch & patio, and leads to the large fam rm w/2nd fpl & built-ins. Main level 6th BR or office has beautiful views across the level property. Remodeled half bath plus a mudroom leading to the oversized 2-car garage complete this level. A dramatic staircase leads to the open, sunny landing & 5 BRs on the 2nd level. Each BR is spacious & offers distinct architectural appeal, beginning w/a pair that share a Jack & Jill bath, and two lrg en-suite BRs. The grand primary suite will impress w/king-sized vltd ceil BR, sep gym or dressing rm, updated white marble bth w/dbl walk-in clsts. Massive LL offers incredible storage or potential rec space.

listings.remarks: Set at the end of a cul-de-sac in the desirable Compo South neighborhood, this lovely colonial home offers an ideal Westport location. Enjoy the view of the lush 0.57-acre lot from the charming screened-in porch. The perimeter is lined with spectacular mature perennials creating a private back yard oasis. Additional highlights include the trifecta of city water, city sewer, and natural gas. Need more living space? A second floor expansion over the garage is feasible. Conveniently located just 1.2 miles from the Saugatuck train station and downtown Westport, and under 2 miles from Longshore Club Park and Compo Beach, this home offers an affordable opportunity to live in one of Westport's most sought-after areas.

Welcome to 32 Narrow Rocks Road, an exceptional ranch-style home nestled in the highly desirable Compo Beach neighborhood of Westport, CT. This 1,883-square-foot residence sits on a generous 0.74-acre lot, with no wetlands, offering expansive outdoor space and endless possibilities. Located just steps from Longshore Golf Course, Compo Beach, and the train station, this home presents a unique opportunity for buyers ready to reimagine and upgrade a well-located property with classic charm and solid bones, while enjoying prime access to premier amenities and coastal living. Step inside to discover a spacious living room featuring a large fireplace and original custom-built hardwood floors that flow throughout the home. The updated kitchen balances function and style with pristine white cabinetry, granite countertops, and modern appliances, opening seamlessly into a cozy dining area. The primary suite boasts two closets and a fully renovated en-suite bath, while three additional bedrooms provide ample space and access to two additional full bathrooms. Enjoy relaxing and entertaining on the large screened porch that opens to a serene stone patio, ideal for outdoor gatherings or a peaceful retreat. With its ideal setting and generous lot, 32 Narrow Rocks Road invites your vision to transform it into a truly exceptional residence.

Welcome to this charming Colonial home in the desirable Old Hill neighborhood of Westport, CT. This 3,683 sq ft residence on a generous 0.95-acre lot blends classic character with modern convenience. The open layout connects living areas to the outdoors, creating an inviting space for relaxation and entertaining. The home boasts attractive exterior accents while maximizing space and inviting light and bright natural elements inside. Step into the backyard to enjoy a private pool with a Jacuzzi spa, surrounded by mature landscaping - ideal for summer gatherings or quiet evenings. The living room includes a cozy fireplace, perfect for family and friends. The layout also offers a spacious family room and formal dining area. The kitchen is equipped with modern appliances, including a wall oven, cooktop, microwave, refrigerator, and dishwasher.  The primary suite on the upper level includes a walk-in closet, and an additional office provides a great work-from-home space. The main level features a practical den for extra living space. The lot includes a porch and patio, offering plenty of room for outdoor enjoyment. Enjoy easy access to Westport's beaches, parks, shopping, dining, and train station, providing convenient commuting and lifestyle options. Enjoy the peaceful neighborhood and a true sense of community.  Discover your dream home at 9 Woodside Lane - where classic Colonial charm meets modern living in one of Westport's finest areas.

Welcome to 4 Heather Hill in Westport! This charming 4 bedroom, 1.5 bath Cape Cod-style home is ideally located on a private road right in the heart of Central Westport. Nestled on a serene quarter-acre lot that is bordered in the rear by a classic stone wall, this property offers both privacy and promise. This home awaits your personal touches and updates. Several key improvements have already been made, including 200 amp electrical service, newer hot water heater and oil tank, roof and gutters replaced less than 5 years ago with a 50 year transferrable warranty, a new stove, range hood and a dishwasher that are less than 2 years old. With ideal proximity to the train, beaches and shopping, Westport living awaits you!

Welcome to 29 Salem Road, where modern design and timeless elegance converge in a home that makes one-floor living effortless. Completely renovated to the highest standards, this light-filled residence is designed for comfort, flow, and connection. Walls of glass bathe the interiors in natural light, while soaring ceilings enhance the sense of openness throughout. At the heart of the home, the chef's kitchen boasts quartz counters, dual oversized islands-one for prep and one for casual dining-custom cabinetry, and top-tier appliances, creating a hub for both everyday living and entertaining. The adjoining living and dining rooms, anchored by a dramatic two-story fireplace, provide seamless spaces for formal or informal gatherings. The sunroom, wrapped in windows, frames serene views of the pool, stone patio, and lush landscape-an ideal spot for year-round relaxation-while the cozy den offers a more intimate retreat for quiet evenings. The bedroom wing ensures privacy and convenience, featuring a stunning new primary suite with spa-like bath and walk-in closet, plus two additional bedrooms with a shared full bath. A separate wing with bedroom, bath, and flexible living area offers endless options: home office, gym, in-law suite or guest quarters. Set on a cul-de-sac in coveted Lower Weston, just minutes from schools and the town center, this property blends the ease of single level living with style, sophistication and an ideal location.

AMAZING NEW CONSTRUCTION! Located in the heart of Westport, The Gables of Westport presents a collection of eight townhomes and five flats, blending sophisticated design with the ease of in-town living. Enjoy close proximity to Metro-North, major highways, Longshore Club & Park, Compo Beach, Levitt Pavilion, Westport Country Playhouse, fine dining, shopping, and entertainment. Crafted by local renowned builder RPM Home Inc., these residences showcase open floor plans and premium finishes: Bertazzoni appliances, Grohe fixtures, custom cabinetry, quartz and marble countertops, 6" white oak flooring, and elegant trim selections. This nearly completed residential flat provides the best of single-floor living, filled with natural light from expansive Marvin windows. The open floor plan seamlessly connects the living room, kitchen, and dining area. Set within a private enclave tucked away from Post Road, the community is surrounded by lush native landscaping and green spaces. Elevator option available. HOA estimated at $500-$600/month. Real Estate Taxes are to be determined.

listings.remarks: A Greens Farms Opportunity with Character and Possibility Set in the heart of sought-after Greens Farms, this charming home offers both comfort today and exciting possibilities for tomorrow. With its Cape-to-Colonial design, the home combines character with a flexible layout-featuring two bedrooms on the main level and two upstairs. One of the spacious second-floor bedrooms could easily serve as a den, office, or media room, adapting to your lifestyle needs. The sun-filled living area is anchored by a newer kitchen, open to the living room for a modern, welcoming feel-perfect for gatherings and everyday living. Outdoors, the level .34-acre lot provides a peaceful setting with space to enjoy. Rarely does a home in Greens Farms come to market at such an approachable price point. Whether you're drawn by the neighborhood or the flexible spaces, this home is a true find in one of Westport's most desirable communities.

Incredible opportunity to own a coastal retreat with sweeping water views of Saugatuck Harbor and beyond. This sun-drenched home is perfectly positioned to capture the beauty of seaside living, offering both tranquility and convenience in one of Westport's most desirable locations. With deeded water rights included, you can enjoy direct access to the shoreline, making it ideal for boating, kayaking, or simply savoring the peaceful waterfront setting. Step inside to find an open floor plan designed for both comfort and entertaining. The interior is flooded with natural light that frame the captivating water vistas, creating a seamless connection between the indoors and outdoors. The main living areas flow effortlessly, allowing gatherings to feel open and inviting, while the patio just outside is perfect for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or evenings spent soaking in the cool sea breeze. Westport is known for its stunning coastline, and this property fully embraces that lifestyle. Breathe in the salt air, watch the sailboats drift by, and immerse yourself in the calming rhythm of the water. Beyond the home itself, the location offers unmatched convenience just minutes to vibrant downtown Westport, the train for easy commuting, and an abundance of shopping and dining options. For recreation, Longshore Park, Compo Beach, and golf and tennis facilities are all within close reach, ensuring a year-round resort-style experience.

listings.remarks: Classic Greens Farms Colonial - Timeless Elegance Meets Modern Comfort ~ Nestled in one of Westport's most desirable neighborhoods, this beautifully updated Center Hall Colonial offers the perfect blend of timeless charm and modern luxury. Ideally located just minutes from Sherwood Island State Park-with its miles of golden sand beaches, scenic picnic areas, and sweeping views-this home provides easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and downtown Westport. Set on a picturesque property with a gentle brook at the far end of the level backyard, the home invites peaceful outdoor living with a charming front porch & back porch, expansive deck, and stone patio-ideal for al fresco dining and entertaining. Inside, a gracious two-story foyer with a curved staircase opens to a formal living room with fireplace and a formal dining room complete with butler's pantry and walk-in pantry. The gourmet kitchen features top-of-the-line new Thermador appliances, stone countertops, and a spacious dining area with access to the deck. A family room w/fireplace with Fr doors to an enclosed porch, a pvt office, and a well-designed mudroom with easy access to the two-car garage complete the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite is a true retreat, offering a fireplace, balcony with beautiful property views, walk-in closet, and luxurious bath. Three additional bedrooms share access to full baths, complemented by a large recreation/media room, half bath and convenient second-floor laundry.

Custom-built waterfront retreat on Bermuda Lagoon is an extraordinary find. Lovingly maintained and never flooded, 100 feet of private beach, a deepwater dock, and breathtaking views of Long Island Sound and Bermuda Lagoon. Designed for year-round enjoyment, the home's soaring ceilings and expansive windows perfectly frame the stunning water vistas. Imagine savoring sunsets from the wraparound deck or cozying up by the fire as snow gently falls. Two dedicated offices, one on the main floor with a full bath, and a second in the primary suite with a private deck and panoramic Sound views provide ideal work-from-home solutions. The gourmet kitchen, complete with an industrial stove, is a chef's dream. The primary suite, a true haven, features a private deck, generous walk-in closets, and a spa-like bath. Three additional bedrooms, two with charming lofts, offer ample space for family and guests. The lower level, an entertainer's paradise with a fireplace warmed family room and a wellness oasis, recently upgraded 42-foot indoor pool, sauna, steam room, and gym. This rare waterfront sanctuary, complete with a full-house generator, offers a unique blend of natural beauty, luxurious living, and enduring tranquility.

Quality construction, cohesive design & functional layouts are hallmarks of SIR SIGNATURE Homes.

Whether you're looking for a full-time charmer or a special country getaway home, with privileges to Westport's private beaches, tennis, and boating, this light filled, updated and expanded cape will not disappoint.

Step inside to a sunlit first floor designed for effortless entertaining. The open floor plan showcases a chic, updated kitchen + an inviting front-to-back fireplace warming the living and family rooms. A versatile office, which could serve as a fourth bedroom, a stylish powder room + a functional mudroom/laundry area add to the allure. French doors open to a generous screened porch + expansive deck, crafting a private sanctuary for alfresco dining with stunning views of the expansive yard. The second floor is a haven of comfort, featuring a spacious primary with updated baths + two additional bedrooms, all bathed in natural light. This home, set back from the road, radiates bright + welcoming energy throughout the day. The excellent flow is perfect for hosting family celebrations or enjoying peaceful moments in cozy corners. The lower level offers ample storage + an attached two-car garage. Embrace an active lifestyle with a leisurely bike ride to Longshore Park or Compo Beach. Memorable entertaining await in the LR w/fpl & bay window and DR w/butler's pantry. The chef's kitchen showcases gorgeous stone counters, top appls incl Wolf range & two dishwashers, flowing in to the sun-filled breakfast rm w/French doors to patio, and through to the incredible fam rm which has a coffered ceiling, stone fpl and extensive built-ins. The large library/office displays expert craftsmanship. Excellent mudrm w/full bath beside the pool. 3-car gar. 5 spacious BRs are well-appointed. Grand primary suite w/tray ceiling, fpl, French doors to a sitting rm/2nd office & dual walk-in clsts is accompanied by a chic, new designer bath w/amazing glass-enclosed shower & freestanding soaking tub. Welcome Home! Bright and Airy! Gorgeous 3 Bedroom, 2.5 Bath home with Cathedral Ceilings and Large entertainment spaces! Beautiful hardwood floors throughout the home! X-tra Large windows! Updated Kitchen, Bathrooms and some newer appliances! Natural Gas Heating, City Water and City Sewer! Terrific Cul-De-Sac Location!! Tucked away amongst nature, this home is just minutes to shopping, restaurants, schools, 5 min from Train Station & public parks! Truly an Open Floor plan with a beautiful fireplace!!! Sliders from Kitchen to the Large expansive Deck completes the home. Ample room in the Finished Basement for a home office / storage / gym plus 2 Car Garage! A very easy to maintain property that has been well kept over the years. **Highest and BEST by 1pm on Monday 6/2/25**

Welcome to 19 Sherwood Drive, where beach lifestyle meets contemporary comfort in one of Westport's most desirable enclaves. This home is just a short stroll from the picturesque Old Mill Beach, offering the ultimate in coastal living. Step inside to a sun-drenched, open-concept first floor featuring a renovated kitchen ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The main level also includes a bedroom and a full bath. Upstairs, you'll find three spacious bedrooms and two full bathrooms, ensuring ample space for family and friends. Central air conditioning keeps the home comfortable year-round. Outdoor living is a delight here: unwind in the 8-person hot tub, host memorable barbecues in the backyard, or savor morning coffee and evening cocktails on the enchanting front deck.  Enjoy the tranquility of a quiet neighborhood, the convenience of being moments from Westport's vibrant downtown, and the natural beauty of the Long Island Sound-all from your new home at 19 Sherwood Drive. This is a rare opportunity to embrace the Westport lifestyle at its finest.

Stunning brand new construction just minutes from downtown!! - Fantastic 6 bedroom, 6.1 bath colonial boasts 6,500+ sq/ft of living space! - Open floor plan with 9' ceilings and tons of natural light! - Gorgeous kitchen features Thermador appliances, white shaker-style cabinetry, quartz counters, tile backsplash, custom step-in wine locker, and large walk-in pantry! - Great flow for entertaining on the main level between the open kitchen, living room with gas fireplace, and spacious dining room! - Spectacular primary suite with vaulted ceiling, attached sitting / dressing room, 2 walk-in closets, and impressive en-suite bath featuring heated tile floor, rainfall shower head + soaker tub! - 3 additional bedrooms on the 2nd floor - Great 3rd floor offers huge family room + another bedroom with private en-suite bath - Bedroom on the main floor doubles as a great home-office option - Huge walk-out lower level with lots of natural light offers tons of options as additional family / play room, home gym, etc. - Lower level also features a custom wine cellar room + full bath + storage room - Fantastic location offers lots of privacy as the last house on a dead-end street! - Large & private back yard & site plan approved with a pool permitted, ready to go (additional cost) - Hardwood floors and LED lighting throughout - Generac Generator - Another quality home by Andy Frank, a builder with 30+ years of experience!

AMAZING NEW CONSTRUCTION! Located in the heart of Westport, The Gables of Westport presents a collection of eight townhomes and five flats, blending sophisticated design with the ease of in-town living. Enjoy close proximity to Metro-North, major highways, Longshore Club & Park, Compo Beach, Levitt Pavilion, Westport Country Playhouse, fine dining, shopping, and entertainment. Crafted by local renowned builder RPM Home Inc., these residences showcase open floor plans and premium finishes: Bertazzoni appliances, Grohe fixtures, custom cabinetry, quartz and marble countertops, 6" white oak flooring, and elegant trim selections. Upstairs, retreat to a luxurious primary suite with spa-like bath and custom walk-in closet, plus an additional guest suite and laundry. Each townhome includes an oversized garage and attic with abundant storage. Set within a private enclave tucked away from Post Road, the community is surrounded by lush native landscaping and green spaces. Elevator option available. HOA estimated at $500-$600/month. Taxes TBD.

listings.remarks: Immediate occupancy! New home purchase, downsizing or investment/income, a complete renovation awaits in your 4 bedroom, 2 full bath home featuring open living/dining area with fireplace, custom built-ins, designer kitchen, vaulted ceilings and new hardwood flooring throughout. Gas heating, central a/c, new windows, generous closet space and a private fenced yard including patio and oversized shed complete your new home. Situated in a quiet neighborhood location all minutes to schools, retail/shopping, Westport Center dining and restaurants with easy access to Compo Beach, Longshore Park, Sherwood Island, Metro North Train Station, I-95 and Rt 15 Merritt Parkway.

Welcome to 402 Harvest Commons-offering effortless 1-level Ranch-style 2 Bedroom,2.5 BA unit has 2 private courtyard-style patios, with freshly painted Kitchen, DR, LR, Hallway, Primary bedroom & Guest room. New w/w carpet in the LR, Primary and Guest BR. This home showcases a custom designed eat-in kitchen w/custom-built cabinets by Domestic Kitchens, granite counters, Wolf gas cooktop, Wolf double oven & a Sub-Zero refrigerator. Hardwood floors flow through the kitchen, hallway & dining room. The hallway leading from the kitchen to the primary suite features Laundry/half bath a full bathroom & a small pantry for additional storage. The Primary BR has vaulted ceiling, AUN suite, with stand up shower & separate tub w access to an outside patio. Perfect for morning coffee! The generous-sized living room & dining room offer a comfortable, open flow ideal for entertaining. The living room, w/vaulted ceiling & 2 stories of windows creates a stunning sun-filled room w/a gas fireplace & a custom built credenza w/granite top & access to both patios. The dining room also has a vaulted ceiling and access to a second patio. The second bedroom offers built in book shelves 2 closets (1 cedar). Main level Laundry/half bath adds convenience. Lower level is ideal for a gym, office or studio. This home also has a full house generator. Harvest commons offers resort-like living with its pool & 2 Har-Tru tennis courts. Close to town, beaches, shopping, restaurants, 95 & Merritt. A true jewel.

Beach Living Awaits at 33 Burnham Hill Road, Westport. Build or reimagine the home of your dreams on this generous .61-acre lot (approximately 100' x 266'), perfectly positioned on a peaceful cul-de-sac in Compo Beach. The property features a beautiful stone wall, an expansive yard, and is surrounded by homes of substantial size. With ample room for a pool, it presents endless opportunities for outdoor enjoyment and design flexibility. This rare offering combines privacy, community, and coastal charm - all just moments from Westport's sandy shoreline, Longshore Club Park, and the vibrant downtown scene. Imagine mornings with ocean breezes, afternoon walks to the beach, and evenings watching the sunset over Long Island Sound. From a modern beach retreat to a charming New England escape, the possibilities here are as inspiring as the setting itself. Enjoy all that Westport has to offer - schools, fine dining, shopping, recreation, and an easy commute to NYC - from one of the town's most beautiful neighborhoods. 33 Burnham Hill: Where your coastal dream begins.

Welcome to your dream home on Westport's premier Compo Beach cul-de-sac - an extraordinary 2+ acre estate offering privacy, luxury, and resort-style living in one of Fairfield County's most coveted coastal neighborhoods. Custom-built by Schmiedeck Construction with interiors by Havilande Whitcom Design, this modern farmhouse blends stunning architecture with high function and comfort. Steps from Longshore Club CC & Compo Beach, the home centers around a dramatic infinity-edge pool, expansive patios, sculpted parterres, outdoor kitchen, multi-level decks, and a large screened porch. Meticulously landscaped with fruit orchard, raised garden w/ fireside seating, sprawling lawns, ambient lighting, firepit - every detail was curated for elevated indoor-outdoor living. Inside, enjoy sleek, state-of-the-art finishes: a show-stopping primary suite with balcony and spa bath, and a walk-out LL with media room, wine cellar, rec room, gym, kitchenette, and pool bath w/ changing room. Flexible spaces incl separate guest quarters and au pair suite - ideal for multigenerational living. Smart systems, 3-stop elevator, LED lighting, generator and energy-efficient HVAC add comfort and convenience. Room for a TC or guesthouse, plus rare sub-dividable potential in one of Westport's most prestigious enclaves.

Welcome to 68 Center Street - a rustic retreat nestled in beautiful Greens Farms. This character-rich 1920s Cottage, cherished by the same family for over 50 years, is now ready to begin a new chapter - with you. You will find charming nooks, thoughtful details and two wood burning fireplaces perfect for quiet mornings or hosting friends, on three finished levels. The glass solarium entry invites you to view a peaceful garden featuring an impressive collection of 37 different kinds of flowers. The eat-in kitchen sets the scene for leisurely weekend breakfasts, while both the living and family rooms - with their fireplaces - provide an inviting backdrop for cozy evenings. Outside, there's a charming detached stone garage, a whimsical potting shed and grounds that offer both privacy and serenity - without sacrificing convenience. You're close to local favorites - restaurants, markets, the Greens Farms train station, Burying Hill Beach, Greens Farms Elementary and Sherwood Island State Park - all just minutes away. 68 Center Street isn't just a home - it's a charming blank canvas waiting for your personal touch! Home and property sold "as is."

listings.remarks: Nestled on the freshwater banks of the Saugatuck River, this extensively renovated/refreshed custom-built riverfront beauty sits high and dry with assumable flood insurance of approx. $1400 a year. Experience the river deck complete with swim ladder, perfect for a kayak launch or swim, memorable entertaining or simply enjoy the quietude of this picturesque & peaceful escape. Tall ceilings & light-filled rooms, accented by wide doorways & beautiful hardwood floors, welcome you into the sunny Living and Dining Rooms, & the newly updated Chef's Kitchen. The Family Room opens to the large stone terrace with pergola which overlooks the River just beyond the good sized, flat backyard. Upstairs you will find 9' ceilings through-out, beginning in the open common area that accesses the Primary Bedroom with 2 walk-in closets & brand new lux Bath, plus 3 additional Bedrooms- one with private Bath & two sharing a Jack & Jill Bath. The finished 3rd floor has flexible space for an office, playroom or gym, plus an attic for storage. Improvements include the total freshly painted interior, new Primary Bath & Powder Room, extensive Kitchen updates, new fireplace, new lighting, new AC, all floors refinished, garage with Tesla charger & so much more. On a quiet in-town cul-de-sac with a private association "swimming hole" at the end of street and a short walk to the center of downtown Westport.

Custom built by Mattera Construction, this exceptional home offers over 11,000 sq ft+/- of refined living on 1.3 private acres in the highly sought-after Sturges Commons neighborhood, known for its strong sense of community and block gatherings. Recently enhanced w/ a brand-new, top-of-the-line cedar wood roof, the home blends timeless craftsmanship w/ modern luxury. The main level is ideal for both elegant entertaining & everyday living, featuring a chef's kitchen with Wolf/Subzero appliances, an inviting family room w/ fireplace, a richly detailed library w/ custom cabinetry, a gracious living room, & large sun filled dining room that can comfortably accommodate 12. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite features architectural ceilings, fireplace, a stunning dressing room, a spa-like bath, & private study. Four additional en-suite bedrooms & a second family room complete the level. The third floor offers a large playroom w/ a walk-in closet & full bath. The walk-out lower level delivers exceptional recreation w/ a private theater, gym, & multiple spaces for games, crafts, & entertaining. Outdoor living rivals a resort, featuring a pool w/ spa, covered terrace w/ fireplace, outdoor kitchen w/ BBQ, & a full-size sport court. A rare opportunity to own a thoughtfully designed home offering scale, comfort, & lifestyle in one of Westport's most desirable neighborhoods. Minutes from all amenities yet situated on a lot with exceptional privacy, this home is not to be missed!

Location, location, location! Make Westport your new home. First time on the market in 30 plus years! Adorable 1930's Cape and separate cottage. Live in one and rent the other, rent both, or build your dream home. The charming, sun filled home (#22) offers 1128 sq ft of living space with 2 bedrooms, one full bath, living room, dining area, sunroom and updated kitchen, with beams, hardwood floors and spacious deck off the sunroom. The cottage (#24) at 904 sq ft has 2 bedrooms, one full bath, living/dining area, updated kitchen, stone floors on main level, and inviting back patio. Close to beaches, shopping and restaurants.

This gracious 4 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom colonial home offers just under 4500 square feet. A finished basement offers layout flexibility. The flow of this home is great with a kitchen that is open to the family room. Manageable backyard with nice landscaping and a patio for entertaining.

listings.remarks: Set on a lovely stretch of Valley Road just off Hillspoint is this bright and spacious Greens Farms home with fresh updates throughout. Life is easy from this ideal Westport neighborhood just minutes from Compo Beach, Longshore Club Park, NYC train, top-rated schools, and its bustling downtown. Sunlight floods the home all day, and moonlight streams in the skylights by night. Living room has a vaulted ceiling and the first of two fireplaces - perfect for cozy evenings. The generously sized dining room is ideal for hosting gatherings of all sizes. The sunny updated kitchen offers beautiful new quartz countertops, new appliances, great storage, and a sunny casual dining area. A large family room with a second fireplace, wet bar and picture window opens directly onto the amply-sized patio and level, fully-fenced backyard, making it perfect for entertaining or relaxing. With five bedrooms and a flexible layout, there's plenty of space for guests, family, or dedicated work-from-home areas. The generously-sized primary suite offers a spa-like master bath with jacuzzi tub, updated double vanity, and huge walk-in closet, plus a private, second home office. Restyled baths throughout. The basement offers tons of storage and could be easily converted to a home gym or bonus space. Hardwood floors throughout. No flood zone and no flood insurance. City water, city sewer and a truly move-in-ready, happy home. Ask about potential pool site. Enjoy life at 11 Valley Road!

Discover an extraordinary opportunity to build or renovate your dream home on this magnificent one-acre property located in the heart of Greens Farms in one of Westport's most coveted neighborhoods. Positioned at the end of a distinguished cul-de-sac, this 2,176 sqft 4 bedroom, 2 full and 1 half bath mid-century ranch style home offers unparalleled privacy and tranquility on beautifully landscaped park-like grounds with mature specimen plantings and enchanting natural beauty. Seemingly a world away yet minutes to town, Compo Beach, the train and the library, this is for the discerning buyer seeking both tranquility and convenience.

Welcome to 14 The Mews! This beautifully renovated home is located on a quiet, private road and offers sophisticated, modern living. Upon entering, you are welcomed to a grand, two-story entry with gleaming hardwood floors and custom finishes throughout. This home is perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The list of upgrades is endless! 2020-2021: Refinished hardwood floors, updated staircase with modern railing, renovated powder room and guest bath with marble finishes, custom Calacatta Vagli marble fireplace surround, built-in wall unit with LED lighting, new recessed lighting, and updated kitchen backsplash. 2022: new Marvin sliding door to deck, new front porch, new deck railings, new Anderson windows in upstairs bedrooms. 2024/2025: Custom primary bath with Calacatta Caldia marble shower, heated floors and custom millwork. New Anderson windows with electric blackout shades & custom window treatments in the primary bedroom. The Open concept main level hosts formal living & dining rooms, family room with vaulted ceilings & custom built-ins. The kitchen has been updated with white cabinetry and appliances; Sub-Zero refrigerator, double oven & cooktop. On a beautiful evening, a sliding door leads to the patio for dining al fresco! The spacious primary suite hosts a luxurious bath featuring heated marble floors and a newly renovated walk-in closet. The lower level is perfect for quiet evenings or hosting! A cozy area for watching movies, Wine room & playroom.

The 2.5 updated baths blend timeless design with modern functionality. Major improvements completed in recent years include roof, windows, siding, electrical, plumbing, HVAC system, and more-offering peace of mind and lasting value. Magnificent move-in ready new construction brought to you by Sound Home Builders. Centrally located in the heart of Westport's coveted Long Lots, Hunt Club and Greens Farms neighborhoods. Elegant design and finishing detail, soaring ceilings and master craftsmanship throughout. Oversized European windows and doors fill the home with natural light. The kitchen features custom cabinetry, warm hues, designer lighting, gourmet appliances and spacious layout. Arched doorways grace a holiday-sized dining room with full wet bar, adjoined by the awe-inspiring living room with serene backyard views and beautiful wood burning fireplace. Oversized doors open to a large patio overlooking the heated gunite pool, adjoining bluestone patios and outdoor fireplace - surrounded by flat lawn, mature trees, colorful plantings and full fence enclosure. Three-car garage has ample room for storage.

listings.remarks: Step into a home where every detail tells a story of timeless elegance and masterful transformation. This 4-bedroom, 3-bath Colonial-reimagined through a multi-year, designer-led renovation-seamlessly marries historic charm with modern sophistication.  Original Southern Pine floors and exposed beams ground the home in authenticity, while a stunning new kitchen by Shore & Country elevates everyday living with bespoke cabinetry, Sub-Zero & Wolf appliances, and quartz surfaces. Sunlit rooms flow effortlessly-perfect for entertaining or retreating in comfort. Each bath is a study in luxury, including a serene primary suite with spa-inspired finishes.  Beyond the interiors, a private backyard oasis awaits: bluestone patio, heated pool, and curated landscaping designed for year-round enjoyment. Upgrades abound-from Marvin windows and Hardie siding to custom closets, designer lighting, and all-new mechanicals.  Set on a quiet, convenient street near downtown, train, and schools-with shuttle service to the station-this is turnkey Westport living at its most refined. Rarely does a home strike this perfect balance of character, quality, and location. And it all unfolds in Old Hill-Westport's most coveted address.

Stunning modern farmhouse colonial on sought after Gault Park Drive. This enclave of cul-de-sacs is known for its proximity to everything the town of Westport has to offer. Minutes to town, minutes to the train and minutes to the beach. All from this fabulous neighborhood of active homeowners riding bikes and walking the quiet streets. Built in 2014, but customized in the past few years with an amazing office, mudroom and bath, family room with beams, built ins and a stunning gas fireplace. Constructed with an open concept that lends to an easy flow of indoor and outdoor living, which is also great for entertaining. The primary bedroom suite sits privately on the second level away from the other 3 bedrooms separated by an enormous second level family space with multiple uses. The fifth bedroom with its own full bath is on the main level. The expansive lawn rolls to the home that is perfectly sited on the property to enable multiple pool sites and privacy should someone wish to add a pool. Not often does a home and property of this caliber in a prime location come to market in Westport. Now's the time to make this home your own.

This beautifully crafted residence includes a sparkling pool and is perfectly nestled in a peaceful, walkable community-for bike rides and evening strolls. Perched on a private cul-de-sac just minutes from downtown Westport, dog parks, beaches, award-winning restaurants, and even a 24-hour CVS for those late-night essentials, this residence perfectly blends convenience with serenity. Step inside and experience Westport luxury redefined-a striking contemporary design surrounded by lush, landscaped grounds that create a peaceful, retreat-like setting. With a separate-entry studio for creative or professional use, this home adapts to your lifestyle-whether you're a growing family seeking space or a downsizer who refuses to compromise on style.Whether you're hosting family on the fabulous rooftop deck, enjoying the privacy, or welcoming guests to their own separate suite, this home delivers the perfect balance of connection and calm. Note: Town records do not include the heated/cooled first-floor office studio and lower-level art studio in the official square footage. listings.remarks: This Nantucket-style turnkey retreat has been reimagined and extensively renovated to create the perfect escape by the sea - a captivating and magical experience inside and out. Just a 4-minute walk from picturesque Old Mill Beach and around the corner from Westport's famed Compo Beach, this home blends a seaside-Scandinavian aesthetic with pickled white oak floors, glossy white walls, and sunlit, open spaces. Affectionately nicknamed The Punchbowl for the way it naturally draws friends together, it's long been a place for easy gatherings. Every detail reflects a thoughtful connection to the area - from its lush native gardens to the charming horseshoe crab door knocker that greets you at the front. Inside and out, it's a coastal home designed for living well by the water all year round. With 3 finished floors, 4 bedrooms, 2 updated full baths there's ample space to enjoy. The inviting kitchen features Subzero and Bosch and opens to living room with fireplace and pretty sunroom. The private property is embraced by mature arborvitae and hornbeams, offering a rare sense of privacy and calm just steps from the shoreline in a prime location. Just a bike ride away, enjoy golf, tennis, swimming and boating at Longshore Beach Club Park or a 5- minute drive to the train and restaurants. So close to the shore yet no flood zone and no flood insurance needed. New natural gas mechanicals in 2017. 18 Sherwood Drive isn't just the perfect beach retreat - it's a lifestyle.

This pristine 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath waterfront home offers the ultimate coastal lifestyle with sweeping views across the water to Sherwood Island State Park. Designed with an open floor plan, it features an updated kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. An expansive deck overlooks the water, creating the perfect backdrop for gatherings or quiet relaxation. From the seawall, launch a kayak or paddleboard and enjoy time on the water just outside your door. With Old Mill Pond beach just steps away, this waterfront home blends modern elegance with a prime location and just a short walk to Compo Beach to experience all it has to offer.

Every plank, beam, and finish in this 3BR, 2.5 bath was selected with intention. A masterclass in design with warmth, quality, and craftsmanship in every detail, and finishes typically reserved for homes at much higher price points. Reimagined by Alex Brandfon, founder of ZIBA Hardwoods, the home reflects a vision of luxury and ease, where reclaimed character and modern precision come together seamlessly. Taken down to the foundation, with only portions of the exterior walls remaining, this home is essentially brand new. At 1,800 SF, it lives larger than its footprint, with a layout that's open, airy, and light-filled. Wide-plank flooring, reclaimed beams, and lofted ceilings feel like a work of art. The kitchen is a showpiece with rift-sawn white oak cabinetry, a painted shiplap ceiling with exposed beams, and a Calacatta marble island that invites gathering and flows to the dining room. The living room centers around a gas fireplace framed in stone creating a cozy yet sophisticated focal point. Fabulous first-floor office, mudroom with custom built-ins, covered porch, landscaped gardens and spacious bluestone patio. Upstairs, retreat to the vaulted primary suite w/ spa-like bath and walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms, full bath & laundry complete the level. The garage offers EV hookup and is generator-ready. Quiet street within short walking distance to town, this home offers convenience and privacy. More than a renovation, it's a transformation at its finest.

listings.remarks: SELLERS WILL BE REVIEWING OFFERS ON MONDAY 11/10 AT 12:00 This gracious Colonial in the heart of coveted Old Hill has been home to one family for 47 years. The welcoming foyer with its sweeping staircase is flanked by a generously sized dining room with fireplace and living room with fireplace and custom built-ins. A paneled study and a sun room provide versatile spaces for work or relaxing.A thoughtfully designed recent addition enhances the home's functionality with a spacious mudroom entry, butler's pantry with sink and dishwasher, a large laundry room with sink, and a walk-in pantry. The chef's kitchen features a huge granite island, high end appliances, vaulted ceiling and custom windows that bring in natural light and opens to the family room, creating a warm central gathering space.The property offers mature plantings, a charming brook, and an expansive lawn bordered by established trees. A generous deck overlooks the landscape and provides an ideal setting for outdoor dining and entertaining.The second floor includes a primary bedroom with built-ins and full bath, along with three additional bedrooms and a hall bath. A finished third floor offers a playroom and office. A classic Old Hill residence with character, light, and room to live comfortably both indoors and out.

listings.remarks: Step into this beautifully renovated modern home, where refined craftsmanship meets contemporary elegance. The grand foyer opens to a stunning living room with soaring double-height ceilings and a dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace. The gourmet chef's kitchen impresses with custom cabinetry, Viking appliances, quartz countertops, and a spacious eat-in area. Designed for effortless entertaining, the layout connects the kitchen, dining, and family rooms seamlessly. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite features a large walk-in closet and a spa-like bath with a soaking tub and oversized shower. Three additional bedrooms offer generous storage, plus a versatile open workspace on the second floor. Enjoy year-round relaxation in the sunroom leading to a spacious deck and professionally landscaped backyard-perfect for outdoor gatherings. Conveniently located across from Birchwood Country Club and just 1 mile from the Westport Train Station.

Welcome to Residence Duplex 2 at The Mill Westport, a spectacular unit with spacious rooftop deck which offers high-end luxury living with all the amenities of a fine custom home in the heart of downtown Westport. With a concierge on-site and approximately 10,000 square feet of spectacular interior and exterior amenity spaces such as The Great Room & Cafe, Pool, Health & Wellness Center, Patio & Rooftop Deck, residents will enjoy carefree, 5-star living. The 31 residences feature large windows, open floor plans, and light wood floors. Their refined details include a large waterfall-edged kitchen island, linear gas fireplaces, Sub Zero and Wolf appliances, full-size washer/dryers, and up-to-date bathrooms with radiant heated master bath floors. A variety of floor plans are available to meet the unique needs of discerning buyers seeking a bespoke lifestyle, with some offering spectacular terraces. All homeowners have access to heated or covered parking. Set in a tranquil, residential neighborhood within walking distance of downtown Westport's many shops, restaurants, activities and close to beaches and commuting options to New York City. The redevelopment and adaptation of The Mill Westport into a luxurious residential property is being undertaken by Coastal Luxury Homes and Gault Family Companies, two Westport-based firms with a proven track record of surpassing the highest expectations.

listings.remarks: Beyond Beautiful - Welcome to 10 Twin Falls Lane, a striking property and home filled with natural light from floor-to-ceiling windows. Step into the sun-drenched foyer with terracotta tile. Throughout the years the home has been updated and modernized with soaring ceilings, serene views, and inspiring design. The expansive family room features a dramatic picture window and flows seamlessly into the marble-countered kitchen with dry bar and adjacent dining area-perfect for entertaining. A spacious den, easily a second family room, includes parquet floors, sliders to the patio, and stairs to a cozy loft. Step into the screened-in porch to enjoy sweeping views of open sky and lawn. The outdoors are just as captivating as the interior with a sparkling pool, charming garden spaces, and a backyard span stretching nearly 100 yards. The primary suite is privately tucked away with a large ensuite bath and soaking tub. The three additional bedrooms bathed in soft light whites- one with vaulted ceilings, wide plank floors, and sliders to the expansive deck. Understated and distinctive, this home is an expression of modernist design-full of charm, light, and joyful living spaces. Just minutes to train, restaurants, shops, YMCA, beaches, and more. Come see how effortlessly enjoyable Westport living can be.

Discover this beautifully remodeled 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath home in one of Westport's most sought-after walk-to-town neighborhoods. Set on a level third-of-an-acre of professionally landscaped property, this move-in ready gem offers the perfect blend of classic charm and modern style. Inside, a bright open floor plan showcases high-end finishes throughout, including a stunning chef's kitchen, elegant bathrooms, and spacious living and dining areas designed for today's lifestyle. The sun-drenched family room and seamless indoor-outdoor flow make entertaining effortless year-round. Thoughtfully updated with comfort and functionality in mind, this home is a rare opportunity to enjoy turnkey living just minutes from downtown, top-rated schools, the beach and the train.

Experience the best of Westport living in this stunning Mid Century Modern residence set on 1.87 prime acres in the heart of town. This is all about the property! Tucked away on a beautifully landscaped property, this 4-bedroom home offers the perfect blend of privacy, modern design, and everyday convenience. Inside, expansive windows bathe the open living spaces in natural light, with soaring ceilings and a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The spacious kitchen, elegant dining area, and inviting living room create an ideal setting for entertaining. Retreat to a serene primary suite with views of the picturesque grounds. Step outside to your own private oasis featuring a sparkling in-ground pool, lush lawns, and mature plantings- fully fenced and perfect for relaxation or play. Enjoy the combination of public water, and town sewer. Located minutes from downtown shopping, restaurants, beaches, top-rated schools, and the train. A truly exceptional offering in one of Westport's most sought-after locations.

Diamond in the Rough! This stately colonial is brimming with potential and ready to be restored to its former grandeur. Nestled on a private lot, the home offers a peaceful setting with ample space for everyone. Boasting over 3,800 sq ft, this spacious residence features 5 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, along with gleaming hardwood floors and a variety of rooms designed for comfortable living. The main level includes a classic kitchen, formal dining room, and a living room with a cozy fireplace. An additional room on this level provides extra space for entertaining, relaxing, or creating your dream layout. Just three steps up from the main level, you'll find a dramatic family room with soaring ceilings and expansive views of the backyard-perfect for gatherings or quiet evenings. Continue up another short flight of stairs to discover the private bedroom wing, complete with five generously sized bedrooms, a full hall bath, and a primary suite with its own en-suite bath. On the lower level, a finished bonus room offers even more versatility-ideal for a TV room, playroom, office, or whatever suits your lifestyle. Don't miss this rare opportunity to bring your vision to life in a home with timeless charm and room to grow!

Completely Rebuilt in 2013 FEMA-compliant 4-5 BR Westport Beach House located in highly sought after Compo Beach Area, offers picture perfect living. The main level features a sunny Kitchen & Family Room w/ gas fireplace & deck; walk-in pantry, front hall closet, Office, Full Bath and three-exposure oversized Flex/Great Room. There are 4 bedrooms on 2nd floor, incl. a spacious Primary Suite w/ vaulted ceilings and sitting area, primary Bath w/double vanities, soaker tub and separate W/C; 3 more bedrooms, Bathroom and Laundry Room complete the 2nd floor. 3rd floor aerie with Full Bath that can be used as a 5th BR Guest Suite. An oversized 2 car garage is just off the Mudroom, storage, whole-house generator & fully fenced landscaped yard. New since Fall 2023: Refinished white oak floors; interior paint; Samsung Pedestal W/D; Bosch DW; upgraded gas FP; centrally monitored alarm system with camera network; LED Lighting & Fans; newly renovated garage with full epoxy-coat floor, storage, & new EV charger; remote whole-house water shut-off. Also new since 2023: front door, storm door, Marvin glass slider; 3 Toto Washlets; New vanities, medicine cabinets, faucets; Outside, new irrigation system, landscaping, and lighting, plus repaved driveway. Walk east 1 block and enjoy a gorgeous swath of quiet sandy beach. Walk south and arrive at the park and marina. With homes on the block commanding more than twice the price, an exceptional value, a joyful space and a move-in ready home.

Located on a quiet Lower Weston cul-de-sac, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers generous living space, stylish updates, and a seamless indoor-outdoor connection. The first-floor primary suite is a true retreat with a large walk-in closet, updated en-suite bath, and sliding doors that open directly to the backyard. The living room features a wood-burning fireplace and its own backyard access, creating a great flow for everyday living and entertaining. The eat-in kitchen connects seamlessly to the living/dining area, making it easy to cook, gather, and relax. Bathrooms are freshly updated in bright white finishes for a clean, modern feel. Outside, a spacious yard and patio provide space to relax, play, or host friends-all in a private setting close to schools, town, and commuting routes.

Set in the heart of Westport, this beautifully renovated Cape style home blends classic character with modern sophistication. The 3 bedroom 3.5 bath residence set on 1 acre features all en-suite baths, each finished in luxurious marble. The marble-floored foyer opens to expansive hardwood floors that flow through the main level. The living room is rich in detail, with custom millwork, built-ins, oversized windows, and a striking fieldstone fireplace. A versatile 1st floor en-suite bedroom also serves as an ideal office. Custom window treatments enhance the home's character and add a polished finish throughout. The chef's kitchen offers marble countertops, elegant cabinetry, LaCornue range and a custom pantry/coffee bar tucked under the rotunda staircase. Ascend this sunlit architectural centerpiece to the primary suite, complete with spa-like full bath and a private deck overlooking the expansive property. A second upstairs en-suite bedroom completes the home's accommodations. Step outside and enjoy the two new bluestone patios with professional landscaping and striking outdoor lighting - perfect for entertaining!  An oversized detached two-car garage provides generous storage. With natural gas, city water, and a convenient location near schools, shopping, beaches and more this residence offers both ease and elegance. 138 Roseville Road is a rare find-an exceptional combination of history, style, and comfort in Westport's most desirable setting.

AMAZING NEW CONSTRUCTION! Located in the heart of Westport, The Gables of Westport presents a collection of eight townhomes and five flats, blending sophisticated design with the ease of in-town living. Enjoy close proximity to Metro-North, major highways, Longshore Club & Park, Compo Beach, Levitt Pavilion, Westport Country Playhouse, fine dining, shopping, and entertainment. Crafted by local renowned builder RPM Home Inc., these residences showcase open floor plans and premium finishes: Bertazzoni appliances, Grohe fixtures, custom cabinetry, quartz and marble countertops, 6" white oak flooring, and elegant trim selections. Nearly completed this residential flat offers the best of first floor living. The open floor plan seamlessly connects the living room, kitchen, and dining area, which extends to a large private terrace and yard. You'll also find a luxurious primary suite with a lavish bathroom and custom closet, a comfortable guest suite, and a dedicated laundry area. Set within a private enclave tucked away from Post Road, the community is surrounded by lush native landscaping and green spaces. Elevator option available. HOA estimated at $500-$600/month. Real Estate Taxes are to be determined.
