listings.remarks: Full of character and cottage-style comfort, this farmhouse offers an inviting blend of vintage charm and modern living. The large, welcoming front porch sets the tone-a perfect spot to sip coffee, greet neighbors, or simply unwind. Inside, the main level features an open country kitchen-perfect for gathering with family and friends-while natural sunlight fills every corner. The cozy living room fireplace with vintage tiles adds timeless appeal. With three bedrooms and two full baths, there's plenty of space today and exciting potential to expand into the walk-up attic or extend off the back of the house. Outdoor living and entertaining is a delight - in addition to the front porch there is a large, flat, private backyard that feels like your own retreat. Perfectly located within walking distance to town and with an easy commute to NYC, this home is ready to be enjoyed for years to come. Step inside and fall in love!

Come see the latest CCO Habitats new construction home - located at the end of a private road - 3 Hubbel's Lane - and buffered by non developable land for privacy. Only one mile to downtown/Main Street (.6 mile to Coffee An' for the best donuts in town!!) with sidewalks to make the stroll even easier! Go the other way, and you're 1.5 miles from the newly renovated Coleytown school district. Close enough for super convenience without being so close that you have to deal with traffic. Easy peasy lemon squeezy! This home is finished on 4 levels with over 6300 finished square feet of living space, and as always, has some new design elements to make it unique from any other CCO Habitats creation. Oversized European doors and tilting windows plus an amazing wall of windows give incredible natural light. Warm and soft with the coastal boho design that is so chic as well as comfortable to live in. A first floor office. A gym. EV outlet and generator ready.  Move in and enjoy life in Westport!

This is the perfect house in the perfect location-just minutes from top-rated schools, playgrounds, ballfields, and houses of worship. Set on a picture-perfect acre of lush, manicured lawn, this Colonial style home offers serene views of a large pond while overlooking 8+ acres of private, protected meadowland. A gas-fired, whole-house generator provides seamless backup power for year-round peace of mind. Step through the front door into a grand two-story foyer that introduces a seamless layout of expansive rooms exceptional for formal entertaining or everyday use. The gourmet kitchen features all granite countertops, double Bosch wall ovens and Subzero refrigeration. The first floor also offers the convenience of a full bath with an oversized shower. Once beyond the kitchen, you flow effortlessly into the spacious family room with vaulted ceilings, a cozy fireplace, and sliding glass doors to help you enjoy the picturesque views. Outside, a large deck overlooks beautifully landscaped gardens and a heated in-ground pool-your own private oasis. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite includes a generous California Closets walk-in as well as a custom-built, luxurious spa-style bath. Three additional bedrooms share a beautifully appointed custom bath with double sinks and thermostatic shower controls for consistent, comfortable water temperatures. The finished lower level adds ample storage and versatile living space, perfect for a playroom, home office, or gym.

Privately nestled on a peaceful cul-de-sac, this masterfully built 2007 residence showcases exceptional craftsmanship, refined design, and luxurious amenities across 4 finished levels. The main floor offers thoughtfully designed living spaces that are both functional and beautiful. A formal living room and dining room-each with a gas fireplace-set the tone for elegant entertaining. The open-concept kitchen with a sunny breakfast area flows effortlessly into an inviting family room. A richly appointed office provides an ideal setting for working from home. Two staircases and two powder rooms elevate the convenience and character of the layout. Upstairs, a serene primary suite and 3 additional en-suite bedrooms offer privacy and comfort. A cozy media room completes the 2nd level. The 3rd floor provides flexible space perfect for a media room, playroom, guest suite, or creative studio, complete with a bedroom and full bath. The sunlit, walk-out lower level features a gym, rec room, add'l bed and full bath plus high ceilings (think golf simulator!). Outside, enjoy resort-style amenities including a stunning pool and spa, built-in grill station, and an oversized gas firepit - enrobed in lush, professionally landscaped grounds. A heated 3-car garage, full-house generator, and laundry room with 2 washers and 2 dryers ensure daily efficiency. Located just minutes from Westport's excellent schools, beaches, train and vibrant downtown.

listings.remarks: Nearly completed this residential flat offers the best of first floor living. Situated in a prime location in the heart of Westport, this development by RPM Home features a limited collection of eight luxury townhomes and five flats, designed for convenient in-town living. This particular unit offers desirable single-level living and is filled with natural light thanks to expansive Marvin windows and sliding doors. The open floor plan seamlessly connects the living room, kitchen, and dining area, which extends to a private terrace. The residence boasts premium finishes throughout, including Bertazzoni appliances, Grohe fixtures, custom cabinetry, quartz and marble countertops, and elegant 6" white oak floors. You'll also find a luxurious primary suite with a lavish bathroom and custom closet, a comfortable guest suite, and a dedicated laundry area. Nestled away from Post Road, The Gables of Westport provides a private enclave surrounded by beautiful lush native gardens and green spaces. Its location also offers easy access to the Metro-North Train, Longshore Club and Park, major highways, and a variety of restaurants, shopping, and entertainment options. Elevator option available. HOA estimated to be $600 per month.

listings.remarks: Have you ever met someone and thought that's an old soul? They have character, exude warmth, and give you a feeling of deep comfort right from the start. Special historic homes are the same way. They have a magical ambiance and carry the energy from the generations before who've loved and cared for them. That shared experience inspires future custodians and artists to bring their vision, and Pinterest boards, to remake the space in a way that adds value while respecting the vintage of it all. The architectural significance of this Colonial Revival has been well preserved over the decades. The main floor features a grand salon which walks out to an incredibly spacious three season porch. There is also a separate sitting area, butlers pantry, library/den and a comfortable eat-in kitchen. The upper level offers a primary suite plus three additional bedrooms, a laundry room, and a full hall bath. The third floor walks up to two bonus spaces. The current owners have a "Home Occupation" use which is a rare find. The adjoined professional office is both peaceful and refined with a private client entrance. Crooked Mile is steeped in Westport history and it's a location worthy of the investment. Tucked on an acre and a third in the Red Coat neighborhood this well manicured property offers privacy and ample room to grow. Anything you can imagine, you can create here and be in good company.

Welcome to 4 Silver Brook Rd- a gem in the heart of Westport. Situated in a true neighborhood (which is rare in Westport), this home was designed and then updated for easy indoor/outdoor entertaining and everyday living. The backyard oasis has mature plantings that create privacy and a peaceful setting as well as 3 different large flat areas for playing catch, gardening or kicking a soccer ball.  The heart of the home opens to a backyard that feels like your own private resort. The open air lounge with fire pit and dining area are covered and usable even on dreary days. Pool has an auto safety cover, attached hot tub and a hook up for a water slide. This center hall colonial has the flow that many seek. All 5 bedrooms are on the 2nd level; the primary and 2 others are ensuite and bedroom 4&5 share an attached bathroom. The first floor has a separate office with a beautiful bay window so you can enjoy the views while working from home. Spacious mudroom, 3 car garage, back staircase, finished 3rd floor and finished basement cover the most sought after features on a buyers wishlist. Move in ready and can be yours for this summer!

Welcome to Brookside, the amazing new project by GreenDay and Co. Get ready to be captivated by this home's transformation-a breathtaking fusion of classic European charm and modern luxury that will leave you speechless. This isn't just your typical modern farmhouse; it's a beautiful reimagining of a European-style estate, carefully rebuilt from the ground up to inspire and impress. it's a magnificent reimagining of a European-style residence, meticulously rebuilt from the ground up!  Step inside this breathtaking five-bedroom masterpiece, where an oversized kitchen paired with a spacious pantry awaits to inspire culinary adventures and unforgettable gatherings! The primary bedroom features a luxurious en suite, and the additional junior suite enhances the already perfectly designed layout. Nestled in an idyllic downtown Westport location on a picturesque cul-de-sac, you'll fall in love with the tranquil ambiance, complemented by the soothing sounds of the delightful mandarin brook bordering the property.  Picture yourself savoring your morning coffee on the walk-out deck, effortlessly accessible from both the dining room and kitchen. Everything here is brand new, thoughtfully designed, and ready for the next lucky owners to create beautiful memories. With chic modern finishes, elegant white oak hardwood floors, and a charming front covered porch, this home

listings.remarks: Step into the timeless appeal of this classic 1939 Cape Cod home brimming with original character and unbeatable curb appeal. Perfectly sited in the heart of Westport's desirable Greens Farms neighborhood, this property offers a rare blend of historic charm, modern updates and exceptional convenience. You'll find as many reasons to LOVE IT TODAY as there are reasons to DREAM YOUR TOMORROW. Many will see it as move-in ready either for themselves (or to update over time) or move-in ready for their tenants. Renovators and flippers will find opportunity, and even Spec Builders since this is not a "designated" historic property and is available for new construction.FEATURES *Authentic 1930s character with well-preserved original details make it special.*Flexible, Practical Layout make Single-level living possible with first floor bedroom, ensuite bath ideal for guests, aging in place, or home office.*Spacious, Versatile Lower Level;SuperSize 2-car garage w/electric charging station.

listings.remarks: Welcome to your storybook escape of one of Westport's famous cartoonists, Jud Hurd! Nestled on 2.5 lush, private acres, this enchanting 4-bedroom, 3-bath stone home with a slate roof, blends timeless charm with modern comfort. You'll be captivated by the home's character from the moment you arrive. The main level features the Kitchen, Living Room, Dining Room, Bedroom, and Full Bath. Upstairs, there are 3 additional bedrooms and 2 full baths Tucked away on the property is a dreamy artist's studio-ideal for painting, writing, or quiet reflection. Surrounded by nature yet minutes from Westport's vibrant downtown, beaches, and top-rated schools, this home is a rare blend of inspiration and convenience. Fall in love with the existing home or build a new home on the vast property. In 2023- New Furnace installed, New electric baseboard heat added, chimney liner installed, in ground oil tank removed and soil tested (reports are available through attached documents.)

This sophisticatedly remodeled antique is bright, spacious with an easy traditional layout and attention to detail. The first floor features an open kitchen/LR layout with two fireplaces, and large eating area w/walk in pantry. Off there you'll find a large formal dining room with a wall of French doors. Office with built-ins, Family room, laundry room, and mud room round out the main level (FR & LR can be swapped on preference). Upstairs is where you'll find five generously sized bedrooms and three full baths. The primary features an impressive walk-in closet with island and custom shelving, and a large bathroom with separate tub and shower, and two separate vanities. One of the bedrooms currently used as an office has a built-in desk and a Murphy bed for easy conversion to a guest room. Another room across the hall shares a large bath with a double vanity. Down the hall are two more bedrooms one of which has an elegantly renovated en-suite bath. The house has great closet space and 2 pull-down attics for additional storage. Extra-large windows and French doors throughout make for a bright and sunny home. The outdoor space is an oasis with a patio and sitting wall offering room for dining, and a fireplace area for lounging. Lots of professionally landscaped lawn to play on. Mostly newer mechanicals, oil tank, and sewer on the street. Nothing to do but move in and enjoy the private yet convenient location.

Enjoy a wonderful life on Woodside Avenue, one of Old Hill's most popular streets, walking distance to town & Earthplace Nature Centre. This charming ranch home offers sophisticated, easy living & so much more. The open floorplan radiates off the bright kitchen with stainless steel appliances, including a wine fridge & gorgeous granite countertops. The formal living room enjoys a wall of sliding glass doors that allow light to flood in & give access to the outside entertaining space. The dining room is perfect for both formal & informal meals. The stunning sunroom is flooded with light & offers a more informal space to relax & enjoy the landscape and the ease of indoor-outdoor living. The large vaulted family room has a grand scale but feels intimate with a cozy fireplace & built-in bookshelves. The main level primary suite is quietly situated and enjoys the second fireplace, has sliders giving access to the private pool area with hot tub. The rest of the primary suite includes a large walk-in closet & marble bathroom with a vaulted ceiling, elegant double vanity, soaking tub & steam shower. Upstairs there are three additional bedrooms and a full bath. Outside the property is surrounded by a professional landscape with mature specimen trees. As well as the attached two car garage there is another large addition that has huge potential. It is a car collector's dream, an opportunity to add an office, a gym & plenty of storage or even perhaps as an ADU. Live your best life!

Unique opportunity to renovate this classic Westport estate on three professionally landscaped acres with a pool. You will love the great room with views of the pond and property. Six bedrooms makes space for everyone with a separate guest wing that is perfect for an au-pair.

Discover the lifestyle you've been looking for, right at your doorstep! Less than half a mile from Riverside Ave in the Saugatuck area of Westport, and the Westport train station you'll find this townhouse in the highly desired Strathmore Lane Association. The open-concept layout designed for modern living presents a welcoming flow from Kitchen through hardwood-floored dining and living room right out onto the patio. The two upstairs bedrooms each boast large walk-in closets with even more storage space in the pull down attic. The full bathroom upstairs, which also privately connects to the primary, has a convenient upper-level laundry area. You'll find plenty of light in the guest room from the two skylights as well. Step outside to your own private patio garden or grill area, surrounded by lush, professionally landscaped grounds - perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Just down the association path from the unit you can relax by the large pool - or do laps knowing you have your own rural Westport border oasis yet everything you could ever need from the varied and numerous Norwalk businesses remains moments down the road.

listings.remarks: Perfectly positioned just minutes from downtown Westport, this beautifully renovated 4-bedroom, 3-bath Cape is nestled on 1.18 serene acres, offering the perfect blend of style, function, and flexibility. The home's thoughtful layout emphasizes convenience, with three spacious bedrooms located on the main level-ideal for guests, home offices, or anyone seeking easy, one-level living. At the heart of the home is a show-stopping chef's kitchen featuring sleek Italian Snaidero cabinetry by Pininfarina (of Ferrari fame), top-of-the-line Viking and Miele appliances, Caesarstone countertops, two sinks, and a large island with seating for six. The open-concept design flows into a cozy family room with a wood-burning fireplace and a sun-drenched dining room with windows on three sides-perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, the private primary suite spans the entire second floor and includes a luxurious spa bath, creating a peaceful retreat. The finished lower level adds even more versatility with a large rec room, wet bar, home theater, office/gym, and laundry room. Outside, a generous deck and level yard provide great space for relaxing, playing, or dining al fresco. Just minutes to top-rated schools, beaches, and commuter routes-this move-in-ready home is the total package.

A rare gem - step into the timeless charm of this Rufus Wakeman home, a quintessential c.1884 home nestled in Westport, CT. Set on a beautiful, level, professionally landscaped, and private 0.82-acre lot, this cherished residence seamlessly blends historic character with modern-day comfort. High ceilings, intricate moldings, and wide plank floors showcase the craftsmanship of a bygone era, while oversized windows flood the home with natural light. The inviting entryway features a bespoke oversized front door and the original handcrafted stairway banister. Gracious living and dining rooms are complemented by a cozy den and a sun-filled home office. The kitchen, dining area, and family room seamlessly flow onto the spacious patio and lush backyard, creating the perfect setting for indoor-outdoor living. The second floor hosts the private living quarters, featuring spacious bedrooms designed for comfort and tranquility. This level includes three full bathrooms, thoughtfully appointed to provide convenience and privacy for family and guests alike. An added perk - a classic barn at the edge of the property awaits your personal touch. Whether transformed into a guest cottage, studio, workspace, or gym, it offers endless possibilities. Ideally located just minutes from Saugatuck Center, Compo Beach, Longshore Club Park, and downtown Westport. This timeless home offers not just a place to live, but a way of life you'll love and never want to leave.

Charming 3-bed/2.5 bath Cape on centrally-located Westport cul de sac with separate, legal one-bedroom, 534 sqft cottage. Vaulted great room with beams and fireplace flow into a sunny living room/dining room. Rustle up lunch in the country kitchen with its gas range, marble counters and breakfast nook. Separate home office plus half bath on the main level. Upstairs, the ensuite primary, with its balcony overlooking the great room, has a vaulted ceiling, double closets and a new ensuite bathroom with marble floors and stall shower. Two bedrooms on the lower level share a Jack & Jill bathroom. Attached garage, plus plenty of off-street parking. The screened-in porch overlooks the bucolic backyard while a stone patio is just waiting for your Adirondack chairs and a fire pit. The separate, rentable 1-bedroom cottage has a living space, kitchen area, loft, full bathroom, WD and private deck with garden area. Rent it out for roughly $2000/mo or keep it for parents, a nanny, an artist's studio or weekend guests. New fencing encloses the backyard, keeping your pets in and deer out. Unbeatable location that's close to everything: walk to Terrain for lunch, pop in for a mani-pedi and pick up dinner at Fresh Market on the way home. Bike to the beach or downtown, plus the MetroNorth train station to NYC is less than 10 minutes drive. And, of course, Westport's unbeatable restaurants, shopping and award-winning schools! Ask about the many sellers' updates and don't miss this one!

Located on a great street, close to town, the train,Winslow Park, the library, stores, Longshore and Compo Beach, the home at 46 Park Lane offers a wonderful opportunity for those wanting to renovate or build new. The 0.60 acre has a beautiful ,level back yard. There are no wetlands and the house is serviced by city water, natural gas and city sewers.  The house offers an eat in kitchen, living /dining room with a fireplace with brick surround. The living room's full wall of windows opens up to the beautiful back yard,offering a feeling of quiet and serenity. There are 5 bedrooms and 3 full baths and a powder room. A large family room and a laundry/mudroom area that leads to the 2-car attached garage. There are 2,300 SF of living space and room for expansion. 10 years ago the new windows were added, the roof was replaced and bathrooms renovated.Hardwood floors are throughout except for the two bedrooms on the 3rd floor. The house is ready for new owners to bring it to its full potential or the lot is perfect for a brand new home. House being sold as is.

A true Westport icon, 11 Beachside Common is one of the most architecturally distinctive homes on the Connecticut coast-known to anyone who's ever strolled Burying Hill Beach. Set on 2.6 waterfront acres, the property offers sweeping southern views over Sherwood Island and Long Island Sound, with sunsets that rival the Low Country and birdlife that fills the surrounding marsh with movement and sound. With water access for kayaking and paddle boarding, it's a nature lover's paradise wrapped in high design.Originally built in 1971, the home underwent a $13M transformation under acclaimed architect James Biber of Pentagram. The goal: not to create rooms, but to dissolve them. Nearly 9,000 sq ft of open, gallery-like living space is unified by a 150-ft handmade tile path that runs the length of the main level. A soaring central room with exposed aluminum column is flanked by playful architectural elements -domes, portholes, skylight tubes, and a floating staircase.A 3-story "tower," designed as the intellectual center of the home, offers 360-degree panoramic views and quiet workspace. This is a home where design, art, and imagination intersect-and where brilliant minds have found inspiration. From Academy Award winners to world-renowned scientists and adventurers, this home has drawn extraordinary lives. If genius gravitates toward whimsy, perhaps it's because whimsy makes room for wonder-and for those bold enough to see differently.

listings.remarks: Welcome to 12 Sandy Hill Terrace in Westport, CT! A spacious home nestled at the end of a cul-de-sac, offering spacious and comfortable living space, ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. This home boasts a central location with a charming trail behind the property that that provides an easy walk to school. Walk to town and Saugatuck, along with easy access to the train and I-95...perfect for commuters. 12 Sandy Hill Terrace features the trifecta of natural gas, city water, and public sewer, enhancing both convenience and efficiency. This is a must-see home for anyone seeking a spacious home in an incredible location. Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy the best of Westport living!

Discover this exceptional, cozy abode nestled in a coveted location just a leisurely stroll away from the beach. Boasting its very own charming guest cottage and delightful in-ground pool, this residence offers unparalleled warmth and hospitality, and promises to be a haven of relaxation and entertainment for all who visit. Steeped in history dating back to 1803, and most recently updated in 2015, this residence seamlessly blends old-world charm with contemporary conveniences tailored for today's lifestyle. The main house boasts a gorgeous kitchen, sunken living room with original beams, 2 fplcs, wideboard flooring, four inviting bedrooms and three full baths, accompanied by a picturesque sunroom that offers captivating views of the tranquil pool area. Additionally, the separate cottage features its own full bath, presenting versatile opportunities as an in-law suite, private guest space, a serene home office, a tranquil yoga studio, or an inspiring artist workspace. Experience the epitome of Westport beach living in this unparalleled sanctuary, offering a unique blend of charm, comfort, and convenience. Welcome to your extraordinary new place to call home.

**Westport Estate Sale!!** Bring your Design Ideas to Life with this 3 Bedroom, 1.5 Bath Saugatuck Raised Ranch Set on .41 Acres. Light Filled Living Room & Dining Area with Fireplace. Nice Hardwood Floors Throughout! High Ceiling, Dry Basement with a Framed Out Half Bath. Basement is Just Waiting to be Finished for Additional Living Space. 1 Car Attached Garage.   Wonderful Location for Commuters! WALK to the Westport Train Station or Hop onto I-95. Less than one Hour to NYC by Road or Rail.   WESTPORT AMENITIES Include: Award Winning Top Rated Public and Private Schools!! Beautiful Resident Beaches, Boating, Parks, Golf, Restaurants, Shopping, Museums, Theatre, Concerts, And So Much More!!   This Home Does Needs Some Work and Remodeling BUT it is WELL WORTH the EFFORT!! Enjoy ALL that Westport has to Offer at an Affordable Price.

A Waterfront Estate That Lives Like a Private Resort. Few homes offer this rare blend of privacy, elegance, and waterfront access-just minutes from downtown Westport. Located at the end of a private lane in Westport's most sought after waterfront enclave, this estate is a haven for those who demand more from life. Wake to panoramic water views. Step outside to your own deep-water dock. Entertain on a grand scale with a sunlit patio, sparkling pool, and walled gardens. Indoors, vaulted ceilings, a glass-wrapped sunroom with fireplace, and seamless living spaces create an atmosphere of relaxed sophistication. Whether you're hosting a summer soiree, enjoying quiet evenings by the fire, or setting out by boat on a whim, this home gives you the freedom to live beautifully. Everything you need is here-and everything else is just minutes away. Live where others vacation. Own what few can.

listings.remarks: A rare offering, this remarkable Frazier Peters stone home is a masterful blend of historic character and timeless elegance, set impressively at the top of Charcoal Hill on 2.3 breathtaking acres of fully-gated privacy. Obsessively maintained and reimagined by the current owners, the home was designed with Peters' signature use of native stone, rich wood, and artisan detail, making the residence feel both enduring and warmly livable. Inside, soaring vaulted ceilings, hand-hewn finishes, and sunlit rooms create spaces that invite both grand entertaining and intimate moments. Multiple living areas flow effortlessly to the outdoors, where endless gardens unfold into meandering pathways, quiet terraces, and vibrant seasonal color. At the heart of the grounds is a sparkling pool and fully-outfitted stone pool house, a perfect retreat for summer days. A 4-car heated stone garage off the elegant belgian block driveway also offers a finished upper level, allowing flexibility for a future studio, office, or guest space. Every corner of the property reveals another place to gather, from sunny stone patios to Japanese gardens under shady awnings, all surrounded by lush plantings, offering a sense of escape yet is so close to all that the vibrant town of Westport has to offer. This home is more than a residence-it is a sanctuary of history, beauty, and possibility, where the craftsmanship of a bygone era meets the comforts of today.

A wonderful lifestyle awaits at Whitney Glen, where maintenance worries melt away and peaceful living takes center stage. Nestled in the heart of Westport, this serene condominium offers the perfect blend of tranquility and convenience-just a short stroll to Winslow Park, Trader Joe's, CVS, and a vibrant mix of dining and wellness hotspots like SoulCycle, Row House, Solidcore, and more. Step inside this sun-drenched, spacious condo and you'll immediately notice the thoughtful updates: sleek new flooring adds warmth and style, vaulted ceilings and expansive windows create an airy, open feel, and a charming balcony invites morning coffee or evening unwinding. A cozy loft hideaway offers the perfect nook for reading or relaxing, while the kitchen and living/dining areas flow beautifully-anchored by modern appliances (all less than four years old) and a WiFi-enabled thermostat for smart, energy-efficient comfort. The bedroom and bath offer a calming retreat, and there's even a private storage area designated just for this unit. Ideal for "snowbirds" or anyone craving a lock-and-leave lifestyle, this home offers the freedom to come and go without the stress of maintaining a larger property. One resident must be 62 years or older-making it a perfect fit for those seeking comfort, community, and convenience. Additional 150 sf walk in attic storage.

listings.remarks: Once-in-a-Generation Historic Estate set on a most coveted stretch of Fairfield County's Gold Coast, with a remarkable provenance as a former Bedford family estate. This extraordinary property is a rare offering that blends timeless architecture with iconic waterfront living. With sweeping views of Long Island Sound, the home's stately presence is matched only by its stunning 3.55 acres of parklike grounds and over 200 feet of waterfront, including a waterfront pool, well-equipped pool house, and 3-bedroom guest cottage. Approach through the gated stone walls and travel the tree-lined drive, enjoying the unfolding Sound views. Rich with original character, the main residence evokes the grace of a bygone era with leaded glass windows, impressive millwork, and grand gathering spaces featuring soaring ceilings designed to showcase the breathtaking views. Included in the home's magic is this wonder: a sailing ship imported from England, reconstructed on site to create a one-of-a-kind study. Generations have hosted parties on these magnificent grounds, enjoyed quiet mornings by the seawall or spent a day boating from the mooring off its private beach. This former longtime home of Lucie Bedford and her husband, Briggs Cunningham - race car driver and America's Cup winner - is a landmark opportunity to own a storied piece of Westport's history along prestigious Beachside Avenue. A one-of-one opportunity to carry on this legacy of luxury and history at this iconic waterfront estate.

Front door opens to spacious entry, that greets one with an amazing open- plan main floor, flooded with light with views of the stunning back yard.The Chef's kitchen has custom cabinetry, floating shelves & professional grade appliances.. Striking marble counter & center island top are complemented by glass tile backsplash.Large island has sink and cabinetry on both sides with seating for 4.The kitchen opens to a spacious dining room with trey ceiling rimmed by lighting. The dining room in turn opens to a seating area with sliding doors to a stone patio & garden as well as a beautiful family room with gas fireplace , built-ins & a vaulted ceiling. One step down is a separate area with heated floor tiles, surrounded by glass sliders & doors. The formal living room boasts an original oversized bay window & dramatic wall with FP & built in dry bar. A sun room on the other side of entry hall, has vaulted ceiling, ceiling fan and glass sliding doors. This room leads to the heated 2 car garage. The upper level boasts a primary suite and 3 more bedrooms and full bath. There are hardwood floors through out the house.  Lower level has finished rec room, cedar closet and utility room. Charm galore, sun drenched main floor and a beautiful professionally landscaped half acre make this a house you won't want to leave!

Features include refinished hardwood floors, custom trim and doors, designer lighting, nickel-gap ceilings, and two private landscaped courtyards ideal for indoor-outdoor living. Spacious living room with wood-burning fireplace and custom stone hearth opens to garden courtyard. Updated eat-in kitchen with new stainless appliances, gas cooktop, wall oven/microwave, and new flooring. Serene primary suite with vaulted ceiling, dual custom walk-in closets, private patio, and spa-quality bath with soaking tub, walk-in shower, double vanity, and premium fixtures. Second full bath fully renovated with radiant heated floors. Redesigned laundry room, tankless water heater, and freshly painted interiors including attached two-car garage. Finished lower level offers flexible space plus storage. Harvest Commons amenities include heated pool and Har-Tru tennis courts. Turnkey, single-level luxury living in the heart of Westport.

listings.remarks: Another opportunity on one of Westport's most desirable streets! This Antique gem has been lovingly cared for by the same family for 31 years. It underwent massive renovations in 2017. Some walls were removed to create a beautiful open gourmet kitchen which opens to a charming Family Room with fireplace. There is also a front living room with pretty builtins. All three full baths have been updated. The hall bath on the second floor features radiant heat in the floor. This gem also offers Central Air throughout the home. Outside there is a large stone patio-perfect for entertaining al fresco surrounded by beautiful gardens and specimen trees. And if all of this is not enough there is a one car garage and a driveway that accommodates two more cars. Walk to everything that downtown Westport offers! This is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy the charm of yesteryear melded with today's lifestyle and conveniences! NOTE: BEST AND FINAL TODAY 1/12 AT 5 PM

listings.remarks: Stylish. Sunlit. Seamless.  Set on a private, level acre on one of Westport's most desirable streets, this turn-key 4-bedroom, 3-bath home blends modern updates with everyday comfort. Fully renovated and move-in ready, it features a bright open layout with oversized windows, custom kitchen with quartz counters and stainless appliances, and French doors that open to a new private deck-perfect for entertaining or unwinding.  Enjoy a newly refreshed sunroom, rich natural light throughout, and thoughtful upgrades including a new roof, windows, skylights, flooring, recessed lighting, solid doors, trim, and fencing. The lower-level 4th bedroom with full bath is ideal for guests, in-laws, or an au pair suite.  Located in the heart of Long Lots-walk to schools, bike to the train, and just minutes from Compo Beach, Main Street, and all Westport has to offer.  The work is done. Just move in and enjoy.

Luxury Living on the Fairfield/Westport Border. "Sturges Manor" is an exceptional 6-bedroom, 8-bath estate that offers a rare combination of privacy, elegance, and resort-style amenities - just minutes from the Post Road and 50 miles from NYC. Enjoy multiple town centers and restaurants. The house features expansive, sun-filled interiors ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Recently refreshed with new paint and carpeting, the home includes a formal living and dining room, a large eat-in kitchen, and generously sized family spaces throughout. The finished lower level is designed for wellness and fun, with a 6-person sauna, steam shower, and a spacious game/media room. A third-floor flex space offers the perfect spot for a yoga studio, home office, or quiet retreat. The outdoor experience is equally impressive: a heated saltwater pool and spa, tranquil ponds, a cascading waterfall, and lush manicured lawns set the tone for relaxed luxury. Entertain with ease using the fully equipped outdoor kitchen and fire pit, or shoot hoops on your basketball court. Additional highlights include a full gym, wine cellar, elevator servicing all levels, and two separate 3-car garages-ideal for collectors. A pre-paid landscaping contract through 2031 ensures the grounds remain pristine year-round. Close proximity to some the CT's best private and public schools. This is an extraordinary opportunity to enjoy the best of Fairfield County in a setting that feels like a private resort

Welcome to Indian River Green! Located in a private community of 20 Townhouse Style Units in the desirable Saugatuck neighborhood with walk to train convenience. Beautiful Open Concept design with custom kitchen which features skylights, vaulted ceiling, corian countertops and tile backsplash. The dining room has built -in bookcases and opens to the spacious Living Room which boasts a fireplace, built-ins, vaulted ceiling and sliders that access your private patio. Private half bath with laundry along with sunlit entry foyer complete the main level. As you walk up the light and bright staircase you are greeted to the Primary Bedroom Suite which showcases a high ceiling, sliders to a wonderful upper balcony/deck and beautiful full bath. The second Bedroom has a vaulted ceiling with an ensuite full bathroom. A wrap around entry porch and private 1 car garage complete this attractive home. Just minutes to the heart of downtown shopping and beaches with easy access to the train and I-95. Enjoy all that the Westport lifestyle has to offer. The perfect place to call home!

listings.remarks: Step into a world of moon dances and magic at 21 Maplewood Avenue, Westport, CT. This beautifully renovated home sings with sophistication and modern charm and character, offering a boutique-like living experience that resonates with timeless melodies. Unparalleled workmanship, led by award winning female builder and team who envisioned, created and completed a massive renovation thoughtfully touching every major component of the home. New siding, roof, gutters, windows (where needed), energy efficient electric heat pump HVAC system all add to the integrity of the existing structure. The redesigned layout resulted in a sun filled foyer with direct line of sight to the oversized, over-the-sink kitchen window highlighting the private back deck and garden. With a now seamless interior flow, including new first floor bedroom suite, wide plank white oak flooring, elevated lighting fixtures throughout, this team created a like-new construction experience. Flexible spaces offer a plethora of possibilities to suit every lifestyle need. The repurposed and customized gourmet kitchen with high end appliances sets a culinary stage. Outside, find your own oasis, offering tranquility and a perfect spot for intimate moments or lively get-togethers. This home is where the days like this, come to life, creating a harmonious blend of modern luxury and lyrical inspiration. Imagine a bright side of the road existence while taking a short walk to all cultural experiences that Westport offers.

Welcome to "The Village" as this lovely neighborhood in Westport is known by long time homeowners. This cape cod style home sits on a flat .25 acre lot on the cul de sac. Opportunity awaits for builders to take advantage of this great location and build a dream home either for you or for a client that has been looking for a terrific lot. If you are an end user and have been renting and waiting for the right home that you can move into... and remodel into your dream home at your own pace, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for! This home features great bones and was a family home that has stood the test of time and use! There is a living room and kitchen on the main floor. There are 2 bedrooms on the main floor and one full bathroom. Upstairs there are two bedrooms. The basement is full and unfinished. This is an opportunity for someone to be able to own a home in Westport and enjoy the beaches, highly rated schools, the arts, dining and shopping and beautiful lifestyle Westport is known for! The home is being sold "as is".

109 Morningside Drive South is an exceptional and rare offering in the highly sought- after Greens Farms neighborhood in Westport CT. Spanning 12.3 acres, this expansive property presents a unique opportunity to create a one-of-a-kind estate in one of Fairfield county's most desirable locations. Nestled amongst prestigious homes, this property offers endless potential for those seeking to build something special. Whether you envision a grand single-family residence or a private compound, the parcel provides an extraordinary canvas for your vision.

Located on highly desirable Guyer Road, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath plus bonus room home is being offered for the first time since 1980. Guyer Road is a quiet horseshoe street with limited traffic and a central Westport location offering convenient access to town, beaches, schools, and shopping. Originally part of an onion farm, the neighborhood was developed in the mid-to-late 1950s, and many homes have since been renovated, expanded, or rebuilt. This home is positioned in the valley section of the street on a .51-acre lot and offers a flexible floor plan with multiple living spaces, including a living room, dining room, and family room. One bedroom was created from the former garage and features its own exterior entrance, offering options for an office, guest area, or conversion back to garage space. The property offers an excellent opportunity for renovation, personalization, expansion or new build. Four bedrooms, two full baths, and a spacious lot provide a solid foundation for future improvements. A rare opportunity to purchase a home on Guyer Road, where properties do not often come on the market.

Winner of the 2025 HOBI Award for "Best In Town Spec Home" in CT! Exceptional new construction, on a quiet cul-de-sac, in one of Westport's most desirable neighborhoods. Walk to Post Road shops, restaurants, Winslow Dog Park, Main Street, Library & Levitt Pavilion. Only 3 miles to train! This stunning home offers 6 bedrooms, 5 full and 2 half baths across 4 finished floors. Features include a Gunite pool with automatic safety cover, a large, flat, fenced in, private yard with walk-out lower level, full house generator, EV charging outlet, and city water, sewer, and natural gas. Traditional layout with modern, high-end finishes and an abundance of natural light. Built by multi-award-winning Westport Family Homes.

listings.remarks: One of the most sought-after walk-to-town neighborhoods in Westport, presents a stately charmer on 8 Washington Ave. Enjoy the splendor of an era gone by with original Victorian architectural details including hard wood flooring, carved mahogany stair banister, detailed window trim and expansive back porch overlooking an oversized garden. This five-bedroom home on three levels offers the walk to town convenience that draws city folk to enjoy country living. A sun filled home, this property presents the ability to move right in the freshly painted and lovingly maintained home with legal assessory dwelling above the garage. A flexible layout provides a first-floor guest suite with full bath, an open kitchen great room, a formal living room with fireplace and utilitarian mud room. The second level boasts three amply sized bedrooms sharing a large bath and a full finished level on the third floor could be enjoyed as a primary suite, guest suite or open play space. Town applies taxes on a small portion of the livable space on this level while one can truly enjoy the use of a robust area with sleeping and living space with a full bath. The detached garage has a partially finished space that could be converted back to a second bay while a full apartment flaunts the second level, adding great value creating an income producing option. Charm, character and ability to add your personal touches, this walk-to-town gem is an investment in a future of loving life here.

Timeless New England Colonial on 1.3 acres blending historic architecture with modern updates. Built in 1860 and reimagined by designer Dan Barsanti with curated interiors by Rena Levine, this five-bedroom, five-bath residence features refined millwork, wide-plank floors, and bespoke lighting. The open main level includes a bright kitchen with premium appliances, dining area, and living room with French doors to a bluestone patio and heated pool. A first-floor suite provides flexible guest or office space; the upper level hosts a spacious primary suite, marble bath, and dressing area. Systems include upgraded HVAC, EV-ready garage, and smart-home controls. Set on 1.3 acres with mature landscaping and a fenced backyard. Just 1 mi to Compo Beach, 0.9 mi to Longshore Golf Club, 1.0 mi to Levitt Pavilion, and 1.1 mi to Downtown Westport shops and dining. Offered furnished with curated designer pieces for a move-in experience rarely available in Westport.

A Westport treasure, this c.1900 beauty enchants with timeless charm and a magical warmth. Once the homestead of one of Westport's largest onion farms, you may still find one growing wild on the lawn. The wrap-around screened porch is perfect for summer mornings or unwinding at sunset. Inside, sunlit living spaces are filled with original character, and the chef's kitchen offers high-end appliances, wine fridge, and a breakfast nook set in a bank of windows. Listed on Westport's historic inventory (but not registry-restricted), the home offers flexibility for expansion or renovation. Outside, enjoy a large, level double lot on a peaceful cul-de-sac-ideal for lawn games, gardening, or a pool. The detached garage does not currently have living space above, but there's ample room to expand or add a guest cottage, office, or gym. Bordered by stone walls, and just minutes from the beach, train, and town-this is a rare chance to own a piece of Westport history.

Thoughtfully designed for both luxury and everyday ease, it offers the rare flexibility of a first or second floor ensuite primary bedroom. Rebuilt in 2005, further renovated in 2015, and featuring a showstopping new kitchen in 2022, this home is truly move-in ready. The kitchen is a chef's dream with quartz countertops, a spacious island, crisp white cabinetry, and top-tier Wolf and Subzero appliances. Designed for seamless living, the home flows effortlessly between spaces to relax, entertain, or work from home. An elevator connects the garage level to the first and second floors for added convenience. A large great room on the second floor is ideal as a gym or secondary family room. The 1-acre property is a private retreat, with mature landscaping by a renowned NY architect, including specimen trees, ornamental grasses, stone walls, & an ADA-compliant walking path. A level yard provides the perfect space for lawn games. The showpiece 50-foot gunite saltwater pool w/spa,is surrounded by a generous patio, while an additional terrace off the kitchen and family room offers multiple areas for dining and lounging. Set on a quiet cul-de-sac within walking distance of top-rated middle and high schools, this location offers the best of town and tranquility. A full-house generator ensures uninterrupted comfort. Don't miss the opportunity to make this extraordinary property your own.

listings.remarks: Beautifully renovated and impeccably decorated 3 bed, 2 bath condo located on the border of Westport and Norwalk in the desirable Birchwood complex. Set at the highest point in the community, this unit offers peaceful treetop views with a glimpse of the water in the distance, a rare and special setting! This spacious home lives entirely on one level and features gleaming hardwood floors, a cozy wood-burning fireplace, and new Andersen windows that flood the space with natural light. The open concept living and dining areas flow effortlessly to a private balcony, perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The updated kitchen and baths are move-in ready, while 3 generously sized bedrooms offer comfort and flexibility. Additional highlights include an attached one-car garage, private storage space, and access to the community pool. Unbeatable location: Walk to Whole Foods, enjoy quick access to downtown Westport, and benefit from an easy commute via nearby train and highways. A rare opportunity to enjoy low-maintenance, stylish living in one of Fairfield County's most convenient and connected areas.

listings.remarks: Beautifully renovated vintage home offers timeless character on a professionally landscaped acre in coveted Old Hill. With 5 bedrooms, 5 full and 2 half baths with generous space and classic charm. The formal living room and elegant library both with fireplaces and hardwood floors create a warm and welcoming space for relaxing and entertaining. A spacious kitchen featuring a large center island, high-end appliances and seamless flow to the inviting family room with fireplace overlooks the grounds. The first floor also includes a private home office and a guest bedroom with en suite bath-perfect for visitors or multigenerational living.Upstairs, the serene primary suite includes a sitting area, dressing room and en suite bath with soaking tub. Two additional bedrooms each with bath complete the second floor. There is a large light-filled studio/bedroom ideal for long term guests or a private retreat above an attached 3-car garage. Outdoors, there are patios for sunning, a space for grilling and luxurious gunite pool with pergola. This home has been thoughtfully updated with modern amenities creating a truly special place to call home.

Location, Location, Location! 7 Buena Vista Drive, is a rare and exceptional property in one of Westport's most sought-after beach neighborhoods. This prime 0.18-acre property sits at the top of Compo Hill and offers incredible views of the Long Island Sound. It is the perfect canvas to build your dream home just moments from the shoreline, where you can enjoy coastal living at it's finest. Located on a quiet, tree-lined cul du sac surrounded by upscale residences, this coveted address seamlessly combines the tranquility of beachside life with convenient access to Westport's vibrant downtown area, top-rated schools, and commuter routes. Whether you're envisioning a modern coastal retreat or a timeless New England classic, 7 Buena Vista Drive presents a unique chance to create a personalized sanctuary in an unbeatable location. The house is being sold as is.

Welcome to Island Life, a truly coveted experience on Saugatuck Island! This home offers breathtaking water views from nearly every room of this sophisticated yet modern beach house. This spacious and airy home is drenched in sunlight, featuring a great room with an open floor plan. The timeless kitchen boasts professional-grade appliances, quartz counters, and a large outdoor porch perfect for alfresco dining. The third-floor rooftop deck provides breathtaking water views of Long Island Sound, and with an outdoor gas fire pit and grill hook-up, rooftop entertaining is effortless. Inside, the third-floor wet bar is ideal for guest gatherings, or it can be utilized as a family room or even a fifth bedroom. This four-bedroom, five-bath home includes a luxurious primary bedroom suite with a spa bath, two walk-in closets, and a delightful Juliet balcony for lounging and enjoying the water views. Additional features include: FEMA compliant, 9-foot ceilings, full house generator, Lutron Lighting, outdoor shower and elevator ready. Enjoy the private neighborhood beach of Saugatuck Island, just steps away. This home is also conveniently located only minutes from Metro North, I-95, and Downtown Westport.

An incredible opportunity has become available to purchase a much-loved, solid home on excellent property in a sought-after location. One of the most exciting new listings to hit the Westport market in months- a scenic, usable 1.25 acres on a beautiful street of high-value homes is the setting for this spacious Colonial. This timeless floor plan offers gracious rooms, hardwood floors in many areas and upgraded thermopane windows. The large front-to-back living room has a fireplace, and an oversized dining room. The kitchen overlooks a gorgeous backyard & flows through to a large family room/alternative dining room w/vaulted ceiling & access to a deck. A main level play/rec room or office is an unexpected bonus, and the full bath on this level adds flexibility to the use of space. Upstairs are four generously-sized bedrooms. The primary suite has large closets and an en-suite bath. The walk-out lower level has an additional finished recreation/play room w/access to the backyard. An attached two car garage, central air, mature trees and landscaping all add to the appeal. Westport is one of the most coveted communities with commuter rail access to NYC, award-winning schools, treasured beaches & recreation, sophisticated shopping, dining, the arts and much more. You have been waiting for a terrific opportunity to become available...and this is the one. *** final offer is due by Monday, November 10, 2025 at 6 PM.*+

Set in the heart of Westport, 23 Bridge Street offers a rare opportunity to own a character-rich home at a price point that is increasingly hard to find in town. Ideally located just minutes from the Metro-North Railroad train station, this property delivers exceptional everyday convenience for commuters and weekend explorers alike. The home borders over 1.5 acres of town-owned open space, a truly rare feature in this part of Westport so close to the center of town. An in-ground pool adds to the lifestyle appeal (pool photo is digitally rendered). Inside, the home is rich with antique barn-style character dating back to the early 1900s. Signature rooms include a dramatic great room with cathedral ceilings and a striking cobblestone fireplace wall, which flows seamlessly into an enclosed sunroom. At ground level, a walk-out offers exceptional versatility, featuring an additional bedroom, full bath, and partial kitchen. This property presents multiple paths forward: remodel in place, expand, or add an additional level. Plans are available for review, offering buyers a head start on unlocking the home's full potential. Surrounded by luxury shopping, renowned dining, and Westport's elevated lifestyle, this is a compelling opportunity to create long-term value in a premier location. Perfectly positioned minutes from Saugatuck Center, Compo Beach, Longshore Club Park, and downtown Westport-this is historical charm paired with modern convenience, 50 miles from NYC, Welcome Home!

Quintessential Connecticut home! This charming antique colonial 3BR/2BA home plus guest cottage, is nestled across from the Aspetuck River nature preserve and only 10 minutes from downtown Westport. Built in 1850,a historic landmark known as the Aaron Burr Adams home, this property has been tastefully restored to have today's modern conveniences, while maintaining its rich history & character. Gorgeous wide plank floors & exposed beams throughout. Enter through the gardened back patio to find the window-lined, eat-in chefs kitchen leading to a charm-filled dining room adorned w/sconces & fireplace. Adjacent is a cozy den/tv room & a spacious sun-filled living room w/fireplace. First floor primary BR w/3 exposures, vaulted ceilings, & massive fireplace, plus large bathroom w/washer/dryer. Upstairs there are 2 additional sunny bedrooms w/views of the Aspetuck River & full bath. Sitting on over 1.2 acres, this large property is surrounded by mature trees, lovely gardens, and boasts a beautiful back lawn. The patio is perfect for entertaining & al fresco dining. Enjoy a book in the hammock, a cozy fire in the firepit, or head to the gorgeous Westport beaches for sun and sand. There are 2 additional structures on the property, a newly rebuilt 2-car garage w/electric charger & a studio/cottage w/breathtaking views of the Aspetuck River. The studio cottage (an extra 275 sqft not included in the 1792) has been recently renovated and includes a sleeping loft, full bath and kitchenett.

When Location and Lifestyle matter... Move-in-ready 2024 construction with direct water views located in the heart of Westport's Compo Beach. Designed by renowned award-winning architect Peter Cadoux, this home is more than just a place to live; it is a spectacular sanctuary designed to enhance every aspect of coastal living. The commitment to luxury is apparent in every detail from the unparalleled architectural design to the meticulous construction customized specifically to withstand the coastal environment. The interior features a bright open layout showcasing expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the rooms w/ natural sunlight and offer breathtaking water views from every angle. Complete w/ 4 bedrooms and 3 full baths, this home offers an ideal level of comfort and privacy. Architect Cadoux's talent shines in the way he cleverly maximizes space and functionality, creating a layout that lives much larger than its physical dimensions. The outdoor area is a seaside oasis w/ secluded backyard, heated pool, and must see in person expansive rooftop deck w/ mesmerizing water views, amble room for hot tub, and is perfect for entertaining, sunbathing, or enjoying evening sunsets. Additional features include smart home technology, an elevator that connects all levels, a 2-car garage, and backup generator. With its prime Westport location just steps from the marina, and beach this property offers an unparalleled lifestyle that is extraordinary, prestigious and serene

listings.remarks: Welcome to Westport Beach Life! This pleasing expanded cape is located just 1.4 miles to the Westport train station, minutes to the center of Westport's shops and restaurants, and a walk to the beach. This home was thoughtfully remodeled in 2015 to add two bedrooms, a finished basement, and a kitchen featuring an open dining/kitchen area. Bedroom/workspace on main floor. Primary bedroom and two bedrooms on upper level. Finished lower level includes laundry and full bath. Many ways to envision space for work/play options. The backyard is a cozy paradise with a deck, stone fireplace, seating area, and flat yard. Move in just in time to enjoy all that coastal Westport offers!

Nestled within a picturesque enclave of distinguished luxury homes in Westport's coveted Greens Farms neighborhood, you'll know you've arrived as mature, stately hedges guide you down a flowering, tree-lined driveway. This Hampton-style home has been masterfully reimagined and updated by its current owners. It sings with natural light, refined millwork, custom moldings, and offers an elegant blend of classic craftsmanship with today's modern comforts. Every room invites a sense of grace and tranquility, while still offering impressive scale and presence. The generously proportioned public rooms showcase walls of windows. The Study is cozy and richly appointed. The white Eat-in Kitchen is just wonderful and opens to the Family Room and has French doors to the patio. Thoughtful details abound: 4 fireplaces, rich paneling, and finely crafted built-ins offer warmth and character throughout. All ensuite, this 5/6 bedroom home offers a charmed lifestyle that exudes versatility and privacy. The walkout lower level includes an oversized recreation room, pool changing room (or bdrm 6), and generous storage. Step outside and enjoy resort-like living with an oversized pool and spa, a ground level and elevated patio, and the most magnificent 1 acre backdrop of matures trees, bushes, and flowers. Ideally located just minutes from Westport's beaches, boutiques, and restaurants, and only a short sidewalk stroll to GFS, "The Hedges on Morningside" - I can't wait to show you this beauty.

Modern, Antique Colonial on .58 acres across from Winslow Dog Park and on the corner of Raphael Rd cul-de-sac. Main level has: Kitchen, Dining area, Living Room w/FP, Office, Family Room, Full Bath and Screened In Porch with wood stove, and Mudroom/Laundry. Upper level has Primary Suite with Full Bath, Walk In closet and Gym. There are also 2 other bedrooms and 1 full bathroom on the Second Floor. The Third Floor has a playroom and storage. Kitchen and all Bathrooms have been updated. One of the most convenient locations in Westport-Walk to Compo Shopping Center, Dog Park, Trader Joes and lots more!

Nestled in Westport's coveted Old Hill neighborhood, this stunning residence blends classic Colonial design w/modern amenities. You're greeted by the centerpiece of the home - an impressive foyer w/soaring ceilings. The spacious office w/lacquer-finished built-ins includes a fireplace and access to the veranda. For more intimate gatherings, go through the French doors to a sitting room, w/pocket-door to the wet bar. Or head to the main open-floor plan for the kitchen, dining, and living rooms. The chef's kitchen boasts an expansive Marble and Farrow & Ball island, Miele dishwashers, ovens, and warming drawer, Thermador fridge, Viking range, large walk-in pantry, and bay window seating. Easily sit ten in the dining area. From the living room, access the veranda, complete w/grill, built-in speakers, and ceiling fans. Plenty of room to play in the beautiful fenced in yard, w/curated plantings in bloom Apr-Oct. Upstairs, the massive primary suite includes a wood-burning fireplace, terrace, ensuite bath w/heated floors and two walk-in closets. The walk-ins include special surprises and numerous built-ins. 3 other large beds, 2 full baths, and laundry room complete this floor. Ascend to the upper level, w/large finished room, huge 5th bed, & full bath w/walk-in closets. Features: 9ft ceilings, 3-car garage, numerous smart-home features, Lutron lighting, irrigation system, custom millwork, whole-house generator, wetlands-free 1.07 acres. Extraordinary, meticulous, move-in ready.

listings.remarks: Set in Westport's prime Coleytown neighborhood on a sun-filled 2-acre property is this striking, recently-built home with a stylish blend of transitional and modern elements. Architectural highlights include a graphite-colored exterior with oak trim, sleek Marvin casement windows, artisan-style galvanized gutters and smoked-glass garage doors, plus a sprawling, level property with Gunite pool and spa surrounded by stunning new low stone walls and bluestone terrace. The gorgeous glass front door leads to the dramatic foyer, floating staircase, oversized windows, custom wood finishes and wide-plank oak floors, enhancing the sun-filled layout. The gourmet cook's kitchen is outfitted with premium appliances, an oversized island, sleek quartz counters, a walk-in pantry and custom cabinetry with a built-in three-zone beverage fridge. Designed for entertaining, this space flows into a spacious living room featuring a two-sided fireplace that connects to a sunroom/dining room and an ensuite bedroom/office. Upstairs are four additional spacious bedrooms, including the primary suite, with a luxurious bath with soaking tub, offering tranquil views of the grounds. A beautiful 2nd floor office is tucked behind glass doors. The walk-out lower level boasts 9-foot ceilings and a media room, gym and playroom. This energy-efficient home features a 5-zone HVAC system, 19kW solar, 240V Level 2 EV charger and generator. Centrally located and just 1.3 mile to schools!

listings.remarks: Private getaway just 1 hour from NYC! Bathed in natural light and surrounded by mature landscaping, this 3-bedroom, 3.5 bath contemporary offers a rare blend of privacy, beauty and lifestyle. Set on 2 level acres with an oversized Har-Tru tennis court, the home features an open, airy floor plan with expansive windows that frame the natural surroundings. Vaulted ceilings and generous entertaining spaces flow seamlessly both indoors and out creating an inviting atmosphere. The kitchen is bright, spacious and perfect for daily life as well as entertaining with ample counter space, eating area and adjacent living space ready for your personal touch. The primary bedroom has a vaulted ceiling, seating area with modern fireplace, a full bath with jetted tub and a walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms, both en suite and a convenient laundry room complete the second floor. A finished lower level adds even more potential with room for recreation and home office. Whether you're a tennis enthusiast or simply seeking a peaceful, light-filled retreat with room to grow, this delightful residence offers exceptional promise in a picture-perfect setting.

HARBORFRONT - 175 ft of beautiful direct Westport waterfront. For the first time in over 50 years, this unmatched harborside home set on over an acre is ready to be enjoyed by new residents. Sited on Saugatuck Harbor, this classic four bedroom Colonial with wrap around porch holds 4000 +sqft of living space. The harbor to the front, the Saugatuck Yacht club to one side, a private and level backyard, and just a quick stroll over to the community beachfront area to the other side.The main level consists of a front to back great room, with a cottage style rotunda breakfast nook overlooking the water, a bright and spacious kitchen with center island and a warm and welcoming family room anchored by a river rock fireplace.There are formal living and dining rooms, a handsome office, a butler's pantry, oversized laundry room, a half bath and even a greenhouse by the rear facing deck! Upstairs, the primary suite has a water facing bedroom with a peaceful balcony, a large bath w shower, tub and water closet, a extra landing space w secondary stairs to the first fl office and double closets. Three family bedrooms and 2 full baths complete the upper level. There is a full LL with walk out to the backyard featuring a rec room, and plenty of storage. The three car garage & private driveway offers plenty of room for guests! The rolling front lawn is home to a party pavilion, perfect for gathering with friends and family to enjoy the sunsets and watch the boats!

Nestled on a peaceful private cul-de-sac in the heart of Westport, this delightful 3-bedroom, 2-bath home combines comfort, charm, and thoughtful updates! Step inside to find a sun-filled layout with a welcoming flow, perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The updated kitchen is a highlight, offering modern style and functionality with easy access to the dining and living areas. Central air, installed in 2019, ensures year-round comfort, while the 2018 Hardie Board siding adds lasting curb appeal. Other major updates include a new roof (2018) and furnace (2014), giving you peace of mind for years to come. Outside, enjoy a spacious yard with room to garden, play, or simply relax on warm summer evenings. Perfectly located just minutes from schools, shopping, restaurants, beaches, and commuting options, this home offers both privacy and convenience. A rare Westport gem ready to welcome its next happy chapter!

Located in a one of Westport's favorite neighborhood close to downtown Westport, schools, and commuter routes, this split-level gem offers both character and practicality.Discover the perfect blend of function and comfort in this split-level home. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms across approximately 2,258 square feet, this versatile layout is ideal for families. Step inside to a bright living area with a large bow window that fills the space with natural light. The open-concept kitchen and dining area opens directly onto an oversized deck - perfect for summer barbecues, morning coffee, or evening gatherings. From the deck, step down to a large, level backyard that offers plenty of room for play, gardening, or outdoor lounging. Upstairs, you'll find three spacious bedrooms. The lower level offers a cozy family room and full bathroom. There is an additional room off of the family room can be used as an additional bedroom or office. Several updates included freshly painted interior, exterior and deck in 2025; new stainless steel oven in 2025; new central air unit in 2024; new oil tank in 2023. Sewer is available on Stone Drive and can easily be connected. The sewer assessment is paid quarterly ($287.74). ALL OFFERS NEED TO BE SUBMITTED BY TUESDAY 8/5 by 8:00 pm!

WALK TO BEACH * WATER VIEWS * ROOM FOR A POOL This coastal gem sits on one of the largest lots near Compo Beach and has been thoughtfully renovated by skilled artisans and craftsmen, combining beachside charm with modern comfort. Located at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, the property features equestrian fencing leading to an oil-and-stone driveway and a flat, partially fenced yard with a spacious deck. Inside, the home offers generous rooms with high ceilings, two fireplaces, and an additional versatile room that can function as a fourth bedroom, au pair suite, or in-law apartment. The oversized kitchen features new appliances and a walk-in pantry, while a second-floor laundry/playroom adds convenience and flexibility. The primary suite impresses with a vaulted ceiling and private balcony. Additional highlights include central heating and air conditioning, fine millwork with shiplap walls, custom built-ins, modern vertical wood accents, and a rotating bookcase entry to the playroom. Owner-owned solar panels, installed in 2013, significantly reduce utility costs. Completing this coastal retreat is an outdoor shower, perfect for rinsing off after a day at the beach. Generous parking and ample yard space make it ideal for friends and family to enjoy year-round gatherings with quick access to nearby Compo Beach. Homes of this size and quality in this area are rarely available-this one is a must-see!

listings.remarks: Want to enjoy everything there is to love about the beach area, without the hassle of a flood zone? This home has everything you need. Perched at the top of Compo Hill, 4 Buena Vista Drive is a picture perfect colonial with water views and modern upgrades.This beautifully maintained home offers a traditional layout with high ceilings, arched doorways, and abundant natural light from the oversized windows. Thoughtful details include custom millwork, a butler's pantry, and spacious living/dining room great for entertaining. An open kitchen with high end appliances overlooks the family room with lots of custom built ins and a wood burning fireplace. Upstairs, the primary suite includes dual closets, wonderful water views, and a private deck creating a serene retreat. Primary bath has radiant heat. Three other upstairs bedrooms are spacious and flexible, including one with a Murphy bed for multipurpose use. In the lower level, there is a versatile hangout space and an additional bedroom which has access to a full bath. A generous mudroom for all your belongings, and 2 car tandem garage with lots of storage space rounds out this level. Enjoy the outdoors with a stone patio for dining, and admire the professional landscaping throughout the property. A whole-house generator and countless upgrades ensure comfort and peace of mind.

Presenting the latest SIGNATURE Home by SIR Development. 19 Twin Circle will feature an incredible showcase of luxury, w/ a natural organic vibe, set on a flat acre at the end of a cul-de-sac walking distance to Stapes High School or Bedford Middle School! Still time to customize and place your SIGNATURE on this new home. Dramatic glass-lined foyer & sun-splashed interiors. Incredible gourmet kitchen. Chic, oak-accented space has an exquisite honed Quartz island w/waterfall edges, Wolf & Sub-Zero appliances & a unique ceiling which highlights the designer lighting that is found throughout. Open flow plan to breakfast rm & through to the fam rm w/a fresh take on the classic coffer ceiling & a Venetian plaster, 60" linear gas fpl. Eye-catching steel & glass doors reveal a living room with oak accents & LED lighting. The DR has an illuminated stepped ceiling & butlers pantry leading to the kitchen. 1st floor office w/built-ins, 2 half baths & MR that leads to the EV ready 3 car garage. Upstairs, a dreamy primary suite w/vaulted ceiling, linear fpl & spa bath w/ radiant heated flrs. Sun drenched 3rd flr has a bonus rm, 2nd office & half bth. Walk-out LL has media rm, gym & 6th BR w/full bth. Private, flat yard has pergola w/motorized roof, salt water pool w/auto cover, outdoor shower, 3 bluestone patios & built-in grill. SIR is the leading Westport luxury homebuilder for 30+years.

The home of your dreams that exceeds every expectation awaits at this spectacular, like-new residence built w/the finest quality & elevated design. Perfectly sited on one of Long Lots' top cul-de-sacs behind a stone wall, the manicured acre w/saltwater gunite pool/spa offers a serene backdrop for this exceptional property. The impressive, soaring foyer w/exquisite millwork introduces interiors w/ 10-ft ceilings on the main level incl the grand LR w/modern marble fpl & DR w/architectural ceiling. Well-appointed library/home office w/built-ins, fireplace & French doors to side & rear porches. The show-stopping chef's kitchen dazzles w/custom cabinetry, marble counters & island, backsplash w/subtle bronze inlay, Sub Zero & Wolf appliances, walk-in pantry, butler's pantry to DR & sunlit dining area, flowing into the stunning fam rm w/French doors & gorgeous fireplace. Expansive rear hall w/full pool bath, mudroom w/ample storage, 3-car garage access, back stairs to 2nd & 3rd flrs. With 7 BRs, 8 full & 2 half baths, there is space for all. Luxe primary suite w/spacious BR, sitting area w/fpl, dressing rm, coffee bar, 2 incredible walk-in clsts, marble bath. Bonus rms on 2nd flr w/built-ins & 3rd flr w/climbing structure. Incredible LL w/media rm, gym, wine cellar, bar, game rm w/fpl, sauna. Resort-style property w/covered porch, pergola, firepit, outdoor kitchen & level lawns framing the 45-ft pool. Generator, Savant smart home system & much more. Impeccable & move-in ready.

Nestled on a quiet, picturesque cul-de-sac, this beautifully maintained home enjoys a prime Westport location-just steps from Staples High School and Bedford Middle School, with direct gated access for ultimate convenience. A short drive brings you to all the amenities Westport has to offer, from shopping and dining to beaches and vibrant town life. Set on a private, level acre, the outdoor spaces are truly exceptional. An expansive deck, dedicated fire-pit area, and fully fenced backyard create the perfect setting for entertaining, play, and year-round enjoyment. Inside, the classic and highly desirable layout features a welcoming two-story foyer, a dramatic great room with exposed beams, vaulted ceilings, and a wood-burning fireplace, an eat-in kitchen with a cozy sitting area, and an oversized dining room ideal for gatherings. The second floor includes all four bedrooms, highlighted by a spacious primary suite with vaulted ceilings, a walk-in closet, and a serene spa bath. The finished lower level offers flexible space for a playroom, gym, office, or all of the above-plus abundant storage. A rare combination of location, layout, and lifestyle-this one won't last.

A rare offering providing the best of both worlds! Enter through stone pillars to find this well built ranch set on large, professionally landscaped property in a multi-million dollar neighborhood near town, train and beach. A spacious front to back great room with wood burning fireplace, built-ins and hardwood floors under the carpet, features walls of windows overlooking the lovely property with mature landscaping. The light filled, custom eat-in-kitchen with Corian counters and wet-bar, provides access to stone patio, laundry area and basement. Three split en-suite bedrooms, one being configured as a den and one a library offers flexibility for family or guests. This "right sized" home is wonderful for entertaining because of the flow between large public rooms and patio, double entrance hall closets and extensive parking. Beautiful, spacious backyard with rock outcropping provides privacy and highlights the natural beauty of its surroundings. Home features hardwood floors, abundant closet space, central air conditioning, city water, 2021 roof and 2017 hot water heater. A detached 2 car garage provides ample room for storage in loft above. Great location near Longshore, Compo beach, transportation, Levitt Pavilion, shopping and restaurants. Great opportunity to renovate to your specifications or build new. Estate property being sold "As Is".   ****NOTE: Highest and best offers to be submitted by 12/14 at 5:00pm****

listings.remarks: Welcome to 1 Boxwood Lane, a private estate where timeless design meets a lifestyle centered on wellness, balance, &renewal. Set on a coveted quiet lane, the circular drive & stone walls introduce a sense of calm while sweeping lawns & specimen plantings create a serene, park-like environment worlds away from daily stress. Inside, sun-drenched interiors open seamlessly through French doors & expansive windows. The open layout encourages effortless living, anchored by a recently renovated custom Chef's Kitchen-perfect for nourishing gatherings & everyday enjoyment. Architectural details, intricate millwork, & graceful transitions between living & dining areas reflect craftsmanship rarely seen today. Once the studio of Norman Mason, each aspect of its design was in service to his art. Set on 1.26 acres overlooking Winslow Park, this charming home carries its history lightly and beautifully. The dramatic great room is anchored by an oversized fireplace, newly refinished hardwood floors and a special light that imbues the space with a certain atmosphere whether holding a dinner party for 20 or relaxing alone with a good book. Built in 2012 and maintained in pristine condition, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath residence offers the rare combination of newer construction quality and effortless coastal elegance, nestled just minutes from the sparkling shores of one of Westport's most coveted neighborhoods. Step inside to an open, airy floor plan bathed in natural light, where a spectacular great room and chef's kitchen flow seamlessly together - crisp whites, soothing blues, and natural textures creating a relaxed yet decidedly high-end atmosphere that simply lives beautifully. When the weather calls, the oversized porch becomes the true soul of the home - the perfect setting for morning coffee, evening gatherings, and the unhurried moments that define summer on the Connecticut shore. Upstairs, the primary suite redefines comfort with a private sitting room, home office, and a spa-inspired bath featuring heated floors, a heated towel rack, and a deep soaking tub - thoughtful luxuries that make every day feel like a getaway. With generous secondary bedrooms, meticulous finishes throughout, and a location that puts Compo Beach, Westport's beloved amenities, and Metro-North all within easy reach, this is coastal Connecticut living at its absolute finest.

Completing the first floor is a large, open living room with custom built-ins and oversized window, a central front to back foyer with direct access to enjoy the spacious bluestone patio and fully fenced back yard, and a shed for extra storage. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms and a flexible office or study provide room to grow, work, or unwind. A new boiler & HW tank. Absolutely impeccable in and out.

Well-proportioned rooms and seamless flow create a home that feels both comfortable and refined.
