An open kitchen with granite counters connects effortlessly to the dining room, offering an ideal setting for everyday living and relaxed entertaining. Three bedrooms and two full baths are arranged with privacy in mind. The primary suite includes a spacious bath, generous closet space, and an adjacent office, sitting room, or playroom. Two additional bedrooms with custom closet built-ins and a well-appointed hall bath complete the interior layout. Outdoor living is equally inviting. Wilton Road places you minutes from town and the shoreline.  At 234, convenience and privacy coexist. A turn onto a side lane and a set-back approach behind mature trees create a setting that feels distinctly separate from the street.  Originally built in 1884, the home has been fully renovated and thoughtfully expanded. A 2024 addition reshaped the main level, enlarging the kitchen and introducing a newly constructed family room anchoring the home. Tall ceilings, open sight lines, and abundant natural light create a sense of volume rarely found in homes of this era. It lives larger than its footprint.  The kitchen centers around an oversized island, with a cozy banquette tucked into the corner. A beverage bar and architectural wine display are seamlessly integrated. The flow from kitchen to family room to dining is open and intuitive. Sliders extend to an expansive stone patio with a built-in grill station and fireplace, creating an easy transition between indoors and out. An expansive lawn invites play, set within the safety of the private backyard. Upstairs, the primary suite features a private sitting room, boutique-style dressing room, and a light-filled bath with a soaking tub and glass-enclosed shower. Additional bedrooms are carefully arranged, including a private suite, offering flexibility for guests. Historic at its core and thoughtfully expanded for today. Set where Westport unfolds at your doorstep, and designed with the scale to fully enjoy it.

listings.remarks: This HIDDEN GEM is a recent Historic Preservation Award makeover of an early 1900's barn in-the-heart of Westport's sought-after Kings Highway Historic District. Nestled in one of the most picturesque in-town settings, the home's privacy will surprise you. In this quiet residence, wake up to a view of the red barn next door that was a speakeasy during Prohibition. The interior and exterior are accented with its authentic original barn beams; salvaged artifacts have been reused such as the barn door rails and horseshoes that re-attached the original rustic door to the front facade; and the fireplace from the early 1900s has its restored black wrought iron screens and andirons. Backyard privacy provides a tranquil view of an old-style fieldstone drywall. Here you will enjoy the best of the old, merged with the amenities of today.On the back porch, you can drop automated Phantom Screens at the press of a button on buggy evenings, and Sonos-connected speakers pipe your favorite music indoors and out wherever you entertain.  PLUS: an ENERGY EFFICIENT HVAC system with TANKLESS water heater / GE Cafe-equipped stainless kitchen with wall ovens / NATURAL GAS HEAT AND 6-burner cooktop and vent hood / roomy walk-in closets and second floor storage room / mud-room/laundry with stainless steel sink / wall-mounted TVs in living room and both upstairs bedrooms / security system / outdoor grill / attached 2-car garage with EV charger and more walled storage.

Step inside to find an open-concept layout featuring 2 cozy fireplaces, gleaming hardwood floors, a bright, updated eat-in kitchen complete w/ a spacious island, walk-in pantry & top-of-the-line appliances. With 4 bedrms & 3 full bths, this home provides plenty of room for family & guests. The primary suite is a true retreat, w/ an oversized walk-in closet & a spa-like bathroom w/a soaking tub, stall shower & double sinks. The heart of the home is the sunlit family room, where soaring ceilings & walls of windows frame sweeping water views. Step out onto the expansive Ipe deck w/sleek marine railings, the perfect spot for al fresco dining, birdwatching, or admiring stunning sunsets. The private, fenced yard features an outdoor shower, a whole-house generator, a 2-car garage, & enclosed storage. Embrace the coastal lifestyle w/ ease: stroll to nearby Canal Beach, launch your kayak or paddleboard, or set sail from the Cedar Point Yacht Club, a short walk from the home. And, when you're ready for a change of pace, Westport's vibrant downtown, gourmet dining, & boutique shopping are just minutes away.

listings.remarks: Whitney Glen, one of Westport's sought-after communities, is surrounded by mature trees & impeccably maintained grounds. This tranquil & serene end-unit condo offers the perfect blend of comfort & convenience. Located on the second floor, this 949-square-foot residence looks much larger thanks to its vaulted ceilings. Natural light pours in through the skylight, sliding glass doors, & large windows highlighting the hardwood, white oak floors throughout. The dining & living room (with its cozy, wood-burning fireplace), kitchen, bed & bath make up the main level. Conveniently located off the foyer are the washer & dryer. Step outside to one of two private decks, ideal for morning coffee or afternoon drinks. A spiral staircase leads to a loft with wood paneled walls. This flexible area offers endless possibilities-office, yoga studio, or guest retreat. It includes a full bath along with access to the attic. There is a huge storage room in the basement. Whitney Glen offers a heated, saltwater pool, open early in the season & extends into early autumn. Despite its peaceful setting, the location is incredibly convenient. Just a short walk to the Westport Country Playhouse, Winslow Park for dogs, CVS, Trader Joes, plus exceptional restaurants & shopping. One resident must be 62 years of age. HOA is $261/month, with an additional tax district of $638/quarter. A rare opportunity to enjoy low-maintenance living in the heart of Westport-where tranquility meets accessibility.

listings.remarks: Design Your Dream Home with an Award-Winning Builder. Step into a world of elegance and sophistication with a soon-to-be-built 6,660 sq. ft. masterpiece by Coastal Luxury Homes. Known for their innovative designs, sleek modern lines, and unparalleled craftsmanship, Coastal Luxury Homes has earned a reputation for creating some of the most sought-after residences. With a focus on prime location, architectural brilliance, meticulous site design, and quality construction, their homes redefine luxury living. This stunning estate is situated on over 6 acres of rare, coveted land in Westport's prestigious Hunt Club neighborhood-a location that hasn't been available for purchase in over fifty years. Coastal Luxury Homes has carefully secured and subdivided this private property into three custom estates, each offering a unique blend of privacy, tranquility and opulence. Blending cutting-edge architecture and state-of-the-art amenities, this home will be a true sanctuary. From the spa-inspired master suite to the open-concept living areas and seamless indoor-outdoor flow, every inch of this home will be designed for those who appreciate the finest in modern living.

Experience the pinnacle of luxury living in this exceptional 4,600 sq ft, 5-bedroom home, ideally located in highly sought-after Old Hill. Perfectly positioned on a pristine 1-acre lot, this stunning home offers a rare "walk-to-everything" lifestyle-just steps from shopping, top-rated restaurants, and Earthplace. Designed for both elegant entertaining and everyday comfort, the home features an open-concept floor plan enhanced by timeless architectural details and modern upgrades. Sun-drenched living spaces on the main level include a gourmet kitchen, formal living room, dining area, family room, office, and a versatile pool cabana or fitness room-all seamlessly opening to an expansive patio for effortless indoor-outdoor living. Two first-floor ensuite bedrooms provide flexible accommodations. Upstairs, the luxurious primary offers a private retreat, complemented by a large playroom, laundry room, and two additional bedrooms with a shared bath-creating a versatile layout. The resort-style outdoor setting is equally impressive, featuring a gunite pool with spa, pergola, fire pit, outdoor grill area, vegetable garden, and a fully integrated lighting and sound system. Mature, century-old trees, curated specimen plantings, and extensive stonework create a private, park-like oasis. For the buyer seeking privacy while being near all the amenities that Westport has to offer, this extraordinary property combines classic elegance, modern amenities, and an unbeatable location.

Welcome to Residence 102 at The Mill Westport, offering high-end luxury living with all the amenities of a fine custom home in the heart of downtown Westport. With a concierge on-site and approximately 10,000 square feet of spectacular interior and exterior amenity spaces such as The Great Room & Cafe, Pool, Health & Wellness Center, Patio & Rooftop Deck, residents will enjoy carefree, 5-star living. The 31 residences feature large windows, open floor plans, and light wood floors. Their refined details include a large waterfall-edged kitchen island, linear gas fireplaces, Sub Zero and Wolf appliances, full-size washer/dryers, and up-to-date bathrooms with radiant heated master bath floors. All homeowners have access to heated or covered parking. Set in a tranquil, residential neighborhood within walking distance of downtown Westport's many shops, restaurants, activities and close to beaches and commuting options to New York City. The redevelopment and adaptation of The Mill Westport into a luxurious residential property was undertaken by Coastal Luxury Homes and Gault Family Companies, two Westport-based firms with a proven track record of surpassing the highest expectations.

Just moments to Bedford Middle School, Staples High School, downtown Westport, trains, shopping, restaurants, Longshore, and Compo Beach, this property combines privacy, recreation, and convenience. The resort-style backyard features a pool with spa, expansive lounging areas, full outdoor kitchen, and a rare post-tension concrete tennis court - the premier surface used at elite clubs and college facilities. The gourmet chef's kitchen features high-end appliances, abundant workspace, and two dishwashers. Main-level highlights include elegant entertaining spaces, a private meditation room, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The primary suite is a retreat with a spa-inspired bath, steam shower, and dressing room with abundant closets. Rarely does a Westport luxury home offer resort-style amenities, premier tennis facilities, flexible living space, and walk-to-school convenience in such a private setting.

listings.remarks: Welcome to easy, carefree living in the heart of Saugatuck. This bright and efficiently designed 550 sq ft studio offers everything you need in one smart, comfortable space. The full kitchen is equipped with a range, refrigerator, dishwasher, and microwave, with durable tile flooring. The main living area features wall-to-wall carpeting, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere perfect for relaxing or working from home.  Even better - your rent includes heat, and hot water, helping to keep monthly expenses simple and predictable. A built-in AC wall unit is provided. Tenant is only responsible for electricity, cable and internet. Enjoy the convenience of shared laundry within the complex, and step outside to experience all that Saugatuck has to offer. You're just a short walk to the train, local restaurants, and coffee shops, with Longshore Club Park and Compo Beach just minutes away. The complex entrance is located at 490 Riverside Ave., and the unit includes one assigned off-street parking space.

Achilles, the home showcases a dramatic open floor plan filled with natural light and refined architectural detail across three beautifully finished levels. At the heart of the home is a stunning chef's kitchen featuring state-of-the-art appliances, custom cabinetry, and generous gathering spaces ideal for entertaining and everyday living. A private study provides the perfect work-from-home retreat, while the luxurious primary suite offers a serene escape with a spa-like bath and abundant closet space. One of Westport's premiere CUL-DE-SACS, WALKING DISTANCE TO ALL 3 SCHOOLS (Long Lots, Bedford, Staples), and 2.3 MILES TO GREENS FARMS TRAIN STATION, this beautifully renovated (2016/2017) 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath home perfectly blends modern luxury with timeless charm. Outside, your personal oasis awaits: a sprawling deck overlooks an inviting in-ground pool/spa, surrounded by lush greenery and a yard perfect for recreation. Unbeatable location complete with natural gas, public water, and easy access to vibrant shopping and dining. This isn't just a home-it's a lifestyle.

Ideally located on the Westport-Norwalk border, this sun-filled 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence offers a rare combination of privacy, natural beauty, and walkable access to everyday essentials, including Whole Foods just across the street. Sunlight fills the interiors, complemented by a long list of thoughtful updates and improvements that reflect a high level of care and meticulous maintenance throughout. A covered front porch sets a gracious tone on arrival, inviting quiet mornings and relaxed evenings, while the expansive rear deck and luxurious hot tub are perfectly suited for unwinding or gathering with friends. Ideally located just moments from town, with easy access to schools, parks, and daily amenities, you'll enjoy nearby tennis and pickleball courts at Town Farm Park, along with the dog park and open green space at Winslow Park for picnicking and easy recreation. Restaurants, shopping, and all that makes Westport so special are close at hand, creating an easy, enjoyable lifestyle in a truly inviting setting.

A sophisticated blend of past & present, this private sanctuary offers the ultimate in modern design in the heart of Westport. Designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living, the property features 5 BRs, 4.5 BAs, a separate guest house, expansive decking & a gunite pool set on private 1.35 acres. The home retains its massive original central chimney now the striking centerpiece of the open main level. The rooms flow seamlessly to the exterior gardens, while expansive walls of glass create a natural connection to the outdoors throughout the seasons. The spectacular 14' limestone kitchen island anchors the space alongside a limestone accent wall & a dramatic portrait window overlooking the patio, dining pavilion & pool. Each impeccably curated room showcases a refined juxtaposition of old & new, creating a cohesive, timeless aesthetic. The luxurious primary suite includes a stunning marble bath, dressing room & scenic views of the grounds. The finished walk-out lower level offers space for yoga, fitness, recreation, plus a walk-in natural stone wine cellar & pool changing room. Tiered steps lead to the pool terrace, ideal for lounging amid magnificent specimen trees and lush gardens. A separate guest house mirrors the organic warmth & texture of the main residence. Mature landscaping screens the fully fenced private level property in a prime Westport location within walking distance to Wakeman Farm, minutes to the train, beaches, shops, restaurants, schools, and other amenities.

Wake up to sunlight dancing across the water and end your day wrapped in the calm of coastal living. Nestled within Westport's coveted Hillspoint/Compo Beach enclave, this 1-bedroom, second-floor apartment offers direct waterfront living on the serene pond preserve - a peaceful retreat where every moment feels like a getaway.  Expansive walls of windows flood the almost 950 sq ft interior with natural light, framing water views at nearly every turn. Step outside to your private glass-paneled deck, where you can take in sweeping views of the water and sky or unwind as boats drift by the dock below.  Inside, thoughtful details enhance everyday comfort: a galley kitchen with built-in pantry, natural gas fireplace, in-unit washer/dryer, air-conditioning, and generous closet space throughout. A bonus room provides flexibility for a home office or reading nook, while a private stairway entrance and reserved parking space ensure ease and privacy.  Just beyond your door lies one of Westport's most charming neighborhoods - tranquil and tucked away, yet only a short stroll to Old Mill Beach, the Old Mill Grocery & Deli, and nearby Compo Beach. Enjoy morning coffee on the deck, launch a kayak from the dock, or catch the sunset over the Sound. With easy access to I-95, the train, and downtown Westport, convenience meets coastal serenity.  This home is more than a place to live - it's an invitation to slow down, breathe deeply, and savor the rhythm of the water.

An elevator connects multiple levels, providing ease and accessibility throughout the home, along with a finished basement offering approximately 1,500 square feet of additional living space. The open-concept floor plan is enhanced by abundant natural light, soaring ceilings, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The chef's kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, custom cabinetry, and premium finishes, opening beautifully to the main living and entertaining spaces. Step outside to a spacious deck perfect for outdoor dining, relaxing, and entertaining guests. Thoughtfully designed with both elegance and practicality in mind, this home offers modern luxury, low-maintenance living, and exceptional comfort in a desirable location. Prefer a lease of 2 years or longer, with rent including garbage collection, lawn care, and snow removal. Perfect for those seeking a sophisticated lifestyle with a first-floor primary bedroom, elevator access, luxury finishes, open floor plan, and bright contemporary living.

Of the 4 homes built at the end of this quiet and centrally located Westport cul-de-sac, this is the most expansive, and it's loaded with top-tier amenities. Entertain or hang out in style in gracious rooms curated by Susan Tracy Designs featuring a warm color palate, and not often found finishes like Venetian plaster and built-in hallway millwork. The open kitchen/family room is a wonderful place to cook, eat and live. It's bathed in natural light and features top-of-the-line appliances including two dishwashers, Thermador wine column, Elkay water dispenser and ultra convenient 2-drawer refrigerator in the scullery. The back of the house opens to a large wrap-around patio accessed from the kitchen eating area as well as the private office, all overlooking a beautiful yard and Signature pool. Once upstairs the Primary bedroom suite steals the show! Bright and airy with a cozy fireplace, huge closet and luxurious bath. Lots more to talk about like the spacious laundry room outfitted with two sets of stack washer/dryers or the lower-level gym with glass doors, or the pool cabana bath with changing area. The list goes on! Come see for yourself.

listings.remarks: Stunning custom-built residence, newly completed in 2024, set within one of Westport's most coveted enclaves. Impeccably designed, this home offers soaring ceilings, refined finishes, and exceptional craftsmanship throughout. At the heart of the home, a chef's kitchen features an oversized center island, Thermador appliance package, seamlessly opening to the dining room adorned with Thibaut wallpaper. The family room showcases vaulted ceilings, a Carrara marble gas fireplace, and French doors leading to the backyard and patio for effortless indoor-outdoor living. The main level also includes a formal living room, office, powder room, mudroom, and access to a three-car garage. Upstairs, the primary suite features vaulted ceilings, two oversized walk-in closets, and a spa-like bath with double vanities, soaking tub, and glass-enclosed shower. Three additional bedrooms, two full baths, and a spacious laundry room complete the second level. A finished third floor provides a versatile bonus room with full bath. The lower level features a media room, fitness space, second office, and ensuite guest suite. Professionally landscaped and fenced, the grounds offer privacy and a beautiful setting for outdoor living. Just minutes to Westport's beaches, shopping, dining and metro north for seamless access to NYC.

Welcome to 4 Cardinal Lane ~ a beautifully expanded and thoughtfully updated home set on two private, level acres in one of Westport's most desirable cul-de-sac neighborhoods. Originally built in 1964 and enhanced with a significant 2015 addition, this 4-bedroom, 3.5 bath residence offers over 4,100 square feet of versatile living space designed for both everyday comfort and effortless entertaining. The layout blends classic charm with modern functionality, featuring sun-filled living spaces, a wood-burning fireplace, an office and seamless flow throughout. The standout "bungalow" addition creates a one-of-a-kind experience, complete with a bar and direct access to the patio, perfect for hosting gatherings year-round. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a walk-in closet and well-appointed bath, while three additional bedrooms provide flexibility for family and guests. A partially finished basement adds more usable space, including a dedicated gym area. Outside, the expansive backyard is a rare find offering endless potential for outdoor living, play, or future enhancements. The patio extends the home's entertaining footprint, creating an ideal setting for dining and relaxing. Just minutes from Westport's top-rated schools, beaches, golf course, tennis and pickle courts, town center, and train this is a unique opportunity to own a spacious, move-in ready home with exceptional indoor-outdoor living and standout entertaining spaces in a coveted setting.

Welcome to Belden Place! Casual Luxury living personified in this boutique complex offering exquisite in-town living. This secure building with elevator access on the Saugatuck River is pet friendly. These luxury apartments are perfectly appointed and designed: plenty of closet space and storage, custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, in-unit washer and dryer, and private balconies. Enjoy the convenience of downtown living and inspiring river views in these beautifully renovated historic buildings in the robust downtown village. Leave your car at home and walk to everything the downtown community has to offer: restaurants, shopping, entertainment and more. Belden Place features fourteen one- and two-bedroom luxury apartments.   Enjoy luxury living on the Saugatuck River at Belden Place. Each apartment features a private deck, custom cabinetry and high-end appliances, elevator access and more!

Classic 3 Bedroom Colonial in the heart of Westport set on a picturesque level .21-acre. Full of potential, this home awaits your creative vision. Good flow and hardwood floors throughout. Flat, pretty property with city water and sewer available nearby. Detached one car garage. Ideally located just a short walk to the Saugatuck River, train, restaurants, shops, the Rowing Club, and coveted Saugatuck Center. Bike to Compo Beach, Longshore Park and golf course, Ned Dimes Marina, the Westport Farmers' Market, Salmon Park, The Levitt Pavilion, Westport Library, The Westport Country Playhouse, and downtown Westport. Home is being sold "as-is". Amazing opportunity for a buyer, designer, investor or builder who understands the great potential in this most sought-after neighborhood.

Set on a breathtaking professionally designed acre, 48 Bayberry Lane is a beautifully reimagined 6,775sf estate offering four finished levels of exceptional living. Thoughtfully enhanced & meticulously maintained by the current owner, the home blends timeless elegance with modern comfort in a private, resort-like setting. A dramatic double-height foyer welcomes sun-filled interiors featuring bespoke details, a formal dining room with butler's pantry, elegant living room with gas fplc and custom built-ins, and an expansive family room anchored by a wood burning fireplace. Designed with intention for both everyday living & entertaining, the eat-in chef's kitchen is a culinary showpiece, flowing seamlessly to a custom terrace through walls of glass doors, creating effortless indoor-outdoor living. Created for relaxation and gathering, the spectacular grounds feature multiple dining & lounging terraces, a built-in grill station, extensive stonework, curated gardens, and a large pool with sun shelf, all surrounded by mature evergreens for exceptional privacy. The residence offers 6 spacious bdrms, including a luxurious primary suite w/fplc, 2 walk-in closets, and a spa-inspired bath. A finished 3rd floor & walk-out lower level provide outstanding flexibility with recreation space, gym, office/guest or au pair accommodations. Ideally located near Westport beaches, downtown, dining, shopping, & train, this impressive property offers a lifestyle of convenience & sophistication.

listings.remarks: Nestled near the beach, this inviting apartment offers a relaxed lifestyle with easy access to local amenities and coastal attractions. Move right into this furnished haven. Newer maple floors in the kitchen, thoughtful storage space, and mini-spilt unit installed in 2022. Modern, thoughtful touches throughout. The kitchen showcases a propane stove, granite counters and ceiling fan. Private entrance through an external staircase. Designated storage space in the home's shared basement, where the shared washer & dryer are located. Enjoy private use of the deck along with a shared backyard and additional storage beneath the deck. Owner will keep Compo Beach Kayak rack membership, inquire for further details! Fixed utilities make life effortless. Very-walkable location: just over a mile to the Westport train station, the vibrant restaurants of Saugatuck and Longshore. Meet friends for an Americano at the amazing Old Mill Market. Enjoy a delicious dinner at the club overlooking the river. The perfect place awaits at 19 Hale Street!

Live the Westport lifestyle you've been dreaming of! Perfectly situated in one of Westport's most convenient neighborhoods, this charming renovated apartment places you just minutes from Compo Beach, the train, Saugatuck's renowned restaurants, Longshore Club Park, and downtown Westport. Filled with warmth and natural light, this inviting two-bedroom home features beautiful hardwood floors throughout, an open-concept living space with a skylight and decorative fireplace, and a well-appointed kitchen with granite countertops, a gas range featuring Air Fry mode, and a lighted ceiling fan. Efficient central air conditioning and heating, along with a newer roof, provide year-round comfort and peace of mind. Additional highlights include a private entrance, private attic storage with direct access from the unit, designated storage space in the shared basement, and a shared laundry area. Relax on your private front patio or enjoy the shared backyard, complete with additional storage beneath the deck. As an added benefit, the owner will retain the Compo Beach kayak rack membership; details are available upon request. Whether you're grabbing your morning coffee downtown, dining along the Saugatuck River, spending the day at Compo Beach, or catching the train into the city, you'll appreciate how effortlessly everything is within reach. Fixed utilities make life effortless. Welcome to 19 Hale Street...where convenience, charm, and the best of Westport come together.

Just beautiful! Welcome to 157 Newtown Turnpike, set on a meticulously landscaped acre-plus of property, this is the combination of easy single level living paired with a newly renovated lower level. This home features thoughtful updates and details throughout that are simply exciting. The welcoming foyer perfectly turns to the formal living room open to dining room - still maintaining their very cool mid-century vibe. Then the surprise comes- a great room/family room complete with soaring vaulted ceiling and wood-burning fireplace perfect for entertaining and cozy nights. Through french doors you'll find the delightful sunroom with vaulted ceilings & skylights with peaceful views in every direction.  The newly renovated lower level adds more than 700 square feet of finished living space- heated and a/c- including a media and lounge area with endless possibilities. An additional unfinished area provides ample room for a workshop, storage, or future expansion.  Outside, enjoy beautiful lawns, mature landscaping, privacy, and room to breathe. And the location? Quintessential Westport- minutes to the train, beach, shopping, dining, movies and more! Oh, did I mention- yes it's town water not well, yes it's DREAMY Westport low taxes and SoConn Natural Gas locator says nat gas available! This is the house you'll love coming home to. Come see it for yourself. Note: The listing agent is not the owner of this property however the homeowner (the seller) is a licensed agent.

listings.remarks: This Greenfield hill Charming colonial, sits on a 1.6 acre lot, right at the border of Fairfield and Westport and only 6 away minutes from the Southport train station and multiple beautiful beaches. Cozy and stylish with a twist of French flair, this well maintained property offers, 5 bedrooms, including a nursery right by the primary suite, 3.5 bathrooms and 5 garages, 3 being attached to the house. On the first floor a large living room leads to an open concept dining room and a bright kitchen, perfect for gatherings. On the second floor, the 5 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms as well as a dedicated office space await you. A full house generator has been installed. Be the first to discover this hidden gem. Agent/co owner. Cameras are installed outside. UPDATE: Sellers are thanking all agents and potential buyers for their interest and are asking for Highest and best offers by Tuesday June 9th noon.

Carefully crafted Connecticut modern farmhouse by award-winning Heine Development, this exceptional 6-bedroom residence blends timeless architecture with refined contemporary living amongst 4 finished levels on 2 private, level acres in one of Westport's most convenient luxury locations. Designed with perfection in symmetry, detail, and craftsmanship, the home pairs classic farmhouse inspiration with sophisticated modern finishes, including wide-plank white oak floors, curated lighting, and elegant interiors by renowned House of Clement. The stunning chef's kitchen features Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, seamlessly connecting to beautifully scaled living and entertaining spaces filled with natural light with Southern exposure and beautiful sunsets. Outdoors, enjoy a resort-style ozone maintained 20'x 50'pool with automatic safety cover, sun shelf, and expansive flat lawns enhanced by organic vegetable beds. The extraordinary lower level offers the ultimate lifestyle experience with a gym, sauna, full bath and a custom treehouse, playroom, and second laundry room, creating flexible spaces for wellness, recreation, and everyday convenience. Additional highlights include natural gas heat, a generator, and exceptional indoor-outdoor flow designed for effortless living and entertaining. A rare offering that combines privacy, luxury, and modern farmhouse elegance just moments from town, train, beaches, and all that Westport has to offer.

Welcome to 7 Mortar Rock, a thoughtfully designed living space. This stunning 6 bedroom transitional modern farmhouse showcases the exceptional craftsmanship and attention to detail that have made the Thomas Brothers Builders highly sought after. Perfectly blending beauty and functionality, this home is tailored to today's lifestyle while delivering timeless appeal. At the heart of the home is a spectacular chefs kitchen featuring quartz countertops and a large island with seating for four and an expansive dining area ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Sun filled spaces with nearly 10 foot ceilings on the main level creates and airy welcoming atmosphere throughout the home. Patio doors off the kitchen open seamlessly to a beautifully landscaped backyard with stone patio and built in gas fire pit. Ideally situated on a quiet cul-de-sac in one of Westport's most desirable locations this property offers the rare convenience of being just minutes from downtown shopping, dining, commuting options and Compo Beach.

Tucked at the end of one of Westport's most coveted cul-de-sacs, this 5-bedroom contemporary offers 6,310 sq ft of finished living space on just over a private acre, with a backyard path leading directly to Bedford Middle and Staples High School. From the foyer, a dramatic vaulted living room with skylights, built-ins and a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace sets the tone. The glass-wrapped sunroom windows (newly replaced) frames stunning views of the lush grounds and heated gunite pool, while the updated eat-in kitchen with granite counters, center island, breakfast bar and pantry flows into a generous family room anchored by a second fireplace. A formal dining room and four main-level bedrooms offer flexibility, including possible first-floor in-law. Upstairs, the primary suite is a true retreat: vaulted ceilings, dressing room, walk-in closet and a private treehouse-like balcony overlooking the backyard. The expansive finished lower level delivers a playroom, game area and built-in wet bar, plus a large laundry room, mudroom and abundant storage. Recent updates include new natural gas heating and tankless hot water systems and new pool filtration. With a 2-car attached garage, walk-up floored attic and Westport beach rights, this is the rare home combining resort-style privacy with a walk-to-schools location - minutes to downtown, the train and Compo Beach.

Step into the timeless charm of this 1920s Classic Colonial, perfectly situated on nearly an acre of lush, manicured grounds. With 2,570 square feet of refined living space, this home effortlessly blends vintage character with modern convenience. The interior features four spacious bedrooms and two-and-a-half baths, offering a thoughtful layout that feels both grand and inviting. The heart of the home opens up to a beautiful, spacious deck and yard, providing a serene backdrop for morning coffee or afternoon relaxation. For those who need extra space, the 1,269-square-foot unfinished basement offers incredible storage potential, complemented by the convenience of a two-car attached garage. The location is truly unbeatable, placing you just moments away from local favorites like The Little Barn, Big Y, and an array of popular shops and restaurants. This is a rare opportunity to enjoy a quintessential New England lifestyle in a premier setting.

A 2025 custom-built masterwork where uncompromising craftsmanship meets modern coastal sophistication. Newly completed and never lived in, this turnkey residence offers 4 bedrooms, 3 full and 2 half baths, and a fully finished lower level. Sun-filled interiors showcase site-finished hardwoods, soaring ceilings, and bespoke millwork by master craftsmen. The chef's kitchen features professional-grade Thermador appliances, custom inset cabinetry, a quartz island, and walk-in pantry - flowing into the great room for effortless entertaining. The primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a stunning oversized shower and a closet outfitted with custom built-ins. Beautiful tile work runs throughout the home, adding texture and craftsmanship to every space. Three additional bedrooms offer flexibility for family, guests, or a home office. The finished lower level is ideal as a media lounge, gym, or playroom. Minutes to Metro-North's express to Grand Central, with easy access to I-95 and the Merritt. Close to Westport's top schools, Compo Beach, downtown, and acclaimed dining. Move-in ready and built without compromise.

Welcome to 10 Grist Mill Lane, a move-in ready home set on a beautiful, level acre at the end of a quiet Long Lots cul-de-sac. Thoughtfully updated throughout, this 3-4 bedroom, 2.5 bath residence offers an open and versatile floor plan designed for today's lifestyle. The dramatic living room features a vaulted ceiling and fireplace, creating a warm and inviting gathering space filled with natural light. The renovated kitchen opens seamlessly to the main living and dining areas, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. A screened porch extends the living space and provides the perfect setting for relaxing or hosting guests while overlooking the private backyard. Flexible living options include a main level den or office that can easily serve as a fourth bedroom. Renovated baths, updated Marvin windows, Hardie Plank siding, and numerous improvements throughout add to the home's appeal. Ideally located on a long, quiet lot in a desirable neighborhood setting, this home combines privacy, comfort, and convenience in one exceptional offering.

Cute ranch located close to Compo Beach in Westport. Property features a beautiful private yard an acre and includes your own pond! Property has Belgian block walkway lined with lush landscaping leading you to the front door. Open floorplan with living area with fireplace and kitchen. Main level also features all 3 bedrooms. Good size deck off the kitchen looking out to the grounds and the pond. Basement features an additional finished room with sliders to rear yard, 2 car garage and laundry area. Owner/agent.

Discover this serene setting in a sought after Old Hill neighborhood. Two thoughtful and beautifully executed additions have made this sprawling 12 room home flow with the versatility to fit today's varied lifestyles. Comfortable open living spaces have been designed with the flexibility to offer multi-generational spaces, a home office or simply to allow for room to grow in the way that pleases you best. The welcoming living room with its broad bay window and formal fireplace provides ample room for your guests and the Baby Grand piano! The custom country kitchen is both practical and beautiful with wide plank wood floors, cherry and glass cabinetry, granite counters and a walk-in pantry. The adjoining family room with it's cathedral ceiling is filled with natural light and includes a fireplace, wet bar and French doors that open to a wraparound deck. The most recent addition is an impressive library with long, tall windows set amid tailored built-ins. An additional exterior entry makes it ideal for home office use while the adjacent full bathroom and closet offers the possibility of a first floor bedroom suite. The informal rear foyer includes access to a laundry area, powder room and extra closets. Just beyond is a 2nd private office or den. Upstairs you'll discover the primary suite with full bathroom and walk-in closet, as well as 4 very spacious additional bedrooms. Unseen value found in the new roof, updated mechanicals and whole house generator!

Come walk this stunning 1.5 acre lot with me - totally private, tucked at the end of a cul de sac in Long Lots. Peace, quiet, and the highest quality custom home spec'd to your wishlist by Coastal Luxury Homes is yours at 22 Dawn Drive. Go bigger/smaller, add an in-law suite or extra bedroom, an art studio, include a pool/spa, pickle court... let's discuss all the possibilities. Square footage and specs can vary, but the standard of excellence does not. Coastal Luxury Homes is the premier Fairfield County bespoke builder.

Welcome to 11 Twin Circle Drive, tucked within one of Westport's most quietly connected neighborhoods. Set on a private association of just two cul-de-sacs, the setting has the kind of easy, unhurried energy that's increasingly hard to find. A place where the street itself feels like an amenity, all just minutes from town, schools, trains, beaches, and everyday conveniences. The home balances comfortable everyday living with easy entertaining. A vaulted main living area with fireplace and hardwood floors connects naturally to the kitchen, complete with custom cabinetry, granite counters, stainless appliances, and a large center island. Just off the kitchen, a covered and screened porch becomes a natural extension of the home through the warmer months, the kind of space where summer dinners tend to stretch well into the evening. Multiple gathering spaces throughout the home offer flexibility for media, fitness, office, or guest use, while the bedroom layout provides both separation and functionality. Outside, expansive lawn space, mature trees, and a fenced pool area create a setting that feels private without sacrificing convenience.

listings.remarks: A rare opportunity to own new construction in Westport's coveted Old Hill neighborhood, offering refined design, a swimming pool, and a walkable lifestyle near Post Road and downtown. Tucked within one of Westport's most sought-after enclaves, this newly constructed 6-bedroom, 5.5-bath home blends architectural sophistication with modern livability. Natural light, clean lines, and well-proportioned spaces create an environment that feels both elevated and effortlessly comfortable. At the center of the home, a beautifully designed kitchen opens to expansive living and dining areas, creating a seamless flow for both everyday living and entertaining. The layout flows easily with ample room for work-from-home, multi-generational living, and evolving lifestyle needs. A main-level suite with a full bath provides privacy and versatility-ideal for guests, a dedicated office, or an extended family. Every detail accentuates comfort, function, and understated luxury. A back yard patio with pool abutting a nature preserve offers privacy with open space and the ease of in-town living. Positioned near Nash Pond and close to local nature trails and amenities, the home also offers exceptional convenience-walkable to the Post Road and just minutes to downtown Westport, shopping, dining, and Metro-North train service to New York City. Luxury new construction in Old Hill, Westport, CT-where location, design, and lifestyle align in one of the town's most desirable settings.

An exceptional offering on 1.38 private acres in the heart of Westport. Ideally situated just moments from vibrant Main Street, this centrally located property offers convenient access to shopping, dining, parks, tennis courts, beaches, the train, and Westport's award-winning schools. It provides an outstanding foundation for creating a one-of-a-kind estate. At the heart of this property stands the Studio-a remarkable 1,551-square-foot stone building designed and built in 1932 by Lewis Welch of Manhattan for renowned sculptor Berthold Nebel. Nebel's Westport estate originally encompassed nine acres, and this offering represents the last remaining parcel of his original estate. Berthold Nebel's daughter, photographer Lucia Nebel White, made the Studio her home and lived there until her death. The property has remained in the Nebel family for three generations. Today, the Studio includes one bedroom, one full bath, a full kitchen, and a dramatic open living space featuring soaring ceilings, a striking stone fireplace, oversized handcrafted timber doors, and exceptional natural light. Rich in character and architectural detail, the Studio offers a rare opportunity for restoration, thoughtful renovation, or integration into a distinctive new estate in one of Westport's most sought-after neighborhoods.

A fully finished lower level offers additional living space with a gym, recreation area, and more. Ideally located for commuting, with easy access to town, beaches, shopping, and transportation.

Tucked into one of Westport's most treasured beach neighborhoods, this sun-filled Colonial is where people ride bikes until dinner, neighbors become lifelong friends, and an evening walk to Compo Beach can become part of your daily routine. From the moment you step inside, soaring ceilings, natural light, and beautifully connected living spaces create a home that feels larger, brighter, and happier than its square footage suggests. Designed for the way families actually live, the open floor plan flows effortlessly from the kitchen to the family room, while the unfinished lower level with soaring ceiling height offers potential for a home gym, golf simulator, media room, or recreation space-adding tremendous future value.  Then there's something you won't find in most homes: an owned Tesla Solar Roof with integrated battery backup. Not panels mounted on top, but the roof itself generating power. Enjoy remarkably low electric costs, automatic backup power during outages, and annual income through Tesla's Virtual Power Plant-all without compromising the home's classic architecture. Outside, gather around the fire pit beneath the stars, tend the garden, and simply enjoy the feeling of belonging that makes this neighborhood so special. With beach rights, top-rated Westport schools, Longshore just around the corner, and one of the area's most welcoming communities, this is more than a beautiful home. It's the heart of Compo Beach living.

In the owners' words...  We moved to this home looking for an escape from city life and a place to grow our family. It has offered us all of that and more.   Every inch of the home serves a purpose, creating a space that feels intentional and complete. The thoughtful size and open layout means we are never far from one another. We can prepare meals in the kitchen while watching our little ones play in the family room. It truly brings a family together.   With an abundance of windows, the living area draws the outdoors in and floods our home with natural light. We love enjoying a cup of coffee in the breakfast nook while looking out at the yard and appreciating the beauty of each season.   Outside, we all spend countless hours exploring the spacious yard - racing around the house, crossing the bridges, searching for frogs in the brook. This is a home that lets us embrace nature.  As much as this home feels like a private retreat, we love the convenience of its central location and being able to get anywhere within Westport, from town to beaches to schools, in a few minutes.   Over our years here, this house became a home, a truly special place to grow our family.

A fresh take on Modern Luxury awaits at this new construction home set on stunning property in the Old Hill area of Westport. Now complete and ready for immediate enjoyment, this dynamic residence is perfectly located for convenience to commuting, the train station, schools, shopping and more. Exhilarating architecture will awaken your senses as you approach this customquality home. Walls of glass blend the natural setting with stunning interiors, and bring sunlight deep into the spectacular rooms. The chef's kitchen is a showpiece, featuring bespoke oak cabinetry, premium finishes, and a substantial walkin pantry. Dual mainlevel offices support today's lifestyle. 5 spacious bedrooms and 7 refined baths create a harmonious balance of comfort and sophistication. The primary suite is a serene retreat with three fitted closets and a spalevel ambiance. Additional bedrooms offer generous scale and thoughtful design. A sunlit upstairs lounge and a finished thirdfloor space provide flexible areas for work, play, or creativity. The finished lower level offers exceptional spaces for fitness, media, or entertaining. Outside, an expansive patio overlooks 1.68 acres of private grounds, ideal for gatherings or quiet reflection. A 3car garage (with a separate bay for a trophy vehicle or storage) and sleek modern detailing complete this remarkable offering. An inspired blend of architecture, setting, and convenience await in a prime location. Pool permit in place.

Are you dreaming of an estate property? Something a bit more than the generic flat acre on a cul de sac? How do two acres on the Aspetuck River sound to you? With views from your bedroom? The sounds of a waterfall next door lulling you to sleep? Having sunnies tickle your toes in the summertime? Maybe a bit of fly fishing for trout? Or perhaps some paddleboarding? Yes, of course, there's a 20x40 salt water pool, but . . the river - wow! Welcome to the latest offering from CCO Habitats - a new construction home with over 8300 sf of finished space on 3 floors. A floorplan you will love, with not only 2 designated offices, but a private first floor bedroom as well. Organic, modern, warm and inviting, with a calming palette sure to blend with and enhance your personal taste. An open starfish floorplan for togetherness as well as privacy. 10 foot ceilings on the first floor. Luxurious European oversized doors and windows provide amazing natural light. Custom cabinetry throughout. 6 bedrooms, 6/2 bathrooms. All of the bedrooms are ensuite with walk in closets. The wine room - where it belongs - in the dining room. An amazing gym that will tempt even the people least prone to exercise into movement. A walk-out lower level that doubles as a pool house, complete with a second laundry, full bath, wet bar and entertaining space. It's all here; only a mile from the award-winning Coleytown schools. This is the one you've been waiting for. Unique. Special. Just like you. :)

listings.remarks: Hidden along a private lane in Westport's Greens Farms neighborhood, this extraordinary 20-acre waterfront estate unfolds as one of the most remarkable shoreline settings ever offered. For more than 65 years, it has been held and enjoyed by the same family as a place to gather, unwind, and take in the ever-changing views across Sherwood Island Park and Long Island Sound. Surrounded by protected open space with no immediate neighbors, the property offers a rare sense of peace and privacy-reminiscent of the Lowcountry, the Hamptons, or Nantucket, a scale and atmosphere seldom found in Westport. Beautiful in every season, the setting also offers extraordinary birdlife and nature watching. Yet it remains moments to the Post Road, train, and town centers, and just one hour from Manhattan. A collection of residences and outbuildings is thoughtfully positioned across the land, including two circa 1940s three-bedroom guesthouses with sweeping water views, creating a true family compound where generations can come together while maintaining a sense of independence. Other structures offer flexibility for staff or future use. The grounds invite a lifestyle centered around the outdoors, with a tennis court, indoor pool, pool house, and formal gardens set within expansive lawns that stretch toward the water. Whether preserved, enhanced, or reimagined, this is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to shape a legacy estate-one that will be experienced and remembered for years to come.

listings.remarks: Introducing The Winslow Manor, one of Westport's most exceptional estates, is a secluded retreat defined by beauty, privacy, and grace, now available for the first time in decades, inviting its next residents to experience the privilege of living within this storied and extraordinary sanctuary. Just steps from downtown & completely remodeled in 2002, welcome home to a rare and timeless estate where classic Arts & Crafts architecture meets the tranquility of a private countryside retreat. Set on over 2.5+ sprawling acres of pristine grounds, this exceptional 5 Bed, 5 Bath residence offers more than 5,100 sqft of refined living, surrounded by natural beauty & complete privacy. From the moment you arrive down the private, meandering drive framed by mature landscaping; The Winslow Manor evokes a sense of warmth, character, and enduring craftsmanship. Rich architectural details, beamed ceilings, inviting living spaces, & thoughtfully designed interiors create a home that feels both grand and deeply welcoming- as if stepping into a piece of cozy history, carefully preserved and elevated for modern living. Designed for both relaxation & recreation, the estate unfolds into an extraordinary outdoor experience. A sparkling Gunite pool, multiple terraces, Pergolas, & dedicated home gym create the ultimate summer retreat, while the surrounding pond and protected wetlands attract an abundance of wildlife, offering peaceful views and a connection to nature rarely found so close town.

The beach lifestyle, water views, natural light, and endless possibilities await at 3 Madeline Avenue. Freshly painted and furnished, this charming 2-3 bedroom cottage offers an open and inviting floor plan featuring refinished hardwood floors, expansive windows, and a sun-filled living space one house from the waterfront. The kitchen is equipped with granite countertops and ample cabinetry, providing abundant storage and functionality. The lower level includes a mudroom, full bath, and a versatile bonus room with a skylight and window-ideal for a home office, guest space, gym, or creative studio. Upstairs, soaring vaulted ceilings, skylights, and oversized windows create a bright and airy retreat. Recent improvements include new flooring and a beautifully updated bath with a new vanity and tub. Step outside to a spacious patio, perfect for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply enjoying the coastal setting. Whether you're looking for a turnkey weekend escape, year-round residence, investment opportunity, or the perfect site to renovate, expand, or build new, this property offers exceptional flexibility in a sought-after location. A rare opportunity to secure water views and exceptional potential in one of the area's most desirable coastal neighborhoods.

Set behind private gates in Westport's prestigious Red Coat estate area, this extraordinary luxury residence offers the utmost in privacy and sophisticated design. Thoughtfully conceived with elegant architecture, exceptional proportions, soaring 10-foot ceilings on the main level, 9-foot ceilings on the second floor and finished lower level, and light-filled interiors, the home blends sophisticated style with effortless everyday living. A stunning custom kitchen appointed with premium Thermador appliances anchors the home, flowing seamlessly into beautifully designed living and entertaining spaces. Superior materials, custom millwork, and bespoke finishes define every room, while 6 ensuite bedrooms in the main residence provide exceptional comfort. Elevator-ready! Walk-up attic offers added possibilities. Outdoors, beautifully landscaped grounds create a private resort setting featuring a spectacular saltwater pool and spa. A separate 550-square-foot guest/pool house/ADU offers ideal accommodations for guests, wellness, or entertaining, while the expansive property provides ample room for a future tennis or sport court. A rare offering in one of Westport's most coveted and prestigious locations, it's just minutes from Westport's bustling downtown, sunny beaches, and award-winning schools. This remarkable estate combines thoughtful design and an unparalleled lifestyle defined by privacy, bespoke design and high-end amenities. Still time to customize. Floor plans available

Rare opportunity to build a custom residence on 1.2 acres in Westport. The previous home has been demolished, and the property is offered with approved architectural plans. Bring your preferred builder and collaborate with the project architect to tailor the design to your vision. Also listed as a to-be-built single-family residence.

This secluded property in Westport, CT at 6 Fox Run Lane offers an opportunity to submit your desired dream home plans to Westport on this picturesque 2 acres of rare undeveloped land. The lot is nestled in a prestigious upscale neighborhood and offers a tranquil bucolic setting, and is surrounded by nature. The new owner may design a custom home to suit your family's needs and preferences between 5,000 and 8,500 square feet. (A large plot will be forwarded to all interested buyers for your  review and other multi-discipline engineering firms specializing in hydrologic and hydraulic analysis, site development, construction professionals, and expert and superior multidisciplinary affiliation with key regulatory agencies and ability to move desired plans forward).

Newly completed, this exceptional modern estate offers approximately 9,200 square feet on 2.1 private acres just minutes from downtown Westport, Compo Beach, and Metro-North. Thoughtfully designed with European craftsmanship, premium finishes, and sophisticated smart-home technology, the home blends timeless design with exceptional functionality. A dramatic floating staircase anchors four finished levels featuring soaring ceilings, custom millwork, and engineered white oak flooring. The chef's kitchen showcases dual quartzite waterfall islands, custom rift white oak cabinetry, a walk-in pantry, and a professional appliance suite. The primary suite offers cathedral ceilings, a fireplace, private balcony, dual dressing rooms, and a spa-inspired bath with heated floors and a soaking tub. Designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, the nearly 950-square-foot covered terrace features granite flooring, a wood-burning fireplace, outdoor kitchen, heated 20' 40' saltwater pool, 10-person spa, and room for a future tennis or pickleball court. The walk-out lower level includes a family room, wet bar, fitness studio, guest suite, and flexible space for a theater, golf simulator, or media lounge. Prepare to fall in love.

Located in prestigious Greens Farms, this European-inspired Colonial offers a rare opportunity to enjoy immediate charm while planning for the future. Set behind private gates on expansive, picturesque grounds, the property is surrounded by multimillion-dollar estates-making it an exceptional canvas for new construction or a significant estate expansion. The existing home is beautifully renovated, offering flexibility with gracious living and dining rooms, a sun-filled sunroom, cozy family room, and a curated Chef's kitchen with Calacatta marble, bespoke cabinetry, and top-tier appliances. A serene Primary Suite and additional bedrooms upstairs, the home functions perfectly as-is-or as a future guest house or accessory residence with thoughtful modifications. The sweeping land provides ample room for a new main residence set further back on the property, while altering the current home for extended family, guests, staff, or as a pool house. Outdoor living is equally compelling, with an expansive covered stone terrace, fire pit, and open meadow-like grounds offering endless possibilities for a pool, tennis court, barn, or gardens. Whether you choose to embrace the home's timeless appeal or create a legacy estate tailored to your vision, this is a unique chance to live comfortably now while building for tomorrow-all in one of Westport's most coveted locations, just minutes to Westport's vibrant downtown with award winning restaurants, premium shopping, beaches, and train.

The home offers timeless and classic New England, the charm you have been seeking. Set up on a quiet hill in the heart of Green Farms, this picturesque shingle home checks every box! In 2021, the home underwent a major renovation, with every room updated and all mechanicals and cedar roof replaced. Sited on nearly two acres of manicured property, there are extensive stone walls, multiple patio areas, mature plantings, and distant Long Island Sound views. The flexible floor plan offers 5 bedrooms on the 2nd floor, plus additional bedroom spaces on the 3rd floor and lower walkout level. A new detached outbuilding, currently used as a gym, offers exceptional flexibility as a private guest suite, home office, or dedicated space for a trading team. The home features a wrap-around porch, gunite pool, outdoor kitchen, fire pit, dog grooming station in the garage, guest suite, theatre, gym, and whole-house audio system. Refined design, exceptional quality, and thoughtful details throughout.

Perched gracefully atop a bluff on a premier private cul de sac overlooking Longshore and the shimmering expanse of Long Island Sound, this exquisite coastal residence embodies a harmonious synthesis of timeless Hamptons style and contemporary modern chic. This estate offers a lifestyle of unparalleled sophistication, effortless elegance, cutting edge innovation, and tranquil opulence. Imagine days on your sun-drenched terraces, reading under the covered porches, a swim in your oversized infinity edge pool with spa, walks to the beach as the backdrop to your everyday life. Inside, discover luxurious living spaces designed for both intimate gatherings and grand entertaining; soaring ceilings; walls of windows; generous stone embellishments; a swoon worthy kitchen with scullery; 6/7 bedrooms which includes the primary bedroom suite with fireplace and generous balcony deck; 8/1 baths; elevator; recreation and wellness retreat with infrared sauna, steam shower, cold plunge, golf simulator, wet bar, and more in the lower level. Artful in architecture and design, indulgent in amenities and appointments, every detail in this home is a testament to the Builder's exceptional craftsmanship and his unwavering dedication to delivering the highest quality construction. The new definition of a Coastal Luxury Masterpiece is HERE... "Manitou Bluff", Westport CT

listings.remarks: Set behind gates on over four exquisitely landscaped acres in Westport's coveted Beachside enclave, 69 Beachside Avenue is a private coastal estate offering a rare blend of scale, privacy, and resort-style living just moments from the shoreline. A long, gracious approach leads to a timeless residence defined by exceptional craftsmanship and sun-filled interiors. Expansive living spaces feature soaring ceilings, seamless flow, and walls of glass that frame the estate's serene, park-like setting-ideal for both grand entertaining and everyday living. At the center of the home, a chef's kitchen opens to elegant formal and informal spaces, creating an effortless environment for hosting. Each room is thoughtfully appointed with high-end finishes, bespoke details, and a refined sense of understated luxury, now fully realized with a newly completed primary bath designed as a private, spa-like retreat. Outdoors, the property transforms into a true resort experience, with a stunning pool and spa, spacious terraces, and a full Har-Tru tennis court set amid rolling lawns and mature plantings, offering exceptional privacy and tranquility. Perfectly positioned near Westport's beaches, Longshore Club, and vibrant downtown, this property also offers the rare advantage of direct access to Greens Farms Academy, a feature shared by only a select few homes. This property is where luxury, land, and lifestyle come together in one of Westport's most prestigious addresses.

An antique jewel set on 3.5 extraordinary acres in the heart of Greens Farms, ready to be transformed into your forever home. Brimming with timeless charm and endless potential, this rare offering showcases beautiful period details, including arched doorways, custom built-ins, and charming deep-set windows that reflect the home's historic character. The gracious main house is complemented by a separate art studio, detached two-car garage, tennis court, and pool-creating a true country compound in one of Westport's most coveted locations. The property is enhanced by stunning specimen plantings, expansive open grounds, and complete deer fencing surrounding the entire lot. A remarkable opportunity to restore, renovate, or reimagine a treasured estate in an unparalleled setting.

A rare offering indeed! Welcome to 4 Charcoal Lane, an unrivaled multi-generational estate mere minutes from top-rated schools, shopping, restaurants and all that Westport has to offer. Sited on 2 private acres, this extraordinary property offers panoramic views of a 7-acre nature preserve, affording permanent tranquility. The meticulous renovations center around a gracious farmhouse-style Colonial with stunning features and superior craftsmanship, plus a spectacular post-and-beam Party Barn. A gourmet chef's Kitchen is the heart of the main residence, featuring a 14-foot Calacatta marble island and a suite of professional-grade appliances with dual Family Room fireplaces nearby. The Living Room's unique tray ceiling was specially designed for a superior piano experience. Upstairs, the Primary Suite is highlighted by a gorgeous spa bath. The property's exceptional appeal is anchored by the Country Carpenters barn, connected by a breezeway w/barn doors that create an inviting welcome to backyard entertaining. This luxury 1BR barn features 20-foot ceilings, heated floors, a full kitchen, and hinge-free retractable doors to seamlessly blend indoor/outdoor living. Resort-style amenities await outdoors with a Pebble Tec pool, waterfall hot tub & blue granite patio that remains cool underfoot on hot summer days. The entertainment porch features built-in heaters, see-thru fireplace and outdoor television. This is more than just a home, it's a legacy waiting to be claimed!

listings.remarks: Set in one of Westport's most prestigious estate enclaves, this exceptional shingle-style residence defines luxury living with a rare emphasis on multi-generational comfort, timeless architecture, and impeccable craftsmanship. Designed and built by a renowned architect and builder for a Fortune 500 CEO, the home reflects uncompromising quality, enduring design, and gracious curb appeal that impresses. Seamless indoor-outdoor living defines the home, with sun-filled interiors, soaring 10-foot ceilings, and an expansive walkout lower level with fireplace, all opening to a resort-style pool, stone patios, fire pit, and covered porch with fireplace, providing an effortless setting for entertaining. Extensive bespoke millwork, six fireplaces, and refined architectural finishes enrich every space. The expansive, level, and private grounds, framed by mature landscaping and abutting the 39-acre Newman Preserve, offer serenity with rare walkability to top-rated schools and 8 minutes to Westport's lively downtown. A spectacular chef's kitchen features Thermador and Wolf appliances, dual islands, 2 dishwashers, walk-in pantry, and a fully equipped butler's pantry with wet bar. The primary suite offers a turreted sitting room, fireplace, and 2 walk-in closets. 6 ensuite bedrooms and a private suite over the garage provide flexibility for guests. Space for elevator! New cedar roof, new boiler, new wine cellar, and other upgrades complete this rare offering in a premier Westport location.

Welcome to 3 Laurel Lane, a stunning new construction nestled in the heart of Westport, Connecticut. Discover the epitome of elegance & sophistication. This modern masterpiece is set on a .21 acre lot. The stunning new luxury construction is designed by renowned Coastal Luxury Homes. Known for their architectural brilliance & unparalleled craftsmanship, Coastal Luxury Homes are a testament to innovative design & meticulous attention to detail. The rich architecture features flowing lines, glass elements, & harmonious blend of natural materials, create a stunning visual impact. The interior showcases an open-concept layout that is as functional as it is beautiful. Every corner will showcase high-end finishes, from cabinetry to the designer fixtures. The rich hardwood floors guide you into the Living Room. Adjacent to the living area, the gourmet Kitchen awaits, boasting ample storage & a generous island that invites culinary creativity. The Kitchen is a chef's paradise, equipped with top-of-the-line appliances & designed for both entertaining & everyday living. The four Bedrooms with en-suite Bathrooms provide both privacy and comfort for family and guests. Ascend to the third level, where you'll find a versatile Rec-Room equipped with full bath. The finished LL features a large Family Room. This home, offers not only luxury but also the convenience of nearby beaches, dining, and shopping. Come experience the perfect blend of refinement & comfort in this exceptional property!

An exceptional home in coveted Greens Farms, 124 Hillandale Road captures the essence of classic Connecticut living. Timeless, elegant, and impeccably maintained, this beautiful estate is surrounded by mature landscaping and a peaceful, private setting, while remaining just minutes from everything Westport has to offer. Spanning four finished levels connected by an elevator, the home seamlessly blends classic architecture with modern comfort. Sun-filled living spaces, beautiful millwork, and thoughtfully designed interiors create an atmosphere that is both sophisticated and welcoming. Whether hosting family and friends or enjoying a quiet evening at home, the layout is designed to accommodate every stage of life with ease. Every detail has been carefully considered, from the state-of-the-art movie theater and golf simulator to the fitness and recreation spaces that make everyday living feel a little more special. Outside, beautifully landscaped grounds and picture perfect pool with auto-cover provide the perfect backdrop for relaxing, entertaining, and making lasting memories, with an outdoor fireplace and multiple gathering spaces to enjoy throughout the seasons. Effortlessly elegant, 124 Hillandale Road embodies the very best of Greens Farms living-a home where timeless design and modern amenities come together to create something truly special.

Tucked away on a private lane just minutes from downtown, Compo Beach, and Metro-North, this beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 3-bath expanded Cape offers turnkey living in one of Westport's most desirable locations. Renovated in 2015 with all-new electrical and plumbing, the home has been meticulously maintained with significant recent improvements, including a new roof, furnace, A/C condenser, water heater, and irrigation system. The sun-filled open-concept living, dining, and kitchen spaces are designed for effortless everyday living and entertaining, featuring a wood-burning fireplace, expansive picture windows, and seamless access to a professionally landscaped backyard retreat centered around a charming flagstone patio. The beautifully appointed kitchen offers a large center island, stainless steel appliances, farmhouse sink, instant hot water dispenser, and chimney-style vent hood. A flexible formal dining room with custom built-in bar cabinetry, guest bedroom or home office, and full bath complete the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite features custom California Closets and a spa-inspired bath with marble finishes, soaking tub, double vanity, and glass-enclosed shower. Two additional bedrooms, an updated hall bath, and second-floor laundry complete the upper level. The finished lower level provides versatile living space, while refinished hardwood floors, privacy fencing, and an oversized one-car garage complete this exceptional home!

31 Franklin Street will be Westports next NEW neighborhood. Prime for redevelopment or reno existing. Multiple redevelopment projects coming to Saugatuck including new approved townhomes and flats across street. Saugatuck train station block in the works. Walk to train station multiple restaurants and cafes. Saugatuck River just steps away.

Welcome to 1 Maplewood Avenue-Your Opportunity to Call Westport Home! Charming, stylish, and filled with possibilities, this inviting **2-3 bedroom Westport home** offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy one of Fairfield County's most desirable communities and its **highly regarded school system**. Step inside to discover **beautifully refinished hardwood floors** and a bright, comfortable floor plan designed for today's lifestyle. The **updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances**, while refreshed **tile bathrooms** add a clean, modern touch.  Need more room? You'll love the versatility of the **finished walk-up attic**, perfect for a home office, creative studio, guest space, or additional retreat. A separate **playroom** provides even more flexibility for recreation, entertaining, or everyday living. Situated on a corner lot with generous parking, the property offers space, convenience, and plenty of potential to make it your own. Whether you're purchasing your **first home, downsizing, or looking for an exciting opportunity to enter the Westport market**, 1 Maplewood Avenue delivers the perfect combination of charm, updates, flexible living space, and location.  Westport living may be more attainable than you think-come discover the possibilities at 1 Maplewood Avenue!

***Best & Final offers due Monday, 9/28 at noon***Tucked away at the end of a long, meandering driveway, this darling ranch offers a sense of privacy and natural beauty that's hard to find. Set back from the road on two acres of lightly wooded land, the home greets you with a welcoming front porch that's just begging for a pair of rocking chairs. Inside, the home is perfectly proportioned, creating an atmosphere that is both intimate and airy. The living room features a cozy fireplace, perfect for chilly evenings. Nearby, the dining area and family room, with wonderful built-ins, add a touch of character and practical storage, flowing seamlessly into a kitchen that truly takes your breath away. With soaring vaulted ceilings and exposed wood beams, the kitchen feels incredibly expansive and serves as a bright, stylish hub for daily life. Glass french doors lead you out to a wonderful back deck that feels like a private sanctuary. Whether you're sipping your morning coffee or hosting a summer dinner, you'll love the view of the sprawling backyard and the canopy of trees beyond. With three comfortable bedrooms and two full baths, the layout is remarkably efficient and well-appointed, proving that thoughtful design creates a massive sense of style. This property is a true retreat from the everyday hustle, offering a peaceful lifestyle and plenty of room to breathe. It's a place to truly unwind and enjoy the beauty of your surroundings.

Welcome to 2 Scofield Place, a charming waterfront beach cottage in Westport's coveted Saugatuck Shores community. Offered furnished or unfurnished, this exceptional rental is available as a summer rental through Memorial Day for $6,500/month or annually for $5,250/month. Nestled along picturesque Harbor Road, this 2-3 Bedroom, 1 Bath home is filled with classic New England charm and showcases breathtaking Long Island Sound views from nearly every room. Step outside to direct water access and embrace the ultimate coastal lifestyle-kayak to Cockenoe Island, paddle up the Saugatuck River into downtown Westport, or enjoy waterfront dining at the iconic Black Duck. Recent updates include new Pella windows, fresh interior paint, newer second-floor carpeting, a partially renovated Bathroom, and a newly paved two-car driveway with a one-car garage. Both Bedrooms feature spacious walk-in closets, while an additional room is ideal as a Home Office, Nursery, or small third Bedroom. The enclosed heated porch adds approximately 120 square feet of year-round living space. Enjoy access to Compo Beach, Longshore Club Park, award-winning Westport schools, Metro-North, I-95, shopping, dining, and everything that makes Westport one of Connecticut's premier coastal communities.
