listings.remarks: Welcome to 108 Harbor Road, a beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home on desirable Saugatuck Island in Westport. Enjoy an open floor plan, recently renovated, and stylish finishes in every room. Just a short stroll to the water, this inviting home offers the best of coastal living and easy access to all that Westport has to offer. Available for up to 10 months starting September 8.

Welcome to this charming and completely updated Compo Beach cottage. Ideally located along prestigious Compo Road South, readily accessible to everything Westport has to offer - walk or bike to the train, Longshore Country Club, or Compo Beach. Inside this unexpectedly spacious home, you'll find three finished levels of living space. A vestibule with coat closet welcomes you into the large ground-level family room, complete with built-in cabinetry and a wood-burning stove. A laundry room with storage completes this floor. Upstairs, the main level offers a sun-filled living room and a sitting room/office overlooking the front lawn. A dining room with built-ins leads to an updated kitchen with new appliances and direct access to the backyard. The primary bedroom, renovated, full bath, and sitting/dressing room round out this level, featuring refinished hardwood floors and high ceilings. A second staircase leads to two additional bedrooms with closet/storage space and continued hardwood floors. Ceiling heights continue to surprise! The entire home has been freshly painted and upgraded with new lighting fixtures. The fenced backyard offers privacy, with well-established perennial gardens enhancing the cottage feel, while the meticulously landscaped front yard showcases a mix of mature and new greenery. A must-see for those who embrace uniqueness!

New construction by renowned Red Coat Homes, ideally set on a quiet cul-de-sac in a premier Westport neighborhood. Designed by architect Judith Larson, this exceptional home offers over 7,000 sq ft of refined living space on more than one acre, complete with a resort-style pool. Timeless architecture and sophisticated finishes create spaces ideal for entertaining, work, and everyday living, with generous room sizes, flexible living areas, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Additional highlights include a three-car garage, elevator-ready and thoughtful design throughout.  Conveniently located close to Westport schools, train, beaches, and town amenities, this is a rare opportunity to own a custom home in a coveted setting. **See photos for progress update!**

Beautifully designed and ideally situated on a prime, centrally located cul-de-sac, this exceptional Westport residence combines timeless architecture, sophisticated finishes and effortless living. Designed by esteemed architect Robert Storm, the home impresses with soaring ceilings, an excellent layout and abundant natural light. The elegant living and dining rooms share a striking double-sided gas fireplace, while the gourmet kitchen features premium appliances and flows seamlessly to the adjacent family room and out to the stone patio and private back property. Five spacious bedrooms on the second floor include an impressive primary suite with two walk-in closets and a sumptuous spa bath with air-jetted soaking tub and an oversized shower. A wide staircase leads to the walk-up expansive third floor, offering wonderful potential to finish additional living space. Extensive recent updates include a beautifully renovated high-ceilinged walk-out lower level with custom cabinetry, wet bar, gym and sixth bedroom. Further enhancements include new HVAC, tankless hot water, a whole-house generator and extensive new landscaping. 3-car garage. 50-year shingle roof. City water, city sewer and natural gas. Offering wonderful scale, light and versatility, this special home enjoys a coveted Westport setting on a social cul-de-sac walkable to Winslow Park, just over a mile to Westport's vibrant downtown shops and restaurants, and less than 10 minutes to the NYC train.

Here's your chance to live in one of Westport's most connected and desirable locations. Tucked away on a quiet property with a peaceful backyard, this beautifully refreshed 3-bedroom ranch offers the kind of location, space, and flexibility that is increasingly hard to find.  Inside, natural light fills a comfortable and surprisingly spacious layout featuring hardwood floors, central air, generous living and dining areas, and a separate family room. Three full bathrooms have been newly renovated, while the primary suite stands out with its vaulted ceiling, walk-in closet, and private bath.  Freshly painted and ready to go, the home offers an easy, move-in-ready lifestyle with room to settle in, entertain, work from home, and enjoy everything Westport has to offer. Leave the car behind and walk or bike to the train station, restaurants, shops, coffee, and everyday conveniences of Saugatuck. When it's time to unwind, step onto the private deck and take in the quiet backyard setting.  Great location. Fresh updates. Flexible living space. Private outdoor space. And Saugatuck right outside your door.  A terrific opportunity to make Westport your home.  Available NOW through 6/30, 7/31 or 8/31. Inquire with lisiting agent about lease length.

Conveniently located near the Merritt Parkway, I-95, shopping, restaurants, beaches & train station. Turnkey, move-in ready, and in an incredible location-this one won't last! Welcome to Northfield Drive, a street in a highly sought after neighborhood, with walking paths to both the elementary and middle schools. This spacious and inviting home is set on a stunning park-like, flat, dry acre. Approx. 3,174 square feet of living space across three levels, plus a full basement, this 11-room home features 4/5 bedrooms and 4 full baths. Kitchen has been updated with quartz counters, Wolf stove and a Sub-Zero refrigerator. Designed for both comfortable everyday living and effortless entertaining, the home features an open floor plan, hardwood floors throughout the first and second levels, vaulted ceilings and walls of windows that fill the interiors with natural light and bring the beauty of the outdoors in. A true highlight is the spectacular family room, with its soaring vaulted ceiling, abundant windows and custom built-ins...an inviting space to enjoy throughout the seasons. The primary suite offers a spa-like retreat with a steam shower, Jacuzzi tub, double sinks and high-end fixtures. The full basement provides wonderful bonus space for a home gym, game room, recreation area or additional storage, while a walk-up attic offers even more versatility. Spacious garage w/EV charger. With generous living spaces, wonderful natural light and an exceptional one-acre setting, this Coleytown home offers the space and flexibility to live, work and entertain. Walking distance to several houses of worship.

Your chance to call this charming Westport Cape Cod home! This 4-bedroom, 2-full-bath residence offers 1,961 square feet of living space, plus an additional 958 square feet of finished lower-level space. The large kitchen provides plenty of room to cook, gather, and dine, while two recently updated full bathrooms add a fresh, modern touch. The finished lower level offers flexible space for a home office, gym, playroom, media room, or whatever fits your lifestyle. Generous windows bring plenty of natural light throughout the home.  Set on a beautiful corner lot at Maple Avenue South and quiet Cottage Lane, the property offers a peaceful setting, an additional driveway, and a two-car garage. The covered porch overlooks the yard and creates an ideal spot for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or enjoying the changing seasons. The location is ideal for both commuters and those looking to enjoy the best of Westport. Greens Farms train station is just over a mile away, making for an easy NYC commute, while I-95 and the Merritt Parkway are conveniently accessible. Shopping, schools, restaurants, beaches, parks, and Westport's vibrant downtown are all close by.

listings.remarks: Everything stays on the other side.  That is what people here say about the footbridge. You cross it, and whatever you were carrying does not come with you.  Compo Mill Cove is a gated private peninsula of nineteen homes on Long Island Sound, and no car has come out here since 1903. It is the reason the loudest thing you hear most mornings is the tide turning under the bridge. Everyone in this town is trying to buy quiet. Out here it is structural.  This is the one with the water in every room: 5,567 SF of Brooke Girty-designed shingle style, built in 2008 and laid out so the Sound is never more than a glance away. Century-old reclaimed French oak floors. A three-story Nautilus stair through the center of the house. Five fireplaces. A Viking and SubZero kitchen. A primary suite with its own fireplace, dual walk-ins and a balcony above the water. Four bedrooms, generously scaled, plus a full third floor for guests, a studio or an office.  Then the part you actually live in. A screened porch for the mornings. A Brazilian hardwood deck and hot tub for the evenings. Your own sandy beach with a kayak pulled up on it, held by a Race Coastal-engineered bulkhead. A private gate opening into the protected shoreline and woodland of Sherwood Island State Park.  Green's Farms station minutes away, Manhattan about an hour.  Nineteen homes. There will not be a twentieth.  Your car is 150 feet away. You will not want it.

listings.remarks: Embrace the rhythm of coastal living in this stunning, fully furnished retreat on Saugatuck Island. Spanning 4,200 square feet across three thoughtfully designed levels, this residence is more than just a home-it's a sanctuary defined by light, salt air, and sophisticated design. The experience begins in the striking foyer, where an open lighthouse cupola soars overhead, bathing the interior in a warm, natural glow. Every corner of this 5-bedroom home reflects an eye for detail, featuring exquisite finishes and curated decor that blend luxury with a relaxed, beachside soul. Outdoor living is a cornerstone of the lifestyle here. Step out onto the screened deck to catch the sea breeze or retreat to the private, fenced backyard. Whether you're hosting a summer cookout at the built-in grill on the stone patio or enjoying the lush green space, the grounds are designed for effortless enjoyment. Best of all, two private beaches are just moments away, offering easy access to swimming, boating, or simply lounging by the shore. While it feels worlds away from the daily grind, this island gem is incredibly convenient. You are just minutes from the Metro-North, major highways, local yacht clubs, and the vibrant dining and shopping scene that makes Westport so desirable. Whether you're looking to spend your days biking quiet roads or watching the sunset over the sound, this property offers a rare opportunity to live the ultimate beach retreat lifestyle.

listings.remarks: Privately set in Westport's coveted Old Hill neighborhood, this like-new sophisticated residence designed by famed architect Peter Wormser pairs striking architecture with timeless, understated elegance. Soaring ceilings, beautifully curated spaces and abundant natural light define the stylish interiors, creating a home that is at once impressive and inviting. 4 finished levels provide exceptional space for everyday living, entertaining, work and guests. The primary suite stuns with its 20-foot ceilings, fireplace, 2 walk-in closets and spa bath. 4 additional bedrooms each feature walk-in closets, while 2 private offices offer dedicated work-from-home space. A 3rd-floor recreation room with full bath adds more flexibility, while the beautifully finished lower level has a home theater, gym, space for play, plus storage. Outdoors, the magical setting unfolds through multiple entertaining spaces, from inviting covered porches to an expansive stone patio with a fully-equipped outdoor kitchen, built-in grill and Big Green Egg, offering an exceptional backdrop for gatherings large and small. Lush, established landscaping creates a remarkable sense of privacy, yet the home is just over a mile to Westport's vibrant downtown. Whole-house generator, solar and level 2 EV charger! The NYC-bound train is just 9 minutes away. Distinctive, sophisticated and effortlessly livable, this exceptional Old Hill residence is a rare offering of inspired architecture, privacy and a prime location.

Tucked away on 1.25 serene acres in Westport's sought-after Coleytown neighborhood, this timeless 5-bedroom Georgian Colonial seamlessly blends grand architectural elegance with comfortable everyday living. Welcomed by an inviting, large front porch this impressive home offers exceptional space both inside and out. Inside, the grand main level flows effortlessly between a large formal living room, a gracious formal dining room, and a designated home office. At the heart of the home, a spacious, sunny kitchen connects directly to a casual den/TV room, while double doors lead from both the kitchen and dining room onto a lovely patio ideal for outdoor dining and entertaining. One of the home's most show-stopping features is the massive bonus room,expertly crafted from real barn wood and complete with exposed timber beams, wide plank wood floors, and a dedicated fireplace, perfect for cozy evenings or hosting large gatherings. Throughout the main house, you will find a total of 3 fireplaces creating a warm, inviting atmosphere. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat featuring a massive walk-in closet and a remarkably large primary bathroom. A second spacious bedroom functions as its own suite, featuring a private bathroom and an exclusive balcony overlooking the grounds. The resort-style backyard oasis centers around an inground pool and a fun, fully equipped pool house featuring a private bathroom and its own fireplace for chilly evening gathering.

Prepare to be enchanted by this recently remodeled and utterly charming colonial home. As you step inside, the 1st floor warmly welcomes you in a living room adorned with a wood burning fireplace, creating the perfect ambiance for cozy evenings. The dining room seamlessly flows into the kitchen, providing an open & inviting space that's ideal for hosting gatherings. The kitchen itself boasts newer cabinets, elegant quartz countertops & gleaming stainless steel appliances, catering to both culinary enthusiasts & entertainers alike. Additionally, a convenient half bath & a well appointed laundry room round out the 1st floor. Venturing upstairs, you'll discover 4 generously sized bedrooms, each offering ample closet space to accommodate your storage needs. The full bathroom on this level has been meticulously remodeled to offer both style & functionality. The lower level presents a vast, unfinished space brimming with potential, currently serving as storage but ready to be transformed into your dream living area. Additional highlights include hardwood floors throughout, newer propane furnace, central AC for your comfort & a freshly constructed patio featuring a wood burning fireplace. The perfect spot to enjoy outdoor gatherings & create lasting memories. Situated for convenient commuting & close to vibrant downtown Westport, this home eagerly awaits its new, loving tenants. Pet friendly accommodations are considered on a case by case basis

This peaceful 3 Bedroom, 2 1/2 Bath home feels worlds away from the hustle and bustle, while being just minutes to Downtown Westport, Compo Beach, Longshore, and major commuter routes. Enjoy a dip in the pool, then relax on the expansive backyard deck and listen to the birds. You'll love the indoor-outdoor lifestyle and entertain with ease, with access to the deck from every room on the main level. A charming arched entrance leads to a gracious Living Room with cozy wood stove, vaulted ceiling and hardwood floors. This 4-bedroom split-level offers space, warmth, and a location that's hard to beat. At the heart of the home is an open-plan living room and modern eat-in kitchen, highlighted by soaring vaulted ceilings with exposed beams plus a fireplace that creates a welcoming focal point. With hardwood floors and updated spaces, the home exudes comfort and convenience. listings.remarks: Ideally situated in a highly walkable in-town location, this charming 1928 home offers a rare opportunity to create something truly special in the heart of Westport. Set on a lovely private lot, the property combines classic character with a wonderfully convenient setting close to shops, restaurants, schools, and all that downtown Westport has to offer. Owned and cherished by the same family for approximately 40 years, the home retains the warmth and architectural details that give an older house its distinctive appeal. Oak floors, gracious proportions, and timeless character provide a wonderful foundation for its next chapter. A first-floor in-law/primary bedroom suite, thoughtfully added in the 1960s, offers convenient one-level living and adds flexibility to the original floor plan. Upstairs, two roomy bedrooms share a generously sized bathroom that presents an exciting renovation opportunity: the space could be reconfigured to create two en-suite bathrooms, one for each bedroom, adding modern functionality while preserving the home's charm and character. While the house is in need of renovation, its established setting, private grounds, classic details, and highly desirable in-town location make it an exceptional opportunity for those looking to restore, renovate, and make the home their own. This is the only just-completed residence on the Compo Beach side of Westport delivered as a fully integrated, self-monitoring home: rooftop solar power w/battery storage, intelligent load management, leak detection w/automatic water shutoff, energy-recovery ventilation, radiant heated floors, singular app-controlled lighting, shades, locks + HVAC. The house can be monitored + adjusted from anywhere in the world and stays powered on stored solar when the grid goes down. Designed by The O'Dell Group across three vertical levels + a panoramic rooftop deck w/gas fireplace, the home opens to Long Island Sound through full-height glazing & connects ground-floor living to a private loggia, heated gunite spa, + landscaped courtyard. Inside, the open kitchen pairs Subzero refrigeration + an integrated appliance package w/a generous island + pantry; the primary suite includes a private balcony + spa-style bath; a fully accessible shower is finished in stone, and a flexible main-level room w/full bath lives as an additional bedroom, home office, or guest suite. Iconic Compo Beach is just a short drive to the Metro-North station and about an hour to Grand Central/Midtown Manhattan. The Westport Project is in a category of its' own; a home engineered to take care of itself, and you, whether you're upstairs, in the city, or on the other side of the world.

At night, retire to your primary suite with spa-like bath and walk-in closet. Upstairs there are 3 other bedrooms and an updated bath. Upstairs, there are 4 bedrooms including a luxurious primary suite complete with the most stunning marble bathroom and a large dressing room. All bedrooms are ensuite with marble bathrooms. A finished third floor and full bathroom is an added bonus. The lower level is an entertainers paradise with soaring ceilings, French doors to the level lawn, fireplace, home theater, gym, possible wet bar and wine cellar. State of the art Crestron system allows for everything to be controlled by a touch of a button. This home captures the best of European romance with modern touches and refined architectural details in a bucolic Wilton setting. Not to miss!

Enjoy an exceptional waterfront lifestyle just moments from the Cos Cob train station, nearby beaches, and vibrant downtown Greenwich.

A three-car garage adds to the unique benefits, practicality, and charm of this special opportunity.

listings.remarks: Tucked away at the end of a cul-de-sac this magical, private oasis awaits. Birds chirping and leaves rustling will be the only noise you hear, despite possessing the convenience of Wilton and Ridgefield town centers within minutes of home. This beautifully maintained contemporary masterpiece embodies a delightfully unique architectural design with amazing vaulted ceilings and stunning walls of windows throughout the home. Natural sunlight cascades throughout and immerses you in a natural environment. The main level includes a two story living room with a floor to ceiling wood burning fireplace and bar that connects to the centrally located dining room which makes hosting friends and family a breeze. The open floor plan allows for direct accessibility to the mid-century modern style kitchen with granite countertops. Just off the kitchen is a cozy family room with another wood burning fireplace and newly finished built-in cabinetry. Access to the expansive back deck, which stretches the ENTIRE back of the home, is available from every room! The second floor consists of three generously sized secondary bedrooms as well as a tremendous Primary Suite with its own large walk-in closet and full bath with soaking tub. There is ample storage space with multiple walk in closets and additional storage space above the two-car garage. This home is truly a retreat in and of itself and will provide memories for years to come!

Nestled off of scenic Nod Hill Road, 83 Hillbrook is a timeless sanctuary where classic allure harmoniously embraces modern comforts. Beyond its charming facade lies a meticulously updated interior. Step through the door and into a realm of tasteful renovations, where a remodeled kitchen and refreshed baths beckon you. The main level unfolds with the grace of tradition, offering a seamless flow for everyday living. A warm oasis awaits in the welcoming 4-seasons sunroom, inviting you to bask in each passing season. Adjacent, a patio extends the living space outdoors, promising tranquil moments beneath the open sky. Off the family room is a versatile bonus room above the garage, awaiting your imagination to transform it into a haven for hobbies, leisure, or relaxation. But the treasures of 83 Hillbrook don't end there. Venture outside to discover a renovated barn, its new roof and siding whispering of endless possibilities-a space ripe for creativity, whether a studio, workshop or private retreat. Whether you're entertaining guests or savoring quiet moments alone, this home effortlessly blends practicality with elegance, promising a life of comfort, convenience, and timeless beauty.

Charming two bedroom modern country cabin on a two acre wooded lot, with walk out lower level that includes a separate living area. Secluded but located just minutes from the intersection of Route 7 and Route 107, with shopping, restaurants, and central Georgetown close by. Convenient to both Cannondale and Branchville Metro North stations. Also close to Weir Farm National Historic Park and to Nod Hill Road, considered one of the ten most scenic roads in the country. The property has been professionally landscaped by owner/landscape designer with peaceful, scenic views using beautiful native flowers, trees and shrubs. There is a surprising amount of storage throughout both levels. Utilities are updated with oil for heat, and propane for cooking and, hot water. There is an auxiliary generator hookup with an inside connection to the main electric panel. In addition to the cabin there is a one car garage and a large shed. You can enjoy the beauty and serenity of comfortable country living with all the conveniences of nearby Georgetown and Wilton. One really needs to see this hidden gem to appreciate its beauty. The property has incredible potential, and with a little effort and vision will realize its full value. It is being sold "AS IS" and is subject to Probate Court approval.

Beautiful, classic South Wilton Colonial with open floorplan in quiet, social, cul de sac neighborhood. Cook your favorite meal in sun-filled, high-end white kitchen with Wolf range, while friends gather at the large island or spread out into the expansive open great room. Step out to the large patio to grill or enjoy cocktails while dining al fresco overlooking the picturesque private level yard. There is an open field to play soccer, lacrosse, football or start an amazing garden. Entertain large groups in the banquet-sized dining room then have dessert by the fireplace in the living room. There is a luxurious first floor primary suite to retire to after a long day with a bath and an extra room for a nursery, office or reading nook. Upstairs there are four additional bedrooms and two full baths. The lower level boasts a separate side entrance with mudroom and large rec room with wet bar. An additional office to work from home, or guest room is also on the lower level with its own entrance. The home has had renovations throughout over the years and has been featured in multiple magazines. The neighborhood is great for running, walking, biking, trick-or-treating and annual block parties. When not feeling social the house and yard are very private. Enjoy all Fairfield County has to offer, as you are minutes to Westport dining and shopping, train to NYC, beaches, trails and award-winning Wilton schools. You will love living here!

A generously sized living room, a dining room with access to the larger deck, make entertaining easy. There is also a cozy family room with beamed ceilings & wide, peg board flooring with a wood-burning fireplace. For the artist in the family, there is a tremendous studio with vaulted ceilings. No artist? Then the options are endless... playroom, workout space, large home office, etc. There is a smaller office, half bath & laundry, too. A primary bedroom suite & 3 more bedrooms with 1/2 bath are upstairs. Central A/C. 2-car garage. Come & enjoy this unique & special property!

Upstairs, the primary bedroom suite is generous, complete with a luxurious closet space and an elegant bath. The wide and open hallway leads to three additional bedrooms and a convenient second-floor laundry room. The third floor offers versatility, allowing the owner to customize the space with its hardwood floors, making it perfect for any purpose. The basement has access from either end of the home and windows to provide natural light and affords even potential for recreational activities, gym, wine cellar, movie theater, youre choice! There is ample room for every need and preference in this beautifully designed colonial farmhouse. What an opportunity! (Interior Similar To Photos)

The living room opens to a full length 3 season porch with full glass windows and storm doors for comfortable entertaining. This colonial charmer is situated on the rise at the rear of the 2 acre parcel which not only provides privacy and solitude but magnificent views of the seasonal pond enhanced by thousands of blooming daffodils in the spring planted over the last 20 years.  There is no more convenient home location -it is close to RT 7 amenities , Wilton town center shopping , metro north RR, medical facilities , Norwalk River Valley Trail and schools.

Enjoy all that Wilton has to offer: restaurants, shopping, hiking trails, close to trains and highways, and so much more. The pristine home you thought only existed in your dreams is right here. Move right in and make your home ownership dreams a reality.
3Br 3.5 Bath, quiet location in desirable Silvermine Woods.

Surrounded by mature landscaping and historic stone walls, this special home offers timeless beauty, privacy, and a coveted address in the heart of Wilton.

Additional amenities such as city water, a whole-house generator, and a full irrigation system enhance both comfort and convenience.

Situated on 1.8 acres backing up to open space, this home provides a perfect blend of privacy and community. Inside, discover the chef's kitchen featuring a six-burner gas range, farm sink, and top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances. A Pietra Cardosa honed countertop and island seating 4-6 make it ideal for gatherings. French doors open to a composite deck, perfect for enjoying the landscaped backyard. The main level boasts hardwood floors, a family room with vaulted ceilings and a slate fireplace, a formal dining room, a cozy living room with a gas fireplace, and a convenient mudroom and laundry room. Over the garage, there is the ideal bonus/playroom. Upstairs, the primary suite is a serene retreat with a marble bathroom featuring a frameless glass shower and soaking tub. Three additional bedrooms, including a second ensuite, offer ample space. Additional amenities include a full-house automatic generator, two basements for storage, an attached garage, central AC, and a security system.

listings.remarks: Welcome to the gem of West Meadow, one of South Wilton's prettiest neighborhoods. This home exudes the elegance and charm of the 1940s with all of the luxuries of today and is situated on one of the nicest lots in town. The manicured acreage includes a beautiful, private pool area, an expansive patio surrounded by beautiful gardens, a large field to play sports, a large party barn, a separate small seasonal office barn, and a treehouse. The gracious living room has a fireplace, an abundance of windows, and opens to a relaxing sunroom with glass doors to the patio. Cook in the high-end kitchen with subzero and gas range while friends and family gather at the center island or the side island with lots of seating. The kitchen opens to cozy family room with big screen perfect for viewing parties or a big cozy fire in fireplace to relax by. The glass doors also connect you to the patio and idyllic property. There is an eating area off the kitchen with built-ins and a banquet-sized dining room. Additionally there's a first floor office with fireplace and a first floor suite complete with own living room, bedroom, full bath, and separate entrance. Upstairs there is a luxurious, tucked-away primary suite with fireplace, sitting area, updated spa bath with soaking tub and steam shower, a walk-in closet, and balcony perfect for taking in the picturesque views of the grounds. There are 4 more bedrooms and two full baths on the second floor. Lower level has a third office/rec room w/fpl.

Welcome to this stunning, modern residence, where luxury meets tranquility. Nestled at the end of a long, private driveway, this meticulously renovated and expanded home features 5 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, and 1 half bath, crafted to perfection by its owner. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by an open and spacious floor plan, designed for both comfort and style. The kitchen is bathed in natural light, boasting custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, and sleek countertops. Patio doors lead to expansive outdoor living spaces and a generous backyard ideal for entertaining guests or relaxing in privacy. The inviting living room is perfect for unwinding, complete with a cozy fireplace. On the main floor, the master suite offers a private retreat with its own fireplace, a large walk-in closet and a spa-like ensuite bath. Additionally, the floor features 3 spacious bedrooms and a beautifully designed bathroom. The lower level of this home is just as impressive, offering a large family room, a home gym, laundry facilities, and 2 more bathrooms. A bright, private office with its own exterior door allows you to work from home without disturbing the rest of the family. Conveniently located close to I-95, Merritt Parkway, and within walking distance to Cranbury Park. This home offers the perfect blend of luxury, privacy, and accessibility.

Best and Final requested by Tuesday April 29th at 8 PM Nestled in the heart of South Wilton, CT - a vibrant yet quaint Fairfield County town - this beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 2.1-bath Colonial sits on 1.24 private acres. Step through the front doors into a warm, inviting atmosphere where gleaming hardwood floors run throughout both the main and upper levels. At the heart of the home is the newly renovated chef's kitchen, complete with Quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a spacious center island - perfect for entertaining or casual family meals. Natural light fills every corner of this home. The main floor features a front-to-back formal living room with a charming wood-burning fireplace, a formal dining room ideal for hosting dinner parties, and a stunning family room with vaulted ceilings and expanded windows. A recently renovated half bath and laundry room complete the main level. Upstairs, you'll find three generous secondary bedrooms and a full bathroom with double sinks and a tub/shower combo. The luxurious primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a spa-like bathroom with a soaking tub, glass-enclosed shower, and dual vanities. The finished walk-out lower level offers a versatile space, perfect for a rec room, playroom, or home gym. Offering the best of both worlds, this home delivers privacy with the convenience of being close to town.

Beautifully sited gracious Colonial in great South Wilton location. Drive up the elegant entrance and enjoy the beautiful grounds creating a stately presence to this four bedroom home. Light and bright home with wonderful flow. Sun drenched living room with fireplace leads directly into large formal dining room off kitchen for easy entertaining. Lovely updated kitchen with its own eat in area/seating. Kitchen opens to great family room with second fireplace and access to deck for excellent outdoor entertaining. Large room over garage can serve multi purposes including home office, playroom, movie room..... Large unfinished basement with high ceilings has great potential to finish for additional living space. An abundance of windows and light make for a very sun filled happy home!

Welcome to your dream home in the heart of Wilton. Nestled just moments from Wilton Center, this beautifully maintained and thoughtfully designed 4-bedroom, 4.5 bath Contemporary residence offers a perfect balance of elegance, functionality, and comfort. Step inside to discover the perfect floor plan ideal for modern living. The main level boasts a dedicated home office, perfect for remote work or study, along with a formal living and dining room. The spacious eat-in kitchen is the heart of the home, which seamlessly flows into two family room areas and a sunroom, with large windows which flood the home with natural light. Upstairs boasts three generously sized bedrooms, two of which share a well appointed hall bath, while the third enjoys the privacy of its own ensuite bath. The luxurious primary suite is complete with two walk-in closets and an updated ensuite bath featuring high-end finishes, a soaking tub, and walk-in shower. The finished lower level adds an additional 1,200 sq ft of living space featuring an entertainment room, home gym, and a potential fifth bedroom - perfect for quests, in-laws, or an au pair. The professionally landscaped yard features a large deck ideal for outdoor entertaining, with a fully functional hot tub included. The home includes a whole-house generator offering peace of mind in any season. This exceptional property checks all the boxes - space, style, location and livability. Don't miss the opportunity to make it yours.

listings.remarks: Highest and best deadline by Monday, 1/13 at 5pm. Located on a quiet lane in South Wilton this 4 bedroom 2.5 bath Colonial home awaits its new owner. Situated on 2.24 acres of parklike property, this home is private yet convenient to schools, train, major highways as well as Wilton and Westport town center. As you enter the home you will find a spacious living room with a fireplace and dining room, ideal for entertaining family and friends. The updated kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances plus an island with a breakfast bar. A few steps away you will enter the family room that can serve as additional living space or a home office. As you venture up to the second floor, you will find a primary bedroom with full bath and room for expansion over the garage. 3 additional bedrooms and a full hall bath complete the second level. Other features of the home include a first floor half bath, hardwood floors, laundry on the main level, attic, plus a full basement ready for the next owner to finish for a playroom or additional living space and a 2-car garage with ample storage space. Outside you will appreciate the large private backyard, patio, and shed. This home has a flexible floor plan and it's conveniently located on a quiet street with endless possibilities!

Prepare to be wowed by the enchanting Middlebrook Farm, a historic gem on over two acres, just minutes from Wilton Center. Built in 1727, this estate is a cornerstone of the community, having served as the Town's Tavern and hosted British Troops in 1777. Meticulously renovated, it blends historic charm with modern luxury across 5,028 square feet. The home features 16 rooms, including 6 bedrooms and 3.5 baths, with high ceilings and an open floor plan. At its heart is a gourmet kitchen, imported from the UK and designed by Mark Wilkinson, featuring marble and soapstone countertops and a cherry wood island. Middlebrook Farm offers a unique opportunity to own a piece of history with all the comforts of today. A few extra highlights: the balcony or indoor upstairs landing are beautiful places to watch the 4th of July Fireworks. The sellers believe the fireplace beehive ovens work. Almost every room has excellent purpose storage -either a traditional closet or shelving/bookshelves that keep spaces looking uncluttered. The attic has clothing storage sellers had built that is about 30 feet long with wooden shelving on top -great for holding seasonal clothing for a large wardrobe. The property boasts beautiful Mulberry bushes.

Luxurious Keelers Ridge Estate: A Serene Sanctuary of Sophistication and Comfort Nestled on a private cul-de-sac in the prestigious Keelers Ridge neighborhood, this executive property is a testament to luxury, tranquility, and meticulous upkeep. Spanning over 2 acres of meticulously curated gardens and specimen plantings, this oasis promises an ambiance of refined elegance and natural beauty. As you enter this magnificent retreat, you are greeted by the warmth of the rising sun, while the evenings are graced with breathtaking sunsets. The estate's incredible landscaping showcases year-round plantings, creating a living tapestry that evolves with the seasons. The residence boasts a suite of upgrades, including a high-tech generator (2021/22) with a self-diagnostic feature, ensuring uninterrupted comfort. The roof has been expertly upgraded and sealed, while the swimming pool has been enhanced with a new heater, cover, and filter. The interior is a paragon of exquisite maintenance, featuring a wine cellar and exercise room that cater to both connoisseurs and fitness enthusiasts alike. The main house offers five bedrooms, including a convenient suite on the main level, perfect for multi-generational living or guest accommodation. Newly built cedar pergolas and a charming cupola atop the pool house add to the estate's allure, while the new HVAC system (2024) ensures modern comfort.

listings.remarks: All the character of 1940s construction with all of the amenities of today. This quintessential cape is warm, inviting, and full of natural light. Relax with a book in the living room with built-ins or lounge by the fire in the sun-filled family room that opens to the beautiful, updated kitchen. Dine in the banquet-sized dining room perfect for hosting dinner parties, and you can work from home in the quiet, private office with built-ins and beautiful views of the expansive yard. The lower level has an additional family/media room and an exercise room to sneak in a quick workout. After a long day, retire to the first floor primary suite with full bathroom and walk-in closets or upstairs to a second suite with a sitting/yoga room, walk-in closet, and built-ins. An updated hall bathroom and another large bedroom with built-ins complete the second floor. The outdoor living area has a large, inground pool, patio, and expansive deck. Imagine yourself sitting by the pool, grilling on the patio, or playing games in the yard. This exquisite outdoor living area is surrounded by mature trees creating a private, idyllic atmosphere. Once the cold thaws, this could be your summer backyard oasis. Convenient to the schools, fields, trails, and train to NYC, this home is easy living at its best.

Meticulously maintained single family detached home in South Wilton's Grumman Hill Village. This home offers a FIRST FLOOR PRIMARY BEDROOM, ideal for convenience and privacy. Enjoy hardwood floors throughout, updated kitchen with granite countertops, GE profile stainless steel newer appliances and new HVAC system. All bathrooms have been completely renovated -with quartz counters and gorgeous custom everything! Beautiful built-in custom library on the first floor makes a great home office. 2nd floor bedrooms for your guests or use a bedroom as a 2nd home office or exercise space. Step outside through the glass slider to a delightful patio & private backyard with a quiet view of the perennial gardens & peaceful forest. Custom-built closets, new thermostats, new lighting - many updates! Enormous easy access walk-in attic on 2nd floor is welcome additional space for all your extra belongings. 2 car garage with new garage door/remote. The best commuter location in town so close to the train stations and Route 7 - this is an ideal location! Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy easy living in this wonderful community with City water/sewer.  Monthly common HOA $330 /month.

Welcome to 58 Pine Ridge Road, a versatile home in a friendly neighborhood. Pine Ridge Rd is a little gem of a street, because it is very walkable, and perfect for biking, or jogging out to Hurlbutt St or Sturges Ridge Rd. This property is wetlands free, and the home is nicely sited on rolling 2+ acres with a private and picturesque backyard. The sunroom is a special feature of this home, where windows on three sides invite natural light and showcase the beauty of the outdoors year-round. This 3 bedroom, 2 1/2 bath home has so much potential. The heated mid level could easily serve as a 4th bedroom, home office, or both. It includes a half bath, with ample space to add a shower or tub to create a third full bath. Additionally, there is a spacious large room--an unheated area with a private entrance from the patio--that gives you incredible flexibility. It could be an au pair suite, an in-law apartment, or a dream retreat for a teenager. The present owners have lovingly maintained this home for 39 years. Some of the many updates include the following: the central AC system is 1 year old; the well with a constant pressure system is 2 years old; the oil tank is 2 years old; and the exterior of the home was painted in 2023. Servco installed a new high efficiency boiler 10 years ago, and a new Boiler Mate hot water tank 7 years ago. With its charm, character, and well-maintained systems, this home is ready to welcome its next fortunate owners.

So move right in and be ready for the golf season on the course, out your windows, or on the two decks overlooking Hole #15's fairway and putting green. Such a peaceful and scenic quality of life in a neighborhood of Wilton homes, part of the 27 holes open to SGC members and their guests. And the Historic Silvermine Community is optimally located for convenience to additional amenities offered by New Canaan and Norwalk's shopping, dining, and best commuting distances.

listings.remarks: Privately nestled on two high acres, this updated colonial blends charm with comfort. A wraparound porch, spacious side yard, and stone-walled back patio create the perfect setting. Inside, a grand two-story entry into the home flows into over-sized formal living and dining rooms with gleaming hardwood floors. The family room, featuring a striking stone fireplace, opens to the eat-in kitchen with easy backyard access. A first-floor den/office with built-ins and a wet bar leads to the all-season sunroom, offering a light-drenched space to relax or entertain. Upstairs, the primary suite is a true retreat with a cozy sitting area, vaulted ceilings, a wood-burning fireplace, beautifully renovated bath, and spacious, custom built walk-in closet. Three additional, spacious bedrooms share an updated bathroom with separate laundry space. All spaces feature over-sized closets with closet systems. Versatile additional space above the garage provides endless possibilities-perfect for a playroom, office, or gym. With updated mechanicals (oil tanks, furnace & appliances), this home ensures both comfort and peace of mind. Designed for effortless living and entertaining, this home, with its flexible floor plan, provides the ideal balance of privacy, space, and functionality with close proximity to Wilton schools, town center and local amenities!

This impeccably maintained 4 Bedroom, 2 1/2 bath Cornell Colonial located in one the most desirable neighborhoods in Wilton is a rare find! Step inside and you immediately feel the warmth & pride of ownership that this home exudes. Gracious living room w/ fireplace is flooded with natural light from the large windows. Cozy den w/ wood burning stove/fireplace and book-cases leads to lovely screened-in porch. The spacious chef's eat-in kitchen, complete w/ top of the line appliances, custom cabinetry, granite countertops & French Doors, steps away from the terrace and pool, is an entertainer's dream. Formal dining room, laundry room & half bath complete the first floor. Bonus room, conveniently located off the kitchen w/ built-ins & vaulted ceilings, ideal for playroom/office/family room. The second floor has 4 large bedrooms & two baths, including the primary suite w/ walk-in closet & ensuite bathroom w/ heated marble floor & walk-in shower. And if you are looking for more places to hang out, head to the lower level with over 1000 sq ft of finished space, perfect for office, exercise & recreation. Relax by the pool & terrace and marvel at nature's paradise. So many features make this property extra special such as the private setting abutting the Town Preserve, multifunctional living spaces, gorgeous curb appeal on beloved cul-de-sac, ideal for walking/biking. The vibrant Bald Hill community hosts many events & has close proximity to Wilton & Ridgefield Town Centers.

Welcome to Glen River, located along the Norwalk River in the heart of Wilton. This wonderful location is perfectly suited to enjoying the benefits of town and country. Enjoy walking to the shops, restaurants, library, Bradley Park, the Norwalk River Valley Trail, Horseshoe Pond and more. Even the train station connecting with Metro North isn't far. The private pool is a delightful amenity. 64 Glen View is in a most desirable location at the top of the complex, with cul-de-sac-like privacy and lovely views. Drive right up to the front door and walk straight in, no steps. The first floor features a full kitchen, sunny living room with fireplace and dining area ,with sliding glass doors opening to an East facing deck with lovely views. Also on the main floor are a half bath and closets. Upstairs features a bright primary bedroom with a vaulted ceiling and walk-in closet, a second bedroom, and a full bath with stacked washer dryer for easy convenience. New hot Water heater Jan 2025. Recently updated by the HOA: New roof, trim, soffit, gutters, skylights, venting, porches, decks, stairs and railings - installed in 2022/2023. No current assessments. Being sold as is.

An additional ensuite bedroom is perfect for guests, while a cozy sitting area and two more bedrooms share a well-appointed full bath.

listings.remarks: This sprawling 5 bedroom ranch with potential in-law is beautifully sited on a quiet South Wilton street, set peacefully behind stone pillars. Also this home is a mere 5 mins to all Wilton schools & 5 mins to the train or Merritt Pkwy. Once inside, the interior welcomes you with an airy open floor plan with gleaming hardwood floors and vaulted ceiling, exposed beams and 2 cozy fireplaces. The huge kitchen has high-end GE Monogram appliances, a large center island, wet bar, double sink and wine cooler and overlooks the full-size indoor swimming pool for year-round enjoyment and pool parties! There are 5 bedrooms on the main floor, including the primary suite with fireplace, full bath and 2 walk-in closets. Room for everyone on the main level, plus, on the walk-out lower level, there's an independent Potential In-Law (has its own entry, kitchenette, laundry, 'sleeping space' & living area).  There is an enclosed 3-season porch (w/new roof and skylight), a four-car garage, newer furnace and new $4K washer/dryer. This very special home is set on an idyllic level open property, with perennial gardens, and total privacy! Only 1 hr to NYC Home being sold as is.

Situated on 1.21 acres of beautiful property, this Colonial is convenient to both Wilton and New Canaan town center, schools, train and major highways, a true commuters dream! This gracious 4 bedroom, 3 full bath home has a spacious, light filled living room with fireplace and dining room perfect for holidays and family gatherings. The newly updated eat-in kitchen is a chef's delight with white cabinets, quartz countertops, island, updated appliances along with a sitting area, fireplace and french door to outdoor deck. Just a few steps away you will find the spacious family room with built-in book shelves, perfect for lounging, reading a book or watching your favorite movie. Half bath, foyer and office complete the main level. Upstairs you will find the primary bedroom with updated bath and plenty of closet space.Three additional bedrooms and an updated full bath complete the second floor. Other features of the home include central air, CITY WATER, solar panels, ring cameras, plus an outdoor deck, and 2 car garage.This unique neighborhood is ideal for walking and biking.One can enjoy a 1 mile scenic walk along the river to Graybarns restaurant or the Silvermine market for breakfast, lunch or dinner. Book your appointments today!

Classic Tudor charm meets thoughtful updates in this beautifully redesigned home, tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac just moments from Weir Farm National Park. Nestled on nearly 2 acres of professionally landscaped grounds and surrounded by mature trees, this property features a private pond with a charming water fountain feature. Step inside to a dramatic 2-story skylit foyer, where new white oak floors lead you through the thoughtfully designed interior. The inviting living room offers custom built-ins and a wood-burning fireplace, opening into a stylish, updated kitchen outfitted with stainless steel appliances. Just off the kitchen, a glass-enclosed sunroom with double-pane windows and a stove fireplace offers a year-round escape. The main level also includes a private, built-out office, formal dining room, a family room with second wood-burning fireplace, and a newly added mudroom off the attached 2-car garage. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features a walk-in closet with custom shelving and a fully reimagined bathroom complete with new tile, fixtures, countertops, a soaking tub, and a smart mirror. 3 additional bedrooms, an updated second full bath, and a brand new laundry room with new washer and dryer complete the upper level. Outdoor amenities abound with a stone patio perfect for entertaining, a large backyard shed, and a full bocce court. A rare opportunity in a special setting.

Interior photos will be posted by the end of the day on Saturday, the 25th. Nestled on a sprawling 2.7-acre lot, this Federal Revival colonial whispers tales from the early 19th century. The expansive property has rolling lawns with mature trees and an abundance of flowers.  Step inside to discover an enchanting blend of charm and functionality. The main floor, thoughtfully expanded over the years, offers a seamless flow and abundant natural light courtesy of its southern exposure. Cozy up by one of the two fireplaces or retreat to the oversized screened-in porch-your personal oasis.  This home boasts three spacious bedrooms and three baths, including a full bath on the main level. The primary suite is a hidden gem, featuring unusually large closets for its vintage, while the other bedrooms offer generous closet space as well.  A full basement and attic provide ample storage. The detached two-car garage is a short walk from the back door. Not to mention, there's plenty of room to add a pool! The Lambert-Miller house is ready and waiting for its next steward. Don't miss your chance to own this charming abode!

104 Cherry Lane is a stunning home ideally located in sought-after South Wilton. Set on professionally landscaped grounds, this property offers 2 acres of cleared, usable space, providing ample room for a pool or outdoor activities. Mornings start w/breathtaking sunrises from the expansive deck, all while enjoying views of the private backyard that adjoins Cherry Lane Park.The grand 2-story foyer, bathed in natural light, welcomes you into this bright & inviting home. The formal living room, complete w/gas fireplace, & the elegant dining room provide perfect spaces for entertaining. The newly renovated chef's kitchen, w/large center island, opens seamlessly into the family room, w/fireplace & custom-built cabinetry. For those who work from home, a spacious office with French doors offers an ideal, quiet retreat.The luxurious primary suite boasts vaulted ceilings, a gas fireplace, and a spa-inspired bathroom featuring dual sinks, a soaking tub, a glass shower, and a generous walk-in closet. 2 large bedrooms, each w/multiple closets, share a bathroom, while a fourth ensuite bedroom offers privacy with its own bath and walk-in closet. The 5th ensuite bedroom, located at the top of a separate staircase, is perfect for guests or additional family members. A bonus great room, complete w/built-ins, creates an excellent setting for movie nights. Walkout lower level has expansion possibilities. You will certainly love living here and enjoying all the space that this home has to offer.

Private Oasis Meets Modern Convenience. Nestled at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this home offers a rare blend of elegance, privacy, and numerous upgrades- no home projects needed. The 2025 interior paint refreshes every room with a modern touch. Renovated in 2021, the laundry room features new floors, streamlined storage, and improved lighting. All three bathrooms have upgraded lighting, and the kitchen boasts a Bosch 36" three-door fridge (2022) and a hot/cold filtered water dispenser (2022) because hydration should be easy. The 2021 gas fireplace inserts come with a remote for easy control. The garage underwent a full renovation, including painted floors, drywall, shelving, better lighting, and additional electrical outlets. A MyQ garage door opener (2021) allows remote operation from anywhere. Outside, a new hose and sprinkler system with a rain monitor (2024, $2K investment) conserves water while keeping the landscape lush. Designed by a Master Gardener, the English Garden features stunning blooms and one of the neighborhood's largest, most private yards, with Copt's Brook flowing through the backyard for added charm. Turn-key and full of thoughtful upgrades, this home is ready for you. Schedule a showing before it's gone!

His designs are revered for their unique fieldstone wall construction method, as well as their spatial organization and sensitive placement in relation to the natural environment. Step through the inviting front entry and discover an extraordinary living experience. The expansive living room and dining room exude timeless charm, creating the perfect setting for entertaining. Not to be missed is the private office and sitting room. The second floor includes four bright and sunny bedrooms. This home boasts not one, but two convenient laundry areas-one located off the mudroom and the other strategically placed on the second floor. The garage apartment can be accessed by two stairways, offering a versatile space that currently serves as a gym, complete with its own bedroom and bath. The full basement offers abundant storage and features a playroom complete with a fireplace. Step outside to your private oasis where a heated pool, spa, and inviting patio await, alongside an outdoor shower and a cabana with a full bath. A three-car garage completes this picture. Whether hosting grand celebrations or seeking peaceful solitude, this exquisite home offers endless possibilities within its serene and picturesque setting in southeast Wilton

listings.remarks: Submit all offers by 3:00 PM Monday 4/28  Welcome to 10 Four Winds Drive, a distinguished Colonial residence situated in a private community in South Wilton, Connecticut. Built in 1994 on the historic grounds of the original Four Winds Farm, this expansive home offers a harmonious blend of classic elegance and modern functionality. listings.remarks: A rare and extraordinary blend of history and modern living nestled on 2.74 private and bucolic acres. This 4-bedroom antique Colonial is the seamless union of two iconic 18th-century Wilton homes - the 1772 Middlebrook-Morgan Homestead and the 1820 Morehouse-Holmes House - relocated, re-framed, and rebuilt with meticulous attention to detail. Every visible beam is original and structural, preserving rich character while offering contemporary comfort. Highlights include a stunning Chef's Kitchen with a French Billot de Boucher butcher block (c.1880, Bordeaux), mercantile counter (c.1895, Nova Scotia), chestnut island with honed black granite, and divided light windows. The Family Room centers on a beehive oven fireplace, rebuilt stone-by-stone. A luxurious primary suite features a Murano glass chandelier, Rumsford fireplace, and custom quartz vanity in the spacious bath. Other features throughout include 250-year-old exposed timbers, antique chestnut/pine floors, a finished 3rd floor, original Borning Room, new baths/mechanicals/washer/dryer, and, a 6-zone heating & cooling system. Outdoors find a 2-story barn with electricity, a freestanding greenhouse, in-ground Gunite pool with granite decking, beautiful grounds, and a simply stunning 228-year-old Sycamore tree - one of the oldest trees in all of New England. "1 OLD HOUSE + 1 OLD HOUSE = A NEW OLD HOUSE," as storied in This Old House magazine. This property is truly a historic treasure ... reimagined for modern life.

The Living Room, anchored by a stately fireplace and a rounded wall of glass, sets the stage for memorable gatherings, while the paneled office/den offers a refined retreat for work/study. Formal occasions find their home in the dining room, with its gleaming hardwood floor. The large EIK, the heart of the home, is a culinary dream with its walk-in pantry/shared laundry for ultimate convenience. Family and friends are drawn to the warmth of the welcoming Family Room, with tray ceiling, warm pine and inviting fireplace. This space seamlessly flows into the versatile solarium/sun room, bathed in natural light for play room, billiards or your year round greenhouse! Upstairs, each Bedroom has its own en-suite bath, one J and J. Primary Suite is a spacious sanctuary boasting an enviable walk-in closet. The property's grandeur is matched only by its serene setting, mature plantings, gardens on over 2.50 acres. The soothing sounds of the Comstock Brook create a tranquil backdrop to this elegant, private haven. The heated in-ground concrete pool, lined with Belgian blocks plus huge play area is your own private country club! BONUS:WHOLE HOUSE GENERATOR. A true gem!

A chef's dream, the spacious updated kitchen boasts custom cabinetry, SS appliances, granite counters & large island or gather around the table in the dining area. French doors open to the front-to-back Family Room with cathedral ceiling, abundant windows & skylights providing natural light. Easy access to the back deck from the kitchen door or Family Rm slider for grilling, morning coffee or entertaining guests. The Living Rm with wood burning fireplace, newly refinished hardwood floors and picture window completes the main level. Up a few steps, arrive to the Primary BR with updated ensuite bath, two additional BRs and updated hall bath. Need an office or extra room for guests? The step down off the foyer leads to a great space currently used as a bedroom w/ a half bath & separate entrance. Yet another cool space for exercise, playroom or office is in the basement near laundry. Great newer mechanicals and waterproofing system are highlights as well. Wilton school bus stops right at the end of the driveway! Convenient to town, schools, Westport, transportation & all that Wilton offers.HIGHEST & BEST OFFERS due TUESDAY, 6/17, by 5PM.Thank you!

This just might be the most convenient location in all of Wilton! On the southernmost edge of town, this property is 2 homes away from the locally beloved Cranbury Park with amazing nature walking trails for both humans and canines! Only 2 mins from Route 7, 3 mins to Merritt Parkway & 5 mins to I95! This adorable low maintenance Cape Cod cottage has mature landscaping, beautiful outdoor open play areas and a 600sqft 2-tier deck. Inside this dollhouse you'll find a sleek kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances including a wine chiller. The sunny Living Room has a romantic stone hearth and large bay window. The great room has 14' cathedral ceiling with fun flexible use options. The primary bedroom and full bath are located on the first level. The second floor has a full length 2nd bedroom which could potentially be divided adding a 3rd bedroom. Attached garage. Home was upgraded to expand with 4 zones of heat and an oversized septic system. Home has a new roof, new well pump & purification system, new water pressure bladder, new filtration and a new garage door was also recently installed. This is an ideal home for so many home hunters due to its location and expansion possibilities. Sold As Is, grab it fast! Agent related to owner.

Endless Potential in a Prime Wilton Location! Imagination, inspiration, and exceptional possibilities await at 25 Vista Road. Set on a level .86 acre lot framed by stone walls and mature trees, this 1930s ranch is ready for its next chapter. Whether you're a builder, investor, or a buyer with a passion for restoration, this is your chance to bring timeless character back to life in a sought-after Wilton location near the New Canaan and Ridgefield borders. Architectural details hint at the home's charm: a vaulted foyer, barrel-ceiling living room with a stone hearth and fireplace, and a dining room with walls of windows overlooking the property. An arched hallway leads to two bedrooms and a full bath, while the kitchen and family room are separated by a spacious laundry/mudroom-ideal for future expansion or redesign. Recent improvements include a new roof and hot water heater (2022), new furnace and gutters (2023), and freshly painted exterior and breezeway. Attached 2-car garage and room for storage. The lot provides flexibility for potential additions, gardens, or outdoor living spaces. Being sold "As-Is", 25 Vista is a rare opportunity to renovate or rebuild in one of Fairfield County's desirable communities with close proximity to town, schools, and train lines, plus the peaceful setting of a residential neighborhood-this property is the blank canvas you've been waiting for.

listings.remarks: Outstanding, updated, modern Colonial tucked into one of Wilton's most sought-after neighborhoods-just a short stroll to town. Offering 4/5 bedrooms, 3 full baths, and 2 half baths, this home seamlessly blends timeless style with thoughtful updates for today's lifestyle.  Step inside to discover beautifully renovated kitchen and baths, sun-filled living spaces, and the comfort of geothermal heating and cooling. A whole-house generator provides peace of mind, while the open layout invites both everyday living and effortless entertaining.  The back patio with built in grill and smoker as well as a gas fireplace is perfect for summer/fall evenings with friends and family. The beautiful gardens designed and cared for by a master gardener are a living work of art. Lush, colorful, and inviting in every season.  This rare combination of walk-to-town convenience, modern updates, and stunning gardens makes 81 Graenest Ridge Road a true gem in Wilton. Please submit "Highest and Best" Offers by Tuesday 9/16 at noon.

Set on just over two acres with long views to roughly fifty acres of protected open space, 160 Olmstead Hill Road blends vintage farmhouse charm with a thoughtful 2013 renovation for easy, modern living. A welcoming front porch leads inside to an open, everyday flow: comfortable living and dining rooms, a sun-splashed chef's kitchen with marble work surfaces and premium appliances (including a built-in coffee maker with dedicated water line), plus an adjoining sitting area that frames the landscape. The two-story family room-anchored by a fireplace and custom built-ins-gathers everyone together. Upstairs, a calm private suite sits apart from three additional bedrooms, with two flexible work-from-home spots nearby. Storage is abundant; recessed lighting and a dry basement add daily convenience. Just outside the kitchen, a bluestone terrace invites morning coffee and evening suppers, with broad lawns and room for a future pool (buyer to verify). A standout feature is the renovated, two-story barn offering approximately 900 square feet of finished, highly adaptable space-perfect for studio, music, office, or play (not included in house square footage; buyer to confirm). Recent investments make living here effortless: interior repaint (2022); exterior carpentry repairs and full painting of the house, barn, and garage (2024); landscape improvements with selective tree work; dusk-to-dawn exterior lighting and upgraded fixtures; Ecobee smart thermostats; high-speed fiber-optic

First floor offers a chef Kitchen with professional grade appliances, granite counters, custom cabinetry and slider leading to a large Deck for outdoor entertaining, Dining Room, Living Room and Family Room with fireplace, new hardwood floors throughout. Mud Room with full Bath and Laundry located off the 3-car garage. Upstairs, Large Primary Bedroom with ensuite and double walk-in closets. In close proximity are two Bedrooms and a hall Bath. All this located on 1.27 professional landscaped acres with room for a pool. Move-in ready, A must see.

Welcome to this beautifully renovated raised ranch in a prime Wilton location, just minutes from the Merritt Parkway and the Norwalk border. The open main level features gleaming hardwood floors, a bright living room, and a chef's kitchen with quartz island, stainless steel appliances, and direct access to the deck-complete with gas hookup for grilling. The lower level offers a private primary suite with walk-in closet and full bath, plus an additional living area with its own entry-ideal for guests, in-laws, or a home office. Nature and tranquility can be found at 13 Indian Hill Road, where this spacious 4300 sq foot Craftsman style home has been designed and thoughtfully updated for comfort, beauty and relaxation. Nestled within trees, specimen plants and beautifully landscaped, this property offers the perfect blend of peaceful living and modern luxury. The gorgeous pool and pergola help to create an outdoor retreat that is stunning in every way. Inside is a gorgeous new kitchen equipped with stylish finishes, quartz countertops and modern appliances. The spectacular 1st floor master en suite bathroom is a true show stopper with spa-like features, including radiant floor heat, walk in shower, and dual vanities. The 1st floor also includes 3 more bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, a great room, office, dining room, living room and additional sitting room. An addition on the 2nd floor provides 2-3 flexible living spaces, including a dance studio/office/playroom/gym~ whatever suits your lifestyle needs. Plumbing is installed on this floor so adding a bathroom is possible. With 4/5 bedrooms, this country rambler offers room. to grow, relax and enjoy. Engineered for efficiency, the residence features a Bosch Hyper Heat HVAC system and a new Solar Array. Positioned moments from the Wilton Metro-North Station, this move-in-ready offering combines sophisticated, sustainable design with exceptional convenience. A rare opportunity for a turnkey luxury lifestyle.

The spacious main level features a large open living & dining area, kitchen, first-floor bedroom & full bathroom perfect as a home office or guest/second room. Primary Bedroom suite on the upper floor features private full Bath, cozy new carpeting and oodles of closet/ storage space! Below finds your own 1-car garage & large, 12x10 storage room. Central AC, in-unit washer & dryer and new Life Proof flooring throughout. This location presents unparalleled in-town living; walk-to Wilton Center's fabulous restaurants, shops, library, train station, grocery stores, pharmacy, public transportation plus Schenck's Island Park and the Norwalk River Trail across the street. Add in Wilton's top-rated schools and this home incorporates a convenient, comfortable community set in a thoroughly private, natural country setting.

listings.remarks: Tucked at the end of a cul-de-sac in one of Wilton's most convenient locations, 8 Maplewood Lane is designed for the way you want to live-easy, active, and connected to nature. With 5-6 bedrooms, a backyard pool, and a rare rear border on a protected nature preserve, this home offers something that's hard to find: lasting privacy with a true "no neighbors behind you" setting.  Start your mornings with coffee and birdsong, knowing the view beyond your yard will remain untouched. Spend afternoons poolside, grilling, entertaining, or unwinding after a busy day-this is a property that makes it simple to enjoy summer at home. When the seasons change, the preserve backdrop adds year-round beauty, from fresh spring greens to crisp fall color.  Inside, the generous bedroom count creates flexibility for a variety of needs-guest space, work-from-home options, a hobby room, or a dedicated play or fitness area-while still keeping everyone comfortable. And when it's time to head out, you're perfectly placed close to Wilton schools, town amenities, and Rolling Hills Country Club, making everyday errands, activities, and meetups feel effortless.  If you've been looking for a home that blends neighborhood convenience, outdoor lifestyle, and enduring privacy, 8 Maplewood Lane is one you'll want to experience in person. 2.75% assumable mortgage until 2028 and 40K credit at closing toward a new roof.

Summer Rental! Updated, furnished Colonial offering comfortable living in a convenient Georgetown location. Just minutes to dining, shops, supermarket, and Metro-North, with easy access to a growing local restaurant scene. High ceilings, an updated kitchen, and two full baths, one with a premium Toto smart toilet enhance the home's appeal. Two bedrooms plus a flexible additional room provide ideal space for a den, office, or additional bedroom with ensuite bath. The finished lower level offers a cozy lounge, while ductless split air conditioning provides efficient, zoned cooling throughout. Enjoy a private deck overlooking a tranquil river, along with a fenced backyard and a universal electric vehicle charging station. Owner/Agent.

THIS is the home you've been waiting for! Beautiful, stately home set on gorgeous level property located in a quiet, private enclave of 17 homes. Enjoy your morning walks in this little slice of heaven in North Wilton. This home abuts the Woodcock Nature Preserve - a wonderful offering right in your backyard! NEW gorgeous quartz state of the art kitchen is the heart of the home - wide open to a fabulous family room with wood burning fireplace. The 1st floor offers a spacious layout with the light filled sunroom/den & gas fireplace & slider doors opening to the outdoor bluestone patio and beautiful level yard. Private Home Office and Formal dining room round out the first floor. The 2nd floor showcases 5 bedrooms, including the lovely Primary bedroom, and the very large Bonus Room for play/media OR it can serve as a terrific in-law/ guest suite complete with the full kitchenette, full bath/laundry and separate entrance with private back staircase. Sparkling hardwood floors throughout this home, spacious closet space, 2nd floor laundry & newer mechanicals, ... this home has been well cared for! Enormous unfinished basement with 2 newer oil tanks and brand-new state of the art $20,000 full house water treatment system. Fox Run Road has been newly paved showcasing a lovely entry approach to the home. Of course.... Award Winning Wilton schools, quaint Wilton Village Center and beautiful downtown Ridgefield are just minutes away. FABULOUS home!

Welcome to this beautifully updated split-level home in the highly desirable town of Wilton Thoughtfully renovated, this 3 bedroom, 3 full bath home offers a seamless blend of modern style and everyday comfort. The open-concept main level is filled with natural light and designed for today's lifestyle, connecting the living, dining, and kitchen areas with ease. The kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a spacious center island-perfect for both casual dining and entertaining. Upstairs, you'll find generously sized bedrooms, including a comfortable primary suite, along with well-appointed bathrooms that reflect the home's updated aesthetic. Set on a private, level property, the outdoor space offers a peaceful retreat with plenty of room for relaxation, play, or entertaining. Enjoy the best of both worlds-privacy and convenience-just minutes from Wilton's town center, commuting routes, and top-rated schools. This well-maintained, move-in ready home presents a wonderful opportunity to enjoy all that Wilton living has to offer.

A rare, attention-grabbing opportunity in the heart of Wilton-36 Scribner Hill Road invites visionaries, builders, and investors to create something truly exceptional. Set on 2 private acres in one of the town's most coveted and picturesque locations, this property is surrounded by natural beauty and distinguished homes, offering a setting that is both serene and highly desirable. Opportunities like this are increasingly rare. The existing residence is in fair to poor condition and requires extensive renovation, or may be best suited for a complete reimagination. With a substantial footprint and expansive acreage, the possibilities are undeniable-restore, expand, or build new. An incredible canvas to design and craft a dream home in a premier location. Property is being sold strictly "AS-IS." Some personal property may remain. All investigations regarding future use, improvements, or redevelopment should be completed with the town following closing. Use caution when touring the property. For those with vision, this is more than a property-it's a chance to unlock extraordinary potential in one of Wilton's most sought-after settings.

Tucked along one of Wilton's most coveted cul-de-sacs, 86 Middlebrook Farm Road is a home that truly belongs to its setting-quiet, prestigious, and effortlessly beautiful. Architecturally designed with intention and a refined eye, this residence balances timeless elegance with modern livability. Spanning 12 thoughtfully curated rooms, including 5 bedrooms, 5 full baths, and a powder room, the home offers both sophistication and comfort in equal measure. The heart of the home is a stunning kitchen, where an oversized marble island, two dishwashers, a walk-in pantry, and seamless flow create the perfect backdrop for daily living and entertaining alike. Each space feels purposeful, inviting, and easy to enjoy. Outdoors, the property transforms into a private, parklike retreat, bordered on one side by the Wilton Land Trust and on the other by 48 acres of the Wilton Riding Club. Flat, manicured grounds offers exceptional privacy and tranquility. The gunite pool serves as a sparkling focal point, paired with a sauna and lush landscaping, creating a true backyard escape. With flexible living options, including potential for a second primary suite, and a location just minutes to Wilton Center, top schools, and commuting routes, this home delivers a lifestyle that is both refined and relaxed.
