listings.remarks: ASKING FOR HIGHEST & BEST OFFERS BY 12 NOON, MONDAY, APRIL 27th.Prime end-unit two-bedroom residence in the highly sought-after Wilton Crest community, ideally located just steps from convenient parking. This bright, move-in ready home offers exceptional privacy and abundant natural light throughout. The living room and both bedrooms feature sliding doors that open to a private patio overlooking beautifully manicured gardens and lawn, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor setting perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The interior showcases beautiful laminate flooring throughout the living space, complemented by elegant granite countertops and modern stainless-steel appliances in the kitchen. The thoughtfully designed layout balances comfort and functionality for effortless everyday living. Residents enjoy resort-style amenities, including a swimming pool and tennis court, all within a walkable setting close to downtown Wilton, nearby scenic trails and Schenck's Island. Additional highlights include private storage space and brand-new smart laundry units in the community basement, professional management, and easy commuter access. A rare opportunity for effortless, low-maintenance living in one of Fairfield County's most desirable communities-offering the charm of a true New England town. Arguably one of the best values currently available in Wilton - come experience it for yourself. ASKING FOR HIGHEST & BEST OFFERS BY 12 NOON, MONDAY, APRIL 27th.

Nestled at the end of a cul-de-sac and bordering Cranbury Park, this exceptional custom-built 2013 residence offers an extraordinary blend of luxury, privacy, and resort-style living.Spanning 4,698 SF, the home features 3 generous bedrooms,3 full and 1 half baths,plus a flexible finished space, ideal for a 4th bedroom, guest suite, or home office.Designed with an open-concept layout, custom millwork, and refined finishes throughout, the home exudes timeless elegance and modern comfort.The gourmet eat-in kitchen showcases marble countertops, an oversized center island,custom cabinetry,premium appliances, and a spacious pantry,flowing into the dining and living areas for effortless entertaining.The living room opens directly to the patio and heated saltwater pool,creating a seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle.Additional main-level highlights include a spacious family room, private office w/custom built-ins, mudroom, oversized laundry room with dual washers and dryers, plus an attached 3-car garage.The luxurious first-floor primary suite offers tranquil property views, an expansive walk-in dressing room, spa-like bath, and direct pool access. Upstairs, a generous den opens to a balcony overlooking the grounds, while two ensuite bedrooms feature walk-in closets. Prof. landscaped grounds include irrigation, a fenced garden and a picturesque, stocked pond with fountain and fishing access.This home has all the bells and whistles.Convenient to the train and major highways!

Stunning Sun-Filled Colonial with Designer Barn. Set on 1.32 flat acres on the New Canaan border, this bright 4-bedroom Colonial offers over 4,000 square feet of sophisticated living space. Built in 1990, the home perfectly captures "old world" architectural charm-featuring reclaimed beams & timeless New England character-while offering the ease & peace of mind of modern construction. The main level features gracious living & dining rooms with fireplaces & an open-concept kitchen that flows into a family room overlooking the expansive backyard. A glass-lined breezeway connects the house to a spectacular renovated barn. Featured in *New England Home* magazine, this climate-controlled "Great Room" boasts soaring ceilings & sliding doors to a stone patio, creating a premier space for indoor-outdoor entertaining. The primary suite serves as a serene retreat with a renovated bath & dual walk-in closets. 2 additional bedrooms-each with fireplace details-share an updated bath alongside a dedicated home office. The finished walk-out lower level adds a recreation room, gym, & private guest suite. Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac that ends at a sprawling nature preserve, the property offers total privacy while remaining incredibly convenient. Situated less than 10 minutes from the downtown centers of Wilton, New Canaan, Ridgefield, & Pound Ridge. This is a rare opportunity to own a distinctive home that balances historic aesthetic with effortless low-maintenance living.

Please submit HIGHEST and BEST OFFERS by Tuesday June 9th at 5pm. At the end of a long shared driveway that feels like a cul de sac this South Wilton 4/5 bedroom Colonial blends classic charm with meaningful modern updates - and it's move-in ready. All of this in sought-after Wilton - celebrated for its top-rated schools, charming village center, and easy Merritt Parkway and Metro-North access. This is Fairfield County living at its finest.

Looking for a diamond in the rough? Located on a rear lot at the end of a cul-de-sac. This property offers the perfect opportunity to create your dream home in South Wilton. Serene Location! Enjoy all that living in Fairfield County has to offer in this very spacious Ranch home with approximately 2,040 square feet located in the quiet town of Wilton. Brand new, modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a double oven, farm sink, lots of cabinets, and an L-shaped island. Baths are remodeled with double sinks and large vanities, and towel warmers! Central air, as well as ceiling fans throughout. The lower level offers a complete recreation room, T.V. room, a gym area, gaming tables, pinball machine, and so much more. You can create office space here too. Easy access to the Merritt Parkway, Westport, shopping, & restaurants. Half hour or less ride to Stamford & Greenwich too. Enjoy all that Fairfield County has to offer!

2500 sq ft South Wilton Ranch with High-End Finishes Throughout, this beautiful home has been completely rebuilt down to the studs, offering a seamless blend of modern luxury and thoughtful design. Privately set back from the road, the home is approached by a long driveway and enhanced by newly installed deer fencing and gated entry, creating a serene and secure setting. Ideally located in South Wilton, just minutes to town, shopping, and commuting routes. The spacious primary suite features a vaulted ceiling, oversized dual walk-in closets, and a spa-inspired bath with radiant heated floors and dual vanities. At the heart of the home is a state-of-the-art kitchen equipped with Energy Star appliances, designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. The finished lower level offers exceptional flexibility and can be utilized as a bedroom, playroom, or home office, complete with a wine cellar and tasting bar-perfect for hosting or relaxing in style. Step outside to a private outdoor entertainment area featuring a custom built-in barbecue, ideal for outdoor dining, all surrounded by mature specimen plantings.  Additional highlights include new garage doors along with a fully automated irrigation and sprinkler system servicing both front and back yards.

Set on a stunning and picturesque 2.24-acre property, this beautifully maintained 4-bedroom home (3 bedrooms per field card) offers the perfect balance of privacy, comfort, and updated living. Surrounded by mature landscaping and peaceful wooded scenery, the property feels like a private retreat while still offering exceptional functionality for everyday life. The main level features an updated kitchen, renovated bathrooms, and an ensuite primary bedroom, along with two additional bedrooms. A warm and inviting living room with fireplace, cozy den/library, and elegant dining room create ideal spaces for both entertaining and quiet relaxation. The dining room opens to a spacious deck overlooking the serene grounds, while a screened-in porch connected to the deck and den provides the perfect spot to enjoy the outdoors throughout the seasons. The finished lower level offers exceptional flexibility with a converted 4th bedroom, expansive common/family room, office area with direct backyard access, laundry area, workshop, abundant storage space, and access to the oversized 2-car garage. Generous closets and storage areas throughout the home provide ample room for organization and everyday convenience. Adding to the home's appeal are a private wooded walking path, whole-house generator, comprehensive security system with multiple exterior cameras, and seasonal tick treatment for added peace of mind. A truly special property offering space, character, and a beautiful natural setting.

The formal living and dining rooms both boast bay windows, hardwood floors and wood burning fireplaces for gracious entertaining. listings.remarks: Beautifully constructed and thoughtfully designed, this exceptional 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom single-level home is privately set on a landscaped 0.70-acre cul-de-sac lot just minutes from downtown Wilton and the Norwalk River Valley Trails. Designed for today's lifestyle, the modern open-concept floor plan seamlessly blends indoor and outdoor living. The stunning chef's kitchen features a large quartzite center island, high-end stainless steel appliances, and abundant workspace - opening directly to an expansive outdoor deck ideal for entertaining and overlooking the flat, professionally landscaped backyard. The main living area offers an expansive entertaining space with fireplace and dining area, all positioned to enjoy beautiful backyard views. Adjacent to the kitchen is a cozy family room along with a flexible fourth bedroom or home office featuring stylish barn doors for privacy, a full bathroom, mudroom separate side entrance. The lower level offers a large two-car garage with electric vehicle charger, extensive storage space, and a full unfinished basement ready to become a gym, recreation area, media room, or additional living space tailored to the next owner's needs.

Highest and best by 2:00 pm on Monday, 5/18. Set on a coveted lower Nod Hill cul-de-sac, 45 Ryders Lane is the kind of home that quietly wins people over the moment they arrive. Classic in style yet thoughtfully updated for modern living, this 4-bedroom Colonial blends timeless architecture with warm, inviting spaces designed for real life.  Inside, light pours through generously sized rooms, creating an easy elegance throughout the home. The renovated kitchen is both beautiful and functional, featuring a Wolf range, Sub-Zero refrigerator, and seamless flow into the home's casual gathering spaces. Nearby, the mudroom and updated laundry area make everyday living refreshingly effortless.   Upstairs, the primary suite feels like a private retreat, complete with a beautifully renovated bath featuring radiant heated floors and a heated towel bar. Three additional spacious bedrooms, an updated hall bath, and a walk-up attic provide flexibility for today's lifestyle.  Outside, summer practically writes its own plans. A charming screened porch overlooks the property, while the stone patio and expansive yard offer room for entertaining, gardening, or simply slowing down for the evening. Thoughtful improvements, including a new cedar roof, solar panels, upgraded electrical service, an invisible fence, and a new water heater, add comfort and peace of mind. A special home in one of Wilton's most sought-after neighborhoods.

Tucked away at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in desirable Lower Lower Wilton on the Westport border, this beautifully updated Colonial offers the perfect blend of privacy, convenience, and lifestyle. Set on 2.35 flat, dry acres with an in-ground pool, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home features approximately 3,500 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. A newly renovated eat-in kitchen showcases quartzite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and seamless flow for everyday living and entertaining. Spacious living and family rooms each feature wood-burning fireplaces, while a dedicated home office and sun-filled bonus room with polished concrete flooring provide flexible spaces for work, relaxation, or recreation. The second floor offers four generously sized bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite, along with the convenience of second-floor laundry. A walk-out lower level features an exceptional mudroom area with abundant storage and functionality. Additional highlights include city water, an ideal commuter location close to both Wilton and Westport amenities, and a rare combination of level land, neighborhood setting, and move-in-ready condition. Wired for generator. Underground electric.

Rarely does a home in Wilton offer true first-floor living with this level of renovation, layout, and neighborhood setting. Completely updated with a designer's eye, this Colonial is tucked into one of Wilton's most sought-after streets, just minutes to downtown, Metro North, the Wilton YMCA, schools, parks, and more. The main-level primary suite is a standout with a renovated spa bath featuring heated floors, soaking tub, oversized marble shower, and custom walk-in closet. The chef's kitchen anchors the home with a massive quartz island, 6-burner gas range, Walker Zanger backsplash, farmhouse sink, and seamless flow to both indoor and outdoor entertaining. The vaulted great room with shiplap, built-ins, and backyard access is where everyone naturally gathers. A separate office with built-ins plus an additional first-floor en suite bedroom with private entrance offers flexibility for guests, au pair, or in-laws. Upstairs are two spacious bedrooms, storage, craft room, and hangout/homework space. Finished lower level with wet bar adds even more usable space. Outside, enjoy the large bluestone patio and beautifully landscaped yard, perfect for summer dinners, morning coffee, or simply enjoying the neighborhood setting. This is the kind of Wilton home buyers wait for: updated, functional, full of character, and in a neighborhood people rarely want to leave.

The high-end kitchen is equipped w/custom white cabinetry, stone countertops, sub zero refrigerator/freezer/icemaker, GE Profile Gas Range and ergonomically-correct two-drawer Fisher Paykel dishwasher. There is a receiving room with radiant heat floors, (so welcoming on a winter's day), a music room/office, a true formal dining room, formal living room with fireplace, large sunny double home office/gym, a delightful "sea blue" walk-in pantry/bar. The yard has invisible dog fencing plus 2 fenced areas, safe for pooches or play and the property rambles beyond into your own private woods! This tasteful gem is in a convenient commuter location, only 50 miles to NYC! Many additional photos coming

The great room serves as a dramatic focal point of the home, anchored by a contemporary freestanding wood-burning fireplace. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly into the dining area and Euro-style kitchen. A den, convenient powder room with laundry, and flexible living space complete the main level. An open staircase leads to two loft-style bedrooms with hardwood floors and a full bath with shower/tub combination, enhancing the home's distinctive design aesthetic. Farmers at heart, we built a greenhouse & installed a vegetable garden, chicken coop (love the fresh eggs) & bunny hutch. Nights around the fire pit are the best! Built in 1939, this enchanting 4 Bed/3 Bath carries the kind of craftsmanship, character, and soul that simply cannot be replicated in today's construction. Thoughtfully arranged within a cozy 1,864-square-foot footprint, every inch of this home has been put to work. There's nothing wasted, nothing superfluous - just warm, efficient living spaces that feel intimate. One of the upstairs bedrooms opens directly onto a private upper porch, a rare and romantic feature perfect for morning coffee, evening stargazing, or simply stealing a quiet moment above the world. Out back, a lovely patio awaits, an ideal setting for summer gatherings, container gardens, or a peaceful retreat at the end of the day. And the location? Practically unbeatable. Stroll to the historic Cannondale Village and train station, making this an exceptional find for commuters or weekenders who want the serenity of a classic New England neighborhood without sacrificing connectivity to the city. listings.remarks: Mid-Century Modern, Reimagined. This singular residence is a compelling conversation between two architectural eras, where a gracious 1950s post-and-beam home designed by Robert Peterson, who studied under Mies van der Rohe, meets a striking contemporary addition by architect Zehra Kuz Mackin. The original structure, defined by its low-slung roofline and classic Mid-Century proportions, has been thoughtfully opened and refined, allowing light to move freely through beautifully composed interiors. Created to accommodate an art collection, guests and vintage automobiles, the zinc-and-glass addition introduces a distinctly modern vocabulary while remaining remarkably harmonious with the original architecture. A sculptural glass-and-steel staircase, gallery-like spaces, private guest suite and collector's garage blur the distinction between residence and exhibition space, yet the home remains inviting and eminently livable. The interior of the original house has been substantially renovated including a recent kitchen makeover.  Beyond the glass, architecture gives way to landscape. A serene, spa-like pool creates an extraordinary sense of privacy and retreat. Rare, sophisticated and impossible to replicate, this is modernism not preserved in amber, but beautifully evolved.

The heart of the home is the family room, anchored by a stone fireplace, soaring ceiling and surrounded by walls of windows and French doors leading to an expansive deck overlooking the beautiful level property. An oversized add'l family room offers exceptional flexibility as a recreation room, media room, fitness space, or additional bedroom. Convenient to Wilton's award-winning schools, town center, and commuting routes, this is a rare opportunity to own in one of Fairfield County's most sought-after locations.

listings.remarks: Rock House Farm, c.1765. One of Wilton's most treasured historic estates, this extraordinary former dairy farm blends nearly three centuries of history with the comforts of modern living. Originally built by Reuben Olmstead in 1765, expanded in the 1800s, and thoughtfully renovated and enlarged in 1997, the estate has been beautifully preserved for generations. Set on six spectacular acres bordered by 14 acres of permanently protected open space, the property offers exceptional privacy and breathtaking pastoral views. The gracious main residence spans over 6,000 square feet with five bedrooms, five full and one half baths, and seven fireplaces. A charming two-bedroom, two-bath guest cottage with full kitchen, laundry and three fireplaces evokes the charm of the English countryside. Completing the estate is a magnificent four-story red dairy barn, a rare architectural treasure and lasting reminder of the property's rich agricultural heritage. Ancient stone walls, rolling lawns, specimen trees and timeless beauty create one of Fairfield County's most remarkable country estates.

Open floor plan on main level and 3 spacious bedrooms plus office/playroom/extra bedroom completes 2nd floor. The private patio provides a peaceful outdoor retreat for relaxing or entertaining. The freshly painted bright and inviting interior features hardwood floors, natural gas heat, and a functional floor plan designed for comfortable everyday living. Updates over the years include newer roof, refinished hardwood floors, updated kitchen appliances, refreshed interior finishes, and meticulous maintenance throughout. Additional features include underground sprinklers, pull-down attic storage, and extensive built-in shelving in the garage. Grumman Hill Village is known for its attractive setting, strong management, and convenient location close to Wilton Center, Westport, shopping, restaurants, schools, train stations, major commuting routes, and public transportation. Move right in and enjoy the convenience, comfort, and lifestyle that make Grumman Hill Village one of Wilton's most popular communities

Lovingly maintained by its original owners, this sun-filled 3-bedroom ranch sits on 1.8 private, tree-lined acres in one of Wilton's most sought-after neighborhoods. Warm hardwood floors throughout the living room and dining area and main level bedrooms. Cozy family room with wood stove, plus a classic living room fireplace with firebox insert for twice the gathering space. Three comfortable bedrooms, 1.5 baths, and 1,379 heated sq. ft. of bright, inviting living. Attached 2-car garage. A rare sense of seclusion with mature trees and peaceful surroundings - yet just moments from Georgetown dining, shopping, and everyday conveniences. Top-rated Wilton schools nearby. A peaceful, private setting with everything close at hand. A truly special home, offered for the first time - don't miss this opportunity. Schedule your private showing today.

Located moments from Wilton Town Center, this fully reimagined 6-bedroom, 5.2-bath residence blends timeless character with modern luxury. Set on more than two pristine acres with a designated pool site and overlooking the Silvermine River, the home has been extensively renovated, showcasing exceptional craftsmanship and thoughtful design throughout. The interior features 9-foot ceilings, Brazilian cherry floors on the main level, red oak upstairs, and custom millwork. Designer finishes, modern lighting, and integrated smart-home technology complement a spacious layout ideal for entertaining and everyday living. The lower level offers two large rooms, each with walk-out access, a fireplace, a full bath, and an additional room that could serve as a bedroom, providing flexible space for nanny or in-law use, guest quarters, recreation, or a private home office. Bespoke cabinetry, premium fixtures, and top-tier appliances elevate each room. Additional highlights include commercial-grade mechanical systems, a Kohler true full-house 48 KW generator, advanced home technology and security, and a lifetime shingle roof with warranty and copper flashing. Outdoors, refreshed landscaping, mahogany deck and porch, and upgraded hardscaping create a private, inviting setting for gatherings or quiet enjoyment.

listings.remarks: Tucked away on a private, serene wooded setting in sought-after South Wilton, this beautifully updated home offers the perfect blend of tranquility and convenience. Enjoy the peaceful sounds of a babbling brook while being just minutes to the train to NYC, major highways, top-rated schools, Wilton Center shopping, and dining. Set on just shy of an acre, the home features a brand-new renovated kitchen, updated bathrooms, hardwood floors, new stainless steel appliances, a spacious primary suite with walk-in closet, and a huge two-car garage. A rare opportunity to enjoy blissful privacy surrounded by nature without sacrificing commuter convenience. Location, location, location.

Turn-key, 3-bedroom, 2-full bath split-level home set on a level 2+ acre property in a sought-after neighborhood, perfect for walking and bike riding. Enjoy direct access to Sackett State Park, offering miles of scenic trails for hiking and walking your dogs. The updated kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast bar that opens seamlessly to the dining area and spacious living room, creating an ideal layout for everyday living and entertaining. Two bedrooms share a full bath, while the primary suite offers a walk-in closet, raised ceiling with skylight, and a private full bath. The finished lower level includes a welcoming family room with a fireplace, built-in shelving, office, full bath, and walkout access to the backyard and deck. Hardwood floors throughout, a gracious entry foyer, and fresh interior and exterior paint add to the home's appeal. Solar panels help keep electric costs low. Conveniently located close to town, schools, and New Canaan, this move-in ready home offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and outdoor recreation. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity!

First time on the market in 39 years! This charming 1930's 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers 2211 sq ft of living space on 2.96 acres of flat, beautiful, park-like property. Set back from the road, this property offers privacy, space, and endless possibilities while remaining conveniently located in a community with award-winning schools. A welcoming foyer leads to a spacious formal front-to-back living room featuring a fireplace and attractive moldings, along with a formal dining room perfect for entertaining. The kitchen offers stainless steel appliances and opens to a dining area and comfortable family room space. An enclosed porch provides additional versatile living space and overlooks the expansive grounds. The second-floor features three bedrooms and a full bath, while the fourth bedroom is privately located on the third floor and includes an ensuite bath. Hardwood floors throughout add warmth and character. With a generous layout, beautiful property, 2-car garage and tremendous potential, this is a wonderful opportunity to bring your vision and create the home you've always wanted. Close to town, train and major highways. Property is being sold "as is."

Amazing value in Wilton! Extensively updated, this charming Colonial offers the perfect blend of classic character and modern convenience. Featuring a newly renovated kitchen, updated bathrooms, refinished hardwood flooring, a new heating system, updated electrical, a new roof, and fresh paint throughout. Among others, a new well cap adds to the list of important improvements. The warmth and character has been thoughtfully preserved, which is what makes this home so special. Ideally located just minutes from town, schools, shopping, dining, and commuter routes, 20 Mountain Road is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy all that Wilton has to offer in a home that is truly move-in ready.

Located close to the Lake Club on a private secluded lot bordering Parting Brook. This home underwent a complete top to bottom remodel featuring, a stunning new kitchen, all new windows, heating and cooling system, new baths, siding, deck, etc.... 4 fireplaces, 2 car garage, walk in closet, newly paved driveway.

In 1968 the owners purchased a 2 acre building lot and built a beautiful home and raised their family and grandchildren. Now it's time for another family to enjoy years of happiness as they did in the past. Spacious single floor living circular drive. Open front door to a large entrance leading to a formal living room and dining room. Eat-in Kitchen opens to a large family room fireplace with a wall of windows overlooking the landscaped property with pool. Master with full bath walk-in closet plus a wall of closets.  Two additional bedrooms main level. Lower level with walkout sliders to covered patio  A spacious playroom additional 1550 Sq Ft. with fireplace and bar area. Bath with shower and possible office/bedroom and a storage room. Two private beautifully landscaped acres, flat open play yard. Also included is a Generic generator.

A truly pristine 2 bedroom, 2 1/2 bath end unit Townhouse in very desirable Wilton Crest is a rare opportunity for the next lucky homeowners. Spacious and chic, this lovely home has been tastefully updated throughout. Stunning living room with vaulted ceiling, fireplace, hardwood floor and sliders leading out to deck is ideal for entertaining. The renovated kitchen boasts new Bosch 800 series appliances, granite counters, subway tile back splash, lots of cabinets and a walkout to the charming patio area. Light-filled dining room offers a beautiful view to a serene setting of trees and nature. Expansive first floor primary suite with ample double closets, vaulted ceiling, patio access & luxurious updated bathroom with jetted tub, double sinks, sky light and large stall shower is a dream oasis. Upstairs you will find another generously sized bedroom and full bath. The lower level is finished with LVP flooring & offers flexible living spaces for playroom and office. In addition there is a laundry room with new GE washer/dryer and convenient access to the garage. So many improvements including new A/C in 2021, new furnace in 2022 & new water heater in 2025. Amazing opportunity to live in a coveted community where residents enjoy premium amenities including a pool & tennis courts and can walk into town for shopping and restaurants. This special home, surrounded by trees, is private and offers a lifestyle of convenience and low maintenance. Not to be missed! Showings begin Sat.

listings.remarks: Back on the market solely due to previous buyer financing dissolution, this exceptional 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath antique Colonial is ready for its next chapter. Celebrated by The New York Times, Realtor.com, and Homes.com for its distinctive character, this home offers the ultimate blend of historic integrity and modern ease. The light-filled interior was designed for effortless, low-maintenance living. Sunlight pours through oversized windows, illuminating wide-plank floors and an updated granite kitchen. French doors lead to a private stone patio, looking out on 1.49 professionally landscaped acres with classic stone walls, native gardens and serene outdoor spaces. The main level features a dramatic dining room with a skylight, a spacious living room with a cozy reading nook and wood stove, plus a main-level laundry room. Upstairs, a vintage-inspired full bath accompanies three charming bedrooms, including a primary suite with a large walk-in closet. Listed on the National Register of Historic Places, the property is a part of the Pollinator Pathway Project and a Certified National Wildlife Habitat. Located in Wilton's Historic District, this home trades the burden of an oversized footprint for an efficient, lock-and-go sanctuary just a short stroll to Georgetown's vibrant cafes, restaurants, and Caraluzzi's Market. With city water, total privacy, and effortless access to Route 7 and Metro-North, this is a perfectly priced masterclass in historic charm.

Easy one-level living meets thoughtful updates in this inviting 4-bedroom, 2-bath ranch, privately set on 1.5 wooded acres in central Wilton. The light-filled interior features hardwood floors, a welcoming living room with fireplace, and a streamlined kitchen with abundant cabinetry, stainless-steel appliances, and generous prep space. Four bedrooms offer flexibility for guests, work, or hobbies, while two full baths include a beautifully tiled walk-in shower. A screened porch brings the outdoors in and opens to a newly leveled, fully fenced backyard with a new stone patio-an ideal setting for dining, recreation, or quiet evenings surrounded by nature. The bright walk-out lower level adds valuable bonus space and features a new sliding door. Major improvements include conversion from oil to propane with a high-efficiency wall-mounted boiler; upgraded 200-amp electrical service; whole-house surge protection; hardwired smoke and carbon monoxide detectors; generator hookup; and water filtration, softening, and reverse-osmosis drinking water. The chimney was professionally cleaned, lined, repaired, and fitted with a new cap, while extensive tree trimming and cabling further enhance the grounds. An attached two-car garage completes this appealing home, Location is key, and this property delivers in that department as well. Situated conveniently close to town, you'll have easy access to all the amenities, shopping, dining and proximity to Wilton's award-winning schools.

Recently refinished and lightened hardwood floors flow throughout, including newly installed hardwoods on the upper level. At the heart of the home, the white chef's kitchen features quartz countertops, Sub-Zero and Thermador appliances, and a generous center island opening to a vaulted family room with custom built-ins and a striking fireplace. Formal living and dining rooms offer inviting spaces to gather, while a private study provides a dedicated home office. Upstairs, the serene primary suite includes two walk-in closets and a marble bath with dual sinks, joined by three additional spacious bedrooms and a hall bath. The finished walk-out lower level expands the living space with room for recreation, fitness or relaxation, plus a fabulous mudroom off the garage. Outside, a large Trex deck overlooks the level, professionally landscaped backyard. Additional enhancements include a new water-filtration system at the point of entry with a new reverse osmosis system at the kitchen sink, whole-house generator and Lutron lighting. Close to Wilton schools, town center, Ambler Farm, Weir Farm and Ridgefield's Main Street. Truly a move in ready property in an idyllic Wilton neighborhood.

Inside, the open-concept main level features gleaming hardwood floors, a spacious living and dining area, an updated kitchen, and a convenient powder room-ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, the sun-filled primary bedroom boasts a vaulted ceiling and a generous walk-in closet. A versatile second room is perfect as a guest bedroom, home office, or study, while a full hall bath and an oversized hallway closet provide excellent additional storage. Central air conditioning ensures year-round comfort.  Residents of Glen River enjoy a community pool, beautifully landscaped grounds, and the convenience of a covered parking space just steps from the unit. Offering a low-maintenance lifestyle in a welcoming community, this move-in-ready home combines comfort, convenience, and an exceptional Wilton location.

listings.remarks: Welcome to 39 Lambert Common! This lovely townhouse has been meticulously maintained and cared for by the same owner for the past 39 years, and the pride of ownership truly shows. Located in the desirable Lambert Commons complex, where units are rarely offered for sale, this corner end unit offers over 1,700 sq. ft. of living space and a two-car garage. The bright and open main level features a sun-filled living room, dining room, half bath, eat-in kitchen, and a versatile bonus room-perfect for a den or home office. The living room features a fireplace and sliders leading to a 15x15 stone patio and private yard space surrounded by beautiful perennial plantings. A convenient walkway provides direct access to the garage. The second level offers two spacious bedrooms with double closets, a full bath, & laundry for added convenience. The primary bedroom suite features its own private full bath with a double vanity & new stall shower. There is plenty of storage throughout, along with a partially finished room in the basement-perfect for a playroom, rec room, or home gym-plus a separate storage/utility room. All custom window treatments are included. Recent improvements include newer windows and appliances, a newer roof, HVAC system (2024), water heater (2024), basement sink and pump (2024), and a new garbage disposal (2026). With no assessments and a location in this sought-after complex, this beautiful end unit is a rare opportunity you won't want to miss!

Originally built in 1769, this beautifully renovated and meticulously maintained antique home blends historic character with modern comfort. Set on two landscaped acres along one of Wilton's most scenic country roads, the four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath residence offers approximately 3,758 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. The renovation included updated electrical systems and a whole-house generator that keeps the home running during power outages. An inviting eat-in kitchen opens to a private patio, while the formal dining room, living room with fireplace, hardwood floors, exposed beams, and period details create warmth and character throughout. The primary suite includes a private bath and walk-in closet, and the finished third-floor offers flexible additional space. A charming antique barn and two-car garage complete the property, with room for a pool. Enjoy peaceful country living close to hiking trails, Weir Farm, schools, markets, the post office, and town amenities.

Steal away to your own private playground in this beautiful contemporary with POOL AND SPORT COURT, on a lovely neighborhood road. Set down a private driveway through lighted stone pillars, the house welcomes you with lush, mature landscaping. A large foyer opens to the sunny living room with beaded vaulted ceilings, floor-to ceiling fireplace and wall-to-wall sliders to a large deck that overlooks the pool and grounds, with a special touch reflecting the owners' love of soccer. The updated kitchen with double ovens, sub-zero fridge, center island and adjacent dining area offers a spacious gathering space with plenty of options for creating memorable meals. The screened porch offers a escape and more dining options in almost all seasons. Wake up in the oversized PRIMARY BR ON FIRST FLOOR to a beautiful view, sliders to the deck, and plentiful closet space plus a full bath. A second BR (currently being used as an office) and full bath is on the first floor. The lower level includes three more bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, sauna, laundry room and a handsome Family Room with fireplace and sliders. Want the grandkids to visit, and have a lot to do, but don't want too much space when they are not there? This is a sanctuary for peace and quiet, that opens up to a joyful celebration of activity and camaraderie when shared with family and friends, on a street known for it's own joyful camaraderie!

SELLER IS REQUESTING ALL OFFERS TO BE SUBMITTED BY TUESDAY, SEPT. 1ST BY 5:00pm.  Located in highly desirable Wilton Hills, this stunning home has been completely transformed over the past six years, offering modern luxury, thoughtful updates, and an exceptional open-concept floor plan. A dramatic two-story foyer welcomes you into a light-filled interior featuring a spacious great room with cathedral ceilings, new mouldings, a new gas fireplace, and a wall of windows overlooking the beautiful and private surroundings. The completely renovated chef's kitchen is a true showstopper, featuring gorgeous quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, a generous 9-foot island, and top-of-the-line Wolf, Bosch, and Sub-Zero appliances. The main-level primary suite provides a private retreat with expansive windows, walk-in closet, tray ceiling and a beautifully updated bath. Upstairs, two generously sized bedrooms feature new hardwood floors and share a newly renovated full bath. The walk-out lower level offers exceptional additional living space, with new vinyl plank flooring, a versatile office that could also serve as a fourth bedroom, and a renovated full bath. With nearly every space thoughtfully updated, this move-in-ready home combines sophisticated design, modern amenities, and flexible living spaces in one of the most desirable South Wilton settings. Updates include: New Roof, New HVAC, New Kitchen, New Baths, Added Hardwood Floors...see complete list under Documents

Fully renovated, innovative living spacious 2 bedroom. Best unit in the building! Brand new kitchen with island for counter seating and brand new bathroom, flex space for living/dining room. Hardwood floors throughout. This amazing building offers a Zen common area equipped with wet bar and microwave for an extra living room feel on 2nd floor, and a large conference room on main floor available to be reserved for outside of office meetings with business hub room. Art House building boasts artistic vibes and a cozy ambiance, perfect place to come home to and relax.

Fully renovated, 2-bedroom apartment centrally located to all. Brand new kitchen and bathroom, high ceilings naturally sun lit. Hardwood floors throughout and slider out to huge 300SqFt personal patio area. This amazing building offers a Zen common area equipped with wet bar and microwave for an extra living room feel on 2nd floor, and a large conference room on main floor available to be reserved for outside of office meetings with business hub room. Art House building boasts artistic vibes and a cozy ambiance, perfect place to come home to and relax.

75 Ledgewood feels like a hidden retreat, set on two private acres bordering protected Wilton land. Surrounded by mature trees and filled with beautiful light, this south-facing, classic Colonial offers a rare sense of privacy while still keeping you close to everything. Inside, thoughtful updates, warm interiors and an easy connection to the outdoors create a home that feels incredibly inviting. The fully updated kitchen opens directly to the deck, while living and dining rooms offer plenty of space to gather. A sun-filled family room with double-sided brick fireplace opens to the patio, and a separate office space with built-ins invites you to work or unwind. Upstairs are four bedrooms and two full baths, including a primary suite with renovated bath featuring heated floors and a walk-in closet. Hardwood floors and abundant natural light carry throughout the home. Outside, the deck, bluestone patio and expansive yard create multiple spaces to dine, entertain or simply enjoy the private, natural surroundings. Meticulously maintained, 75 Ledgewood combines the privacy of a tucked-away setting with the convenience of desirable South Wilton - minutes to town, top-rated schools and commuter routes to NYC.

The most magical setting begins on a quiet cul-de-sac in South Wilton. Welcome to 11 Greenbriar Lane, a freshly painted 4-bed Colonial set on 1 acre. The kitchen is a cook's dream, with a Viking gas cooktop, Sub-Zero refrigerator, Miele double wall oven, warming drawer, and dishwasher, plus custom cabinetry and a wine bar. The main level flows through an open concept, eat-in kitchen, fireplaced living room, den and sitting room with beautiful views of the back yard. The home office with built-ins offers tucked away convenience. The newly renovated mudroom is accessible from both the side door and two-car garage. A separate staircase leads to a hidden-away family room above the garage, with beamed ceilings, projector and a second fireplace, perfect for movie nights and lazy weekends. Upstairs are four bedrooms, including the primary suite with walk-in closet and renovated marble bathroom with double vanity and heated floors, plus a second-floor laundry room. Outside, professionally landscaped grounds with a gentle brook, stone walls, and perennial gardens frame flat front and back yards with irrigation. The stone patio, terraces, and outdoor fireplace make it an entertaining paradise. Behind the charm are thoughtful updates: exterior paint (2026), garage EV charger, a generator hookup, and upgraded well and water systems. Just 3 minutes to Wilton Center, with easy access to the Merritt, Route 7, and Metro-North, it's a commuter's dream. Your happily ever after begins here.

Incredible Opportunity in Wilton - 41 Acres. Priced to Sell. A rare chance to own a combined 41 acres in highly desirable Wilton. This very private wooded retreat offers underground utilities and city water at the property line. Just minutes from top restaurants, shopping, and three Metro-North stations, with easy access to the Route 7 corridor. Offered as a single package, these two contiguous parcels-Lot #1 (38+ acres, MLS# 170563180) and Lot #2 (3+ acres, MLS# 170562988)-are listed separately due to state parcel numbers but sold together for one low price. Wilton is known for its award-winning schools, classic New England charm, vibrant town center, scenic parks and trails, and as the home of Cannondale Bicycles and chip giant ASML. Note: A 2.5 acre fenced portion is not buildable. Buyers to perform due diligence. Estate sale - sold AS IS.

Sophisticated South Wilton Colonial: This Nantucket shingle-style residence blends timeless architectural elegance with seamless modern luxury, ideally positioned for effortless commuting to town, the train, and the Merritt Parkway. Thoughtfully designed for both grand entertaining and everyday comfort, the home features gorgeous custom details, extensive high-end upgrades, and an integrated three-zone surround sound system. The chef's kitchen is outfitted with premium appliances including a Viking six-burner gas cooktop, double ovens with a warming drawer, a built-in refrigerator, and a Miele dishwasher, opening directly into an inviting family room with custom built-ins and fireplace. On the main level, a sophisticated room provides versatile living space, seamlessly accommodating a formal dining room or private work space. Upstairs, the master bedroom serves as a luxurious private sanctuary with a cozy fireplace, a dedicated sitting area, expansive walk-in closets, and a spa-inspired primary bath. There are four additional bedrooms on this floor, two with ensuite bathrooms and two with a connected full-bath. The upper third level boasts a sixth bedroom suite and a large multi-generational living space with extensive built-ins, including cozy window-seating. The finished lower level provides an ideal versatile space featuring a spacious dedicated play/ game room, home gym, and a comfortable TV-watching area designed to grow right along with your kids...

Welcome to 40 Valeview Road, set on 2.27 private acres in South Wilton's most convenient neighborhood, just minutes to town, highways & trains to NYC. This 6-bedroom Colonial was built to do it all:cook, entertain & work from home. The kitchen anchors it all: high-end appliances, two islands for prepping and serving, with an open flow into the dining area & family room. A first-floor office with French doors provides a dedicated, private work from home space. The mudroom off the garage keeps everyday life organized.The primary suite is a genuine retreat, w/a gas fireplace, a custom walk-in closet & spa-like bath. Four additional bedrooms share the floor w/a dedicated playroom.The walk-up attic adds even more storage.The lower level includes a playroom with a fireplace and TV, a bedroom currently used as a gym, a full bath, and a flex space plus a sliding door outside: this level could be a possible in law/au pair suite. Even more storage in unfinished portion of the basement.Outside, the backyard is large, open and flexible:plenty of room to spread out.The patio is made for entertaining, all within a private, professionally landscaped yard with a possible pool site. As Wilton's first LEED/Energy Star-built home, 40 Valeview also delivers real efficiency where it counts: geothermal heating and cooling helps keep monthly utility bills noticeably lower. This is a home that was designed to be lived in and enjoyed fully - and it shows.

Just in time for the 2026/2027 school year! Great opportunity to move right into this freshly painted, rare, stand-alone 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse, with new hardwood floors. It offers exceptional privacy with no shared walls in the highly desirable Wilton Crest complex. Featuring a private attached 1-car garage and a welcoming foyer that opens to a serene back patio framed by natural rock walls, this home is ideal for peaceful living. The spacious living room includes hardwood floors, a wood-burning fireplace, and sliders to a balcony-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The open-concept layout continues into a generous dining area and a bright kitchen with ample cabinet space. Upstairs, the large primary suite boasts multiple closets and a full bath with dual sinks, a walk-in shower, and a jetted tub. A second en-suite bedroom offers comfort for guests or family. Additional highlights include central air, new heating and A/C systems, and great storage with a partial basement, laundry room, and garage. Residents enjoy access to a pool and tennis courts, with low-maintenance living just minutes from Wilton Center's shops, restaurants, and train station. Available unfurnished for a 1-2 year lease.

listings.remarks: Welcome to Grumman Hill Village, a coveted South Wilton community that blends privacy, convenience, and true neighborhood charm. This 1,984 SF, 3-bedroom home stands out for its main-level primary suite and attached two-car garage. Lovingly maintained and freshly painted, the home welcomes you with a bright, open main level where the eat-in kitchen, dining area, and living room flow together seamlessly. A separate den offers a cozy retreat for reading, relaxing, or working from home. The main-level laundry room adds everyday convenience. Step outside to a private back patio, an ideal spot for morning coffee, al fresco dinners, or simply unwinding. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms share a full bath, offering comfortable space for family or guests. Grumman Hill Village is known for its close-knit community spirit, highlighted by a beloved Halloween tradition that brings neighbors together for one of the area's most festive trick-or-treating nights. Natural gas, city water, and city sewer, add everyday ease, while the South Wilton location puts Wilton Center, dining, top schools, train stations, and major commuting routes all within easy reach. This is a rare opportunity to enjoy space, privacy, convenience, and community in one of Wilton's most established and sought-after residential settings.

Tucked at the end of a private shared driveway far off the main road, this exceptional Wilton colonial has the feel of a quiet cul-de-sac - offering the perfect blend of privacy, space, and convenience. The heart of the home is an expansive great room that flows into a spectacular kitchen - ideal for everyday living and effortless entertaining - with sliders opening to a wraparound deck overlooking a beautiful, flat yard. The formal dining room is made for holidays and dinner parties alike. Upstairs, the generous primary suite is a retreat unto itself, complete with a walk-in closet, full bath, and a private office. Three full bathrooms serve the home, with a flexible fourth bedroom upstairs perfect for guests, a playroom, or a home office. A third garage bay provides excellent storage. Perfectly positioned in the heart of Wilton - just minutes to town center, Georgetown, Cannondale Station, and major highway access.

Step into the timeless charm of Rock House Woods, an enchanting 1800s farmhouse seamlessly blending historic character with modern conveniences, including GEOTHERMAL heating & cooling! An exceptional outdoor living room with fireplace and pergola, expansive tiered terraces, heated pool and spa create a private resort-like setting surrounded by mature landscaping, sweeping lawns and a picturesque freshwater pond. Adding another dimension to the property is the extraordinary three-story carriage barn-a destination unto itself. With expansive entertaining and recreation spaces, offices, a spectacular secret "Speak Easy" and extensive garage and storage capacity for car collections, boats

A private retreat designed for easy, modern living. Tucked away from the road on 1.86 beautifully landscaped acres, this bright and airy ranch combines a sleek, clean aesthetic with an open concept floor plan and vaulted ceilings throughout.  Thoughtfully maintained and move in ready, the main residence features an updated kitchen and baths, fresh interior and exterior paint, an enclosed porch, and a spacious primary suite with new wall to wall carpeting. Two additional generously sized bedrooms and a flexible layout easily accommodate a variety of lifestyles and needs.  Adding exceptional versatility is a separate, ADU with a studio living space, private entrance, and separate parking. Peaceful and private yet convenient to town, schools, shopping and commuting, this turnkey home offers the rare combination of serenity, flexibility and effortless living. A portable generator is included. Estate Sale.

Steeped in history and rich with original character, the Samuel Fitch House (c. 1800) presents an opportunity to own an authentic piece of Wilton's past. Just 2 miles from Wilton Center, this 2,121 sf Colonial offers 3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths, surrounded by lush perennial gardens & mature fruit trees. Inside, the home showcases many of the architectural details that antique home enthusiasts seek, including wide-plank floors, hand-hewn beams, original fireplaces, period millwork, built-in cabinetry, and handcrafted doors and hardware. More than two centuries of thoughtful evolution have allowed the home to retain the warmth, craftsmanship & character that simply cannot be replicated. Whether you're searching for a full-time residence or a peaceful weekend retreat, you'll appreciate the easy commute to New York City by train or car, nearby walking trails & convenient access to both Wilton Center and Westport. Located within one of Connecticut's most highly regarded school systems, the setting offers the perfect balance of history, convenience & natural beauty. The Samuel Fitch House is being offered as-is and is best suited for buyers who genuinely appreciate the unique qualities of a historic home. Continue the stewardship of a residence that has stood for over two centuries. Buyers should expect the character, imperfections & ongoing care that accompany a home of this vintage while embracing the privilege of preserving an important piece of Connecticut history. Welcome Home!

Set on one of Wilton's most sought-after cul-de-sac streets, this classic, turnkey Colonial offers 4,355 SF of finished living space, 4 bedrooms, and 3 full, 1 half baths. Thoughtfully renovated in 2023, updates include the roof, gutters, windows, kitchen, flooring, and interior and exterior paint. The chef's eat-in kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring a Wolf 8-burner range with double ovens, Sub-Zero, warming drawer, large center island, and generous workspace. Adjacent to the kitchen, the spacious family room features a gas fireplace and built-ins. Formal living and dining rooms flow beautifully for everyday living and entertaining, with gorgeous millwork throughout. Private office with dry bar, built ins and bay window make working from home a pleasure. A spacious mudroom with 1/2 bath, heated brick floors and built-in cubbies adds both charm and function. The inviting primary bedroom features a walk-in closet and luxurious bath with heated floors, spa tub, steam shower and sauna. Three additional bedrooms, a full, and second-floor laundry complete the upper level. Finished walk-out lower level offers flexible additional living space. A large year-round back porch overlooks the level backyard with plenty of room for play and entertaining. Whole-house generator and new, fully paid-for solar panels provide added peace of mind and significant energy savings. A beautifully updated home combining classic character, modern amenities, and a wonderful Wilton location.

Light and bright town home at Wilton Crest, in the heart of Wilton. Quick close possible. 2 bedroom, 2 full and 1 half bath home with the living room, dining room, kitchen, primary bedroom, primary bathroom, laundry, half bath, and two decks all on one level. The second bedroom and full bathroom are on the second floor, and a full unfinished basement is on the lower floor. The unit is just a short walk from your garage, and just six steps up from the walkway brings you into the front door. Vaulted ceilings, skylights, sliders to the decks provide a light, bright and open feel to this home. Just freshly painted throughout. New hardwood floors in the primary bedroom, and refinished hardwood floors in the living room and dining room. Granite counters and stainless steel appliances in the kitchen. Vaulted ceiling, ceiling fan and a wood burning Fireplace in the living room. Central Air conditioning. Hot water heater new in 2023. Wilton Crest amenities include a nice size Swimming pool just a short walk from #50. Convenient South Wilton location, close to Wilton center, one mile +/- to Wilton Library, the Supermarket, restaurants and stores, sidewalk from Wilton Crest takes you into the center. Less than 2 miles to Wilton Train Station. Move in and enjoy...

listings.remarks: Nestled on a picturesque stretch of bucolic Turtleback Road-a long-time favorite route for local walkers-this inviting 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom ranch offers a rare connection to Wilton's historic pastoral roots. Once part of a cherished local dairy farm, the property carries a peaceful, storied atmosphere that's hard to find. Inside, the home feels bright, refreshed, and rejuvenated, boasting beautiful refinished hardwood floors and a fresh coat of paint throughout an effortless, single-level layout. While the interior shines, the view out of every window truly steals the show. The property backs directly onto expansive woodlands, offering easy access to miles of hiking leading to the historic Weir Farm National Historical Park. Sweeping views from the expansive picture windows and the tranquil sunroom provide a front-row seat to a rolling meadow and the changing New England seasons. It is the exact kind of peaceful backdrop that turns a morning cup of coffee into a daily retreat. Practicality meets country charm, with two separate driveways-the upper drive serving the main level, and the lower drive offering direct, convenient access to covered parking and the walk-out lower level. A brand-new 4-bedroom septic system delivers absolute peace of mind, along with the potential to expand the footprint down the road. Enjoy a true single-level oasis located equidistant to Wilton Center, Ridgefield's historic Main Street, and trendy Georgetown.

attribution.office: Citi Atlas Real Estate Co LLC

listings.remarks: Marvelous opportunity at 205 Mountain Road in Wilton! This ranch-style home is set on approximately 1.60 acres with a lightly wooded, sloping lot. The property features one-level living, a screened porch, a private well, and a private septic system. Its existing layout offers a solid starting point for renovation and value creation. Update the current home, redesign the interior, or explore expansion possibilities, subject to town approvals. The property's natural setting provides privacy while remaining convenient to Route 7, shopping, dining, and nearby amenities. Ideal for investors, contractors, builders, or buyers seeking a renovation project in the Wilton market. Bring your plans and vision to unlock this property's full potential.

Discover a beautifully reimagined South Wilton luxury home, completed in 2026 and ready to enjoy! Over $800K invested in an extensive renovation and a 1,000+ sq. ft. addition transforms this sun-filled, approximately 3,700 sq. ft. home with 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and a 3-car garage into an exceptional turnkey home. Soaring cathedral and vaulted ceilings, oversized Andersen windows, and hardwood floors create bright, inviting spaces. The open main level features a designer kitchen with premium KitchenAid appliances, abundant cabinetry, and a walk-in pantry, flowing into elegant dining and living rooms overlooking beautifully landscaped, private grounds. A charming family room with exposed beams and a cathedral ceiling is ideal for entertaining or relaxing. Upstairs, the newly built primary suite impresses with vaulted ceilings, oversized windows, a spacious fitted walk-in closet, and a luxurious bath. Three additional bedrooms include one ensuite; a dedicated second-floor laundry adds convenience. Extensive upgrades include HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofs, windows, doors, lighting, and finishes, plus a finished lower level. Enjoy a low-maintenance composite deck with cable railings, a refreshed covered porch, manicured landscaping, and a whole-house Generac generator. Move right in and enjoy the luxury of having it all done!

listings.remarks: Nestled among the trees in desirable South Wilton, this architecturally significant mid-century modern contemporary offers timeless design, privacy, and comfort. Inspired by Frank Lloyd Wright's School of Design at Taleisin. Offering approximately 2,700 square feet, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence is filled with natural light from expansive windows and sliding glass doors that seamlessly connect the interior with the surrounding landscape. A dramatic living room features vaulted ceilings, exposed wood beams, built-in shelving, and a striking stone fireplace. The adjoining dining room flows into the kitchen and inviting family room with a wood-burning fireplace and sliders to the deck and private backyard. The spacious primary suite is a true retreat with its own fireplace, sitting area, walk-in closet, private deck access, and spa-inspired bath with soaking tub, oversized shower, double vanity, skylight, and water closet. Two additional bedrooms, hardwood floors, an attached two-car garage, and a full unfinished basement provide flexibility and abundant storage. Conveniently located just minutes to Metro-North, major commuting routes, Wilton Center, and award-winning schools, this is a rare opportunity to own an architecturally distinctive home in one of Fairfield Counties favorite towns.

Welcome to this light-filled, contemporary 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath townhouse, ideally situated in one of South Wilton's most convenient locations! Soaring ceilings, skylights, and an abundance of natural light create a bright, airy atmosphere throughout. The spacious kitchen features new stainless steel appliances and opens to a private, enclosed deck, also accessible from the primary suite. The inviting living room offers multiple exposures, a cozy fireplace, and a private balcony all perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The generously sized first-floor primary suite boasts cathedral ceilings and a beautifully updated, spa-inspired bathroom featuring a luxurious soaking tub and separate shower. Upstairs, a second bedroom and full bath provide a comfortable and private retreat for guests or family. The expansive lower level ( the largest in the complex!) includes a finished office/playroom, ample room for a home gym, exceptional storage, and direct access to the attached one-car garage. Additional highlights include central air, second floating parking space, and plenty of guest parking. Enjoy resort-style amenities, including a pool and tennis courts, all just moments from South Wilton's shops, restaurants, and Metro-North. An exceptional combination of space, natural light, comfort, and convenience. A wonderful opportunity not to be missed!

listings.remarks: VERY motivated sellers! Reduced below recent bank appraisal! Beautifully situated on a spacious corner lot, this exceptional home enjoys the added privacy of a quiet dead-end street as its crossroad. Offering over 3,300 sq. ft of living space, this versatile floor plan provides generous room for today's lifestyle w/ endless possibilities for customization. The bright & inviting main level features a spacious living room, dining area, updated kitchen w/ sliders to deck, & an expansive family room perfect for gatherings & entertaining leading to patio. The oversized laundry room offers excellent potential for custom built-in cabinetry, a folding station, mudroom organization, or additional storage. Upstairs, primary bedroom is a true retreat, complete w/ a walk-in closet & abundant space to create the luxurious primary suite you've always wanted. W/ room to add a full en-suite bathroom. Additional bedrooms are generously sized, while the large bonus/recreation room provides incredible flexibility. Complete w/ full bathroom & set apart from the other bedrooms, this space could easily serve as: an au pair suite, multi-generational living space/office/gym or playroom. Home has a generator. Outdoor living is equally impressive with both a spacious patio and deck, offering multiple areas to relax, entertain, and enjoy the beautiful surroundings. Great opportunity to own a home w/ outstanding sq footage, flexible living spaces, & a peaceful location combining privacy w/ convenience

Now offering 1 MONTH FREE with a one-year lease a significant savings opportunity on an already exceptional value. Rarely does an in-town rental of this size and floor plan become available. This expansive 2360 sq ft end-unit duplex occupies the 3rd and 4th floors at The Wilton Center Lofts, offering a unique opportunity for modern, elevated living with private decks on both levels. Excellent commuter location-just a seven-minute walk to the Metro-North train and a three-minute drive. This home is architecturally and interior designed by the award-winning Granoff Architects, featuring top-tier finishes and timeless design throughout. The apartment boasts 9-foot ceilings and large, light-filled windows, creating a bright and open atmosphere. The gourmet kitchen includes quartz countertops, stainless steel BOSCH appliances, custom cabinetry, and premium fixtures. Wood-grain flooring flows throughout, complementing luxurious bathrooms, while large walk-in closets, an in-unit washer and dryer, providing everyday comfort and convenience. Residents enjoy access to a fitness center, tenant lounge, covered parking, and available storage units, further enhancing the lifestyle experience. Furry friends are welcome. This exceptional duplex delivers modern luxury, and intelligent design.

Welcome to 12 Lambert Common, a spacious three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath townhouse tucked away from the road in sought-after South Wilton. Offering three levels of living space and numerous recent improvements, this inviting home combines comfort, privacy, and convenience. The spacious living and dining area features hardwood floors, a fireplace, and sliders to a private stone patio with mature plantings and a peaceful space. The bright eat-in kitchen offers a charming bay window, new countertop, sink, faucet, disposal, and dishwasher. A powder room completes the main level. Upstairs, the generously sized primary bedroom features a private full bath, while two additional bedrooms share a hall bath. All second-floor windows have been replaced. The finished lower-level family room offers flexible space for entertaining, a home office, fitness, or recreation and a new high-performance washer and dryer. Additional highlights include storage, a new hot water heater, detached one-car garage, and assigned parking. Convenient to Wilton Center, Westport, New Canaan, Metro-North, shopping, dining, and major routes. With spacious interiors, thoughtful updates, and a tranquil setting, 12 Lambert Common offers comfortable, low-maintenance living. Please see the complete list of upgrades and improvements list in photos

listings.remarks: This beautiful, light-filled townhome is located in Glen River, one of Wilton's most sought-after communities. Offering the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience, the home features updated kitchen and baths, fresh hardwood floors, and thoughtful details throughout. The updated kitchen boasts modern finishes and stainless steel appliances, creating a clean, functional space for everyday living and entertaining. Adjacent open-concept living and dining areas are bathed in natural light, highlighted by beautiful custom millwork and a cozy wood-burning fireplace. Need a quiet place to work or relax? The cozy office/den features custom built-ins and a sunlit skylight. Wide sliding glass doors open to a private patio-ideal for morning coffee, alfresco dining, or unwinding at the end of the day. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite includes a walk-in closet with a custom California Closet system and a beautifully updated full bath. The second bedroom features a dramatic vaulted ceiling, a palladium window, and its own walk-in closet. A full-sized second-level laundry adds true everyday convenience. A 1-car carport and plenty of guest parking are a great addition to this home.  Residents of Glen River enjoy a private in-ground pool and an unbeatable Wilton location-just minutes to the town center, Metro-North train, local shopping, dining, and scenic walking trails. Enjoy turnkey, low-maintenance condo living!

listings.remarks: Welcome to an unparalleled masterpiece of living, nestled within a completely fenced, four-plus-acre private paradise in the very heart of Wilton, Connecticut. This extraordinary estate perfectly balances absolute serene privacy with the effortless convenience of town life. Approached via double-gated entries, the winding driveway unveils a residence meticulously crafted for the epicurean, the entertainer, and the modern visionary. The heart of the home centers around a true chef's kitchen, anchored by a roaring fireplace that radiates warmth and timeless character. Designed for both casual mornings and grand-scale catering, it features premium commercial appliances, a designated coffee bar room for your morning rituals, and endless custom storage to keep the aesthetic flawless. Just off the kitchen, a walk-in wine room awaits your private collection. For seamless entertaining, the formal sitting room features a fully equipped walk-in bar, transitioning beautifully into a stunning screened-in porch and a massive outside deck overlooking the grounds. Offering a total of six luxurious bedrooms, the home's layout is brilliantly engineered for ultimate privacy. The Owner's Suite and Family Quarters are situated in the main expanse of the home, offering opulent retreats with peaceful views of the estate.

listings.remarks: Tucked away on a private, wooded two-acre lot in South Wilton, this 1890 antique farmhouse pairs quintessential New England character with expansive, light-filled proportions and a luxury pool complex completed in August 2025. The crowning jewel is the spectacular heated saltwater pool, seamlessly integrated into a sprawling custom stone paver deck sitting atop a majestic 10-foot natural boulder wall. Complete with a custom pool bar and a built-in automatic cover, this elevated terrace creates an unmatched private entertainer's paradise. Inside, the home has been freshly prepared for its next chapter with crisp white paint throughout and beautifully refinished original hardwood floors. Unlike typical antiques, the layout boasts grandly scaled rooms, high ceilings, and windows that flood the space with light. The main level flows through a formal living room with a classic fireplace, a generous formal dining room, an expansive family room, and a sun-filled eat-in kitchen featuring terracotta tile flooring. Two separate four-season rooms offer exceptional flexibility - one overlooks the pool, while the other features a floor-to-ceiling brick fireplace with French doors opening to a high deck nestled in the mature tree canopy. A private home office and separate study complete the main floor.

Charming first-floor apartment in an 1840 Colonial in Wilton's Cannondale section with a front porch and private entrance. Spacious living room and inviting kitchen with ample storage, electric range, dishwasher, and counter seating. Comfortable bedroom with two closets and a full hallway bath. Ample parking, utilities and trash pickup included, with pets encouraged. Convenient to train, downtown Wilton, Wilton High School and Route 7 Connector. Annual lease required. Owner just added brand new, in unit laundry. See this today!

HIGHEST AND BEST. SELLERS WILL REVIEW ALL OFFERS TUESDAY OCTOBER 13 AT 5:00PM. Located at the top of coveted Olmstead Hill, with rear views of spectacular 50 acre conservation/protected parcel of land. Classic Connecticut country home blends vintage farmhouse charm with thoughtful renovation and all of the modern conveniences. Sun-filled, fabulous open floor plan and loads of glass to bring the beautiful surroundings in! Chefs kitchen includes a gas fireplace, marble counter tops and high end appliances including built-in coffee maker with dedicated water line. There are two flexible, work from home locations on the second floor in addition to three bedrooms plus the primary bedroom with spacious, ensuite bath. GORGEOUS BARN WITH HEAT AND AC WAS COMPLETELY RENOVATED IN 2013. VERY SPECIAL, ADAPTABLE SPACE FOR MUSIC, ART STUDIO OR PARTIES. Recent improvements include exterior painting of barn, main house and detached garage in 2024. New oil tank 2025 and all hardwood floors throughout were sanded and refinished 2026, NEW 5 BEDROOM SEPTIC LEACHING FIELDS IN 2022. HOUSE IS 4 BEDROOMS. NEW FIELDS ARE NEAR BARN. WELL, MEANING WATER ACCESS IS ALSO NEAR BARN. Exclusions: Dining Room Chandelier.

This FULLY RENOVATED home offers modern updates and a pastoral setting in Wilton. The property features 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, a new central heating and AC system, and an attached 2-car garage. The layout includes 3 bedrooms with walk-in closets, plus a flexible 4th room suitable for an additional bedroom or office. Inside, the open floor plan connects the kitchen to bright living spaces and updated bathrooms. Outside, a stone pathway leads up the hill to a private picnic area overlooking the house. Minimum of 10 Months rental.

Tucked within a serene 11-acre setting, this bright, first-floor studio offers simple, stress-free living. Open layout, gallery kitchen, full bath, and one dedicated parking space. Landlord covers heat, electric, trash, and grounds maintenance. Quiet setting. No laundry. Strong credit required.

A true New England Classic- 39 West Meadow Rd was built in 1931 in "The Meadows," a neighborhood of architecturally significant homes. Upon entering the foyer, you are greeted by a sweeping staircase with grand living and dining rooms on either side. Each room offers gracious space for gathering and entertaining, showcasing timeless original craftsmanship, including beautifully carved mantel, fireplace, built-in corner china cabinets, and elegant dentil molding.  The kitchen features Viking & LG stainless steel appliances and an eat-in dining area with French doors to a private bluestone patio. A spacious family room/den off the living room is ideal for movie night, game days, or possible home office. Above the garage, an au-pair or in-law suite offers 2 bedrooms, a full bath, and a private entrance, as well as a mudroom and laundry area off the kitchen. Continue to the upper levels of the main house, and you will find 6 additional private bedrooms. The 2nd floor hosts 4 oversized bedrooms, including a Primary en-suite, as well as a hall bath, while the light and bright 3rd floor offers 2 more bedrooms and a full bath. Outside, mature trees and gardens with specimen plantings bloom with color throughout the seasons. Relax on the bluestone patio and enjoy your own private oasis- a rare opportunity to own this Classic Beauty in South Wilton!

Welcome to 561 Belden Hill Road! A beautiful, move-in-ready 4 bedroom 3 bath home set on 2+ acres of beautifully landscaped property in desirable South Wilton with CITY WATER. Unique combination of a convenient commuting location with generous living spaces and an incredible flat, private yard. The perfect balance of everyday comfort, entertaining, and outdoor enjoyment. Inside, gracious well-proportioned rooms with plenty of space for family and friends. The eat-in kitchen opens to a bright expansive sunroom with peaceful views of the surrounding grounds. The elegant living room with custom built-ins and gas fireplace flows into the dining room. A comfortable family room with gas fireplace, along with a full bath and laundry room. Upstairs you will find 4 generously sized bedrooms including the primary bedroom suite w/walk-in closet, and 3 other bedrooms and full bath providing comfortable accommodations for family and guests. The lower level offers a spacious bonus room with endless possibilities for a playroom, home office, media room, or additional recreation space. The outdoor setting is truly exceptional. An attached two-car garage is complemented by an oversized detached garage with a loft. Ideally situated in South Wilton, this home offers easy access to the Merritt Parkway, I-95, shopping, town amenities, and Wilton's award-winning schools. Enjoy the best of suburban living with a convenient commute and a peaceful, private setting to call home.

Ideally situated in South Wilton, 175 Range Road blends charming character with modern comfort and everyday convenience. Just minutes to town, train, schools, and commuter routes, the home enjoys a private setting framed by professional landscaping, flowering perennials and accent trees, an expansive front lawn, and a beautiful stone patio out back, ideal for entertaining or quiet relaxation. Inside, architectural details shine with warm wooden beams, custom kitchen design, wide plank flooring, a vaulted ceiling, pocket doors, and an original stone fireplace. The kitchen features custom cabinetry, while the living and family rooms offer warm and bright gathering spaces. A sound system, natural stone half bath, and custom closets complete the first floor. The stunning primary suite feels like a private retreat, offering expansive windows, and a beautifully appointed ensuite bath with natural stone, a soaking tub, separate shower, and radiant heated floors. Additionally, the primary offers four closets including a spacious walk-in as well as a cedar closet. Two additional, well-proportioned bedrooms and hallway bath complement the upstairs. Completing the second floor is a spacious loft overlooking the kitchen offering numerous possibilities. An oversized two-car garage provides ample storage and flexibility. Distinctive, inviting, and exceptionally located, this is South Wilton living at its best.

Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in desirable South Wilton, this beautifully updated New England Colonial offers timeless charm, modern comfort, and 1.2 private, professionally landscaped acres. Thoughtfully refreshed interiors feature refinished hardwood floors, updated lighting and hardware, and a sophisticated color palette. An exceptional floor plan offers generously sized living spaces with effortless flow. The beautifully appointed kitchen boasts Viking appliances, custom cabinetry, a walk-in pantry, wet bar, and expansive counter space. Opening to a welcoming family room with a river stone fireplace, this space is ideal for everyday living and entertaining. A spacious mudroom, main-level laundry, and screened porch add convenience and charm. Upstairs, four generous bedrooms, three full baths, a versatile fifth room, and a spectacular bonus room above the garage offer exceptional flexibility. The finished lower-level features recreation and fitness spaces, plus an impressive temperature-controlled wine cellar. A walk-up attic provides ample storage and third-floor expansion potential.Outside, level lawns, a picturesque stream, and an expansive private driveway create a truly peaceful setting. A charming footbridge crosses the stream to a dedicated gardening area with raised beds. A whole-house generator and two-car garage complete this exceptional home, just minutes from Wilton Center, downtown Westport, and Metro-North.
